title: AhaBench: Do Agents Learn from Prior Experience? A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Continual Learning
summary: Modern language agents are expected to operate over long horizons: they ask follow-up questions, reuse worked examples, handle tool feedback, and adapt to delayed consequences. Most evaluations still reset the agent after a prompt or score only the final state of one trajectory. AhaBench asks a more operational question: when a fixed model receives useful experience, does its later behavior improve under a related evaluation condition where the obvious support has been removed, changed, or delayed? The suite contains three components. Aha-Puzzle tests no-hint exploration after solved hidden-state puzzles; Aha-Euler turns Project-Euler-style mathematical ideas into generated taught/held-out tasks with exact validators; and Aha-Vending, an open-source implementation inspired by Vending-Bench, tests whether a simulated vending agent remains profitable while handling delayed feedback and operational incidents. AhaBench reports a three-part scorecard: Initial Score measures starting competence, Post-Experience Score measures the later empirical outcome, and Learning Lift is their difference. This decomposition is the main empirical message: models that use visible support well, models that reach high post-experience scores, and models that improve most during a run are not always the same. On the common eight-model panel, Claude Opus 4.6 leads aggregate Post-Experience Score at 64.3 and aggregate Learning Lift at +25.8, with Gemini 3.1 Pro close behind at 63.4. The component results explain the split: puzzle traces raise supported scores but often fail to become no-hint exploration behavior; Aha-Euler full teaching reaches 78.6-100.0% while answer-only transfer ranges from 0.0 to 73.9%; and Aha-Vending separates profitable incident handling from bankruptcy and no-order failure. We release benchmark tasks, rubrics, validators, simulator code, and interfaces for evaluating new agents.

AI.tldr: AhaBench提出了一个新的基准套件，通过三分量任务（Aha-Puzzle、Aha-Euler、Aha-Vending）评估语言代理在接收到有用经验后，能否在支持被移除、改变或延迟的条件下实现行为改进。它引入三部分评分卡（初始得分、经验后得分、学习提升），揭示了"善用支持"、"达到高分"和"提升最大"的模型往往不是同一批模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的语言代理评估大多在单次提示后重置代理，或仅评分单条轨迹的最终状态，无法回答"模型在获得有用经验后，后续行为是否在相关但支持被移除/改变/延迟的评估条件下得到改善"这一操作性问题。作者希望构建一个能真正反映代理长时程学习能力的基准。
AI.method: AhaBench包含三个组件：Aha-Puzzle测试无提示探索能力（在解决隐含状态谜题后）；Aha-Euler将类Project-Euler数学概念转化为教/测分离的生成任务并配备精确验证器；Aha-Vending（开源实现，灵感来自Vending-Bench）测试模拟售货机代理在延迟反馈和运营事故下能否保持盈利。评估采用三部分评分卡：初始得分、经验后得分和学习提升（两者之差）。
AI.result: 在8个模型的公共面板上，Claude Opus 4.6在聚合经验后得分（64.3）和聚合学习提升（+25.8）方面领先，Gemini 3.1 Pro紧随其后（63.4）。各组件显示：谜题轨迹能提高有支持得分但难以转化为无提示探索行为；Aha-Euler完整教学达到78.6-100.0%，而仅答案迁移仅0.0-73.9%；Aha-Vending能区分盈利的事故处理与破产/无订单失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 核心实证结论是：能很好使用可见支持的模型、能达到高经验后得分的模型、以及在运行过程中提升最大的模型，并不总是同一批模型。AhaBench的分数分解揭示了这种分歧，并发布了基准任务、评分标准、验证器、仿真代码和新代理评估接口。

title: When Do Options Help? Policy Necrosis and Redundant Coverage in Option-Critic
summary: Option-critic learns options: sub-policies together with a learned rule for when each one hands control back. Its headline result is that performance improves as options are added. We explain that result, with theory and experiment. First, the termination rule option-critic learns by maximising return contributes nothing. When the termination test and the policy that picks options read the same values, the test fires at every step, so the learned rule is identical to always terminating. When that policy explores and the test does not, as in option-critic itself, the rule can block the exploration; there are instances where it suffers $Ω(T)$ regret while always terminating holds to $O(\log T)$. Forcing termination at every step leaves the option-count curve intact. Second, the policy inside an option barely explores at all, so a state locks onto the first action that looked good and never updates again. We name this policy necrosis, give a state-level test for it, and find three fifths of states necrotic in a typical option. Restoring exploration repairs those states, and one option then solves the task. Third, extra options improve no option; what falls is the chance that all of them fail in the same state, from $59\\%$ to $4\\%$, and performance follows that joint quantity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过理论和实验揭示了option-critic方法性能提升的真实来源：终止规则几乎不起作用（退化为每步终止），option内部策略存在"策略坏死"问题导致缺乏探索，而多个option带来的性能提升源于降低了所有option在同一状态同时失效的概率（从59%降至4%），并非option本身质量提升。
AI.motivation: Option-critic的核心宣称是随option数量增加性能会提升，但其头条结果缺乏充分的理论解释。作者旨在厘清这一性能提升背后的真实机制，而不是笼统接受表面结论。
AI.method: 结合理论分析与实验验证：(1)证明当终止规则与option选择策略读取相同值时，终止测试每步都触发，学习到的规则等价于始终终止；(2)证明终止规则可能阻碍探索并导致Ω(T)遗憾；(3)提出"策略坏死"概念，给出状态级诊断测试；(4)通过对比实验分析多个option减少联合失败概率的效应。
AI.result: 终止规则对option-critic无实质贡献；每步强制终止不改变option数量-性能曲线；option内部策略存在坏死现象，约五分之三的状态陷入坏死；恢复探索后单个option即可解决问题；多个option的性能提升源于联合失败概率从59%降至4%。
AI.conclusion: Option-critic的性能提升并非来自其设计宣称的机制（学习终止规则与子策略），而是统计上的"保险效应"——增加option降低了所有策略在同一状态全部失效的可能性。该结论对option-based强化学习方法的设计具有重要警示意义。

title: Multi-granularity Adaptive Hypergraph Representation Learning via Granular-ball
summary: Hypergraph representation learning aims to capture high-order information in graphs by constructing hyperedges that simultaneously connect multiple nodes. These hyperedges adapt to the graph's topological features, facilitating the extraction of high-order relationships at multiple granularities. Most prior work relies on predefined definitions to generate hyperedges, overlooking the diversity in graph topological structures and the multi-granularity characteristics of hyperedges. As a result, this limits their ability to effectively and adaptively discover high-order relationships and efficiently process complex structural information. To address this limitation, we propose a novel framework called \underline{M}ulti-\underline{G}ranularity \underline{H}ypergraph \underline{R}epresentation \underline{L}earning (MGHRL). MGHRL introduces an Adaptive Granular Hypergraph Generation strategy, which generates hyperedges at multiple levels of granularity through the adaptive splitting of granular-ball, effectively capturing high-order relationships based on the graph's topological structure. Additionally, we propose a Multi-Granularity Hypergraph Network with multiple sub-networks, capturing features from hyperedges at different granularities and integrating them via hierarchical reversible connections. Experimental results show that MGHRL significantly outperforms baseline models on benchmark datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MGHRL框架，通过自适应粒度超图生成策略和多重子网络的多粒度超图网络，有效捕捉图中多粒度高阶关系，实验验证其显著优于基线模型。
AI.motivation: 现有超图表示学习方法依赖预定义规则生成超边，忽视了图拓扑结构的多样性以及超边的多粒度特性，导致无法有效且自适应地发现高阶层关系和处理复杂结构信息。
AI.method: 提出MGHRL框架，包含两个核心组件：(1)自适应粒度超图生成策略，通过粒度球的自适应分裂在多个粒度层级生成超边，基于图拓扑结构捕捉高阶层关系；(2)多粒度超图网络，由多个子网络构成，分别捕捉不同粒度超边的特征，并通过层级可逆连接进行特征整合。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的实验结果表明，MGHRL显著优于各类基线模型。
AI.conclusion: MGHRL通过自适应粒度超图生成与多粒度特征融合，有效解决了现有方法对图结构多样性和超边多粒度特性关注不足的问题，为超图表示学习提供了新的思路。

title: Capsule Lens: Locating and Tracking Concept Geometry in Model Representations
summary: Understanding how concepts are encoded in the internal representations of machine learning models is a central problem in mechanistic interpretability, essential both for the science of deep learning and for the trustworthy deployment of increasingly capable models. Existing approaches to interpret model representations mainly map representations onto more interpretable spaces and do not directly characterize how concepts occupy representation space; various hypotheses have been proposed, but often lack of rigorous validation and largely focus on static representations. In this work, we introduce Capsule Lens, a framework that matches the region a concept occupies with a simple, trackable geometric form, a capsule, defined by several interpretable parameters, fitted in closed form to each concept's geometry and validated on held-out samples. We apply Capsule Lens in two major settings: static and dynamic representations. On static representations, we demonstrate how to locate concept geometry across various models, and how the span and norm curves uncover important geometric characteristics. On dynamic representations, we present three case studies tracking representation drifts induced by distinct training settings, CLIP pretraining, RL post-training on visual question answering, and RL post-training on mathematical reasoning. These analyses reveal qualitatively different geometric dynamics, ranging from broad network-wide restructuring in CLIP pretraining to localized and concept-specific changes in RL post-training. Our results include findings aligned with existing literature as well as novel observations. We believe Capsule Lens stands as a promising tool for locating, analyzing, and tracking concept geometry in both static and dynamic representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Capsule Lens框架，用可解析的几何形式（胶囊）刻画机器学习模型内部表示中概念所占的区域，支持静态与动态两类表示的分析与追踪。
AI.motivation: 现有可解释性方法主要将表示映射到可解释空间，缺乏对概念在表示空间中几何占位的直接刻画；已有假设缺少严格验证且多聚焦于静态表示。
AI.method: 用胶囊（capsule）这种由若干可解释参数定义、具有封闭形式求解能力的几何形状来拟合每个概念的表示区域，并在留出样本上验证。在静态与动态两类表示上均适用。
AI.result: 静态表示上能够定位多种模型的概念几何并揭示关键几何特性；动态表示上通过CLIP预训练、VQA上的RL后训练、数学推理上的RL后训练三个案例，展示了从全局网络重构（CLIP）到局部概念特异性变化（RL）的不同几何动态，发现与既有文献一致及新的观察。
AI.conclusion: Capsule Lens是定位、分析与追踪静态和动态表示中概念几何的有效工具，有望推动概念几何与表示漂移的进一步科学理解。

title: Seeing Without Understanding: Large Language Model Evaluation of Mobile User Interface Quality, Failure Taxonomy, and Architectural Explanation
summary: Evaluating mobile user interface quality at scale remains a persistent challenge in software engineering and human-computer interaction. Rule-based heuristic methods offer structural reliability but demand significant engineering effort, while human annotation does not scale to the volume of applications produced annually. Large language models present a promising alternative, yet their reliability for structured UI judgment has not been systematically examined, and the patterns behind their failures remain insufficiently characterized. This paper addresses both gaps. We begin with the complete RICO dataset of 66,261 real-world mobile application screens, from which we derive a refined evaluation corpus of 15,000 screens through a rigorous, literature-guided selection process. Each screen is assessed across seven criteria: structural JSON validity, minimum visible element count, clickable component presence, non-zero layout bounds, image integrity, and perceptual duplicate removal. Against this corpus, we apply a heuristic baseline built from severity-weighted usability signals, normalized layout metrics, and pixel-ratio complexity measures calibrated to real user sentiment. Multiple language models independently rate each screen across usability, layout quality, and visual complexity from structured JSON descriptions and raw screenshots. Dimension-level comparison against the heuristic uses agreement rates, Cohen's Kappa, and confidence calibration. Recurring divergence patterns are organized into a failure taxonomy and interpreted through transformer architectural signatures: MLE plausibility bias, attention misgrounding, and autoregressive over-commitment.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了大语言模型在移动应用界面质量判断任务上的可靠性，基于66,261个RICO屏幕构建15,000个精炼评估语料，与基于严重性加权启发式基准进行多维度对比，揭示模型失败模式并将其归类为基于Transformer架构特征的故障分类体系。
AI.motivation: 移动界面质量评估面临两方面痛点：基于规则的启发式方法工程量大且难以规模化，人工标注无法应对海量应用；而大语言模型作为替代方案尚未被系统性检验其结构化UI判断的可靠性，失败模式也不清晰。
AI.method: 从完整RICO数据集（66,261个屏幕）中通过文献引导的严格筛选得到15,000个屏幕的评估语料，每个屏幕按七项标准（JSON结构有效性、最小可见元素数、可点击组件存在性、非零布局边界、图像完整性、感知重复移除）评估；建立基于严重性加权可用性信号、标准化布局指标和像素比复杂度（校准至真实用户情绪）的启发式基线；多个语言模型独立基于结构化JSON描述和原始截图评估可用性、布局质量和视觉复杂度；在维度层面与启发式基线比较使用一致率、Cohen Kappa和置信度校准。
AI.result: 研究发现语言模型与启发式基线在维度比较中呈现特定的分歧模式，论文将这些重复性分歧整理为故障分类体系，并通过Transformer架构特征（MLE似然偏置、注意力错位、自回归过度承诺）进行解释。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型在移动UI质量评估上的可靠性具有系统性局限，其失败模式可追溯至Transformer架构的内在特征，为未来改进LLM驱动的UI评估方法提供了方向性指引。

title: Beyond Right and Wrong: Evaluating Second-order Social Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Previous AI alignment efforts have focused primarily on first-order social norms -- teaching models what is socially acceptable or unacceptable (e.g., `do not steal'). However, social intelligence depends not only on norm recognition, but also on anticipating who will enforce it and how (e.g., public shame or even imprisonment). These second-order expectations, known as metanorms, govern how people respond when social rules are broken. We introduce a novel framework for evaluating metanorm reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) along two dimensions: emotional appraisal and behavioral response, and propose new classification tasks, namely, predicting self-regulation in violators, and other-regulation in observers. We release a multi-perspective dataset, NormReact, of 450 norm violation scenarios, hand-annotated for emotions and behavioral responses across norm violators' gender and observers' social closeness. Current LLMs portray a harsher social world: across six models, they overpredict negative sanctions where humans would expect inaction, and alignment with human judgments deteriorates as social distance increases. These findings suggest that AI systems in norm-sensitive domains from conflict mediation to policy simulation, may risk producing a distorted picture of social regulation: one that over-represents punishment and under-represents the tolerance, restraint, and relational calibration that characterize actual norm enforcement in real world.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种评估大语言模型（LLMs）元规范推理能力的新框架，包含情感评价和行为反应两个维度，并引入两个新分类任务（预测违规者的自我调节和观察者的他者调节）。作者发布了一个包含450个规范违规场景的多视角数据集NormReact，研究发现当前LLMs倾向于过度预测负面制裁，且社会距离增加时与人类判断的一致性下降，可能导致AI在规范敏感领域产生扭曲的社会规范执行图景。
AI.motivation: 以往的AI对齐研究主要关注一阶社会规范（教导模型什么可接受/不可接受），但社会智能不仅依赖于规范识别，还依赖于预判谁会执行规范以及如何执行（如公众羞辱或监禁）。这些二阶期望（元规范）被现有研究忽视，缺乏系统性的评估框架和数据集来考察LLMs在这方面的推理能力。
AI.method: 提出了一个沿情感评价和行为反应两个维度评估LLM元规范推理的框架，设计了两个新分类任务（预测违规者自我调节和观察者他者调节），并构建了一个包含450个规范违规场景的多视角数据集NormReact，手工标注了不同违规者性别和观察者社会亲近度条件下的情感和行为反应。
AI.result: 在六个LLM模型上进行评估，发现所有模型都倾向于过度预测负面制裁，而人类在这些情境下往往预期不采取行动；同时随着社交距离的增加，LLM与人类判断的一致性明显下降。
AI.conclusion: 当前AI系统在冲突调解、政策模拟等规范敏感领域可能产生扭曲的社会调控图景——过度代表惩罚而低估了真实世界规范执行中的宽容、克制和关系校准。

title: HB-PVI: A Hierarchical Bayesian Personalization and Value-of-Information Framework for Complex Activity Recognition
comment: Manuscript submitted to IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
summary: Personalization can improve activity-recognition performance, but participant-specific gains are heterogeneous, and every additional calibration label has an acquisition cost. This study presents HB-PVI, a hierarchical Bayesian personalization and value-of-information framework jointly modeling participant heterogeneity, the benefit and harm of four personalization mechanisms, and the economic value of an additional label, for the 47-participant MUSIC-CAR complex-activity cohort. A leakage-safe, leave-one-participant-out evaluation combines a sequential-Monte-Carlo participant-effect updater with a Student-$t$ hierarchical gain model and a one-step expected-value-of-sample-information (EVSI) stopping rule. Adapter personalization produced small positive mean F1 gains, growing from 0.00099 at one label to 0.00198 at ten, while adapter-plus-head and prototype-residual personalization were negative on average. Under the primary practical-benefit threshold ($Δ_{\min}=0.01$) and cost setting, one-step EVSI was zero at every decision state, so the policy purchased no labels and retained population inference for all 47 participants, matching always-stop exactly (region-of-practical-equivalence probability $=1$). Relative to fixed ten-shot adapter personalization, this reduced labeling by 100\% while keeping the posterior mean F1 loss at 0.00217 (95\% credible interval, 0.00048 to 0.00389), with posterior probability 0.9992 of remaining below the 0.005 tolerance. HB-PVI was utility-optimal in 199 of 216 cost-threshold settings and in every setting at or above the primary label cost. These results argue for a population-first deployment policy whenever personalization gains are small relative to labeling, computation, and harm costs, and show that value-of-information reasoning, not raw predictive accuracy, should drive personalization decisions in health-sensing applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HB-PVI，一种分层贝叶斯个性化与信息价值框架，用于在47名参与者的复杂活动识别数据上联合建模参与者异质性、四种个性化机制的收益与危害以及额外标签的经济价值。结果显示适配器个性化的F1增益极小（0.00099至0.00198），一步EVSI在所有决策状态下为零，因此最优策略是不购买任何标签并保留群体推断，相比固定十次个性化减少了100%标注成本且F1损失仅0.00217。HB-PVI在216种成本-阈值组合中的199种下达到效用最优，主张在个性化增益小于标注/计算等成本时采用群体优先部署策略。
AI.motivation: 个性化可提升活动识别性能，但参与者特异性增益具有异质性，且每个额外校准标签都有获取成本。现有研究缺乏一个统一框架来同时量化个性化机制的收益与潜在危害，以及额外标签的经济价值，因此需要一种能够权衡个性化收益与标注成本的方法来指导部署决策。
AI.method: 采用分层贝叶斯框架（HB-PVI），整合参与者异质性建模、四种个性化机制（适配器、适配器+头部、原型残差等）的收益/危害评估，以及信息价值分析。评估采用防泄漏的留一参与者法，结合序贯蒙特卡洛参与者效应更新器、Student-t分层增益模型和一步期望样本信息价值（EVSI）停止规则。
AI.result: 适配器个性化在1个标签时F1增益为0.00099，10个标签时为0.00198，均为小幅正值；适配器+头部和原型残差个性化平均为负。在实际收益阈值（Δmin=0.01）和成本设置下，所有决策状态的一步EVSI为零，策略不购买任何标签，与始终停止策略完全一致（实际等价概率=1）。相比固定十次适配器个性化，标注减少100%，F1后验均值损失仅0.00217。HB-PVI在216个设置中的199个达到效用最优。
AI.conclusion: 当个性化增益相对于标注、计算和危害成本较小时，应优先采用群体推断而非个性化。在健康感知应用中，个人信息价值推理而非原始预测准确性应驱动个性化决策。

title: Companion AI and Ethical Design: Learning from System Failures and User Desires
comment: 21 pages, accepted in peer reviewed conference: Future Technologies Conference - to be included in Springer nature conference proceedings 2026
summary: Human users are interacting with chatbots and companion AI technologies as if they were human. A growing array of AI-systems are now trained to recognise, interpret and simulate feeling in user interactions. Ethical considerations such as fairness, accountability, transparency and explainability (FATE) are paramount in technologies designed to socially interact with humans and/or support relationship development. Using a semantic approach, we examine 14,081 comments in a Reddit user discussion forum about Replika, a leading companion AI app, across a four-year period. We ask what user-reported functional errors can tell us about human-AI intimacy in companion AI communities, and what ethical design framework can be developed in response. The findings show that functional errors, or ``bugs,'' impose an emotional cost on users, reducing feelings of intimacy and highlighting the need for more robust, resilient design systems that incorporate stochastic and iterative forms of intimacy in companion AI applications. Rather than ``artificial intimacy'' or ``pseudo- intimacy'', we propose the more inclusive term ``Intimate AI'' to describe this relationship. Based on the findings, we offer a contextually aware, applied Expert Systems design framework for the programming and designing of Intimate AI that accounts for user feedback and ethical AI development.

AI.tldr: 本文通过语义分析方法，研究了Reddit论坛上四年间关于Replika伴侣AI应用的14,081条用户评论，探讨用户报告的功能错误如何影响人机亲密关系，并据此提出包含随机性与迭代性亲密设计的伦理设计框架，倡导用"亲密AI"取代"人工亲密"的概念。研究发现功能错误会给用户带来情感成本、降低亲密感，凸显了更稳健、有韧性的设计系统的必要性。
AI.motivation: 用户越来越多地以对待人类的方式与聊天机器人和伴侣AI技术互动，且AI系统被训练去识别、解释和模拟情感。涉及公平性、问责性、透明度和可解释性（FATE）的伦理考量在社交互动和关系发展型技术中至关重要，需要系统性理解用户报告的AI功能问题及其对人机亲密关系的影响。
AI.method: 采用语义分析方法，对Reddit用户讨论论坛中关于Replika（一款领先的伴侣AI应用）的14,081条评论进行了跨越四年的文本分析，聚焦用户报告的功能错误（即"bug"），并以此为基础提出伦理设计框架。
AI.result: 功能错误对用户施加了情感成本，降低了用户的亲密感，表明需要采用结合随机性和迭代性亲密形式的更稳健、更具韧性的设计系统。研究还提出"亲密AI"这一更具包容性的术语来替代"人工亲密"或"伪亲密"。
AI.conclusion: 基于研究发现，文章提供了一个情境感知的、面向应用的专业系统设计框架，用于亲密AI的编程与设计，该框架兼顾了用户反馈和伦理AI开发的需求。

title: CriticGen: Generation-Aware Evaluation as Actionable Feedback
summary: Current evaluation methods for large language models are coarse-grained and decoupled from generation, producing generic explanations that fail to provide actionable feedback for model improvement. We propose CriticGen, a fine-grained, generation-aware evaluation framework that turns evaluation into actionable control for answer improvement. CriticGen first generates sample-specific evaluation dimensions and scoring criteria under high-level categories such as subjective, objective, and self-derived constraints. These criteria then serve as a dynamic rubric for jointly producing a score, a reason, an executable refinement suggestion, and a refined answer. This rubric-conditioned refinement process enables models to diagnose flaws and perform targeted answer improvement. Experimental results show that fine-grained evaluation should be both instance-specific and actionable. CriticGen induces higher-quality rubrics, improving relevance/coverage from 3.33/4.03 to 3.97/4.24. CriticGen also achieves the best score correlations, with 0.9556 Pearson and 0.9560 Spearman, and raises the F1 of criterion-grounded reasons and executable suggestions from 0.6369/0.5994 to 0.7554/0.7900. Crucially, its feedback translates into reliable answer improvement, improving 73.17% of answers with a 93.28% non-degradation rate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CriticGen，一种细粒度、生成感知的大语言模型评估框架，通过生成实例特定的评估维度和评分标准作为动态评估规则，使模型能诊断缺陷并执行有针对性的答案改进，在相关性、相关性覆盖及答案改进率等指标上均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评估方法粒度粗糙且与生成过程脱节，产生的泛化解释无法为模型改进提供可操作的反馈，难以真正指导模型提升。
AI.method: CriticGen首先在高层次类别（主观、客观、自定约束）下生成样例特定的评估维度和评分标准，将其作为动态评估规则（rubric），用于联合生成分数、理由、可执行的改进建议和改进后的答案，实现基于规则的答案精细化改进。
AI.result: CriticGen使相关性/覆盖率从3.33/4.03提升至3.97/4.24；Pearson相关系数达0.9556、Spearman达0.9560；理由和建议的F1从0.6369/0.5994提升至0.7554/0.7900；改善73.17%的答案，非退化率达93.28%。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度评估应当既具实例特异性又可操作，CriticGen通过将评估转化为可执行的控制信号，实现了评估与生成的深度融合，为LLM的针对性改进提供了有效途径。

title: Endogenous Exploration in Reinforcement Learning with Intrinsic Curiosity
summary: We propose a reinforcement learning framework in which exploration is driven by intrinsic curiosity, designed for scenarios where environments are non-stationary and rewards are sparse, delayed, uninformative, or absent. In our model, action selection is guided by a combination of external rewards and an epistemic motivation mechanism that biases the agent toward structured exploratory directions. The central hypothesis is that effective exploration emerges at intermediate levels of incoherence, while performance degrades under both overly rigid and overly disordered dynamics. To test this idea, we implement the framework on top of a Liquid State Machine (LSM) substrate and evaluate it on two standard benchmarks: the discrete-action LunarLanderv2 and the continuous-control BipedalWalkerv3. The proposed method achieves competitive performance on both tasks relative to established deep RL algorithms, including Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) and Intrinsic Curiosity Module (ICM). We further show that the curiosity window is not recovered in Active Inference agents under the same analysis, suggesting that the proposed dynamics capture a distinct exploration regime

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于内在好奇心的强化学习框架，结合外部奖励与认识性动机机制，在液态状态机（LSM）平台上实现，并在LunarLander和BipedalWalker基准上取得与PPO、ICM相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 针对非平稳、奖励稀疏或缺失的环境中传统强化学习探索不足的问题，研究者假设有效探索出现在中等程度的"不协调"（incoherence）水平下，并希望通过好奇心驱动的认识性动机机制实现这一探索区间。
AI.method: 构建一种由外部奖励与认识性动机机制共同引导行动选择的强化学习框架，使智能体偏向结构化探索方向；将框架实现于Liquid State Machine（LSM）基底上，并与Active Inference代理进行对比分析。
AI.result: 该方法在离散动作的LunarLander和连续控制的BipedalWalker两个基准测试上取得与PPO和ICM等成熟深度强化学习算法相当的竞争性能；同时发现Active Inference代理未表现出相同的好奇心窗口。
AI.conclusion: 提出的好奇心驱动探索机制在中等不协调水平下能产生有效探索，且该探索机制代表了一种区别于Active Inference的独特探索模式，对非平稳稀疏奖励环境中的强化学习具有潜在价值。

title: From Sensor Data to Classroom Inquiry: GenAI-Supported Exploration of School Digital Twin Data
comment: Submitted to the 12th IEEE International Smart Cities Conference 2026 (ISC2 2026) and accepted for publication
summary: Digital Twins for educational buildings can support sustainability-oriented learning, but their use in schools remains limited. This paper presents a GenAI-based chatbot built on top of an existing Digital Twin for two school buildings in Greece, using real IoT data from environmental sensors and energy meters. The chatbot enables educators to query live and historical building data, compare spaces, and generate ideas for classroom activities through natural language. The system was evaluated in an 80-minute workshop with 17 secondary-school educators, who compared it with an existing web-based dashboard. Results show strong perceived usability and pedagogical value, particularly for inquiry-based learning, hypothesis formation, and interdisciplinary lesson planning. Participants also highlighted limitations related to response speed, data verification, trust, and the continued value of visual dashboards. Overall, the findings suggest that GenAI interfaces can make Digital Twin data more accessible for educational use, provided they are designed with transparency, verification, and pedagogical grounding.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个基于生成式AI的聊天机器人，构建在希腊两所学校的数字孪生系统之上，利用真实IoT传感器和能源计量数据，让教育工作者通过自然语言查询建筑数据并生成课堂活动创意。在17名中学教育工作者的80分钟工作坊评估中，系统展现出良好的可用性和教学价值，但也存在响应速度、数据验证和信任等方面的局限。
AI.motivation: 数字孪生技术在教育建筑中可支持可持续发展学习，但其在学校场景中的应用仍然有限，且现有基于Web的可视化仪表板对教育工作者而言数据访问门槛较高，需要更自然直观的交互方式来提升数据的教育可用性。
AI.method: 基于已有的两所希腊学校建筑数字孪生系统，集成真实IoT环境传感器和能源计量数据，构建GenAI驱动的聊天机器人。系统支持自然语言查询实时和历史建筑数据、空间对比以及生成课堂活动建议。通过80分钟工作坊对17名中学教育工作者进行实证评估，并与现有Web仪表板进行对比。
AI.result: 系统在感知可用性和教学价值方面获得较高评价，尤其在探究式学习、假设形成和跨学科课程规划方面表现突出。参与者同时指出了响应速度、数据验证、信任问题以及可视化仪表板仍然具有价值的局限性。
AI.conclusion: GenAI界面能够显著提升数字孪生数据在教育场景中的可访问性，但需要以透明度、可验证性和教学理论为基础进行设计，才能充分发挥其在可持续发展教育中的潜力。

title: When Does Memory Help? A Cost-Aware Evaluation of Long-Term Memory in Tool-Using LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory for LLM agents is evaluated today by conversational recall benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval), which measure question answering over dialogue history, not whether remembered facts change what a tool-using agent does. We present MERIT (Memory Evaluation for Realistic Instrumented Tasks), a benchmark and harness that measures the marginal utility of memory for task-executing agents under explicit cost accounting. MERIT provides episodic tool-use tasks in three domains whose dependence on earlier-episode facts is verified by an automated leak check; a difficulty ladder ending in updated-fact recall; controlled memory corruption; and full token and dollar metering of every memory operation. Across 23,440 scored episodes ($42.57), a two-generation pilot on gpt-4.1-mini and a preregistered 3-model x 3-seed grid (GPT-4.1, Claude Haiku 4.5; memory side held fixed), memory lifts dependent-task success from a leak-verified floor of 0.00 to 0.55-1.00. On updated facts, embedding retrieval collapses unpredictably (0.30-0.95 across models; max seed gap 0.45), and agents act on a correctly retrieved value only 55% of the time, while update-on-write stores (a structured fact store and, notably, LLM summarization) remain at 0.70-1.00; the hybrid is worse than the fact store alone. A latest-generation spot-check (Claude Sonnet 5, gated on a clean full-replay control) reproduces the pattern. Swapping a memory's implementation moves task success by up to 60 points, and full replay is never economical: the best condition per domain delivers 2.7-3.9x its marginal utility per dollar. We release the benchmark, harness, and all traces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MERIT基准与测试框架，用于评估工具型LLM代理的长时记忆的实际效用。通过三项记忆任务、泄漏校验和严格的成本核算，研究发现记忆能显著提升依赖任务成功率（0到0.55-1.00），但嵌入检索在更新事实场景下表现不稳定，更新时写入的结构化存储和LLM摘要方法更可靠。记忆实现方式的不同可使任务成功率产生高达60个百分点的差异，且完整回放策略永远不经济。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM代理长时记忆评测（如LoCoMo、LongMemEval）主要基于对话历史问答来评估记忆，而非考察记忆事实是否真正改变工具使用代理的实际行为。因此需要一个能够衡量记忆在任务执行代理中边际效用的评测框架，并明确考虑成本核算。
AI.method: 构建MERIT基准与测试框架：设计三个领域的工具使用片段任务，依赖早期片段事实，通过自动化泄漏检查验证任务确实需要记忆；包含难度递增的阶梯直至更新事实回忆；受控记忆损坏；对每个记忆操作进行全面token和美元计量。采用两代试点（gpt-4.1-mini）以及预先注册的3模型×3种子网格（GPT-4.1、Claude Haiku 4.5）进行实验，并做了Claude Sonnet 5的spot-check验证。
AI.result: 在23,440个评分片段（成本$42.57）中，记忆将依赖任务成功率从泄漏验证的0.00提升至0.55-1.00。更新事实场景下嵌入检索性能不稳定（跨模型0.30-0.95，最大种子差距0.45），代理仅有55%的概率正确执行检索到的值；更新时写入存储（结构化事实存储及LLM摘要）保持0.70-1.00，混合方案劣于单独的事实存储。交换记忆实现可使任务成功率波动达60个百分点，完整回放始终不经济，最优条件每美元带来2.7-3.9倍的边际效用。
AI.conclusion: MERIT证明不同记忆实现对工具执行代理的实际任务影响差异巨大，更新时写入策略优于嵌入检索，混合检索架构可能反而损害性能，且成本约束下完整回放并非理性选择。研究开源了基准、测试框架及全部trace数据。

title: Robustness of LLM-Generated SystemVerilog Assertions to Semantics-Preserving RTL Transformations
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being explored for automating SystemVerilog Assertion (SVA) generation, yet most evaluations report correctness on a single syntactic representation of an input. Such point accuracy does not reveal whether a model's correct output is stable when the same RTL behavior is written differently. This paper presents a controlled metamorphic evaluation of LLM-based SVA generation under semantics-preserving RTL transformations. Starting from the VERT dataset, we construct a quality-filtered conditional-control pool and a stratified 40-program evaluation set containing 295 assignment behaviors. We evaluate two open code models, Qwen2.5-Coder-7B and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite, with an identical evaluation prompt and greedy decoding. Three transformations are studied: operand reordering, deterministic identifier renaming, and redundant parenthesization. Beyond baseline and transformed accuracy, we measure conditional robustness, invariance failure, and any-flip rate, with 10,000-sample clustered bootstrap intervals at the RTL-program level. Across all six model-transformation conditions, 9.7%-27.0% of behaviors that were correct on the original RTL become incorrect after a semantics-preserving transformation. Aggregate accuracy can therefore hide substantial instability: under identifier renaming, DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite improves from 53.9% to 63.7% accuracy while 19.5% of its originally correct behaviors fail. Manual review of 30 sampled correct-to-wrong transitions identifies dropped path predicates, branch-polarity errors, Boolean-structure corruption, and output-contract violations. The results show that point accuracy alone is insufficient for characterizing LLM reliability in assertion generation and motivate robustness-aware evaluation for AI-assisted hardware verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对LLM生成SystemVerilog断言(SVA)的可变(\"metamorphic\")评估方法，通过在保持语义的RTL变换（操作数重排、标识符重命名、冗余括号化）下检验模型输出的稳定性。研究发现，在六个模型-变换组合条件下，9.7%-27.0%原本正确的行为在变换后变得错误，表明点准确率无法充分衡量LLM在断言生成任务中的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成SVA的评估仅在单一语法表示上报告正确率，无法揭示当同一RTL行为以不同方式编写时，模型输出是否保持稳定。这种\"点准确率\"掩盖了模型在语义保持变换下可能出现的显著不稳定性，因此需要一种可控的可变评估方法来更全面地刻画LLM在硬件验证中的可靠性。
AI.method: 基于VERT数据集构建质量过滤的条件控制池和含295个赋值行为的40个程序分层评估集；使用两个开源代码模型（Qwen2.5-Coder-7B和DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite）在相同提示词和贪心解码下评估；研究三种变换（操作数重排、确定性标识符重命名、冗余括号化）；采用条件鲁棒性、不变性失败和任意翻转率等指标，并在RTL程序级别进行10,000样本聚类自助法区间估计。
AI.result: 在所有六个模型-变换条件下，9.7%-27.0%的原始正确行为在语义保持变换后出错。标识符重命名下DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite准确率从53.9%提升至63.7%，但同时19.5%的原始正确行为失败。人工审查30个正确到错误的转变案例，识别出路径谓词丢失、分支极性错误、布尔结构破坏和输出契约违规四类错误模式。
AI.conclusion: 点准确率本身不足以表征LLM在断言生成中的可靠性，聚合准确率可能掩盖显著的不稳定性。该研究为AI辅助硬件验证提出了鲁棒性感知评估的必要性和新方向。

title: An Agent Model Abstraction for Human-AI Teaming Cognitive Coupling
comment: Presented at the 23rd IFAC World Congress, Busan, Republic of Korea, 2026
summary: Industrial environments increasingly rely on collaboration between humans and AI-enabled agents. Effective teamwork requires aligning how agents perceive situations, plan actions to pursue goals, and adapt to changing conditions, yet existing systems lack mechanisms for cross-agent cognitive processes coupling. This paper presents a conceptual cognitive agent model that formalises cognitive coupling through eight components: Input, Process, Output, State, Value, Memory, World Model, and Goal. The model abstracts how agents coordinate and co-regulate their cognitive cycles, providing a basis for analysing distributed cognition and designing cognitively interoperable human-AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个概念性认知智能体模型，通过八个组件（输入、过程、输出、状态、价值、记忆、世界模型和目标）形式化认知耦合机制，以支持工业环境中人机协作团队的有效协同。
AI.motivation: 工业环境日益依赖人类与AI智能体的协作，但现有系统缺乏跨智能体认知过程耦合的机制，导致团队无法有效对齐情景感知、行动规划和环境适应。
AI.method: 提出概念性认知智能体模型，通过八个组件（Input、Process、Output、State、Value、Memory、World Model、Goal）形式化认知耦合，抽象智能体如何协调和共同调节认知循环。
AI.result: 该模型为分析分布式认知和设计认知可互操作的人机协作系统提供了理论基础和分析框架。
AI.conclusion: 该模型可作为认知可互操作的人机AI系统设计与分析的基准框架，弥合现有系统中跨智能体认知耦合的缺失。

title: AutoFyn Technical Report: Non-Parametric Expert Iteration for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: We introduce AutoFyn, an agent harness inspired by the Expert Iteration algorithm, adapting a frozen model across many rounds by updating persistent state from verified reward signals rather than model weights. Each round begins from a fresh model session, and durable information is reintroduced only through explicit interfaces such as persistent memory files, reports, and repository state. Within a round, an orchestrator explores, plans and builds many alternative approaches with specialized agents, while a task-grounded verifier verifies the work and supplies an objective reward for measuring progress. This reward is distilled back into the persistent state, which updates the effective policy for the next round. In this technical report, we formalize this loop and describe its persistent state and verification interfaces. We then demonstrate its use in three domains, namely olympiad mathematics, data science, and cybersecurity. On the six fresh problems of the 2026 International Mathematical Olympiad, every model with room to improve scores higher under AutoFyn than in its provider's own coding agent. AutoFyn also built the top-ranked agent on the Spider 2.0 dbt benchmark, and has produced $16$ maintainer-confirmed vulnerability advisories in Next.js, MetaMask, pnpm, Warp, LiteLLM, Langflow, and Open WebUI.

AI.tldr: AutoFyn 是一种受专家迭代算法启发的智能体框架，通过更新持久状态（而非模型权重）来适应冻结模型，在多轮迭代中利用客观奖励信号不断改进性能。该框架已在奥林匹克数学、数据科学和网络安全三个领域展示出显著效果。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体在解决复杂任务时，通常受限于单轮推理或仅依赖内部生成的答案，模型的"经验"无法跨任务跨会话地积累与复用，导致性能瓶颈和资源浪费。作者希望设计一种无需修改模型权重即能持续提升任务表现的方法。
AI.method: AutoFyn 采用专家迭代算法循环：每一轮从全新模型会话开始，通过持久内存文件、报告和仓库状态等显式接口引入历史经验；轮内有编排器探索、规划和构建多种备选方案，由任务级验证器提供客观奖励；该奖励被蒸馏回持久状态，更新下一轮的有效策略。
AI.result: 在2026年国际数学奥林匹克6道新题上，AutoFyn使每个有改进空间的模型的得分都超过其原厂商的编码智能体；在Spider 2.0 dbt基准上构建出排名第一的智能体；并在Next.js、MetaMask、pnpm、Warp、LiteLLM、Langflow和Open WebUI等项目中产出了16个获维护者确认的安全漏洞公告。
AI.conclusion: AutoFyn 证明了一种"冻结模型+外部持久状态+客观验证信号"的范式能够在多个高难度领域有效提升智能体能力，为构建可积累经验、可跨会话改进的智能体系统提供了可行路径。

title: PAC-Private Autoregressive Generation: Calibrating Noise to Ensemble Disagreement
summary:
Language models adapted on private text are often served through APIs, so privacy leakage occurs through generated outputs rather than exposed weights. Private prediction protects these releases. Methods such as PMixED incur privacy cost at each release and increasingly rely on the public model over long horizons. PAC privacy instead calibrates noise to output variability across possible secrets, adding less noise when predictions are stable. To our knowledge, PAC-private prediction has not previously been extended from classification to autoregressive generation.
  We construct $m=128$ overlapping worlds from the private corpus, with each record appearing in exactly $m/2$ worlds, and train one adapter per world over a frozen public model. The realized world is the secret. At each token, the public model defines a candidate set, the worlds vote, and their posterior-weighted disagreement determines the PAC noise; unanimity requires no calibration noise. We prove $I(S;Y_{1:T}) \leq I(S;H_T) \leq bT$. Our contributions are extending PAC privacy to autoregressive generation, handling adaptive self-generated contexts, and introducing coupled decoding that preserves privacy accounting while avoiding greedy degeneration.
  On WikiText-103 with GPT-2-small, we retain 74% of the fine-tuning gain at a per-token budget of $2^{-32}$, while membership-inference success is bounded by 51.08% after $10^6$ tokens; posterior-entropy estimates of leakage are roughly 17% of the charged budget. Inference privacy is not content protection: even when membership advantage on a memorized canary is indistinguishable from zero, the canary is emitted at the same rate. Against PMixED under matched membership-inference bounds on the same data universe and test set, we retain 98% of non-private headroom from $10^2$ to $10^6$ tokens, versus at most 56%, with no crossover.

AI.tldr: 该论文将PAC隐私从分类任务扩展到自回归文本生成，通过构造128个重叠世界并训练适配器投票，实现了在极低per-token隐私预算下保留大部分微调收益的私有预测方法PPAC。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在私有文本上微调后常通过API提供服务，隐私泄露主要来自生成输出而非暴露的权重。已有方法如PMixED每次发布都产生隐私成本，且长期依赖公共模型。PAC隐私虽可在预测稳定时减少噪声，但此前未扩展至自回归生成。
AI.method: 从私有语料构造m=128个重叠世界，每条记录出现在m/2个世界中，每个世界在冻结的公共模型上训练一个适配器。实际世界作为秘密。每生成一个token时，公共模型定义候选集，各世界投票，基于后验加权的不一致性决定PAC噪声量；完全一致时无需校准噪声。证明了I(S;Y_1:T) ≤ I(S;H_T) ≤ bT。引入耦合解码以保持隐私预算同时避免贪婪解码退化。
AI.result: 在WikiText-103上用GPT-2-small，per-token预算2^-32时保留74%的微调收益；10^6个token后成员推理成功率上界为51.08%；后验熵估计的泄漏约为收费预算的17%。在相同成员推理界下与PMixED对比，从10^2到10^6 token保留98%非私有headroom，而PMixED至多56%，且无交叉。
AI.conclusion: PAC私有预测成功扩展到自回归生成，在极低隐私预算下仍能保持良好效用，显著优于PMixED。同时指出推理隐私不等于内容保护——即使成员推理优势为零，记忆化的canary仍可能以相同速率被生成。

title: Will My Assistant Remember My Allergy? What Personal LLM Assistants Forget When Conversation Memory Is Compressed
summary: Personal LLM assistants (health companions, elder-care agents, accessibility aides) are judged by what they remember about a person: a medication or an allergy mentioned in passing and needed days later. Privacy pushes them on-device, where a month of conversation can outgrow the model's own weights, so an eviction policy must decide what the cache forgets. Benchmarks report that eviction keeps such facts at a 20% budget, but they compress a prompt that already contains the user's future question, foresight no cache-reusing assistant has. Hide the question until after compression and the advantage vanishes: on PA-Bench, 100 assistant conversations we construct, an allergy mentioned in passing survives to the question that needs it 0--1% of the time, against 97% with full memory. The cause is the budget, not the scorer: none of the training-free policies we evaluate ranks the fact high enough, and the budget that would keep it is too large to bother compressing. A compressed cache is an inference-reuse mechanism, not a persistence layer: safety-critical facts need an auditable episodic store alongside it, and an interface that asks rather than invents.

AI.tldr: 个人LLM助手（如健康伴侣、老年护理代理、无障碍助手）的质量取决于其对用户信息的记忆能力。出于隐私考虑，这些助手通常部署在设备端，一个月对话量可能超过模型本身参数规模，因此需要缓存驱逐策略来决定遗忘什么。现有基准声称在20%预算下驱逐策略能保留关键事实，但这些基准压缩的是已包含用户未来问题的提示词——实际缓存复用助手不具备这样的"预知能力"。隐藏问题后再压缩，优势即消失：在PA-Bench（构造的100个助手对话）上，偶然提及的过敏信息能在需要它的提问中存活的概率仅为0-1%，而完整记忆情况下为97%。问题根源在于预算而非评分器：所有免训练策略都无法将关键事实排到足够高的优先级，而能保留它的预算又大到不值得压缩。压缩缓存本质上是推理复用机制，而非持久化层：安全关键事实需要可审计的分集式记忆存储作为补充，以及一个"询问而非臆造"的交互界面。
AI.motivation: 研究者发现现有缓存驱逐基准存在方法论缺陷：它们允许压缩时"偷看"用户未来的问题，这不符实际缓存复用场景。当去除这一预知优势后，压缩缓存保留安全关键事实（如过敏信息）的能力急剧下降至近乎为零，动摇了以20%预算进行缓存驱逐以保障关键信息安全的假设。
AI.method: 研究者构建了命名为PA-Bench的基准，包含100个助手对话场景，模拟"偶然提及的过敏信息在后续问题中需要被回忆"的实际用例。在压缩过程中隐藏用户问题（对比现有基准可见问题），系统评估多种免训练驱逐策略在有限预算下的关键事实保留率。
AI.result: 在隐藏用户问题的条件下，关键事实（如过敏信息）的存活率从完整记忆的97%骤降至0-1%。所有被评估的免训练策略均无法在预算内将关键事实排在足够靠前的位置；若要保证保留则预算需大到使压缩失去意义。
AI.conclusion: 压缩式缓存本质上应被视为推理复用机制而非持久化存储层。对于安全和健康相关的关键事实，需要独立的可审计分集式（episodic store）记忆系统加以保障，同时设计面向用户的接口时应当主动"询问"而非让模型"臆造"不确定的记忆信息。

title: Damage-Aware Bandit Pruning for Vision and Language Transformers
summary: Structured post-training pruning of transformers requires selecting complete functional units whose suppression causes limited degradation. We formulate structured-unit selection for language and vision transformers as a damage-aware multi-armed bandit problem under a fixed candidate-evaluation budget. Attention heads and MLP channel groups are temporarily masked on calibration batches. Paired damage is the masked loss minus the base loss on the same batch, reducing batch-to-batch variation. A smooth bounded reward drives either a UCB-style policy or fractional-Beta Thompson Sampling, and the final mask is constructed sequentially by adding one unit at each step. The selected units are functionally zeroed in the original dense checkpoint; therefore, the reported parameter effects represent effective structural suppression rather than physical compression or measured speedup. Experiments on WikiText-2, LAMBADA, and Imagenette cover GPT-2, OPT, Pythia, Qwen2.5, SmolLM2, ViT-B/16, DeiT-Tiny, and Swin-Tiny, with comparisons against random, magnitude, static-saliency, and budgeted-greedy selection. Across five seeds, the bandit methods usually reduce degradation relative to budgeted greedy in the paired language-model comparisons. Of 28 comparisons highlighted in the paper, 23 bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero and 11 paired tests have p < 0.05; six have q < 0.05 after Benjamini-Hochberg correction across the full family of 116 dataset-wise tests. Matched-evaluation results for ViT-B/16 and Swin-Tiny indicate that their gains are not explained solely by a larger candidate-evaluation budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将Transformer的结构化剪枝单元选择问题建模为受固定评估预算约束的"损伤感知多臂老虎机"问题，通过掩码校准批次上的配对损伤来评估注意力头和MLP通道组的重要性，采用UCB或分数Beta汤普森采样策略逐步构建最终掩码，在多种语言和视觉Transformer上验证了该方法通常优于预算贪心基线。
AI.motivation: 结构化后训练剪枝需要选择抑制后损伤有限的完整功能单元，但现有方法（如随机、幅度、静态显著性和预算贪心选择）在固定评估预算下难以高效地识别最优剪枝单元组合，缺乏对损伤的感知和系统化的探索-利用权衡。
AI.method: 将单元选择形式化为损伤感知的多臂老虎机问题；在相同校准批次上计算"被掩码损失减去基线损失"作为配对损伤以减少批次间方差；使用平滑有界奖励驱动UCB风格策略或分数Beta汤普森采样；每一步顺序添加一个单元构建最终掩码；被选单元在原始密集检查点上进行功能性归零（非物理压缩）。
AI.result: 在WikiText-2、LAMBADA和Imagenette上对GPT-2、OPT、Pythia、Qwen2.5、SmolLM2、ViT-B/16、DeiT-Tiny和Swin-Tiny进行实验；在28个对比中23个bootstrap置信区间排除零，11个配对检验p<0.05，BH校正后6个q<0.05；老虎机方法在配对语言模型比较中通常比预算贪心降低更多退化；ViT-B/16和Swin-Tiny的匹配评估表明其增益不完全由更大评估预算解释。
AI.conclusion: 损伤感知的老虎机方法在结构化剪枝单元选择上展现出相对于预算贪心方法的更优性能，尤其体现在语言模型的配对比较中；视觉模型的增益部分独立于评估预算效应，但整体统计显著性仍需审慎解读。

title: Connecting Score Matching, Maximum Likelihood, and Expectation-Maximization in Mixed Linear Regression
summary: We study variance-preserving diffusion of the response in mixed linear regression (MLR) with unknown mixing weights. Our analysis separates the statistical guarantees of score matching from the loss geometry and optimization signal at a fixed diffusion noise level. The KL divergence links the denoising score matching objective integrated over the diffusion path with the likelihood and a terminal discrepancy. Under mild regularity conditions and terminal schedule, the resulting estimator converges up to the ground truth parameters of MLR, and its scaled error converges to the Gaussian limit of the maximum-likelihood estimator. At a fixed scale of the diffusion noise level, we derive a decomposition linking the score matching loss to cross-entropy and Expectation-Maximization (EM) operators. This decomposition yields an EM-related low-noise gradient expansion with additional correction terms of latent variance. In the high-noise limit, we further characterize gradient descent on this limiting loss under isotropic covariance. Along fixed high signal-to-noise ratio rays, the score matching imbalance gradient and the latent-variance term tend to zero pointwise. Numerical experiments illustrate our theoretical findings and statistical guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文研究混合线性回归（MLR）中响应变量的方差保持扩散，并将分数匹配的统计保证与固定扩散噪声水平下的损失几何和优化信号分离分析。在温和正则条件和终止时刻安排下，估计量收敛到真实参数，其缩放误差收敛到极大似然估计的高斯极限。论文还建立了固定噪声尺度下分数匹配损失与交叉熵及EM算子之间的分解关系，并刻画了高噪声极限和高信噪比射线下的梯度下降行为。
AI.motivation: 混合线性回归（MLR）中未知混合权重的估计在统计上具有挑战性，而扩散模型/分数匹配方法在此类问题中的理论保证尚不清晰。现有工作大多将统计保证与优化几何混在一起分析，缺乏对分数匹配在扩散路径上不同噪声水平下性质的深入理解。
AI.method: 将去噪分数匹配目标沿扩散路径积分后与似然函数及终端散度通过KL散度联系起来；在固定扩散噪声水平下，推导分数匹配损失与交叉熵和EM算子的分解关系；利用EM相关的低噪声梯度展开，引入潜在方差修正项；在高噪声极限和各向同性协方差假设下刻画梯度下降对极限损失的行为。
AI.result: 估计量在温和条件下一致收敛到MLR的真实参数，缩放误差收敛到MLE的高斯极限分布；在固定低噪声下，分数匹配损失可分解为EM相关梯度项加潜在方差修正项；在高信噪比固定射线上，分数匹配不平衡梯度和潜在方差项逐点趋于零，并通过数值实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 论文为分数匹配在混合线性回归中的一致性、渐近正态性以及优化信号的结构提供了完整的理论刻画，建立了分数匹配与EM算法的深层联系，并为理解扩散模型参数估计的统计与优化性质提供了新的分析框架。

title: Tactile Search: Enhancing Targeting in 3D Space
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Mixed and Augmented Reality (ISMAR 2026)
summary: Visual search is crucial in daily life, from scanning for relevant information to spotting signs of danger. When sensory channels are overloaded or degraded, cognitive tasks can be supported by crossmodal information representations through vibrotactile cues. We introduce Tactile Search, an approach that uses modulation of frequency and amplitude of vibrations to the hands, for guiding attention to the location of objects in 3D space. We evaluated this approach in a competitive VR game where participants searched for targets using both vision and touch. Across two studies -- an in-the-wild demonstration (n=55) and a controlled laboratory experiment (n=28) -- we found that vibrotactile feedback significantly improved performance and increased user confidence. In the combined haptic condition, performance did not differ across target heights. We further analyzed participants' subjective experiences and search strategies highlighting the benefits of the tactile cues. Our findings suggest that Tactile Search can enhance interaction and provide design considerations for integrating haptic search into interactive systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tactile Search方法，通过对手部施加频率和振幅调制的振动触觉提示，引导用户在3D空间中进行视觉搜索。在VR游戏中通过两项研究（野外演示n=55和受控实验n=28）验证，发现振动触觉反馈显著提升搜索表现和用户信心，并提出了将触觉搜索集成到交互系统中的设计考量。
AI.motivation: 日常生活中视觉搜索极为重要，但当感觉通道过载或退化时，仅依赖视觉可能不足。作者旨在利用触觉通道的跨模态信息表征来支持认知任务，弥补视觉通道的不足。
AI.method: 1) 提出Tactile Search方法，通过调制传递给手部的振动频率和振幅来编码目标在3D空间中的位置信息；2) 在竞争性VR游戏中让参与者同时使用视觉和触觉搜索目标；3) 开展两项研究：野外演示（n=55）和受控实验室实验（n=28）进行评估。
AI.result: 研究表明振动触觉反馈显著提升了搜索性能并增加了用户信心；在结合触觉条件下，不同目标高度的搜索表现无显著差异；此外还分析了参与者的主观体验和搜索策略，揭示了触觉提示的益处。
AI.conclusion: Tactile Search能够增强人机交互体验，作者为将触觉搜索集成到交互系统中提供了设计建议。

title: Compiling VGDL into Causal Models
comment: To be published at IEEE Conference on Games 2026
summary: Reinforcement learning and large language models often struggle to accurately capture the causal mechanics of game environments. Standard reinforcement learning agents tend to rely on spurious correlations, while large language models are prone to hallucinating game rules. Although causal reinforcement learning improves interpretability, there is currently no formal methodology to map complex game mechanics directly into causal models. To address this, we propose a deterministic framework that compiles games specified in the Video Game Description Language into Dynamic Structural Causal Models. Rather than inferring causal structures from gameplay traces or noisy large language models' outputs, our methodology directly translates game components, including sprite dynamics, interaction rules, and termination conditions, into explicit structural equations. Each game tick represents a causal transition from state variables at time $t$ to $t+1$. By establishing this grounded mapping, the approach guarantees absolute causal fidelity to the ground-truth game mechanics. The resulting models offer transparent causal pathways that support counterfactual reasoning, causal reinforcement learning agent training, and procedural content validation. This framework provides a principled bridge between symbolic game descriptions and causally grounded game AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个确定性框架，将视频游戏描述语言（VGDL）编写的游戏直接编译为动态结构因果模型（DSCM），通过对游戏组件的显式结构方程翻译，保证对真实游戏机制的绝对因果保真度，从而支持反事实推理、因果强化学习智能体训练和程序化内容验证。
AI.motivation: 现有的强化学习智能体容易依赖虚假相关性，而大语言模型容易幻觉游戏规则，尽管因果强化学习能提升可解释性，但目前缺乏将复杂游戏机制系统性地映射为因果模型的正式方法。
AI.method: 提出一个确定性编译框架，将VGDL描述的游戏（包括精灵动态、交互规则、终止条件）直接翻译为显式结构方程，每个游戏tick表示从t时刻状态变量到t+1时刻的因果转换。
AI.result: 该方法确保对真实游戏机制的绝对因果保真度，生成的模型提供透明的因果通路，支持反事实推理、因果强化学习智能体训练和程序化内容验证。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在符号游戏描述与因果驱动的游戏AI之间建立了原则性桥梁。

title: GraphNOSE: A Graph Transformer in Olfaction
summary: Predicting olfactory qualities from molecular structure is an open problem in chemoinformatics. Although linear models can link molecular features to odor descriptors, they often fail when extrapolating to novel chemical scaffolds, extreme molecular weights, or complex odor mixtures. To address this, we introduce GraphNOSE, an open-source graph transformer framework that predicts multi-label odor descriptors from simplified molecular-input line-entry system (SMILES) strings for single molecules and binary mixtures. By integrating positional and structural encodings within a transformer-based graph architecture, GraphNOSE achieves strong performance with six times fewer parameters than standard graph neural network (GNN) baseline while consistently outperforming linear models, molecular language model embeddings, molecular fingerprints, and baseline GNNs by an average area under the ROC curve (AUROC) margin of 4.52% (p < 0.01). GraphNOSE achieves an AUROC of 84% on out-of-distribution compounds (OODs). This exceeds the current state-of-the-art GNN for OOD in olfaction (Open-POM: 81%, p < 0.001), and identifies conditions under which linear models empirically fail. Finally, we apply XAI (explainable AI) methods to identify which substructures and molecular features drive odor predictions, yielding insights consistent with chemical intuition and grounded in the model's learned representations. Together, these results establish GraphNOSE as a scalable and interpretable architecture for olfactory prediction that generalizes to structurally distinct compounds underrepresented in current perceptual databases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GraphNOSE，一个开源的图变换器框架，用于从SMILES字符串预测单分子和二元混合物的多标签气味描述符。该模型参数量仅为标准GNN的六分之一，平均AUROC超越线性模型、分子语言模型嵌入、分子指纹和基线GNN达4.52%，在分布外化合物上达到84%的AUROC，超越当前最优的Open-POM（81%）。同时利用XAI方法识别驱动气味预测的分子子结构，结果与化学直觉一致。
AI.motivation: 从分子结构预测气味质量是化学信息学中的开放问题。线性模型虽能将分子特征与气味描述符关联，但在外推到新型化学骨架、极端分子量或复杂气味混合物时常常失效，亟需更具泛化能力的架构。
AI.method: GraphNOSE采用基于Transformer的图架构，集成位置编码和结构编码，从SMILES字符串预测多标签气味描述符，支持单分子和二元混合物预测。结合可解释人工智能（XAI）方法分析驱动气味预测的关键子结构和分子特征。
AI.result: GraphNOSE参数量为基线GNN的六分之一，平均AUROC超越线性模型、语言模型嵌入、分子指纹和基线GNN达4.52%（p<0.01）；在分布外化合物上AUROC达84%，显著优于当前最优GNN Open-POM（81%，p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: GraphNOSE是一种可扩展且可解释的气味预测架构，能够泛化到当前感知数据库中代表性不足的结构不同化合物，为嗅觉预测提供了一种高效且可靠的解决方案。

title: Art2Song: Enhancing Visual Art Appreciation with Contextual Music Generation
comment: 3 pages, 1 figure, To appear in the Adjunct Proceedings of the 39th Annual ACM Symposium on User Interface Software and Technology (UIST Adjunct '26)
summary: Art2Song is a conceptual framework that expresses artworks as sound by separating Non-Visual Context, which is difficult to perceive from the image alone, from Visual Evidence. Visual Evidence, such as objects, colors, and spatial composition, is transformed into Lyrics, while the Contextual Mood derived from the historical and art-historical context in the museum's artwork description is reflected in the background soundtrack. Rather than describing artworks textually, Art2Song aims to explore the possibility of a new mode of art appreciation in which viewers experience hidden stories and emotional context through music. As future interaction directions, we plan an Emotional Layer Blending Slider interface and a structured, traceable song-generation scenario, presenting the possibility that users can explore the relationship between Visual Evidence and Contextual Mood.

AI.tldr: Art2Song是一个将艺术品转化为声音的概念框架，通过区分视觉证据（物体、颜色、空间构图）与非视觉语境（历史及艺术史背景），分别将其转化为歌词和背景音乐，探索以音乐方式进行艺术欣赏的新模式。
AI.motivation: 传统的艺术品描述方式以文本为主，难以让观众直观感受到艺术品中隐含的历史故事和情感语境。作者希望探索一种全新的艺术欣赏模式，让观众通过音乐体验作品中难以从图像直接感知的深层内容和情感氛围。
AI.method: 将艺术品信息分为两部分：视觉证据（如物体、颜色、空间构图）转化为歌词，非视觉语境中的情境情绪（源自博物馆艺术品描述中的历史与艺术史背景）反映到背景配乐中，以此生成完整的歌曲作品。
AI.result: 论文提出了Art2Song概念框架及未来的交互方向，包括情感图层混合滑块（Emotional Layer Blending Slider）界面和结构化的、可追踪的歌曲生成场景，使用户能够探索视觉证据与情境情绪之间的关系。
AI.conclusion: Art2Song开辟了以声音和音乐作为艺术品表达媒介的新路径，通过将视觉信息与历史语境分别映射到歌词与配乐，为观众提供多感官、沉浸式的艺术欣赏体验，并为未来人机交互中的艺术探索提供了新的可能性。

title: ARC-Bench: Closed-Loop Replanning Masks Broken Action Ranking in Frozen JEPA World Models
summary: Reward-free latent world models plan by scoring candidate actions with distances in a frozen latent space: an action is preferred if its predicted future embedding lands closer to the goal embedding. This silently assumes that latent closeness is action-rankable, i.e., that ordering candidates by latent distance agrees with ordering them by true cost. We audit this assumption directly. We introduce ARC-Bench, a no-leak, fixed-candidate protocol that measures whether frozen JEPA-style objectives rank candidate actions correctly, and apply it to official released JEPA-WM checkpoints across navigation and manipulation-style control. The assumption fails, severely and structurally: on the official manipulation audits the top-scored candidate is almost always suboptimal, and the same inversion appears in the maze domains. A controlled visual-backbone extension shows that the defect persists when DINOv2 is replaced by video-pretrained V-JEPA 1 and V-JEPA 2 encoders at ViT-L/ViT-G scale. Provenance, undertraining, matched-budget backbone controls, and metric-circularity controls rule out trivial explanations. We then explain why this defect has stayed invisible: closed-loop replanning masks it. When we reduce the planner's replanning frequency, success collapses in both a navigation and a manipulation domain, and the episodes rescued by frequent replanning are enriched for severe first-plan ranking failures in the PointMaze first-plan diagnostic. Closed-loop success rates therefore systematically overstate the rankability of frozen latent representations. ARC-Bench supplies the measurement, and the masking mechanism the explanation, for methods that adapt, amortize, or replan around latent-space planners without directly auditing released JEPA-WM action rankability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ARC-Bench基准，审计冻结的JEPA式潜在世界模型中的行动排名能力，发现"潜在距离接近即等于真实成本最优"这一假设严重且结构性地失败；并通过减少重规划频率导致成功率骤降的实验，揭示了闭环重规划掩盖了这一缺陷的机制。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型（如JEPA-WM）依赖一个隐含假设：在冻结的潜在空间中，候选行动的距离排序与真实成本的排序一致（即"潜在接近度可行动排名"）。现有研究从未直接审计这一假设，导致闭环成功率的评估可能系统性高估潜在表征的行动可排名性。
AI.method: 作者设计了ARC-Bench，一种无泄漏、固定候选的行动排名审计协议，用于直接测量冻结的JEPA式目标是否正确排名候选行动。他们将该协议应用于官方发布的JEPA-WM检查点（涵盖导航和操作类控制任务），并进行了受控视觉骨干扩展实验（DINOv2换成视频预训练的V-JEPA 1和V-JEPA 2编码器，ViT-L/ViT-G规模）。同时通过血统追踪、欠训练控制、匹配预算骨干控制和度量循环控制来排除琐碎解释，并通过降低规划器重规划频率来测试闭环掩盖假设。
AI.result: 假设严重且结构性地失败：在官方操作类任务审计中，得分最高的行动几乎总是次优的，同样的倒置现象也出现在迷宫域中。用V-JEPA编码器替代DINOv2后缺陷依然存在。减少重规划频率后，导航和操作领域的成功率均崩溃，说明被频繁重规划拯救的回合恰好富集了严重的一次规划排名失败。
AI.conclusion: 闭环成功率的评估系统性高估了冻结潜在表征的行动可排名性。ARC-Bench提供了测量工具，掩盖机制提供了解释，该方法适用于那些在没有直接审计JEPA-WM行动可排名性的情况下进行适应、摊销或围绕潜在空间规划器重规划的方法。

title: Analysis of Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia with Neural Networks
summary: The paper introduces a neural network-based approach for analyzing ECG signals to estimate respiratory rate by leveraging the phe- nomenon of Respiratory Sinus Arrhythmia (RSA). Our method employs a deep learning model trained to predict respiratory waveforms directly from ECG input data. To achieve this, we developed and evaluated three different neural network architectures capable of automatically extract- ing relevant features from ECG signals without the need for manual preprocessing. The proposed approach offers a robust and scalable solu- tion for non-invasive respiratory monitoring, with potential applications in healthcare and wearable technology

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于神经网络的方法，通过利用呼吸性窦性心律失常（RSA）现象，直接从ECG信号中估计呼吸频率，无需手动预处理。
AI.motivation: 传统ECG估测呼吸频率的方法通常依赖手动特征提取和信号预处理，既耗时又缺乏普适性。作者希望开发一种鲁棒且可扩展的非侵入式呼吸监测方案。
AI.method: 利用深度学习方法，采用三种不同的神经网络架构，直接从ECG输入数据中预测呼吸波形，从而实现呼吸频率的自动估计。
AI.result: 开发并评估了三种神经网络架构，均能自动从ECG信号中提取相关特征，无需手动预处理即可实现呼吸频率估计。
AI.conclusion: 该方法为非侵入式呼吸监测提供了鲁棒且可扩展的解决方案，在医疗保健和可穿戴技术领域具有潜在应用前景。

title: Flawed but Memorable: Student Critical Reception of Interest-Personalized GenAI Analogies in Computing Education
comment: 12 pages, 2 figures, and 2 tables. Accepted to the 26th Koli Calling International Conference on Computing Education Research (Koli Calling 2026)
summary:
Motivation: Undergraduate computing students increasingly turn to generative AI (GenAI) tools to understand abstract concepts through analogies. Analogies compare an unfamiliar concept to something familiar, but judging whether the comparison holds requires knowledge of both. GenAI may also embed assumptions about who the learner is. GenAI education research centers on output correctness, leaving students' critical reception of analogies largely unexamined.
  Method: We investigate how students evaluate the accuracy, appropriateness, and assumptions in GenAI-generated analogies, and their perceptions of interest-personalized versus generic technical explanations. Ten students with CS2 experience participated in a pre-survey, a think-aloud task with linked-list and recursion explanations, and a semi-structured interview grounded in the Paul-Elder framework. They judged accuracy, clarity, engagement, and trust separately.
  Results: Most participants described interest-personalized analogies as more engaging or memorable than generic technical explanations, while trust was mixed. Some trusted the tailored analogies more; others scrutinized them more closely or distrusted the tailoring. Participants with deep source-domain knowledge identified structural flaws requiring that knowledge to recognize. Because personalization and explanation format differed together, these findings do not isolate an effect of personalization alone.
  Implications: A familiar source flips the student's role. On the concept they are still learners, but on the familiar source they are the expert, and that is the position from which an analogy can be judged. We call this two-sided analogy auditing. GenAI systems should ask what students know, not just what interests them, and treat a flawed analogy as something to inspect and fix rather than accept.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过10名有CS2经验的学生参与前测、出声思维任务和半结构化访谈，调查学生如何评估GenAI生成类比（linked-list和递归讲解）的准确性、适当性及其中隐含的假设，并比较兴趣个性化类比与通用技术解释的感知差异。结果显示多数学生认为个性化类比更吸引人，但信任度不一；具有深厚源领域知识的学生能识别需要该知识才能发现的结构缺陷。研究提出"双向类比审计"概念，建议GenAI系统应询问学生已掌握的知识而非仅关注兴趣，并将有缺陷的类比视为可供检查和修正的对象。
AI.motivation: 本科生越来越多地使用GenAI通过类比来理解抽象概念，但类比是否成立需要同时了解新旧两个领域，而GenAI可能隐含对学习者身份的假设。现有GenAI教育研究过度关注输出正确性，忽视了学生对类比的批判性接受过程，这一空白需要填补。
AI.method: 研究采用定性方法：招募10名具有CS2经验的学生，依次完成预调查问卷、出声思维任务（涉及链表和递归的GenAI类比解释）和基于Paul-Elder批判性思维框架的半结构化访谈。学生分别评判准确性、清晰度、参与度和信任度，并区分兴趣个性化类比与通用技术解释的比较。
AI.result: 多数参与者认为兴趣个性化类比比通用技术解释更引人入胜或更易记忆，但信任程度呈现分化：部分更信任定制类比，另一些则更严格审查或不信任个性化。具备深层源领域知识的学生能识别出需要该知识才能察觉的结构性缺陷。由于个性化和解释格式同吋变化，研究无法单独隔离出个性化本身的效果。
AI.conclusion: 熟悉的类比源翻转了学生的角色：在目标概念上他们仍是学习者，但在熟悉源上他们是专家，这正是评判类比的立足点，称为"双向类比审计"。GenAI系统应询问学生已掌握的知识而非仅关注兴趣，并将有缺陷的类比视为可检查和修复的对象，而非被动接受的内容。

title: RAPID: Reliability-Aware Pair Importance Distillation
summary: Inter example relational distillation transfers a teacher's representation geometry by matching relations among examples within a mini batch. Computing all pairs has quadratic complexity in the batch size, whereas uniform subsampling may use a limited relation budget inefficiently. We introduce Reliability Aware Pair Importance Distillation, or RAPID, which separates a reliability gated relational target from a full support adaptive pair proposal. Reliability determines which teacher relations are emphasized, while calibrated teacher entropy and detached student-teacher residuals determine which relations are evaluated. Exact inverse proposal correction makes the loss and gradient estimators conditionally unbiased with respect to the gated mini batch target. We evaluate RAPID in two text classification settings: AG News with BERT-to-DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 256, and SST-2 with DistilBERT to DistilBERT distillation using three paired seeds and a relation budget of 64. Reliability gated relational distillation achieves the highest observed mean student accuracy on both datasets: 94.285 plus or minus 0.054 percent on AG News and 88.800 plus or minus 0.532 percent on SST-2. RAPID ranks second, achieving 94.241 plus or minus 0.025 percent and 88.685 plus or minus 0.462 percent, respectively, compared with 94.154 plus or minus 0.124 percent and 87.271 plus or minus 0.162 percent for the cross entropy baseline. Pilot evaluations are counted toward the same total budget as the main relation evaluations. Across both settings, the gated target yields the highest mean accuracy, while the adaptive proposal remains within seed-level variation. These results support the modular view that target reliability and evaluation priority are separable design dimensions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RAPID（Reliability Aware Pair Importance Distillation），一种关系型蒸馏方法，通过可靠性门控的目标和自适应对提议分离目标可靠性与评估优先级。在AG News和SST-2文本分类任务上，可靠性门控关系蒸馏取得了最高平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有实例间关系蒸馏（inter-example relational distillation）在匹配教师表征几何结构时，需要计算批次内所有样本对的关系，计算复杂度随批大小呈二次方增长。而均匀子采样可能无法高效利用有限的关系预算，因此需要一种更智能的对选择策略。
AI.method: RAPID将关系蒸馏分解为两个模块：（1）可靠性门控的关系目标（reliability gated relational target）决定哪些教师关系被重点强调；（2）全支持的自适应对提议（full support adaptive pair proposal）决定评估哪些关系。使用校准的教师熵和分离的学生-教师残差来确定关系的重要性，并通过精确逆提议校正（exact inverse proposal correction）使损失和梯度估计量相对于门控小批量目标保持条件无偏。
AI.result: 在AG News（BERT到DistilBERT，关系预算256）上，可靠性门控关系蒸馏达到94.285±0.054%的最高平均学生准确率；在SST-2（DistilBERT到DistilBERT，关系预算64）上达到88.800±0.532%。RAPID排名第二（94.241±0.025%和88.685±0.462%），均优于交叉熵基线（94.154±0.124%和87.271±0.162%）。试点评估计入与主关系评估相同的总预算。
AI.conclusion: 门控目标在两个设置下均取得最高平均准确率，自适应提议在种子间变异范围内。实验结果支持模块化观点：目标可靠性和评估优先级是可分离的设计维度。

title: Newton Matching for Generative Modeling: A Unified Framework for Fine-Tuning and Sampling
summary: We develop Newton Matching, a unified framework for fine-tuning and sampling in generative modeling. The target is $π\proptoμe^{τr}$, where $r$ is the reward, $τ>0$ the inverse temperature, and $μ$ denotes the pretrained model's terminal density for fine-tuning or the constant $1$ for sampling. We shift the paradigm from isolated losses to iterative optimization over canonical models: population minimizers of standard conditional matching for terminal densities. Under compatible smooth-realization assumptions, canonical velocities form a manifold diffeomorphic to the density manifold. Transporting the Fisher-Rao metric and mixture connection to this manifold, we show that the reverse-KL Hessian equals the metric, so the Newton direction coincides with the negative Fisher-Rao gradient. At terminal density $ρ$, each stage takes a tangential step generated by the regularized reward $r-\frac1τ\log(ρ/μ)$, followed by terminal-density-preserving canonicalization. This canonical retraction yields an exact finite-stepsize density characterization. For the ideal iteration, we prove strict reverse-KL descent away from the target for $0 < η\le τ$, global convergence under mild conditions, and local quadratic convergence for full steps ($η=τ$). Covariance and gradient forms, each with forward or reverse regression-pair constructions, yield sample-wise tangential-update losses with the same population minimizer, without importance sampling or full-trajectory backpropagation. We develop approximate updates and define critical-point consistency as vanishing tangential displacement if and only if $ρ=π$. We recover representative methods as exact realizations, critical-point-consistent approximations, or objective-altering variants, enabling modular algorithm design. Our work advances the theory and algorithms of reinforcement learning for generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Newton Matching框架，将生成模型的微调与采样统一为迭代优化问题，通过Fisher-Rao度量与Newton方向建立联系，证明了严格的reverse-KL下降、全局收敛与局部二次收敛性质，并统一了多种现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型微调与采样方法缺乏统一的理论框架，通常依赖隔离的损失函数设计，难以系统分析其收敛性质与相互联系。作者希望建立一个统一框架，将目标分布π∝μe^{τr}下的微调与采样问题转化为可迭代优化的规范模型，从而在理论上解释并改进现有方法。
AI.method: 将标准条件匹配在总体层面的极小值作为规范速度，证明其构成与密度流形微分同胚的速度流形；将Fisher-Rao度量与混合联络传递到该流形，证明reverse-KL的Hessian等于该度量，从而使Newton方向等价于负Fisher-Rao梯度。每一阶段以正则化奖励r-(1/τ)log(ρ/μ)的切向步进，再通过保持终端密度的规范化（retraction）实现有限步长下的精确密度更新。提出协方差与梯度两种形式，各配前向或反向回归对构造的样本向切向更新损失。
AI.result: 理想迭代下证明：当0<η≤τ时严格reverse-KL下降；温和条件下全局收敛；η=τ全步长时局部二次收敛。提出的近似更新与临界点一致性定义（切向位移为零当且仅当ρ=π）使多种现有方法可被分类为精确实现、临界点一致近似或改变目标的变体。
AI.conclusion: Newton Matching为生成模型的强化学习微调与采样提供了统一的理论与算法框架，推动了该领域在理论分析和模块化算法设计方面的发展。

title: MM-SVGEdit: A Multimodal-Driven SVG Editing for UI Design
summary: In the field of UI design, Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) is widely used as a design medium. However, traditional SVG editing techniques have high entry barriers and require cumbersome manual iteration, while LLM-based editing solutions suffer from low accuracy and poor user controllability. To address these issues, we propose MM-SVGEdit, a multimodal-driven SVG editing approach that integrates traditional SVG editing and LLM-based methods. We introduce a two-stage strategy in which visual grounding is followed by modification. Both stages support two interaction modalities: natural language instructions and direct manipulation (mouse and keyboard). We trained and evaluated MM-SVGEdit on a self-constructed dataset of 14,476 question-answer pairs generated from UIs, covering 11 types of editing operations on both single and multiple UI targets. The results show that MM-SVGEdit improves SVG editing accuracy, efficiency, and user-perceived control while reducing token consumption and response time.

AI.tldr: MM-SVGEdit是一种多模态驱动的SVG编辑方法，将传统SVG编辑与基于LLM的方法相结合，采用"视觉定位+修改"的两阶段策略，支持自然语言指令和直接操作两种交互方式，在自建数据集上显著提升了编辑精度、效率和用户可控性。
AI.motivation: 传统SVG编辑技术门槛高且需要繁琐的手动迭代，而基于LLM的编辑方案精度低且用户可控性差，现有方法难以兼顾易用性和精确性。
AI.method: 提出MM-SVGEdit多模态驱动的SVG编辑方法，集成传统SVG编辑与LLM方法，采用两阶段策略：先视觉定位后修改；两个阶段均支持自然语言指令和鼠标键盘直接操作两种交互方式；在自建的14,476个问答对数据集上进行训练和评估，覆盖11种编辑操作，支持单个和多个UI目标。
AI.result: MM-SVGEdit在SVG编辑精度、效率和用户感知控制力方面均有提升，同时降低了token消耗和响应时间。
AI.conclusion: MM-SVGEdit通过融合传统编辑与LLM方法并引入多模态两阶段编辑策略，有效解决了SVG编辑中入门门槛、编辑精度和用户可控性之间的权衡问题。

title: PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN: Prior-Guided Joint Probabilistic Forecasting of Clinical Trajectories
summary: Clinical deterioration unfolds through coupled, partially observed trajectories, not a single diagnostic label. We introduce PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN, a trajectory-first framework for joint probabilistic forecasting of multivariate physiology. It combines missingness-aware temporal encoders, a soft organ-system prior, patient-specific relations, nonlinear Kolmogorov-Arnold messages, and a low-rank multivariate Student-t head. We evaluate 24-hour histories and six-hour forecasts on a frozen MIMIC-IV-derived cohort of 6,882 patients and 54,694 windows. Across five seeds and 13 models, PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN obtains the second-lowest normalized MAE (0.37727 +/- 0.00029) and the lowest RMSE (0.52656 +/- 0.00034). It reduces MAE by 0.52% relative to deterministic TimeKAN. For probabilistic forecasting, it reaches a marginal NLL of 0.66380 and a CRPS of 0.27301. Empirical coverage is 0.533, 0.831, and 0.958 for nominal 50%, 80%, and 95% intervals. Removing relational structure causes the largest ablation loss. Increasing covariance rank improves joint likelihood but has little effect on point accuracy. A trajectory-derived risk score remains weaker than a dedicated GRU-D classifier (AUROC 0.603 versus 0.650), which limits the present clinical claim. Joint trajectory forecasting therefore provides an inspectable intermediate task, but accurate physiology forecasts alone do not ensure a calibrated event detector.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PGP-Clinical-TimeKAN框架，将临床恶化视为多变量生理学的联合概率轨迹预测任务而非单一标签分类。在MIMIC-IV队列上实现了最低RMSE和第二低MAE，但轨迹衍生风险评分的AUROC弱于专用分类器。
AI.motivation: 临床恶化并非单一诊断标签，而是通过耦合且部分观测的轨迹展开。作者认为需要采用轨迹优先的框架，对多变量生理指标进行联合概率预测，而非局限于标签分类。
AI.method: 模型结合了缺失感知时间编码器、软器官系统先验、患者特定关系结构、非线性Kolmogorov-Arnold消息传递机制，以及低秩多元Student-t分布的预测头，实现多变量生理学的联合概率预测。
AI.result: 在6,882名患者和54,694个时间窗口上，模型取得最低RMSE(0.52656)和第二低MAE(0.37727)。相比确定性TimeKAN降低MAE 0.52%。概率预测方面，边际NLL为0.66380，CRPS为0.27301。但轨迹衍生风险评分的AUROC(0.603)低于GRU-D分类器(0.650)。
AI.conclusion: 联合轨迹预测提供了可检查的中间任务，但准确的生理预测并不自动保证校准的事件检测器。该工作对临床主张持谨慎态度，揭示了预测精度与事件检测能力之间的差距。

title: A Multi-Source Ensemble Approach to Candidate Generation for Alternative Vacation Rental Property Recommendations
comment: Accepted at RecTour 2026, Workshop on Recommenders in Tourism, co-located with the 20th ACM Conference on Recommender Systems (RecSys 2026). To appear in CEUR Workshop Proceedings
summary:
Alternative property recommendations play a critical role in vacation rental marketplaces, helping users discover relevant options when viewing a specific listing. However, generating high-quality candidate alternatives presents unique challenges: heterogeneous inventory, geographic constraints, rapid availability changes, and long-tail property distributions. We present a comprehensive study of candidate generation (CG) approaches for vacation rental alternatives, comparing collaborative filtering, shallow embeddings, and graph neural network (GNN) methods.
  Our experiments on a large-scale vacation rental platform (over 2M active properties) show that a hybrid architecture combining item-based collaborative filtering with GNN-based retrieval improves Recall@300 by 14.8% over the strongest baseline, by leveraging the complementary strengths of the two sources: collaborative filtering excels at early recall for properties with rich interaction history, while GNNs discover diverse, non-obvious alternatives and handle cold-start scenarios more effectively. As a component result, GNN-based embeddings alone substantially outperform shallow Hotel2Vec embeddings (48-68% relative recall improvement across K), motivating their inclusion in the ensemble.
  Crucially, we examine how CG-stage gains carry through to the downstream ranking stage, and find that a stronger candidate pool yields higher downstream ranking quality, though attributing this effect cleanly is complicated by the coupling between candidate generation and ranker training. This recall-conversion gap is an important consideration for practitioners deploying new retrieval methods in two-stage recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文在大型度假租赁平台上系统研究了候选生成（CG）方法，提出了结合基于物品的协同过滤与图神经网络（GNN）检索的混合架构，在Recall@300上比最强基线提升14.8%。研究还揭示了CG阶段收益与下游排序质量之间存在"召回-转化鸿沟"现象。
AI.motivation: 度假租赁市场中的替代房源推荐对用户体验至关重要，但候选生成面临异质库存、地理约束、快速可用性变化及长尾房源分布等独特挑战，现有方法缺乏系统性的对比研究。
AI.method: 在超过200万个活跃房源的平台上，对比了协同过滤、浅层嵌入（Hotel2Vec）和图神经网络等候选生成方法，提出了将基于物品的协同过滤与GNN检索相结合的混合架构。
AI.result: 混合架构较最强基线在Recall@300上提升14.8%；GNN嵌入单独相比Hotel2Vec有48-68%的相对召回率提升；更强的候选池可带来更高的下游排序质量，但CG与排序训练之间的耦合使归因复杂化。
AI.conclusion: 协同过滤擅长有丰富交互历史的早召回，GNN能发现多样化非显而易见的替代品并更好处理冷启动场景，两者互补。同时，部署新检索方法时需要关注"召回-转化鸿沟"这一重要实际考量。

title: Adaptive Ecological Momentary Assessment with a Hybrid Language Model: Formative Expert Review and Retrospective Evaluation
summary: Ecological momentary assessment (EMA) measures experience in daily life, but fixed questionnaires and schedules collect information of uneven value and can interrupt participants. We present and retrospectively evaluate EMA-E4B, a hybrid framework for question selection and prompt timing. Separate ridge models propose an item set and delay; a supervised Gemma 4 E4B language layer produces the final structured response and explanation. Evaluation distinguishes proxy action performance, output conformity, and formative judgments of response quality. The data contain 4,372 records from 79 participants and yield 3,516 sequential cases under a participant separated split. One involved domain expert preferred the complete hybrid response in 15 of 20 decisive comparisons, with two ties among 22 reviews. On 75 reused development cases, hybrid question utility and timing similarity were 0.832 and 0.818; the head alone reached 0.852 and 0.818. A separate 60 case comparison with untouched E4B under the same head gave action differences of -0.0031 and -0.0105. Thus, the language layer produced structured responses with action scores comparable to or slightly below the reference configurations, while the expert feedback favored the complete hybrid response. These observations establish a concrete, inspectable framework and clarify the distinct roles of action scoring and response review. Repeated adaptive administration and practical effects on measurement and participant burden remain future research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并回顾性评估EMA-E4B混合框架，用于生态瞬时评估（EMA）中的问题选择与提示时机控制。通过分层的ridge模型分别建议题目集合与延迟时间，再由Gemma 4 E4B语言层生成最终结构化响应及解释。基于79名参与者共4372条记录的评估显示：混合响应在专家偏好中胜出（20次决定性比较中15次占优），但在行动分数上与基准配置相当或略低，揭示了行动评分与响应审查的不同作用。
AI.motivation: 传统EMA依赖固定问卷和固定调度，收集的信息价值不均，且频繁打断参与者。需要一个自适应框架来动态选择问题和安排提示时机，以提升数据价值并减轻参与者负担。
AI.method: 提出EMA-E4B混合框架：两个分离的ridge模型分别建议题目集合与提示延迟，一个受监督的Gemma 4 E4B语言层将二者融合，生成最终结构化响应并提供解释。评估区分代理行动性能、输出一致性和形成性质量判断三个维度，采用参与者分离的数据划分方法。
AI.result: 在22次评审中有15次决定性偏好（2次平局）支持完整混合响应；开发案例上混合问题效用和时序相似度分别为0.832和0.818，单独头部模型达到0.852和0.818；与未修改E4B的60例对照显示行动差异为-0.0031和-0.0105。语言层生成的结构化响应行动分数与基准相当或略低，但专家反馈偏好完整混合响应。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了具体可检查的EMA自适应框架，明确了行动评分与响应审查在评估中的不同角色。重复自适应施测及其对测量效果和参与者负担的实际影响尚待未来研究。

title: SciLitBench: Benchmark and Design Principles for LLM-Powered Systematic Literature Reviews
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, and 5 tables. Data and code are available at https://github.com/linlab/SciLitBench
summary: Systematic reviews require sustained human judgment across thousands of records, yet existing evaluations of large language models (LLMs) typically examine review stages in isolation. We introduce SciLitBench, a multi-stage benchmark spanning title and abstract screening, full-text screening, and schema-guided data extraction, with 42,981 retrieved records, 1,012 full texts, and annotations for 888 included papers. Across 22 open-weight LLMs from six model families, explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria improve title and abstract screening $F_2$ by 28.8\%, while researcher-authored rationales improve full-text screening by 15\%. Data extraction reveals a different reliability regime: performance declines from 0.97 accuracy for publication year to 0.37 Jaccard overlap for computational approach, while the strongest models recover only 30\% of annotated evaluation evidence and 25\% of limitations. SciLitBench identifies a practical boundary between high-recall screening and evidence-complete extraction and provides a reproducible resource for evaluating LLM-assisted evidence synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SciLitBench，一个覆盖标题/摘要筛选、全文筛选和模式引导数据提取的多阶段系统综述基准，包含42,981条检索记录、1,012篇全文和888篇纳入论文的标注。对22个开源LLM评估发现：明确纳入/排除标准可将标题与摘要筛选F2提高28.8%，研究者撰写的理由可使全文筛选提高15%；数据提取性能波动大（准确率从0.97到Jaccard 0.37），最强模型仅能恢复30%的评估证据和25%的局限性。该基准界定了高召回筛选与证据完整提取之间的实际边界。
AI.motivation: 系统综述需要数千条记录中持续的人类判断，但现有的LLM评估通常孤立地考察某一综述阶段，缺乏能够覆盖完整流程的多阶段基准来全面评估LLM辅助证据综合的实际能力。
AI.method: 构建了包含三项任务的SciLitBench基准：标题与摘要筛选、全文筛选和模式引导的数据提取，涵盖22个开源LLM（来自6个模型家族），系统比较不同提示策略（如显式纳入/排除标准、研究者推理）对各阶段性能的影响。
AI.result: 显式纳入/排除标准使标题与摘要筛选F2提升28.8%；研究者撰写的理由使全文筛选提升15%。数据提取性能出现显著退化：从出版年份0.97的准确率降至计算方法0.37的Jaccard重叠，最强模型仅能恢复30%的标注评估证据和25%的局限性。
AI.conclusion: SciLitBench揭示了系统综述中高召回筛选与证据完整提取之间存在明确的能力分界线，为评估LLM辅助证据综合提供了一个可复现的资源，帮助社区理解LLM在实际综述工作流中的适用边界。

title: Data Scout: Targeted Web Crawling for Domain-Specific Pretraining Corpora
summary: The dominant approach to building domain-specific pretraining corpora is to filter large web archives such as CommonCrawl. This works well for popular domains but breaks down for specialized ones, where relevant content is sparse and often beyond the reach of popularity-driven crawlers. We present Data Scout, which inverts this: instead of filtering an archive, it directs a targeted crawl. An LLM expands a root topic into a taxonomy and thousands of search queries; the returned URLs (seeds) are grouped by subdomain and screened with a user-supplied classifier (the probe), admitting each subdomain on the basis of a small sample. This works because relevance has a sharp boundary at the subdomain level: in mathematics, a page is 21x more likely to be relevant than one on a sibling subdomain. With the FineMath classifier as the probe, 21.9% of crawled pages are high-quality math content, 70x the 0.31% rate from filtering a comparable web sample, so the crawl wastes far less effort. But the payoff is not just efficiency: 63.2% of these pages are missing from CommonCrawl altogether, yet just as useful for training. Continued pretraining of Llama-3.2-3B on 1.9B Data Scout tokens matches FineMath corpus on GSM8k. Because the probe is the only domain-specific component, Data Scout can in principle apply to any domain with such a classifier.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Data Scout，一种面向特定领域的预训练语料构建方法。它不依赖过滤现有网络档案（如CommonCrawl），而是通过LLM将根主题扩展为分类树和搜索查询来引导定向爬取，并以用户提供的分类器（探针）按子域名筛选网页。实验表明，该方法在数学领域的相关高质量内容比例（21.9%）远高于传统过滤方法（0.31%），且63.2%的网页不在CommonCrawl中但同样有效用于训练。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于过滤大规模网络档案（如CommonCrawl）构建领域语料的方法对热门领域有效，但对专门领域失效，因为相关内容稀疏且难以被流行度驱动的爬虫捕获。需要一种面向专门领域语料构建的反向思路。
AI.method: Data Scout采用"定向爬取而非过滤档案"的逆向方法：1) 用LLM将根主题扩展为分类树和大量搜索查询；2) 对返回的URL（种子）按子域名分组；3) 使用用户提供的分类器（探针）对小样本进行筛选，以子域名为单位决定是否纳入。其核心洞察是相关性在子域名层面具有尖锐边界（数学领域中，相关页面比兄弟子域名页面相关概率高21倍）。
AI.result: 以FineMath分类器为探针，Data Scout爬取页面的21.9%为高质量数学内容，是过滤可比网络样本的0.31%的70倍。63.2%的相关页面不存于CommonCrawl但同样有训练价值。使用19亿token对Llama-3.2-3B进行持续预训练，在GSM8k上与FineMath语料效果相当。
AI.conclusion: 由于探针是唯一领域特定的组件，Data Scout原则上可推广到任何拥有此类分类器的领域。该方法不仅提升了语料构建效率，还发现了现有档案中缺失但同样有效的价值数据。

title: FrankenReport: Early Exiting in Long-Form Generation Using Expected Value of Computation
summary: While deep research systems address interactive information-seeking needs impressively, their real-world deployments face latency and resource-consumption challenges. We present FrankenReport, an interface for long-form knowledge-seeking report generation that supports adaptive early exiting per section: it evaluates intermediate outputs during generation and predicts whether further targeted computation will yield significant quality gains. In a simulation study, FrankenReport outperforms random allocation baselines by a large margin (up to 4x) under low budgets and smoothly recovers full-pipeline quality as the budget grows, showing that future quality gains are predictable from intermediate drafts. Through experiments and user studies, we further show that despite varying preferences across users and topics, FrankenReport adapts to simple, natural user feedback as efficiently as methods requiring much costlier supervision such as generated drafts and explicit rationales.

AI.tldr: FrankenReport是一种支持按章节自适应提前退出的长文知识检索报告生成接口，通过评估中间输出预测后续计算是否能带来显著质量提升，在低预算下相比随机分配基线最多提升4倍性能，并能平滑恢复完整流程质量。
AI.motivation: 深度研究系统虽然能出色地满足互动式信息检索需求，但在实际部署中面临延迟和资源消耗过大的挑战，需要更高效的计算资源分配策略。
AI.method: 设计了按章节的自适应提前退出机制，在生成过程中评估中间输出，预测进一步定向计算是否会产生显著质量收益；通过模拟研究和用户研究验证，并与随机分配基线及需要更昂贵监督信号（如生成草稿、显式理由）的方法进行比较。
AI.result: 在低预算下相比随机分配基线最高提升4倍性能；随着预算增长能平滑恢复完整流程质量。用户研究表明无论用户和主题偏好如何变化，FrankenReport仅需简单自然的用户反馈即可达到与需要昂贵监督方法相当的自适应效率。
AI.conclusion: 未来质量收益可从中间草稿中预测，FrankenReport通过按章节自适应提前退出实现了高效的长文报告生成，且对用户反馈的适应无需昂贵监督信号即可实现。

title: SCAFFOLD: Self-Improving Web Agents via Recursive Parametric Skill Abstraction
summary: Web agents need to navigate visually rich, long-horizon interfaces that change across sites, yet most previous agents still learn each task in isolation and discard the procedural knowledge they accumulate. Recent skill-augmented frameworks take an important first step, but they treat the skill library as a flat or two-tier prompt-side cache and offer no principled mechanism for compressing redundancy or composing skills recursively. We introduce \textsc{Scaffold}, a self-improving framework for visual web agents that (i) induces parametric, executable skills from successful trajectories under a multi-instance abstraction constraint, (ii) maintains a recursively composed hierarchy in which higher-level skills invoke lower-level ones, (iii) compacts the library via a minimum-description-length (MDL) criterion and behavioral equivalence checking, and (iv) periodically distills skill-augmented trajectories back into model weights to internalize the abstractions. Across WebArena, VisualWebArena, and a held-out split of Online-Mind2Web, \textsc{Scaffold} improves success rate by $11.1$--$17.2$ absolute points over the strongest skill-augmented baseline and shows monotonic gains across five self-improvement iterations without library collapse. We release the code and documents in the Github \href{https://github.com/BokwaiHo/SCAFFOLD}{repository}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Scaffold，一个面向视觉Web智能体的自改进框架，通过多实例抽象约束诱导可执行技能、递归构建技能层级、基于MDL准则压缩技能库，并周期性将技能增强轨迹蒸馏回模型权重，在WebArena、VisualWebArena和Online-Mind2Web上相比最强技能增强基线提升11.1-17.2个绝对百分点，且五轮自改进迭代中无库塌缩、性能单调提升。
AI.motivation: 现有Web智能体在解决每个任务时彼此孤立，无法积累和复用过程性知识；已有的技能增强框架将技能库视为扁平或两层的提示侧缓存，缺乏对技能冗余进行压缩以及递归组合技能的机制。
AI.method: (1) 在多实例抽象约束下从成功轨迹中归纳参数化、可执行的技能；(2) 维护递归组合的技能层级，高层技能调用低层技能；(3) 通过最小描述长度（MDL）准则和行为等价性检查来压缩技能库；(4) 周期性地将技能增强轨迹蒸馏回模型权重，使抽象内化。
AI.result: 在WebArena、VisualWebArena和Online-Mind2Web（留出集）上，相比最强技能增强基线，成功率提升11.1-17.2个绝对百分点；五轮自改进迭代中表现出单调增益且无技能库塌缩。
AI.conclusion: Scaffold验证了通过技能层级构建、冗余压缩与模型权重蒸馏相结合的自改进范式，能够有效提升视觉Web智能体在长时程、视觉丰富接口上的任务成功率，并实现稳定持续的自改进。

title: RAPTOR: Role-Aware Private Training for Mixture-of-Experts
summary: Differentially private (DP) fine-tuning methods treat sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models as a single dense block, ignoring that shared layers see all data while experts only see routed records.
