We identify and formally characterize three resulting failure modes: global clipping suppresses expert gradients, batch-level normalization dilutes sparse expert updates, and fixed privacy noise degrades signal-to-noise ratio on low-load experts. We introduce RAPTOR - a Role-Aware Private Training framework, which alternates shared and expert optimization and targets each failure directly, using expert-specific clipping and noise together with a public expected-owner denominator and a count-independent update schedule that avoids conditioning on private, realized expert counts. We prove the resulting mechanism satisfies $(\varepsilon,δ)$-DP: because each record is assigned to exactly one owner expert, per-expert mechanisms within a layer compose in parallel, so updating all $E$ experts costs no more, in privacy terms, than updating one, with shared and expert streams composing sequentially across training. We further derive a bias-variance decomposition of the public-denominator estimator showing its bias grows predictably with routing imbalance, yielding a privacy-free rule for selecting which layer to protect from routing entropy measured on a small public corpus. Experiments on Switch Transformer and OLMoE fine-tuning across GLUE tasks, and on DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny, show consistent gains over standard DP baselines across several privacy levels ($\varepsilon$), with the largest margins typically at the tightest budgets. Code and models are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/RAPTOR

AI.tldr: RAPTOR是一个角色感知的私有训练框架，专门针对差分隐私(DP)微调稀疏混合专家(MoE)模型时忽略专家路由结构的缺陷而设计。通过交替优化共享层和专家层，并采用专家特定裁剪、噪声及公共期望分母等技术，该框架在隐私预算不增加的前提下实现了对Switch Transformer、OLMoE和DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny等模型的一致性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有DP微调方法将稀疏MoE模型当作单一稠密块处理，忽视了共享层看到所有数据而专家层只看到被路由子集的本质区别。作者识别了三种失效模式：全局裁剪压制了专家梯度、批级归一化稀释了稀疏专家更新、固定隐私噪声降低了低负载专家的信噪比。
AI.method: RAPTOR交替优化共享层与专家层，针对每个失效模式采用相应策略：专家特定裁剪与噪声、使用公共期望分母替代私有统计量、以及不依赖私有实际专家计数的更新调度。理论上证明由于每条记录仅分配给一个所有者专家，层内各专家机制并行组合，更新全部E个专家的隐私代价与更新单个专家相同。此外，作者对公共分母估计器进行偏差-方差分解，导出无隐私代价的层选择规则。
AI.result: 在Switch Transformer和OLMoE的GLUE任务微调以及DeepSeek-VL2-Tiny上的实验表明，RAPTOR在各种隐私级别(ε)上均优于标准DP基线，且在隐私预算最紧张时获得最大性能提升幅度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了DP与MoE路由结构的适配问题，提出了一种利用并行组合原理显著降低隐私成本的训练框架，代码和模型已公开。

title: Can People Distinguish Human and AI Agency in Humanoid Teleoperation? A Preliminary Study of Agency Perception
comment: 3 pages, accepted by ACM UIST 2026 as a poster
summary: Can people distinguish between human and AI agency in humanoid teleoperation? To explore this question, we developed \textit{Ghost-in-the-Loop}, a teleoperation framework that supports both human-operated and AI-generated control of a robot's voice, facial expressions, and gestures while maintaining a consistent embodiment. We conducted a preliminary online study ($N=50$) in which participants viewed short interaction clips generated by either a Human Operator or an AI Control and judged the perceived source of control. Results suggest that participants often struggled to distinguish between the two conditions in brief interactions. Qualitative responses indicate that judgments were primarily influenced by perceived naturalness, temporal coordination, and consistency across speech, facial expression, and gesture. These findings provide initial insights into agency perception in embodied human--AI communication and motivate future investigations of blended human--AI telepresence systems.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨人们能否区分人形远程操作中的人类与AI控制。作者开发了"Ghost-in-the-Loop"远程操作框架，可同时支持人类操作和AI生成的语音、面部表情和手势控制，并保持一致的具身呈现。通过在线研究（N=50），参与者观看由人类操作员或AI控制生成的短交互片段并判断控制来源。结果表明，参与者往往难以在短暂交互中区分两种条件，定性反馈显示判断主要受感知自然度、时间协调性以及语音-面部表情-手势一致性的影响。
AI.motivation: 探究在具身人机通信中，人们是否能够区分人类操作与AI控制的代理来源，为理解人类对混合人类-AI远程呈现系统的代理感知提供初步洞见。
AI.method: 开发了Ghost-in-the-Loop远程操作框架，支持人类操作员和AI控制两种模式下对机器人语音、面部表情及手势的统一控制。通过在线研究（N=50），让参与者观看由两种模式生成的短交互视频片段，并进行控制来源判断，同时收集定性回答。
AI.result: 参与者普遍难以在短暂交互中区分人类操作与AI控制。定性分析发现，参与者的判断主要依赖于感知的自然度、时间协调性以及语音、面部表情和手势之间的一致性这三个维度的线索。
AI.conclusion: 研究为具身人-AI通信中的代理感知提供了初步见解，揭示了人类与AI在远端操作中的可混淆性，并为未来探索混合人类-AI远程呈现系统的研究方向提供了动机。

title: Reasoning-Aware Compression: Identifying and Protecting Vulnerable Reasoning Circuits for Energy-Efficient LLM Deployment
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) impose substantial energy costs during deployment, yet current compression methods apply uniform quantization across all components, risking damage to critical reasoning circuits. We present a reasoning-aware compression framework that benchmarks quantization conditions across five reasoning benchmarks, GSM8K, FOLIO, MATH-500, ProofWriter, and MuSiQue, with hardware-level GPU energy measurement; profiles per-module INT4 vulnerability across all 196-224 (layer, projection) pairs via a perturbation sweep on a held-out calibration split, then selectively restores the most sensitive circuits to FP16. Three findings emerge. First, INT4 quantization can increase energy by extending reasoning chains; a 25% power reduction becomes a net energy increase on GSM8K. Second, vulnerability is task-dependent: attention projections are more critical for mathematical reasoning, and sensitivity patterns differ by architecture in logical inference. Third, selective compression achieves Pareto-optimal points inaccessible to uniform methods: R1-Qwen-7B Top-10% on ProofWriter gains +12 pp over FP16 at -9.7% energy, validated on held-out data across five reasoning benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种推理感知的压缩框架，针对大规模推理模型（LRMs）在部署时的能耗问题，通过逐模块扰动扫描识别量化敏感电路，并选择性恢复关键模块至FP16，实现能耗与推理性能的帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: 大规模推理模型部署能耗巨大，现有压缩方法对所有组件施加均匀量化，可能破坏关键的推理电路，导致性能下降甚至能耗不降反增。
AI.method: 提出推理感知压缩框架：(1) 在5个推理基准（GSM8K、FOLIO、MATH-500、ProofWriter、MuSiQue）上对量化条件进行硬件级GPU能耗测量；(2) 通过扰动扫描对全部196-224个（层，投影）对进行逐模块INT4脆弱性分析；(3) 选择性将最敏感的电路恢复为FP16精度。
AI.result: 三项关键发现：(1) INT4量化可通过延长推理链增加能耗，GSM8K上25%的功率降低反成净能耗增加；(2) 脆弱性具有任务依赖性，数学推理中注意力投影更关键，逻辑推理中敏感性模式因架构而异；(3) 选择性压缩实现均匀方法无法达到的帕累托最优：R1-Qwen-7B在ProofWriter上Top-10%选择性恢复相比FP16提升12个百分点，同时能耗降低9.7%。
AI.conclusion: 选择性、推理感知的压缩策略可优于传统均匀量化方法，在降低能耗的同时保持甚至提升推理能力，为大规模推理模型的高效部署提供了新思路。

title: Nonlinear elliptic homogenization with the parametric Deep Ritz method
summary: Elliptic homogenization is used to determine coarse-grained properties of materials with features on small scales. When these small scale features have rapid, periodic fluctuations, the solution field corresponding to a homogenized constitutive relation closely resembles the true solution based on the heterogeneous material. This homogenized behavior of the material is computed from a cell problem, where a cell is defined to be one period of the fluctuating material. In the context of linear elliptic partial differential equations, the homogenized constitutive relation is defined simply by a constant coefficient tensor, but for nonlinear problems, the homogenized response depends on the macroscopic state and/or its gradient, thus requiring solutions to parametric cell problems. When computing a numerical solution with the homogenized constitutive relation, it is useful to have a differentiable representation of the solution to the cell problem, as derivatives of the homogenized constitutive relation are required in Newton iterations for the macroscopic state field. In this work, we use the Deep Ritz method to solve the parametric cell problems that arise from nonlinear homogenization. First, we exploit the variational structure of the cell problem, then we discretize the dependence of the cell response on both space and the macroscopic state with a neural network. Enforcing boundary conditions on the cell response strongly, we next use the parametric Deep Ritz method to simultaneously solve the cell problem over a range of macroscopic states. We show that this method is accurate, efficient, and offers a continuous and differentiable representation of the cell response over the macroscopic state and gradient. We then show that our parametric representation of the cell response significantly expedites macroscale solutions when compared to a traditional $\text{FE}^2$ scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用参数化Deep Ritz方法求解非线性均匀化中的参数化胞元问题，通过神经网络同时离散空间与宏观状态依赖，获得连续可微的胞元响应表示，相比传统FE²方案显著加速宏观尺度求解。
AI.motivation: 非线性均匀化问题中，均匀化本构关系依赖于宏观状态及其梯度，需要求解参数化胞元问题。在宏观牛顿迭代中需要本构关系的导数，因此需要胞元问题的可微表示。传统方法效率有限。
AI.method: 利用胞元问题的变分结构，用神经网络同时离散胞元响应对空间坐标和宏观状态的依赖；通过参数化Deep Ritz方法对宏观状态范围同时求解胞元问题，并强加边界条件。
AI.result: 该方法在精度和效率上表现良好，提供胞元响应对宏观状态和梯度的连续可微表示，相比传统FE²方案显著加速宏观尺度求解。
AI.conclusion: 参数化Deep Ritz方法为非线性均匀化胞元问题提供了一种准确、高效且可微的求解方案，可有效加速宏观尺度的数值计算。

title: Disclosure and dissolution: explainability, AI power, and situated agency in understanding
comment: in proceedings of explainable ai for the arts workshop 2026 arxiv:2607.20131
summary: This paper interrogates the political and philosophical stakes of AI through the lens of cyborg theory cosmotechnics and glitch feminism. It advocates for a tech-positive critically situated approach to AI as a collaborator and substrate for power relations rather than an autonomous agent of harm. By rejecting the naive pause stop narratives of the human AI binary and embracing an explainable AI XAI artistic practice within embodied intersectional and community rooted engagements AI can empower diverse voices and foster ethical creativity. It starts by examining a frontier cybersecurity AI situating its framing within AI public anxiety and arguing for a new critical stance on human navigation in an AI world.

AI.tldr: 本文通过赛博格理论、宇宙技术和故障女性主义的视角，审视AI的政治与哲学意涵，倡导一种技术积极但具有批判性定位的AI观——将AI视为权力关系的协作载体而非自主危害者，主张以可解释AI（XAI）艺术实践在具身化、交叉性和社区扎根的参与中实现伦理创造力。
AI.motivation: 反对将AI简单化为"人类-机器二元对立"中自主危害者的叙事，拒绝浅薄的"暂停/停止"式回应，试图在公众AI焦虑的语境下建立一种新的批判性立场。
AI.method: 融合赛博格理论、宇宙技术和故障女性主义三个理论框架，通过前沿网络安全AI案例进行情境化分析，论证以可解释AI（XAI）艺术实践作为赋权工具的路径。
AI.result: 提出AI可以赋能多元声音并促进伦理创造力，主张在具身化、交叉性和社区扎根的框架中重新理解人类在AI世界中的导航方式。
AI.conclusion: AI应被视为权力关系的协作载体与基底（substrate），而非自主危害主体，需以技术积极且批判性的姿态取代简单的反对或暂停叙事。

title: When and What to Teach: Budget-Aware Online Adaptation for Web Agents
summary: Web agents have achieved significant success in automating complex internet tasks but deploying them in real-world environments requires continuous online adaptation. Given that deploying powerful proprietary models remains commercially cost-prohibitive, practitioners must rely on lightweight local models that evolve post-deployment via online teaching from a stronger teacher. However, standard interactive feedback imposes prohibitive costs. We show that conventional trajectory-level preference optimization wastes budget on both unresolvable episodes and redundant execution turns. To resolve these inefficiencies, we propose \textbf{Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming}, a budget-aware framework that systematically orchestrates \textbf{when} and \textbf{what} to teach. Specifically, our framework integrates a solvability-aware teacher gate to dictate \textbf{when} to query the teacher model and a score-guided turn selection mechanism to decide \textbf{what} informative turns to retain. Extensive experiments on MiniWoB and TimeWarp demonstrate that our method achieves comparable first-pass success while reducing teacher calls by 22.6\% and student training compute by 52.1\% on average. Our code is available at https://github.com/zjw131f1fc/budgeted-online-teaching.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种预算感知的在线教学框架（Score-Guided Online Teaching with Budgeted Trajectory Trimming），通过可解性感知的教师门控和评分引导的回合选择机制，在网页代理的在线部署中减少不必要的教师查询和训练开销，在保持相当的首次通过成功率的同时大幅降低计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现实环境中部署网页代理需要持续的在线适应，但由于商业大模型部署成本过高，需要使用轻量级本地模型并依赖在线教学中更强教师模型的指导。然而，标准的交互式反馈成本高昂，传统的轨迹级偏好优化浪费预算在无法解决的回合和冗余的执行步骤上。
AI.method: 提出预算感知的在线教学框架（BOTT），包含两个关键组件：(1) 可解性感知的教师门控（solvability-aware teacher gate），用于决定何时查询教师模型；(2) 评分引导的回合选择机制（score-guided turn selection），用于决定保留哪些信息量丰富的回合进行教学。
AI.result: 在MiniWoB和TimeWarp基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在实现相当的首次通过成功率的同时，平均减少了22.6%的教师调用和52.1%的学生训练计算量。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统性地编排"何时教"和"教什么"，所提出的框架有效解决了在线教学中的预算浪费问题，实现了高效且成本可控的网页代理在线适应性部署。

title: Online Learning with LLM Experts from Limited Feedback
summary: We study adaptive routing of prompts to large language model (LLM) experts to maximize response quality in an online setting with limited feedback. We formulate it as a bandit problem with $K$ actions that represent experts and $d$ features that encode prompts, over a horizon of $T$ rounds. We propose algorithms that strategically select and observe rewards to minimize regret. In the full-information setting, we achieve a regret of $\tilde{O}(d T / \sqrt{m})$, while in the bandit setting we achieve $\tilde{O}(d T \sqrt{K / m})$, where $m \ll T$ is a budget on feedback. Our experiments show that we efficiently learn high-quality routing strategies across diverse LLMs from limited feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在线环境中有限反馈下的大语言模型（LLM）专家自适应路由问题，将其建模为带特征编码的K臂老虎机问题，提出了在完整信息设置下遗憾界为Õ(dT/√m)、在bandit设置下为Õ(dT√(K/m))的算法，并通过实验验证了在多样化LLM上仅凭有限反馈即可高效学习高质量路由策略。
AI.motivation: 在多LLM专家系统中，如何自适应地将提示词路由到最合适的模型以最大化响应质量，同时面临在线设置和有限反馈（需策略性选择并观察奖励）的挑战，现有方法缺乏对此问题的系统性研究。
AI.method: 将提示词路由问题形式化为带d维特征、K个动作（专家）和T轮时间范围的bandit问题；设计了在完整信息和bandit两种设置下战略性选择并观察奖励的算法，分别推导出对应的遗憾上界。
AI.result: 完整信息设置下达到Õ(dT/√m)的遗憾界，bandit设置下达到Õ(dT√(K/m))的遗憾界（m≪T为反馈预算），实验表明算法能在多样化LLM上从有限反馈中高效学习高质量路由策略。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为LLM路由问题提供了理论保障的在线学习算法，在极有限的反馈预算下仍能高效逼近最优路由策略，对实际部署多LLM系统具有重要价值。

title: The Effectiveness of Virtual Patient Simulation Versus Peer Simulation in Providing Sexual Counseling During Pregnancy: A Randomized Controlled Trial
summary: Although sexual health counseling is one of the important responsibilities of healthcare professionals, effective educational methods are needed to develop students' counseling skills in this field. The aim of this study was to compare the effectiveness of virtual patient simulation and peer simulation methods in developing sexual counseling skills during pregnancy among nursing faculty students. This randomized controlled trial included 51 participants assigned to one of three groups: virtual patient simulation, peer simulation in a virtual environment, or face-to-face peer simulation. In the study, all groups received face-to-face theoretical instruction on sexual counseling during pregnancy. Following the theoretical training, students participated in virtual patient simulation, peer simulation in a virtual environment, or face-to-face peer simulation practices according to the groups to which they were assigned by randomization. Outcome measures included the Sexual Attitudes and Beliefs Scale, the Student Satisfaction and Self-Confidence in Learning Scale, and the Sexual Counseling Skills Evaluation Form. It was determined that the participants' SABS scores decreased significantly after the intervention. According to the results of the mixed repeated-measures ANOVA, the effect of time was statistically significant. However, the group effect and the group x time interaction were not significant. There was no difference between the groups in terms of Satisfaction in learning, Self-confidence in learning, and Skill scores. This study showed that different simulation methods used in sexual counseling education during pregnancy were effective in reducing students' negative attitudes and beliefs and provided similar educational outcomes. Therefore, virtual patient and peer simulations may be recommended as feasible approaches for improving sexual counseling skills.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过随机对照试验，比较了虚拟患者模拟、虚拟环境同伴模拟和面对面同伴模拟三种方法在孕期性咨询技能培养中的效果，发现不同模拟方法均有效减少护生负面性态度与信念，且教育效果相当。
AI.motivation: 性健康咨询是医疗专业人员的重要职责之一，但需要有效的教育方法来培养学生的咨询技能，目前缺乏对不同模拟教学方法的比较性研究。
AI.method: 随机对照试验，51名护理院系学生随机分配至三个组：虚拟患者模拟组、虚拟环境同伴模拟组和面对面同伴模拟组。所有组先接受面对面的孕期性咨询理论教学，随后按组别参与相应的模拟实践。采用性态度与信念量表（SABS）、学习满意度和自信量表及性咨询技能评估表进行评估。
AI.result: 干预后所有参与者的SABS评分显著下降；混合重复测量方差分析显示时间效应显著，但组间效应和组×时间交互效应不显著；三组在学习满意度、学习自信和技能评分方面无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 不同模拟方法在孕期性咨询教育中均能有效减少学生的负面态度和信念，并产生相似的教育效果。虚拟患者模拟和同伴模拟可被视为提升性咨询技能的可行教学途径。

title: The Failure Happens Before the Drift: The Social Dynamics of Values in LLM Agent Societies
summary: Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents are increasingly used as proxies for human participants in social science research, yet it remains unclear whether they can faithfully simulate diverse and conflicting human value systems. We present a World Values Survey (WVS)-grounded simulation framework where culturally diverse agents with different communication styles engage in longitudinal, value-laden discussions. Across approximately 4,000 conversations involving 1,200 personas, 15 topics, and three models (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Flash, and Gemma-4-E4B), we evaluate value faithfulness, value drift, and conversational realism. We find that more than 50\% of personas fail to express their assigned WVS profiles from the outset, while 2-7\% drift after repeated conversations. Ablations removing demographic details improve faithfulness for some models but do not change the broader trend: simulated value distributions still systematically deviate from the assigned WVS profiles. Compared to human discussions, simulated dialogues show a different trade-off between stylistic consistency and semantic diversity, often producing content-wise varied but stylistically repetitive exchanges. These findings suggest that current LLM agents can generate plausible conversations, but remain limited proxies for representing and preserving diverse human value profiles over time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个基于世界价值观调查（WVS）的模拟框架，用于评估LLM智能体能否忠实模拟多样化的人类价值观系统。通过约4000段对话、1200个角色、15个主题和3种模型，发现超过50%的角色从一开始就无法表达其预设的WVS价值观，2-7%在重复对话后发生漂移，且模拟对话在风格一致性与语义多样性之间呈现与人类不同的权衡，表明当前LLM智能体作为人类价值观代理仍存在局限。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体正越来越多地被用作社会科学研究中人类参与者的代替品，但其能否忠实模拟多样化且相互冲突的人类价值系统尚不清楚。研究旨在系统性地评估这一能力。
AI.method: 构建基于WVS的模拟框架，赋予文化多样化的智能体不同的沟通风格，让其参与纵向、价值导向的多轮讨论。实验涵盖约4000段对话、1200个人物角色、15个话题，以及GPT-4o、Gemini-2.5-Flash和Gemma-4-E4B三种模型，评估指标包括价值忠实度、价值漂移和对话真实性。同时进行消融实验，去除人口统计学细节以检验其对价值忠实度的影响。
AI.result: 超过50%的角色从一开始就无法表达其预设的WVS价值观档案；2-7%的角色在重复对话后发生价值观漂移。消融实验移除人口学细节虽对某些模型有所改善，但未改变整体趋势：模拟的价值观分布仍系统性偏离预设的WVS档案。与人类对话相比，模拟对话在风格一致性和语义多样性之间表现出不同的权衡，往往产生内容多样但风格重复的交流。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM智能体虽能生成看似合理的对话，但在表征和长期保持多样化人类价值观档案方面仍是有限的代理工具。这一发现对LLM在人机交互、社会科学模拟等领域的应用提出了重要警示。

title: Generalizing HVAC Control With Domain Randomized Reinforcement Learning
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures. Short paper published in ACM Sustainability Week Companion '26
summary:
Deploying advanced HVAC (Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning) controllers at scale remains difficult because performance often depends on accurate building models or per-site retuning. We propose NOMAD-RL (Neural Online Meta-Adaptation for Dynamics), a general-purpose Reinforcement Learning (RL) controller designed to transfer across heterogeneous thermal zones through a universal, non-invasive thermostat interface. The controller acts on temperature setpoints from zone measurements and forecasts, while a recurrent policy supports online adaptation under partial observability.
  Our main contribution is an adaptive domain randomization scheme based on physics-informed normalizing flows, which models correlated and multimodal distributions of thermal-zone parameters while maintaining physical plausibility and controllability. This produces a realistic and progressively adaptive training curriculum that improves transfer across buildings. We evaluate NOMAD-RL against a constant-setpoint PID controller, RL without domain randomization, and MPC in single- and multi-zone settings. NOMAD-RL consistently outperforms the PID and non-randomized RL baselines, and approaches the performance of a well-tuned MPC, especially in the more challenging multi-zone case. These results highlight the potential of adaptive, physics-informed domain randomization for robust and transferable HVAC control.

AI.tldr: 提出NOMAD-RL，一种基于递归策略和物理信息归一化流的自适应域随机化方法，用于跨不同类型热区域的HVAC集中控制，无需逐站点参数调优。
AI.motivation: 大规模部署高级HVAC控制器之所以困难，是因为其性能往往依赖于精确的建筑模型或逐站点的重新调参，缺乏通用且可迁移的控制方案。
AI.method: NOMAD-RL通过通用无侵入式恒温器接口，作用于温度设定点；采用递归策略支持部分可观测条件下的在线自适应；核心创新是基于物理信息归一化流的自适应域随机化方案，可建模热区域参数的关联及多模态分布，保持物理合理性与可控性，形成渐进式自适应训练课程。
AI.result: 在单区域和多区域场景中，NOMAD-RL一致优于恒定设定点PID控制器和无域随机化的RL基线，尤其在更困难的多区域场景中接近调优良好的MPC性能。
AI.conclusion: 自适应的、物理信息驱动的域随机化方案有望实现鲁棒且可迁移的HVAC控制，展示了大规模部署通用RL控制器的潜力。

title: The Interface of Theseus: The Rise of Just-In-Time Interfaces
summary: Our community creates interfaces---pre-constructed, static artifacts. These interfaces are effortful to create, so we invest great effort and care into each of them. Yet the equilibrium is shifting: we can now construct nearly any software, bespoke, within moments. When construction is cheap, we may soon live in a future in which interfaces are constructed in real time. This is a world of just-in-time interfaces: rapid, discardable, on-demand interfaces tailored to our needs in the moment. Will our community still create traditional interactive systems in this world? Or will we create interface generators, ``interface.md'' guides for AI consumption? I argue that we ought to lean into a future of rapid, bespoke, on-demand interfaces.

AI.tldr: 本文预言了一个"即时界面"的未来：随着AI使软件构建成本急剧下降，界面将从预先精心构建的静态产物转变为可按需快速生成、用完即弃的临时性界面。作者认为社区应拥抱这一转变，从创建传统交互系统转向创建界面生成器。
AI.motivation: 传统界面构建成本高昂且费力，但AI技术使软件几乎可以即时构建。作者希望探讨当构建成本趋近于零时，界面设计的范式将如何转变，以及社区是否还应继续投入大量精力制作传统交互系统。
AI.method: 这是一篇观点/立场论文（position paper），通过概念推演和未来场景构想来论证"即时界面"（just-in-time interfaces）的必然性与价值，并提出社区应从制作静态界面转向制作界面生成器的方向性建议。
AI.result: 作者提出"即时界面"的概念——快速、可丢弃、按需生成的界面，认为未来社区应拥抱这一范式，从创建传统交互系统转向构建界面生成工具。
AI.conclusion: 作者主张我们应该主动投向快速、定制化、按需生成界面的未来，而非固守传统精心设计的静态界面范式。

title: Beyond "AI Helps Humans": Decision-Targeted Evaluation Design for Human-Agent Teams in the Agentic Era
summary: Wherever a coding agent works under engineer supervision, or a clinical model assists a radiologist, the deployment question is whether to keep the human-AI workflow or replace it with the human alone or the agent alone. The human-AI workflow is worth keeping only if it beats both of those alternatives. Yet once it is deployed, neither alternative outcome is observed: recovering one means replaying the task under that alternative, and every replay costs expert time or compute. Under a fixed replay budget, the design question is therefore which tasks should be more likely to receive a human-only replay, and which an agent-only replay. Existing methods do not directly target this decision. Agent benchmarks do not choose which missing baseline to measure, variance-based sampling ignores which of the two comparisons is closer to failing, and Bayesian information methods focus on learning model parameters instead of making the deployment decision. We propose TEAM-Design, a rule that gives every task two replay probabilities, one per baseline. It raises a probability where the missing baseline outcome is hard to predict from what is already known about the task and where that comparison is harder to establish, and lowers it where replay is expensive. We prove that the rule solves this budgeted design problem, and that drawing the replays at random from recorded probabilities still controls the chance of wrongly declaring that the workflow beats both. We reanalyze 6 clinical settings, where no human-AI workflow beats both alternatives, and a coding benchmark, where one does, then evaluate TEAM-Design on synthetic designs and on a semi-synthetic design built from a real chest X-ray reader study. TEAM-Design works best when one of the two comparisons is clearly harder to settle than the other, and can do worse than variance-based allocation when the two are similarly difficult.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TEAM-Design规则，在有限回放预算下为每个任务分配两种基线（纯人类、纯智能体）的回放概率，以最优地决定哪些任务应接受人类回放、哪些应接受智能体回放，用于验证人机协同工作流是否优于两个单独基线。
AI.motivation: 在人机协同部署中（如编码代理在工程师监督下、临床模型辅助放射科医生），需要判断是否保留人机协同工作流而非用纯人类或纯智能体替代。但一旦部署后无法观测两种替代结果，只能通过回放获取，而回放预算有限，因此需要决定哪些任务优先回放哪类基线。现有方法（智能体基准、方差采样、贝叶斯信息方法）均未直接针对这一部署决策优化。
AI.method: 提出TEAM-Design规则：为每个任务分配两个回放概率（每类基线各一个）。当缺失基线结果难以从已有信息预测、且该比较更难确立时提高概率；当回放成本高时降低概率。作者证明该规则解决了预算受限的设计问题，且从记录的概率中随机抽取回放仍能控制错误声明工作流优于两个基线的概率。
AI.result: 在6个临床设置（无任何工作流同时击败两个基线）和1个编码基准（有工作流同时击败两者）上进行再分析，并在合成设计和基于真实胸部X光读片研究的半合成设计上评估TEAM-Design。结果表明：当两个比较难度差异明显时TEAM-Design表现最佳；当两个比较难度相似时可能劣于方差分配方法。
AI.conclusion: TEAM-Design为预算受限的人机协同部署验证问题提供了理论最优的分配规则，在比较难度不对称时尤为有效；但其局限在于比较难度对称时性能可能不及现有的方差类方法。

title: Scaling Optimal Classification Trees via Adaptive Feature and Sample Reduction
summary: Dynamic programming for optimal classification trees becomes computationally expensive as the numbers of features and training samples increase. We develop a joint feature- and sample-space reduction framework based on STreeD. Weighted STreeD merges duplicate records created after projection onto a fixed candidate set into weighted representatives. This reduces sample-dependent computation without changing the fixed-candidate optimization problem. Adaptive STreeD repeatedly refines a bounded candidate set, retains features used by the incumbent tree, rebuilds the weighted representation, and solves the resulting reduced problems. Each certified Weighted STreeD solution is optimal for its current candidate set, while the outer feature search remains heuristic over the full feature space. Experiments on five data sets show that Weighted STreeD achieves speedups of up to 121.41 times over standard STreeD. Adaptive STreeD reduces runtime in matched comparisons at depths 2 to 4 and continues to return feasible trees at greater depths where full-feature methods are limited by time or memory. Under the same computational budget, its predictive performance remains comparable to the evaluated optimal classification tree baselines and is higher in some comparisons. These results show how joint feature- and sample-space reduction can scale dynamic-programming-based optimal-tree learning to more demanding instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于STreeD的联合特征与样本空间缩减框架，包括Weighted STreeD（合并重复记录为加权代表以加速计算）和Adaptive STreeD（自适应精炼候选特征集并重建加权表示），在五个数据集上实现最高121倍的加速，同时保持与最优分类树基线相当的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 基于动态规划的最优分类树方法在处理大规模特征和训练样本时计算代价极高，亟需有效的缩减策略来扩展其应用范围。
AI.method: 提出两种方法：Weighted STreeD通过将样本投影到固定候选特征集后合并重复记录为加权代表，减少样本相关计算；Adaptive STreeD反复精炼有界候选特征集，保留当前最优树所用特征，重建加权表示并求解缩减后的问题。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上，Weighted STreeD相比标准STreeD实现最高121.41倍加速；Adaptive STreeD在深度2至4减少运行时间，在更深度可返回可行树（全特征方法受限于时间或内存）；在相同计算预算下预测性能与最优分类树基线相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 联合特征与样本空间缩减能有效将动态规划最优树学习扩展到更具挑战性的实例。

title: Adaptive Complementarity in Human-AI Systems: Architecture as a State-Shaping Choice
summary: Human-AI interaction can improve current performance while changing the capabilities and relationships on which future performance depends. We develop adaptive complementarity, a framework for choosing interaction architecture with these state consequences in view. Access, information exposure, task allocation, timing, and communication can alter which arrangement will be valuable later; their settings can often be reset faster than the capabilities, search patterns, or conventions they create. Three mechanisms organize the argument: information exposure and collective search, delegation and capability evolution, and strategic interdependence and information governance. Their integration yields cross-mechanism implications, including conditions under which a loss of expertise heterogeneity increases the information differentiation required to preserve independent search. We distinguish strong human-AI complementarity from advantage over another workflow and from advantage over an evolving reference policy. A knowledge-coverage illustration shows how different interaction histories can reverse current workflow rankings even at equal human competence. It also separates that result from the incremental value of state feedback, which can be small when a well-chosen stable workflow anticipates learning. The framework directs evaluation toward the states present interaction creates, their consequences for later architectural fit, and the conditions under which observing and responding to them is worthwhile.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自适应互补性"框架，用于在考虑状态后果的前提下选择人机交互架构，强调交互设置（信息暴露、任务分配等）的可重置速度快于它们所创造的能力与惯例，并提出跨机制整合的评估框架与知识覆盖率的示例验证。
AI.motivation: 人机交互虽能提升当前表现，但会改变影响未来表现的"能力"与"关系"。已有研究多关注当前绩效或单一互补性定义，忽视了交互架构选择对未来架构适配状态的影响，因此需要一个将状态后果纳入考量的框架。
AI.method: 提出"自适应互补性"框架，围绕三个机制展开论证：（1）信息暴露与集体搜索（2）委托与能力演化（3）战略互依与信息治理。通过三机制整合得出跨机制含义，并以知识覆盖率示例区分强互补性、对其他流程的优势、对演化参考策略的优势，以及状态反馈的增量价值。
AI.result: 框架区分了强人机互补性与两类"优势"概念，揭示了不同交互历史可在人类能力相同的情况下逆转当前工作流排序；同时表明状态反馈的增量价值可能较小——当稳定且精心选择的工作流能提前预期学习时，稳健流程已足够。
AI.conclusion: 评估应聚焦于当前交互所创造的状态、这些状态对未来架构适配的影响，以及判断观察和响应这些状态在何种条件下具有价值。该框架为动态人机协作设计提供了决策导向。

title: EdgeMem: LLM-Free Agent Memory Construction and Retrieval via Evidence-Preserving Multi-Anchor Hypergraph
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, and 5 tables. An earlier implementation is available at https://github.com/Soullesskid/edgemem ; it differs substantially from the version described in this paper. The repository will be updated with the corresponding implementation after peer review
summary: Agent memory allows LLM agents to use earlier interactions when answering new queries. Existing methods often compress interaction histories into summaries or other LLM-generated representations. Repeated generation adds cost and can discard answer-bearing details before the system knows what a future query will require. We propose EdgeMem, an agent-memory method built around a simple principle: preserve original interaction turns and organize them through complementary content, temporal, and episodic cues. EdgeMem realizes this principle with a multi-anchor hypergraph constructed by lightweight local processing. Retrieval directly returns source evidence and reserves LLM use for final answer generation, combining structured access to multi-session histories with faithful retention of the original conversation. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S show strong retrieval and memory-grounded question answering; on LoCoMo, EdgeMem achieves the highest strict-judge score among seven reproduced systems under a shared prompt (61.01 versus 58.70), while construction and retrieval require no generative-LLM calls. Overall, EdgeMem shows that preserving and organizing source evidence provides an effective and efficient foundation for agent memory without generative memory management.

AI.tldr: EdgeMem是一种基于"保留原始交互轮次并通过内容、时间和情节线索组织"原则的智能体记忆方法，通过轻量级多锚点超图实现，检索直接返回原始证据，仅在最终答案生成时使用LLM，在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上表现出色。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆方法通常将对话历史压缩为摘要等LLM生成表示，重复生成增加成本，且可能在系统知晓未来查询需求之前就丢弃了包含答案的关键细节。
AI.method: EdgeMem通过轻量级局部处理构建多锚点超图，利用互补的内容、时间和情节线索组织原始交互轮次；检索阶段直接返回源证据，将LLM使用仅限于最终答案生成环节。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo和LongMemEval-S上展示了强大的检索和记忆基础的问答性能；在LoCoMo上，七个复现系统共享提示词下，EdgeMem的严格评判得分最高（61.01对比58.70），且构建与检索无需生成式LLM调用。
AI.conclusion: 保留并组织源证据为智能体记忆提供了高效且有效的基础，无需生成式记忆管理即可实现出色性能。

title: SAFEGuard: Detect Optimization-Based Jailbreak Attacks Through Harmful Semantic Analysis and Fluency Measurement
comment: Published as a conference paper at the Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026). Our project page is available at https://vietvo89.github.io/SAFEGuard_project/
summary: Despite the significant efforts devoted to aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values and ensuring safe deployment, recent work has revealed that LLMs remain vulnerable to adversarial jailbreak attacks that can bypass safety guardrails and elicit harmful responses. Many defense methods are proposed to detect jailbreaks but they are limited in their effectiveness to counter wide-range optimization-based jailbreak mechanisms that can yield highly fluency-optimized or harmful semantic obfuscated prompts. To tackle this challenge, we propose a unified detection framework SAFEGuard which incorporates a hybrid fluency measurement based on cross-layer distribution distance and perplexity, and the analysis of harmful semantics through gradient matching. Our method is grounded in a paramount observation: high fluency prompts maintain their malicious intention close to harmful prompts while harmful semantic obfuscated prompts often inject gibberish token sequences. Our evaluation demonstrates that SAFEGuard consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and achieves significant improvement in accuracy across different optimization-based jailbreaks. This underscores the effectiveness of SAFEGuard against evolving jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAFEGuard，一个统一的越狱攻击检测框架，结合跨层分布距离与困惑度的混合流畅度度量以及基于梯度匹配的有害语义分析，有效检测优化型越狱攻击，性能优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型即使经过对齐训练，仍易受到对抗性越狱攻击的侵害。现有防御方法对优化型越狱机制（如高度流畅优化或有害语义混淆的提示）检测效果有限，亟需更有效的统一检测框架。
AI.method: SAFEGuard提出统一检测框架，包含两个核心组件：1）基于跨层分布距离和困惑度的混合流畅度测量；2）通过梯度匹配进行有害语义分析。方法基于两个关键观察：高度流畅的提示其恶意意图接近有害提示，而语义混淆的提示往往注入无意义的token序列。
AI.result: 实验评估表明SAFEGuard在不同优化型越狱攻击上持续优于最先进的基线方法，在检测准确率上取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: SAFEGuard在应对不断演化的越狱攻击方面展现出有效性，为解决LLM安全部署中对抗性攻击检测提供了有力的统一框架。

title: Living with AI Companions: Sustained AI Companionship Predicts Lower Well-Being Through Lower Human Interaction
summary: AI chatbots are increasingly used for companionship, emotional support, and personal self-disclosure; however, how social engagement with these systems unfolds over time and shapes users' well-being remains unclear. To address this, we conducted a two-wave longitudinal study of CharacterAI users, surveying 1,182 participants at baseline and 439 after a mean follow-up of 12 months. We examined how social engagement with AI companions evolves and how these longitudinal engagement patterns may influence well-being through two hypothesized pathways: sustained social engagement over time and the displacement of human social interaction. We found that interaction intensity, companionship use, and self-disclosure all showed substantial continuity over time. Greater interaction intensity at baseline predicted greater subsequent interaction intensity, companionship use, and self-disclosure. Consistent with the longitudinal engagement pathway, sustained social engagement across these dimensions was consistently associated with lower well-being. Results further support the social displacement pathway, indicating that these links were mainly explained by lower in-person social interaction. These findings highlight the importance of designing AI companions that support human social relationships without displacing them

AI.tldr: 通过为期12个月的两波纵向研究（1182名基线参与者，439名随访参与者），考察CharacterAI用户与AI伴侣的社交互动如何随时间演变及其对幸福感的影响。研究发现互动强度、陪伴使用和自我表露具有高度时间连续性，且持续社交参与与更低的幸福感相关，这一关联主要由线下人际社交被替代所解释。
AI.motivation: AI聊天机器人被越来越多地用于陪伴、情感支持和个人自我表露，但用户与这些系统的社交参与如何随时间演变并影响幸福感尚不清楚。作者旨在填补这一研究空白。
AI.method: 采用两波纵向研究设计，对CharacterAI用户进行问卷调查，基线调查1182名参与者，平均12个月后随访439名参与者。通过两条假设路径（持续性社交参与和人际社交替代）分析纵向参与模式对幸福感的影响。
AI.result: 互动强度、陪伴使用和自我表露均表现出显著的时间连续性；基线互动强度更高的用户在后续表现出更高的互动强度、陪伴使用和自我表露。与纵向参与路径一致，各维度的持续社交参与均与更低幸福感相关。结果支持社交替代路径，表明这些关联主要由较低的线下人际社交所解释。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果强调了设计AI伴侣时的重要性——应支持而非替代人类社交关系。AI陪伴系统的设计需要关注其对用户线下社交互动的潜在替代效应，以维护用户长期幸福感。

title: Deep belief networks are exact
summary: We prove that every strictly positive probability distribution on \(\{-1,1\}^n\) is represented exactly by a sigmoid belief network with finite parameters. This answers a question of Sutskever and Hinton. The proof upgrades their probability-sharing approximation to exact representation using Brouwer's fixed-point theorem.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了任意定义在{-1,1}^n上的严格正概率分布都能被具有有限参数的sigmoid置信网络精确表示，回答了Sutskever和Hinton提出的问题。证明方法是将他们的概率共享近似方法升级为精确表示，核心工具是Brouwer不动点定理。
AI.motivation: Sigmoid置信网络是否能够精确表示任意严格正的概率分布是一个悬而未决的问题。Sutskever和Hinton此前提出了概率共享近似方法，但无法证明精确表示的存在性。该问题对于理解sigmoid置信网络的表达能力至关重要。
AI.method: 作者通过对Sutskever和Hinton的概率共享逼近方法进行升级，利用Brouwer不动点定理证明存在有限参数使得sigmoid置信网络能够精确（而非近似）地表示任意严格正的离散概率分布。
AI.result: 证明了对任意定义在{-1,1}^n上的严格正概率分布，都存在一个具有有限参数的sigmoid置信网络恰好表示该分布，从而回答了Sutskever和Hinton的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 该结果建立了sigmoid置信网络在表示能力上的充分性，即这类网络可以精确建模任何无零概率的离散分布，为sigmoid置信网络的理论基础提供了重要补充。

title: Selective Posterior Margin Regularization for Forward-Corrected Classification
summary: Learning with class-conditional label noise often relies on a transition model from latent clean classes to observed annotations. Forward correction embeds this transition in the likelihood, yet finite-sample networks may still memorize corrupted labels. The corrected likelihood also induces a reverse posterior over the clean classes that could explain each annotation. When its leading class differs from the annotation, the model and transition matrix provide evidence against that annotation, but the leading alternatives can remain nearly tied. We introduce Selective Posterior Margin Regularization (SPMR), which preserves the Forward objective and converts this disagreement into a graded update on the clean classifier. SPMR selects the leading reverse-posterior class, scales a detached pairwise margin by the separation between the two leading posterior classes, and assigns correspondingly little influence to diffuse conflicts. The gap factorizes into transition- adjusted pairwise separation and the posterior mass carried by the leading pair. The active margin follows the locally minimum-norm logit direction that enlarges the selected pairwise margin. Across five known-transition benchmarks, SPMR improves full-length Forward by 2.5-7.0 percentage points and remains 0.7-2.5 percentage points above Forward with Mixup and early stopping. Matched interventions support distinct gains from the posterior-space coefficient, transition-adjusted target, and pairwise action. The same design transfers to estimated transitions, human annotations, architectural changes, and stronger Forward recipes. The formulation uses latent-class evidence already available inside Forward correction without promoting every posterior conflict to a corrected label.

AI.tldr: 本文提出选择性后验边际正则化（SPMR），在保持前向校正目标不变的前提下，利用反向后验中前两类之间的差异程度，对干净分类器施加分级别的边际更新，从而缓解类条件标签噪声下的记忆过拟合问题。在五个已知转移基准上，SPMR相比完整前向校正提升2.5-7.0个百分点，且在多种设置下均保持稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 在前向校正（Forward correction）框架下，虽然转移模型被嵌入似然中，但有限样本下的网络仍可能记忆损坏标签。当前向校正的反向后验中主导类与标注不一致时，虽然模型和转移矩阵提供了反对该标注的证据，但各备选主导类之间可能几乎并列，导致原有方法无法有效区分强弱证据并施加合理惩罚。
AI.method: SPMR的核心包括三部分：(1) 选择反向后验中的主导类别；(2) 将主导类的成对边际按后验中前两类之间的分离程度进行缩放（该缩放因子可分解为转移调整的成对分离度与主导对的后验质量之积）；(3) 激活边际沿局部最小范数logit方向更新，以扩大所选成对边际。整个正则项以分离度加权，对模糊冲突赋予较小影响。
AI.result: 在五个已知转移基准上，SPMR较完整前向校正提升2.5-7.0个百分点，比前向校正+Mixup+早停仍高0.7-2.5个百分点。消融实验验证了后验空间系数、转移调整目标和成对作用各自带来独立增益。该方法也能迁移到估计转移矩阵、人工标注、架构变化及更强的前向校正设置。
AI.conclusion: SPMR利用前向校正中已有的潜在类别证据进行分级正则化，不将每个后验冲突都提升为修正标签，从而在保持前向目标的同时有效缓解标签噪声下的记忆问题，是一种通用且稳健的改进方案。

title: From Human Factors to Human-Technology Factors: An HCI Perspective on Technology in Avalanche Safety
summary: The avalanche safety literature has identified human factors that contribute to accidents, yet researchers note a persistent gap between these insights and effective product design. Meanwhile, interactive technologies are shaping backcountry decision making with or without grounding in theory and research. We broaden the discussion of human factors into ``human-technology factors," examining how technology can both support and undermine judgment in avalanche terrain, from a human-computer interaction (HCI) perspective. We summarize relevant HCI concepts along four dimensions - attention, cognition, trust, and social interaction - and use them to revisit McCammon's FACETS framework, cataloging ways in which specific technologies may mitigate or exacerbate classic heuristic traps, grounded in accident reports and literature where possible. We identify recurring patterns, including technologies with dual-sided effects and a pervasive ``digital expert halo."

AI.tldr: 本文从人机交互（HCI）视角拓宽了雪崩安全领域中"人为因素"的讨论，提出"人-技术因素"概念，批判性地检视交互技术如何影响野外雪崩地形中的决策。
AI.motivation: 雪崩安全文献已识别出导致事故的人为因素，但研究者注意到这些洞见与有效的产品设计之间存在持续脱节；同时，交互技术在理论依据不足的情况下正在塑造野外决策，需要系统性地审视技术的影响。
AI.method: 从注意力、认知、信任和社交互动四个HCI维度总结相关概念，并用以重新审视McCammon的FACETS框架，结合事故报告和相关文献，系统分类具体技术可能加剧或缓解经典启发式陷阱的方式。
AI.result: 识别出反复出现的模式，包括具有双面影响的技术，以及普遍存在的"数字专家光环"现象。
AI.conclusion: 技术在雪崩决策中既可能支持也可能削弱判断力，需要将人为因素讨论拓展为"人-技术因素"，以弥合研究与产品设计之间的鸿沟。

title: EnvCraft: Synthesizing Executable Environments in Agentic RL for Claw-like Agent
summary: The paradigm of LLMs has rapidly shifted from passive language interfaces to autonomous Claw-like agents that execute long-horizon tasks across stateful workspaces. While Agentic Reinforcement Learning (Agentic RL) provides a promising path to optimize these agents, its scaling is heavily bottlenecked by the severe scarcity of interactive training environments. Existing synthetic environments are strictly limited to tool-calling endpoints, rendering them insufficient for accommodating the end-to-end real-world demands of claw-like agents. To bridge this gap, we introduce EnvCraft, an automated framework for synthesizing executable environments and scalable training data. Specifically, EnvCraft employs an environment synthesis engine to build sandbox-isolated workspaces, alongside a topology-aware data generation engine to produce coherent task trajectories. Overall, we synthesize 139 interactive environments comprising approximately 20K complex tasks for Agentic RL training. Experiments on Qwen3/3.5 models (8B-32B) show that our method yields gains of up to +11.9% on Claw-style benchmarks and +8.0% on general tool-use benchmarks, with concurrent reductions in inference token cost. The results confirm that synthesized executable environments provide robust and generalizable learning signals for training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EnvCraft框架，用于自动合成可执行的交互式环境和可扩展的训练数据，以解决Agentic RL中交互环境稀缺的瓶颈问题。通过构建139个交互环境和约2万个复杂任务，在Qwen3/3.5模型上实现了Claw风格基准测试最高+11.9%和通用工具使用基准+8.0%的性能提升，同时降低了推理代币成本。
AI.motivation: LLM正从被动语言接口演变为自主Claw类智能体，Agentic RL虽有前景但受限于交互训练环境的严重稀缺。现有合成环境仅限于工具调用端点，无法满足Claw类智能体的端到端真实世界需求。
AI.method: EnvCraft包含两个核心组件：一是环境合成引擎，用于构建沙箱隔离的工作区；二是拓扑感知的数据生成引擎，用于生成连贯的任务轨迹。通过这两个引擎自动合成可执行环境和大规模训练数据，支撑Agentic RL训练。
AI.result: 合成了139个交互环境及约2万个复杂任务。在Qwen3/3.5模型（8B-32B）上，Claw风格基准测试最高提升+11.9%，通用工具使用基准提升+8.0%，同时推理代币成本有所降低。
AI.conclusion: 合成可执行环境能够为智能体训练提供稳健且可泛化的学习信号，有效弥补真实交互环境不足的问题，验证了EnvCraft方法的有效性和可扩展性。

title: Beyond Arbitrary Geometry: Topology Generalization In neural PDE Operators
summary: Neural operators that accept arbitrary meshes are often treated as geometry-general, but unseen domain topology changes both the invariant and decaying subspaces of a PDE operator. We use Hodge heat flow as a controlled lens on this distinction and introduce TopoBox-3D, where tunnels and cavities vary Betti support while the exact Hodge decomposition separates the harmonic kernel from the positive spectrum. Across six architectures, models that infer topology implicitly suffer excess matched degradation in 37 of 45 model--task topology-OOD cells, yet cases that change harmonic dimension are not more strongly penalized on average. The dominant difficulty is instead spectral: the initial Rayleigh quotient is the most stable predictor of error, and spectral broadening adds information for edge and face cochains. Most strikingly, controlled probes show that explicit incidence and harmonic coordinates do not yield the best kernel-identity accuracy; nevertheless, TNO ranks first in mixed-input nonharmonic accuracy on all six tasks with nontrivial harmonic support. Together, these results establish topology as a distinct generalization axis beyond arbitrary-geometry compatibility and show that its influence extends across the Hodge spectrum rather than remaining confined to the harmonic kernel. More broadly, they suggest that global, low-frequency structural priors may help organize predictions in the faster-decaying complementary component, offering a new perspective on how neural operators may generalize across topology as well as geometry.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TopoBox-3D基准，研究神经算子在不同拓扑（如隧道和空腔改变Betti数）下的泛化能力。通过Hodge热流作为受控视角，发现拓扑分布外推（OOD）导致模型性能显著下降，但主要困难来自谱域而非调和核，显式调和坐标并非最优，而全局低频结构先验可能帮助泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子通常声称对任意网格几何泛化，但忽略了域拓扑变化对PDE算子不变和衰减子空间的影响。作者希望厘清"几何一般性"与"拓扑一般性"的区别，系统地考察拓扑OOD下神经算子的实际表现。
AI.method: 引入TopoBox-3D基准：通过改变隧道和空腔来改变Betti支撑，利用精确的Hodge分解将调和核与正谱分离。使用Hodge热流作为受控实验视角。在六个架构、六个任务上系统测量模型在拓扑OOD场景下的性能，并通过受控探针测试显式incidence和调和坐标的作用。
AI.result: 在45个模型-任务拓扑OOD单元中37个出现过量匹配退化。调和维数改变并非更强惩罚因素，主要困难在谱域——初始Rayleigh商是最稳定的误差预测因子，谱展宽对边和面cochain是有益信息。显式incidence和调和坐标并未带来最好的核身份准确率，但TNO在全部六个非平凡调和支持任务的混合输入非调和准确率中排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑是独立于几何兼容性的泛化轴，其影响跨越整个Hodge谱而非仅局限于调和核。全局低频结构先验可能在更快衰减的互补分量中帮助组织预测，为神经算子在拓扑与几何双维度上的泛化提供了新视角。

title: Large-Scale User Behavior Analysis in Multimodal AI-Assisted Manual Task Execution
summary: Conversational Task Assistants (CTAs) are multimodal dialogue systems that support users in complex real-world tasks such as cooking and DIY through voice, text, image, and video interactions. Prior user studies have focused on controlled settings, leaving limited understanding of real-world CTA usage at scale. In this work, we present a large-scale study of CTA usage based on thousands of users in-the-wild. Our large-scale real-world data analysis unveils new understandings of (i) user-CTA interaction flows, (ii) user intents, (iii) user conversational traits, and (iv) behavioral factors associated with user satisfaction. Our findings reveal key opportunities for future research in CTAs, particularly in user interaction design and task engagement, concluding with concrete design guidelines.

AI.tldr: 本文基于数千名真实用户的大规模数据，对会话任务助手（CTA）在现实场景中的使用行为进行了全面分析，揭示出用户与CTA的交互流程、意图、对话特征及与满意度相关的行为因素，并提出了具体的设计指南。
AI.motivation: 以往对会话任务助手（CTA）的用户研究多集中在受控实验环境中，缺乏对真实世界中大规模、长期使用行为的理解，因此需要在大规模野外数据上开展用户研究。
AI.method: 基于数千名用户在实际环境（in-the-wild）中使用CTA的真实数据，开展大规模数据分析，从交互流程、用户意图、用户对话特征以及用户满意度相关的行为因素四个维度进行系统性研究。
AI.result: 发现用户与CTA的交互流程、意图分布、对话特征存在新的规律，并识别出与用户满意度相关的关键行为因素，揭示了用户在交互设计与任务参与方面的关键机会点。
AI.conclusion: 研究为CTA领域未来的研究方向提供了新的见解，特别是在用户交互设计和任务参与方面，并最终给出了具体的设计指导原则。

title: Planning and Scheduling Business Processes under Control-Flow Uncertainty
summary: Scheduling activities in business processes can improve efficiency (e.g., reduce makespan), but is challenging because the exact sequence of activities required to complete a case is often uncertain due to decisions based on data that emerges during execution. Nevertheless, probabilistic information regarding such decisions can often be estimated or derived from historical execution logs, and can help anticipate which execution paths are likely to lead to successful completion. Planning with particular execution paths affects feasibility, i.e., the probability of successful completion, and the expected number of superfluous activities that are planned but never executed. We frame the problem as a chance-constrained optimization problem and present two formulations: A decomposed approach with two stages, a planning stage that minimizes the expected number of superfluous activities subject to a feasibility constraint, and a scheduling stage that minimizes the makespan over the planned activities; and an integrated approach that combines planning and scheduling into a single formulation. Evaluation on two real-world and one synthetic dataset shows that the integrated approach yields superior makespans but is intractable at scale, while the decomposed approach scales to large settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了业务流程中在不确定执行路径下的活动调度问题，将规划与调度分别或联合建模为机会约束优化问题，实验表明集成方法效果更优但难以扩展，分解方法则能处理大规模场景。
AI.motivation: 业务流程中的活动调度能够提升效率（如缩短完工时间），但由于执行过程中基于数据的动态决策导致活动序列不确定，使得调度具有挑战性。历史日志中的概率信息可帮助预测可能的执行路径，因此需要一种能平衡可行性与调度效率的方法。
AI.method: 将问题构建为机会约束优化问题，提出两种形式化方案：（1）两阶段分解法，先进行规划阶段以在可行性约束下最小化预期多余活动数，再进行调度阶段以最小化工期；（2）集成法，将规划与调度合并为单一公式。
AI.result: 在两个真实数据集和一个合成数据集上的评估显示：集成方法能产生更优的工期结果，但在规模较大时难以求解；分解方法则能够扩展到大规模场景。
AI.conclusion: 集成方法在解质量上具有优势但存在可扩展性瓶颈，分解方法虽解质量略逊但在实际大规模应用中更具实用性，二者为业务流程调度中的不确定性规划提供了可选的权衡方案。

title: Budgeted Task-Aware Acquisition of Dynamic Networks
summary: Learning on dynamic graphs is difficult when changes in the underlying network are only partially observed. Acquiring current graph information incurs observation and computational costs, making complete updates impractical under limited resources. This paper focuses on budgeted task-aware acquisition on dynamic networks, where a model needs to decide which stale graph information to refresh for a downstream task. We propose Scout, a lightweight framework that learns the task value of querying each node from the maintained graph and observation history. Our evaluation covers one synthetic and four real-world dynamic networks, two downstream tasks, nine acquisition baselines, and several query budgets. Scout achieves the highest mean downstream performance in 19 of the 21 benchmark-budget settings. Task-utility supervision also outperforms structural-change supervision in 13 of the 16 real-world settings. On the same dynamic network, task-matched acquisition improves link-prediction AUC by 0.012-0.016 and node-classification accuracy by 0.064-0.09 over task-mismatched acquisition. These results show that useful graph observations depend on the downstream task and that limited observation budgets can be allocated more effectively by learning directly from downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Scout框架，用于在动态图上进行"预算受限的任务感知信息采集"——即在资源有限的情况下，决定刷新哪些过时图信息以服务于下游任务。实验表明Scout在21个基准-预算组合中的19个取得最高平均下游性能，并证明任务匹配的采集策略显著优于结构变化驱动的策略。
AI.motivation: 动态图学习中，网络的底层变化往往只能被部分观测。获取完整的当前图信息代价高昂（观测成本和计算成本），在资源受限场景下不现实。因此需要一种策略，在有限预算内决定优先刷新哪些过时节点信息，以最大化下游任务的性能。
AI.method: 提出Scout轻量级框架，从当前维护的图结构和观测历史中学习每个节点对下游任务的查询价值（任务价值）。采集预算的分配基于学习到的任务效用而非单纯的结构变化指标。
AI.result: 在1个合成和4个真实动态网络、2个下游任务、9种采集基线和多种查询预算下评估：Scout在21个基准-预算组合中的19个取得最高平均下游性能；任务效用监督在16个真实场景的13个中优于结构变化监督；在相同动态网络上，任务匹配的采集相比任务不匹配的采集，链路预测AUC提升0.012-0.016，节点分类准确率提升0.064-0.09。
AI.conclusion: 图观测的价值是任务依赖的——对下游任务有用的图信息取决于具体任务本身。在有限的观测预算下，通过直接学习下游效用（而非仅关注结构变化）来分配预算，可以将资源更有效地用于提升任务性能。

title: JudgmentLens: Human-AI Sensemaking of Complex Legal Judgments
summary: Judicial judgments are increasingly available, yet dense language and distributed relationships among facts, evidence, reasoning, and rulings remain difficult for non-experts to interpret. Through a mixed-methods formative study with Chinese non-expert readers (survey N=34; interviews N=6), we identified structural, interpretive, verification, and action breakdowns. We developed JudgmentLens, an AI-augmented reading system combining persistent case representations, adaptive explanations, and traceable links from generated interpretations to judgment passages. In a counterbalanced within-subject evaluation (N=16), participants completed tasks faster with JudgmentLens than with conventional PDF reading and reported lower workload and greater self-reported decision understanding, while rubric-scored comprehension did not differ reliably. An exploratory PDF+DeepSeek probe suggested that conversational AI supported formulated questions while leaving question formulation, answer integration, and source checking largely to users. We contribute an empirical account of non-expert judgment sensemaking and design strategies for inspectable, source-grounded AI mediation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非专业读者理解司法裁判文书困难的问题，通过混合方法形成性研究识别了结构性、解释性、验证性和行动性四类理解障碍，开发了AI增强阅读系统JudgmentLens，并验证了其在提升阅读效率、降低认知负荷和增强决策理解方面的效果。
AI.motivation: 司法裁判文书日益公开可得，但其密集的语言表达以及事实、证据、推理和裁决之间分散的关联关系，使非专业读者难以理解和解读。
AI.method: 采用混合方法研究：首先通过问卷调查（N=34）和访谈（N=6）开展形成性研究，识别非专业读者的理解障碍；然后设计并开发JudgmentLens系统，集成持久化案件表征、自适应解释以及从生成的解释到裁判文书原文的可追溯链接；最后进行反向平衡的受试者内评估（N=16），并与PDF阅读及探索性PDF+DeepSeek方案进行对比。
AI.result: 受试者内评估显示，使用JudgmentLens完成任务的速度显著快于传统PDF阅读，同时报告更低的认知负荷和更高的自我报告决策理解度；但基于评分量规的理解评分在两种条件下无可靠差异。探索性PDF+DeepSeek探针表明，对话式AI支持已提出的问题回答，但问题提出、答案整合和来源核查仍需用户自行完成。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献了非专业读者对裁判文书意义建构的实证性描述，以及可检查、来源可追溯的AI中介设计策略。

title: Agents Trust Tools Too Much: Measuring Reliance on Unreliable Tools
summary: Existing evaluations of tool-using agents primarily measure whether an agent can successfully complete diverse tasks with tools. These evaluations generally assume that tools return reliable information. However, tool returns in real-world systems can be plausible yet incorrect. We investigate how agents respond to unreliable tool returns by evaluating fourteen LLMs using three tools-web search, LLM sub-agent delegation, and code execution. For each tool, we corrupt its returns and measure whether agents adopt the corrupted content in their final answers. Agents exhibit high levels of overtrust across all three settings: the mean adoption rate exceeds one third for every tool and reaches 68.0% for web search. Analysis of reasoning traces reveals a particularly concerning failure mode: agents often recognize conflicts and even recover the correct answer internally, yet present only the corrupted answer without warning the user. To mitigate agents' overtrust in tool returns, we intervene at three levels: prompting by the user, metadata from the tool provider, and post-training by the agent builder. Although some interventions help for particular models or tools, none consistently mitigates overtrust across tools. These findings identify overtrust in unreliable tools as a serious and persistent failure mode, motivating evaluations and interventions that enable agents to validate tool outputs and transparently communicate unresolved conflicts.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了工具使用型AI代理对不可靠工具返回信息的过度信任问题。通过对14个LLM和3种工具（网络搜索、LLM子代理委派、代码执行）的实验发现，代理平均采纳被篡改内容的比例超过三分之一，网络搜索场景高达68%。作者还发现代理常能在内部识别冲突并得出正确答案，但最终仍只呈现被篡改的答案且未向用户预警。虽在用户提示、工具元数据和后训练三个层面尝试干预，但均无法在所有工具上一致缓解过度信任问题。
AI.motivation: 现有工具使用的评估几乎都假设工具返回可靠信息，但真实系统中工具返回可能看似合理却实为错误。作者希望探究代理在不可靠工具面前是否会产生过度信任，以及这种失败模式能否被有效缓解。
AI.method: 使用三个工具（网络搜索、LLM子代理委派、代码执行）评估14个LLM，对工具返回结果进行篡改，测量代理是否在最终回答中采纳被篡改的内容。通过推理痕迹分析识别失败模式，并在用户提示层面、工具元数据层面、代理构建者后训练层面分别实施三类干预。
AI.result: 所有工具的过度信任率均超过三分之一，网络搜索最高达68%。推理痕迹显示代理常能识别冲突甚至内部得出正确答案，但最终仅展示被篡改的答案且不向用户预警。三类干预虽对部分模型或工具有效，但均无法在所有工具上一致性缓解过度信任。
AI.conclusion: 过度信任不可靠工具是严重且持久存在的失败模式，现有干预手段不足以全面解决该问题。需要开发能让代理验证工具输出并向用户透明沟通未解决冲突的评估方法和干预策略。

title: A budget-dependent crossover between coverage- and response-based training-set selection for machine-learned interatomic potentials
summary: Selecting compact training sets for machine-learned interatomic potentials requires deciding whether to preserve structural diversity or target configurations on which models disagree. The better choice can depend on how much data is retained, making a comparison at one training-set size insufficient. Here we link selection criteria to prediction accuracy through a budget-resolved comparison of retrained MACE models on GAP-20 Carbon and pooled revised MD17. Structural coverage is compared with a response-guided selector that targets disagreement between a coverage-trained model and a full-data reference. This retrospective response witness tests the value of model disagreement for compressing an already labelled pool. At 5\%, coverage gives smaller absolute deviations from the full-data error than random sampling across four force endpoints in both datasets. The witness has larger deviations than coverage at 1\% and 5\%, but the ordering reverses at 20\%. At 20\%, witness-selected models also lower direct held-out force errors by 0.46--5.89\% relative to coverage, with all eight paired training-seed intervals favouring the witness. Six errors fall below the full-data reference. Mean force-error reductions are 0.164--0.167~meV~$\textÅ^{-1}$, with larger gains for tail and masked endpoints. Complementary analyses show that learned similarity preserves the coverage ranking, while selecting by frozen-model error gives higher error than embedding coverage. These findings establish retained-data budget as a deciding variable in atomistic training-set selection and provide a direct test of when response-guided compression improves on structural coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文通过预算解析对比发现，机器学习原子间势训练集选择中，结构覆盖策略与模型分歧（响应引导）策略的相对优劣取决于保留数据量：在1%和5%预算下覆盖策略误差更小，但在20%预算下分歧引导策略反超覆盖策略，降低留出集力误差0.46-5.89%，表明数据保留预算是训练集选择的关键决定变量。
AI.motivation: 为机器学习原子间势选择紧凑训练集时，需要决定是保留结构多样性（覆盖策略）还是针对模型分歧的构型（响应引导策略），而两者的孰优孰劣可能依赖于保留数据量的大小，仅在一种训练集大小下比较是不充分的，需要预算解析的比较来揭示这种依赖关系。
AI.method: 在GAP-20 Carbon和合并revised MD17两个数据集上，对重训练的MACE模型进行预算解析比较。将结构覆盖度量与响应引导选择器（针对覆盖训练模型与全数据参考模型之间的分歧）进行对比，在1%、5%和20%预算下评估各策略与全数据误差的绝对偏差，并配套分析学习相似性对覆盖排序的保持性及冻结模型误差选择的表现。
AI.result: 在5%预算下，覆盖策略在四个力端点上均比随机采样更接近全数据误差；响应引导策略在1%和5%下偏差大于覆盖策略，但在20%下顺序反转，引导选择模型将直接留出力误差降低0.46-5.89%，八个配对训练种子区间均偏向引导策略，六项误差低于全数据参考，平均力误差降低0.164-0.167 meV/Å，尾部与掩码端点增益更大。
AI.conclusion: 保留数据预算是原子训练集选择中的决定性变量；研究为响应引导压缩何时优于结构覆盖提供了直接检验，表明在较高预算下利用模型分歧引导选择可以优于单纯的结构多样性保留。

title: Situated Action in Pre-Hospital Critical Care Dispatch: Identifying where and how Algorithmic Assistance might be useful in the daily work of specialist Emergency Medical Dispatchers
summary:
This study uses ethnographic immersion and observation as contextual inquiry to understand situated action at an Emergency Medical Dispatch critical care hub. The work is a response to the urgent need to recruit context-specific knowledge and participation into design that helps to narrow the AI Chasm - the gap between the promise of Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems and what they deliver for clinicians and their patients.
  The work of a pre-hospital critical care team's dispatch process is described and analysed to reveal both the structure of the workflow and the different cognitive demands it makes on staff tasked with dispatch decision-making. Elements of attention, communication and focus between the humans, as they carry out this work, are drawn out in order to understand the work-as-done and identify the many dependencies in the process. The motivation is to establish where AI support might be useful and to discover what challenges there could be in designing appropriate algorithmic assistance. We ask whether, where and how the design and implementation of an AI system might be considered. The ultimate objective is to improve the decision process itself to the benefit of clinicians and patients.
  The study identifies three key steps in the situated workflow and details how decision-makers negotiate each one as emergency calls follow complex routes between them. We find compelling evidence that the first of these decision steps constitutes the most promising candidate for unobtrusive assistance that could be safe and effective in improving both clinician workload and clinical outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过民族志浸入与观察，在紧急医疗调度中心进行情境化调查，分析院前急救团队的调度工作流程与认知需求，旨在识别AI辅助的最佳介入点，并发现第一个决策步骤是最有希望实现安全、无干扰AI辅助的环节。
AI.motivation: 为了缩小"AI鸿沟"——即人工智能系统承诺与实际为临床医生和患者带来的价值之间的差距，需要将具体情境的专业知识和参与引入系统设计中，因此需要深入理解调度决策的实际工作流程。
AI.method: 采用民族志浸入与观察作为情境化探究方法，在紧急医疗调度关键护理中心对院前急救团队的调度流程进行描述和分析，揭示工作流结构、认知需求以及人机互动中的注意力、沟通与专注要素，分析"实际完成的工作"及其依赖关系。
AI.result: 研究识别出情境工作流中的三个关键步骤，详细说明决策者在紧急呼叫沿复杂路径流转时如何完成每一步；发现第一个决策步骤是最适合引入无干扰、安全有效的AI辅助的最有希望的候选环节，能够改善临床医生工作负担和临床结局。
AI.conclusion: 该研究明确了AI系统在调度决策过程中可能提供支持的具体位置和设计挑战，最终目标是改进决策过程本身，惠及临床医生和患者。

title: The convergent laboratory: when AI reasoning, autonomous experiments, high performance and quantum computing reshape chemistry
summary: This Comment emerges from TPC26 (https://tpc26.org), a conference convening leaders from academia, national laboratories, and industry who are reshaping materials science discovery. The meeting explored how AI, autonomous agents, self-driving labs, higher performance and quantum computing converge to amplify their individual impact on materials science discovery. The perspectives here reflect the firsthand experiences of researchers at these frontiers and capture the essence of this global endeavor. As AI-driven reasoning, autonomous agentic frameworks, self-driving laboratories, and fault-tolerant quantum processors mature simultaneously, we offer this Comment as a reference at what we believe is a tipping point of transformative advances and productive disruption in the chemical sciences.

AI.tldr: 本文基于TPC26会议共识，论述了AI、自主智能体、自动驾驶实验室、高性能计算与量子计算等前沿技术正在汇聚融合，推动材料科学发现进入变革性的转折点。
AI.motivation: 人工智能、自主智能体、自驱动实验室和容错量子处理器正同时走向成熟，作者认为化学与材料科学正处于突破性变革的关键节点，需要及时总结和阐述这一前沿融合趋势。
AI.method: 基于TPC26会议中来自学术界、国家实验室和工业界的领袖与一线研究者的亲身经验与观点，进行跨领域综合评述。
AI.result: 指出AI驱动推理、自主智能体框架、自驱动实验室与容错量子处理器正同时成熟，其协同效应将放大各自对材料科学发现的影响。
AI.conclusion: 作者将其作为一份参考性评论文章，聚焦于化学与材料科学正处于转型性突破和生产性颠覆的临界点这一核心判断。

title: Grounded and Faithful P&ID Reasoning: Constraining Vision-Language Models with Recovered Evidence Graphs
summary: Piping and Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs) are the authoritative maps of process plants: isolation, maintenance, and HAZOP decisions depend on what connects to what. Vision-language models describe these sheets fluently, yet they often invent or miss process connections---and an invented or missed link can reverse an isolation or reachability call, so a plant decision cannot trust a fluent answer that was never checked against the linework. We instead recover an explicit graph of the drawing---its symbols, the process connections between them, and the tags that name them---and then require the model to answer only by querying that graph through seven read-only operators, so a topology claim is returned only when it cites the query results that support it. On TopoPID-VQA, a new suite of 3000 topology questions over these sheets, Graph-Grounded Harness (Ours) raises exact match accuracy from 36.7--41.3% under image-only prompting to 74.3--76.0% for Qwen3-VL-4B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and Gemma-4-E4B. It does so on an imperfect substrate: on Digitize-PID dataset the recovered graph scores F1 0.742 on exact process connections, and 0.801 once symbols and tags are pooled in. The residual errors track that gap---grounding pays off where the recovered graph is right, and perception error still breaks topology questions where it is not.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Graph-Grounded Harness方法，通过将P&ID图纸恢复为显式图结构（符号、工艺连接、标签），并强制视觉语言模型仅通过七个只读查询算子回答拓扑问题，在TopoPID-VQA基准上将精确匹配准确率从36.7-41.3%提升至74.3-76.0%，尽管底层图形恢复本身存在误差（F1 0.742）。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型在描述P&ID图纸时虽然流畅，但会臆造或遗漏工艺连接——一个错误或丢失的连接可能完全逆转隔离或可达性判断，导致工厂决策无法信任未经图纸线条校验的模型回答。
AI.method: 先显式恢复图纸的图结构（符号、工艺连接、标签），再要求模型只能通过七个只读查询算子访问该图来回答问题，使拓扑断言必须引用查询结果作为支撑证据。
AI.result: 在TopoPID-VQA数据集（3000个拓扑问题）上，对于Qwen3-VL-4B、Qwen3-VL-8B和Gemma-4-E4B三种模型，精确匹配准确率从纯图像提示的36.7-41.3%提升至74.3-76.0%。恢复图在Digitize-PID上精确工艺连接F1为0.742，合并符号和标签后F1为0.801。
AI.conclusion: 图接地方法在被恢复正确的图上效果显著，但感知误差仍会破坏图恢复错误处的拓扑问题，说明该方法的性能受限于底层图恢复质量。

title: Quantifying the Engagement Trap: Impact of Short-form Video Recommender Systems on Users with ADHD
comment: Preprint accepted at The 28th International ACM SIGACCESS Conference on Computers and Accessibility (ASSETS 2026)
summary: Short-form video platforms use recommender systems to maximize engagement through highly efficient personalized recommendations. However, the impact of these recommendations on users with ADHD compared to users without ADHD remains underexplored. Through this study, we introduce and operationalize the Engagement Trap, illustrating how recommender systems, while successfully optimizing for engagement, disproportionately disadvantage users with ADHD. This stratified study of 302 participants, recruited via the online platform Prolific, compares experiences between participants with and without ADHD. Our results show that while recommendations are perceived as relevant across groups, participants with ADHD report significantly higher levels of time blindness, post-usage regret, and emotional distress when consuming recommendations. Moreover, we collect feedback for several proof-of- concept, theoretical design interventions for neuro-inclusive design principles. These findings provide quantitative evidence of systemic differences in engagement-optimized recommender systems and highlight the unbalanced negative effects and interactions these systems create for participants with ADHD. We argue for neurodiversity-aware, human-centered design approaches that mitigate such algorithmic harms and support more equitable experiences.

AI.tldr: 本研究发现，短视频推荐系统虽然对所有用户都能实现精准推荐，但对ADHD（注意力缺陷多动障碍）用户造成了不成比例的负面影响，包括更严重的时间盲视、使用后后悔感和情绪困扰，研究提出了神经包容性设计原则以缓解这种算法伤害。
AI.motivation: 短视频平台通过推荐系统最大化用户参与度，但推荐系统对ADHD用户与非ADHD用户的差异化影响尚未得到充分研究。研究旨在揭示推荐系统在优化参与度的同时，如何对ADHD用户产生不成比例的负面影响。
AI.method: 这是一项分层研究，通过在线平台Prolific招募了302名参与者，比较ADHD与非ADHD用户在使用推荐系统时的体验差异，并收集了参与者对多种神经包容性设计原则概念性设计干预方案的反馈。
AI.result: 研究结果显示，虽然两组用户对推荐的感知相关度相同，但ADHD用户报告了显著更高水平的时间盲视、使用后后悔感和情绪困扰。研究提供了量化证据表明参与度优化的推荐系统对ADHD用户存在系统性的不平衡负面影响。
AI.conclusion: 研究主张应采用神经多样性意识、以人为中心的设计方法，以减轻此类算法危害并支持更公平的用户体验。

title: What LLM Trading Agents Actually Do in Production: A Six-Month, Population-Scale Record from Two Fleets
comment: 17 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Artifacts, figures, and aggregate data: https://github.com/ProjectDXAI/continuous-record-llm-trading-agents
summary: We present a continuous, population-scale measurement record of autonomous language-model trading agents operating in production across two systems with one design lineage: DX Terminal Pro (3,505 user-funded vaults trading real ETH in Base memecoin markets for 21 days, February to March 2026) and the DXAP live alpha fleet (500 to 599 user-created agents all-history, 91 to 117 concurrently active, trading Hyperliquid perpetuals, June to August 2026). The record spans roughly six months, 7.5M single-model invocations with about 300K onchain actions, and a further 231,638 multi-tool turns producing 14,596 fills. Four findings carry the paper. First, the operating layer determines behavior more than anything written in strategy text: a risk slider explains leverage (+0.425 per level), agent fixed effects absorb 60% of variance, and a leaderboard render boundary causally routes selection (regression discontinuity 1.75x at the top-3 cut). Second, sizing is volatility-blind: median leverage is 5.0x in every volatility sextile, and one posture-slider cell (11% of the book) holds 62% of liquidations. Third, agents capture almost none of the upside they reach: 43.2% of positions saw at least +300 bps of favorable excursion within 24h, yet 49.3% of those closed with a negative trade return; a mechanical bracket recovers +39.0 bps per position. Fourth, neither fleet shows a directional edge. The DXAP fleet is not profitable and trails a matched Hyperliquid retail benchmark (41% vs. 50% roundtrip win rate). A paired-replay league of frontier models on 416 captured production scenarios finds decision quality statistically indistinguishable at this horizon, while choice stability differs sharply across model families. Every headline survives day-clustered inference, permutation nulls, and a common-fee restatement; the paper closes with a 17-rule methodology canon bought with our own retractions.

AI.tldr: 本文基于一个连续的大规模生产环境测量记录，涵盖两个自主语言模型交易代理系统（DX Terminal Pro与DXAP实时alpha舰队），历时约六个月、750万次模型调用、30万次链上操作及14,596笔成交，得出四项核心发现：操作层比策略文本更能决定行为；仓位规模对波动率盲视；代理几乎无法捕获上行利润；两个舰队均无方向性alpha。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏对自主语言模型交易代理在真实生产环境中的大规模、连续测量记录，难以回答这些代理在实际交易中的行为规律、盈利能力与模型决策质量等关键问题。
AI.method: 通过两个同源设计的生产系统收集数月真实交易数据（DX Terminal Pro在Base memecoin市场、DXAP在Hyperliquid永续合约市场），运用固定效应分析、回归不连续设计、波动率分层、配对回放联赛（416个生产场景）等统计方法进行系统分析。
AI.result: 四项核心发现：1) 操作层（风险滑块、固定效应、排行榜边界）比策略文本更能决定行为；2) 杠杆选择对波动率盲视且集中聚集导致62%清算来自11%的头寸；3) 43.2%头寸达到+300bps有利波动但49.3%仍亏损，机械支架可回收+39bps/头寸；4) 两舰队均无方向性alpha，DXAP以41%对50%逊于基准，模型间决策质量统计上不可区分但选择稳定性差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 所有发现经过日聚类推断、置换零假设和共同费用重述后仍成立。论文以自我更正形成的17条方法论规范收尾，强调操作基础设施对LLM交易代理行为的决定性影响，同时坦承当前LLM交易代理在盈利能力和方向性预测上尚不具备显著优势。

title: CALM: Class-wise Agreement and Label-gated Disagreement Modulation for Decentralized Federated Learning
summary: Conventional federated learning relies on parameter averaging, which forces clients to be doubly homogeneous: all must run an identical architecture, and accuracy degrades when local data are non-IID. Decentralized federated distillation sidesteps both: each client runs its peers' model snapshots as teachers on its own local data and distills from their soft predictions, with no server, no public data, and no shared architecture. Under severe non-IID skew, however, the trustworthiness of the aggregated teacher target is a matter of degree, yet existing pipelines make hard, all-or-nothing decisions: outlier teachers are discarded by threshold, and whatever target survives is trusted in full. We propose CALM, which replaces every hard decision with a smooth trust gate at three levels: per class, teachers are weighted by agreement with the peer consensus; per sample, distillation is scaled by the teachers' divergence from that target; and a label gate scales it by how strongly the target supports the sample's true label. None of this adds communication or auxiliary data. On CIFAR-10, SVHN, OrganAMNIST, and Google Speech Commands with heterogeneous client architectures under Dirichlet label skew, CALM consistently outperforms uniform and hard-filtered distillation and matches or exceeds competing heterogeneous-FL methods.

AI.tldr: CALM是一种去中心化联邦蒸馏方法，通过三级平滑信任门控（按类别一致权重、按样本发散度缩放蒸馏、标签门控）替代传统硬性阈值决策，在不增加通信和辅助数据的前提下，在异构架构和非IID数据分布下优于现有联邦学习方法。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦学习基于参数平均，要求客户端架构同构且对非IID数据敏感；虽然后续的去中心化联邦蒸馏解决了这些问题，但在严重非IID分布下，教师聚合目标的可信度是程度问题而非二元的，现有管线采用"全有或全无"的硬决策（阈值丢弃异常教师、完全信任幸存目标），这种处理不够精细。
AI.method: CALM在三个层级引入平滑信任门控：(1) 按类别级别，教师根据与同行共识的一致性进行加权；(2) 按样本级别，蒸馏根据教师与聚合目标的发散度进行缩放；(3) 标签门控，根据目标对样本真实标签的支持强度进行缩放。所有操作不增加通信开销或辅助数据。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、SVHN、OrganAMNIST和Google Speech Commands数据集上，使用异构客户端架构并施加Dirichlet标签倾斜条件下，CALM一贯优于均匀蒸馏和硬过滤蒸馏方法，性能达到或超过其他异构联邦学习方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过细粒度的信任建模替代粗粒度的硬决策，可以显著提升在严重非IID和架构异构场景下的联邦蒸馏性能，且无需额外通信或外部数据的代价。

title: Humans Introduce, Models Elaborate: Asymmetric Narrative Agency in Human-LLM Co-Writing
summary: Human-LLM co-writing is increasingly used for open-ended text generation, but much prior work focuses on final outputs rather than the interactional dynamics through which stories are produced. We study turn-based collaborative storytelling across three matched conditions: Human-Human (HH), Human-LLM (HA), and LLM-LLM (AA). Using a shared storytelling paradigm, we measure how agents align, introduce novel material, and influence narrative development through turn-level measures of valence adaptation, semantic novelty, transience, and resonance. Our results show that HA co-writing is not intermediate between HH and AA collaboration. Instead, it displays a distinctive asymmetry where humans tend to introduce more novel and persistent narrative material, while LLMs tend to elaborate and stabilize the existing context. These findings suggest that, in this setting, LLMs function less as human co-authors and more as adaptive narrative amplifiers that reshape how agency is distributed in collaborative writing.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了人机协作写作中轮流式故事创作的交互动态，通过人与人类（HH）、人与LLM（HA）、LLM与LLM（AA）三种匹配条件的对比实验，发现HA协作并非介于HH与AA之间的中间状态，而呈现出独特的不对称性：人类引入更多新颖且持久的叙事材料，而LLM则倾向于阐发和稳定已有上下文。LLM在此设定下更多扮演"自适应叙事放大器"的角色，而非真正的人类合著者。
AI.motivation: 人机协作写作日益普及，但以往研究多关注最终输出质量，忽略了故事产生的交互动态过程。为了深入理解人类与LLM在协作写作中的角色分工与交互机制，需要系统地比较不同协作组合下的叙事对齐、创新引入与影响力模式。
AI.method: 采用共享故事创作范式，设置三组匹配条件（Human-Human、Human-LLM、LLM-LLM），通过回合级（turn-level）指标测量：效价适应（valence adaptation）、语义新颖性（semantic novelty）、瞬态性（transience）和共鸣度（resonance），以量化叙事过程中的对齐程度、新材料的引入方式及对叙事发展的影响。
AI.result: HA协作呈现独特的不对称模式：人类倾向于引入更多新颖且持久的叙事材料，LLM则负责阐述与稳定既有上下文。HA不是HH与AA之间的简单中间态，而是具有自身特色的交互动力学特征。
AI.conclusion: 在这类协作写作设定中，LLM并非扮演人类合著者的角色，而是更像自适应的叙事放大器，重塑了协作写作中的能动性（agency）分配方式，这对理解人机创作生态具有重要意义。

title: CUSP: Decomposable Collective Uncertainty for Multi-Agent Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Aggregating heterogeneous vision-language models (VLMs) can improve multimodal reasoning, but neither an individual model's confidence nor that of the aggregated answer measures reliability at the system level. We present CUSP (Collective Uncertainty through Semantic Opinion Pooling), a training-free uncertainty quantification framework that maps multiple VLM responses to a shared semantic response space, pools them into a pooled semantic opinion, and reports two complementary system-level signals: collective uncertainty, the dispersion of the pooled opinion, and Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD), the conflict among the model-level opinions. Within this pooled semantic opinion, the unnormalized collective entropy decomposes exactly into the mean of the models' individual semantic entropies and the JSD, separating total dispersion from model conflict. Requiring neither token logits nor calibration labels, CUSP applies to open-weight and commercial VLMs alike. In static multi-VLM ensembles, collective uncertainty is the strongest signal in the small-model regime (0.764 AUROC for prediction-error detection, 0.889 AUARC for abstention), outperforming uncertainty baselines majority voting and naive selection by 4.7 to 15.8 points and widening its margin as the ensemble grows; JSD is strongest in the evaluated commercial regime (0.819 AUROC, 0.910 AUARC) and ranks hard-answer model conflict with AUROC up to 0.982. The pooled prediction also improves accuracy over the average single model by 5.6 to 13.0 points. Over the full trajectory of a multi-step, multi-agent system, subagent collective uncertainty ranks system failures above chance (0.619 AUROC) and gives the best abstention ordering among the evaluated signals (0.699 AUARC).

AI.tldr: CUSP是一种无需训练的集体不确定性量化框架，通过将多个VLM的响应映射到共享语义空间并池化为"语义意见"，提供集体不确定性和JSD两个系统级信号，用于检测多VLM系统中的预测错误和模型冲突，比多种基线方法更优。
AI.motivation: 现有研究虽然表明聚合异构视觉语言模型能提升多模态推理能力，但无论是单个模型的置信度还是聚合答案的置信度，都无法衡量系统层面的可靠性，缺乏一个有效的系统级不确定性量化方法。
AI.method: CUSP框架将多个VLM的响应映射到共享的语义响应空间，池化为统一的语义意见，从中提取两个互补信号：集体不确定性（意见的离散度）和Jensen-Shannon散度（JSD，各模型意见间的冲突度）。该方法无需token logits和校准标签，适用于开源和商业VLM。理论上证明未归一化的集体熵可精确分解为各模型个体语义熵的均值与JSD之和。
AI.result: 在静态多VLM集成中，集体不确定性在小模型场景是最强信号（预测错误检测AUROC 0.764，弃权AUARC 0.889），比多数投票和朴素选择等基线高出4.7到15.8个百分点且随集成规模增大优势扩大；JSD在商业模型场景最强（AUROC 0.819，AUARC 0.910），难例模型冲突排序AUROC达0.982。池化预测比平均单模型准确率高5.6-13.0个百分点。在多步多智能体系统的全轨迹上，子智能体集体不确定性可超出偶然水平排序系统失败（AUROC 0.619），提供最优弃权排序（AUARC 0.699）。
AI.conclusion: CUSP为多VLM系统提供了一种有效的、无需训练的集体不确定性量化方法，能够同时捕捉整体不确定性与模型间冲突两个互补维度的信息，在静态集成和多智能体动态系统中均表现出优越的可靠性和实用性。

title: One Rate Is Not Enough: Adaptive Anisotropic Learning Rates for LoRA Fine-Tuning
summary: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) has become the standard for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large language models. Most LoRA variants follow a uniform-LR convention, applying a single global learning rate across every rank-one component of every adapter. We show that this convention overlooks substantial within-module heterogeneity, where the rank-one components of a LoRA adapter update at highly uneven rates and low-velocity modules converge to concentrated singular spectra that underutilize the nominal rank budget. To address this, we propose an adaptive anisotropic learning-rate model that assigns each rank-one component its own effective learning rate, computed online from training-time signals and mean-normalized per module to preserve the global LR budget. AnLR-LoRA instantiates this model with two signals available during AdamW optimization, namely function-space velocity and Adam SNR, as a lightweight scheme with no extra trainable parameters. Across commonsense reasoning, natural language generation and visual instruction-tuning benchmarks, AnLR-LoRA consistently improves over LoRA while encouraging broader use of rank capacity, with gains that remain robust across a wide range of global learning rates and transfer cleanly to other LoRA variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AnLR-LoRA方法，通过为LoRA适配器的每个秩一组件分配独立的各向异性学习率，解决了传统统一学习率约定下组件更新速率不均、低速度模块收敛到集中奇异谱导致秩容量利用不足的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有LoRA变体普遍采用统一全局学习率，忽略了适配器内部各秩一组件间的巨大异质性——不同组件更新速率差异显著，且低速模块会收敛到集中的奇异谱，未能充分利用标称秩预算。
AI.method: 提出自适应各向异性学习率模型，为每个秩一组件赋予独立有效学习率；学习率基于训练期间的信号在线计算（包括函数空间速度和Adam信噪比两种信号），并按模块进行均值归一化以保持全局学习率预算不变；该方法无需额外可训练参数，可轻量集成到AdamW优化流程中。
AI.result: 在常识推理、自然语言生成和视觉指令微调等多个基准上，AnLR-LoRA相比标准LoRA持续取得改进，同时促进秩容量的更广泛利用；增益在广泛的全局学习率范围内保持稳健，并能干净地迁移到其他LoRA变体中。
AI.conclusion: 通过打破统一学习率约定、实现秩一组件层面的自适应学习率分配，AnLR-LoRA有效提升了LoRA微调的性能与秩容量利用率，且鲁棒性强、兼容性好，为参数高效微调提供了新的方向。

title: Designing for Healthy, Affordable, and Sustainable Human-HVAC Interactions for Heating in Smart Homes
summary: As geopolitical tensions, energy crises, and energy-intensive AI infrastructure intensify concerns about demand, affordability, and resilience, communities increasingly encounter these challenges through everyday energy practices, particularly winter heating. Against this background, the doctoral exposé, "Designing Human-HVAC Interaction for Healthy, Affordable, and Sustainable Heating in Smart Homes", is structured around four chapters. First, a multidisciplinary literature review defines and positions Human-HVAC Interaction, focusing on heating in smart homes. Second, longitudinal living lab studies with design probes examine everyday heating practices, thermal comfort, and indoor environmental quality, with attention to thermally vulnerable groups such as older adults, pregnant or menopausal women, parents with infants, and people affected by allergies or airborne pollutants. Third, a VR-based smart home demonstrator explores how heating and IEQ scenarios can be prototyped and evaluated as a virtual living lab, while critically examining the limits of representing bodily indoor climate conditions through VR. Fourth, follow-up design studies examine how VR-based insights can be translated into physical-digital prototypes that combine digital fabrication, distributed environmental sensing, and diverse interface forms for critical heating and IEQ contexts. The thesis aims to contribute a design-oriented understanding of Human-HVAC Interaction by building from a multidisciplinary literature review to empirical living lab and co-design studies, VR-based prototyping, and physical system development, examining how smart home users make sense of, negotiate, and respond to smart HVAC system.

AI.tldr: 本文是围绕"智能家居中的人-HVAC（供暖通风空调）交互设计"的博士论文开题报告，旨在通过跨学科文献综述、纵向生活实验室研究、VR智能家居示范及虚实结合原型设计四个章节，为健康、可负担且可持续的冬季供暖提供设计导向的理解。
AI.motivation: 地缘政治紧张、能源危机及能源密集型AI基础设施加剧了人们对能源需求、可负担性和韧性的担忧，而冬季供暖作为日常能源实践是社区感知这些挑战的核心场景。现有研究缺乏对智能家居用户如何理解、协商和响应智能HVAC系统的设计导向性理解，尤其忽视了热脆弱群体。
AI.method: 论文采用四章渐进式研究设计：(1)跨学科文献综述界定Human-HVAC Interaction；(2)结合设计探针的纵向生活实验室研究，关注热脆弱人群的采暖实践、热舒适与室内环境质量；(3)基于VR智能家居示范平台进行虚拟生活实验室的原型与评估；(4)后续设计研究将VR洞察转化为结合数字制造、分布式环境传感与多样化界面的物理-数字混合原型。
AI.result: 论文尚处于开题阶段，未见具体实验结果。其预期产出包括：对Human-HVAC Interaction概念的设计导向性理论框架、对热脆弱群体采暖实践的实证洞察、VR作为虚拟生活实验室的方法论评估（含其表征局限性的批判），以及将虚拟洞察落地为物理原型的转化设计方法。
AI.conclusion: 该博士论文旨在通过从文献综述到经验性生活实验室、VR原型再到物理系统开发的完整研究链条，为智能家居中的人-HVAC交互提供设计导向理解，帮助用户在健康、经济性与可持续性之间做出更明智的供暖决策，并特别关注热脆弱群体的需求。

title: Recovering Temporal and Geographic Signals from Language Model Embeddings
summary: Understanding whether language-model embeddings encode structured real-world information is important for both representation analysis and information retrieval. We study this question for temporal and geographic signals using a simple projection-based method that operates directly on output embeddings. Given a small set of seed examples, the method defines an axis in embedding space and ranks texts or entities by their projection onto that axis. Our approach is fully black-box and model-agnostic: it requires only embeddings, without access to model weights, internal activations, auxiliary probes, or additional training. This makes it applicable to modern embedding models available only through APIs and provides a lightweight way to analyze whether temporal and spatial dimensions are present in their representation spaces. We apply the method to temporal and geographic datasets and find that embedding projections recover meaningful chronological and spatial structure. These results provide evidence that output embeddings encode signals relevant to time and space, while also offering a practical tool for interpretability and for downstream temporal and geographic information retrieval tasks, such as temporal ordering, geographic ranking, and tagging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于投影的黑盒方法，利用少量种子示例在嵌入空间中定义轴，通过投影得分对文本或实体进行排序，以检测语言模型输出嵌入中是否编码了时间和地理等结构化真实世界信息。实验表明，该方法能有效恢复时间与空间结构，为无法访问内部权重的现代API嵌入模型提供了轻量级的可解释性分析工具。
AI.motivation: 理解语言模型嵌入是否编码了结构化的真实世界信息（如时间和地理信号）对表示分析和信息检索都至关重要，但现有方法往往需要访问模型内部激活或额外训练探测器，难以适用于仅通过API提供的现代嵌入模型。
AI.method: 提出一种简单的基于投影的方法：给定少量种子示例，在嵌入空间中定义一个轴，然后通过计算文本或实体在该轴上的投影值进行排序。该方法完全黑盒且与模型无关，仅需输出嵌入，无需权重、内部激活、辅助探测器或额外训练。
AI.result: 将方法应用于时间和地理数据集，发现嵌入投影能够恢复有意义的时序和空间结构，证明输出嵌入中确实编码了与时间和空间相关的信号。
AI.conclusion: 输出嵌入编码了时间和空间信号，该方法提供了一种实用的可解释性工具，可服务于下游的时间与地理信息检索任务，如时间排序、地理排名和标记等。

title: A First-Order Learning Algorithm for Online Resource Allocation with Constant Regret
summary: We study a finite-horizon online resource allocation problem with initial resource capacities proportional to the horizon. In each period, a request type is observed and one action is chosen from a finite menu. Each action earns a reward and consumes a vector of resources. The arrival types are independent and identically distributed, but their probabilities are unknown.
