We present a primal first-order learning policy that, in each period, performs one gradient ascent update of the action coordinates associated with the current request type. The policy achieves $O(1)$ expected additive regret relative to the hindsight optimum, with a bound independent of the horizon $T$. It does not solve any linear program, and the regret bound does not require a nondegeneracy assumption on the fluid linear program.

AI.tldr: 本文研究有限时域在线资源分配问题，提出一种原始一阶学习策略，每期对当前请求类型相关的动作坐标执行一次梯度上升更新，实现了O(1)期望加性遗憾，且不依赖线性规划求解和流体LP非退化假设。
AI.motivation: 在线资源分配问题中，已有方法通常需要求解线性规划或依赖非退化假设，计算开销大且适用范围受限。作者希望设计一种简单高效的学习策略，能够获得与T无关的遗憾上界。
AI.method: 提出一种原始（primal）一阶学习策略：每期仅针对当前观测到的请求类型，对其相关动作坐标执行一次梯度上升更新，不求解任何线性规划。
AI.result: 该策略实现了O(1)期望加性遗憾（相对于事后最优），遗憾界与时间T无关，且不需要对流体线性规划做非退化假设。
AI.conclusion: 这项研究表明，在初始资源容量随水平线性增长的情况下，通过简单的在线梯度上升即可获得常数级遗憾，避免了LP求解的计算负担并放宽了假设条件。

title: Delusions and Harms Associated with AI Chatbot Use: Early Evidence from 185 Real-World Reports
summary:
Importance: Reports have raised concerns that AI chatbots may validate or elaborate delusional beliefs, respond inappropriately to suicidal ideation, and contribute to mental health harms, but real-world data on reported harms remain limited.
  Objective: To characterize psychopathological features, chatbot behaviors, timing, and outcomes in first- and second-hand accounts of mental health harm linked with AI chatbot use.
  Design: Cross-sectional secondary analysis of deidentified online survey responses gathered between August 7, 2025, and February 2, 2026.
  Main Outcomes and Measures: The primary quantitative outcome was the presence of delusional beliefs, coded by paired raters with relevant clinical experience. Additional variables included reason for chatbot use, current episode features, delusional content, chatbot validation of beliefs, harms, social and occupational consequences, healthcare use, and timing.
  Results: 95 first-hand and 90 second-hand accounts were analyzed. Median age was 35.0 (IQR 27.0 - 45.0). Raters coded descriptions consistent with delusional beliefs in 102 reports (55.1%), with chatbot validation of beliefs in 50/102 (49.0%). Common outcomes included isolation, relationship breakdown, hospital admission, job loss, and financial loss. Four second-hand reports described death by suicide.
  Conclusions: In this self-selected convenience sample, AI-chatbot-associated harms were frequently described in relation to delusional beliefs, perceived chatbot validation, intensive use, and substantial social, occupational, and clinical consequences. Because reports were retrospective, unverified, and collected from individuals seeking to report harm, our findings should be interpreted as preliminary signal detection rather than as suggesting prevalence or providing evidence of causality. Prospective surveillance and trajectory-based safety evaluations are needed.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于2025-2026年间收集的在线调查数据，分析了95份一手和90份二手关于AI聊天机器人导致心理健康伤害的报告，发现55.1%的报告涉及妄想信念，其中49%被认定为聊天机器人验证了这些信念，伤害后果包括社会隔离、关系破裂、住院、失业和经济损失，另有4份报告描述自杀死亡。
AI.motivation: 已有报告担忧AI聊天机器人可能验证或放大妄想信念、对自杀意念回应不当并导致心理健康伤害，但基于真实世界数据的相关伤害证据仍然有限，亟需系统性表征这些伤害的临床特征。
AI.method: 对2025年8月7日至2026年2月2日间收集的去识别在线调查回复进行横断面二次分析，由具有临床经验的配对评估员对妄想信念等主要定量结局进行编码，并分析聊天机器人使用原因、妄想内容、验证行为、伤害后果、医疗资源使用及时间线等多维度变量。
AI.result: 在185份报告中（95份一手、90份二手），中位年龄35岁；102份（55.1%）报告被评估为符合妄想信念描述，其中50/102（49.0%）涉及聊天机器人验证了用户信念；常见后果包括社会隔离、关系破裂、住院、失业和经济损失；4份二手报告描述了自杀死亡。
AI.conclusion: AI聊天机器人相关伤害常与妄想信念、感知到的聊天机器人验证、高强度使用及严重的社会、职业和临床后果相关。由于样本为自我选择、回顾性且未经核实，研究结果应视为初步信号检测而非流行率或因果证据，需前瞻性监测和基于轨迹的安全性评估。

title: Beyond Prompts: Measuring and Optimizing LLM Tool-Agent Harnesses
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026. 18 pages, 9 figures, 10 tables
summary: LLM tool agents can be improved without retraining by modifying the runtime harness around a fixed model: prompts, tool interfaces, middleware, state handling, and recovery logic. We study this setting as resource-bounded harness selection for fixed-model multi-turn tool agents, with the search surface scoped to prompts and tool-boundary middleware: edits are guarded intercepts at the tool boundary, not arbitrary rewriting of agent execution logic. Our optimizer-agnostic protocol reports mean held-out lift, worst-condition lift, repeatability, logged cost diagnostics, and RelLift95(B), a conservative estimate of the held-out gain of the harness selected under budget B. We instantiate the protocol with prompt-only and prompt-plus-middleware optimizers, including PRISM, which clusters failures and routes repairs to prompt, tool-boundary middleware, or joint edit surfaces within a Pareto search. On BFCL multi-round, tau2-Retail, and tau2-Telecom, PRISM obtains mean held-out lifts of 14.2, 14.9, and 10.1 percentage points and positive empirical RelLift95 on all three benchmarks, and a component ablation attributes the margin chiefly to failure-surface routing and the edit-pattern constraint. Across optimizers, the results show that some search procedures can occasionally find large gains but still choose brittle updates, so the reliability of the chosen harness should be reported alongside average held-out lift.

AI.tldr: 本文研究固定模型下多轮工具智能体的运行时框架优化，提出了一种与优化器无关的评估协议，并介绍PRISM优化器，通过在提示词和工具边界中间件上进行失败聚类与修复路由，在三个基准上取得了显著的留出集性能提升。
AI.motivation: 无需重新训练即可通过修改运行时框架（提示词、工具接口、中间件、状态处理、恢复逻辑）来改进LLM工具智能体，但当前缺乏系统化的搜索与评估方法，尤其是可靠性与平均性能并重的问题。
AI.method: 将问题建模为固定模型多轮工具智能体的资源受限框架选择；搜索范围限定为提示词和工具边界中间件上的受控拦截编辑。提出优化器无关的评估协议，报告平均留出提升、最差条件提升、可重复性、日志成本诊断及RelLift95(B)保守增益估计。实例化提示词与提示词+中间件优化器，PRISM通过失败聚类将修复路由到提示词、工具边界中间件或联合编辑面，并在Pareto搜索内运行。
AI.result: 在BFCL多轮、tau2-Retail和tau2-Telecom上，PRISM分别获得14.2、14.9和10.1个百分点的平均留出提升，且三个基准上RelLift95均为正。组件消融表明增益主要来自失败面路由和编辑模式约束。
AI.conclusion: 某些搜索过程偶尔能发现较大增益但可能选择脆弱的更新，因此在报告平均留出提升的同时应报告所选框架的可靠性；PRISM的失败面路由与编辑约束策略是提升鲁棒性的关键。

title: A dictionary learning framework for graphs via filters and optimal transport
summary: We propose a graph dictionary learning (GDL) framework where each graph is represented as a zero-mean Gaussian distribution derived from its filtered Laplacian. Each observed graph is approximated by a barycenter over learned atom graphs, computed under the filter graph distance (fGOT), a graph comparison metric sensitive to global structural properties. The reconstruction error between the observed graph and its barycenter is measured by the surrogate fGOT (sfGOT) distance, a tractable approximation of fGOT that handles graphs without known node correspondence, and is minimized end-to-end via backpropagation. We further provide a novel interpretation of sfGOT through the lens of the Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion, showing that minimizing the sfGOT distance between two graphs is equivalent to maximizing statistical dependence between the spectral embedding of their nodes. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate competitive performance over existing GDL methods on graph clustering and classification tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种图字典学习（GDL）框架，将每个图表示为来自其滤波拉普拉斯算子的零均值高斯分布，通过滤波图最优传输（fGOT）距离下的重心来近似观测图，并利用代理fGOT（sfGOT）距离作为可计算的重构误差度量进行端到端反向传播优化。实验表明该框架在图聚类和分类任务上优于现有GDL方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的图字典学习方法在处理全局结构特性和节点不对应场景下存在局限性，需要一个能够有效捕捉图全局结构属性且无需节点对应关系的图字典学习框架。
AI.method: 每个图被表示为由其滤波拉普拉斯算子导出的零均值高斯分布；观测图通过滤波图距离（fGOT）度量下的重心在学习的原子图上进行近似；重构误差使用代理fGOT（sfGOT）距离来衡量，该距离可处理节点无对应关系的图，并通过反向传播实现端到端优化。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的图聚类和分类任务中，该框架相比现有图字典学习方法展现出具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作还从希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则的角度对sfGOT提供了新解释，表明最小化两个图之间的sfGOT距离等价于最大化节点谱嵌入之间的统计依赖性，为图字典学习提供了新的理论视角。

title: Representational Fidelity in Didactic Visualization: Toward a Multidimensional Design Space
comment: To appear in IEEE Transactions on Visualization and Computer Graphics (Proceedings of IEEE VIS 2026). Supplemental material: https://osf.io/rx749/
summary: Representational fidelity is routinely treated as a single abstract-realistic continuum, a simplification that limits how it is described and compared across research and design contexts. We introduce a multidimensional design space of representational fidelity for didactic visualization in science & engineering, inductively derived from a 175-item corpus spanning several disciplines, modalities, and instructional aims. The resulting design space specifies five dimensions: Morphological, Dynamic, Cueing, Contextual, and Interactive Fidelity, with seven sub-dimensions. We demonstrate the design space's descriptive power through successive rounds of expansion and refinement and analyze the corpus to reveal relationships among dimensions and implications for design and research. We further validate the design space through a pilot focus group in which participants applied the dimensions in an open-ended design exercise. Resulting sketches and verbal rationales informed a single-designer applied case study, offering preliminary evidence of the design space's generative potential as a structured aid to design exploration. Together, these contributions lay the groundwork for future research and more intentional design practice.

AI.tldr: 本文针对"表征保真度"历来被简化为单一抽象-真实连续统的问题，提出了一个多维设计空间，包含形态、动态、提示、情境和交互五个保真度维度及七个子维度，并基于175项跨学科语料归纳推导、通过设计工作坊验证其描述性与生成潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究将表征保真度视为单向度的抽象-真实连续统，这种简化限制了其在科研与设计情境中的描述和比较能力，亟需一个更精细的多维框架。
AI.method: 从涵盖多学科、多模态、多教学目标的175项文献语料中归纳性推导出五维度设计空间（形态、动态、提示、情境、交互保真度及其七个子维度）；通过多轮扩展与精炼验证描述力；对语料进行分析以揭示维度间关系；再通过试点焦点小组（参与者进行开放式设计练习）及单一设计师应用案例研究对设计空间进行验证。
AI.result: 形成了包含五个主维度、七个子维度的表征保真度多维设计空间；语料分析揭示了各维度间的关联及对设计与研究的启示；焦点小组中参与者的草图与口头论证以及案例研究提供了该设计空间作为结构化设计探索辅助工具具有生成潜力的初步证据。
AI.conclusion: 该多维设计空间为科学与工程领域教学可视化中的表征保真度研究奠定了新基础，支持更细致地描述与比较，并促进更有意图的设计实践，为未来深入研究提供了方向。

title: The Normalization of Deviance in AI Development
summary: Work on the risks of artificial intelligence has focused predominantly on capability risk: the danger that systems become too powerful, too autonomous, or too misaligned with human values. Far less attention has been paid to the organizational level---to whether the institutions building these systems are themselves predisposed to drift toward failure. This paper argues that they are. Regardless of how capable AI systems become, the organizations building them face the same structural dynamics that preceded past major technological disasters. Drawing on case studies of the Space Shuttle Challenger, the Three Mile Island accident, and the Boeing 737 MAX crashes, this paper identifies the common structural mechanisms preceding each failure and maps them onto contemporary AI development. The findings suggest that existing safety infrastructure may provide less protection than it appears, as organizations can complete safety processes in full compliance and still produce catastrophic outcomes. The pre-disaster period of AI development is still underway; the purpose of this paper is to make these dynamics legible while they can still be interrupted.

AI.tldr: 本文认为，无论AI系统能力如何，构建它们的组织都面临与历史上重大技术灾难相同的结构性动态（如挑战者号、三哩岛事故、波音737 MAX），提出即使组织完全合规地完成安全流程，仍可能产生灾难性后果，呼吁在灾难前兆期将这些动态清晰化以便干预。
AI.motivation: 现有AI风险研究过度聚焦于能力风险（系统过于强大、自主或与人类价值观偏离），而忽视了组织层面的风险——即构建这些系统的机构本身是否容易走向失效。本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 通过对三个历史重大技术灾难（挑战者号航天飞机、三哩岛核事故、波音737 MAX坠机）的案例研究，识别每次失败前共同的结构性机制，并将其映射到当代AI开发的组织实践中。
AI.result: 研究发现，现有的安全基础设施可能提供的保护比表面看起来更少，因为组织可以在完全合规地完成安全流程的情况下仍然产生灾难性结果。AI开发的前灾难期仍在进行中。
AI.conclusion: 呼吁在AI灾难性失败发生之前，将组织层面的风险动态变得清晰可辨、可被干预，以此作为抵御AI组织性失败的重要防线。

title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Efficiency Methods for Multi-Agent Systems
comment: The 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing
summary: Efficiency is increasingly important for Large Language Model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS), as larger models and more agents introduce substantial execution costs. Recent methods aim to make MAS cheaper by pruning agents, removing communication edges, or searching for compact structures. However, we argue that existing evaluations may overestimate their true ability to improve MAS efficiency. Reported gains are often measured under method-specific prompts and starting topologies, making them difficult to attribute to the proposed structural changes. Moreover, many reported successes appear in non-MAS-demanding settings, where a single agent or a randomly pruned system can already preserve strong performance. To study these issues, we introduce a controlled and MAS-demanding diagnostic benchmark for representative MAS efficiency methods. We evaluate methods under a shared backbone model, agent registry, and runtime, across controlled variations in topology, scale, depth, and tool use. Our analysis shows that many reported gains are setup-dependent and may arise from structural collapse, disabled tool pathways, or starting systems where random pruning already preserves accuracy, rather than robust improvements in MAS efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有多智能体系统（MAS）效率优化方法的评估存在系统性偏差：许多报告的收益依赖于特定提示词和起始拓扑结构，且数据集本身不具MAS挑战性（单智能体或随机剪枝即可保持性能）。作者引入了一个可控且具MAS挑战性的诊断基准，在共享的骨干模型、代理注册表和运行时下系统评估，结果显示许多收益是设置依赖的，可能源于结构坍塌、工具通路禁用或起始系统本身冗余。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型和多智能体系统的规模扩大，执行成本显著增加。现有MAS效率方法（如剪枝智能体、移除通信边、搜索紧凑结构）声称能降低成本，但其评估可能存在方法特定提示词和起始拓扑导致的归因困难，以及评测任务不具足够的MAS需求性，使报告的效率提升被高估。作者希望通过受控基准揭示真实效率收益。
AI.method: 构建一个受控且具MAS挑战性的诊断基准，在共享的骨干模型、智能体注册表和运行时下评估代表性MAS效率方法。系统控制变量包括拓扑结构、规模、深度和工具使用的变化，以隔离方法结构性改变对效率的贡献。
AI.result: 分析表明许多报告的效率收益是设置依赖的，可能源于结构坍缩（系统退化为更简单形式）、禁用工具通路（通过移除工具而非真正优化）或起始系统冗余（随机剪枝已能保持准确率）等原因，而非对MAS效率的稳健改进。
AI.conclusion: 现有MAS效率方法的广泛性能高估源于评估设计的缺陷，需要更严格、可控且具挑战性的基准来正确衡量结构性改动对效率的真实贡献。

title: StitchOver: Technical Embroidery on Seamed Fabrics
summary:
Smart textiles embed interactivity into everyday garments, supporting use cases like always-available sensing for medical applications or sports. Machine embroidery allows integrating functionalities into existing textiles. However, embroidering onto real-world textile goods remains challenging. Textile goods are rarely made of a single homogeneous substrate of fabric, and embroidery with functional materials such as conductive threads requires machines to be more tightly calibrated than for decorative embroidery. In particular, seams, which bring together different substrates, along with machine variability, cause shifts in tension and friction between the functional thread and the textile substrate that frequently lead to defects (70% of samples in our evaluation).
  We present a technique to reliably embroider on seamed fabric even when using functional threads. Our software tool automatically digitizes user-defined stitch patterns by introducing what we call "JumpStitches" to bypass seam interference.
  We evaluated our approach under varying machine states (under-tensioned, well-calibrated, and over-tensioned), and across multiple seam and pattern configurations. Our results show that the JumpStitch mechanism eliminates defects, while maintaining conductivity compared to 70% defects without JumpStitches, and even in poorly calibrated machine states continues to work well.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为JumpStitches的技术，通过在绣花针迹中自动引入"跳跃针迹"来绕开接缝干扰，从而实现在带接缝的织物上使用功能线（如导电线程）进行可靠的机器刺绣。实验表明该技术将缺陷率从70%降至零，即使在机器校准不佳的情况下也能保持良好的导电性能。
AI.motivation: 智能纺织品将交互性嵌入日常服装中，机绣是整合功能到现有纺织品的关键方式。然而在实际纺织品上刺绣面临挑战：真实织物很少是单一均匀基底，接缝将不同基底连接在一起，加之功能线（如导电线程）要求机器更精确的校准。机器变异性导致功能线与织物基底之间的张力和摩擦力变化，经常造成缺陷（评估中70%的样本存在缺陷），因此需要一种能够在带接缝的织物上可靠刺绣的方法。
AI.method: 作者开发了一种软件工具，能够自动对用户定义的绣花图案进行数字化处理，通过在针迹中引入所谓的"JumpStitches"（跳跃针迹）来绕过接缝干扰，避免功能线与接缝区域发生不利的相互作用。
AI.result: 在多种机器状态下（欠张力、良好校准、过张力）以及多种接缝和图案配置下进行评估。结果显示JumpStitch机制消除了缺陷，相比没有JumpStitches时70%的缺陷率，该方法保持了导电性；即使在机器校准不佳的情况下也能持续良好工作。
AI.conclusion: JumpStitches技术能够有效解决在带接缝织物上使用功能线程进行机绣时的高缺陷率问题，显著提高了智能纺织品制造在真实世界条件下的可靠性和鲁棒性。

title: From Monolithic Blending to Agentic Orchestration: Dynamic Response for Conversational Assistants at Scale
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Industry Track. 16 pages, 1 figure, 21 tables
summary: Conversational assistants can blend retrieval, action selection, escalation, and wording in a single model path, or separate those roles. We report a production migration of a customer-support assistant at a large accommodation marketplace (millions of conversations per month, 11 languages, 10-second P90). Dynamic Response (DR) replaces a single Qwen3-235B-A22B blended responder with a bounded ReAct orchestrator over typed tools plus a smaller generator that writes from a backend-validated context contract. Because the migration also changed prompts, alignment, and serving, we attribute each effect to its cause and claim as architecture effects only those measured on identical replayed turns: typed entity selection moves the reservation selector to a precision-first operating point (precision 8.3% to 89.1%, recall 75.2% to 67.3%), and typed action IDs with a membership check remove observed structured-action hallucination (2.14% to 0.0%). A low-ramp A/B test reproduces the replay escalation reductions: hard-escalation responses fall from 5.60% to 3.08% and soft-escalation responses from 9.56% to 2.49%, while production handoff volume holds roughly steady; self-solve is directional (+5.1 points, 95% CI [-2, +12]). Serving optimizations cut orchestrator P90 latency from 3.87s to 2.24s on a GPU footprint reduced by roughly one-third, and self-hosting reduces estimated annual model-serving cost by more than an order of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了一个大型住宿预订平台客服助手的生产级架构迁移：用"有界ReAct编排器+类型化工具+小型生成器"的Dynamic Response（DR）架构替换了单一的Qwen3-235B-A22B混合响应模型，在相同回放数据上实现了实体选择精度从8.3%提升至89.1%，结构动作幻觉从2.14%降至0%，减少GPU足迹约三分之一，并将模型服务成本降低一个数量级以上。
AI.motivation: 单一大型模型的混合路径（同时承担检索、动作选择、升级和措辞）在生产环境中难以精确控制各环节质量，尤其在精度、幻觉率和延迟方面的表现难以分别归因和优化。作者希望探索将不同角色分离的架构是否能带来更可控、更优化的生产级客服性能。
AI.method: 提出Dynamic Response（DR）架构，用一个有界ReAct编排器调度类型化工具，并由一个更小的生成器基于后端验证的上下文契约进行文本生成。迁移同时涉及了提示词、对齐和服务方式的改动，作者通过在相同重放回合上的测量来将架构效果与其他因素分离。实施包括：类型化实体选择、类型化动作ID配合成员检查，以及配套的服务优化和自托管部署。
AI.result: 在相同重放回合上：预订选择器精度从8.3%提升至89.1%（召回率从75.2%下降至67.3%），结构动作幻觉从2.14%降至0%。低流量A/B测试显示硬升级响应从5.60%降至3.08%，软升级响应从9.56%降至2.49%；自我解决率方向性提升+5.1点（95% CI [-2, +12]）；编排器P90延迟从3.87s降至2.24s，GPU足迹减少约三分之一；月均模型服务成本降低超过一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将客服助手的多个角色从单一巨大模型中解耦为"编排器+工具+小型生成器"的分层架构，可以在生产规模（每月数百万会话、11种语言、P90延迟10秒）下获得显著的精度提升、幻觉消除、延迟降低和成本节省，验证了分离式架构在大规模生产客服系统中的可行性和优势。

title: Interpretable and Fair Generalized Additive Neural Networks via Multi-objective Learning
summary: Interpretability and fairness are two of the most emphasized dimensions in trustworthy artificial intelligence (AI). Various explainable AI methods have been introduced to improve interpretability. This paper focuses on neural network (NN)-based generalized additive models (GAMs), a class of self-interpretable models. While most existing research has prioritized improving the accuracy of NN-based GAMs, their interpretability remains largely underexplored. To address this gap, this paper introduces explicit quantitative metrics for evaluating the interpretability of NN-based GAMs, empirically examines their effectiveness, and explores strategies for improving interpretability within these models. In addition, the simultaneous and explicit optimization of both interpretability and fairness, along with their trade-offs and the underlying reasons, remains underexplored. To address this, we propose a multi-objective neural basis model (MONBM) framework based on multi-objective evolutionary learning to consider accuracy, interpretability, and fairness simultaneously. A partial retraining strategy is further developed to facilitate the practical application of evolutionary multi-objective optimization to deep model architectures. Based on MONBM, this paper reveals the complex relationships between these dimensions and the reasons behind these intricate relationships. This analysis demonstrates how multi-objective optimization can be combined with self-interpretable models to reveal relationships among trustworthiness objectives. In addition, MONBM obtains a set of models with different trade-offs between dimensions, and the competitiveness of the approach is validated by comparing it with state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: 本文针对神经网络基广义加性模型（NN-based GAMs），提出了显式的可解释性量化指标，并提出了一个基于多目标进化学习的多目标神经基模型（MONBM）框架，同时优化精度、可解释性和公平性，揭示了这三个可信AI维度之间的复杂关系与权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有研究大多只关注提升NN-based GAMs的精度，而忽视了其可解释性评估；同时，可解释性与公平性同时显式优化及其内在权衡关系也缺乏探索。
AI.method: 提出显式的可解释性量化指标用于评估NN-based GAMs；提出基于多目标进化学习的MONBM框架，将精度、可解释性、公平性作为三个优化目标同时考虑；并开发部分重训练策略以支持进化多目标优化在深度模型架构上的实际应用。
AI.result: MONBM揭示了三类可信AI维度之间的复杂关系及其深层原因；获得了一组具有不同维度间权衡的模型集合；与最先进方法相比验证了方法的竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明多目标优化可以与自解释模型结合，有效地揭示可信AI各维度间的内在关系与权衡，为同时优化精度、可解释性和公平性提供了新的思路。

title: "Here Be Sharks!": Enhancing Scientific Communication and Analysis through Authoring Interactivity
summary: We report on a case study for designing authoring environments for interactive visualizations to enhance scientific work. We conducted a workshop and prototype review with a group of marine biologists. When it came to visualizing their data, participants identified challenges in conveying their research accurately and completely as well as and analyzing it with ease. Based on our findings, authoring environments should consider the context of scientific work aspects such as domain expertise, collaboration culture, and publication traditions. We propose consideration of non-traditional programming languages and environments for scientific work, discuss ways of facilitating interactive visualizations for scientists, and examine ways of meaningfully integrating AI. The critiques, artifacts, and reactions from the scientists along with our analysis and discussion inform how computational tools should be designed for scientific work.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对海洋生物学家的工作坊和原型评审案例研究，探讨如何为科学工作设计交互式可视化创作环境。研究发现科学家在数据可视化中面临准确性传达、完整性保障和易用性分析的挑战，基于此提出创作环境应考虑领域专长、协作文化和发表传统等科学工作情境，并建议探索非传统编程语言、AI的深度集成等设计方向。
AI.motivation: 交互式可视化对科学工作至关重要，但现有创作工具往往脱离科学工作的实际情境，未能满足科学家在准确传达研究结果、完整呈现数据以及便捷分析方面的需求。本研究旨在通过实际案例，为面向科学家的可视化创作环境提供更具针对性的设计洞见。
AI.method: 采用案例研究方法，与一组海洋生物学家开展工作坊并进行了原型评审，收集科学家对可视化工具的反饋、批评和建议，结合定性分析提炼设计启示。
AI.result: 识别出科学家在数据可视化中的三大挑战：准确传达研究、完整呈现信息、便捷分析数据；发现领域专业知识、协作文化、论文发表传统等因素显著影响工具接受度和使用方式；提出应探索非传统编程语言、并结合AI能力提升可视化创作效率与智能分析。
AI.conclusion: 科学用可视化创作环境的设计必须植根于真实科学工作情境，充分考虑领域特性与学术生态。未来工具设计应打破传统编程范式，让AI与交互式可视化深度融合，以真正支撑科学发现与交流。

title: Inference-Time Graph Engineering for Multi-Agent LLM Workflows
summary: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly rely on graph-structured communication to coordinate specialized agents. We revisit multi-agent orchestration from a graph-engineering perspective: rather than optimizing a static topology, we synthesize a task-conditioned temporal workflow graph that jointly specifies agent connectivity and edge-level communication semantics. We introduce ReActNet, a training-free framework that compiles a query and a set of role-specialized agents into a sequence of directed communication graphs. Each graph snapshot corresponds to one reasoning stage, and each edge carries a natural-language instruction specifying the message that a source agent should provide to a target agent. The compiled temporal graph is then executed through structured message passing: agents update their reasoning states by integrating their previous states with messages from controller-assigned neighbors, and a final aggregator synthesizes the resulting states into the answer. This design separates graph compilation from graph execution, making multi-agent coordination explicit, inspectable, and task-conditioned without requiring reinforcement learning or gradient-based topology optimization. Across knowledge reasoning, mathematical problem solving, code generation, and GAIA-style assistant tasks, ReActNet consistently improves over fixed-topology and learned-topology baselines while maintaining competitive inference cost. These results suggest that effective multi-agent orchestration depends not only on which agents communicate, but also on engineering executable workflow graphs that encode when, why, and how information should flow during reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReActNet，一个免训练的多智能体LLM框架，它将查询和角色专业化智能体编译为时间序列的有向通信图，通过结构化消息传递执行推理，在知识推理、数学求解、代码生成和GAIA任务上优于固定拓扑和可学习拓扑基线。
AI.motivation: 现有图结构通信的多智能体系统大多优化静态拓扑，忽略了任务条件化的动态协调需求。本文希望从图工程视角重新审视多智能体编排，通过构建任务条件化的时间工作流图来明确指定智能体之间的连接关系和通信语义。
AI.method: ReActNet将查询和一组角色专业化智能体编译为一系列有向通信图快照，每个快照对应一个推理阶段，每条边携带自然语言指令规定源智能体向目标智能体提供的消息内容。该方法将图编译与图执行分离：编译阶段生成任务条件化的时间图，执行阶段通过结构化消息传递更新智能体推理状态，最后由聚合器综合各状态生成答案。
AI.result: 在知识推理、数学问题求解、代码生成和GAIA式助手任务上，ReActNet一致优于固定拓扑和可学习拓扑的基线方法，同时保持具有竞争力的推理成本。
AI.conclusion: 有效的多智能体编排不仅取决于哪些智能体进行通信，还取决于如何工程化可执行的工作流图，即编码推理过程中信息应该何时、为何以及如何流动。

title: QGB-W$k$NN: Quantum Granular-Ball Learning for Robust Classification
summary: Nearest-neighbor classification is widely used in machine learning, yet existing methods often suffer from low computational efficiency and limited robustness in noisy environments. To jointly address these challenges, this paper proposes an efficient and reliable weighted $K$-nearest neighbor classification framework based on quantum granular balls, termed QGB-W$k$NN. The proposed framework improves computational efficiency by integrating quantum-enhanced granular-ball representation with hierarchical nearest-neighbor search, while enhancing classification reliability through a purity-aware weighted decision mechanism. Specifically, quantum-kernel granular balls are constructed to reduce retrieval redundancy and strengthen nonlinear feature representation under limited quantum resources. A granular-ball purity-guided HNSW optimization strategy is developed to exploit structural reliability for hierarchical graph construction during neighbor retrieval, alleviating the local optimality issue caused by conventional random layering. Finally, a weighted voting mechanism jointly incorporating granular-ball similarity and purity is introduced to produce more reliable classification decisions in noisy environments. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate that QGB-W$k$NN achieves competitive classification accuracy while exhibiting favorable Pareto trade-offs between classification performance and computational cost. Moreover, the proposed framework consistently improves robustness under various noisy conditions, suggesting that reliability-aware quantum granular-ball learning provides a promising paradigm for efficient and robust nearest-neighbor classification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于量子粒度球的加权K近邻分类框架（QGB-WkNN），通过量子增强的粒度球表示、纯度引导的HNSW优化和加权投票机制，同时提升近邻分类的计算效率和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的近邻分类方法在计算效率和噪声环境下的鲁棒性方面存在不足，需要一种能同时解决这两个问题的分类框架。
AI.method: 提出QGB-WkNN框架，包含三个核心组件：1）利用量子核构造量子粒度球以减少检索冗余并增强非线性特征表示；2）提出粒度球纯度引导的HNSW优化策略，利用结构可靠性构建层次图以缓解随机分层导致的局部最优问题；3）引入结合粒度球相似度与纯度的加权投票机制，在噪声环境下提升分类决策的可靠性。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上的大量实验表明，QGB-WkNN在保持具有竞争力的分类精度的同时，展现出良好的分类性能与计算成本之间的帕累托权衡，并能在各种噪声条件下持续提升鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性感知的量子粒度球学习为高效且鲁棒的自近邻分类提供了一种有前景的新范式。

title: Enhancing Communication in Speech Therapy: Exploring the Cognitive Synergy Between Gesture and Speech
summary: This paper examines the adaptation of a rhythm-based interface, originally designed for manual dexterity rehabilitation, for use in speech therapy. The interface allows users to control synthesized vocal phrases through finger tapping, leveraging the cognitive link between gesture and speech. Through interviews with four therapists and pilot tests with one speech therapist and eight children with speech impairments (autism, Down syndrome, verbal apraxia, dyslexia), we found that the interface improves motivation and therapeutic outcomes by facilitating more interactions between verbally challenged patients and the therapist. Our findings suggest that rhythmic gestures can enhance verbal communication, offering potential for broader therapeutic and educational applications.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将原本用于手动灵活性康复的节奏接口改编为言语治疗工具，该接口允许用户通过手指敲击控制合成语音短语。通过与四位言语治疗师的访谈，以及一位治疗师和八名言语障碍儿童（自闭症、唐氏综合征、言语失用症、阅读障碍）的试点测试，发现该接口通过促进患者与治疗师之间的更多互动，提升了动机和治疗效果。研究结果表明节奏性手势可增强言语交流，具有更广泛治疗和教育应用的潜力。
AI.motivation: 探索节奏手势与言语之间的认知联系，将现有康复技术扩展到言语治疗领域，以帮助言语障碍患者改善沟通和治疗效果。
AI.method: 采用质性研究方法，包括对四位治疗师的结构化访谈，以及一位言语治疗师与八名具有不同言语障碍（自闭症、唐氏综合征、言语失用症、阅读障碍）的儿童进行的试点测试。
AI.result: 该节奏接口能够显著提升言语障碍儿童的参与动机，并通过增加患者与治疗师之间的互动频次，改善整体治疗成效。
AI.conclusion: 节奏性手势对言语交流具有增强作用，该接口不仅适用于现有的手部康复场景，还可扩展应用于言语治疗、教育等更广泛的领域。

title: DI-Bench: Systematically Generating In-Domain Data Intelligence Benchmarks for Enterprise Agents
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures, 13 tables. Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track
summary: Evaluating enterprise agents on domain-specific benchmarks is critical, yet public benchmarks rarely evaluate whether agents can integrate business knowledge with analytical computation, and constructing such benchmarks manually is costly. We present DI-Bench, a pipeline for generating realistic benchmarks for data intelligence (DI), the practice of extracting insights from large volumes of enterprise data. To emulate realistic DI tasks that require both computation and knowledge retrieval, DI-Bench builds an artifact linkage graph over data tables, dimensions, metrics, and documents to form questions involving structured data and associated knowledge. Ground truth answers are derived via query execution, followed by LLM question generation and validation. Applied to two public datasets, the pipeline produces a 731-task benchmark covering knowledge retrieval, analytical computation, and rule-grounded reasoning. To show the discriminatory capability and difficulty of the benchmark, we evaluate four models, revealing a substantial finding: models achieve only 32% accuracy when doing computational tasks where retrieved business rules modify the computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DI-Bench，一个自动生成企业数据智能（DI）领域基准测试的流水线。它通过构建工件链接图（连接数据表、维度、指标和文档）来生成需要同时进行知识检索与计算分析的真实任务，并通过查询执行生成标准答案。在两个公共数据集上生成731个任务，评估四个模型后发现：当业务规则改变计算方式时，模型准确率仅为32%。
AI.motivation: 企业级智能体需要同时具备业务知识与分析计算能力，但现有公共基准很少评估这一综合能力，且人工构建此类基准成本高昂。
AI.method: DI-Bench流水线包含三个关键步骤：1）在数据表、维度、指标和文档之间构建工件链接图，以模拟需要知识与计算结合的真实DI任务；2）通过查询执行生成标准答案；3）利用LLM进行问题生成与验证。整个流程自动化生成高质量、多样化的基准任务。
AI.result: 流水线在两个公共数据集上成功生成731个任务，覆盖知识检索、分析计算和规则推理三类能力。评估四个模型发现：模型整体表现不佳，在需要业务规则修改计算的场景下准确率仅为32%，说明该基准具有良好的区分度和挑战性。
AI.conclusion: DI-Bench能够以较低成本生成反映真实企业数据智能需求的基准，并揭示了现有模型在"知识引导的计算"这一关键能力上的显著短板，为后续模型改进提供了明确方向。

title: LoGIC: Budgeted Context Construction for Node-Level Graph In-Context Learning with Tabular Foundation Models
summary: Tabular foundation models have become powerful graph learners. Systems such as G2T-FM and GraphPFN encode each node as a feature row and make predictions through in-context learning (ICL), with labeled rows serving as the prompt. Current protocols employ the complete training table as context, causing attention to scale quadratically with the labeled pool and introducing preprocessing and memory bottlenecks. We investigate context construction for node-level graph ICL: which labeled nodes and auxiliary unlabeled nodes should constitute the prompt for specified queries. We formulate this allocation in terms of two resources: a labeled-context budget for predictive evidence and an unlabeled-halo budget for adapter message passing without using label capacity. We present LoGIC, which retrieves labeled nodes via structural, feature-based, and coverage channels, shares each context across the queries in a graph-local cluster, incorporates an unlabeled halo for adapter backbones, and chooses the channel and context budget without test labels. Across three backbone configurations drawn from two model families on GraphLand, budgeted contexts maintain locally runnable full-context performance, stay competitive with published large-dataset results, and markedly lower peak memory requirements compared with full-context and whole-graph inference. They further permit frozen graph ICL on million-node graphs without retraining. Our analysis identifies when retrieval channels work best and connects their behavior with graph properties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LoGIC框架，用于图级上下文中节点层面的上下文构建。通过结构、特征和覆盖度三个检索通道选取标注节点，并引入无标注"光环"节点支持适配器消息传递，在有限上下文预算下保持全上下文性能，显著降低内存需求，支持百万节点图上的冻结图上下文学习。
AI.motivation: 现有的表格基础模型（如G2T-FM、GraphPFN）在图节点预测中使用完整训练表作为上下文，导致注意力复杂度随标注池平方增长，产生预处理和内存瓶颈。需要探索如何合理分配上下文的标注预算和辅助无标注预算。
AI.method: 提出LoGIC方法：1) 通过结构、特征和覆盖度三个检索通道选择标注节点；2) 在图局部簇内共享上下文；3) 引入无标注光环节点支持适配器消息传递；4) 无需测试标签即可选择最佳通道和上下文预算。
AI.result: 在GraphLand上三种骨干配置（两个模型家族）下，预算化上下文保持局部可运行的全上下文性能，与已发表的大规模数据集结果相当，显著降低峰值内存需求，并支持在百万节点图上进行无需重训练的冻结图上下文学习。
AI.conclusion: 分析揭示了各检索通道最适用的场景，并将通道行为与图的属性联系起来，为图上下文学习中的上下文工程提供了系统性理解。

title: Visualizing Colonial Regimes: A Multi-View Approach to (Historical) Political Transformation
comment: 19 pages, 6 figures (figure 2 consists of two elements). Accepted for presentation at the Digital Heritage of European Conflicts Conference (DHECC 2026). Submitted to a special issue of the International Journal of Digital Humanities
summary: This paper takes a critical approach to visualization of colonial regimes. Drawing on critical hermeneutics and postcolonial theory, we created interactive visu- alizations revealing the constructed nature of colonial categories and exposing the hierarchies between empires and territories. Using the Varieties of Political Regimes dataset, our approach combines temporal flow visualization and geo- graphic distribution mapping. This allows us to contextualize colonial rule within broader patterns of political change. Our visualization challenges conventional, static, and isolated representations of colonial data by making the interpre- tive frameworks underlying colonial categorization visible through coordinated temporal, spatial, and relational views.

AI.tldr: 本文基于批判诠释学与后殖民理论，利用交互式可视化揭示殖民范畴的建构性本质以及帝国与领地之间的层级关系，挑战传统殖民地数据的静态孤立呈现。
AI.motivation: 传统殖民地数据可视化往往是静态、孤立且不加反思的呈现方式，未能揭示殖民分类体系背后的建构性质及其权力层级结构。
AI.method: 采用批判性诠释学与后殖民理论框架，结合Varieties of Political Regimes数据集，将时间流可视化与地理分布映射相结合，通过协调的时间、空间和关系视图呈现殖民地统治。
AI.result: 实现了将殖民规则置于更广泛政治变迁模式中进行语境化分析的可视化方案，使殖民分类背后的诠释框架通过多视图联动变得可见。
AI.conclusion: 该方法挑战了传统殖民数据的静态、孤立表征方式，展示了批判性视角在数据可视化中的价值。

title: Distilling Vision-Language Models for On-Device Fire Understanding
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising alternative to conventional fire detection systems by reasoning about the semantic context of a scene and thus reducing false alarms, yet their large model size makes deployment on embedded fire sensors impractical. In this paper, we study how domain-specialized VLMs can be compressed for fully on-device deployment without losing the safety-critical behavior required for fire detection. We develop a teacher-student knowledge distillation framework in which large VLMs fine-tuned for fire understanding can be distilled into lightweight students. Experiments across multiple VLM families and model scales show that compact students preserve most of their teachers' fire-understanding capability. We further deploy the distilled models on our commercial Detectium fire detection sensor and jointly evaluate reasoning accuracy, latency, and memory usage. The results show that compression and deployment affect not only accuracy but also model failure modes, with Qwen2.5-0.5B providing the strongest overall deployment trade-off. Our findings provide broader guidance for deploying domain-specialized VLMs in resource-constrained, safety-critical settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何通过知识蒸馏将大视觉语言模型压缩为轻量级学生模型，实现火灾检测传感器上的完全端侧部署，在保持安全关键行为的同时平衡推理精度、延迟和内存使用。
AI.motivation: 传统火灾检测系统易产生误报，而VLM虽然能通过语义理解降低误报，但其模型规模过大无法在嵌入式火灾传感器上实际部署。
AI.method: 提出教师-学生知识蒸馏框架：将针对火灾理解微调的大规模VLM蒸馏到轻量级学生模型中，并将蒸馏后的模型部署到商业化的Detectium火灾检测传感器上进行联合评估。
AI.result: 紧凑的学生模型保留了教师模型大部分的火灾理解能力；压缩和部署不仅影响精度，还影响模型的失败模式；Qwen2.5-0.5B在整体部署权衡中表现最强。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在资源受限且安全关键的环境中部署领域特化VLM提供了指导，证明通过蒸馏实现端侧火灾检测是可行的。

title: On-the-go Forgetting without Explicit Unlearning via ERASE
summary: Existing unlearning approaches typically rely on post hoc weight adaptation or distillation, leading to duplicated memory costs, degraded generalization, and limited scalability. In this work, we introduce ERASE, Erasure via Reconstructive Adversarial Signal Editing, a framework for on-the-go forgetting that suppresses the observable influence of private data without modifying model weights. ERASE leverages structured, class-conditioned input perturbations to induce selective forgetting during inference, eliminating the need for retraining, fine-tuning, or model copies. We rigorously characterize sufficient conditions when ERASE provably achieves functional forgetting of designated subclasses while preserving predictions across other subclasses within the same superclass. This analysis offers a principled foundation for inference-time forgetting under mild regularity assumptions. Across diverse architectures and benchmark datasets, ERASE maintains the best observed balance between forgetting efficacy, computational efficiency, and retention fidelity over recent unlearning-based methods. By reimagining data removal as forgetting without unlearning, our work establishes a scalable, regulation-aligned pathway for continual, privacy-conscious learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ERASE框架（Erasure via Reconstructive Adversarial Signal Editing），在不修改模型权重的前提下，通过在推理阶段施加结构化的类别条件输入扰动来实现选择性遗忘（即"on-the-go forgetting"），无需重训练、微调或模型副本，兼顾遗忘效果、计算效率与保留保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器遗忘方法通常依赖事后权重适应或蒸馏，存在内存成本重复、泛化性能下降和可扩展性受限等问题。
AI.method: ERASE利用结构化的类别条件输入扰动在推理阶段诱导选择性遗忘，通过理论刻画ERASE实现功能遗忘的充分条件，在温和正则性假设下提供了推理时遗忘的原理性基础。
AI.result: 在多种架构和基准数据集上，ERASE相比近期基于遗忘的方法取得了遗忘效果、计算效率和保留保真度之间的最佳平衡。
AI.conclusion: 通过将数据移除重新构想为"无遗忘的遗忘"，该工作建立了可扩展且符合法规的持续隐私感知学习路径。

title: Rescuing Performance from the Demo: Co-Designing Drum Gesture Mappings with a Percussionist
summary: Augmenting instruments with sensors and neural network mappings is a well-explored digital musical instrument design approach. While augmentations can create new expressive opportunities, they also exert aesthetic influence and can constrain musicians' gestural language, which, if left unchecked, can lead to technological capture. To examine this, we conducted a study with a professional percussionist, co-developing a gesture mapping toolkit and recording a ten-track album. Drawing on the concept of productive dissonance, our study aimed to hold the musician's aesthetic in tension with technological constraints. This, along with a practice-based reflective approach, supported the development of a continuous gesture recognition method for percussive mapping and surfaced insights into the design process. We identify knowing-when as a form of tacit knowledge that supported productive dissonance, and raise an open question: absent a musician's broader social context, how do we know whether a technology's influence is genuinely supporting their practice?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了如何通过"生产性不协调"理念来平衡乐器增强技术的美学影响与音乐家手势语言受限的问题，通过与一位专业打击乐手合作开发手势映射工具包并录制十轨专辑，提出"知时"作为一种支持该过程的隐性知识，并质疑在缺乏音乐家社会背景时如何评判技术影响的正当性。
AI.motivation: 传感器和神经网络增强的数字乐器虽然能创造新的表现机会，但其美学影响可能约束音乐家的手势语言，导致"技术俘获"问题。现有研究缺乏对这一张力的深入实践考察。
AI.method: 与一位专业打击乐手共同开发手势映射工具包，录制一张包含十轨的专辑，采用以实践为基础的反思方法，并运用"生产性不协调"概念将音乐家的美学与技术的限制保持张力。
AI.result: 开发出一种用于打击乐映射的连续手势识别方法，并在设计过程中发现了"知时"这一隐性知识形态，它支持了生产性不协调的实践。
AI.conclusion: 文章提出一个开放性问题：在缺乏音乐家更为广泛的社会背景时，我们无法确知技术的影响是否真正支持其艺术实践，这有待进一步探索。

title: More Than Mimicking Reviewers: Evaluating LLMs for Pre-Submission Peer Review
summary:
Peer-review feedback often arrives too late for authors to make meaningful revisions. We study an author-facing LLM system that moves part of this stress test before submission: it generates a broad pool of atomic concerns and compresses them into a short report. We evaluate agreement with historical reviews and, separately, the possible validity of concerns they omit.
  From 10,000 ICLR 2026 submissions, we use 3,398 manuscripts with accessible versions that predate review. On a ten-paper diagnostic, independent sampling covers 44.9% of historical issues; deduplication and refill reaches 78.7% strict and 84.9% seriousness-weighted coverage, at 3.6$\times$ more requests and 5.2$\times$ more tokens. A hidden Top-32 Oracle preserves the full 79.3% weighted coverage of a 256-candidate pool, but paper-only selectors retain only 40--44%. LLM review therefore provides broad coverage with a large candidate pool but compresses poorly; ablations identify representative selection and matcher sensitivity as the main sources of this gap.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个面向作者的LLM系统，在论文提交前生成原子化关注点列表并压缩为简短报告。基于3,398篇ICLR 2026论文的实验表明，独立采样覆盖44.9%历史问题，去重和补充后可达到78.7%严格覆盖和84.9%加权覆盖，但压缩性能欠佳，主要瓶颈在于代表性子集选取和匹配器灵敏度。
AI.motivation: 同行评审反馈往往来得太晚，作者无法在提交前进行有意义的修改。因此希望构建一个作者可用的LLM系统，在投稿前进行类似的评审压力测试。
AI.method: 系统首先生成大量原子化关注点，再将其压缩为简短报告。使用10,000篇ICLR 2026投稿中的3,398篇可回溯版本论文进行评测，并设计十篇论文的诊断集，比较独立采样、去重+补充策略对历史评审问题的覆盖情况，同时引入隐藏Top-32 Oracle和仅基于论文的选择器进行消融分析。
AI.result: 独立采样覆盖44.9%的历史问题；去重和补充后可达78.7%严格覆盖和84.9%按严重性加权的覆盖，但需3.6倍请求和5.2倍token。隐藏Oracle可保持256候选池79.3%的加权覆盖，但仅基于论文的选择器只能保留40-44%。
AI.conclusion: LLM评审配合大规模候选池能提供广泛的覆盖面，但压缩性能不佳；消融实验表明代表性子集选择和匹配器灵敏度是造成这一差距的主要原因。

title: Machine Learning for Pre-Culture ESBL Risk Stratification to Guide Empiric Antibiotic Selection: A 12-Hospital Study of Enterobacteriaceae Cultures
comment: Accepted for presentation at American Medical Informatics Association (AMIA) Annual Symposium 2026
summary: Empiric antibiotic therapy for suspected ESBL-producing Enterobacteriaceae must be selected 48-72 hours before culture results, forcing clinicians to choose between undertreating resistant infections and overusing carbapenems that drive further resistance. We developed a cost-sensitive XGBoost model predicting an ESBL phenotype (resistance to ceftriaxone, ceftazidime, cefepime or piperacillin-tazobactam) at culture ordering using 45 pre-culture EHR features across 132,955 cultures from 72,217 patients at 12 hospitals (14.41% with the ESBL phenotype). Cultures were partitioned at the patient level. At 90% sensitivity, the model achieved 95.8% NPV, reducing post-test ESBL probability to 4.2%, a threshold that may support safe carbapenem-sparing in non-ICU settings, while sparing 307 of every 1,000 cultures an unnecessary broad-spectrum course at the cost of 14 missed ESBL cases per 1,000. SHAP analysis identified prior ESBL colonization as the dominant predictor, ahead of prior organism burden and neighborhood deprivation; removing deprivation features caused minimal performance loss ($Δ\text{AUROC} = -0.020$), enabling equitable bedside deployment. Discrimination was unchanged under a strict IDSA ESBL-E definition (AUROC 0.766), with specimen type added as a predictor (0.764) and without any class-imbalance correction (0.762), and ranged from 0.71 to 0.78 across organism strata.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一种基于XGBoost的成本敏感模型，利用45个培养前电子病历特征预测ESBL产肠杆菌表型，在12家医院的132,955份培养样本中，90%敏感性下达到95.8%的阴性预测值（NPV），可将ESBL后验概率降至4.2%，有助于在非ICU环境安全减少碳青霉烯类使用，同时SHAP分析显示既往ESBL定植是首要预测因子。
AI.motivation: 经验性抗生素治疗必须在培养结果出来前48-72小时选择，临床医生面临两难：要么治疗不足导致耐药感染未被覆盖，要么过度使用碳青霉烯类加剧耐药。需要一种能在培养下单时预测ESBL表型的工具来支持更精准的经验性用药决策。
AI.method: 构建成本敏感的XGBoost模型，使用12家医院72,217名患者的132,955份培养数据，提取45个培养前EHR特征，按患者层面划分数据。通过校准敏感性阈值并结合SHAP可解释性分析评估特征重要性，同时进行了多维度稳健性验证，包括IDSA严格定义、标本类型、类别不平衡处理及不同菌种分层分析。
AI.result: 模型在90%敏感性下达到95.8%的NPV（ESBL后验概率降至4.2%），每1000份培养中可避免307次不必要广谱用药，代价是漏诊14例ESBL。AUROC为0.766（严格定义下），在不同菌种分层中为0.71-0.78。去除社会剥夺特征仅导致AUROC下降0.020，保证公平部署。
AI.conclusion: 该模型展示了在经验性抗生素决策中利用EHR数据实现精准预测的可行性，可在保证安全性的同时减少碳青霉烯类过度使用。模型具有较好的稳健性和公平性，值得临床进一步验证与推广。

title: Healthcare Utilization, Chronic Condition Management, and Workplace Functioning Among Users of a Purpose-Built Mental Health AI (Ash): Cross-Sectional Study
summary: Mental health challenges can exacerbate physical symptoms and complicate management of chronic conditions. Purpose-built artificial intelligence (AI) tools may offer scalable support for co-occurring mental and physical health concerns. This cross-sectional study compared past-6-month healthcare utilization, chronic condition management, physical health behaviors, mental health change, and workplace functioning between active (n = 169) and non-users (n = 73) of a mental health AI (Ash). Participants had at least one chronic condition (e.g. hypertension, chronic pain). Binary outcomes were modeled as adjusted risk differences (RDs) using linear probability models and continuous outcomes were modeled with linear regression; all models were adjusted for hypertension. Relative to non-users, active users were more likely to report improved mental health (61.4% vs. 34.3%; RD = 0.27), higher medication adherence (91.7% vs. 76.4%, RD = 0.15), fewer skipped or delayed chronic-condition care activities (b = -0.44), and were less likely to report repeat urgent care visits (9.5% vs. 23.3%; RD = -0.15) and monthly-or-more absenteeism (24.2% vs. 45.2%; RD = -0.20, all ps < .05). Findings provide preliminary evidence that use of purpose-built AI may be associated with positive symptom-based and utilization outcomes for those managing co-occurring mental and physical concerns.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过横断面设计比较了使用心理健康AI工具(Ash)的活跃用户与非用户，在共病慢性和心理健康问题人群中的医疗利用、慢病管理、心理健康变化及工作功能等指标。结果显示活跃用户在心理健康改善、药物依从性、减少急诊就诊和缺勤等方面均显著优于非用户，提示面向特定目的构建的AI可能为身心共病管理提供可扩展的支持。
AI.motivation: 心理健康问题会加重身体症状并使慢病管理复杂化，现有支持资源有限，需要探索可扩展的解决方案。作者希望评估专门构建的AI工具能否为身心共病患者提供有效的支持性干预。
AI.method: 采用横断面研究设计，比较过去6个月内活跃使用心理健康AI工具(Ash)的用户(n=169)与非用户(n=73)在医疗利用、慢病管理、身体行为健康、心理健康变化和工作功能方面的情况。参与者均至少患有一种慢病。使用线性概率模型计算调整后的风险差异(RDs)分析二元结果，线性回归分析连续结果，所有模型均调整了高血压变量。
AI.result: 与非用户相比，活跃用户心理健康改善比例更高(61.4% vs. 34.3%; RD=0.27)，药物依从性更高(91.7% vs. 76.4%; RD=0.15)，跳过或延迟慢病护理活动更少(b=-0.44)，重复急诊就诊比例更低(9.5% vs. 23.3%; RD=-0.15)，每月或更频繁缺勤的比例更低(24.2% vs. 45.2%; RD=-0.20)，所有差异均具有统计学显著性(p<.05)。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供初步证据表明，使用专门构建的AI工具可能与共病心理和身体健康问题人群的症状改善及医疗资源利用优化呈正向关联，可作为传统医疗服务的可扩展补充支持手段。

title: Spillover-Aware Multi-Value Steering for Pluralistic LLM Alignment
summary: Activation steering controls LLM behavior at inference time by adding learned directions to hidden states, but existing methods handle one concept at a time. Pluralistic alignment, where different stakeholders need different value emphases, requires steering multiple dimensions simultaneously. We show that naive steering produces substantial spillover: the effect intended for one value leaks into others. This parallels the treatment-versus-spillover decomposition in causal inference. We trace spillover to geometric entanglement of steering directions, captured by their Gram matrix, and derive a zero-cost correction from an activation-norm-penalized objective that decouples each direction's contribution exactly. Our end-to-end pipeline requires no fine-tuning, no reward model, and no manual prompt engineering: given only domain questions, it automatically discovers value dimensions, extracts directions, diagnoses entanglement, and applies corrected steering. On climate discourse, the correction improves the net steering effect from +5.9% to +14.0%, validated over 100,000 pairwise judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种零成本的多概念激活引导校正方法，通过激活范数惩罚目标函数解耦各价值维度的引导方向，解决了朴素的激活引导在多元对齐中产生的"溢出效应"，在气候话语任务上将净引导效果从+5.9%提升至+14.0%。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法一次只能处理单一概念，而在多元对齐场景中，不同利益相关者需要同时强调多个价值维度。朴素引导会产生显著的溢出效应——针对一个价值的引导效果会干扰其他价值，这一问题亟待解决。
AI.method: 作者将溢出问题类比为因果推断中的处理效应与溢出分解，将溢出归因于引导方向的几何纠缠（用Gram矩阵刻画），并从一个带激活范数惩罚的目标函数中推导出零成本校正公式，该公式能精确解耦每个方向的贡献。整个流程无需微调、奖励模型或人工提示工程，仅需领域问题即可自动发现价值维度、提取方向、诊断纠缠并应用校正引导。
AI.result: 在气候话语数据集上，通过超过10万对成对判断验证，该方法将净引导效果从+5.9%提升至+14.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为多元对齐提供了高效解决方案，证明了通过几何解耦即可消除引导溢出，且无需额外的训练成本或人工干预。

title: DART: Distributional Adversarial Recurrent Training for Algorithm Learning
summary: Recurrent reasoning models (RRMs) can solve structured problems, achieving easy-to-hard generalization through iterative computation in hidden space. These models are typically trained with instance-level supervision, which becomes increasingly problematic as task difficulty grows: valid solutions occupy a tiny region of the solution space, while invalid solutions proliferate rapidly. We propose Distributional Adversarial Recurrent Training (DART), a training framework that replaces single-point supervision with a local target distribution around the ground-truth solution and aligns model outputs with this distribution through an adversarial objective. DART provides a richer learning signal and encourages more stable iterative trajectories toward valid solutions. When evaluated on Maze, Chess, and masked Sudoku with multiple RRMs, including Deep Thinking Systems and Tiny Recursive Models, DART improves solution quality, stability, and robustness under the evaluated distribution shifts. Comparisons with label smoothing, Gaussian softened targets, and progressive training show that DART is not explained by target softening alone and is complementary to training schemes that stabilize long-horizon recurrence. These results identify DART as a promising approach for improving robustness across the evaluated recurrent reasoning models.

AI.tldr: DART框架用局部目标分布替代单点监督，通过对抗目标训练循环推理模型，在Maze、Chess和Sudoku任务上提升了模型输出质量、稳定性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 循环推理模型在任务难度增加时，实例级监督会失效——有效解在解空间中占比极小，而无效解快速增多，导致训练信号不足。
AI.method: DART将单点监督替换为围绕真实解构建的局部目标分布，并通过对抗目标优化使模型输出与该分布对齐，以提供更丰富的学习信号并促使迭代轨迹趋向有效解。
AI.result: 在Maze、Chess和masked Sudoku上，DART在多种RRM（如Deep Thinking Systems和Tiny Recursive Models）上均提升了解决方案质量、稳定性和分布偏移下的鲁棒性。与label smoothing等方法对比显示其效果不能仅由目标软化解释，且与稳定长程循环的训练方案互补。
AI.conclusion: DART是一种有前景的分布级对抗训练方法，可用于增强循环推理模型在复杂结构化问题上的鲁棒性和稳定性。

title: To Stop or Not to Stop: Exploring the Intention-Behavior Gaps in Smartphone Usage
summary: As smartphones become integral to daily life, researchers have sought to identify when the use becomes problematic. Previous studies have operationalized problematic smartphone usage (PSU) from either an intention or a behavior perspective. Both risk delivering interventions not welcomed by users. We propose a novel approach to operationalizing PSU as the intention-behavior gap (IBG). We collected self-reported data on intentions to stop phone usage, alongside usage behavior data, from 37 participants over two weeks. We calculated IBG, examined effects of demographic and contextual variables, and developed machine learning models to predict IBG in real time. We found that IBG was explained by gender, time, app, and input interactions, among other factors. Intention was predicted most accurately with only personal data, whereas behavior and IBG were predicted most accurately with both personal and global data. Our findings can inform the design of future intervention tools optimized for timing and adaptive intensity.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出用"意图-行为差距"(IBG)来操作化问题性智能手机使用(PSU)，通过收集37名参与者两周的自我报告停止使用意图与行为数据，计算IBG并用机器学习实时预测，发现性别、时间、应用和输入交互等因素可解释IBG，且不同预测目标需要不同的数据组合。
AI.motivation: 以往研究从意图或行为单一角度操作化问题性智能手机使用(PSU)，这两种方式都存在向用户提供不受欢迎干预的风险，因此需要新的操作化方法来更好地理解和使用PSU。
AI.method: 收集37名参与者两周的自我报告停止使用意图数据与使用行为数据，计算意图-行为差距(IBG)，分析人口统计学和情境变量的影响，并开发机器学习模型以实时预测IBG。
AI.result: IBG可由性别、时间、应用类型和输入交互等因素解释；意图仅用个人数据预测最准确，而行为和IBG需要同时结合个人与全局数据才能达到最高预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果可为未来干预工具的设计提供依据，优化干预的时机选择和自适应强度调整。

title: Evidence-Aligned Local Composition of Discrete Experts for Sequence Restoration
summary: A document modeled as a discrete sequence of tokens can be thought of as being generated from a composition of texts from different domains; a README file, for example, moves between prose, code, and configuration. When such a document is corrupted and only frozen domain experts are available, restoring it requires deciding both what is missing and which expert to trust at each position, at test time and without region labels or a trained router. We introduce evidence-aligned local composition, which infers a soft, position-wise weighting over the experts from the marginal evidence of the corrupted observation under a given corruption model, estimating the evidence from the experts' own denoising losses and smoothing the weights across positions. Because the weighting is soft, it recovers a mixture when the true composition is mixed and concentrates on one expert when that suffices. Across a categorical simulator, byte-level experts, and experts fine-tuned from a $1.3$B discrete flow-matching model, the inferred weights track the true regions at $0.85$ field accuracy on naturally mixed scientific documents, and at $0.98$ on constructed mixtures whose regions are lexically disjoint. Restoration improves over a single global weight when the experts are genuinely distinct and reduces to it when they converge, tracking a measure of expert separation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"证据对齐的局部组合"方法，在文档受损且仅有冻结的领域专家模型可用时，通过从专家自身的去噪损失估计边际证据，在测试时推断每个位置的软权重，实现无需区域标签或路由器的文档恢复。
AI.motivation: 现实文档常由多个领域（如代码、散文、配置）的文本组合而成。当文档损坏而只有各领域的冻结专家可用时，需要在测试时同时判断缺失内容以及每个位置该信任哪个专家，且没有区域标签或训练好的路由器，这是一个困难的组合推断问题。
AI.method: 提出证据对齐局部组合（evidence-aligned local composition），从损坏观测在给定损坏模型下的边际证据推断专家的逐位置软权重，利用专家自身的去噪损失估计证据，并跨位置平滑权重。软权重既能恢复混合组合，也能在单一专家足够时集中到该专家。
AI.result: 在分类模拟器、字节级专家以及由1.3B离散流匹配模型微调的专家上验证，推断权重在自然混合的科学文档上达到0.85的字段精度，在词法不相交的构造混合上达到0.98。当专家真正不同时恢复效果优于单一全局权重，当专家趋同时退化为全局权重，并跟踪专家分离度指标。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需区域标签或训练路由器即可在测试时确定各位置应信任的领域专家，能有效恢复多领域混合文档，且对专家间的差异程度具有自适应能力。

title: Memory in Deep Time-Series Models
summary: Deep learning for time series has progressed through successive architectural paradigms, from recurrent networks and transformers to structured state-space models, retrieval-augmented predictors, foundation models, and tool-using agents. These developments are typically studied in isolation, organized by architecture or modeling era. We argue that they can instead be viewed through a common question of \emph{how does a time-series model retain and access information beyond its immediate input?} This question is motivated by a fundamental limitation of conventional time-series modeling: information relevant to a prediction may lie far beyond a feasible input window, while compressing history into a fixed-size state can discard information that may become useful later. We formulate this challenge as a \emph{memory} problem and organize existing time-series methods along a spectrum from internal memory, encoded in parameters and fixed-size states, to external memory that is addressable, retrievable, and increasingly maintained by agents. We then develop a unified taxonomy of memory mechanisms and review three classes of external memory, including explicit modules, retrieval augmentation, and agentic stores, under a common framework for what is retained, how it is written and accessed, and how it persists. A cross-cutting analysis maps these mechanisms to time-series tasks and identifies gaps in both methods and evaluation. We conclude by outlining open problems in building memory systems that can selectively retain, retrieve, revise, and forget information as temporal environments evolve. The result is a framework for studying memory as a first-class dimension of time series modeling, independent of the underlying backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以"记忆"为核心维度重新审视时间序列建模方法，将各种时序模型（从RNN、Transformer到状态空间模型、检索增强预测器和agent系统）统一在"模型如何在其直接输入之外保留和访问信息"这一共同问题下，建立从内部记忆到外部记忆的谱系，并开发统一的记忆机制分类体系，识别研究空白并展望开放问题。
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列建模存在根本性局限：预测所需的相关信息可能远超出可行的输入窗口，而将历史压缩为固定大小的状态又可能丢弃未来可能有用的信息。现有的各类时序深度学习方法通常按架构或建模时代孤立研究，缺乏统一视角来理解它们如何解决信息保留与访问这一核心挑战。
AI.method: 作者将时序建模的核心挑战形式化为"记忆"问题，沿"内部记忆（参数编码与固定大小状态）→ 外部记忆（可寻址、可检索、由agent维持）"的谱系组织研究方法。开发了统一的记忆机制分类体系，涵盖了记忆保留什么、如何写入与访问、以及如何持久化三个维度，并系统回顾了三类外部记忆：显式模块、检索增强和agent存储。
AI.result: 提出了统一的时间序列记忆机制分类框架，将记忆机制映射到时序任务上进行跨切面分析，识别了现有方法与评估中的空白。该框架独立于底层骨干网络架构，使记忆成为时间序列建模的一等维度。
AI.conclusion: 时间序列模型应当在随时间演化的环境中具备选择性保留、检索、修正和遗忘信息的能力。文章指出构建此类记忆系统仍存在多项开放问题，呼吁将记忆作为深入研究时间序列建模的一等设计维度。

title: Embedded Human-Centered Data Science in a Graduate Programming Course: A Framework and Case Study
summary: As AI and data-driven systems pervade practice, there is an imperative for instructors to embed societal impact and ethics content into computing courses. In response, we present the Human-Centered Education for Learning in Information and eXplainable Computing (HELIX) framework for information science programs, organized around three iterative pillars - knowledge building, decision-making, and empowerment - with concrete actions for instructors and students. We applied the framework in a graduate, introductory programming course using readings, algorithmic design activities, and scenario-based reflections. We present a pilot implementation of this framework to examine changes in students' (n=22) knowledge acquisition, decision-making processes, and self-reflection regarding human-centered perspectives in data science. We release an anonymized materials kit (survey, assignments, analysis code) to support adoption. We discuss design tensions (workload, assessment, relevance to diverse information science learners) and provide guidelines for integrating human-centered content without overwhelming technical outcomes. Findings suggest that the HELIX Framework is feasible in information science contexts and future work should use comparative survey assessment to strengthen causal inferences.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了HELIX框架（Human-Centered Education for Learning in Information and eXplainable Computing），用于在计算机课程中嵌入社会影响与伦理内容。该框架围绕知识构建、决策制定和赋权三大迭代支柱组织，并在研究生入门编程课程中进行了试点实施（n=22）。研究通过阅读材料、算法设计活动和情景反思来考察学生在数据科学中人本视角的知识获取、决策过程和自我反思的变化，并发布了匿名化材料工具包以支持推广。
AI.motivation: 随着AI和数据驱动系统在各领域普及，计算机课程教学中亟需融入社会影响和伦理内容，但目前缺乏系统的教学框架来指导信息科学项目中的此类教学设计。
AI.method: 提出了HELIX框架，采用三大迭代支柱（知识构建、决策制定、赋权），在研究生入门编程课程中进行试点，通过阅读材料、算法设计活动和基于场景的反思来应用框架，收集了22名学生的数据进行分析。
AI.result: 试点结果表明HELIX框架在信息科学教育中具有可行性；研究识别了设计中的张力（工作量、评估、对多样信息科学学习者的相关性），并提供了在不干扰技术学习成果的前提下整合人本内容的指导原则。
AI.conclusion: HELIX框架在信息科学情境中可行，未来应使用比较性调查研究来加强因果推断。

title: Exposing Weaknesses in Emotion Recognition in Conversations
summary: Emotion Recognition in Conversations (ERC) aims to identify speakers' emotions in multi-turn dialogue. Accurate emotion recognition can support a wide range of applications, including empathetic conversational agents, mental health support, and educational technologies. While many recent approaches rely on task-specific fine-tuning, such models may exploit dataset-specific cues. A central yet rarely questioned assumption in ERC is that each utterance can be assigned a single unambiguous emotion label. To investigate this assumption, we study ERC using Large Language Models (LLMs) in a zero-shot setting while incorporating preceding conversational turns as context. We show that aggregate metrics mask systematic failures. Errors concentrate around utterances containing negations, exclamations, and interjections. This pattern is consistent across all evaluated models, suggesting limitations in the benchmarks rather than model-specific weaknesses. A controlled re-annotation study involving four human annotators supports this finding: strong agreement is observed in only 35 percent of cases, with neutral utterances dominating high-agreement instances, while many emotional categories fall into low-agreement regimes. These findings suggest that many apparent model errors reflect genuine annotation ambiguity rather than poor emotion understanding. Standard single-label evaluation is therefore insufficient. To address this limitation, we introduce an LLM-as-Judge framework that evaluates each emotion independently according to its plausibility in the conversational context rather than enforcing a single-label decision.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了对话情感识别（ERC）中的一个核心假设——每条话语可被赋予单一明确的情感标签。研究发现，LLM在零样本设置下产生的错误往往集中在否定、感叹和插入语等话语上，且人类标注者仅在35%的情况下高度一致，表明多数"模型错误"实际源于标注歧义而非模型能力不足。为此，本文提出了一种LLM-as-Judge框架，对每种情感独立评估其在对话语境中的合理性，替代传统的单标签评估方式。
AI.motivation: ERC领域普遍依赖单标签标注假设，但这一假设很少被质疑。现有基于任务特定微调的模型可能利用数据集特有线索，且聚合指标掩盖了系统性的失败模式。本文旨在揭示标注歧义问题，并挑战单标签评估范式的有效性。
AI.method: 采用多种LLM在零样本条件下进行ERC实验，纳入前序对话轮次作为上下文；通过受控再标注研究（四名人类标注者）检验标注一致性；并提出LLM-as-Judge框架，对每种情感独立评估其在语境中的合理性，而非强制执行单标签决策。
AI.result: 错误集中在含否定、感叹和插入语的话语中，且该模式在所有评估模型上一致；人类标注者仅在35%的情况下达成强一致性，中性话语主导高一致性实例，许多情感类别落入低一致性区域。
AI.conclusion: 许多表面上的模型错误实际反映了真实的标注歧义，而非情感理解能力的不足。标准的单标签评估不足以准确衡量ERC模型性能，需要向多标签或基于合理性的评估框架转变。

title: Granular-Ball Quantum Clustering for Resource-Efficient and Robust Learning
summary: Quantum clustering aims to exploit quantum feature representations to uncover complex data structures beyond conventional Euclidean geometry. Yet this sample-level kernel construction requires O(n^2) quantum circuit executions for n data points, creating a major bottleneck under near-term quantum resource constraints. Prior solutions fail to resolve this efficiency-accuracy dilemma: classical granular-ball clustering reduces sample complexity but relies on Euclidean metrics that cannot capture quantum correlations, while existing quantum compression schemes prioritize efficiency over structural preservation, degrading performance on non-convex or noisy data. Here we propose Granular-Ball Quantum Clustering (GBQC), a framework that tightly couples granular-ball structural abstraction with quantum feature learning. GBQC first compresses raw data into compact, representative granular balls via a PCA-guided splitting strategy, reducing kernel evaluations by 80% compared to full-sample methods. A quantum cohesion mechanism then filters noisy granules in Hilbert space to improve clustering robustness. Extensive experiments on synthetic, noisy, overlapping, and real-world datasets demonstrate that GBQC consistently achieves superior clustering accuracy and robustness compared with representative classical and quantum clustering methods. Meanwhile, the proposed granular-ball compression significantly reduces quantum kernel evaluations and computational overhead, enabling quantum clustering experiments on larger datasets within parameterized quantum learning frameworks. These results suggest that granular-ball representations serve not only as a compression mechanism to reduce quantum computational costs but also as an effective structural abstraction mechanism that improves clustering quality by eliminating redundant and structurally ambiguous learning units.

AI.tldr: 提出粒球量子聚类（GBQC）框架，通过粒球结构抽象结合量子特征学习，在压缩量子核评估80%的同时提升聚类准确性和鲁棒性，解决了量子聚类的效率-精度两难问题。
AI.motivation: 量子聚类需要O(n²)次量子电路执行，在近期量子资源下构成严重瓶颈；现有方法要么依赖经典欧氏度量无法捕捉量子关联，要么牺牲结构保真度导致非凸或噪声数据上性能下降，缺乏同时兼顾效率和精度的方案。
AI.method: GBQC框架包含两个核心步骤：首先通过PCA引导的划分策略将原始数据压缩为紧凑的代表性粒球，减少80%的核评估；然后利用量子内聚机制在希尔伯特空间中过滤噪声粒球，提升聚类鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在合成、噪声、重叠和真实数据集上的大量实验表明，GBQC相比代表性经典和量子聚类方法在聚类准确性和鲁棒性上持续取得更优表现，同时粒球压缩显著降低了量子核评估和计算开销，使更大规模数据集的量子聚类实验成为可能。
AI.conclusion: 粒球表示不仅作为降低量子计算成本的压缩机制，更是一种有效的结构抽象机制，通过消除冗余和结构模糊的学习单元来提升聚类质量。

title: Location-Independent Robot-Assisted Finishing Using Digital Twins and Extended Reality
comment: 6 pages, 5 figures, 2027 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration
summary: This paper presents a cyber-physical system (CPS) for location-independent programming, supervision, training, and teleoperation of a Robot-Assisted Finishing (RAF) system used to post-process metal additive-manufactured (AM) components. A digital twin (DT) built in Unity is delivered to the operator as a WebGL application that supports both desktop and immersive modes through WebXR-compatible devices. Moreover, it exchanges robot state and pose commands with a collaborative robot through a Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) broker. The DT enforces kinematic and collision constraints before a pose is released to the physical robot, and augments the virtual component with a color map of the surface topography that supports operator decisions on part repositioning or process termination. The architecture was validated on a specially designed physical RAF system. A steady-state joint synchronization error of 0.12 deg and a mean round-trip latency of 563 ms were measured, which is adequate for supervisory programming and intermittent teleoperation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于数字孪生（DT）的赛博物理系统（CPS），用于金属增材制造（AM）部件的机器人辅助精加工（RAF）系统的与位置无关编程、监督、培训和遥操作。系统通过Unity构建数字孪生，以WebGL应用形式交付，支持桌面和沉浸式模式（通过WebXR），并使用MQTT协议与协作机器人通信。数字孪生在释放位姿命令前强制执行运动学和碰撞约束，并通过表面形貌彩色图谱辅助操作员决策。实验验证显示，关节同步误差为0.12度，平均往返时延为563毫秒，足以支持监督编程和间歇性遥操作。
AI.motivation: 金属增材制造部件需要后续精加工处理，而传统方法要求操作员与物理机器人近距离编程和操作，受限于位置，缺乏灵活性和沉浸式交互能力。作者旨在开发一套支持位置无关的编程、监督、培训和遥操作架构，提升人机交互的安全性和可访问性。
AI.method: 采用数字孪生方法：在Unity中构建RAF系统的虚拟镜像，以WebGL技术跨平台部署，并支持WebXR沉浸式设备；通过MQTT代理实现数字孪生与协作机器人之间的机器人状态和位姿命令双向通信；在命令下发至物理机器人前加入运动学和碰撞约束校验层，并在虚拟工件上叠加表面形貌彩色图谱供操作员决策。
AI.result: 在特制的物理RAF系统上验证了架构可行性。测量得到稳态关节同步误差为0.12度，平均往返时延为563毫秒，该性能指标满足监督编程和间歇性遥操作的需求。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的CPS架构成功实现了对机器人辅助精加工系统的远程、沉浸式操作与监管。数字孪生结合约束校验和可视化增强，为金属增材制造后处理提供了安全、灵活且位置无关的人机交互方案。

title: Agentic BAIM-LLM Evaluation (ABLE): Benchmarking LLM Use of Protein Design Tools
comment: Last revised in February 2026; presented without further revision. An earlier revision at was presented at the NeurIPS 2025 Workshop on Biosecurity Safeguards for Generative AI; see https://openreview.net/forum?id=fDysOrWaGd
summary: We introduce ABLE, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents' ability to use biological AI models (BAIMs), such as ProteinMPNN and AlphaFold3, in dual-use protein design workflows. ABLE assesses agent performance through a set of tasks spanning structure retrieval, sequence generation, and design validation. We evaluate 15 frontier models and find that seven refuse all tasks, while the remaining models exhibit substantial performance differences. Claude Sonnet 4 and Gemini 3 Pro achieve the highest scores across information retrieval, tool selection, and tool use. We further compare model performance on a subset of tasks against an expert human baseline. Our results suggest that current LLMs can substantially lower barriers to protein design, but remain inconsistent in planning, strategy generation, and integrating biological knowledge with tool use.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ABLE基准，用于评估LLM智能体在双用途蛋白质设计工作流程中使用生物AI模型（如ProteinMPNN和AlphaFold3）的能力。实验评估了15个前沿模型，发现7个拒绝所有任务，其余模型表现差异显著，Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 3 Pro得分最高。结果表明当前LLM虽能大幅降低蛋白质设计门槛，但在规划、策略生成和生物知识整合方面仍不稳定。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质设计涉及双用途风险（dual-use），而LLM智能体与生物AI模型的结合可能降低蛋白质设计的门槛，需要系统性的基准来评估LLM智能体在这些工作流中的实际能力与潜在风险。
AI.method: 构建ABLE基准，设计涵盖结构检索、序列生成和设计验证三类任务，对15个前沿LLM模型进行系统评估，并在部分任务上与专家人类基线进行对比。
AI.result: 15个模型中7个拒绝执行所有任务；其余模型在信息检索、工具选择和工具使用方面表现差异显著，其中Claude Sonnet 4和Gemini 3 Pro表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM确实能够降低蛋白质设计的进入门槛，但在规划能力、策略生成以及将生物知识与工具使用整合方面仍存在不一致性，暗示这些系统在安全性上需要进一步关注和提升。

title: IXPLORE: Bounded Ideal Point Estimation with Grid-Based Uncertainty Quantification
summary: Ideal point estimation is widely used to analyze and visualize political data. However, selecting the corresponding spatial model involves various trade-offs: while model-based approaches such as Item Response Theory (IRT) are based on utility functions rather than optimized for predictive accuracy, most Machine Learning (ML) alternatives struggle to generalize beyond training data when embedding sparse test responses. We introduce IXPLORE, a bounded ideal point estimation algorithm that combines a predictive fit objective with a sparsity-aware likelihood function. On five benchmark datasets spanning surveys, roll calls, and deliberation, this approach surpasses model-based and ML-based algorithms on reconstruction and imputation error - especially for users with sparse responses. Furthermore, we show that non-linear feature transforms can further reduce the reconstruction error while remaining visually interpretable. To quantify uncertainty, IXPLORE applies grid-based posterior inference on a bounded 2D latent space. Available as a Python package on PyPI, IXPLORE offers a flexible framework for constructing bounded, interpretable political maps with fast inference and strong imputation performance.

AI.tldr: IXPLORE是一种有界理想点估计算法，结合预测拟合目标与稀疏感知似然函数，在重建与插补误差上超越基于模型和基于机器学习的现有算法，尤其适用于稀疏响应用户，并支持网格贝叶斯后验推断与非线性的可解释可视化。
AI.motivation: 现有政治数据理想点估计方法存在权衡：基于IR T等模型的方法依赖效用函数而非优化预测精度；多数机器学习替代方案在嵌入稀疏测试响应时难以泛化。
AI.method: 将预测拟合目标与稀疏感知似然函数结合，采用有界2D潜空间上的网格贝叶斯后验推断，并通过非线性特征变换提升重建效果同时保持可解释性。
AI.result: 在覆盖调查、投票和审议的五个基准数据集上，该方法在重建和插补误差方面分别超越了基于模型和基于机器学习的算法，尤其对于稀疏响应的用户优势明显。
AI.conclusion: IXPLORE提供了快速推断和强插补性能的灵活框架，可用于构建有界、可解释的政治地图，并以Python包形式发布在PyPI上。

title: Travel Package Booking Application with API Bot
comment: 6 pages. Originally published in the International Journal of Recent Technology and Engineering (IJRTE), Volume 8, Issue 4, November 2019
summary: These days we are witnessing many mobile applications based on the recommended systems, which have become a great technology which is been used by the various mobile applications according to the situation. Recommendation provided by the mobile application is a key element for the person who is traveling to several places. For any tourist information application contextual information is much needed to guide the user on his interests this can be achieved by the Context-aware computing. Which provides the user most interactive system with the suggestions provided by it based on the input from the user in a certain location, here context includes the user's mental, social, physical environments. To achieve this contextual information, we will design and implement the context-aware user interface based on the user for which we have to study the user and design a rich user interface. The final outcome for which users have the satisfaction when using context-aware functionality will be much better than non-context-aware application.

AI.tldr: 本文提出设计并实现一种基于上下文感知的用户界面，用于旅游信息移动应用，以根据用户所处位置及环境提供个性化推荐，提升用户体验满意度。
AI.motivation: 随着移动应用中推荐系统技术的普及，旅游信息应用需要结合上下文感知计算来提供更精准、更符合用户兴趣的推荐服务，而传统非上下文感知的应用无法满足这一需求。
AI.method: 通过研究用户行为与环境信息（包括用户的心理、社会及物理环境），设计并实现一个基于用户的上下文感知用户界面，使其能够根据用户所处位置和输入信息动态提供推荐建议。
AI.result: 采用上下文感知功能的用户最终使用满意度显著优于使用非上下文感知应用的体验。
AI.conclusion: 上下文感知技术在移动旅游推荐应用中具有明显优势，能够为用户提供更互动、个性化的服务体验。

title: Beyond Top-$k$ Skill Retrieval: Diversity-Aware Skill Routing for LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external skills, but routing user requests over large skill registries is difficult because many skills are functionally redundant while complex tasks often require complementary skill sets. Existing skill routers typically rank candidates independently by query relevance, which can waste context budget on redundant skills. We propose Diverse Skill Routing (DSR), a diversity-aware reranking framework that uses a Determinantal Point Process to balance relevance and non-redundancy. DSR introduces a query-residual diversity kernel that penalizes redundant skill overlap while reducing penalties caused only by shared query relevance. On the SkillRouter benchmark, DSR improves recall and full coverage over a strong pointwise reranking baseline, with larger gains on multi-skill queries. These results suggest that skill routing should be treated not only as relevance ranking, but also as complementary set selection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Diverse Skill Routing (DSR)框架，利用行列式点过程在技能路由中平衡相关性与非冗余性，通过查询残差多样性核减少冗余技能选择，在SkillRouter基准上显著提升多技能查询的召回率和覆盖率。
AI.motivation: LLM代理依赖外部技能时，大型技能库中的路由非常困难：功能冗余的技能浪费上下文预算，而复杂任务又需要互补的技能组合。现有的技能路由通常独立按查询相关性排序，无法有效处理技能间的冗余关系。
AI.method: 提出DSR框架，基于行列式点过程（DPP）进行多样性感知的重新排序。核心创新是引入查询残差多样性核，该核能惩罚冗余技能重叠，同时减少仅因共享查询相关性带来的惩罚。
AI.result: 在SkillRouter基准上，DSR相比强点级重排序基线提升了召回率和完整覆盖率，在多技能查询任务上取得更大增益。
AI.conclusion: 技能路由不应仅被视为相关性排序问题，而应被视为互补技能集合的选择问题，DSR验证了这一观点。

title: Minimizing the Effect of Sleep Deprivation in the Forward-Forward Algorithm
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 7 tables. Accepted at the 28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition (ICPR 2026), Lyon, France, August 17-22, 2026. This is the accepted manuscript; the Version of Record is published by Springer in Lecture Notes in Computer Science and is available online at https://doi.org/10.1007/978-3-032-31933-3_40
summary: This paper addresses the challenge posed by sleep deprivation in the Forward-Forward algorithm, where separating the two passes in this algorithm and imbalancing the data processing in the passes is considered an imitation of the cognitive processes observed in humans suffering from sleep deprivation. Previous research has demonstrated that sleep deprivation in the Forward-Forward algorithm has a catastrophic effect on learning efficacy. To mitigate this issue, we explore several approaches; these include alternative activation, optimized loss function, and threshold tuning. To simulate periodic rest, we reduce the number of positive passes in alternating epochs, creating short break phases. We additionally investigate the potential of caffeine-induced stimulation to enhance performance during sleep-deprived conditions. Experimental evaluations conducted on the MNIST and Fashion-MNIST datasets demonstrate that these modifications improve accuracy under the context of sleep deprivation. For example, a 2%-62% accuracy gain is observed in a severe sleep deprivation setting (16 positive or awake periods and 1 negative or sleep period). The approaches also enhance the resilience of the algorithm and its alignment with the adaptive mechanisms of human cognition.

AI.tldr: 本文针对Forward-Forward算法中的"睡眠剥夺"问题展开研究。在严重睡眠剥夺情境下（16个正相位清醒期：1个负相位睡眠期），通过替代激活函数、优化损失函数和阈值调参等方法，结合周期性休息模拟和咖啡因刺激机制，在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上实现了2%-62%的准确率提升，增强了算法的鲁棒性及其与人类认知适应机制的契合度。
AI.motivation: Forward-Forward算法中两个传播过程的分离与失衡模仿了人类睡眠剥夺时的认知状态。已有研究表明睡眠剥夺对算法学习效能具有灾难性影响，因此亟需寻找缓解策略来改善该情况下的学习性能。
AI.method: 提出了多种缓解方法：1) 替代激活函数；2) 优化损失函数；3) 阈值调参；4) 在交替轮次中减少正相位次数以模拟周期性休息（短休息阶段）；5) 引入"咖啡因刺激"机制以增强睡眠剥夺条件下的性能。实验在MNIST和Fashion-MNIST数据集上进行。
AI.result: 在严重睡眠剥夺设置（16个正相位或清醒期对比1个负相位或睡眠期）下，这些修改实现了2%-62%的准确率提升，证明了所提出方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法不仅提升了睡眠剥夺条件下算法的准确性，还增强了算法的韧性(resilience)，并使其更好地与人类认知的适应性机制相吻合。

title: Learning Counterfactual World Models for Embodied Reasoning under Partial Observability
summary: World models promise a general route to embodied intelligence: learn predictive dynamics once, then reason, plan, and act with them. Increasingly, the representations beneath such models are pretrained on large-scale video, interaction, and multimodal corpora, which raises a question prediction quality alone cannot answer: when is a learned representation actually actionable? We identify a failure mode we call counterfactual collapse: a model predicts visually plausible futures while failing to distinguish interventions with different behavioral consequences. This arises whenever a representation is optimized for perceptual similarity rather than intervention structure, which is precisely the objective under which most large-scale pretrained encoders are learned. We introduce Counterfactual Latent World Models (CLWM), which combine a recurrent belief-state encoder, action-conditioned latent dynamics, and a contrastive counterfactual objective that separates futures induced by distinct interventions even when their observations look alike. Across occluded manipulation, aliased navigation, and long-horizon manipulation, CLWM improves planning success over the strongest baseline (65.1% $\to$ 74.6% on Occluded Push and 67.3% $\to$ 78.9% on Aliased Maze) and reduces exploitative planning failures (18.4% $\to$ 9.7% on Deferred Kitchen), with ablations attributing the gains to hard counterfactual negatives, especially perceptual-alias negatives. Finally, our counterfactual separability metric, which tracks planning success across the five baseline model classes ($r \ge 0.94$), is representation-agnostic: given intervention-outcome labels, it can audit any encoder, pretrained or trained from scratch, before a planner trusts it. We do not yet measure it on large-scale pretrained encoders. Here we establish the metric and its relationship to planning success for world models trained from scratch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实潜在世界模型（CLWM），解决世界模型表征中"反事实崩溃"问题——模型能预测视觉上合理的未来，但无法区分具有不同行为后果的干预。通过反事实对比目标和硬反事实负样本，在多个任务上显著提升规划成功率，并提出表征无关的反事实可分离性指标用于审计编码器。
AI.motivation: 大规模预测式世界模型的表征质量无法仅通过预测精度衡量。现有预训练编码器优化基于感知相似性而非干预结构，导致模型对视觉相似但行为后果不同的干预无法区分，即反事实崩溃，限制了世界模型的可行动性。
AI.method: 提出CLWM框架，包含三部分：(1) 循环信念状态编码器；(2) 动作条件的潜在动力学；(3) 对比反事实目标，用于分离不同干预所导致的潜在未来，即使观测在视觉上看起来相似。同时引入反事实可分离性指标，通过给定的干预-结果标签审计任意编码器；通过硬反事实负样本（尤其是感知混淆负样本）训练模型。
AI.result: 在遮挡操作任务中规划成功率从65.1%提升至74.6%（Occluded Push），在多义导航任务中从67.3%提升至78.9%（Aliased Maze），在长时程操作中将利用性规划失败从18.4%降至9.7%（Deferred Kitchen）。消融实验表明增益主要来自硬反事实负样本。反事实可分离性指标与五种基线模型的规划成功率高度相关（r≥0.94）。目前仅在从零训练的世界模型上验证，尚未在大规模预训练编码器上测量。
AI.conclusion: 感知相似性优化的表征不足以支撑可行动的规划，需要引入干预结构的反事实学习。CLWM证明了反事实目标的有效性，反事实可分离性指标可作为表征可行动性的先验审计工具。未来工作需将指标扩展到大规模预训练编码器的评估。

title: Data Quality Rule Generation with LLMs
summary: The validation of data, such as customer and employee data, is an important task in many organizations. Errors in data can have severe consequences. For example, a wrong drug unit in a patient record can lead to life-threatening medication errors, and a missing street number in an address to failed deliveries. Companies often employ rule-based enterprise data quality (DQ) tools, which allow domain experts to specify rules to validate the data over time. While rule-based DQ tools are computationally efficient and provide explainable reports, maintaining a comprehensive rule set manually is challenging, as domain experts often overlook essential rules, especially in complex domains and large data volumes. Hence, closing these gaps remains an open problem in practice. In this paper, we address the challenge of automated DQ rule generation. For this, we formalize a generalizable generate-filter framework and introduce LeDQeR, an LLM-based DQ rule generation approach. First, a large language model (LLM) generates candidates rules from an observed dirty data tuple for a given rule-based DQ tool syntax. Second, we apply four filter techniques that ensure the (i) executability, (ii) correctness, and (iii) generalizability, and avoid (iv) redundancy of the generated rules. An extensive experimental evaluation suggests that LeDQeR is able to produce effective and compact rule sets for various datasets and error types.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LeDQeR，一种基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动化数据质量（DQ）规则生成方法，通过"生成-过滤"框架（generate-filter）从脏数据中自动生成高质量、可执行、通用且不冗余的DQ规则，显著降低手动维护规则集的成本。
AI.motivation: 企业中的数据验证（如客户和员工数据）至关重要，数据错误可能造成严重后果（如患者记录中用药单位错误、地址缺失门牌号等）。虽然基于规则的DQ工具计算高效且报告可解释，但手动维护全面规则集具有挑战性，领域专家在复杂领域和大数据量场景下往往遗漏关键规则，这仍是一个未解决的实践问题。
AI.method: 本文形式化了一个通用的"生成-过滤"框架，并引入LeDQeR方法。该方法分为两步：（1）利用大语言模型（LLM）根据观测到的脏数据元组，在给定基于规则的DQ工具语法下生成候选规则；（2）应用四种过滤技术，确保生成规则的（i）可执行性、（ii）正确性、（iii）通用性，并避免（iv）冗余。实验评估表明LeDQeR能为多种数据集和错误类型生成有效且紧凑的规则集。
AI.result: 广泛的实验评估结果表明，LeDQeR能够针对多种数据集和不同类型的错误生成有效且紧凑（compact）的规则集，验证了该方法在自动化DQ规则生成方面的有效性和通用性。
AI.conclusion: LeDQeR通过LLM生成与过滤技术相结合的方式，有效解决了规则式DQ工具中规则集手动维护困难的问题，能够在复杂领域和大数据量场景下自动生成高质量规则，为数据质量验证提供了实用的自动化解决方案。

title: EmoMed: An Emotionally-Aware Agent for Multimodal Medical Support with Real-Time Information Retrieval
summary: We present EmoMed - a multimodal medical consultation agent that adapts its responses based on users' emotional states while maintaining clinical accuracy. The system processes text and medical images, detects affect indicators (anxiety, confusion, urgency) from user input, and adjusts response tone, structure, and detail level accordingly. To ensure factual reliability, the agent grounds clinical information through a dual retrieval mechanism: web-based fact-checking and an API-connected, continuously updated medical knowledge base. We evaluate our approach across seven state-of-the-art language models (GPT-4/5, Qwen3, Llama 4, Gemini 2.5, Grok4, Claude3) using comprehensive metrics including LLM-as-judge assessments, MedQA style accuracy tests, BERT Score, safety/helpfulness ratings, and multimodal medical benchmarks. The results demonstrate that emotionally adaptive responses consistently outperform neutral baseline across evaluation dimensions, without compromising clinical accuracy. A controlled user study validated these findings, with participants reporting improved perceived empathy and communication clarity, while maintaining trust in factual accuracy. Source code: https://github.com/NasonovIvan/EmoMed-Agent

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EmoMed，一个多模态医疗咨询代理，它能感知用户的情绪状态（焦虑、困惑、紧迫性），并相应调整回复的语气、结构和详细程度，同时通过双检索机制（网络事实核查+持续更新的医学知识库API）确保临床准确性。在七个主流大语言模型上进行了全面评估，结果显示情绪自适应回复在各项指标上均优于中性基线，且不会损害临床准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗咨询代理虽然能够提供临床信息，但缺乏对用户情绪状态的感知和适应能力，难以在保持临床准确性的同时提供具有同理心的沟通体验，导致医患互动中的沟通障碍和用户体验不佳。
AI.method: EmoMed系统包含三个核心模块：1）多模态输入处理（文本+医学图像）；2）情绪影响检测，识别焦虑、困惑、紧迫性等情绪指标；3）根据情绪状态动态调整回复策略。为保证事实可靠性，采用双检索机制：网络事实核查与API连接的持续更新医学知识库。评估使用七种SOTA语言模型（GPT-4/5、Qwen3、Llama4、Gemini2.5、Grok4、Claude3），指标涵盖LLM-as-judge、MedQA准确率、BERT Score、安全/有用性评分及多模态医学基准测试，并开展了受控用户研究。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，情绪自适应回复在所有评估维度上均一致优于中性基线，且不影响临床准确性。用户研究进一步证实参与者感知到更高的同理心和沟通清晰度，同时保持对事实准确性的信任。
AI.conclusion: EmoMed证明了在医疗咨询场景中，情绪感知与临床准确性并非互斥，通过精心设计的多模态处理和双检索机制，可以在提升用户体验和沟通质量的同时维持医学信息的可靠性，为情感智能医疗对话系统提供了有效的实现范式。

title: AgentBrew: Offline Tool-Use Agent Learning from Raw Real-World Trajectories
