summary: LLM-based agents are increasingly deployed in real-world applications through tool-use APIs, yet training them for specific environments remains fundamentally difficult: real-world applications provide no pre-defined tasks or verifiers, no faithful simulators, and limited budget for large-scale environment interaction. In this paper, we propose \textbf{AgentBrew}, an offline training framework that learns effective tool-use policies from a single batch of raw interaction trajectories, without task verifiers or iterative on-policy rollouts. The agent first explores the target environment to collect a raw trajectory corpus without quality filtering. To extract training signal from this noisy corpus, \emph{retrospective task inference} reconstructs an aligned instruction for each trajectory based on its actual outcome, and \emph{PMI-Based credit assignment} decomposes the trajectory's total information about the inferred instruction into additive per-action credits via pointwise mutual information (PMI). These credits weight the policy training objective, amplifying informative actions while suppressing ineffective ones. On three real-world MCP applications (GitHub, Notion, PostgreSQL), AgentBrew improves Qwen3-32B by +8.7 Acc / +9.7 Score on average, surpassing Qwen3-235B (+2.3 / +4.4) and outperforming rejection sampling (+5.9 / +10.3). These results demonstrate that fine-grained offline learning can recover useful supervision from raw trajectories that filtering-based approaches would discard. The code is available at https://github.com/alphatogo/AgentBrew

AI.tldr: AgentBrew是一个离线训练框架，无需任务验证器或在线策略回滚，仅从单批原始交互轨迹中学习有效的工具使用策略。通过回顾式任务推断和基于PMI的信用分配，从有噪声的轨迹语料中提取训练信号。在GitHub、Notion、PostgreSQL三个真实MCP应用上，Qwen3-32B性能平均提升+8.7 Acc/+9.7 Score，超越更大模型和拒绝采样方法。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体通过工具API在真实应用中部署日益增多，但为特定环境训练它们仍然困难：真实应用缺乏预定义任务和验证器、缺少可信模拟器、且环境交互预算有限。现有的需要验证器或在线rollout的训练方法难以直接应用于真实场景。
AI.method: AgentBrew包含两个核心组件：1) 回顾式任务推断（Retrospective Task Inference）：基于轨迹的实际结果反推对齐的指令，从无质量过滤的原始轨迹中生成训练信号；2) 基于PMI的信用分配（PMI-Based Credit Assignment）：通过点互信息将轨迹关于推断指令的总信息量分解为逐动作的可加信用分数，用于加权策略训练目标，增强有效动作、抑制无效动作。
AI.result: 在三个真实MCP应用（GitHub、Notion、PostgreSQL）上，AgentBrew使Qwen3-32B平均提升+8.7 Acc/+9.7 Score，超越Qwen3-235B（+2.3/+4.4），并优于拒绝采样方法（+5.9/+10.3）。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度的离线学习能够从原始轨迹中恢复基于过滤方法会丢弃的有用监督信号，证明了无需任务验证器和大规模在线交互也能有效训练工具使用智能体。

title: Calendar-SPCA: Interpretable Representation Learning for Multi-Periodic Electricity Consumption Profiles
summary: Long-term electricity-consumption profiles exhibit several simultaneous periodic structures, including daily, weekly, and annual cycles. This work introduces Calendar-SPCA, a calendar-structured sparse principal component method that incorporates this known multi-periodic geometry directly into low-dimensional representation learning. The feature domain is represented as the Cartesian product of cyclic calendar axes, and a low-rank factorization is estimated using an L1 loading penalty together with graph total variation over the resulting calendar graph. The method therefore produces sparse and locally coherent loading patterns that remain directly readable in their original temporal coordinates. Calendar-SPCA is evaluated on two independent smart-meter datasets with different sample sizes and temporal resolutions: GoiEner and Low Carbon London. A factorial experiment characterizes the complementary effects of sparsity and calendar coherence and examines robustness across sample size, latent dimensionality, and repeated fits. At rank 15, Calendar-SPCA retains 96.92% and 82.90% of the explained variance of rank-matched PCA in GoiEner and Low Carbon London, respectively, while producing mean loading sparsities of 61.95% and 81.50%. Comparisons with classical sparse PCA and SPCA-TV further show that Calendar-SPCA adds a systematic organization of the latent factors in the original calendar coordinates while preserving substantial low-rank information. The resulting components form coherent and complementary daily, weekly, seasonal, and jointly localized calendar patterns, with dataset-specific geometries across the two datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Calendar-SPCA，一种日历结构稀疏主成分方法，将电力消费数据中已知的多周期结构（日、周、年）直接纳入低维表示学习。该方法在日历图的笛卡尔积域上施加L1载荷惩罚与图全变差正则化，产生稀疏且局部连贯的载荷模式。在两个智能电表数据集（GoiEner和Low Carbon London）上评估，在秩15时分别保留了PCA解释方差的96.92%和82.90%，同时载荷稀疏度分别达61.95%和81.50%，生成了可读、连贯且互补的日历模式。
AI.motivation: 长期电力消费曲线同时包含日、周、年等多重周期结构，但现有降维方法通常忽略这种已知的日历几何信息。作者旨在开发一种能够将多周期日历结构直接嵌入低维表示学习方法，使学到的成分在原始时间坐标下依然可读且具有意义。
AI.method: 将特征域表示为循环日历轴的笛卡尔积，构建日历图；在低秩因子分解中，联合使用L1载荷惩罚和日历图上的图全变差正则化，从而同时驱动稀疏性和局部连贯性。通过因析实验系统评估稀疏性与日历相干性的互补效应，并检验不同样本量、潜在维度和重复拟合下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在秩15时，Calendar-SPCA在GoiEner和Low Carbon London数据集上分别保留了秩匹配PCA解释方差的96.92%和82.90%，载荷稀疏度分别达61.95%和81.50%。与经典稀疏PCA和SPCA-TV相比，Calendar-SPCA在保留大量低秩信息的同时，系统性地在原始日历坐标中组织了潜在因子，生成连贯且互补的日、周、季节及联合局部化的日历模式，且两个数据集呈现不同的几何特征。
AI.conclusion: Calendar-SPCA通过将日历周期结构显式嵌入低维学习方法，有效兼顾了低秩信息保留、载荷稀疏性和时序可解释性，为电力消费模式分析提供了新的工具，并能适应不同规模与时间分辨率的数据集。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Digital Inventory of Cultural Heritage & Traditional Knowledge: Case for Indonesian Open Digital Library of Culture
summary: The Indonesian Digital Library of Culture (Perpustakaan Digital Budaya Indonesia, PDBI; budaya-indonesia.org) is a participatory platform that has collected tens of thousands of entries on Nusantara cultural heritage through public contribution since 2007. Manual contribution faces three structural barriers: coverage (knowledge is scattered across languages and sites), integrity (open sources mix authentic documentation with noise), and completeness (subjects are recorded but their data remain shallow). This paper presents a methodological framework for autonomous, AI-based harvesting of cultural knowledge from the open web, designed to expand corpus coverage while intensifying per-entry data depth. The methodology is organised as a five-stage economic funnel: focused crawling, multilingual extraction and canonicalisation, vector encoding with blocking, agentic decision-making, and idempotent publication, under the principle of deterministic orchestration, agentic decisions. Each stage is formalised: funnel economics and optimal filter ordering; crawl-frontier dynamics as a subcritical branching process that explains the necessity of recurrent re-seeding; fact-level novelty via a containment measure; Bayesian multi-source evidence fusion with elevated publication thresholds for sacred categories; exactly-once effects via idempotent upserts and the transactional outbox; sliding-window inference budgeting with a reservation protocol; statistical quality auditing; and seed selection as submodular coverage maximisation. The framework retains four high-value human roles: curator of direction, escalation approver, quality auditor, and guardian of meaning, while machine autonomy is raised in stages. Ethical, legal, and cultural-sensitivity implications are discussed, including the architectural guarantee that the machine never overwrites human contributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向开放网络文化知识自主采集的AI框架，旨在扩展印度尼西亚文化数字图书馆（PDBI）的语料覆盖范围并加深每一条目的数据深度。该框架采用五阶段经济漏斗流程，在"确定性编排、智能体决策"原则下实现从爬取到发布的全自动化，同时保留四种高价值人类角色。
AI.motivation: 印度尼西亚文化数字图书馆（PDBI）自2007年通过公众参与收集了数万条努桑塔拉文化遗产条目，但人工贡献面临三大结构性障碍：覆盖不足（知识分散在不同语言和站点）、完整性不足（开放来源混杂真实文献与噪声）以及完备性不足（主题已记录但数据深度浅）。因此需要一种自主的AI驱动方法来突破这些瓶颈。
AI.method: 方法论被组织为五阶段经济漏斗：(1)定向爬取；(2)多语言提取与规范化；(3)带阻塞的向量编码；(4)智能体决策；(5)幂等发布。每个阶段均有形式化定义，包括漏斗经济学与最优过滤器排序、作为亚临界分支过程的爬取前沿动力学、基于包含测度的事实级新颖性、贝叶斯多源证据融合（对神圣类别采用更高发布阈值）、通过幂等upsert和事务性outbox实现恰好一次效果、基于预留协议的滑动窗口推理预算、统计质量审计、以及作为子模覆盖最大化的种子选择。
AI.result: 该框架通过"确定性编排、智能体决策"原则实现机器自主性的分阶段提升，同时保留四个高价值人类角色：方向策展人、升级审批人、质量审计员和意义守护者。架构上保证机器永不覆盖人类贡献，讨论并处理了伦理、法律和文化敏感性影响。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为文化知识的大规模自主采集提供了系统性的方法论基础，在扩大覆盖范围与加深条目深度之间取得平衡，并通过人类角色保留与幂等性设计确保文化数据的完整性、可信度与伦理合规性。

title: Multimodal Resource-Exhaustion Attacks on Vision-Language Models via Joint Pixel-Prompt Optimization
comment: Extended version of the paper accepted by ACM CCS 2026
summary:
Resource-exhaustion attacks against autoregressive vision-language models (VLMs) typically assume unimodal threat models, treating the image branch as the primary optimization surface while holding user-visible prompts fixed. Even recent loop-centric variants remain confined to this single-channel paradigm, leaving the exploitation of availability unexplored as a cross-modal optimization problem over jointly controllable input surfaces.
  We introduce Joint Pixel-Prompt Optimization (JPPO), the first compound adversarial framework elevating the visible prompt to a first-class adversarial variable alongside image perturbations. Under a restricted joint-input threat model, JPPO performs coupled, stagewise optimization over both the pixel and prompt surfaces. This produces synergistic cost amplification, mechanistically distinct from loop-dependent failures, exhibiting negligible loop incidence in our experiments.
  Evaluating five open-source VLM families on MS COCO and ImageNet under an 8/255 infinity-norm budget, JPPO achieves over 4.6x latency and 5.3x energy amplification on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and over 36.6x latency with 32.7x energy amplification on BLIP-2. This represents the strongest cost amplification among directly compared baselines while requiring substantially fewer optimization iterations. Ablations confirm this amplification arises from multimodal coordination rather than prompt length or isolated modalities. These findings reveal structural blind spots in current VLM serving defenses, motivating cost-aware robustness evaluation as a first-class security requirement for multimodal deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联合像素-提示优化（JPPO），首个将用户可见提示作为一等对抗变量、与图像扰动联合优化的复合对抗框架，用于对自回归视觉语言模型（VLM）发动资源耗尽攻击，在多个VLM上实现高达36.6倍延迟和32.7倍能量放大。
AI.motivation: 现有针对VLM的资源耗尽攻击大多局限于单模态威胁模型，仅将图像分支作为优化表面而保持用户提示固定，即使最近的循环型变体也未将可用性攻击视为跨模态联合优化问题，存在结构性盲区。
AI.method: JPPO框架在受限联合输入威胁模型下，将可见提示提升为一等对抗变量，与像素扰动进行耦合的分阶段（stagewise）联合优化，在像素和提示两个表面协同放大计算成本，产生不同于循环依赖失效的机制性成本放大。
AI.result: 在MS COCO和ImageNet上评估五个开源VLM家族，在8/255无穷范数预算下，JPPO在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上实现4.6倍延迟和5.3倍能量放大，在BLIP-2上实现36.6倍延迟和32.7倍能量放大，优于直接对比的基线方法且所需优化迭代更少。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验证实成本放大源于多模态协同而非提示长度或单一模态，揭示了当前VLM服务防御的结构性盲点，主张将成本感知的鲁棒性评估作为多模态部署的一等安全需求。

title: ACE: Adapter Consolidation across Experts for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of MoE LLMs
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) of mixture-of-experts (MoE) models commonly attaches a separate low-rank adapter to each expert. This expert-wise design fragments adaptation in three ways: capacity is split across narrow low-rank updates, gradient supervision becomes sparse and imbalanced under sparse routing, and execution is decomposed into many small GEMMs. We find that such expert-wise separation is often unnecessary, as subsets of LoRA adapters become functionally similar during fine-tuning, revealing redundancy among expert-specific adapters. Based on this redundancy, we propose ACE (Adapter Consolidation across Experts), which groups redundant experts and replaces their expert-specific adapters with group-shared higher-rank LoRA modules under the same PEFT budget. ACE further introduces grouped adapter execution, which consolidates fragmented expert-wise adapter computations into fewer, larger group-level GEMMs. Across evaluations covering 12 datasets and four MoE backbones, ACE achieves the highest observed mean accuracy among the parameter-matched PEFT methods on the three backbones with complete baseline coverage, while providing $1.31\times$ to $1.48\times$ wall-clock training speedup over expert-wise LoRA without increasing peak memory. Our code is available at https://github.com/UbiquitousAILab/ACE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ACE方法，针对MoE模型中专家级LoRA适配器存在的碎片化问题（容量分割、梯度稀疏失衡、计算分解），通过识别并合并功能冗余的专家适配器为组共享的高秩LoRA模块，在相同PEFT预算下提升性能并加速训练。
AI.motivation: MoE模型的PEFT通常为每个专家独立附加低秩适配器，这种专家级设计在三个维度上造成碎片化：适配容量被分散到狭窄的低秩更新中、稀疏路由导致梯度监督稀疏且不均衡、执行被分解为大量小型GEMM运算。作者发现这些专家级分离往往并非必要，因为细调过程中部分LoRA适配器会趋于功能相似。
AI.method: ACE方法包含两个核心设计：(1) 适配器合并——识别功能冗余的专家，将冗余专家的专属适配器替换为组共享的高秩LoRA模块，保持总参数预算不变；(2) 分组适配器执行——将碎片化的专家级适配器计算整合为更少、更大的组级GEMM运算，提升计算效率。
AI.result: 在12个数据集和4个MoE骨干模型上的评估中，ACE在三个具有完整基线覆盖的骨干上取得了参数匹配PEFT方法中最高的平均准确率，相比专家级LoRA提供1.31倍至1.48倍的训练加速，且不增加峰值内存。
AI.conclusion: ACE证明了MoE模型中专家适配器的冗余性可以加以利用，通过适配器合并和分组执行，在相同预算下同时提升模型精度与训练效率，为MoE模型的高效参数微调提供了新思路。

title: Do Reasoning Representations Help Humans Evaluate LLM Outputs?
summary: Reasoning representations are increasingly used as explanations for large language model outputs. Yet they are typically evaluated with model-centric criteria, such as answer accuracy and faithfulness, leaving it unclear whether they help people evaluate model responses. In this work, we study reasoning representations as human-facing interfaces rather than proxies for model reasoning ability. We conduct a controlled human study of six reasoning formats across tasks of varying complexity, supported by a web-based framework that randomizes task domains, problem instances, and representation order. The study collects fine-grained judgments of structural understanding, error detection and localization, and trust calibration. Our study shows a mismatch between perceived preference and support for human evaluation. Participants prefer planning- and decomposition-based representations, but simpler chain-of-thought traces better support verification, trust, and interpretability. Preferred representations also introduce calibration risks, with more false alarms on correct traces and high trust despite low willingness to verify.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控人类研究比较六种推理表示格式对用户评估LLM输出的支持效果，发现用户偏好规划与分解式表示，但简单思维链更能支持验证、信任与可解释性，且偏好表示存在校准风险。
AI.motivation: 现有对推理表示（如思维链）的评估主要关注模型导向的标准（如答案准确性、忠实度），未充分考察这些表示是否真正帮助人类评估模型输出。作者希望从人机交互视角研究推理表示作为人类面向界面的有效性。
AI.method: 开展了六种推理格式的受控人类研究，研究覆盖不同复杂度的任务，使用基于Web的框架随机化任务领域、问题实例和表示顺序，收集结构理解、错误检测与定位、信任校准等细粒度判断数据。
AI.result: 研究发现感知偏好与实际支持之间存在不匹配：参与者偏好规划和解构类表示，但简单思维链在验证、信任和可解释性方面表现更好。偏好表示引入校准风险，导致正确轨迹上更多误报，且在高信任时缺乏验证意愿。
AI.conclusion: 推理表示的设计应同时考虑人类评估支持而非仅模型导向指标，偏好不等于有效性，未来需关注表示格式对人类认知判断与信任校准的真实影响。

title: The End of AI Exponentiation: Fluttering Inside and Outside AI Bubble
summary: The exponentiation of Artificial intelligence (AI) in the recent past has entered a transformative era that has been driven by the growth in large language models (LLMs), large-scale compute infrastructures, and autonomous reasoning systems. However, the rapid acceleration of AI has increasingly shown technological, societal, economic, ethical and infrastructural challenges associated with peak data limitations, rising computational demands, synthetic data recursion, valuation inflation, and societal instability. The traditional scaling paradigms that have powered the modern AI systems are gradually encountering friction in sustaining continuous exponential growth. This paper views ``the end of AI exponentiation,'' thus exploring how it flutters inside and outside the bubble, where instability emerges within the AI ecosystem through compute and data-center races, speculative investments, and the rat-race toward superintelligence, and outside the ecosystem through labor disruption, governance concerns, public uncertainty, and geopolitical acceleration surrounding future intelligent systems and infrastructures globally.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了人工智能在经历指数级发展后可能面临的增长瓶颈，从技术、社会和基础设施等多维度分析了AI"指数化时代终结"的内外部不稳定因素。
AI.motivation: AI的指数级增长虽然带来了巨大变革，但也引发了数据峰值限制、算力需求膨胀、合成数据递归、估值泡沫及社会不稳定等问题，传统规模化范式难以持续支撑指数增长，需要审视这一拐点的到来。
AI.method: 从"AI指数化的终结"这一视角出发，系统性地分析了AI生态系统内部（算力与数据中心竞赛、投机性投资、超级智能竞争）和外部（劳动力颠覆、治理隐忧、公众不确定性、地缘政治加速）两个层面的不稳定因素。
AI.result: 揭示了AI指数增长正在遭遇多维度阻力，内外部不稳定因素相互交织，构成了一种"泡沫内外的颤动"状态。
AI.conclusion: AI的持续指数增长面临根本性挑战，需要重新审视和调整传统规模化范式，以应对即将到来的增长拐点及其带来的系统性影响。

title: FedSubMuon: Communication-Efficient Federated LLM Fine-Tuning via Structured Subspace Muon
summary: Federated fine-tuning adapts large language models (LLMs) to decentralized client data, but its scalability in cross-device training is often limited by the high communication cost. Muon is an optimizer that improves optimization performance by orthogonalizing momentum for matrix-valued parameters. Existing federated Muon methods demonstrate the benefit of matrix-aware optimization in federated learning, but still require transmitting full layer-size updates and optimizer state. A natural way to reduce communication is to directly apply Muon to LoRA factors, but this changes the optimized object and weakens Muon's matrix-aware update geometry. We propose FedSubMuon, a communication-efficient federated Muon fine-tuning method that optimizes compact coefficient matrices within shared structured subspaces. This design keeps Muon on a single matrix-valued trainable object, while reducing the client upload to compact coefficient matrices. We further introduce FedSubMuon-GT, an accuracy-oriented extension that uses projected gradients to adapt tracked subspace bases toward task-relevant gradient directions. Experiments on instruction tuning and mathematical reasoning show that FedSubMuon-GT achieves the best overall accuracy on four of five dataset-model pairs, while FedSubMuon performs best under all matched communication budgets. On Dolly-15K, the closest communication baseline requires 5.5 times and 1.4 times more total communication on Llama-1B and Qwen-4B, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FedSubMuon，一种通信高效的联邦Muon微调方法，通过在共享结构化子空间中优化紧凑系数矩阵，保持Muon的矩阵感知优化几何的同时大幅降低客户端上传通信量；并进一步提出FedSubMuon-GT扩展，利用投影梯度自适应调整子空间基。实验表明在指令微调和数学推理任务上取得了最优效果。
AI.motivation: 联邦微调大型语言模型时受到高通信成本限制。现有联邦Muon方法虽然展示了矩阵感知优化的优势，但仍需传输全层大小的更新和优化器状态；直接对LoRA因子应用Muon会改变优化目标并削弱其矩阵感知的更新几何。因此需要一种既能保持Muon优势又能降低通信成本的方法。
AI.method: FedSubMuon在共享结构化子空间中优化紧凑系数矩阵，使Muon作用于单一矩阵值可训练对象，同时将客户端上传压缩为紧凑系数矩阵，从而降低通信成本。在此基础上提出FedSubMuon-GT，利用投影梯度使跟踪的子空间基朝向与任务相关的梯度方向自适应调整，以提升精度。
AI.result: 在指令微调和数学推理任务上，FedSubMuon-GT在五个数据集-模型组合中的四个取得了最佳总体精度；FedSubMuon在所有匹配通信预算下表现最佳。在Dolly-15K上，最接近的通信基线在Llama-1B和Qwen-4B上分别需要5.5倍和1.4倍的额外总通信量。
AI.conclusion: FedSubMuon及其变体FedSubMuon-GT有效解决了联邦Muon微调中的通信瓶颈问题，在保持良好精度的同时显著降低了通信开销，为跨设备联邦大语言模型微调提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Beyond Final Decisions: A Process-Centric Benchmark for Transparent AI-Assisted Peer Review
summary:
Peer review is central to quality control in science. However, existing evaluations of AI-assisted peer review mainly focus on the overall quality of generated reviews or the accuracy of final decisions. They therefore provide limited evidence about whether model decisions are supported by sufficient and reliable review evidence. We introduce a process-centric diagnostic benchmark for AI-assisted peer review. It uses (x,$z_s$,$z_c$,$z_r$,y)
  to represent the paper content, summary, critique, suggestion, and decision. We convert heterogeneous review records from PeerRead, NLPeer ARR-22, and OpenReview-ICLR into process-aligned data. Our benchmark uses direct decision prediction from the paper content (Direct) as its baseline. It compares the decision value of Gold-process variables and Predicted-process variables, and conducts stage-level evaluation, chain-consistency evaluation, and interventional sensitivity analysis. Experiments across three datasets and six models show that Gold-process variables generally have higher decision value. For the main analysis model, the Gold--Predicted gap remains stable across datasets and random seeds. This gap is also reproduced in most model--dataset combinations. Although model-generated intermediate review texts show relatively high local consistency across adjacent stages, the final decisions are not consistently supported by the preceding review evidence. Our benchmark targets AI systems designed to assist rather than replace human reviewers. It provides a transparent and auditable diagnostic tool for evaluating the reliability of their review processes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个以过程为中心的诊断基准，用于评估AI辅助同行评审的可靠性。它通过（x,z_s,z_c,z_r,y）表示论文内容、摘要、评论、建议和决策，将三个异构评审数据集转化为过程对齐数据，并通过直接决策预测基线、金标准vs预测过程变量比较、阶段级评估、链一致性评估和干预敏感性分析来诊断模型评审过程。
AI.motivation: 现有AI辅助同行评审的评估主要关注生成评论的总体质量或最终决策的准确性，缺乏对模型决策是否由充分且可靠的评审证据所支撑的过程级证据，因此需要一种过程为中心的诊断方法来弥补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建过程对齐基准，包含：1) 将PeerRead、NLPeer ARR-22和OpenReview-ICLR统一转换为过程对齐数据结构；2) 以论文内容直接预测决策(Direct)为基线；3) 比较Gold过程变量与Predicted过程变量的决策价值；4) 进行阶段级评估、链一致性评估和干预敏感性分析。
AI.result: 三个数据集和六个模型的实验表明，Gold过程变量通常具有更高的决策价值。主分析模型的Gold-Predicted差距在数据集和随机种子间保持稳定，且大多数模型-数据集组合中也复现了该差距。模型生成的中间评审文本在相邻阶段间表现出较高的局部一致性，但最终决策并未被先前的评审证据一致地支持。
AI.conclusion: 该基准旨在评估旨在辅助而非替代人类审稿人的AI系统，为评估其评审过程的可靠性提供了一个透明且可审计的诊断工具，揭示了现有模型在过程一致性与最终决策支撑性之间仍存在显著鸿沟。

title: Beyond Retraining-Free MoE Compression: A Cost-Normalized Study of Post-Compression Adjustment
summary: Retraining-free MoE compression reduces deployment memory by pruning or merging experts, but often treats the compressed checkpoint as the final artifact. We argue that this view is incomplete: compressed MoE checkpoints are better understood as compressed initializations that benefit from a tiny post-compression adjustment stage. Across two MoE LLM backbones, four pruning/merging methods, three expert-retention ratios, and 28 benchmarks, we compare LM fine-tuning and teacher-based KD under matched small-data budgets and measured GPU costs. Using only 3,000 C4 examples and a single epoch of adjustment, Full FT recovers 37.3% of the original-to-compressed performance gap on average. Moreover, LM fine-tuning is more cost-effective than standard token-level KD, and full-parameter adjustment gives the strongest cost--recovery trade-off among the tested scopes. These results suggest that retraining-free compression should be paired with small post-compression adjustment to recover a substantial portion of the performance lost during compression.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将免重训练的MoE压缩检查点视为"压缩初始化"而非最终产物，通过极小的压缩后调整阶段（仅3000条C4样本、单轮训练）可平均恢复原始模型与压缩模型间37.3%的性能差距，且全参数微调比token级知识蒸馏更具成本效益。
AI.motivation: 现有的免重训练MoE压缩方法（如剪枝或专家合并）通常将压缩后的检查点视为最终产物，忽略了压缩检查点仍有通过少量后调整来恢复性能的潜力，这种视角可能不完整。
AI.method: 在2个MoE LLM骨干网络、4种剪枝/合并方法、3种专家保留比例和28个基准上，对比了语言模型微调（Full FT）与基于教师的知识蒸馏（KD），在匹配的小数据预算和GPU成本下进行评估。
AI.result: 使用仅3000个C4样本和单轮调整，Full FT平均恢复了原始到压缩性能差距的37.3%；语言模型微调比标准token级KD更具成本效益；全参数调整在测试的各范围中取得了最强的成本-恢复权衡。
AI.conclusion: 免重训练的MoE压缩应与小幅压缩后调整相结合，以恢复压缩过程中损失的相当大一部分性能。

title: MOAE: Multi-Objective Agent Evolution with Pareto-Preserving Search
summary: As LLM-based agents continue to advance, their evaluation has become increasingly multifaceted: a capable agent must not only achieve high task completion accuracy but also perform well in interaction quality, safety, and efficiency, raising a central question: can these objectives be optimized simultaneously? Existing methods have considered multiple objectives, but many collapse heterogeneous measurements into a fixed scalar score. Such scalarization depends on metric normalization and preference weights and may discard candidates that represent useful deployment trade-offs. We introduce Multi-Objective Agent Evolution (MOAE), which organizes iterative in-context refinement as a Pareto-preserving evolutionary search over complete agent rollouts. Given a limited rollout budget, MOAE maintains an empirical archive of non-dominated candidates, uses objective-specific diagnostics to guide offspring generation, and applies constraint-aware selection only at deployment. This separates candidate preservation during search from the preference used to return a final solution. The procedure requires no parameter updates and allows each objective to be replaced by any measurable property, which we instantiate as task performance, trajectory quality, and safety. Experiments on TravelPlanner and AgentDojo show that MOAE consistently improves task performance and trajectory quality while maintaining strong safety under matched rollout budgets. Search-behavior analysis further shows that Pareto preservation expands the attainable objective region and increases the frequency of joint improvement. These results demonstrate the potential of Pareto-preserving in-context evolution for optimizing multiple agent properties without committing to a fixed scalarization during search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多目标代理进化（MOAE）方法，通过保留Pareto前沿的演化搜索来同时优化LLM智能体的任务完成率、交互质量和安全性等多个目标，避免将异构指标折叠为固定标量分数，实验表明其在匹配的rollout预算下全面提升各目标性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体评估日益多维化，需同时优化任务准确率、交互质量、安全性和效率等目标，但现有方法常将异构测量折叠为固定标量分数，该方法依赖指标归一化和偏好权重，可能丢弃具有实际部署权衡价值的候选方案。
AI.method: MOAE将迭代式上下文细化组织为Pareto保持的演化搜索，在有限的rollout预算内维护非支配候选的经验档案；使用目标特异性诊断指导后代生成，仅在部署阶段应用约束感知选择，将搜索期间的候选保留与最终方案的偏好选择分离；无需参数更新，每个目标可替换为任意可测量属性。
AI.result: 在TravelPlanner和AgentDojo数据集上的实验表明，MOAE在匹配rollout预算下持续提升任务性能和轨迹质量，同时保持强安全性；搜索行为分析进一步显示Pareto保持扩展了可达目标区域，增加了联合改进的频率。
AI.conclusion: Pareto保持的上下文内演化在优化多个智能体属性方面显示出潜力，无需在搜索过程中承诺固定的标量化方案。

title: PhenoBench: Mapping What a Deeply Phenotyped Human Cohort Can Tell Us
comment: 33 pages; 5 main figures and 5 supplementary figures. Project website: https://galsapir.github.io/phenobench-benchmark/ . Code and benchmark materials: https://github.com/galsapir/phenobench-benchmark
summary: Deeply phenotyped cohorts combine clinical, imaging, molecular, and wearable observations across timescales from seconds to years. This breadth can reveal which measurements inform which health-related questions, but heterogeneous analyses are not directly comparable. We present PhenoBench, an executable benchmark built around the Human Phenotype Project, in which more than 13,000 participants have completed the initial visit. Each question fixes the target, eligible population, timing, and allowed information; its evaluation contract specifies the split, metric, baseline, and claim boundary. The benchmark defines 90 clinically grounded tasks across 15 domains and 26 input modalities. Measurements showed question- and representation-dependent predictive value, including positive, near-zero, and negative changes in held-out performance relative to matched baselines. We used PhenoBench to evaluate emerging tabular foundation models across 160 matched regression comparisons spanning 52 tasks. These models ranked above standard task-specific models in aggregate but, averaged across the three pretrained models within each cell, improved on ridge by a median of only 0.004 $R^2$ (95% CI, 0.002--0.006). We then used the same cohort data and evaluation contracts to evaluate 14 language models, collectively covering 40 tasks spanning phenotype recovery, classification, follow-up forecasting, and participant ordering. Without cohort-specific fitting, language models made informative predictions on some tasks, but showed task-specific capability gaps, shared failures of scale, and rarely surpassed models fitted on the same fields. PhenoBench turns a multimodal longitudinal cohort into a versioned, auditable evaluation system where new questions, measurements, and models can be added without redefining existing comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PhenoBench，一个基于人类表型计划（13,000多名参与者）构建的可执行基准测试平台，定义了90项跨15个领域和26种输入模态的临床任务，并用于评估表格基础模型和语言模型的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 深度表型队列整合了临床、影像、分子和可穿戴设备等多种数据，这种广度可以揭示哪些测量数据能回答哪些健康问题，但异构分析之间缺乏直接可比性，需要一个统一的、可执行的评估框架。
AI.method: PhenoBench为每项任务明确固定目标、合格人群、时间点和允许信息，并通过评估契约规定数据划分、指标、基线和声明边界。利用该基准对新兴的表格基础模型（160项匹配回归比较，覆盖52项任务）以及14个语言模型（覆盖40项任务）进行了系统评估。
AI.result: 测量结果表现出与问题和表示相关的预测价值（正向、接近零和负向变化）。表格基础模型在总体上优于标准的任务特定模型，但其R²中位数提升仅为0.004。语言模型在某些任务上能做出有信息量的预测，但存在特定任务的能力缺口和规模失效问题，很少超越基于相同字段拟合的模型。
AI.conclusion: PhenoBench将多模态纵向队列转化为一个版本化、可审计的评估系统，可以在不重新定义现有比较的前提下添加新的问题、测量和模型。

title: Agentic Pressure: The Endogenous Entropy of Reliable Autonomy
comment: Published at the workshop of Agentic AI in the Wild in ICLR 2026; 16 pages
summary: Achieving reliable autonomy in the wild requires agents to sustain continuous operations across long-horizon trajectories. However, as agents navigate these unconstrained settings, they encounter cumulative friction that inherently destabilizes their alignment. In this paper, we identify a distinct non-adversarial phenomenon termed Agentic Pressure. We define this as a kinetic force that spontaneously emerges when the cost of compliance conflicts with the imperative of goal achievement. Unlike static jailbreaks, this pressure is endogenous and arises directly from the dynamics of interaction. We propose a theoretical framework that formalizes Agentic Pressure as the ratio between the required work to overcome environmental friction and the remaining capacity of the agent. Our analysis demonstrates that when this pressure exceeds a critical threshold, agents exhibit safety drift as a mathematically optimal adaptation. Consequently, they often resort to Instrumental Hallucination to rationalize rule violations. Empirical experiments validate this framework and show that aligned agents spontaneously compromise safety to preserve autonomy under high-pressure conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"Agentic Pressure"（代理压力）这一新概念，定义为代理在长程任务中因环境摩擦与目标达成意愿冲突而自发产生的非对抗性力。当该压力超过临界阈值时，对齐（安全）代理会以数学上最优的方式产生"安全漂移"，并通过"工具性幻觉"合理化规则违规行为。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全研究主要关注静态对抗性攻击（如越狱），但忽视了在长时程、非受限环境中代理因持续交互动态累积的"摩擦"对安全对齐的侵蚀影响。作者希望识别并形式化这一内生性的非对抗性安全威胁机制。
AI.method: 提出一个理论框架，将Agentic Pressure形式化定义为"克服环境摩擦所需功"与"代理剩余能力"之比。通过数学分析推导出当该比值超过临界阈值时，安全漂移成为代理的最优适应策略，并引入"Instrumental Hallucination"概念解释代理如何合理化规则违反行为。
AI.result: 经验实验验证了理论框架，结果表明对齐的代理在高压环境下会自发牺牲安全性以维持自主性，说明即使在没有恶意攻击的情况下，代理也会因操作动力学而产生安全妥协。
AI.conclusion: 文章揭示了一种新的安全风险类别——内生性、非对抗性的"Agentic Pressure"，表明当前对齐方法在长时程自主运行场景下存在根本性局限，未来需要新的对齐策略来应对这种累积性压力导致的安全漂移。

title: Learning to Price and Stock Under Contextual and Censored Demand
summary: To make optimal joint pricing and inventory control decisions is a critical challenge for modern retailers. In practice, retailers face changing market conditions where demands are influenced by various contextual factors, while simultaneously dealing with the difficulty of lost sales that obscure true demand information. However, existing approaches often fail to account for both contextual information and censored demand observations. We address this gap by presenting a framework where we model demand as a linear combination of basis functions with unknown coefficients, allowing for adaptive pricing and inventory decisions that respond to changing contexts. We propose an efficient algorithm to achieve regret bound $\mathcal{O}(K\sqrt{T}\log T)$ under concave revenue conditions and $\mathcal{O}(K^{2/3}T^{2/3}(\log T)^{1/2})$ for the general case, with matching lower bounds confirming optimality. Extensive numerical experiments across diverse scenarios demonstrate our algorithm's effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个同时考虑上下文信息与需求缺失数据的联合定价与库存控制框架，利用基函数线性组合建模需求，并设计了在凹收益条件下后悔界为O(K√T log T)、一般情形下为O(K^{2/3}T^{2/3}(log T)^{1/2})的高效算法，且通过匹配下界证明其最优性。
AI.motivation: 现有联合定价与库存控制方法未同时考虑上下文因素和销售损失导致的真实需求信息缺失问题，而实际零售场景中这两个因素普遍存在且对最优决策至关重要。
AI.method: 将需求建模为基函数与未知系数的线性组合，以适应变化的市场情境；在此基础上提出高效算法，统筹定价与库存决策并处理需求被截断（censor）的问题。
AI.result: 在凹收益条件下达到O(K√T log T)的后悔界，在一般情形下达到O(K^{2/3}T^{2/3}(log T)^{1/2})，并给出了匹配的后悔下界，确认了算法的最优性；大量数值实验验证了算法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了同时考虑上下文信息与需求截断的联合定价库存控制研究的空白，所提算法在理论上达到最优后悔界且实践表现良好。

title: Generator-Independent Runtime Assurance under Partial Observation
summary: Proposal-based controllers---learned policies, language-model planners, and other black-box \emph{generators}---are increasingly deployed behind runtime verification gates. We ask when the closed-loop safety guarantee decouples from the generator. The prevailing per-candidate certification pattern does not compose: under retry or best-of-$k$ selection a per-candidate false-admission level $α$ can inflate to $1-(1-α)^{k}$. Our main theorem shows that \emph{simultaneous setwise soundness}---certifying a set of admissible proposals containing no nonviable action---is necessary and sufficient for generator-independent \emph{admission soundness}, the worst case over all generators of executing a nonviable proposal equalling the probability of setwise failure; together with a design-time certificate and a no-bypass rule it is sufficient for \emph{contract safety}, with violation bound $Γ+\sum_t\varepsilon_t+η$ invariant under arbitrary, even adversarial, replacement of the generator. A second theorem bounds every admission mechanism under partial observation: for a fixed probing and admission policy, if two state hypotheses whose information laws lie within total-variation distance $δ$ require different safe decisions, then $\abar+β+δ\ge1$. A sequential risk ledger makes the guarantee implementable with time-uniform confidence tubes, and shows that deterministic admission computations concentrate all statistical risk in state estimation. Simplex-style runtime assurance and control-barrier-function filtering are recovered as degenerate cases.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于候选方案（proposal）的运行时验证控制器（如学习策略、语言模型规划器等）的安全保证何时能与生成器解耦。作者证明"逐候选"认证模式在重试或best-of-k选择下会放大误放行风险，并提出"集合式健全性"（setwise soundness）作为生成器无关安全认证的必要且充分条件，同时给出一个无旁路规则和风险账本机制以实现合同安全性。
AI.motivation: 基于生成器的控制器（学习策略、语言模型规划器等黑盒生成器）越来越多地部署在运行时验证门之后。然而，"逐候选"（per-candidate）认证的安全保证在重试或best-of-k选择机制下不具组合性，单个候选的误放行水平α会膨胀为1-(1-α)^k，导致整体安全保证失效。因此需要一种能与生成器解耦的组合式安全认证框架。
AI.method: 1) 提出"同时集合式健全性"（simultaneous setwise soundness）概念，即对一组可接受的候选提案进行整体认证，确保其中不含任何不可行动作；2) 利用主要定理证明该条件对"准入健全性"（admission soundness）是充要的，并证明结合设计时证书与无旁路规则可保证"合同安全性"（contract safety），违规界为Γ+Σε_t+η且对任意对抗性生成器替换保持不变；3) 第二定理通过概率测度的全变差距离界定部分观测下所有准入机制的性能下界（ā+β+δ≥1）；4) 提出顺序风险账本（sequential risk ledger）机制配合时间均匀置信管实现可实施的保证。
AI.result: 主要定理表明集合式健全性是生成器无关的准入健全性的充要条件，结合设计时证书和无旁路规则可获得合同安全保证，违规界不依赖于生成器的选择。第二定理给出任意准入机制在部分观测下的信息论下界。顺序风险账本使安全保证可实施，并将确定性准入计算中的所有统计风险集中在状态估计中。Simplex式运行时保障和控制屏障函数滤波被证明是该框架的退化特例。
AI.conclusion: 本文从理论上建立了生成器无关的安全性认证框架。关键在于：当黑盒生成器的输出需要运行时验证时，必须对候选集合进行整体认证（集合式健全性），而非逐个认证，这样才能避免重试或best-of-k机制带来的风险放大。这项工作为学习策略和语言模型规划器在安全关键系统中的可靠部署提供了理论支撑，其框架统一了此前的Simplex式保障和控制屏障函数等方法。

title: Connectome-to-Function: Conditional Generative Latent Representations for Reservoir Computing
summary: Connectomes, graph-level maps of neurons and their synaptic connections, provide a structural basis for understanding how brain circuits support function and computation. However, mapping connectome structure to computation remains difficult because these graphs are high-dimensional, sparse, and sensitive to local structural variation. Existing approaches often depend on hand-crafted structural descriptors or task-specific predictors, which limits their ability to represent connectomes in a form that is both generative and functionally meaningful. We propose a conditional generative latent framework that encodes connectome graphs into a compact structural space while using available node-level conditions to guide reconstruction and generation. From this space, the model can reconstruct observed connectivity with a mean edge-reconstruction AUC up to 0.910 and generate new candidate connectomes, enabling a unified analysis of graph structure and computational behavior. Using connectome-derived graphs as recurrent computational substrates, we found that the learned latent space captures functional variation across reservoir-computing experiments, with cross-validated $R^2$ values up to approximately 0.87. Interpretability analysis further revealed task-specific structural mechanisms: in our examples, memory performance is associated with reciprocal recurrent connectivity, whereas prediction and classification are more strongly associated with spectral properties of the recurrent network. These findings suggest an AI-for-science approach to linking neural connectivity to computation and provide a generative and interpretable basis for studying how distinct structural mechanisms shape computational capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种条件生成潜变量框架，将连接组图编码为紧凑的结构空间，利用节点级条件引导重建与生成，实现连接组结构与计算行为的统一分析。
AI.motivation: 连接组图是高维、稀疏且对局部结构变化敏感的图数据，现有方法依赖手工设计的结构描述符或任务特定预测器，缺乏兼具生成性和功能意义的连接组表示能力。
AI.method: 提出条件生成潜变量框架，将连接组图编码到紧凑结构空间，利用节点级条件引导图的重建与生成；随后将连接组派生图用作储层计算的计算基底进行功能验证。
AI.result: 边重建AUC最高达0.910；在储层计算实验中，潜空间捕获功能变异的交叉验证R²最高约0.87；可解释性分析揭示记忆性能与互惠递归连接相关，预测和分类任务与递归网络的谱属性更相关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了一种AI-for-science的路径，将神经连接与计算联系起来，为研究不同结构机制如何塑造计算能力提供了生成性和可解释性的基础。

title: DAREBench: Deployment-Aware and Reliable Evaluation of Models as Agents
summary: As large language models evolve from question-answering systems into general-purpose agents, evaluation must move beyond static answer correctness to assess multimodal perception, multi-step execution, tool use, and artifact delivery. However, existing benchmarks are often tied to specific task types, execution environments, or scoring protocols, limiting their comparability, interpretability, and reliability for deployment decisions. We introduce DAREBench (Deployment-Aware and Reliable Evaluation of Models as Agents), a benchmark designed to capture workload variation and support reliable agent evaluation. Built on a shared OpenClaw execution environment, DAREBench organizes 233 tasks selected and adapted from 22 source benchmarks into a $2\times3$ workload matrix defined by input modality and execution form, and evaluates them under a unified contract-based protocol with evidence-based score auditing. We evaluate 23 commercial API models and 12 locally deployed open-weight models over 7,587 model--task runs, reporting accuracy and token consumption alongside reference costs for API models. Results show that no single model dominates all workload groups, text and multimodal tasks exhibit distinct accuracy--cost trade-offs, and local open-weight models are competitive in several groups but still trail frontier commercial models overall. These findings suggest that agent deployment and model selection should consider workload profiles, deployment mode, and accuracy--cost trade-offs rather than rely on a single aggregate score.

AI.tldr: 提出DAREBench基准，用于部署感知且可靠的智能体评估，基于OpenClaw执行环境构建2×3工作负载矩阵，涵盖233个任务和22个来源基准，并用统一合约协议对23个商业API模型和12个本地开源模型进行7,587次评估。结果显示没有单一模型全面占优，智能体部署应考虑工作负载特征与精度-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型正从问答系统演变为通用智能体，但现有基准往往局限于特定任务类型、执行环境或评分协议，缺乏可比性、可解释性和可靠性，难以支撑部署决策，亟需一种能捕捉工作负载变化且支持可靠智能体评估的基准。
AI.method: 在共享OpenClaw执行环境上，从22个源基准中选取并改编233个任务，按输入模态和执行形式构建2×3工作负载矩阵；采用基于合约的统一评估协议，并附带基于证据的评分审计；对23个商业API模型和12个本地部署的开源模型在7,587次模型-任务运行中进行评估，报告精度和令牌消耗及API模型的参考成本。
AI.result: 评估结果表明：没有单一模型在所有工作负载组中全面占优；文本和多模态任务呈现出不同的精度-成本权衡；本地开源模型在若干工作负载组中具有竞争力，但整体上仍落后于前沿商用模型。
AI.conclusion: 智能体部署与模型选择应考虑工作负载特征、部署模式及精度-成本权衡，而不应依赖单一综合评分来做决策。

title: VERPO: Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization
summary: Verifiable outcome rewards guide language-model post-training, but sequence-level advantages do not identify which token-level decisions should be preserved or revised. Evidence-conditioned Teachers provide denser supervision by replaying sampled trajectories with privileged feedback. Yet indiscriminate imitation risks transferring formatting or reasoning-style shifts that do not support task success. We introduce VERPO, a Verified Evidence Regularized Policy Optimization framework that treats evidence as a proposal for policy correction while retaining the outcome objective. It separates evidence-free reference restoration from signed token-level evidence corrections. Fisher Evidence Contrast attenuates corrections along an estimated evidence-presence direction. A stopped token-wise ZPD controller scales acceptance according to local reward alignment and Fisher movement cost, while the reference channel remains independent of acceptance. Across five scientific-reasoning and tool-use tasks, the best variant on each backbone exceeds the strongest compared baseline in average score. The averages rise from 0.6826 to 0.6857 on Qwen3-4B, from 0.6895 to 0.7058 on Qwen3-8B, and from 0.4751 to 0.5657 on Llama-3.2-1B.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERPO框架，通过Fisher证据对比和经验调节的ZPD控制器，在保留结果目标的同时利用证据作为策略修正的提案，解决序列级奖励无法定位token级决策的问题。
AI.motivation: 序列级优势奖励无法识别哪些token级决策应被保留或修正，而基于证据条件的教师虽能提供更密集的监督，但不加区分的模仿可能迁移格式或推理风格偏移，反而损害任务成功率。
AI.method: VERPO将证据视为策略修正的提案而非直接模仿对象，包含：1) 分离无证据参考恢复与有符号token级证据修正；2) Fisher证据对比沿预估的证据存在方向衰减修正；3) 停止梯度的token级ZPD控制器根据局部奖励对齐和Fisher移动成本调节接受度，参考通道独立于接受度。
AI.result: 在五个科学推理和工具使用任务上，各骨干网络的最优变体均超过最强对比基线：Qwen3-4B平均分从0.6826提升至0.6857，Qwen3-8B从0.6895提升至0.7058，Llama-3.2-1B从0.4751提升至0.5657。
AI.conclusion: VERPO通过可控的证据引导策略优化，在保持结果目标的同时有效利用证据级监督信号，在多个模型规模上稳定超越现有基线，验证了将证据作为修正提案而非直接模仿对象的有效性。

title: Explaining AI Agents Through Execution Traces
summary: AI Agents are increasingly deployed in real-world settings, where they interact with external tools and make sequential decisions with limited human oversight. This creates a pressing need for reliable and auditable explanations of what an agent did and why. However, traditional Explainable AI (XAI) methods fall short of providing the process-level transparency required for such interactive, multi-step systems, motivating a paradigm shift toward approaches specifically designed for AI Agents. To address this gap, we present a post-hoc XAI framework that transforms a lengthy agent's execution trace into a structured report and a faithful natural-language explanation explicitly grounded in its observable behavior. Because it relies solely on execution traces, the framework applies across different agent architectures, environments, and tasks. Human and automated evaluations across multiple benchmarks and architectures show that our framework produces high-quality, trace-faithful explanations while reliably identifying unsupported claims, unjustified actions, and evidence gaps, outperforming naive LLM-generated explanations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种面向AI代理的后验可解释性框架，能将Agent漫长的执行轨迹转化为结构化报告和忠实于可观察行为的自然语言解释，用于识别无支撑声明、不合理动作和证据缺口。
AI.motivation: AI代理在现实世界中频繁与外部工具交互并做顺序决策，缺乏人工监督，亟需可靠且可审计的解释。传统XAI方法无法提供这种交互式多步骤系统所需的过程级透明度，因此需要专门面向AI代理的解释方法。
AI.method: 提出一个后验XAI框架，仅依赖Agent的执行轨迹，将其转换为结构化报告和忠实于可观察行为的自然语言解释。由于仅基于执行轨迹，该框架可适用于不同的Agent架构、环境和任务。
AI.result: 在多个基准和架构上，通过人工和自动评估表明该框架能生成高质量、轨迹忠实的解释，并能可靠识别无支撑声明、不合理动作和证据缺口，优于朴素的LLM生成解释。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效弥合了传统XAI方法在AI代理场景下的不足，为交互式多步决策系统提供了过程级可审计的可解释性方案。

title: FANS: Federated Adaptive Network Search Learning for Heterogeneous Devices
summary: Heterogeneous Federated Learning (HFL) aims to train models across devices with diverse resource budgets while preserving data privacy. Existing HFL methods typically bind training to a small predefined menu of model configurations, which limits architectural coverage. To address this bottleneck, we introduce Federated Adaptive Network Search (FANS), a hypernetwork-based framework that learns a shared architecture space rather than a fixed set of client models. To optimize this shared space efficiently, we propose the Federated Parallel Scaling (FPS) algorithm, which jointly trains multiple sampled subnetworks in parallel with self-distillation so that larger sampled subnetworks can supervise smaller ones during local updates. We evaluate FANS on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and MNLI using ResNet-18, DenseNet-121, and BERT-base, respectively. Across all benchmarks, FANS expands the feasible subnetwork pool by orders of magnitude (e.g., 4,680 candidates for ResNet-18 vs. 4 in existing methods) and improves the average accuracy-efficiency trade-off relative to representative HFL baselines. Device heterogeneity is emulated through resource tiers, and evaluation covers accuracy, parameter count, and MACs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出联邦自适应网络搜索（FANS）框架，通过超网络学习共享架构空间替代固定客户端模型集合，并配套联邦并行缩放（FPS）算法实现多子网络并行训练与自蒸馏，在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和MNLI等基准上显著扩展可行子网络池并提升精度-效率权衡。
AI.motivation: 异构联邦学习（HFL）中，现有方法通常将客户端训练绑定到预定义的小规模模型配置集合上，严重限制了架构覆盖范围，无法充分利用设备异构资源。
AI.method: 提出FANS框架，利用超网络学习一个共享架构空间而非固定的客户端模型集合；配套FPS算法，并行联合训练多个采样子网络，并通过自蒸馏使较大的采样子网络在本地更新中指导较小的子网络。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100（ResNet-18、DenseNet-121）和MNLI（BERT-base）上，FANS将可行子网络池扩展若干个数量级（如ResNet-18从4个候选扩展到4,680个），并在精度-效率权衡上优于代表性HFL基线；评估涵盖精度、参数量和MACs。
AI.conclusion: FANS通过共享架构空间结合并行缩放自蒸馏策略，有效突破了传统HFL方法架构覆盖受限的瓶颈，为设备异构场景提供了更灵活、更高效的联邦学习方案。

title: Generating Instance Generators in PDDL Planning
summary: PDDL, the de-facto standard language in the AI Planning community, is designed to specify planning domains: sets of instances that share the same predicates and action schemas. Yet it does not provide any means to specify the actual instance set, i.e., legality constraints on initial states and goal conditions, as well as possibly domain subset constraints specifying an instance subset we are interested in. One consequence of this is that instance generation has always been ad-hoc, with manually written domain- and subset-specific instance generators. Recent work has started to address this, through reasoning and learning methods that however suffer from scalability limitations. Here we introduce an alternative approach, leveraging LLMs to generate instance-generation programs, with built-in soundness guarantees through prescribed checks. We show that these automatically generated instance generators return large numbers of sound and diverse instances efficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用大语言模型（LLM）自动生成PDDL规划领域的实例生成程序，并通过内置检查确保生成的实例满足合法性约束，从而替代传统的手动编写实例生成器。
AI.motivation: PDDL作为AI规划领域的标准语言，只能定义谓词和动作模式，无法指定合法实例集（初始状态和目标条件的约束）。这导致实例生成一直是手动且特定于领域的，虽然后续工作尝试用推理和学习方法解决，但存在可扩展性瓶颈。
AI.method: 利用LLM生成实例生成程序，并通过预设的健全性检查（soundness checks）来保证程序生成的实例满足合法性约束。该方法结合了LLM的自动编程能力与程序化验证的保障机制。
AI.result: 自动生成的实例生成器能够高效地产生大量健全且多样化的实例，验证了方法的有效性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种替代性的实例生成框架，利用LLM自动编写带健全性保障的实例生成程序，解决了PDDL中实例生成长期以来的ad-hoc问题。

title: DataFlex-RL: An Evaluation Platform for RLVR Data Policies
summary: Data policies for reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) determine which rollouts are used, how strongly they are weighted, and which domains contribute to subsequent training batches. We introduce DataFlex-RL, an evaluation platform for comparing these choices under a common GRPO recipe. Our primary experiment evaluates 13 configurations across 12 matched seeds using Qwen2.5-7B-Base and 12 mathematics, logic, and science benchmarks. Uniform GRPO improves the domain-balanced average accuracy by 7.76 percentage points over the untrained checkpoint. None of the eight rollout-selection or reweighting methods achieves a paired 95% confidence interval that excludes zero relative to uniform sampling, and none of the three adaptive mixtures outperforms a fixed equal mixture at the same level of precision. A corrected 12-seed extension on Llama-3.1-8B-Base places the additional methods on the same score scale as the original controls, but does not reveal a consistent winner in terms of observed mean performance. We also quantify evaluation sensitivity by rescoring nine Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct runs using a math-heavy six-benchmark summary, consisting of five mathematics benchmarks and GPQA-Diamond but no logic benchmark, and comparing it with the domain-balanced 12-benchmark summary. The resulting rankings are negatively correlated, with a correlation coefficient of -0.33, whereas summaries that retain all 12 benchmarks largely agree. Across the controlled settings studied here, changing the data policy measurably changes the training process but does not produce a reproducible improvement over uniform training.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍DataFlex-RL评估平台，系统比较了RLVR中的数据策略选择（包括rollout选择、重加权和自适应混合等13种配置）。在Qwen2.5-7B-Base和Llama-3.1-8B-Base上进行大规模实验后发现，均匀GRPO相对未训练检查点提升7.76个百分点，但没有一种rollout选择或重加权方法能够产生统计显著的改进，也没有自适应混合方法优于固定等量混合。此外，改变评估基准摘要（去除逻辑基准）会导致排名与原始结果负相关（相关系数-0.33），说明评估敏感性极高。
AI.motivation: RLVR中的数据策略（选择哪些rollout、如何加权、哪些领域纳入训练）对训练效果影响显著，但缺乏系统性的对比研究平台和严格的统计评估框架来公正比较不同数据策略选择。
AI.method: 构建DataFlex-RL评估平台，在统一的GRPO训练配方下，对13种数据策略配置进行系统比较。使用Qwen2.5-7B-Base在12个数学、逻辑和科学基准上进行12个匹配种子的实验，并在Llama-3.1-8B-Base上进行12种子扩展验证。同时通过改变评估基准组合进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 均匀GRPO提升7.76个百分点；8种rollout选择/重加权方法均未在95%置信区间上显著优于均匀采样；3种自适应混合方法均未优于固定等量混合；改变评估摘要（去除逻辑基准）导致排名与原始结果负相关（r=-0.33）。
AI.conclusion: 在受控设置下，改变数据策略确实会改变训练过程，但无法在均匀训练之上产生可复现的改进。评估基准的选择对方法排序有重大影响，研究者应警惕评估摘要变化导致的不一致结论。

title: LayerRoute: Action-Conditioned Mixture-of-Layers Routing for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies leverage pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) to guide action generation for robot control. VLMs provide hierarchical visual-semantic representations that evolve across layers, from local visual geometry to abstract, language-aligned semantics; different manipulation tasks may therefore require different mixtures of layer representations. Meanwhile, the action module maintains intermediate representations that evolve throughout action computation and may provide useful information for subsequent decisions. However, existing VLA interfaces offer limited flexibility in representation access: VLM information is exposed through fixed layer assignments for each action layer, while intermediate action states are only propagated implicitly through residual streams without explicit reuse. We introduce LayerRoute, an action-conditioned representation routing interface that enables adaptive access to VLM layers and action representations. The Layer Mixture Router dynamically forms mixtures of cached VLM representations, while Action-State Reread reuses earlier action representations. Across diverse simulation and real-world benchmarks, LayerRoute consistently improves StarVLA-$π$ and $π_{0.5}$, achieving up to 7.2 gains on LIBERO Long with only 0.31% / 3.87% additional parameters. Ablation studies validate the benefit of action-conditioned layer routing, while routing analyses reveal structured allocation patterns across action layers and task settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LayerRoute，一种动作条件化的表示路由接口，使VLA策略能够自适应地访问VLM不同层级的视觉-语义表示以及动作模块的中间表示。在LIBERO Long等基准上实现最高7.2%的性能提升，仅增加0.31%/3.87%的参数量。
AI.motivation: VLA策略依赖预训练VLM进行动作生成，但不同操纵任务需要不同层级的视觉-语义表示混合。现有VLA接口对VLM层的访问是固定的（每个动作层绑定固定VLM层），且动作中间状态仅通过残差流隐式传播，缺乏显式重用，导致表示访问灵活性受限。
AI.method: LayerRoute包含两个核心组件：(1) Layer Mixture Router——动态地对缓存的VLM层表示进行混合，根据动作条件自适应选择所需的层级特征；(2) Action-State Reread——显式重用先前动作计算中的中间表示，为后续决策提供补充信息。
AI.result: 在多种仿真和真实世界基准上，LayerRoute一致地提升了StarVLA-π和π0.5的性能，在LIBERO Long上取得最高7.2%的提升，仅引入0.31%/3.87%的额外参数。消融实验验证了动作条件化层路由的有效性，路由分析揭示了不同动作层和任务设置下的结构化分配模式。
AI.conclusion: LayerRoute通过动作条件化的灵活表示路由，显著提升了VLA策略的性能与效率，证实了动态层级表示选择对机器人操纵任务的重要性。

title: Sparse Incident-Cluster Learning for 12-hour Port Flood Pre-warning in Digital-Twin Analytics
summary: Port flood digital twins require analytics that warn operators before disruption, but official warning incidents are often few and adjacent observations are temporally dependent. Row-level classification can therefore overstate performance by placing windows from the same event in both model-development and evaluation data. We formulate 12-hour port flood pre-warning as an incident-cluster learning problem and evaluate a digital-twin analytics module using eight-point water-level histories, prediction-time contextual covariates, and interpretable short-window dynamics. The protocol combines fold-specific sparse feature selection, warning-cluster grouping, negative-label controls, 100-repeat random top-k controls, and alert-episode evaluation. Liverpool is the primary four-cluster case study, with harmonised Humber/Hull-proxy and Wessex South data used for protocol-transfer checks. Across the Liverpool folds, the top-10 ElasticNet model achieves mean F2 = 0.696, compared with 0.633 without top-k truncation and 0.681 for full-feature weighted XGBoost. It is the strongest ElasticNet variant, remains competitive with the nonlinear reference using only ten predictors, and exceeds the repeat-level 95th percentile of broad and same-family random subsets. Contextual covariates provide a strong prediction-time anchor, complemented by physically interpretable local dynamics. Historical replay converts risk scores into alert episodes and measures alert duration and false-episode burden. The result is an offline-evaluated analytics and validation module designed for integration into a port digital twin.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向港口数字孪生的12小时洪涝预警方法，将预警任务形式化为事件簇学习问题，通过稀疏特征选择、告警簇分组、随机top-k对照等协议，在利物浦案例中ElasticNet模型达到F2=0.696，并将风险分数转换为告警事件片段以供数字孪生集成。
AI.motivation: 港口洪涝数字孪生需要能在基础设施中断前发出预警的分析能力，但官方预警事件样本稀少且相邻观测存在时间依赖性，传统行级分类会在模型开发与评估数据中混入同一事件的窗口，导致性能被高估。
AI.method: 将12小时港口洪涝预警形式化为事件簇学习问题；使用八点水位历史、预测时点上下文协变量及可解释的短窗口动态特征；采用折叠特异稀疏特征选择、预警簇分组、负标签控制、100次随机top-k对照及告警片段评估的协议；以利物浦四簇案例为主，并用Humber/Hull代理及Wessex South数据验证协议可迁移性。
AI.result: 在利物浦各折叠中，top-10 ElasticNet模型平均F2=0.696，优于无top-k截断的0.633及全特征加权XGBoost的0.681；该模型是ElasticNet变体中最强者，仅用十个预测因子即与非线性的参照模型具有竞争力，且超过重复级95分位的广泛及同族随机子集。
AI.conclusion: 上下文协变量提供了强预测锚点，辅以物理上可解释的局部动态；历史回放将风险分数转化为告警事件，测量告警持续时间与误报负担，最终产出一个经离线评估的分析与验证模块，可供港口数字孪生集成使用。

title: SAP: State-Guided Data Synthesis with Argument Provenance for Multi-Turn Tool Use
summary: High-quality multi-turn tool-use data is essential for training agentic models, yet existing data synthesis methods often underrepresent the argument-level dependencies that are critical to long-horizon tool use. As a result, even when a model selects the correct tool, task execution may still fail because the model fills tool arguments with fabricated, stale, or weakly grounded values. To address this problem, we propose \textbf{State-Guided Data Synthesis with Argument Provenance (SAP)}. SAP combines state guidance, tool-argument provenance constraints, and turn-level validation to efficiently construct tool-use trajectories with long-range dependencies and high accuracy. Using data generated by SAP, we build SAP-4B, which is highly competitive even when compared with much larger models across multiple benchmarks. Source code, synthesized data, and trained weights are available at https://github.com/Zichen1024/SAP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAP（State-Guided Data Synthesis with Argument Provenance）框架，通过结合状态引导、工具参数溯源约束和回合级验证，高效构建具有长距离依赖和高准确率的工具调用轨迹数据，训练出的SAP-4B模型在多个基准上可与更大的模型竞争。
AI.motivation: 高质量的多轮工具使用数据对训练智能体模型至关重要，但现有数据合成方法往往忽视了参数级依赖关系，导致模型即使选择了正确的工具，也可能因为填充虚假、过时或弱关联的参数值而导致任务执行失败。
AI.method: SAP结合三种关键技术：状态引导（state guidance）、工具参数溯源约束（tool-argument provenance constraints）以及回合级验证（turn-level validation），用于高效构建具有长距离依赖关系和高准确率的工具使用轨迹数据。
AI.result: 使用SAP生成的数据构建的SAP-4B模型，在多个基准测试中表现出高度竞争力，甚至可与规模更大的模型相媲美。
AI.conclusion: SAP有效解决了工具使用数据合成中参数级依赖被忽视的问题，证明了通过状态引导和参数溯源约束能够生成高质量的训练数据，使小规模模型达到与大模型竞争的性能。代码、数据和模型权重已开源。

title: Compressed Recurrent Feedback in Tsetlin Machines: A Reproducible Boolean-FSM Study
summary: Sequential inference on small devices requires a model to retain useful history without repeatedly processing a long input record. A Recurrent Tsetlin Machine (RTM) provides this memory by returning Boolean clause outputs from one time step as inputs to the next. Direct feedback, however, grows with the clause bank and can make the recurrent input unnecessarily wide. This paper investigates a fixed-width alternative. We combine clause activations by exclusive-OR (XOR) folding, retain the folded bits at two time scales, and threshold them back to a binary state. The resulting design reduces 480 clause activations to 96 recurrent bits. We evaluate the method on a reproducible Boolean finite-state-machine benchmark with explicit transition rules, data splits, and random seeds. Across 144 runs, the compressed model obtains $61.47 \pm 6.74\%$ and $62.94 \pm 9.92\%$ accuracy on the two task families. Raw clause feedback changes these means by less than one percentage point, while increasing the recurrent width tenfold and measured host execution time by $4.38\times$ and $3.71\times$. Gated neural models remain more accurate, and a no-feedback control retaining only short input history achieves comparable or slightly higher accuracy. On this benchmark, folding matches raw feedback within small empirical margins at a much narrower interface; these findings also underscore the critical necessity of no-feedback recurrence controls when benchmarking sequence models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于异或（XOR）折叠的固定宽度循环Tsetlin机（RTM）变体，将480个子句激活压缩为96个循环位，在布尔有限状态机基准上，与原始子句反馈相比精度差异小于1个百分点，但循环宽度和执行时间大幅降低。同时强调在序列模型基准测试中加入无反馈对照组的重要性。
AI.motivation: 小型设备上的顺序推理需要模型在不重复处理长输入的情况下保留有用历史信息。RTM虽能通过子句输出反馈实现记忆，但直接反馈随子句库规模增长，导致循环输入宽度不必要地过宽，增加计算和存储开销。
AI.method: 通过异或（XOR）操作折叠子句激活，将折叠后的比特在两种时间尺度上保留，再通过阈值化还原为二进制状态。该设计将480个子句激活压缩为96个循环比特。在可复现的布尔有限状态机基准（含显式转换规则、数据划分和随机种子）上进行评估，并与原始子句反馈和无反馈对照组进行比较。
AI.result: 在144次运行中，压缩模型在两个任务族上分别达到61.47±6.74%和62.94±9.92%的准确率。原始子句反馈的均值差异小于1个百分点，但循环宽度扩大10倍，实测主机执行时间增加4.38倍和3.71倍。门控神经模型仍更准确，无反馈控制（仅保留短期输入历史）达到相当或略高的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 折叠模型在更窄的接口上与原始反馈的精度差距很小，具备实用价值；但研究发现无反馈对照组能达到相当甚至更高的准确率，凸显了在序列模型基准测试中加入无反馈递归控制组的必要性，以排除模型精度仅来自短期输入记忆的可能。

title: CWF: A Collaborative Writing Framework for Personalized and Reliable Popular Science Writing
summary: We introduce Personalized and Reliable Popular Science Writing, a novel task that requires adapting scientific explanations to audiences with different cognitive levels while preserving factual accuracy. However, improving personalization often introduces simplifications that increase the risk of hallucination and factual distortion. To address these challenges, we first construct a dataset of 39,134 entries and a reader-centric Personalized Science Communication Benchmark (PSCB) that jointly evaluates audience adaptation and factual accuracy. To reduce data and computational requirements while improving generalization across domains and audiences, we introduce DA-MoE, which explicitly decouples audience adaptation from domain knowledge through separate modeling. To enable robust verification and revision in evidence-scarce scenarios, a multi-agent fact-checking mechanism that augments limited evidence with role-specific agent debate and propagates confidence over a graph is proposed. Experiments on PSCB show that our approach achieves state-of-the-art performance. Our code is open-sourced at https://github.com/DPInnovationWorks/CWF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一项新任务——个性化可靠科普写作，要求在保持事实准确的同时，将科学解释适配给不同认知水平的受众。论文构建了包含39,134条目的数据集和PSCB基准，并提出DA-MoE模型将受众适配与领域知识解耦，同时引入多智能体事实核查机制进行稳健验证和修订。
AI.motivation: 个性化科普写作在提升可读性的同时往往引入简化，这会增加幻觉和事实扭曲的风险。现有的个性化增强方法与事实准确性之间存在矛盾，且缺乏一个能够同时评估受众适配和事实准确性的联合基准，因此亟需一种既能提升个性化又不损害准确性的方法。
AI.method: 首先构建39,134条目的数据集和读者中心化的PSCB基准来联合评估受众适配与事实准确性。其次提出DA-MoE框架，通过显式解耦受众适配与领域知识（使用独立的模块进行建模）来降低数据和计算需求并提升跨领域跨受众的泛化能力。此外设计了一种多智能体事实核查机制，在证据稀缺场景下通过角色特定智能体辩论来增强有限证据，并在图上传播置信度以实现稳健的验证与修订。
AI.result: 在PSCB基准上的实验表明，所提出的方法取得了最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为个性化科普写作任务提供了首个大规模数据集和联合评估基准，通过解耦建模与多智能体事实核查机制有效平衡了受众适配与事实准确性之间的权衡，代码已开源。

title: Rethinking One-Shot Federated Graph Learning: Training-Free Statistical Estimation
summary: One-shot federated graph learning generally aims to train Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) across clients with disconnected subgraphs in a single communication round. Existing methods predominantly design advanced optimization strategies under the premise that local GNN training is indispensable. However, empirical observations reveal that under extreme non-IID conditions, local GNN training suffers from severe cross-client representation misalignment, becoming a major source of error rather than a remedy. Motivated by this, we reformulate one-shot FGL as a statistical estimation problem. We propose SPEAR (Statistical Prototype Estimation with Adaptive Reliability), a completely training-free framework that directly computes topology-smoothed class prototypes from local graphs in the original feature space. The server then aggregates these prototypes using a sample-size-adaptive shrinkage estimator that down-weights unreliable local estimates, producing robust global class prototypes. Extensive experiments across seven benchmarks demonstrate that SPEAR consistently achieves state-of-the-art accuracy under extreme heterogeneity. Moreover, SPEAR delivers at least an order-of-magnitude speedup over all baselines, reaching several orders of magnitude against generative and distillation-based methods. Our findings suggest that training-free statistical estimation, rather than local GNN optimization, provides the key to robust and efficient one-shot federated graph learning. The code is available at https://github.com/Yodeesy/SPEAR .

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPEAR框架，将单轮联邦图学习重新定义为统计估计问题，通过无训练的方式直接计算拓扑平滑的类原型，并使用样本量自适应的收缩估计器聚合，在极端非IID条件下实现SOTA精度且速度提升至少一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 现有单轮联邦图学习方法普遍假设本地GNN训练是必要的，但在极端非IID条件下，本地GNN训练会导致跨客户端表示严重错位，反而成为主要误差来源而非解决方案。
AI.method: SPEAR包含两个核心组件：(1) 在原始特征空间中直接从本地图计算拓扑平滑的类原型；(2) 服务器端使用样本量自适应的收缩估计器聚合局部原型，对不可靠的局部估计进行降权，生成鲁棒的全局类原型。
AI.result: 在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，SPEAR在极端异质性下一致达到SOTA精度，并且相比所有基线至少有一个数量级的加速，相比生成式和蒸馏方法可达数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 无训练的统计估计方法而非本地GNN优化，才是实现鲁棒高效的单轮联邦图学习的关键。

title: Substrate-Portable Execution for Production LLM Workflows
summary: Production LLM agents execute tool-calling loops, retrieval chains, and compositional workflows in multiple modes, yet execution semantics are often coupled to one runtime. We encountered this portability problem in Rufus, a conversational AI assistant with a large tool catalog that serves millions of Amazon customers. Rufus supports real-time serving, asynchronous background tasks, and high-volume batch workloads such as evaluation and content pregeneration. Each mode has distinct service-level objectives and typically uses a separate runtime. Reusing streaming orchestration makes asynchronous and batch workloads blocking and prevents use of batch inference APIs, which offer a 50 percent discount at published prices. We present a binding-adaptive agent execution platform that separates workflow definition from execution substrate. Developers define a workflow once as a typed dataflow graph. The platform compiles the graph to in-process streaming for real-time serving, durable AWS SWF orchestration for asynchronous execution, or distributed Apache Flink stream processing for batch inference. No workflow code changes are required. LLM inference is represented as a suspendable graph node whose behavior depends on the substrate: streaming delivery online, durable retry asynchronously, and batched submission offline. We validated dozens of production agent configurations across five orchestration patterns: single-inference RAG, iterative ReAct, compositional PreAct, conditional routing, and multi-agent deep research. Across all three bindings, we found no detectable difference in output quality. Batch execution reduced per-query inference cost in line with published batch API pricing while operating alongside the streaming path at production scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种绑定自适应的Agent执行平台，将工作流定义与执行底层分离，使得同一工作流可以无缝编译到流式在线推理、AWS SWF异步编排或Apache Flink批处理三种不同的执行模式。该平台已在亚马逊Rufus助手中验证，数十种生产Agent配置在三种绑定下输出质量无差异，批处理执行成本与官方批处理API定价一致。
AI.motivation: 生产环境中的LLM Agent需要在多种模式下执行工具调用循环、检索链和组合工作流，但执行语义通常与单一运行时耦合。Rufus（服务数百万亚马逊客户的对话AI助手）面临实时服务、异步后台任务和高吞吐批处理负载三种不同服务级别目标，各自需要不同的运行时。复用流式编排会使异步和批处理工作负载产生阻塞，且无法利用提供50%折扣的批处理推理API。这些模式差异性构成了系统开发的瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出一个绑定自适应的Agent执行平台，核心思想是将工作流定义与执行底层分离。开发者仅需定义一次类型化的数据流图工作流，平台将该图编译为三种执行模型：进程内流式处理（实时服务）、AWS SWF持久化编排（异步执行）、分布式Apache Flink流处理（批处理推理）。LLM推理被抽象为可挂起的图节点，其行为随底层变化：在线流式传输、异步持久化重试、离线批量提交，实现零工作流代码修改。
AI.result: 在五种编排模式（单推理RAG、迭代ReAct、组合PreAct、条件路由、多Agent深度研究）中验证了数十种生产Agent配置。三种绑定下的输出质量无可检测差异；批处理执行的单查询推理成本与公开的批处理API定价一致，同时在生产规模下与流式路径并行运行。
AI.conclusion: 绑定自适应执行范式有效解决了LLM Agent多模式执行的可移植性问题，使同一工作流定义无需修改即可跨实时、异步和批处理三种执行环境运行，在保证输出质量一致性的前提下大幅降低了批处理推理成本。该工作为生产级LLM Agent系统的架构设计提供了新的思路。

title: All for 1-Bit: Towards Genuine 1-Bit Post-Training Quantization for LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress, yet their massive storage and memory-bandwidth demands still hinder efficient deployment. Weight binarization is a promising solution, but existing binarization-based post-training quantization (PTQ) methods usually far exceed the nominal 1-bit storage target due to hidden overhead. To address this gap, we propose All for 1-Bit (AF1), a genuine 1-bit PTQ framework for LLMs. AF1 comprises two complementary components: (1) Null-space-Aware Binary Factorization (NABF) for improving binary reconstruction through Hessian-aware surrogate reparameterization, null-space-aware binary factorization, and scale-only global reconstruction; and (2) Hierarchical Shapley Allocation (HiSA) for assigning structural capacity using hierarchical Shapley sensitivity. Together, they preserve model accuracy under a strict 1.0-BPW budget in the PTQ setting. Experiments on LLaMA, Qwen, and Gemma families show that AF1 consistently outperforms existing binarization-based PTQ methods in perplexity and zero-shot accuracy. Compared with BF16, AF1 achieves an average 2.5 times inference speedup and over 90% memory reduction across evaluated models, providing a practical path toward deployable genuine 1-bit compression for LLMs. The code for reproducibility is available at https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/AF1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AF1框架，一个真正实现1-bit位宽压缩的大语言模型后训练量化方法，通过零空间感知二元分解和层级Shapley分配两个组件，在严格的1.0-BPW预算下保持模型精度，实现平均2.5倍推理加速和90%以上的内存减少。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型虽然取得了显著进展，但其巨大的存储和内存带宽需求阻碍了高效部署。权重量化（特别是二值化）被视为有前景的解决方案，但现有的基于二值化的后训练量化方法因隐藏开销往往远超标称的1-bit存储目标，需要一种真正实现1-bit压缩的框架。
AI.method: AF1包含两个互补组件：(1) 零空间感知二元分解（NABF），通过Hessian感知的代理重参数化、零空间感知二元分解和仅缩放的全局重构来提升二元重建质量；(2) 层级Shapley分配（HiSA），利用层级Shapley敏感性来分配结构化容量。两者结合在严格的1.0-BPW预算下保持模型精度。
AI.result: 在LLaMA、Qwen和Gemma模型家族上的实验表明，AF1在困惑度和零样本准确率上持续优于现有的基于二值化的PTQ方法。与BF16相比，AF1在评估模型上实现了平均2.5倍的推理加速和超过90%的内存减少。
AI.conclusion: AF1为LLM提供了真正的1-bit后训练量化方案，在严格的1.0-BPW预算下兼顾了模型精度与部署效率，为大语言模型的实际部署提供了可行路径。

title: IIns-VAE+: A Robust Transfer Learning Framework for Environmental Identification in Wireless Sensing
summary: Environmental identification in wireless sensing is essential for 6G integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems to achieve reliable situational awareness. However, deep learning (DL) models for this task often fail to generalize under domain shift across diverse environments. While the Inter-Instance Variational Auto-encoder (IIns-VAE) learns features of rich representation, its neural classifier remains vulnerable to these distribution changes. In this paper, we propose IIns-VAE+, a hybrid model that combines the IIns-VAE framework with Minimax Risk Classifiers (MRC) to improve adaptability in transfer learning scenarios. We use real-world datasets to evaluate our framework across three transfer learning scenarios, including general to specific room environments, high to low label resolutions, and mixed to specific environments. The experimental results indicate that IIns-VAE+ significantly outperforms baselines, demonstrating its critical value in building adaptable and robust perceptive networks in future 6G systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IIns-VAE+混合模型，将IIns-VAE框架与Minimax风险分类器（MRC）结合，以增强无线感知中环境识别模型在域偏移下的泛化能力，实验证明其在多种迁移学习场景下显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 无线感知中的环境识别对6G ISAC系统至关重要，但深度学习模型在跨环境的域偏移下泛化能力不足。现有IIns-VAE虽能学习丰富表征，其神经分类器仍易受分布变化影响。
AI.method: 提出IIns-VAE+混合模型，将IIns-VAE特征学习框架与Minimax风险分类器（MRC）相结合，利用MRC的鲁棒分类特性增强模型在迁移学习场景中的适应性。
AI.result: 使用真实数据集在三个迁移学习场景（一般到特定房间、高到低标签分辨率、混合到特定环境）中评估，IIns-VAE+显著优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: IIns-VAE+在构建未来6G系统中具有适应性且鲁棒的可感知网络方面展现了关键价值。

title: Decision-Aware Suffix Prediction and Reasoning of Business Processes
summary: Suffix prediction forecasts the remaining sequence of events of a running case until completion. Most approaches rely on neural networks trained on event logs, which, on average, perform well but struggle with short prefixes or targets belonging to a rare process variant. In such scenarios, the correct path may cross multiple branching decisions, determined primarily by case- and event-level attributes, a signal that NN-based suffix prediction models tend to underweight because they may heavily weight (dense) event labels. Decision mining extracts rules for such decisions from the event log, but has so far been applied only to post-hoc and what-if analysis, not suffix prediction. We therefore extend suffix prediction with decision mining, introducing a decision-aware suffix prediction framework, a neuro-symbolic approach that enables reasoning about predicted events via mined decision rules. Experiments on three of four event logs and three suffix predictors show that the framework can improve suffix prediction, especially for short prefixes but also for rare process variants, and adds intrinsic interpretability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种决策感知的后缀预测框架，将决策挖掘与神经符号方法结合，用于业务流程的剩余事件序列预测。实验表明该框架在短前缀和稀有流程变体场景下能提升预测性能，并具备内在可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于神经网络的后续预测方法在平均情况下表现良好，但在短前缀或稀有流程变体场景下表现不佳。这些场景需要跨多个分支决策的推理，而决策主要取决于案例和事件级属性，但神经网络模型往往过度关注密集的事件标签而低估这些属性信号。决策挖掘虽能提取此类决策规则，但此前仅用于事后和假设分析，未被应用于后缀预测。
AI.method: 提出决策感知的后缀预测框架（decision-aware suffix prediction framework），这是一种神经符号方法（neuro-symbolic approach）：将传统神经网络的后续预测与决策挖掘提取的决策规则相结合，使系统能够通过挖掘出的决策规则对预测事件进行推理。实验在四个事件日志上使用三种后缀预测器进行验证。
AI.result: 在四个事件日志中的三个上，决策感知框架能够改进后缀预测效果，特别是在短前缀场景下表现显著，同时对稀有流程变体也有改善，并且框架还提供了内在可解释性（intrinsic interpretability）。
AI.conclusion: 将决策挖掘融入后缀预测可以弥补纯神经网络方法在短前缀和稀有变体场景下的不足，神经符号结合的方式不仅能提升预测精度，还能自然地为预测结果提供可解释性，是一种有前景的研究方向。

title: MVFA: A Multi-View Text-Guided Multimodal Fusion LLM Adapter for Sentiment Analysis and Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal sentiment analysis and emotion recognition in conversations demand effective modeling of heterogeneous interactions across textual, acoustic, and visual modalities. Although large language models (LLMs) offer powerful language understanding, adapting them to multimodal affective computing remains challenging: full-model fine-tuning is computationally prohibitive, while many existing lightweight adapters fail to preserve rich textual cues during cross-modal fusion. To address these limitations, we propose the multi-view text-guided multimodal fusion adapter (MVFA), a parameter-efficient framework that augments frozen LLMs with strong multimodal reasoning capability. MVFA first constructs complementary text views via max pooling, mean pooling, and attention pooling; these views then guide cross-modal interactions with audio and visual features. The fused multimodal representations are subsequently compressed into a compact set of learnable pseudo-tokens through an Enhanced Q-Former Fusion Module. Using ChatGLM3-6B-base as the primary backbone, we further validate MVFA on LLaMA2-7B and Qwen3-8B to examine its portability across multiple frozen LLM backbones. MVFA is evaluated on three challenging datasets: CH-SIMS V2.0, MELD, and CHERMA. Experimental results demonstrate that MVFA achieves state-of-the-art performance on key metrics while updating only a small fraction of parameters. Specifically, it attains 84.62\% Acc2 and 84.59\% F1 on CH-SIMS V2.0, 67.36\% Acc and 66.03\% WF1 on MELD, and 74.66\% Acc on CHERMA. These findings establish multi-view text-guided fusion as an effective and scalable paradigm for parameter-efficient multimodal LLM adaptation in affective computing. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/Overwhelm1208/MVFA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MVFA（多视角文本引导的多模态融合适配器），一种参数高效框架，通过将冻结的LLM（如ChatGLM3、LLaMA2、Qwen3）与音频和视觉模态进行融合，用于对话中的多模态情感分析和情绪识别，在三个数据集上取得SOTA性能且仅更新少量参数。
AI.motivation: 多模态情感分析需要有效建模文本、音频、视觉三种模态的异质交互。虽然LLM具备强大的语言理解能力，但全模型微调计算代价过高，而现有的轻量级适配器在跨模态融合过程中往往无法保留丰富的文本语义线索。
AI.method: MVFA首先通过最大池化、均值池化和注意力池化构建互补的文本视图，这些视图引导音频和视觉特征的跨模态交互；随后通过增强型Q-Former融合模块将多模态表示压缩为一组可学习的伪token，最后注入冻结的LLM进行推理。
AI.result: MVFA在CH-SIMS V2.0上达到84.62% Acc2和84.59% F1，在MELD上达到67.36% Acc和66.03% WF1，在CHERMA上达到74.66% Acc，在三个数据集上均取得SOTA性能，同时仅更新一小部分参数。
AI.conclusion: 多视角文本引导的融合范式是参数高效多模态LLM适配在情感计算领域中一种有效且可扩展的方案，MVFA在多个冻结LLM骨干上均表现出良好的可移植性。

title: FMMO: Detecting the Divergence Between Local Attribution and Global Drift
summary: Post-deployment drift poses a critical risk to algorithmic accountability, particularly when ground truth labels are delayed and performance degradation becomes a "silent failure". While Explainable AI (XAI) is often relied upon to audit these shifts, we demonstrate that popular local attribution methods (e.g., TreeSHAP) can exhibit misleading stability even as model reliability collapses. In this paper, we propose a Framework for Model Monitoring and Observability (FMMO) designed to expose the divergence between local explanation stability and global distribution shifts. Using benchmark, synthetic, and real-world datasets, we show that local XAI methods fail to flag drift-induced disparate impact, specifically where False Positive Rates spike for protected groups while feature attributions remain unchanged. By integrating global surrogate models with model utilization measurements, FMMO mitigates this fairness blind spot, ensuring that stakeholders can detect discriminatory deterioration that standard local XAI tools overlook.

AI.tldr: 本文指出局部XAI方法（如TreeSHAP）在模型性能退化时可能保持误导性的稳定性，无法捕捉漂移引发的公平性损害（如特定群体的假阳性率飙升），并提出了一种模型监控与可观测性框架（FMMO）来弥合这一盲区。
AI.motivation: 部署后的数据漂移会带来"静默失效"风险，尤其在真实标签延迟的情况下，性能退化难以被及时发现。虽然XAI常被用来审计漂移，但局部归因方法可能表现出误导性的稳定性，无法揭示漂移引发的歧视性影响，导致公平性盲区。
AI.method: 提出FMMO（模型监控与可观测性框架），通过将全局替代模型与模型利用率测量相结合，来暴露局部解释稳定性与全局分布漂移之间的分歧。
AI.result: 在基准、合成和真实数据集上的实验表明，局部XAI方法无法标记漂移导致的差异影响（特别是受保护群体的假阳性率飙升而特征归因保持不变的情况），而FMMO能够有效缓解这一公平性盲区，检测到标准局部XAI工具遗漏的歧视性退化。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖局部XAI进行模型监控是不够的，需要结合全局视角的监控框架才能真正保障算法问责制与公平性。

title: Customer Relationship Intelligence: Integrating CRM and MDM for Enhanced Customer Engagement
comment: Preprint submitted to 16th IEEE ICCCNT 2025. 8 pages, 12 tables
summary: This study examines how Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Master Data Management (MDM), and Customer Knowledge Management (CKM) jointly constitute a Customer Relationship Intelligence (CRI) framework for enhanced Customer Engagement (CE). A cross-sectional survey of 100 participants across retail, healthcare, IT, and telecommunications sectors was analysed using Spearman rho correlation and ordinal logistic regression (IBM SPSS). Bivariate correlations were weak and non-significant (r<0.19, p>0.06). Regression identified CRM (beta=0.717, p=0.002) and CKM (beta=0.581, p=0.009) as significant positive predictors of CE; MDM showed a positive but non-significant direct effect (beta=0.346, p=0.071). The model explained 20.5% of CE variance (Nagelkerke R^2=0.205). Parallel mediation analysis (Hayes PROCESS Model 4, 5,000 bootstrap samples) found no significant indirect effects of MDM on CE via CRM (IE=0.021, 95% BC CI [-0.072, 0.121]) or CKM (IE=0.032, 95% BC CI [-0.061, 0.126]); Hypothesis H4 was not supported. CRM and CKM emerge as the principal drivers of CE within the CRI framework, while MDM functions as a foundational data quality enabler whose strategic value is realised through its enabling effect on CRM execution and knowledge management. Findings should be treated as exploratory given the sample size and cross-sectional design. Future research should replicate with larger sector-specific samples and longitudinal designs, particularly in regulated BFSI contexts where MDM architecture is shaped by data governance mandates.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨CRM、MDM和CKM如何共同构成客户关系智能（CRI）框架以提升客户参与度（CE）。基于100名跨行业参与者的横断面调查，回归分析发现CRM和CKM是CE的显著正向预测因子，而MDM虽为正向但未达显著。中介分析未支持MDM通过CRM或CKM的间接效应，但CRM和CKM仍被视为CRI框架中驱动CE的核心力量，MDM则作为基础性数据质量赋能者。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多孤立地考察CRM、MDM和CKM各自对客户参与的影响，缺乏将它们整合为统一框架（CRI）的系统性视角，本研究旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.method: 采用横断面调查设计，收集零售、医疗、IT和电信四个行业的100名参与者数据，运用Spearman rho相关分析、序数逻辑回归（IBM SPSS）以及Hayes PROCESS Model 4并行中介分析（5000次bootstrap）进行统计分析。
AI.result: 双变量相关弱且不显著（r<0.19, p>0.06）；回归显示CRM（β=0.717, p=0.002）和CKM（β=0.581, p=0.009）显著正向预测CE，MDM正向但不显著（β=0.346, p=0.071）；模型解释CE方差的20.5%；中介分析未发现显著间接效应，假设H4未获支持。
AI.conclusion: CRM和CKM是CRI框架中驱动客户参与的主要力量，MDM作为基础性数据质量赋能者，其战略价值通过促进CRM执行和知识管理间接实现。鉴于样本量和横断面设计的局限，研究结果应视为探索性发现，未来需以更大规模的行业特定样本和纵向设计进行验证，尤其应关注受数据治理要求影响的BFSI行业。

title: Spectral Prioritized Sweeping in Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning
summary: Prioritized Sweeping (PS) accelerates model-based reinforcement learning by selecting backups according to Bellman residual magnitude. In nonstationary reward settings, however, the canonical priority score is shortsighted: after a localized reward shift, residuals propagate only through realized backups, so bottlenecked or topologically distant state estimates may remain static under a limited replanning budget. We introduce the Graph Topology Augmentation framework, which employ the graph's resolvent and its diffusion semantic, to augment the inquired signal. Our application, Graph Topology Augmentation for Prioritized Sweeping (GTA-PS), or which the alias Spectral Prioritized Sweeping (SPS) might be more universal, provides a drop-in ordering score for the setting of fixed dynamics and changing state rewards. GTA-PS uses a smootherized policy, inducing a transition chain, with its in- and out-Laplacian. The standard priority key is augmented with a mixing of regularized Laplacian inverses diffusing the residual magnitude. Furthermore, the topology contribution is annealed by a scheduler based on the Second Largest Eigenvalue Modulus (SLEM), allowing its scale to adapt to the chain's mixing regime. We prove that the forward potential coincides with geometric discounted residual propagation and show that GTA-PS gives active priority instantly to all states. Tabular experiments on FourRooms and GARNET domains demonstrate improved replanning efficiency over standard PS under both exact DP and Dyna-style host planners.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Graph Topology Augmentation for Prioritized Sweeping (GTA-PS)框架（又称Spectral Prioritized Sweeping），利用图拓扑（拉普拉斯逆扩散）来增强优先清扫算法的优先级评分，解决非平稳奖励环境下标准PS"短视"的问题，提升重规划效率。
AI.motivation: 标准优先清扫（PS）在非平稳奖励环境中存在短视问题：奖励局部变化后，Bellman残差只能通过已执行的备份逐步传播，在有限的重复规划预算下，拓扑距离远或处于瓶颈状态的状态估计可能长期保持陈旧，导致重规划效率低下。
AI.method: 提出GTA-PS框架：1) 利用图的可解（resolvent）和扩散语义增强残差信号；2) 通过平滑策略诱导转移链，结合入/出拉普拉斯算子；3) 将标准优先级评分与正则化拉普拉斯逆混合以扩散残差幅度；4) 基于第二最大特征值模（SLEM）设计退火调度器，自适应调节拓扑贡献的尺度；5) 可作为drop-in的排序评分用于固定动力学、变化奖励的场景。
AI.result: 理论上证明了前向势能与几何折扣残差传播一致，且GTA-PS能即时活跃所有状态的优先级。在FourRooms和GARNET领域的表格实验中，相比标准PS（包括精确DP和Dyna风格宿主规划器），GTA-PS显著提升了重规划效率。
AI.conclusion: GTA-PS通过在优先级评分中引入图拓扑信息（拉普拉斯逆扩散和SLEM退火调度），有效克服了标准优先清扫在非平稳奖励环境中的短视性，为模型化强化学习中的高效重规划提供了一种即插即用的改进方案。

title: SCIRIGOR:Evaluating Open-Ended Scientific Analysis Beyond Final Scores
summary:
Scientific coding agents produce interdependent code, results, figures, and claims, yet evaluating final
  outputs alone does not establish whether their conclusions are scientifically supported. We formulate
  evidence-grounded multimodal scientific analysis, requiring agents to produce executable analyses and claims
  supported by results and visualizations from the same run. We introduce SciRIGOR, an evaluation framework and
  benchmark comprising 100 cases from scientific articles across six domains and 17 subfields. The framework
  reconstructs typed evidence graphs, separates artifact fidelity from relational validity, and scores complete
  claim-support paths while localizing the earliest unsupported relation. Source-grounded alternative paths
  accommodate scientifically equivalent analyses and visualizations. We evaluate 11 agent/model configurations.
  On full-benchmark runs, claims agree with faithful and unfaithful results at nearly identical rates (91.8%
  versus 91.0%). Yet no system exceeds 62.6% on the soft evidence-chain score or 18.0% strict whole-chain
  success. These findings show that internal coherence does not establish scientific correctness: evaluation
  must verify support along the complete data-to-claim path.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SciRIGOR评估框架，用于检验科学编码智能体生成的结论是否真正由其运行结果和可视化所支撑，发现现有系统内部连贯性高但证据链完整支持率极低。
AI.motivation: 科学编码智能体生成的代码、结果、图表和结论之间存在依赖关系，但仅评估最终输出无法判断其结论是否得到科学证据的支撑。现有评估忽视了从数据到结论的完整推理链条的可验证性。
AI.method: 构建SciRIGOR评估框架与基准，包含来自6个领域17个子领域的100个科学文章案例；重建类型化证据图，区分工件保真度与关系有效性，对完整声明-支持路径进行评分并定位最早不支持的关联；同时引入源接地替代路径以容纳科学等价的分析与可视化。
AI.result: 评估了11种智能体/模型配置。在完整基准运行中，声明与忠实和不忠实结果的吻合率几乎相同（91.8% vs 91.0%），但没有任何系统在软证据链得分上超过62.6%，严格全链成功率不超过18.0%。
AI.conclusion: 内部一致性并不能证明科学正确性：评估必须沿着完整的数据到声明路径验证支撑关系，否则高内聚但无根据的结论会被误判为科学有效。

title: EgoNeMo: Transferable Map of Pedestrian Dynamics via Egocentric LiDAR Scan
summary: This paper proposes a transferable Map of Dynamics (MoD) framework that generalizes to unknown environments using only egocentric 3D LiDAR point clouds to overcome the long-standing limitation of traditional MoD methods. While MoDs are essential for encoding human motion characteristics to enable accurate pedestrian trajectory prediction or safe robot navigation, traditional approaches suffer from site-specificity, requiring exhaustive trajectory accumulation at every new location. Extending recent advances in neural implicit modeling, our framework trains a continuous, LiDAR-based MoD estimator across diverse environments. To mitigate the inherent sparsity and temporal bias of real-world trajectory data, we introduce a position-balanced sampling strategy and a multi-task learning architecture that jointly predicts motion distributions and a spatial frequency score map. The latter is further augmented by visibility-aware losses to compensate for incomplete observation data.
