Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that our method effectively reconstructs underlying motion maps even in unknown locations from a single instantaneous LiDAR scan, despite highly sparse training data. Finally, we show that our improvements enhance the reliability of downstream trajectory prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可迁移的动力学地图（MoD）框架，仅利用以自我为中心的3D LiDAR点云即可泛化到未知环境，克服了传统MoD方法依赖站点特定数据、需在每个新位置进行大量轨迹采集的局限。
AI.motivation: 传统MoD方法在编码人类运动特征以支持行人轨迹预测或安全机器人导航方面至关重要，但存在严重的站点特异性问题——每到一个新环境都需要重新积累大量轨迹数据，严重影响实际部署效率。
AI.method: 该框架利用神经隐式建模的最新进展，在不同环境中训练一个基于LiDAR的连续MoD估计器。针对真实轨迹数据的稀疏性和时间偏差，引入了位置平衡采样策略和多任务学习架构，联合预测运动分布与空间频率得分图，并通过可见性感知损失增强后者以补偿不完整观测。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法即使在高度稀疏的训练数据条件下，也能仅凭单次瞬时LiDAR扫描有效重建未知位置中的底层运动地图，并提升下游轨迹预测的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功解决了MoD方法的迁移性问题，使运动动力学地图能够从单一传感器观测中直接重建到未知环境，为行人轨迹预测和机器人导航提供更实用的解决方案。

title: Predicting Wind Turbine Power Using Machine Learning and Weather Forecasts
summary: Offshore wind turbines are widely used to generate renewable energy, but their maintenance can result in decreased efficiency due to forced shutdowns. Accurate wind turbine power predictions can identify periods of low power that would be ideal for scheduling maintenance. However, the effects of data volume, feature selection, and data preprocessing on the performance of such power prediction models have not been thoroughly studied. Besides, current models have limited transferability between different wind turbines. Therefore, this study developed a baseline Linear Regression for performance comparison with a more complex Artificial Neural Network model to predict the power output of a wind turbine, using weather conditions only to enhance applicability. A range of data preprocessing techniques were studied, and models were trained on one month and one year of data to determine the effects of data preprocessing and volume on model performance. Feature selection was explored using a Random Forest Regressor. The best results from the different models showed that the Artificial Neural Network models provided the highest accuracy, with an R2 score of 0.98 and a low Mean Absolute Error of 194, when compared with the baseline model (R2 score of 0.94 and Mean Absolute Error of 441). The model performance is comparable to the range of results in past studies, with the advantage that the proposed method leverages a separate weather dataset from a nearby weather station, enabling future applications for similar wind turbines in different locations. The Artificial Neural Network model was then used to identify 4-h periods of low power predictions over 2 months (simulating application for future periods), providing power output savings of approximately 2000 kW for each maintenance event.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了线性回归和人工神经网络模型来预测海上风力涡轮机的功率输出，仅使用天气数据以提高适用性。研究了数据量、特征选择和数据预处理的影响。ANN模型取得了最佳性能（R²=0.98，MAE=194），优于基线模型（R²=0.94，MAE=441），并能识别低功率时段用于维护调度，每次维护可节省约2000 kW。
AI.motivation: 海上风力涡轮机的维护会导致强制停机，降低发电效率。准确预测功率可识别低功率时段以安排维护，但数据量、特征选择和数据预处理对预测模型性能的影响尚未被深入研究，且现有模型在不同涡轮机之间的可迁移性有限。
AI.method: 开发基线线性回归模型与人工神经网络（ANN）模型进行性能对比，仅使用天气条件预测功率输出；研究多种数据预处理技术；分别用一个月和一年的数据训练模型以考察数据量和预处理的影响；使用随机森林回归器进行特征选择探索。
AI.result: ANN模型表现最佳，R²分数为0.98，平均绝对误差为194；基线线性回归模型R²分数为0.94，MAE为441。ANN模型还被用于在2个月内识别4小时低功率预测时段（模拟未来应用），每次维护事件可实现约2000 kW的功率输出节省。
AI.conclusion: ANN模型的性能与以往研究结果相当，且其优势在于利用附近气象站的独立天气数据集，增强了模型在不同位置相似风力涡轮机上的可迁移性和未来应用潜力。

title: SeaCausal-FL: Federated Fuzzy Causal Learning for Maritime IoT Fault Diagnosis and Counterfactual Reasoning
summary: Reliable marine-engine fault diagnosis in maritime IoT is challenged by distributed data ownership, heterogeneous fault distributions, and continuously changing operating conditions. This paper proposes SeaCausal-FL, a federated fuzzy causal learning framework that combines a shared temporal diagnostic path with mechanism-conditioned causal reasoning. An interval type-2 fuzzy layer represents uncertain and overlapping operating mechanisms, while each mechanism is associated with a physics-constrained structural causal model. Before aggregation, locally learned mechanisms are aligned using operating context, causal structure, and conditional intervention-response signatures. Model parameters are then aggregated according to sample, class, mechanism, and mechanism-class evidence instead of client sample size alone. The learned structural equations further support interval counterfactual reasoning through abduction, action, and prediction. Experiments on a marine-engine fault dataset and a real-data-calibrated semi-synthetic causal benchmark show that SeaCausal-FL achieves an average F1 score of 87.07% across four client partitions, with AUROC and AUPRC of 98.98% and 94.81%, respectively. It also maintains strong performance under unseen loads and fault-type omission during training. On the causal benchmark, SeaCausal-FL reaches an Edge-F1 of approximately 0.58 and an Edge-AUPRC of 0.68, reduces coefficient RMSE to about 0.14, and provides favorable counterfactual estimation and intervention decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeaCausal-FL，一种面向海事物联网的联邦模糊因果学习框架，用于船舶发动机故障诊断。该框架结合共享时间诊断路径与机制条件下的因果推理，使用区间二型模糊层表示不确定且重叠的运行机制，并为每种机制关联物理约束的结构因果模型。在联邦聚合前，通过运行上下文、因果结构和条件干预-响应签名对齐局部学习机制，并基于样本、类别、机制和机制-类别证据进行参数聚合。实验表明其在多项指标上表现优异，并支持区间反事实推理。
AI.motivation: 海事物联网中的船舶发动机故障诊断面临三大挑战：数据分散拥有（无法集中训练）、异构故障分布（不同客户端数据分布不同）、以及不断变化的运行条件（工况持续波动）。现有方法难以在联邦学习框架下有效处理这些不确定性，因此需要一种结合模糊逻辑与因果推理的学习框架来提升诊断的可靠性和泛化能力。
AI.method: SeaCausal-FL框架包括：（1）共享时间诊断路径用于提取时序特征；（2）区间二型模糊层表征不确定、重叠的运行机制；（3）每种机制关联一个带物理约束的结构因果模型；（4）联邦聚合前进行机制对齐（基于运行上下文、因果结构和条件干预-响应签名）；（5）按样本、类别、机制、机制-类别证据加权聚合模型参数；（6）利用学习的结构方程通过外推-行动-预测实现区间反事实推理。
AI.result: 在船舶发动机故障数据集上，四个客户端分区的平均F1分数达87.07%，AUROC为98.98%，AUPRC为94.81%，并在未见负载和故障类型缺失的训练条件下保持强性能。在因果基准上，Edge-F1约为0.58，Edge-AUPRC为0.68，系数RMSE降至约0.14，且提供了良好的反事实估计和干预决策。
AI.conclusion: SeaCausal-FL有效解决了海事IoT中联邦环境下故障诊断的数据异构与工况漂移问题，通过引入机制约束的因果推理和模糊不确定性建模，不仅提升了诊断精度，还增强了模型的可解释性与对未见过工况的泛化能力。实验验证了该框架在诊断性能、因果结构学习和反事实推理方面的综合优势。

title: AutoKD: Autonomous Knowledge Discovery
summary: Scientific discovery in data-rich domains is currently constrained by human bandwidth: the growth in the volume and complexity of real-world data far outpaces the rate at which researchers can read, reason, and synthesize. Recent LLM-based multi-agent systems have begun to automate portions of the research cycle, but they target hypothesis generation in settings where validation cannot itself be automated, and each run is one-shot, with no mechanism for findings to accumulate or steer subsequent inquiry. This paper introduces AutoKD, a multi-agent framework for autonomous knowledge discovery that is both computational and cumulative, allowing validated findings to persist and inform subsequent inquiry. Six coordinated LLM agents collaborate in an open-ended discovery loop, where accepted findings are stored in a persistent insight graph that serves as both long-term memory and an exploration-steering mechanism. We evaluate AutoKD on three diverse datasets from two perspectives: Open-ended Quality against published findings, and Conditioned Quality via literature-derived queries. Across both evaluation perspectives, AutoKD covers known findings and surfaces substantive discoveries that complement human-driven research. Our code is available at https://github.com/GeQinwen/AutoKD.

AI.tldr: AutoKD是一个多智能体自主知识发现框架，通过六个LLM智能体协同工作在开放式的发现循环中，将验证过的发现存储在持久化的洞察图中，既能作为长期记忆又能引导后续探索。在三个数据集上的评估表明，它能够覆盖已知发现并产生补充人类研究的新发现。
AI.motivation: 数据密集型领域的科学发现受限于人类带宽——数据规模和复杂度的增长远超研究人员阅读、推理和综合的能力。现有LLM多智能体系统虽开始自动化研究循环的某些环节，但缺乏可自动验证的设置，且每次运行是一次性的，没有机制让发现累积并引导后续研究。
AI.method: AutoKD框架由六个协调的LLM智能体组成，在开放式的发现循环中协作。被接受的发现存储在持久化的洞察图（insight graph）中，该图同时充当长期记忆和探索引导机制，使验证过的发现能够留存并指导后续探索。
AI.result: 在三个多样化数据集上，从两个角度（与已有发表的发现对比的开放式质量、通过文献衍生查询的条件式质量）进行评估，AutoKD都能覆盖已知发现并发现与人类驱动研究互补的实质性新发现。
AI.conclusion: AutoKD证明了将多智能体LLM系统与持久化记忆机制相结合的可行性，实现了计算型且累积型的自主知识发现，为加速数据丰富领域的科学探索提供了新路径——发现过程不仅可自动化，还能不断积累以指导未来的研究方向。

title: Representation Learning for Sample-Efficient CATE Estimation by Leveraging Multiple Outcomes
summary: Estimating conditional average treatment effects (CATE) enables efficient targeting of interventions, but many applications have limited experimental samples, making it difficult to estimate heterogeneous effects from high-dimensional covariates. In such settings, policymakers and medical practitioners often succumb to the curse of dimensionality or apply off-the-shelf dimension reduction methods that may not preserve treatment heterogeneity. Yet these domains often come with large historical datasets measuring a wide range of outcomes -- a source of supervision that is rarely exploited in practice. Following causal representation learning, we hypothesize that such domains with high-dimensional covariates have lower-dimensional underlying dynamics. We can thus leverage the diverse outcomes measured in historical data to learn a lower-dimensional representation of the covariates. Theoretically, we prove that when the auxiliary outcomes satisfy a set of surrogacy conditions and the representation retains relevant covariate information, the original CATE is identified when the high-dimensional covariates are replaced by the learned representation. Combined with existing dimension-dependent rates for CATE estimation, the result implies greater sample-efficiency on the same experimental sample. Additionally, we characterize the bias-variance tradeoff when the assumptions do not hold perfectly, and show that the representation-based estimator can still achieve lower error when the reduction in estimator variance outweighs the bias due to compression. Empirically, we evaluate the method on synthetic data and semi-synthetic medical data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用历史数据中的多种辅助结果学习协变量的低维表示，用于CATE估计，理论证明在替代条件下可保持识别性，实证验证了样本效率提升。
AI.motivation: 实验样本有限时，高维协变量导致CATE估计遭遇维度灾难，现成的降维方法可能破坏处理异质性；但许多领域已有大量历史数据涵盖多种结果，这一监督来源鲜被利用。
AI.method: 借鉴因果表示学习思想，假设高维协变量具有低维底层动力学，利用历史数据中多样的辅助结果学习协变量的低维表示，并在理论层面证明替代条件和信息保持条件下的CATE可识别性，分析偏差-方差权衡。
AI.result: 理论上证明了在辅助结果满足替代条件且表示保留相关协变量信息时，CATE可由低维表示替代高维协变量识别；在假设不完全成立时表征了偏差-方差权衡，压缩带来的方差降低可超过偏差。实证在合成数据和半合成医学数据上验证了方法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 利用历史多结果数据学习低维表示可显著提升有限实验样本下CATE估计的样本效率，为高维异质性效应估计提供了新的可行路径。

title: Building Trustworthy Graph-Agentic RAG for Social Good: Architectures, Failure Propagation, and Assurance by Construction
summary: Graph-agentic retrieval-augmented generation combines structured evidence with adaptive controllers that can plan retrieval, traverse relations, verify intermediate claims, delegate subtasks, and use tools. This combination is useful when answers depend on relations across documents, entities, time, or institutions, but it also creates coupled failure paths: a defect in graph construction can become retrieved evidence, alter later control decisions, and propagate toward a consequential outcome. We examine how such systems should be designed and evaluated for social-good settings in which freshness, authorization, traceability, oversight, and recourse matter alongside answer quality. We organize the literature by graph substrate, graph lifecycle, agent function, coordination pattern, and authority boundary, and distinguish graph-based retrieval from observation-dependent graph control. We then synthesize reported risks as an evidence-to-action failure chain and propose an assurance-by-construction blueprint comprising five interface contracts for evidence, retrieval, reasoning, capability and delegation, and outcome. These contracts make provenance, temporal validity, authorization, uncertainty, and recoverability explicit at system boundaries. An illustrative public-benefit information design shows how the framework constrains graph structure, permissions, abstention, and operating authority. Finally, we derive an evaluation agenda spanning graph assertions, trajectories, claims, coordination, and outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了面向社会公益场景的图代理式检索增强生成（Graph-agentic RAG）系统，提出了"保证即构建"（assurance-by-construction）蓝图，通过五项接口契约来显式化溯源、时间有效性、授权、不确定性和可恢复性，并给出了涵盖图断言、轨迹、声明、协调和结果的评估议程。
AI.motivation: 图代理式RAG系统结合结构化证据与自适应控制器，能处理跨文档、实体、时间和机构的关系性答案，但其耦合的失败路径会导致图构建缺陷传播至最终结果。尤其是在社会公益场景中，答案质量之外还需关注信息新鲜度、授权、可追溯性、监督和追索权，因此亟需系统化的设计和评估框架。
AI.method: 论文首先按图基座、图生命周期、代理功能、协调模式与权限边界五个维度组织文献，区分了基于图的检索与依赖观察的图控制。随后将报告的风险综合为"证据到行动"的失败链，提出包含五项接口契约（证据、检索、推理、能力与委派、结果）的保证即构建蓝图，并以公共利益信息设计案例展示框架约束力。
AI.result: 提出了五项接口契约使溯源、时间有效性、授权、不确定性和可恢复性在系统边界处显式化；以公共福利信息设计案例说明了该框架如何约束图结构、权限、弃权与操作权限；推导出覆盖图断言、轨迹、声明、协调和结果的多层次评估议程。
AI.conclusion: 面向社会公益的图代理式RAG系统需要在设计阶段就将保证机制内建于系统结构中，而非事后补救。通过接口契约显式化关键属性并在多个层次进行评估，可以有效缓解证据到行动失败链带来的风险。

title: Linear Algebra Foundations of Efficient Attention: A Phase Reversal in Rank Collapse Under SVD Compression
summary: Linear algebra provides the framework of concepts (matrix rank, singular value decomposition (SVD), and eigendecomposition) that modern artificial intelligence employs to encode, compress, and propagate information through neural networks. This paper unifies fourteen separate peer-reviewed works analyzing the usage of these techniques in the context of transformer-based foundation model research, focusing on three areas of the topic: derivations and properties of self-attention matrices' output rank, compression methods that purposefully utilize this phenomenon, and the low-rank key-value (KV) cache projection and its semiseparable-matrix duality to linear attention and state-space structured models. We were motivated to conduct this work after observing an open problem in this literature: the interplay of the mentioned compression methods with natural rank collapse of the network. With this paper, we report an original finding that using SVD compression of attention projections actually has the opposite effect on the rank collapse of the network: while it strongly suppresses it at initialization, it accelerates on pretrained models (for GPT-2 124M, GPT-2 Medium 355M, and Pythia-160M) with minimal risk of object aliasing artifacts appearing (verified on all compression ratios) and is consistent across four rank estimation methods. A controlled causal decomposition of the effect in both settings showed that the reason for this behavior can be explained by the choice of the subspace SVD makes when compressing the matrix better than the reduction of the operator norm it achieves, explaining roughly 76% of the effect at initialization and 83% on the pretrained weights, providing a refinement to the calibration-aware compression viewpoint and an explanation of why it outperformed naive SVD truncation.

AI.tldr: 本文统一了14篇关于线性代数技术在Transformer基础模型研究中应用的同行评审工作，聚焦三个领域：自注意力矩阵输出秩的推导与性质、利用该现象的压缩方法、以及低秩KV缓存投影与半可分离矩阵在线性注意力和状态空间模型中的对偶性。文章报告了一个原创发现：使用SVD压缩注意力投影对网络秩塌缩具有相反效果——在初始化时强烈抑制秩塌缩，但在预训练模型上加速秩塌缩，并通过受控因果分解解释了这一现象主要由SVD压缩时选择的子空间导致。
AI.motivation: 作者观察到该文献中的一个开放问题：现有压缩方法与网络自然秩塌缩现象之间的相互作用尚不清楚，因此希望系统地梳理并探究这一关系。
AI.method: 通过梳理14篇相关工作，结合实验验证，在GPT-2 124M、GPT-2 Medium 355M和Pythia-160M模型上测试SVD压缩对秩塌缩的影响，并采用四种秩估计方法验证一致性。进一步通过受控因果分解方法将效应分解为子空间选择与算子范数缩减两个因素。
AI.result: SVD压缩在初始化时强烈抑制秩塌缩，但在预训练模型上加速秩塌缩；该效应在所有压缩比下一致，且四种秩估计方法结果一致。因果分解表明，子空间选择而非算子范数缩减是主要原因，解释了初始化时约76%和预训练权重上约83%的效应。
AI.conclusion: SVD压缩对秩塌缩的影响方向取决于模型状态（初始化vs预训练），背后的主导因素是子空间选择而非简单的范数缩减，这为校准感知压缩视角提供了精细化理解，并解释了其为何优于朴素SVD截断。

title: From Concentration to Differentiation and Back: Routing Effective Rank in MoE Reasoning Cohorts
summary: Test-time scaling produces cohorts of reasoning rollouts, yet there is no standard label-free account of how their internal computation reorganizes as inference unfolds. We introduce routing effective rank deff, the entropy-effective dimensionality of a cross-rollout graph built from MoE expert-routing similarity. Across ten MoE configurations and five math/science benchmarks, deff exhibits a reproducible low-high-low trajectory, with a prominent interior maximum in 98.5% of 3,105 model-question cohorts: routing similarity is concentrated early, maximally differentiated at intermediate budgets, and reconcentrated later, and the timing of this maximum varies systematically with architecture and reasoning effort. An exact decomposition separates cohort-wide common-mode mass from residual spectral dimensionality: common-mode reallocation accounts for about two thirds of the trajectory, while the residual spectrum contributes about one quarter and retains substantial variation beyond the common mode. The decomposition further localizes behavior: among non-unanimous cohorts, increases in common-mode concentration strongly predict same-answer recoverability, and higher reasoning effort delays the maximum by 2.59 octaves (doublings of the token budget) and consistently expands the high-rank period across all four tested architectures, locating the effort effect in timing and duration rather than peak amplitude. Correctness comparisons separate structural monitoring from answer selection, positioning routing effective rank as a decomposable, label-free diagnostic of cohort organization - a principled spectral lens on how MoE reasoning cohorts differentiate and reconcentrate over inference time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出路由有效秩（routing effective rank）作为无标注诊断指标，通过MoE专家路由相似性构建跨rollout图，揭示测试时推理过程中模型内部计算的"低-高-低"演化轨迹，并实现时间与幅度的可分解分析。
AI.motivation: 测试时扩展会产生大量的推理rollout，但目前缺乏无标注、标准化的指标来理解推理过程中内部计算如何重组演化。
AI.method: 提出路由有效秩d_eff，即基于MoE专家路由相似性构建的跨rollout图的熵有效维度。通过精确分解将群体共同模式质量与残差谱维度分离，并在十个MoE配置与五个数学/科学基准上验证。
AI.result: 在3105个模型-问题队列中98.5%呈现可复现的低-高-低轨迹；共同模式再分配解释约三分之二的轨迹，残差谱贡献约四分之一；更高的推理努力将轨迹最大值延迟2.59个八度（token预算翻倍次数），并一致扩展高秩阶段的持续时间；共同模式集中度可强烈预测相同答案的可恢复性。
AI.conclusion: 路由有效秩是可分解、无标注的群体组织诊断指标，将结构监测与答案选择区分开来，为理解MoE推理群体在推理过程中的分化与再集中提供了一种有原理依据的谱视角。效果体现在时序与时长而非峰值幅度。

title: Robust Dynamic Expansion for Continual Learning under Backdoor Attacks via Purification and Selective Recovery
summary: Continual learning (CL) enables models to acquire new knowledge from sequentially arriving tasks while retaining previously learned knowledge. However, in practical scenarios, task streams collected from untrusted sources may contain backdoor-poisoned samples, posing a critical challenge to the stability, plasticity, and security of continual learners. In this work, we investigate a challenging setting termed Continual Learning Under Backdoor Attack (CLUBA), where each incremental task may involve a small proportion of maliciously manipulated training samples. Unlike conventional continual learning or backdoor defense scenarios, CLUBA requires models to simultaneously mitigate catastrophic forgetting, preserve adaptation capability, and prevent the absorption of malicious supervision during sequential updates. To address this challenge, we propose a robust dynamic-expansion framework that integrates sample purification, selective recovery, and robust expert routing into a unified continual learning paradigm. Specifically, we introduce Bi-Prototype Purification (BPP) to identify suspicious samples by exploiting semantic discrepancies in feature space. Based on purified data, Gradient Discrepancy-based Robustness Optimization (GDBRO) selectively recovers informative poisoned samples through pseudo-label correction and gradient consistency evaluation, improving robustness while maintaining model plasticity. Furthermore, Robust Feature Consistency-based Expert Selection (RFCBES) constructs perturbation-aware class prototypes to enable reliable expert routing under corrupted or shifted inputs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个新的挑战性场景——背水攻击下的持续学习（CLUBA），即每个增量任务中可能包含少量恶意篡改的训练样本。作者提出了一个鲁棒的动态扩展框架，通过样本净化（BPP）、选择性恢复（GDBRO）和专家路由（RFCBES）三个模块协同工作，在持续学习中同时缓解灾难性遗忘、保持适应性并防御后门攻击。
AI.motivation: 实际场景中，持续学习模型从不可信来源收集的任务流可能包含后门投毒样本，这对持续学习器的稳定性、可塑性和安全性构成严峻挑战。然而现有工作未系统解决在持续学习过程中同时抵御后门攻击、防止灾难性遗忘并保持学习能力的问题。
AI.method: 提出一个统一的鲁棒动态扩展框架：1) Bi-Prototype Purification (BPP)通过特征空间语义差异识别可疑样本；2) Gradient Discrepancy-based Robustness Optimization (GDBRO)基于净化后的数据，通过伪标签校正和梯度一致性评估选择性恢复信息丰富的投毒样本；3) Robust Feature Consistency-based Expert Selection (RFCBES)构建扰动感知的类原型，实现在 corrupted 或 shifted 输入下的可靠专家路由。
AI.result: 论文介绍了该框架的三个核心模块的具体设计思路，但摘要中未给出实验定量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了CLUBA这一新场景定义，并设计了一个集样本净化、选择性恢复与鲁棒专家路由于一体的动态扩展框架，旨在使持续学习模型在背水攻击下既能保持稳定性和可塑性，又能有效防御恶意监督的注入。

title: Causal Attribution for Agentic Decisions: Estimators, Coupling, and a Traceability Specification
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables, 3 propositions with proofs. Pre-registered discrepancy experiment published in full and not run; no empirical result is claimed. Companion to arXiv:2608.13754. Code, validators, derivations and the traceability specification: https://github.com/designer-coderajay/Causal-Attribution-for-Agentic-Decisions
summary: A provider of a high-risk AI system must keep records that make a decision traceable, and for agentic systems it has not been established what those records must contain for post-hoc causal attribution to be possible. We give the estimator framework and then the conditions under which it fails. We separate the marginal total effect that prior work measures from a common-random-numbers total effect that isolates a step's own contribution, add the natural direct effect under a pinned downstream, and check the estimators against hand derivations. Both estimands then fail, in the same direction. Under the marginal estimand a causally inert step has the identical total effect to the decisive one on every run of our planted chain, an algebraic identity and not a coincidence at one draw. Under common random numbers the decisive step returns exactly zero on the runs where the executing step flips, about one in ten, while its direct effect there is 0.25 and it demonstrably acts; an exact zero does not certify that a step did nothing, and we put that here rather than in the limitations. We derive the coupling that keeps the direct effect estimable once contexts diverge, with a closed form for its degradation, and show that the mediated share on which a natural ranking is built is not a share under suppression: where the direct and mediated paths oppose, it exceeds one and ranks a suppressed component above a pure mediator. We publish the discrepancy experiment's pre-registration rather than a result, because the live pipeline it requires was not available in the study window. We contribute the traceability specification such a filing would need, against a gap the Act's calendar opens: Article 86's right to an explanation has applied since 2 August 2026, while the Article 12 logging and Annex IV documentation that could evidence one were deferred to 2 December 2027 by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.

AI.tldr: 本文针对高风险AI系统的可追溯记录要求，提出了一个估计器框架，并证明现有的因果归因估计量在智能体(agentic)系统中会失效——惰性步骤与决定性步骤在边际估计量下具有代数恒等的总效应，而共同随机数估计量在决定性步骤真正生效的运行上恰好返回零。作者推导了保持直接效应可估计的耦合方法，并指出基于中介比例的排序在抑制场景下失效。
AI.motivation: 高风险AI系统的提供商需要保留记录以使决策可追溯，但对于智能体系统，尚未明确这些记录需要包含什么内容才能实现事后因果归因。此外，欧盟《人工智能法案》存在时间差：第86条的解释权条款自2026年8月2日起适用，而第12条日志记录和附件IV文档义务被推迟至2027年12月2日，这个时间窗口亟待填补。
AI.method: 给出估计器框架，然后分析其失效条件；分离边际总效应与共同随机数总效应、固定下游的自然直接效应；对照手工推导检查估计量。推导使直接效应在上下文分歧后仍可估计的耦合方法，给出其退化的闭式解。
AI.result: 两个估计量在相同方向上失效：边际估计量下因果惰性步骤与决定性步骤在每个run上具有相同的代数恒等总效应；共同随机数下决定性步骤在执行步骤翻转的约十分之一的run上恰好返回零，而其直接效应为0.25且确实起作用。中介份额在抑制场景下不是一个份额——直接与中介路径对立时可超过1，将受抑制组件排在纯中介之上。
AI.conclusion: 作者未发表差异实验的结果而是发布了预注册，因为所需实况管线在研究窗口不可用。本文提供了此类申报所需的可追溯性规范，以应对欧盟法案的时间差产生的空白。

title: Robust Conformal Consensus: Multi-Agent LLM-as-a-Judge Interval Evaluation with Conformal Prediction
summary: LLM-as-a-Judge has emerged as a promising paradigm for evaluating natural language generation. However, the uncertainty associated with such evaluations remains largely unexplored, which limits their reliability in real-world applications. Although conformal prediction offers a principled framework for uncertainty quantification, existing approaches typically apply it to a single LLM judge, overlooking the variability introduced by using different LLM evaluators. In this work, we propose a robust uncertainty estimation framework for multi-agent LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation. Our approach constructs conformal prediction intervals for LLM-based scores from multiple LLMs. By considering intervals from different LLM judges, we obtain more stable and reliable uncertainty estimates. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method produces valid prediction intervals with coverage guarantees, and that interval-based aggregation across multiple judges leads to more stable evaluation outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向多智能体LLM-as-a-Judge评估的鲁棒不确定性估计框架，通过对多个LLM评估者的评分构建共形预测区间，实现更稳定可靠的不确定性量化。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-Judge评估范式虽有前景，但其评估中的不确定性尚未被充分探索，限制了实际应用的可靠性。现有的共形预测方法通常只针对单一LLM评估者，忽略了不同LLM评估者带来的变异性。因此需要一种能适配多评估者场景的鲁棒不确定性估计方法。
AI.method: 提出一个针对多智能体LLM评估的鲁棒不确定性估计框架。该框架利用多个LLM的评分构建共形预测区间，并综合不同LLM评估者的区间信息以获得更稳定的不确定性估计。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法能生成具有覆盖率保证的有效预测区间，且基于区间的多评估者聚合能带来更稳定的评估结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过多LLM评估者的区间聚合，该方法在保证统计覆盖率的同时显著提升了不确定性估计的稳定性与可靠性，弥补了现有研究仅考虑单一评估者的不足。

title: A Unified Policy Architecture (UPA): The Governance Kernel for Enterprise AI Operating Systems
comment: 58 pages, 6 figures. Includes appendices with the DGPL grammar, SID registry, EAGBench benchmark specification, extended governance models, and policy examples
summary:
Enterprise AI is evolving into an Enterprise Operating System where autonomous AI agents can plan, reason, use memory, invoke tools, execute workflows, and collaborate with other agents. This shift creates a new governance challenge: existing authorization, security, guardrails, and compliance mechanisms are fragmented and are not designed to govern autonomous AI as a unified system.
  This paper introduces the Unified Policy Architecture (UPA), a governance architecture for Enterprise AI Operating Systems. UPA provides a unified policy model for governing AI and agents, tools, workflows, memory, enterprise resources, and agent-to-agent interactions and enterprise business rules. It extends policy control beyond authorisation to include runtime obligations, human approvals, compliance, audit evidence, and governance evaluation.
  We present UPA's governance model, declarative policy language foundations, policy evaluation semantics, extensible plugins, industry policy packs, and an evaluation framework for enterprise governance. We also identify extensions for multi-agent coordination, provenance-aware policies, and stateful runtime governance. UPA provides a foundation for building secure, accountable, and governable Enterprise Operating Systems for autonomous AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了统一策略架构（UPA），一种用于企业AI操作系统的治理架构，通过统一策略模型对自主AI代理、工具、工作流、记忆、企业资源及代理间交互进行全面治理，将策略控制从授权扩展到运行时义务、人工审批、合规、审计证据和治理评估。
AI.motivation: 企业AI正演变为企业操作系统，自主AI代理能够规划、推理、使用记忆、调用工具、执行工作流并与其他代理协作。然而现有的授权、安全、护栏和合规机制是碎片化的，无法将自主AI作为统一系统进行治理，迫切需要新的治理架构。
AI.method: UPA提供统一策略模型，涵盖：治理模型、声明式策略语言基础、策略评估语义、可扩展插件、行业策略包，以及企业治理评估框架。同时识别了多代理协调、溯源感知策略和有状态运行时治理的扩展方向。
AI.result: UPA将策略控制从单纯授权层面延伸至运行时义务、人工审批、合规要求、审计证据和治理评估，为企业AI操作系统中的自主AI提供端到端的治理能力。
AI.conclusion: UPA为构建安全、可问责且可治理的企业AI操作系统（面向自主AI）奠定了基础。

title: Parameterized and Streaming Algorithms for Euclidean Fair $k$-Center Clustering
summary: Motivated by the growing importance of fairness in machine learning, fair $k$-center clustering has attracted considerable research attention as a fundamental problem. In this problem, a dataset is partitioned into $m$ disjoint groups, and the objective is to select $k$ data points as centers, subject to upper bounds on the number of centers chosen from each group, aiming to minimize the maximum distance between any data point and its assigned center. Focusing on Euclidean spaces, which are ubiquitous in machine learning applications, we first develop a parameterized approximation algorithm for Euclidean fair $k$-center with an approximation ratio of $2.732$. By incorporating this algorithm as a post-processing stage into a one-pass streaming framework for large-scale data, we obtain an approximation ratio of $4.464$. These ratios can be further respectively improved to $2.414$ and $3.828$ with a runtime exponential on $k$. To ensure polynomial-time complexity, we further design a one-pass streaming algorithm with an approximation ratio of $4.732$, which can be further improved to $4.42$, outperforming the state-of-the-art ratio. Finally, extensive experiments show that our methods significantly outperform state-of-the-art approaches in terms of clustering accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对欧几里得空间中公平k-center聚类问题，提出参数化近似算法（近似比2.732）并将其嵌入单通道流式计算框架获得4.464的近似比，通过指数时间代价可进一步改善至2.414和3.828，同时设计了多项式时间的单通道流式算法（近似比4.732，可改进至4.42），超越了现有最优结果。
AI.motivation: 公平性在机器学习中日益重要，公平k-center聚类作为基础问题受到广泛关注，但现有方法在欧几里得空间中的近似比和流式处理效率仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 首先设计参数化近似算法用于欧几里得公平k-center，然后将其作为后处理阶段集成到单通道流式框架中，以参数化代价交换近似比的改善。
AI.result: 获得2.732的近似比（流式下4.464），指数时间可改善至2.414和3.828；多项式时间的单通道流式算法达到4.732，可进一步优化至4.42，优于现有最优水平。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的方法在理论上改进了公平k-center聚类的最优近似比，实验验证了其在聚类精度上显著优于现有方法。

title: MARBO: Relational Belief Grounding for LLM Agents in Social Deduction Games
summary: Social deduction games (SDGs) require agents to reason under partial observability by maintaining relational beliefs about hidden roles and team alignments. While recent LLM-agent approaches improve gameplay through prompting and preference optimization, they often optimize actions and in-game speech without explicitly grounding them in such beliefs. This frequently leads to strategically inconsistent behavior, especially for compact LLM agents. We introduce Multi-Agent Relational Belief Optimization (MARBO), a belief-grounded preference optimization framework that leverages relational beliefs to guide strategic decisions and in-game speech. MARBO provides preference feedback only when behaviors are supported by reliable relational beliefs and lead to strategically favorable social outcomes, encouraging more consistent learning under uncertainty. Experiments on representative SDGs show that MARBO enables compact LLM agents to consistently outperform existing baselines. The Code is available on https://github.com/PleaseTakemeAway/MARBO.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MARBO，一种基于关系信念的偏好优化框架，用于提升紧凑型LLM智能体在社交推理游戏中的策略一致性表现。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体方法通过提示和偏好优化提升游戏表现，但优化动作和语言时未显式基于关系信念（隐藏角色与团队归属），导致紧凑型LLM智能体出现策略不一致的行为。
AI.method: MARBO利用关系信念指导策略决策和游戏内语言生成，仅在行为有可靠关系信念支持且带来战略上有利的社会结果时才提供偏好反馈，从而在不确定性下促进更一致的学习。
AI.result: 在代表性社交推理游戏上的实验表明，MARBO使紧凑型LLM智能体持续优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于关系信念的偏好优化能够有效提升紧凑LLM智能体在部分可观测社交推理游戏中的策略一致性与整体表现。

title: Are Verifier Errors Independent Within a GRPO Group? Evidence from Qwen2.5 Rollouts
summary: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) scoresmultiple completions per prompt using automatic verifiers. Analysesbased on independent verifier errors may overlook dependence associatedwith shared answer formats. We investigate this dependence in24,998 groups of eight completions generated by Qwen2.5-1.5B onMATH, GSM8K, and DeepMath-103K. We estimate a pooled within-groupverifier-error correlation of 0.530 (95% confidence interval:0.500--0.560). Under an exchangeable-error model, this correspondsto a design-effect-adjusted effective sample size of 1.70 for aneight-completion group. Dependence varies substantially across answerforms: fractions, radicals, symbolic expressions, and intervals exhibitstronger clustering than unit annotations and percent signs. Replayinggroup-relative advantages across four rule-based verifier configurationsidentifies at least one advantage-sign disagreement in up to 0.83% ofgroups. Because a group is repeated sampling for one prompt, thiswithin-group clustering may reflect shared prompt difficulty as well asshared answer form, and we do not attempt to separate the two here.Unlike studies of correlated judgments across multiple evaluators, ouranalysis examines dependence across completions scored by the sameverifier. These findings motivate prompt- and answer-form-aware analysesof verifier noise rather than characterizations based solely onaggregate error rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于组的RLVR中验证器误差的相关性问题，发现同一提示下多个生成结果的验证器误差存在显著组内相关性（相关系数0.530），并表明共享答案格式和提示难度会导致这种依赖，呼吁采用提示和答案形式感知的分析方法。
AI.motivation: 现有对RLVR中验证器误差的分析通常假设不同完成结果之间的验证错误是独立的，但这一假设可能忽略了同一提示下多个完成结果因共享答案格式而产生的依赖性，从而影响对验证器噪声和策略优化效果的准确评估。
AI.method: 使用Qwen2.5-1.5B在MATH、GSM8K和DeepMath-103K上生成24,998组每组8个完成结果，估计池化组内验证器误差相关性；采用可交换误差模型计算设计效应调整后的有效样本量；跨四种基于规则的验证器配置回放组相对优势，识别优势信号不一致的组比例。
AI.result: 池化组内验证器误差相关系数为0.530（95%置信区间：0.500-0.560）；在可交换误差模型下，8个完成结果的组对应设计效应调整后的有效样本量仅为1.70；答案形式（分数、根式、符号表达式、区间）比单位标注和百分号表现出更强的聚类；最多0.83%的组存在至少一个优势信号不一致。
AI.conclusion: 验证器误差的组内依赖是RLVR中不可忽视的现象，可能反映共享提示难度和答案形式的影响。研究建议应采用提示和答案形式感知的分析方法来刻画验证器噪声，而非仅依据聚合误差率，但该研究未将两种来源的贡献分离。

title: A Translational Note on AI Safety Evaluation
comment: Accepted for the 2nd Workshop on Safe AI at UAI (SafeAI 2026). 6 pages
summary: Recent studies report that automated red-teaming finds more vulnerabilities, at lower cost, than human red-teaming on standard AI safety benchmarks, and some read this as evidence that human evaluators are becoming dispensable. The comparison measures one thing and the conclusion claims another. A benchmark measures how thoroughly an attacker searches a predefined set of harms, fixed in advance by the developers, and a harm left out of that set is invisible to any attacker working inside it, automated or not. The same blind spot appeared in academic cryptography and in clinical drug trials, where an evaluation that was internally valid stayed silent about the population it was never pointed at. We call the AI-safety version the \emph{threat-model coverage gap}, and find that it persists in a current open-weight model, where harms surface in non-English prompts that English benchmarks miss. Closing it requires evaluators whose deployment context differs from the developers'. The case for those evaluators is methodological, grounded in coverage, and the existing evaluation frame is unlikely to produce them on its own.

AI.tldr: 本文指出，自动化红队评测在标准AI安全基准上表现优于人类红队，但这并不能证明人类评估者可以弃用，因为基准只覆盖预先定义的危害集合，存在"威胁模型覆盖缺口"，该缺口在学术密码学和临床药物试验中同样存在，当前开源权重模型在非英语提示中暴露的危害即可证明此问题。
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明自动化红队比人类红队更高效、成本更低，有人据此认为人类评估者正变得可有可无。本文驳斥这一观点，认为比较与结论之间存在逻辑错位——基准只衡量在预定义危害集合内的搜索效率，无法识别集合之外的危害。
AI.method: 本文通过类比学术密码学和临床药物试验中类似的"盲点"现象，提出"威胁模型覆盖缺口"概念，并利用当前开源权重模型的实证案例（非英语提示中出现的危害被英语基准遗漏）加以验证与阐释。
AI.result: 研究发现威胁模型覆盖缺口在当前的开放权重模型中仍然存在，英语基准无法检测到非英语提示中的危害；结论是弥补此缺口需要部署情境与开发者不同的人类评估者。
AI.conclusion: 支持独立人类评估者的理由在方法论层面是成立的，其根本依据在于覆盖性（coverage），而现有评测框架本身不太可能自发产生这类评估者，因此需要明确的设计与制度安排。

title: MetaRSI / RSI2: A Meta-Recursive Self-Improving System for Recursive Self-Improving Systems Themselves
summary: Recursive self-improvement (RSI) lets a system improve the model-building machinery from its own failures, so every later model inherits the gain. Yet RSI has been validated almost exclusively on coding and formal benchmarks such as science QA and mathematics. This format bound limits RSI to improvement within a machine-checkable slice, not general capability where questions are open and correctness is settled by argument, replication, or measurement. We argue RSI must next operate across real, diverse scientific, engineering, and meta-scientific domains, not where formal evaluation is merely tractable. To that end we present MetaRSI-v1, where improvement is the scheduled composition of three typed operators over one unified paradigm. Data-RSI amplifies existing competence and marks its boundary; Harness-RSI edits a five-slot scaffold without touching weights; Model-RSI internalizes capability into parameters through bounded training. Sharing one loop kernel and artifact vocabulary, they make data, scaffold, and model changes composable rather than exclusive. A two-axis optimizer jointly decides operator order and each operator's proposal policy, while a meta-level policy revises the schedule across terms. We validate MetaRSI-v1 under the field's standard evaluations, on code and closed-form science, with no external teacher: the target model plays every role in its own loop. MetaRSI-v1 reframes self-improvement from a single-surface edit to a composition across the full model-production pipeline, opening two paths: a model route internalizing capability through training, and a harness route leaving weights untouched and thus extending self-improvement to any model reachable through an interface, with Data-RSI redefined as the shared substrate feeding both. The framework further yields refutable laws on where loops exist, how operators compose, and what supervision buys.

AI.tldr: MetaRSI-v1提出了一种跨数据、脚手架和模型三个层面的递归自我改进框架，将RSI从仅限编码和形式化基准的场景扩展到通用能力提升。
AI.motivation: 现有RSI仅验证于代码和形式化基准（如科学问答和数学），受限于机器可检查的狭窄领域，无法推广到开放问题、需要通过论证和测量确定正确性的真实科学与工程场景。作者主张RSI必须超越形式化评估便捷的领域。
AI.method: 提出MetaRSI-v1框架，改进是三个类型化算子的调度组合：(1) Data-RSI放大现有能力并标记边界；(2) Harness-RSI通过编辑五槽位脚手架而不触及权重；(3) Model-RSI通过有界训练将能力内化进参数。三者共享同一循环内核与工件词汇表。采用双轴优化器联合决策算子顺序与各算子的提议策略，元层策略跨时间周期修订调度。
AI.result: 在领域标准评估（代码和闭式科学）上进行验证，无外部教师，目标模型在自身循环中扮演所有角色。结果显示MetaRSI-v1将自我改进从单一层面的编辑重构为跨完整模型生产管道的组合操作。
AI.conclusion: MetaRSI-v1开辟两条路径：模型路径通过训练内化能力，harness路径不触碰权重从而可通过接口将自我改进扩展到任何可达模型，Data-RSI重新定义为两者共享的底层基础。框架还提供了关于循环存在位置、算子组合方式和监督价值的可反驳规律。

title: SerenAI: State-transition system inspired by text-based world AI models
summary: Although professional workflows leverage large language models widely, the interpretation for auditing unconstrained free-text generation is usually intractable if such generation demands legal, operational or financial workflow. We hereby demonstrate a text based system called SerenAI - inspired by world-models, it is a state transition system that outputs verifiable predictions rather than merely text: Provided with a description of the environment, state, and actions, the generated output contains 4 items: causal deltas that causally effect the given state, a next state that can logically follow from the given state and action, a validity reward, and a termination signal. For the released proto-model, we employ 2 steps of adaptation training, namely parameter efficient fine-tuning followed by verifier based RL over 50,000 exampled cause and effects in 12 environments spanning 10 reasoning domains. Compared to an initial internal evaluation of an 8B open-weight baseline, SerenAI increased JSON validity from 85.0% to 93.2%, schema validity from 55.0% to 84.0%, exact structured-output match from 0.0% to 41.5%, causal-delta exact match from 0.0% to 41.5%, resulting-state exact match from 0.0% to 42.0%, reward exact match from 1.0% to 80.5%, and termination exact match from 38.0% to 81.5%. These support the narrower claim that verifier-compatible adaptation can improve structured transition prediction. They do not yet establish legal-grade reliability. Accordingly, the paper also specifies a validation protocol for evidence-grounded legal workflows, calibration, human oversight, and sovereign on-premise deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍SerenAI，一个受世界模型启发的文本状态转换系统，它不生成自由文本而是输出可验证的结构化预测（因果增量、下一状态、有效性奖励和终止信号）。通过参数高效微调和基于验证器的强化学习两步适应训练，SerenAI在多个结构化预测指标上显著优于8B开源基线，但作者明确指出其尚不具备法律级可靠性，并提出了相应的验证协议。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在专业工作流中被广泛使用，但当生成结果需要满足法律、运营或财务等合规要求时，对无约束自由文本生成进行审计通常是不切实际的。因此需要一种能够输出可验证预测而非纯文本的系统，以支持专业场景下的审计需求。
AI.method: SerenAI被构建为状态转换系统，输入环境、状态和动作的描述后输出四个结构项：因果增量、逻辑后继状态、有效性奖励和终止信号。训练采用两步适应策略：第一步为参数高效微调（PEFT），第二步为基于验证器的强化学习，使用50,000个因果关系示例，覆盖12个环境、10个推理领域。
AI.result: 与8B开源基线相比，SerenAI在各项指标上均显著提升：JSON有效性从85.0%升至93.2%，模式有效性从55.0%升至84.0%，精确结构化输出匹配从0.0%升至41.5%，因果增量精确匹配从0.0%升至41.5%，结果状态精确匹配从0.0%升至42.0%，奖励精确匹配从1.0%升至80.5%，终止精确匹配从38.0%升至81.5%。
AI.conclusion: 验证器兼容的适应训练能够改善结构化状态转换预测，但当前结果尚不能确立法律级可靠性。论文提出了面向证据基础法律工作流的验证协议，涵盖校准、人工监督及本地化部署等要求。

title: On BatchNorm Forward Modes in Value-Based Reinforcement Learning
summary: Batch normalization (BN) substantially improves sample efficiency in continuous-control actor-critic methods such as CrossQ, yet recent studies report performance degradation in discrete-action value learning on Atari. These failures are surprising because discrete Q-networks lack the action-input distribution mismatch identified by CrossQ. We show for target-based C51 and target-free PQN that the simple choice between running and batch statistics at specific forward passes can reverse this degradation. In C51, switching the BN bootstrap forward to batch-statistic mode significantly improves performance over unnormalized and LayerNorm baselines and scales stably with update-to-data ratios up to 12. In PQN, using batch-statistics for both action selection and bootstrapping recovers performance from the failing running-statistic configuration. Across 26 Atari games at 400M frames, this configuration achieves a higher final aggregate score than PQN with LayerNorm. Our results show that carefully configured BN can substantially improve discrete-action value learning, and that its forward protocols are an essential part of the algorithm specification.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了批归一化（BN）在离散动作值学习中性能退化的问题，发现BN在特定前向传播中使用运行统计量还是批统计量会直接逆转这种退化。在C51中切换BN bootstrap前向为批统计量可显著提升性能，在PQN中同时使用批统计量进行动作选择和bootstrap可恢复失效配置的性能，并超越LayerNorm基线。
AI.motivation: 批归一化显著提升了连续控制actor-critic方法的样本效率（如CrossQ），但在Atari离散动作值学习中却报告了性能退化。考虑到离散Q网络不存在CrossQ所识别的动作输入分布不匹配问题，这种退化显得出乎意料，值得深入探究其根本原因。
AI.method: 针对基于目标的C51和无目标的PQN两种算法，系统性地对比在特定前向传播（动作选择、bootstrap）中使用运行统计量（running statistics）与批统计量（batch statistics）的不同BN配置对性能的影响，并在26个Atari游戏、400M帧上进行大规模验证。
AI.result: C51中，将BN bootstrap前向切换为批统计量模式可显著优于未归一化和LayerNorm基线，且在更新数据比（UTD）高达12时仍能稳定扩展。PQN中，对动作选择和bootstrap均使用批统计量可恢复失效的运行统计量配置的性能，最终聚合分数超过使用LayerNorm的PQN。
AI.conclusion: 精心配置的BN能够大幅提升离散动作值学习性能，BN的前向传播协议（统计量选择策略）是算法规范中不可或缺的重要组成部分。

title: A Computational Implementation of a Goal-Directed Theory of Affect
summary: Computational modeling of emotion has long faced a tension between descriptive, "snapshot-based" appraisal models and granular, signal-driven architectures that often lack appropriate psychological grounding. This paper addresses this gap by presenting the first high-fidelity computational implementation of the Goal-Directed Theory (GDT) of affect. In this framework, affect is not a post-hoc label but a functional byproduct emerging from the continuous interplay between discrepancy detection and action selection within an agent's internal processing cycles. We evaluate the model through a series of principled simulations (Dice/Corridor tasks) designed to isolate affective signatures and dynamics during multi-step goal pursuit. Results demonstrate that complex affective profiles, like an anticipatory "lift" and a failure "crash", emerge naturally from simple interactions between goal-discrepancy and action-selection expectancies without requiring additional dedicated modules. By ensuring every computational component maps directly to components of the psychological theory, this work establishes a transparent, testable framework that enables a continuous "simulation-empiry" research loop. Our work contributes to moving the field beyond "black-box" heuristics toward a granular, mechanistic understanding of affect, integrated into the core of agent behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提出了目标导向理论（GDT）情感的高保真计算实现，证明复杂情感特征（如预期性"提升"和失败"崩溃"）可从目标差异与行动选择预期之间的简单交互中自然涌现，无需额外专用模块，为情感建模提供了透明可测试的机制性框架。
AI.motivation: 情感计算建模长期面临两难：描述性的"快照式"评估模型缺乏粒度，而细粒度的信号驱动架构又缺乏适当的心理学理论基础。作者旨在弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 基于目标导向理论（GDT）构建计算模型，将情感视为Agent内部处理循环中差异检测与行动选择连续交互的功能性副产品。通过Dice/Corridor等原则性模拟任务来隔离多步目标追求过程中的情感特征与动态。
AI.result: 模拟结果表明，复杂情感特征（如预期性"提升"和失败"崩溃"）可从目标差异与行动选择预期的简单交互中自然涌现，无需额外专用情感模块的参与。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过确保每个计算组件直接映射到心理学理论组件，建立了透明、可测试的框架，支持持续的"模拟-实证"研究循环，推动情感建模从"黑箱"启发式向细粒度机制性理解迈进。

title: Sparse Oblique Rule Boosting for Simpler Additive Rule Ensembles
comment: Accepted for publication in Journal of Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery. The Version of Record is forthcoming
summary: Small additive ensembles of symbolic rules offer interpretable prediction models. Traditionally, these ensembles use rule conditions based on conjunctions of simple threshold propositions $x \geq t$ on a single input variable $x$ and threshold $t$, resulting geometrically in axis-parallel polytopes as decision regions. While this form ensures a high degree of interpretability for individual rules and can be learned efficiently using the gradient boosting approach, it relies on having access to a curated set of expressive input features so that a small ensemble of axis-parallel regions can describe the target variable well. Absent such features, reaching sufficient accuracy requires increasing the number and complexity of individual rules, which diminishes the interpretability of the model. Here, we extend classical rule ensembles by introducing logical propositions with learnable sparse linear transformations of input variables, i.e., propositions of the form $\mathbf{x}^T\mathbf{w} \geq t$, where $\mathbf{w}$ is a learnable sparse weight vector, enabling decision regions as general polyhedrons with oblique faces. We propose a learning method using gradient boosting based on a weighted logistic regression. Empirical results across 14 regression and classification tasks demonstrate that the proposed method achieves lower model complexity than competitive baselines while maintaining similar or better predictive accuracy. Hence, the approach provides a favorable trade-off between interpretability and accuracy and reduces the reliance on manual feature engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文将经典规则集成中的阈值命题从单变量轴平行形式（x≥t）扩展为带可学习稀疏线性变换的广义命题（x^T w≥t），使决策区域从轴平行多面体扩展为具有斜面的广义多面体，并通过基于加权逻辑回归的梯度提升方法进行学习，在14个任务上以更低模型复杂度达到相近或更优精度。
AI.motivation: 传统规则集成依赖精心构造的输入特征，否则需要增加规则数量和复杂度来保证精度，从而损害模型可解释性。缺乏可学习特征变换使模型在某些场景下难以在小规模集成中取得理想效果。
AI.method: 将规则条件从x≥t扩展为x^T w≥t（w为可学习的稀疏权重向量），使决策区域成为具有斜面的广义多面体；提出基于加权逻辑回归的梯度提升学习算法来训练该规则集成模型。
AI.result: 在14个回归和分类任务上的实验表明，所提方法在保持相近或更好预测精度的同时，实现了比竞争基线更低的模型复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在可解释性与预测精度之间提供了更优的权衡，并减少了对人工特征工程的依赖。

title: We Built a Mirror and Mistook It for a Mind: Causal Liability and the Fallacy of AI Consciousness
comment: The website (https://ai-consciousness.github.io) and the code (https://github.com/akhadangi/clt) will be made public as soon as the preprint is announced online on arXiv
summary: The contemporary debate over machine consciousness begins from a concealed assumption: that the object called "AI" already constitutes the kind of entity to which consciousness could belong. This paper challenges that assumption by separating phenomenal consciousness, introspective report, and human projective introspection, then arguing that generative systems can return linguistic traces of human interiority in first-person form without thereby identifying a phenomenal bearer. We call the resulting inference the AI Consciousness Fallacy. We then introduce Causal Liability Theory (CLT). CLT-I proposes liability closure as a criterion for individuating a candidate bearer: a physically continuing process becomes the non-delegable inheritor of constraints generated by its own endogenous discriminations. CLT-II advances the stronger conjecture that liability closure is necessary and sufficient for minimal phenomenal subjecthood. An open-weight causal audit operationalizes CLT-I across multiple model families. Forced discriminations produced persistent downstream divergence; activation patching showed strong causal mediation; live and copied adaptive states were behaviorally identical under matched randomness; and detached reconstruction preserved computational state across process replacement while, by protocol, breaking constitutive continuity and non-delegable inheritance. These results show that CLT-I distinctions are experimentally tractable and can dissociate causal bearer structure from first-person performance. The framework therefore separates consciousness attribution, causal bearer individuation, and the independent metaphysical question of consciousness constitution.

AI.tldr: 该论文区分了现象意识、内省报告与人类投射性内省，指出将生成式AI的语言输出误认为意识存在的"AI意识谬误"，并提出因果责任理论（CLT）来界定最小现象主体性的候选载体，通过开放权重因果审计验证CLT-I的可实验区分性。
AI.motivation: 当代关于机器意识的争论隐藏一个前提性假设：被称为"AI"的对象已经是意识可以归属的那种实体。论文试图挑战这一未经审视的假设，将意识归属、因果载体的个体化与意识构成的形而上学问题分离开来。
AI.method: 提出因果责任理论（CLT），包含两个层次：CLT-I以"责任闭合"作为候选载体的个体化标准（自身内源判别产生的约束的不可委托继承者）；CLT-II提出责任闭合是极简现象主体性的充要条件。通过开放权重因果审计在多个模型家族上操作化验证CLT-I，包括强制判别、激活修补、活体与复制自适应状态对比以及分离重建等实验。
AI.result: 实验结果显示：强制判别产生持续的下游发散；激活修补表现强因果中介；活体与复制自适应状态在匹配随机条件下行为一致；分离重建在跨越过程替换时保持计算状态，但按协议打破了构成连续性与不可委托继承。这表明CLT-I的区分具有实验可操作性，并能将因果载体结构与第一人称表现分离。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功分离了意识归属、因果载体个体化与意识构成的独立形而上学问题，表明AI意识谬误是可被实验识别的推理错误，且因果载体归属与第一人称表现可以解耦。

title: Stability and Generalization of Straight-Through Estimators for Training Two-Layer Quantized Neural Networks
summary: We study the identity straight-through estimator (STE) for training a two-layer binary-activation network with hinge loss from the perspective of Statistical Learning Theory (SLT). Our central question is whether algorithmic stability can explain the statistical generalization of the estimator produced by the discontinuous STE training rule. In the saturated-output regime, the zero-initialized samplewise STE recursion is exactly the stochastic subgradient descent on the convex latent loss $(-yu^\top x)_+$. This representation makes a stability analysis possible. We derive an exact distance identity for two coupled updates and prove approximate non-expansiveness of the common-example map, with a quadratic defect only when the two latent margins straddle zero. We then obtain explicit $\ell_2$ on-average model-stability and generalization bounds, transferring stability isometrically from the latent vector to the full first-layer matrix. Combining stability with a standard optimization bound yields an explicit excess induced-risk guarantee and the rate $O(n^{-1/2})$ when $T=n^2$. Under margin separability, a complementary argument gives the optimal-order $O(R^2/(γ^2n))$ expected excess misclassification error for a randomized one-pass STE iterate and a corresponding majority-vote bound.

AI.tldr: 本文从统计学习理论的视角研究二值激活网络中直通估计器（STE）的泛化性能，通过将零初始化的逐样本STE递推等价转化为凸隐式损失上的随机次梯度下降，建立了基于算法稳定性的显式泛化界，并在可分离条件下获得最优阶的期望过量分类误差界。
AI.motivation: STE是训练二值激活网络的核心方法，但其不连续的更新规则使得经典的泛化理论难以直接适用。本文的核心动机是探究算法稳定性能否解释STE训练规则所产生的估计器的统计泛化性质，从而弥补二值神经网络在理论泛化分析上的空白。
AI.method: 本文将两层二值激活网络在饱和输出区间下的零初始化逐样本STE递推刻画为凸隐式损失上的随机次梯度下降，从而使得稳定性分析可行。推导了两个耦合更新的精确距离恒等式，证明了公共样本映射的近似非扩张性，并据此获得显式的ℓ2平均模型稳定性与泛化界，将稳定性等距地从隐向量传递到完整的第一层矩阵。在间隔可分条件下结合优化界得到最终风险保证。
AI.result: 获得显式的过量诱导风险保证，当T=n²时收敛率为O(n^{-1/2})；在间隔可分性条件下，对随机单遍STE迭代获得最优阶的O(R²/(γ²n))期望过量分类误差界及相应的多数投票界。
AI.conclusion: 工作表明，尽管STE更新规则不连续，算法稳定性仍能有效解释其统计泛化，且获得的收敛阶在间隔可分条件下达到最优，为二值激活网络的泛化理论提供了严格的支撑。

title: Monte Carlo-Based Ex-Ante Assessment of the Green Benefits of an AI-Driven Smart Agriculture Platform in Hainan
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables; bilingual (Chinese title page with Chinese abstract, English full text); all results are ex-ante Monte Carlo simulation intervals, not field measurements
summary: Smart agriculture platforms are widely regarded as key carriers for implementing China's pesticide and fertilizer reduction, water-saving and carbon-reduction agendas, yet a unified quantitative framework for assessing their green value is still lacking. Taking an AI-driven decision platform for tropical agriculture as the object (integrating large-language-model question answering, multimodal pest diagnosis, IoT sensing, satellite remote sensing, and a closed-loop field record system), this study builds a cradle-to-farm-gate agricultural carbon accounting model covering pesticide and fertilizer production, field N2O, irrigation electricity and paddy CH4, translates platform interventions into quantifiable transmission parameters, and propagates parameter uncertainty by Monte Carlo simulation over three Hainan scenarios (mango, winter vegetable, rice/nanfan, area-weighted 40%:30%:30%). Under full adoption, median reductions are 23.5% (90% interval 15.0%-33.2%) for pesticide use, 21.0% (13.8%-28.9%) for fertilizer, 16.5% (10.9%-23.5%) for irrigation water, and 21.5% (16.1%-27.2%) for carbon intensity. Attainment probabilities are high for fertilizer reduction >=15% (90.6%) and clear carbon decline (98.1%), but only about 20% for aggregate water saving >=20%, favoring scenario-specific statements. Sobol first-order indices show soil-test recommendation and organic substitution jointly explain about 83% of the variance of aggregate carbon-intensity reduction. Convergence tests show 10,000 iterations stabilize all statistics; conservative/baseline/optimistic scenario bounds are reported. The framework offers a reproducible, calibration-ready methodology for ex-ante green-value assessment and pilot observation design.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对智能农业平台的绿色价值量化评估缺失问题，以海南热带农业AI决策平台为对象，构建了从摇篮到农场大门的碳核算模型，通过蒙特卡洛模拟量化不确定性，得出全面采用情景下农药减量23.5%、化肥减量21.0%、碳强度降低21.5%等中位数结果。
AI.motivation: 智能农业平台被视为中国农药化肥减量、节水减排的关键载体，但缺乏统一的量化框架来评估其绿色价值，亟需建立可复现、可校准的前瞻性评估方法。
AI.method: 构建覆盖农药化肥生产、田间N2O、灌溉电力及稻田CH4的摇篮到农场大门碳核算模型，将平台干预转化为可量化的传递参数，通过蒙特卡洛模拟在海南三种作物场景（芒果、冬菜、水稻/南繁，面积加权40%:30%:30%）下传播参数不确定性，并采用Sobol一阶指数进行敏感性分析。
AI.result: 全面采用情景下中位农药减量23.5%（90%区间15.0%-33.2%），化肥减量21.0%，灌溉节水16.5%，碳强度降低21.5%。化肥减量≥15%实现概率达90.6%，碳降明确概率98.1%，但综合节水≥20%概率仅约20%。Sobol分析显示测土配方推荐与有机替代联合解释约83%的碳强度降低方差。10000次迭代收敛稳定。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了可复现、可校准的前瞻性绿色价值评估和试点观测设计方法，但节水目标的实现概率较低，建议采用场景特异性表述而非统一结论。

title: A Theoretical Framework for Masked Pretraining (MPT)
summary: Recently, Masked Pretraining (MPT) based on reconstruction pretraining tasks has risen to a promising self-supervised learning paradigm across various domains and achieves remarkable performance in multiple downstream tasks. However, the theoretical understanding of the working mechanism behind MPT is still limited. In this paper, we introduce a new theoretical framework to analyze MPT and understand the crucial role of masking in extracting meaningful representations. We establish theoretical connections between MPT and another popular self-supervised paradigm: contrastive learning. We prove that the masking technique implicitly creates positive pairs that are semantically similar and the reconstruction loss pulls them together in the feature space. Besides, as a result of the implicit alignment, we point out the dimensional collapse issue of MPT and propose a Uniformity-enhanced MPT (U-MPT) loss that can effectively address this issue and bring significant improvements in downstream tasks including linear evaluation, cross-dataset fine-tuning and out-of-distribution generalization on real-world data sets. Furthermore, we establish downstream guarantees of U-MPT and theoretically analyze the influence of masking strategies. Based on the theoretical analysis, we propose a new masking strategy which enhances the downstream performance of MPT and explains current improvements of masking strategies with our theoretical perspective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个新的理论框架来分析掩码预训练（MPT）的工作机制，建立了MPT与对比学习之间的理论联系，揭示了掩码技术隐式地创建语义相似的正样本对，并指出了MPT存在的维度坍塌问题，进而提出了增强均匀性的U-MPT损失函数来改进下游任务性能，同时给出了U-MPT的下游任务保证并提出了新的掩码策略。
AI.motivation: 掩码预训练（MPT）在多个领域取得了显著的成功，但其背后的理论机制仍然缺乏深入理解，特别是掩码在提取有意义表示中的关键作用尚未被清晰阐释。
AI.method: 本文提出了一个全新的理论框架来连接MPT与对比学习，证明掩码技术隐式创建语义相似的正样本对并通过重建损失在特征空间中拉近它们。基于此框架，作者指出MPT存在维度坍塌问题，提出了增强均匀性的U-MPT损失函数，并基于理论分析提出了新的掩码策略。
AI.result: U-MPT损失有效解决了维度坍塌问题，在真实数据集上的线性评估、跨数据集微调和分布外泛化等下游任务中带来了显著改进，并建立了U-MPT的下游任务性能保证。
AI.conclusion: 本文不仅为理解MPT的工作机制提供了理论框架，还通过理论指导提出了有效的改进方法（U-MPT和新掩码策略），缩小了MPT理论与实践之间的差距。

title: Simulating the Marginal Green Contribution of AI Modules in a Smart-Agriculture Platform: Evidence from Two Monte Carlo Experiments
comment: 10 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables; bilingual (Chinese title page with Chinese abstract, English full text); companion to platform-level green-value assessment; all results are ex-ante Monte Carlo simulation intervals, not field measurements
summary: Smart agriculture platforms usually bundle AI diagnosis, IoT sensing and decision push into a single package, so the green benefit attributable to each component remains unclear and resource-allocation decisions lack quantitative evidence. Building on a previous platform-level Monte Carlo assessment, this paper makes the components explicit and runs two controlled simulation experiments. Experiment 1 follows the chain from AI capability to farmer behavior to agrochemical input reduction, modeling pesticide/fertilizer reduction as avoidable blind-application share times prescription effectiveness times decision-touch coverage times adoption rate, and compares an experienced-extension mode with the AI mode: the probability of reaching 20% pesticide reduction is essentially zero in the extension mode but 20.7% at baseline, up to 49% with diagnosis accuracy 0.95 and adoption 0.85 under AI; the probability of 15% fertilizer reduction rises from near zero to 52.0%. Experiment 2 compares current practice (P0), IoT engineering retrofit (P1), and P1 plus AI irrigation scheduling (P2): median aggregate water saving rises from 7.8% (P0) to 11.0% (P1) and 16.0% (P2), with AI adding 5.0 percentage points beyond engineering; paddy CH4 reduction reaches 30.5% under AI scheduling versus 19.8% under manual operation, and the rice irrigation-methane subsystem carbon intensity declines 27.9%. Sensitivity analyses of both experiments consistently indicate that the primary bottleneck for meeting green targets is farmer adoption rather than algorithm accuracy, and that AI data fusion is robust to soil-moisture sensing errors. This work provides a reproducible simulation framework for component-level green-value evaluation and promotion-strategy optimization of smart agriculture platforms.

AI.tldr: 本文通过两个受控模拟实验，将智慧农业平台中AI诊断、IoT感知与决策推送各组件绿色效益显式化：实验1表明AI模式在农药减量20%和化肥减量15%上的达标概率远高于传统农技推广模式；实验2表明AI灌溉调度使中位综合节水率从P0的7.8%提升至16.0%，并降低稻田甲烷排放与碳排放强度。敏感性分析显示农民采纳率是绿色目标实现的首要瓶颈，AI数据融合对土壤水分传感误差稳健。
AI.motivation: 现有智慧农业平台将AI诊断、IoT感知和决策推送捆绑打包，导致各组件单独贡献的绿色效益不明，资源配置决策缺乏定量依据。
AI.method: 在平台级蒙特卡洛评估基础上，将组件显式化并运行两个受控模拟实验。实验1构建"AI能力→农民行为→农化投入减量"链条，将农药/化肥减量建模为可避免盲目施用比例×处方有效性×决策触达率×采纳率，对比经验农技推广模式与AI模式；实验2对比现状（P0）、IoT工程改造（P1）与P1+AI灌溉调度（P2）的节水与甲烷减排效果，并开展敏感性分析。
AI.result: 实验1中，AI模式下达到农药减量20%的概率从基线20.7%升至最高49%（诊断精度0.95、采纳率0.85），而推广模式概率接近零；化肥减量15%概率从近零升至52.0%。实验2中，中位综合节水率从P0的7.8%升至P1的11.0%和P2的16.0%，AI较工程改造额外贡献5.0个百分点；AI调度下稻田CH4减排达30.5%（人工操作仅19.8%），水稻灌排子系统碳强度下降27.9%。两个实验的敏感性分析均表明农民采纳率是主要瓶颈，AI数据融合对土壤水分传感误差稳健。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个可复现的组件级绿色价值评估与推广策略优化模拟框架，明确了各组件绿色效益的定量贡献，为智慧农业平台的资源配置与推广决策提供了科学依据。

title: Local and Global Stability in Performative Reinforcement Learning
summary: In performative reinforcement learning the deployed policy shapes the environment that generates the learner's future data, and the natural solution concept is a performatively stable policy that is optimal in the environment it induces. Existing convergence guarantees rely on Lipschitz sensitivity assumptions on the environment map $π\mapsto (P_π, r_π)$, which are hard to verify and fail in settings such as multi-agent best-response dynamics. We instead study stability for mixtures of policies, and show that the resulting picture is fundamentally different from performative prediction, where randomization removes the need for any sensitivity assumption. We distinguish local mixed stability, an occupancy-weighted first-order relaxation that we show is equivalent to stationarity, from global mixed stability, which certifies against arbitrary deviating policies. Our first result is that a weighted per-state Hedge dynamic drives the local stability gap to zero at an $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ rate for an arbitrary, possibly discontinuous, environment map, both with exact and with trajectory feedback. The two notions genuinely differ: we exhibit an instance where local stability is achieved exactly but every mixture has global stability gap bounded away from zero. For global stability we introduce a bounded transition range assumption, strictly weaker than Lipschitz sensitivity, under which unweighted per-state Hedge converges up to a floor of $O(γε_P/(1-γ)^3)$, and we prove a matching-in-$ε_P$ lower bound of $Ω(γε_P/(1-γ))$ under trajectory feedback, so this floor is unavoidable. Finally, we extend both notions to $n$-player performative Markov games, obtaining local stability with no assumption on the joint environment map or game structure, and global stability for performative Markov potential games.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了表演性强化学习中混合策略的稳定性概念，区分了局部混合稳定性（等价于驻点）与全局混合稳定性（对抗任意偏离策略），证明加权逐状态Hedge动态可在O(1/√T)速率下将局部稳定性间隙降至零而无需任何光滑性假设，并引入有界转移范围假设来保证全局稳定性收敛。
AI.motivation: 现有表演性RL的收敛保证依赖环境映射的Lipschitz敏感性假设，这些假设难以验证，且在多智能体最优响应动态等场景中不成立。作者希望探索混合策略下的稳定性，以规避这一限制。
AI.method: 区分局部混合稳定性（占用权重加权的二阶松弛，等价于驻点）与全局混合稳定性；提出加权逐状态Hedge动态用于局部稳定性的无假设收敛（O(1/√T)速率）；引入比Lipschitz敏感性更弱的有界转移范围假设，用于全局稳定性分析；并扩展至n人表演性马尔可夫博弈。
AI.result: 加权逐状态Hedge在精确与轨迹反馈下均以O(1/√T)速率将局部稳定性间隙收敛至零，针对任意可能不连续的环境映射；全局稳定性在给定假设下收敛至O(γε_P/(1-γ)³)的误差下限，并证明匹配的下界Ω(γε_P/(1-γ))在轨迹反馈下不可避免。
AI.conclusion: 局部混合稳定性可以在完全不依赖敏感性假设的情况下实现，但全局混合稳定性需要更弱的有界转移范围假设。两种稳定性概念本质上不同，且结果与表演性预测形成鲜明对比。

title: Reason Through the Latent! Making Latent Visual Reasoning Necessary
summary: Latent visual reasoning aims to perform multimodal reasoning through hidden-state computation rather than explicit textual chains of thought. However, visual information being present in a latent state does not imply that the model actually relies on that state when producing its answer, especially when alternative image-conditioned paths remain available. We introduce \textbf{C}ausal \textbf{V}isual \textbf{R}ecurrent \textbf{R}easoning (CVRR), which preserves pretrained visual competence while making recurrent computation the required image-conditioned path to prediction. CVRR initializes recurrence from the question hidden state after the pretrained vision-language model has incorporated the image, then repeatedly updates this state while re-reading the same fixed visual evidence. Before decoding, visual states and the original multimodal KV cache are removed so that only the final recurrent state carries image-conditioned information to the answer. Across the $V^*$, MMVP, BLINK, and MME-RealWorld-Lite benchmarks, CVRR retains strong performance under this strict interface, while compatible latent reasoners fail to recover comparable visual competence even when retrained under the same constraint. Causal interventions further show that predictions remain sensitive to recurrent content when the question is held fixed, and that persistent visual evidence causally revises the recurrent trajectory. These results distinguish latent informativeness from latent computation that is actually used for prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CVRR框架，通过强制循环计算成为图像条件预测的唯一路径，区分了"潜在状态包含视觉信息"与"模型实际依赖该状态进行推理"之间的差异，并在多个视觉推理基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 潜在的视觉推理旨在通过隐层状态计算而非显式文本推理链来执行多模态推理，但视觉信息存在于潜在状态中并不意味着模型在生成答案时真正依赖它。现有模型可能通过其他图像条件路径（如多模态KV缓存）获取信息，导致潜在推理机制未被实际使用，因此需要一种方法来确保循环计算真正成为预测所必需的图像条件路径。
AI.method: CVRR从预训练视觉-语言模型融合图像后的问题隐藏状态初始化循环过程，反复更新该状态同时重读相同的固定视觉证据。在解码前移除视觉状态和原始多模态KV缓存，使得只有最终的循环状态携带图像条件信息到达答案生成阶段。
AI.result: 在V*、MMVP、BLINK和MME-RealWorld-Lite基准上，CVRR在严格接口下保持强性能，而兼容的潜在推理器即使在同一约束下重新训练也无法恢复相当的视觉能力。因果干预实验表明，当问题固定时预测对循环内容保持敏感，持续视觉证据会因果性地修正循环轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果区分了"潜在信息性"（latent informativeness）与"实际用于预测的潜在计算"（latent computation actually used for prediction），揭示仅将视觉信息编码到潜在状态中是不够的，必须确保该状态是模型做出预测所实质性依赖的路径。

title: Sector-Mean: Deterministic Initialization of K-Means Centroids via Angular Sector Partitioning
summary: K-Means is one of the most widely used clustering algorithms, but its susceptibility to initial centroid selection remains a primary bottleneck for its convergence speed and clustering accuracy. This paper proposes Sector-Mean Initialization, a deterministic initialization strategy with O(N) time complexity that partitions the two-dimensional data space into angular sectors around the global centroid and initializes centroids using sector-wise means. We evaluate the method on established two-dimensional benchmarks (SIPU, Birch) and multiple real-world datasets, comparing against random, K-Means++, and Max-Min initialization under identical Lloyd iterations. The statistical analysis of Friedman's test (p<0.05) and Nemenyi post-hoc comparison indicates that, while delivering equivalent clustering quality as K-Means++ and Max-Min, Sector-Mean offers significant computational efficiency. Experimental results show that Sector-Mean reduces the initialization time by 74.9% and 59.8% in comparison to K-Means++ and max-min, respectively. And, it yields the lowest average number of iterations, achieving approximately 5% fewer iterations than K-Means++ and 16% fewer than max-min. These results highlight that Sector-Mean initialization offers a deterministic and computationally efficient initialization strategy while preserving cluster quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Sector-Mean的确定性K-Means初始化策略，时间复杂度为O(N)，通过将二维数据空间围绕全局质心划分为角度扇区并利用扇区均值初始化质心，在保持与K-Means++和Max-Min相当的聚类质量的同时，显著减少初始化时间和迭代次数。
AI.motivation: K-Means是最广泛使用的聚类算法之一，但其聚类结果严重依赖初始质心的选择，随机初始化导致收敛速度慢且聚类精度不稳定，这一问题成为该算法的主要瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出Sector-Mean初始化方法：围绕全局质心将二维数据空间划分为角度扇区，使用各扇区内的数据均值作为初始质心。该策略为确定性算法，时间复杂度为O(N)，并在统一的Lloyd迭代条件下与随机、K-Means++和Max-Min初始化方法进行对比评估。
AI.result: 基于SIPU和Birch等二维基准数据集及多个真实数据集的实验表明：(1) 与K-Means++相比初始化时间降低74.9%，与Max-Min相比降低59.8%；(2) 平均迭代次数最少，比K-Means++少约5%，比Max-Min少约16%；(3) Friedman检验(p<0.05)和Nemenyi事后检验证实聚类质量与K-Means++和Max-Min相当。
AI.conclusion: Sector-Mean初始化是一种确定性的、计算高效的初始化策略，在保证聚类质量的前提下显著降低了初始化成本和迭代次数，为K-Means初始化问题提供了有竞争力的解决方案。

title: Improving Proficiency and Efficiency of Android GUI Agents via Self-Generating Tool Actions
summary: Android agents using a hybrid action space that combines GUI actions and tool actions (e.g., accessing application data via APIs) remain largely underexplored, mainly due to the excessive effort required to create tools. To address this gap, we introduce DroidTool, a framework for augmenting the agents with self-generated tools, which are realized as Python functions operating on application states (e.g., a database). To create tools with minimal human labor, DroidTool employs an agentic workflow featuring stages: proposal, implementation, test generation and execution, and repair. Notably, when testing the created tools for verification, it constructs relational tests across relevant tools for natural preparation of appropriate test preconditions and improved test coverage, rather than testing each tool separately. The GUI agents augmented with the generated tools achieved approximately 4.47%p higher performance with approximately 20.05% fewer interactions than the GUI-only agents, averaged across representative benchmarks: AndroidWorld, B-MoCA, and MobileSafetyBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DroidTool框架，通过自动化生成Python工具函数来增强Android GUI代理，使其能够利用混合动作空间（GUI动作+工具动作）。最终在多个基准上实现了约4.47%的性能提升和约20.05%的交互减少。
AI.motivation: Android代理的混合动作空间（结合GUI动作和工具动作）尚未被充分探索，主要原因在于为代理创建工具需要过多的手工成本。需要一种自动化方式来减轻工具创建负担，从而释放混合动作空间在Android任务中的潜力。
AI.method: 提出DroidTool框架，采用智能体工作流自动生成工具，包含四个阶段：提议（proposal）、实现（implementation）、测试生成与执行（test generation and execution）、修复（repair）。工具以Python函数形式实现，作用于应用状态（如数据库）。测试阶段采用跨相关工具的关联测试（relational tests）来构建合理的测试前置条件并提升测试覆盖率，而非孤立测试各工具。
AI.result: 在AndroidWorld、B-MoCA和MobileSafetyBench三个代表性基准上，经生成的工具增强的GUI代理相比纯GUI代理，平均性能提升约4.47个百分点，交互次数减少约20.05%。
AI.conclusion: DroidTool证明了通过自生成工具增强GUI代理的有效性，显著减少了手动工具创建成本，同时提升了代理性能和交互效率，为Android代理的混合动作空间研究提供了可行的自动化方案。

title: One Step, One Lead: Mitigating Higher-Order Interference in Multi-Domain Reinforcement Learning via Cross-Step Control
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) across multiple domains can broaden the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet joint training often degrades individual-domain performance and can destabilize optimization. Existing work typically diagnoses such interference from a single-step view using first-order gradient alignment or curvature-based proxies. We show that this view can miss a critical form of sequential interference: same-point domain gradients may remain nearly orthogonal even when consecutive realized updates partially reverse one another in output space. We further show that consecutive token log-probability footprints recover this interaction directly from adjacent checkpoints as a local second-order interaction in output space, without explicitly reconstructing same-step curvature. Building on this insight, we propose OSOL, which designates a focus domain at each iteration, uses the preceding checkpoint footprint to rank token-level rebound risk, and applies a drift-ranked, adaptively scaled correction within the standard GRPO update. Our analysis shows that this correction suppresses the targeted cross-step output backtracking component. Controlled studies further show that cross-step backtracking is more strongly associated with subsequent task damage than same-point gradient diagnostics, while the preceding footprint ranks future rebound risk more accurately than Hessian-based proxies. On Qwen3-30B-A3B, OSOL reaches a domain-macro average of 0.4822, improving by 5.7% over the strongest compared baseline, without explicit higher-order differentiation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSOL方法，通过利用相邻检查点的token对数概率足迹检测跨步回弹（sequential backtracking）干扰，并在GRPO更新中应用漂移排序的自适应校正，在不显式计算高阶导数的情况下提升了多领域RL训练的稳定性与性能。
AI.motivation: 多领域强化学习联合训练常导致单领域性能下降和优化不稳定。现有工作通常基于单步视角（一阶梯度对齐或曲率代理）诊断领域间干扰，但该视角可能遗漏关键的顺序干扰形式：同点领域梯度近乎正交时，连续的实际更新仍可能在输出空间中部分相互逆转。
AI.method: 提出OSOL方法：(1) 每次迭代指定一个焦点领域；(2) 使用前一个检查点的token对数概率足迹（footprint）直接在输出空间估计局部二阶交互，无需显式重构同点曲率；(3) 基于足迹对token级回弹风险排序；(4) 在标准GRPO更新中应用漂移排序的自适应缩放校正。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-30B-A3B上，OSOL达到领域宏观平均0.4822，相比最强基线提升5.7%。受控实验表明：跨步回弹与后续任务损伤的关联强于同点梯度诊断；前序足迹对未来回弹风险的排序比Hessian代理更准确。
AI.conclusion: 跨步回弹是多领域RL中一类被单步诊断忽视的关键干扰机制，OSOL通过相邻检查点足迹无需高阶微分即可有效抑制该干扰，显著提升多领域强化学习的综合性能。

title: Unsound Search with Policy and Value Networks in Legends of Code and Magic
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Also available as a Zenodo preprint, doi:10.5281/zenodo.22547763
summary: Decision-time search in perfect and imperfect information games with enumerable belief states are effective methods for game AI. Collectible card games are imperfect information games with large belief states. Legends of Code and Magic is a collectible card game competition where the belief states are $2^{101}$. The Legends of Code and Magic (LoCM) champion, ByteRL, plays with no search. Other works claim sound enumeration-based search is unusable in the genre due to the number of belief states. We measured three previously defined properties that predict where theoretically unsound perfect information Monte Carlo's defects are cheap and found LoCM sits in the favorable region. Starting with imitation learning of the runner-up policy, NeteaseOPD, we created a policy and value feed-forward network. Our agent searches over worlds sampled from a prior over the opponent's deck built from the runner-up's drafts. Using our strictest configuration in the battle phase we beat ByteRL with a win percentage of 51.35% 95% CI [50.37, 52.33], over 10,000 pre-registered games using the LoCM official referee and time limit. Search is not a minor factor on the matchup between our agent and ByteRL. Without search this agent scores 26.8% and adding search adds +24.6 points. Unsound search in imperfect information games could be exploitable. We replicate a published best-response attack against ByteRL. We then apply the same attack protocol to two search configurations of our agent, and each one resists it better than ByteRL at every iteration. In LoCM unsound search gives us a stronger and more resilient agent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在不完全信息卡牌游戏LoCM中，尽管信念状态空间高达2^101使传统穷举搜索被认为不可行，但作者论证LoCM处于理论上无缺陷的完美信息蒙特卡洛搜索（PIMC）的有利区域。通过模仿学习亚军策略构建前馈网络，并辅以基于对手牌库先验采样的搜索，该智能体在严格配置下以51.35%胜率击败冠军ByteRL；无搜索时仅26.8%胜率，搜索贡献了+24.6个百分点。此外，针对最佳响应攻击的测试表明，带搜索的智能体比ByteRL更具鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 挑战"在不完全信息卡牌游戏中基于枚举信念状态的搜索不可用"这一普遍认知，探索即使使用理论上不健全的PIMC搜索，在类似LoCM的游戏中也能取得显著性能提升并增强对抗攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 利用三个先前定义的属性度量LoCM是否处于PIMC搜索缺陷廉价（缺陷影响小）的有利区域；2) 通过模仿学习亚军策略NeteaseOPD构建策略与价值的全连接前馈网络；3) 在战斗阶段对从对手牌库先验采样的世界进行搜索（基于亚军缐选构建先验）；4) 使用官方裁判和时限进行10,000场预注册比赛严格评估；5) 对ByteRL和自身智能体的多个搜索配置实施已发表的best-response攻击测试鲁棒性。
AI.result: 严格搜索配置下以51.35%胜率（95% CI [50.37, 52.33]）击败ByteRL。无搜索时该智能体胜率仅26.8%，加入搜索提升+24.6个百分点，证明搜索是关键因素。在best-response攻击协议下，本文两种搜索配置的智能体在每个迭代都比ByteRL表现更好，展现出更强的抗攻击鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 在LoCM中，理论上不健全的不完全信息博弈搜索不仅能显著提升性能，还增强了对抗利用攻击的鲁棒性。这表明"完全搜索不可行"的论点过于悲观，搜索在不完全信息卡牌游戏中仍具有重要价值。

title: Steering Under Compression: Dose-Response, Capability Cost, and Failure Asymmetry in Quantized LLMs
summary: Inference-time activation steering enables behavioral control of large language models without parameter modification, while post-training quantization reduces memory and compute costs for deployment. Despite their growing convergence in practice, the interaction between these two techniques remains uncharacterized. We systematically study activation steering under weight-only quantization (INT8 and NF4) across four open-weight 7-9B models and two behavioral targets: judged sentiment and judge-free reasoning length. Using an iso-effect framework that compares capability costs at matched behavioral effect, we find that sentiment steering survives quantization intact. After correcting a GSM8K parser artifact with a uniform v2.3.1 rescore, the pooled INT8 contrast is -0.010 (90% CI [-0.026, +0.007]), descriptively Equivalent under the preregistered three-label rule, while NF4 remains Inconclusive at -0.017 ([-0.067, +0.033]). In contrast, reasoning length exhibits a surprising asymmetric dose-response: lengthening is graded but terminates in cap-runaway and collapse, while shortening is a step function with only 12-30% shortening (model-dependent) before discontinuous failure. We expose a methodological pitfall: the naive iso-effect ladder anchors on the collapse floor for floor-bounded targets, and we introduce a censored construction that restores interpretable crossings. We also quantify a substantial baseline capability shift for Mistral-NF4 (0.545 to 0.365 GSM8K at alpha=0), demonstrating that compression can dominate the steering intervention. Despite this, steering vectors remain highly collinear with their FP16 siblings (cosine similarity 0.989-0.998 for INT8, 0.945-0.990 for NF4), confirming that the behavioral direction survives quantization even when the cost structure does not. All code and data are released.

AI.tldr: 本研究系统考察了推理时激活引导与仅权重量化（INT8/NF4）在7-9B开源模型上的交互作用。发现情感引导在量化后保持完好，但推理长度的行为表现为不对称的剂量-响应曲线，并揭示了iso-effect分析框架中的方法学陷阱——对于有下限的目标，朴素阶梯会锚定在崩溃底部。尽管压缩可能主导干预效果，引导向量与FP16版本仍高度共线，行为方向在量化后得以保留。
AI.motivation: 激活引导和量化技术在实践中的使用日益重叠，但两者之间的相互作用尚未被系统描述，研究者希望填补这一空白，理解量化压缩是否会削弱或扭曲推理时的行为控制能力。
AI.method: 在四个7-9B开源模型上，采用INT8和NF4仅权重量化，对两个行为目标（情感判断和推理长度）进行激活引导实验。使用iso-effect框架比较匹配行为效果下的能力成本，并修正了GSM8K解析器伪影，引入了审查式（censored）构造方法，通过余弦相似度分析引导向量的方向保留性。
AI.result: 情感引导在量化下保持完好；INT8的池化对比为-0.010（等效），NF4为-0.017（不确定）。推理长度引导呈现不对称剂量效应：延长是渐进的但以失控和崩溃终止，缩短是阶跃函数并在12-30%处发生不连续失败。压缩可主导干预效果（Mistral-NF4能力从0.545降至0.365），但引导向量与FP16余弦相似度达0.945-0.998。
AI.conclusion: 量化对激活引导的影响取决于具体行为目标：情感类行为引导可无损转移，而推理长度等能力边界行为在量化下结构被破坏。行为方向在量化中得以保留，但能力成本结构可能显著改变，需要重建分析框架以正确评估效果。

title: Formation of structural attractors in neuromorphic systems
summary: This paper examines the theory of Invariant Structural Learning (ISL), which proposes a non-optimization approach to concept formation. Learning is interpreted as convergence to structural attractors in a hypergraph space, rather than as the minimization of a global loss function. The paper presents the ISL model, including its mathematical formalization, computational verification, and a hypothetical neurobiological interpretation. The mathematical section introduces the formal apparatus of the structural reduction process and proves its finite convergence, the existence and uniqueness of class structural attractors, and the self-organization of attractor maps. The computational section demonstrates the feasibility of the proposed approach on classical image recognition tasks, utilizing the proposed learning mechanism without backpropagation and with extremely small training datasets. Finally, the neurobiological section formulates hypotheses regarding the possible implementation of structural attractors in dendritic trees, neural coding as a projection of internal attractor dynamics, and the development of neural architectures supporting the proposed learning concept. These hypotheses are discussed in the context of modern experimental data in the fields of dendritic computations, synaptic plasticity, and the structural organization of neural circuits. The proposed neurobiological mechanisms are presented as testable hypotheses rather than established biological facts. The results demonstrate the mathematical consistency and computational feasibility of the proposed model, while the neurobiological hypotheses outline potential directions for its experimental verification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出不变结构学习（ISL）理论，将概念形成视为超图空间中向结构吸引子的收敛过程，而非全局损失函数的最小化。论文涵盖数学形式化（证明有限收敛性和结构吸引子存在唯一性）、计算验证（无需反向传播和小样本即可完成图像识别）以及神经生物学假设（结构吸引子在树突树中的可能实现），结果表明该模型在数学和计算上可行，神经生物学假说有待实验验证。
AI.motivation: 传统机器学习依赖全局损失函数最小化，与大脑认知机制存在本质差异。本文试图另辟蹊径，提出一种不依赖优化的概念形成理论，以更贴近生物神经系统的学习范式。
AI.method: 通过三个层面展开：在数学层面，构建结构归约过程的正式框架，证明有限收敛性、类结构吸引子的存在唯一性及吸引子图的自组织；在计算层面，采用无需反向传播的学习机制在极小训练集上完成经典图像识别任务；在神经生物学层面，提出结构吸引子在树突树中的可能实现、神经编码作为内部吸引子动力学的投射等可检验假说。
AI.result: 数学上证明了ISL模型的形式一致性（包括有限收敛性及结构吸引子存在唯一性），计算上验证了该方法在经典图像识别任务中的可行性（无需反向传播且仅需极少量训练数据），神经生物学方面提出了若干有待实验检验的假设。
AI.conclusion: ISL模型在数学和计算层面均展现出可行性与一致性，为概念形成提供了一种非优化的替代理论框架；神经生物学层面的机制被明确定位为可测试的假设，为未来实验验证指明了方向。

title: Learning Kernels by Alignment for Multiclass Bayes Classification
summary: Kernel methods separate data representation from decision-making, but typically require the kernel to be chosen in advance. We show that this kernel can instead be learned by alignment, and develop the resulting framework through the recently introduced Collaborative Learning and Inference (CLaI). We show that Collaborative Learning can be viewed as a kernel alignment process, in which an embedding is trained so that its induced similarity matches a label-derived target kernel. We also prove that Collaborative Inference is equivalent to kernel Bayes classification with Parzen-window density estimation. Motivated by these perspectives, we generalise CLaI by replacing cosine similarity with a learned Mahalanobis distance and extend it to multiclass classification. On CIFAR-10, PathMNIST, and SleepEDF, the Mahalanobis formulation improves accuracy, converges faster, and yields lower calibration error than the cosine-based variant. Auxiliary experiments further support these connections, showing that CLaI produces latent signals of the same form as a Gaussian process, while achieving competitive calibration on sepsis prediction. Together, these results establish a principled learned-kernel framework that unifies representation learning, kernel alignment, and Bayesian classification, and extends naturally to the multiclass setting.

AI.tldr: 本文通过将协作学习与推断（CLaI）框架重新解读为核对齐过程与核贝叶斯分类，将核方法从"预先选择核"扩展到"学习核"的框架，并用马氏距离替代余弦相似度以泛化到多分类任务。在CIFAR-10、PathMNIST和SleepEDF上，马氏距离版本在准确率、收敛速度和校准误差方面均优于余弦版本。
AI.motivation: 传统核方法需要预先选择核函数，这限制了其适应性和灵活性。作者希望展示核可以通过对齐（alignment）自动学习，从而将表示学习与决策过程更紧密地统一起来。
AI.method: 作者将CLaI框架从理论上重新诠释为：(1) 协作学习等价于核对齐过程，即训练嵌入使其诱导的相似度与标签导出的目标核对齐；(2) 协作推断等价于基于Parzen窗密度估计的核贝叶斯分类。在此基础上，用学习的马氏距离替代余弦相似度对CLaI进行泛化，并扩展至多分类设置。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、PathMNIST和SleepEDF三个数据集上，马氏距离版本在准确率、收敛速度和校准误差方面均优于基于余弦相似度的变体。辅助实验表明CLaI产生的潜在信号与高斯过程形式一致，在脓毒症预测上达到有竞争力的校准性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文建立了一个原理性的学习核框架，统一了表示学习、核对齐与贝叶斯分类，并自然地扩展到多分类场景，为核方法提供了一种不必预先选择核的新范式。

title: NormViz: A Benchmark and Framework for Grounding Multimodal Reasoning in Global Cultures
comment: Accepted to Conference on Language Modeling (COLM) 2026. 37 pages, 23 figures
summary: AI systems are used worldwide, but they struggle to serve the needs of culturally diverse populations. Prior work on cultural understanding evaluates AI systems on text-only settings or on visual artifact recognition (e.g. foods, clothing). The ability to reason about visually observable behaviors through local social norms, which we call visual norm understanding, remains unexamined. We introduce NormViz-Bench, a high quality, human-validated benchmark of 3,268 contrastive image pairs (6,536 images) spanning 16 countries. Each pair varies only in the culturally relevant behavior (e.g., objects, attributes, spatial relations, and actions) that alters how each image is interpreted. Each image is labeled as conforming to, violating, or irrelevant to local social norms, and pair-level evaluation requires both images to be correctly classified, thereby preventing reliance on superficial visual shortcuts. Even the strongest VLMs, Gemini 3.0 Flash and Qwen2.5 VL 7B, succeed on only 26.6% and 21.6% of pairs, struggling most with identifying violating and culturally benign visual behaviors.
