Towards bridging this, we introduce NormViz-Train, a training dataset of 64k images paired with explanations. Though absolute performance remains low (<30%), finetuning on NormViz-Train improves pair accuracy relatively by up to 125% and 36% Qwen3-VL 4B and 8B respectively, showing a path forward to teach models to connect visual perception to cultural significance. Together, NormViz-Bench and NormViz-Train establish visual norm understanding as a challenging and consequential frontier for multimodal AI.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NormViz-Bench基准，包含16个国家3,268组对比图像对，用于评测AI系统通过视觉行为理解当地社会规范（视觉规范理解）的能力。最强视觉语言模型仅达到26.6%的成对准确率。另提出NormViz-Train训练集（64k图像带解释），微调后相对准确率提升最高达125%，确立了视觉规范理解作为多模态AI的重要前沿方向。
AI.motivation: 现有文化理解研究仅关注纯文本或视觉文物识别（如食物、服饰），尚未考察AI通过视觉可观察的日常行为推理当地社会规范的能力，即"视觉规范理解"。
AI.method: 构建NormViz-Bench：3,268对人类验证的对比图像对（6,536张图像），覆盖16个国家，每对仅在文化相关行为维度（对象、属性、空间关系、动作）上变化。每张图像标注为符合/违反/与当地社会规范无关，需两张图像均正确分类才算通过。另构建NormViz-Train：64k带解释的训练图像，用于微调视觉语言模型。
AI.result: 最强的视觉语言模型（Gemini 3.0 Flash和Qwen2.5 VL 7B）仅在26.6%和21.6%的图像对上成功，在识别违规和文化中性行为上最为薄弱。微调后Qwen3-VL 4B和8B的相对成对准确率分别提升125%和36%，但绝对性能仍低于30%。
AI.conclusion: 视觉规范理解是一个具有挑战性且影响深远的多模态AI前沿任务。NormViz-Bench和NormViz-Train为该方向提供了系统化的评测与训练基础，揭示了尽管提升空间巨大，微调路径证明模型可以将视觉感知与文化意义相连接。

title: How Does Parameter Pruning Reshape DNN Representations? An Interaction-Driven Exploration
summary: This study focuses on the scientific problem of understanding internal factors that govern the diverse performance degradation of deep neural networks (DNNs) when different parameters are pruned. In order to explain why pruning certain parameters leads to significant performance degradation but pruning other parameters does not, we examine how the pruning operation affects the interaction patterns encoded by the DNN. We find that when we progressively increase the pruning ratio, the interaction patterns encoded by DNNs exhibit a distinct three-phase dynamics, \emph{i.e.}, model performance is not largely affected until the pruning operation begins to remove low-order interactions, and low-order interactions exhibit strong generalizability. Moreover, we find that the high sensitivity of DNN performance to the pruning of certain modules is attributed to whether the pruning operation removes generalizable low-order interaction patterns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了不同参数剪枝导致深度神经网络性能退化差异的内在因素，发现剪枝操作对DNN编码的交互模式产生影响，且低阶交互模式的移除是导致性能显著下降的关键。
AI.motivation: 理解为何剪枝某些参数会导致显著的性能退化，而剪枝其他参数则不会，从而解释DNN参数剪枝性能退化的多样性。
AI.method: 通过逐步增加剪枝比例，观察剪枝操作如何影响DNN编码的交互模式，分析交互模式的三阶段动态变化及其与模型性能的关联。
AI.result: 发现DNN编码的交互模式在逐步剪枝时呈现明显的三阶段动态：在低阶交互被移除之前模型性能不会受到显著影响；低阶交互模式具有较强的泛化能力；某模块剪枝导致性能高度敏感的原因在于剪枝是否移除了可泛化的低阶交互模式。
AI.conclusion: DNN剪枝性能退化的根本原因在于是否破坏了具有强泛化能力的低阶交互模式，这为理解剪枝行为提供了新的理论视角。

title: Learning transferable human physiology from two million hours of sleep with SleepFM-2
summary: Sleep provides a nightly window into health by capturing coordinated activity across the brain, heart, muscles and respiratory system. We introduce SleepFM-2, a sleep foundation model developed and evaluated on 282,511 polysomnography recordings from 26 cohorts, including 235,865 used for pretraining. These data span more than two million hours of multimodal physiology. Compared with SleepFM, SleepFM-2 improves disease prediction and sleep scoring, supports arousal, limb movement and respiratory event detection, and transfers to wearable sensing and subjective sleep phenotypes. A model combining its PSG representation with age, sex and BMI met a prespecified discrimination and significance criterion for 215 subsequently recorded EHR phenotypes in two held-out cohorts, including one health system unseen during pretraining. For 155 phenotypes, the PSG representation added reproducible information beyond demographics. SleepFM-2 also outperformed a 480-feature baseline derived from the same recordings. Its disease scores revealed a reproducible principal component associated with reduced sigma-band spatial coupling and increased hypnodensity entropy. The frozen encoder performed within the observed range of expert scorers for sleep events and transferred to wakeful EEG, headband and in-ear EEG, wrist PPG and wrist accelerometry. It improved sleep staging across six accelerometry cohorts and achieved disease-prediction performance in UK Biobank similar to models pretrained directly on accelerometry. Finally, SleepFM-2 captured aspects of subjective sleep not recovered by conventional PSG summaries, particularly reports of the recorded night. These results show that multimodal sleep physiology can provide a transferable representation of human health across diseases, clinical tasks, sensors and subjective experience.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了SleepFM-2，一种基于282,511例多导睡眠监测（PSG）记录训练的多模态睡眠基础模型。该模型在疾病预测、睡眠评分、睡眠事件检测等方面均优于先前版本，可迁移至可穿戴设备数据与主观睡眠表型，并已在多个独立医疗系统中验证其跨疾病、跨任务、跨传感器的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 睡眠是反映健康状况的重要窗口，涵盖大脑、心脏、肌肉和呼吸系统的协调活动。现有睡眠模型在数据规模、任务覆盖和跨传感器迁移能力方面存在局限，需要构建更强大的基础模型来挖掘大规模多模态生理数据的健康表征价值。
AI.method: SleepFM-2利用来自26个队列的282,511例PSG记录（其中235,865例用于预训练，涵盖超过200万小时的多模态生理数据）进行预训练。模型整合PSG表征与年龄、性别、BMI等人口学信息进行疾病预测，并在外部held-out队列中验证。通过预定义的判别力与显著性标准筛选215种EHR表型，并使用冻结编码器评估各种下游任务的迁移性能。
AI.result: 模型在215种EHR表型中达到预设标准，其中155种表型PSG表征在人口学信息之外提供了可复现的增量信息。模型优于480特征基线，发现与降低的sigma频带空间耦合及增加的催眠图熵相关的可复现主成分。冻结编码器在睡眠事件检测上达到专家评分水平，并成功迁移至多种可穿戴传感器。跨6个加速度计队列提升睡眠分期性能，UK Biobank中疾病预测接近直接在加速度计上预训练的模型。
AI.conclusion: 多模态睡眠生理数据能够提供一种可迁移的人类健康表征，适用于多种疾病、临床任务、传感器类型和主观睡眠体验。SleepFM-2展示了大规模PSG数据驱动的睡眠基础模型在健康感知领域的广泛潜力。

title: Second-Order Smooth Planning with Optimal-Transport Bellman Smoothing
comment: Published at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Planning with a generative model aims to estimate the value of a state using as few simulator calls as possible. SmoothCruiser achieves problem-independent complexity $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-4})$ by exploiting the smoothness of the entropy-regularized Bellman backup, but its estimator is only first-order. We show that the sample-complexity exponent of SmoothCruiser-type planners is governed by the order $β$ of the local Taylor remainder, giving oracle complexity $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-(2+2/(β-1))})$: the first-order case $β=2$ recovers SmoothCruiser, while a second-order/cubic remainder $β=3$ yields $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3})$. We reach this regime with an optimal-transport-smoothed Bellman backup over action distributions, which has a closed form, a policy gradient, and a Lipschitz Hessian, and whose quadratic correction admits an unbiased cross-product estimator. The resulting SecondOrderSmoothCruiser achieves $\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3})$ oracle complexity for fixed OT parameters, and we relate the OT, entropy-regularized, and unregularized objectives through explicit regularization-bias bounds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SecondOrderSmoothCruiser算法，通过最优传输平滑的Bellman backup实现二阶/cubic修正，将规划器样本复杂度从一阶的$\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-4})$提升至$\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3})$。
AI.motivation: SmoothCruiser虽实现了问题无关的$\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-4})$复杂度，但其估计器仅为一阶，存在进一步降低样本复杂度的空间。作者希望利用高阶泰勒余项来提升规划效率。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析SmoothCruiser类规划器的样本复杂度由局部泰勒余项阶数β决定，复杂度为$\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-(2+2/(β-1))})$；2) 提出基于最优传输(OT)平滑的Bellman backup，它在动作分布上具有闭式解、策略梯度、Lipschitz Hessian等特点；3) 二次修正项可采用无偏交叉乘积估计器；4) 结合上述设计构建SecondOrderSmoothCruiser算法。
AI.result: SecondOrderSmoothCruiser在固定OT参数下达到$\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-3})$的oracle复杂度，优于一阶SmoothCruiser的$\widetilde O(\varepsilon^{-4})$；并给出了OT、熵正则化与无正则化目标之间显式的正则化偏差界。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用二阶/cubic泰勒结构，规划器的样本复杂度可以从$\varepsilon^{-4}$降低到$\varepsilon^{-3}$，揭示了基于平滑Bellman backup的规划器中高阶信息对样本效率的关键作用。

title: A visual large language foundational model for medical image recognition using clinician-oriented social media
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across diverse domains, showing considerable potential in medicine. However, their application in medical settings remains limited by the scarcity of visual question answering (VQA) datasets that capture clinical reasoning and explicit image-text alignment. Here, we leverage de-identified medical images and expert commentaries shared on clinician-oriented social media. By combining an advanced LLM with clinician-in-the-loop verification, we established a rigorous pipeline to construct ThoughtMed-1M, a long-form medical VQA dataset containing over one million VQA pairs and designed to capture structured clinical logic and medical image-text alignment. To demonstrate its utility, we developed a FOundational LLM Trained on ThoughtMed-1M (FOLTMed). FOLTMed achieved state-of-the-art performance across 42 medical VQA benchmark datasets, with a macro accuracy of 85.4%, and generated more clinically coherent responses on the ThoughtMed-1M test set. It outperformed state-of-the-art models by 3--5% across factuality and similarity metrics, highlighting a scalable paradigm for advancing research on clinically grounded multimodal LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了ThoughtMed-1M，一个包含超过一百万对长格式医学视觉问答对的数据集，并基于此训练了FOLTMed模型，该模型在42个医学VQA基准上取得最先进性能，宏准确率达85.4%。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在医学领域展现出潜力，但受限于缺乏能够捕捉临床推理和显式图文对齐的视觉问答数据集。
AI.method: 利用去标识化的医学影像和来自面向临床医生的社交媒体上的专家评论，结合先进LLM与临床医生在环验证，构建了包含超过100万VQA对的ThoughtMed-1M数据集，并基于此训练FOLTMed基础模型。
AI.result: FOLTMed在42个医学VQA基准数据集上取得最先进性能，宏准确率85.4%，优于现有模型3-5%的事实性和相似性指标，并生成更具临床一致性的响应。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了通过严谨数据管道构建大规模临床医学VQA数据集的可扩展范式，为推进临床基础的多模态大语言模型研究提供了新路径。

title: Power Mean Estimation in Stochastic Continuous Monte Carlo Tree Search
comment: Published at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025)
summary: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) has demonstrated success in online planning for deterministic environments, yet significant challenges remain in adapting it to stochastic Markov Decision Processes (MDPs), particularly in continuous state-action spaces. Existing methods, such as HOOT, which combines MCTS with the Hierarchical Optimistic Optimization (HOO) bandit strategy, address continuous spaces but rely on a logarithmic exploration bonus that lacks theoretical guarantees in non-stationary, stochastic settings. Recent advancements, such as POLY-HOOT, introduced a polynomial bonus term to achieve convergence in deterministic MDPs, though a similar theory for stochastic MDPs remains undeveloped. In this paper, we propose a novel MCTS algorithm, \Algname, designed for continuous, stochastic MDPs. \Algname integrates a power mean as a value backup operator, alongside a polynomial exploration bonus to address the non-stationarity inherent in continuous action spaces. Our theoretical analysis establishes that \Algname converges at a polynomial rate of $\mathcal{O}(n^{-ζ})$, $ζ\in (0,1/2)$, where \( n \) is the number of visited trajectories, thereby extending the non-asymptotic convergence guarantees of POLY-HOOT to stochastic environments. Experimental results on stochastic tasks validate our theoretical findings, demonstrating the effectiveness of \Algname in continuous, stochastic domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为\Algname的蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，用于连续随机马尔可夫决策过程，通过引入幂均值作为价值回溯算子并结合多项式探索奖励，实现了多项式收敛率O(n^{-ζ})，将POLY-HOOT的非渐近收敛保证扩展到随机环境。
AI.motivation: 现有MCTS方法（如HOOT）在连续的随机MDP中缺乏理论保证，POLY-HOOT虽然引入了多项式奖励项但在确定性MDP中仅能收敛，尚缺乏针对随机MDP的类似理论。因此需要一种能够处理连续状态-动作空间且具备收敛保证的随机MDP规划算法。
AI.method: \Algname将幂均值（power mean）作为价值回溯（value backup）算子，用于应对连续动作空间中固有的非平稳性问题；同时引入多项式探索奖励（polynomial exploration bonus）来平衡探索与利用，从而在连续随机MDP中进行有效的在线规划。
AI.result: 理论分析证明\Algname以多项式速率O(n^{-ζ})（ζ∈(0,1/2)，n为访问轨迹数）收敛，扩展了POLY-HOOT到随机环境中的非渐近收敛保证。实验结果表明该算法在连续随机任务上有效，验证了理论发现。
AI.conclusion: \Algname成功将多项式收敛率的理论保证从确定性MDP推广至连续随机MDP，为高维连续随机环境中的在线规划提供了一种具有理论支撑且实践有效的MCTS解决方案。

title: When and Why LLM Causal Priors Help: Closed-Loop Prior Selection for Amortized Causal Inference
summary: Causal effect estimation asks how an outcome would change under an intervention, and medicine, economics, and public policy all treat it as a foundational task. Prior-data fitted networks (PFNs) amortize the task: a model trained on large numbers of programmatically generated synthetic causal tasks reads a new problem's observational data into context and returns an interventional-effect estimate in a single forward pass. The capability of such models is largely determined by the synthetic training prior, which is currently designed by hand, a bottleneck acknowledged by both Do-PFN and CausalPFN. Large language models (LLMs) can now ``draw'' plausible causal graphs for a given domain, suggesting that LLM-distilled graphs could serve as prior material. Whether injecting such graphs helps at all, where any gain comes from, and when injection helps. Practice has so far relied on manual trial and error. We propose a \emph{closed-loop prior selection framework} that casts prior injection as a budget-constrained optimization over a candidate prior pool. Candidates undergo cheap post-training and are scored by a composite metric dominated by real-domain generalization; the winner then receives full training and paired statistical validation. On a 7.34M-parameter Do-PFN, the framework's winner attains a formally significant $2.75\times$ gain on the primary evaluation domain, and its error falls below that of the uninjected official base. Generalization on an adjacent monitoring domain improves significantly, and no monitored capability degrades. Mechanism experiments show that the gain depends on the semantic content of the distilled graph rather than its structural diversity alone does not produce it (directional evidence). With this framework and this regularity in hand, the use of LLM causal priors stops being manual trial and error and becomes an empirically verifiable selection problem.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个闭环先验选择框架，将LLM蒸馏因果图的注入建模为预算约束下的优化问题。在7.34M参数的Do-PFN上，框架胜出者取得2.75倍显著增益，且证明增益来源于图的语义内容而非结构多样性。
AI.motivation: PFN（先验数据拟合网络）通过合成任务训练来摊销因果效应估计，其能力由合成训练先验决定，但先验目前依赖人工设计，效率低且缺乏系统性验证。LLM能够生成领域相关的因果图，但如何选择与注入这些图仍依赖手动试错。
AI.method: 提出闭环先验选择框架：将先验注入建模为预算约束优化问题。候选先验经历廉价的后训练，由以真实域泛化为主导的复合指标打分，胜出者获得完整训练并进行配对统计验证。
AI.result: 在7.34M参数的Do-PFN上，框架胜出者获得统计显著的2.75倍增益，误差低于未注入官方基线；相邻监控域泛化显著改善，无监测能力退化。机制实验表明增益依赖蒸馏图的语义内容，结构多样性本身不能产生增益（方向性证据）。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将LLM因果先验的使用从手动试错转变为可经验验证的选擇问题，为PFN型因果推断模型的先验选择提供了系统性方法论。

title: Structural Entropy-Driven Graph Diffusion Generation for One-Shot Federated Graph Learning
summary: One-shot federated graph learning (FGL) requires the server to estimate client contributions from highly compressed information, yet conventional volume-based weighting captures the amount of client data while overlooking how its connectivity is organized. In this paper, we propose SPIRE, a Structural Entropy-Driven Graph Diffusion Generation method that introduces topology-aware client differentiation into one-shot FGL. Specifically, we employ first-order degree-distribution structural entropy as a compact descriptor of degree-mass dispersion and use it to derive structural client weights, providing an inductive bias that accounts for differences in graph topology beyond data volume. On the generation side, a graph diffusion model on the server synthesizes pseudographs conditioned on the weighted client prototypes, capturing both semantic and structural information without requiring additional client-side training. The generated pseudographs are then assembled via disjoint union fusion to train a global graph neural network. Extensive experiments on seven real-world graph datasets demonstrate that SPIRE consistently outperforms conventional and one-shot FGL methods, with particularly strong gains under highly heterogeneous (non-IID) and graph-perturbed settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPIRE，一种基于结构熵驱动的图扩散生成方法，用于一次性联邦图学习（One-shot FGL）。该方法利用一阶度分布结构熵作为拓扑描述符来区分客户端权重，并在服务器端通过图扩散模型生成伪图，最后通过不相交并集融合训练全局图神经网络。在七个真实图数据集上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 一次性联邦图学习中，服务器需要从高度压缩的信息中估计客户端贡献，但传统的基于数据量的权重方法只关注客户端数据数量，忽视了图的连通性组织方式（拓扑结构）的差异，缺乏拓扑感知的客户端区分能力。
AI.method: (1) 利用一阶度分布结构熵作为度-质量分散度的紧凑描述符，据此推导结构化的客户端权重，提供超越数据量的拓扑归纳偏置。(2) 在服务器端使用图扩散模型，以加权客户端原型为条件合成伪图，捕获语义和结构信息且无需额外的客户端训练。(3) 通过不相交并集融合将生成的伪图组装起来，训练全局图神经网络。
AI.result: 在七个真实世界图数据集上的大量实验表明，SPIRE在常规和一次性FGL方法中均表现一致更优，在高度异构（非IID）和图扰动设置下增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: SPIRE通过结构熵感知的权重分配与图扩散生成的结合，有效解决了一次性联邦图学习中忽视拓扑结构差异的问题，在异构和扰动场景下展现出鲁棒性和优越性能。

title: iBrain: A Unified Foundation Model Reading the Brain from Surface to Spikes
summary: Invasive neural recordings provide high-fidelity measurements of brain activity, with signals such as intracranial EEG (iEEG) and intracortical spiking activity capturing neural dynamics at different spatial and temporal scales. Yet existing neural foundation models have largely been developed independently for different invasive recording paradigms, leaving joint pretraining across heterogeneous invasive signals underexplored. In this work, we introduce iBrain, a unified foundation model that jointly learns from iEEG and spiking activity. iBrain employs signal-specific encoders to accommodate their distinct signal characteristics and a shared spatiotemporal Transformer backbone to model dependencies across recording channels and time. We pretrain iBrain on over 7,000 hours of heterogeneous neural recordings using masked signal reconstruction and channel-view alignment, promoting contextual modeling of neural dynamics and robustness across different channels. iBrain consistently outperforms single-signal pretraining baselines and achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks. Further experiments demonstrate that iBrain exhibits transferability and data efficiency across diverse recording settings. These results highlight the potential of joint pretraining on heterogeneous invasive neural recordings to support scalable neural modeling and transferable representations across recording settings and downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出iBrain，一个统一的神经基础模型，能够联合学习iEEG和尖峰活动两类侵入性神经记录信号。通过信号特定编码器和共享时空Transformer骨干，在超过7000小时的异质神经数据上进行预训练，取得了多项基准上的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的神经基础模型大多是针对单一侵入性记录范式独立开发的，缺乏跨异质侵入性信号的联合预训练研究，限制了模型的泛化能力和表征迁移性。
AI.method: iBrain采用信号特定编码器适配不同信号特征，使用共享的时空Transformer骨干建模记录通道间和时间维度的依赖关系；通过掩码信号重构和通道视图对齐两种预训练任务，在7000多小时的异质神经记录上进行联合预训练。
AI.result: iBrain在多个基准上一致优于单信号预训练基线，达到最先进性能；实验还表明其在多样化记录设置下具有良好的迁移性和数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 联合预训练异质侵入性神经记录信号具有巨大潜力，能够支持可扩展的神经建模并获得跨记录设置和下游任务的可迁移表征。

title: Bi-HYCO: Bi-Objective Cooperative Learning for PDE Parameter Identification under Fragmented Observations
summary: Physical and synthetic models may describe complementary aspects of the same PDE-governed system while receiving different, possibly fragmented, observations. We propose Bi-Objective HYCO (Bi-HYCO), a cooperative framework that retains both representations and their local observational objectives while coupling their predicted states at unlabeled interaction points. These points contain no measurements and do not augment the data; they provide a communication mechanism in the common state space. The two criteria form a vector-valued objective, and weighted scalarizations provide computational realizations. For the deterministic shared-observation algorithm with fixed interaction points, we prove sufficient decrease and finite length of the whole alternating sequence, which converges to a mixed critical point under the stated Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz-type assumptions. Elliptic transmission and two-dimensional Navier-Stokes experiments assess parameter and state reconstruction, noise and scalarization effects, and PINN/XPINN references. Ablations show that removing state interaction while retaining aggregation deteriorates parameter recovery in the tested configurations, particularly for Navier-Stokes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双目标混合协同框架（Bi-HYCO），在保留物理模型与合成模型各自表示和观测目标的同时，通过在无标签交互点耦合状态预测，实现互补建模。理论证明算法收敛至混合临界点，并通过椭圆传输与二维Navier-Stokes实验验证参数和状态重建性能。
AI.motivation: 物理模型和合成模型可能描述同一PDE系统的互补方面，但它们接收的观测数据可能不同且零碎。现有方法往往难以同时利用两种模型的优势，需要一个能保留双方表示并实现协同的框架。
AI.method: 提出Bi-HYCO协同框架，采用双目标向量值目标函数（保留两模型各自的局部观测目标），通过在无标签交互点耦合两者的预测状态作为通信机制，不增加数据。使用加权标量化实现计算求解，对确定性共享观测算法（固定交互点）进行收敛性分析。
AI.result: 在Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz型假设下证明了交替序列的充分下降性和有限长度，并收敛至混合临界点。椭圆传输和二维Navier-Stokes实验考察了参数/状态重建、噪声和标量化效应，并与PINN/XPINN参照对比。消融实验显示移除状态交互仅保留聚合会恶化参数恢复，尤其对Navier-Stokes问题更显著。
AI.conclusion: 状态交互是协同框架中关键机制，仅做目标聚合而缺乏状态耦合会显著降低参数恢复性能。Bi-HYCO为PDE系统中物理与合成模型的协同提供了理论基础和有效的计算框架。

title: SSP-DMGTimeNet: Physics-Constrained Learning for Spatiotemporal Trajectory Prediction of Vehicle Platoons
summary: Existing car-following prediction methods mainly optimize trajectory accuracy, while rarely considering whether predicted disturbances propagate realistically along a vehicle platoon. This limitation may lead to accurate but string-unstable predictions. We propose SSP-DMGTimeNet, a physics-constrained learning framework for spatiotemporal trajectory prediction of vehicle platoons. The model combines multi-scale temporal representations with cross-vehicle interaction features to capture complex and time-varying platoon dynamics. A propagation-delay-aware causal attention mechanism explicitly models upstream-to-downstream disturbance propagation by learning response delays between adjacent vehicles and accumulating them along the platoon. In addition, time- and frequency-domain string-stability losses relieve disturbance amplification across both adjacent vehicles and arbitrary sub-platoons during training. Experiments on HighD show that SSP-DMGTimeNet achieves an unstable-window rate of 0.65\% for five-vehicle platoons and a maximum head-to-tail amplification of 0.898 on the ground-truth excitation subset, while maintaining competitive trajectory prediction performance. In zero-shot evaluation on NGSIM US-101 and I-80, the model achieves velocity MAEs of 1.316~m/s and 1.252~m/s, with unstable-window rates of 3.90\% and 4.10\%, respectively. These results demonstrate that incorporating platoon-level physical constraints can effectively balance trajectory prediction accuracy and disturbance propagation stability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SSP-DMGTimeNet，一个物理约束的车辆队列时空轨迹预测框架，在保证轨迹预测精度的同时，通过显式建模扰动传播和字符串稳定性约束，有效解决了现有方法预测准确但队列不稳定（string-unstable）的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的跟车预测方法主要优化轨迹精度，很少考虑预测的扰动是否能在车辆队列中真实传播，这可能导致预测结果虽然准确但字符串不稳定（string-unstable），即扰动在队列中被放大。
AI.method: 该模型结合多尺度时间表示与跨车交互特征捕捉复杂的时变队列动力学；提出传播延迟感知的因果注意力机制显式建模上游到下游的扰动传播；引入时域和频域的字符串稳定性损失来约束训练，抑制相邻车辆及任意子队列中的扰动放大。
AI.result: 在HighD数据集上，五车队列的不稳定窗口率为0.65%，真实激励子集的最大头尾放大为0.898，同时保持有竞争力的轨迹预测性能。在NGSIM US-101和I-80上的零样本评估中，速度MAE分别为1.316 m/s和1.252 m/s，不稳定窗口率分别为3.90%和4.10%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果证明，在轨迹预测中融入队列级物理约束可以有效平衡预测精度与扰动传播稳定性，验证了物理约束学习框架的可行性。

title: Model-Adaptive and Risk-Constrained Frequency Hopping Against Predictive Jammers
summary: Adaptive frequency hopping against predictive jamming must address both model uncertainty and policy exposure: the context-loss relationship may vary across operating regimes, while persistent hopping patterns may expose high-probability channels to attack. We propose D-PACT-AFH, a model-adaptive and risk-constrained adversarial contextual-bandit framework in which a Tsallis-FTRL master combines a global linear learner with a partitioned local learner and selects the model class online. D-PACT-Hit incorporates channel-wise marginal hit risk into model selection, while D-PACT-Safe applies a minimum-Kullback-Leibler projection to enforce a per-slot risk budget. We establish estimator validity under non-anticipating attacks, an oracle decomposition relative to the better fixed base, and an exact conditional-risk guarantee for the Safe projection. Experiments across diverse channel regimes and jammer types demonstrate effective model adaptation and a controllable goodput-risk tradeoff: D-PACT-AFH recovers 95.5% of the local learner's gain under observable switching while avoiding 77.7% of its degradation in a negative-control regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出D-PACT-AFH框架，一种模型自适应且风险约束的对抗性上下文老虎机方法，用于应对预测性干扰下的自适应跳频问题。框架通过Tsallis-FTRL主学习器结合全局线性学习器与分区局部学习器并在线上选择模型类别，同时提出两种变体：D-PACT-Hit引入通道边际命中风险到模型选择中，D-PACT-Safe通过最小KL散度投影实现每时隙风险预算。实验表明该方法能有效适应模型变化并实现可控的吞吐量-风险权衡。
AI.motivation: 自适应跳频对抗预测性干扰时需同时应对两大挑战：一是上下文-损失关系可能随运行环境变化而产生模型不确定性，无法用单一固定模型描述；二是持续跳频模式可能暴露高概率信道而遭受攻击，带来策略暴露风险。现有方法未同时处理模型适应性与风险约束问题。
AI.method: 设计D-PACT-AFH框架：采用Tsallis-FTRL作为主学习器，将全局线性学习器与分区局部学习器进行组合，通过在线方式动态选择最优模型类别。该框架包含两个核心变体——D-PACT-Hit将逐信道的边际命中风险纳入模型选择过程，D-PACT-Safe则通过最小KL散度投影技术对每时隙施加风险预算约束。
AI.result: 理论方面：建立了非预期攻击下的估计器有效性、相对于更优固定基线的oracle分解以及Safe投影精确条件风险保证。实验方面：在多种信道环境和干扰类型下展示有效模型适应性。D-PACT-AFH在可观测切换场景下能恢复局部学习器95.5%的增益，在阴性对照场景下避免了77.7%的性能退化，呈现可控的吞吐量-风险权衡。
AI.conclusion: D-PACT-AFH通过模型自适应与风险约束的联合设计，有效解决了预测性干扰环境下自适应跳频中的模型不确定性和策略暴露问题。实验验证了其在不同信道环境与干扰类型下的鲁棒性，实现了良好吞吐量与可控风险之间的灵活权衡。

title: RedKnot-MLA: Multi-Head Offline-Online Reuse for DeepSeek-V4 Long-Context Serving
summary: Multi-head latent attention (MLA) exposes many logical query heads through one packed latent KV stream. This representation is memory efficient, but it removes the physical per-head cache boundary assumed by conventional head-wise reuse. We present our system, a DeepSeek-V4 realization of RedKnot's head-aware reuse principle. Each immutable document is processed offline at canonical position zero; certified Local-head contributions are retained as MLA-Off. At serving time, query-side RoPE relocation restores the document's request position, a small Global-head set and protected Local token rows are recomputed as MLA-Online, and the two paths are merged before a single shared output projection. The packed MLA latent is never split. DeepSeek-V4-Flash uses 37 reusable layers and a 56/8 Local/Global partition, giving a 75.29% analytic logical head-row ceiling; the Pro-0813 profile uses 55 layers and 112/16 heads, giving 78.89%. Frozen Flash operating points show hot-artifact TTFT speedups of 2.02-3.84x. At 256K, the archived three-dataset study reports an aggregate F1 change of +3.24 percentage points, an EM change of +4.16 points, and a 78.7-79.5% analytic major-operator arithmetic saving, while one dataset decreases by 2.81 F1 points. A separate author-reported 256K hot-artifact QPS measurement is approximately 2.0x; because its raw concurrency trace is not included in this bundle, we mark it as preliminary rather than archived evidence. We describe the factorization, position repair, token-row closure, sparse-MoE support, TP8 integration, and the measurement boundaries needed to interpret these results.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeepSeek-V4系统，实现了RedKnot的头部级重用原则（head-aware reuse）。该方法将文档离线处理为MLA-Off缓存，服务时通过查询端RoPE重定位恢复位置，仅重算少量Global头和保护的Local token行（MLA-Online），两路径合并后经共享输出投影。由于MLA的packed潜变量从不拆分，实现了逻辑查询头重用而不破坏内存效率。
AI.motivation: MLA（多头潜注意力）将多个逻辑查询头打包到一个潜KV流中，虽内存高效，却移除了传统逐头重用所依赖的物理每头缓存边界。这使得文档级逻辑头级重用无法直接实现，需要新的系统设计来兼顾内存效率与推理重用。
AI.method: 采用两阶段路径：离线阶段（MLA-Off）在规范位置0处理不可变文档，保留认证的Local-head贡献；服务阶段（MLA-Online）通过查询侧RoPE重定位恢复请求位置，重算少量Global头和受保护的Local token行；两条路径合并后进入共享输出投影，整个过程不拆分packed MLA潜变量。系统涵盖因子分解、位置修复、token行闭包、稀疏MoE支持及TP8集成。
AI.result: DeepSeek-V4-Flash配置（37个可复用层，56/8 Local/Global分区）达到75.29%的分析性逻辑头行上限；Pro-0813配置（55层，112/16头）达78.89%。冻结Flash工作点显示热工件TTFT加速2.02-3.84倍；256K归档三数据集研究中，聚合F1提升+3.24个百分点，EM提升+4.16个百分点，主运算符算术节省78.7-79.5%，但一个数据集F1下降2.81点。另有一份作者报告的256K热工件QPS约为2.0倍，因缺少原始并发跟踪，标记为初步而非归档证据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了在不拆分packed MLA潜变量的前提下实现头部级重用的可行性，显著提升了热工件场景的推理性能。同时作者强调测量边界的区分——归档证据与初步结果需明确标记，部分数据集存在性能下降，结果需要在完整上下文中解读。

title: Role-Specific Predictive Geometries for Nonstationary Multivariate Graph-Signal Forecasting
summary: Forecasting multivariate graph signals is challenging when node-level trajectories are nonstationary but stable relations persist across nodes and features. In an error-correction representation, long-run equilibrium restoration and short-run transient propagation represent different predictive roles and need not share a common cross-feature geometry. We introduce role-specific predictive geometries in which directed Long relations act on estimated equilibrium coordinates, whereas directed Short relations act on lagged differences. Matrix-valued Long responses mix equilibrium coordinates before graph propagation, while Short responses use graph-filtered transient designs; a direct multi-horizon estimator couples forecast corrections across adjacent horizons. Temporal cross-fitting and Frisch-Waugh-Lovell partialling-out give selected edges a conditional predictive interpretation relative to a graph-temporal backbone. The Long operator remains right-factorized through the equilibrium subspace and therefore annihilates source common-trend directions. Controlled experiments recover all planted Long relations (20/20), all planted Short relations (20/20), and both role families in every Dual realization (10/10). Across four real-world benchmarks, the proposed predictor improves on the G-VARMA backbone in three datasets, with all 25 fold-horizon comparisons favorable on the five-fold financial benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对多变量图信号预测的方法，在节点轨迹非平稳但跨节点和特征关系稳定的场景下，为长期均衡回复（Long关系）和短期瞬态传播（Short关系）分别引入角色特定的预测几何结构。Long算子作用于估计的均衡坐标并通过均衡子空间右因子化，Short关系作用于图滤波后的滞后差分。通过时间交叉拟合和FWL偏除方法实现条件预测解释，实验验证在受控环境和企业数据基准上优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 多变量图信号预测中，节点级轨迹非平稳但节点间及特征间的稳定关系持续存在。在误差修正表示下，长期均衡回复与短期瞬态传播具有不同的预测角色，不应共享相同的跨特征几何结构。现有方法（如G-VARMA骨干）未能区分这两种角色的差异化预测几何，导致预测精度受限。
AI.method: (1) 为Long和Short关系分别定义角色特定的预测几何：Long关系作用于估计的均衡坐标（矩阵值Long响应在图上传播前混合均衡坐标），Short关系作用于图滤波后的滞后差分设计（Short响应使用图滤波的瞬态设计）；(2) 设计直接多步预测估计器，耦合相邻预测时域的误差修正；(3) 使用时间交叉拟合和Frisch-Waugh-Lovell偏除法，使被选中的边相对于图-时间骨干获得条件性预测解释；(4) Long算子在均衡子空间上保持右因子化，从而消去源共同趋势方向的影响。
AI.result: 受控实验中，方法完整恢复所有植入的Long关系（20/20）、所有植入的Short关系（20/20），以及在每种Dual实现中识别出两个角色族（10/10）。在四个真实世界基准数据集上，相比G-VARMA骨干，在三个数据集中取得改进；在五项交叉验证的金融基准中，全部25个折-时域比较均表现有利。
AI.conclusion: 将长期均衡与短期瞬态传播的角色分离，并赋予各自独立的预测几何，能够显著提升非平稳多变量图信号预测的精度。该方法在受控和真实数据场景中均展现出可靠性与优越性，尤其在金融数据上表现突出。

title: Beyond One-Shot Expansion: Contrastive Evidence Exploration for Multi-Hop Retrieval
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) critically depends on retrieving the evidence necessary for effective reasoning. However, this remains particularly challenging in multi-hop question answering (QA), where supporting passages are often linked through intermediate entities and relations that must be progressively uncovered. Existing retrieval approaches typically rely on a single retrieval intent or one-shot query expansion, limiting their ability to adapt to newly retrieved evidence and potentially introducing noisy or redundant retrieval signals. To address these limitations, we propose a training-free multi-hop retrieval framework that integrates evidence-conditioned exploration, passage-specific contrastive refinement, and coverage-aware final ranking. During offline indexing, the framework constructs passage-specific contrastive facets that characterize each passage relative to its semantically similar neighbors, providing fine-grained signals to distinguish closely related candidates. At inference time, the framework iteratively retrieves evidence, generates probes targeting unresolved information needs, refines candidate relevance using the contrastive facets, and selects a complementary set of passages that collectively cover diverse evidence-seeking intents. Experiments on MuSiQue, HotpotQA, and 2WikiMultihopQA demonstrate consistent improvements in retrieval quality and downstream QA performance over baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个无需训练的多跳检索框架，通过证据条件探索、段落级对比精炼和覆盖感知排序来提升RAG系统中多跳问答的检索质量。
AI.motivation: 多跳问答中的RAG检索高度依赖逐步发现的中间实体和关系来连接支持性段落，但现有方法依赖单一检索意图或一次性查询扩展，无法适应新检索到的证据，且容易引入噪声或冗余信号。
AI.method: 提出训练无关的多跳检索框架：(1) 在离线索引阶段，为每个段落构建与语义相似邻居相对的对比面，提供细粒度区分信号；(2) 在推理阶段，迭代检索证据、生成针对未解决信息需求的探针、利用对比面精炼候选相关性，并选择互补段落集以覆盖多样的证据寻求意图。
AI.result: 在MuSiQue、HotpotQA和2WikiMultihopQA三个基准数据集上，相较于基线方法，在检索质量和下游问答性能上均取得一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效克服了传统多跳检索中意图单一和查询扩展一次性的局限性，通过迭代证据探索和对比精炼显著增强了多跳推理的支持证据获取能力。

title: Not Just Oversmoothing: Detecting the Echo Chamber Effect in Graph Neural Networks
summary: Oversmoothing is a well-known failure mode of Graph Neural Networks (GNNs). However, most existing diagnostics rely on global aggregation measures that fail to capture the heterogeneous dynamics of message passing. Real-world graphs exhibit pronounced community structure, and message passing operates on two timescales, with representations collapsing rapidly within communities and slowly across them. This creates a critical gap in which intra-community representations can become indistinguishable while inter community separation persists, a failure mode that we refer to as the Echo Chamber Effect. To quantify this effect, we introduce the Echo Chamber Index (ECI), which stratifies pairwise distances by community membership and reveals when global energy diminishes while inter-community separation persists. ECI further shows that feature retention mechanisms can preserve the echo chamber under the conditions of our theoretical analysis. The consequences depend on label structure: when communities align with classes, the echo chamber can sharpen node classification, whereas when they do not, the same collapse makes classification provably harder. Motivated by this analysis, we propose Community-Aware Split Propagation (CASP), a lightweight plugin that decouples intra- and inter-community aggregation and learns their balance from label structure. CASP improves diverse backbone GNNs across most evaluated homophilic and heterophilic settings.

AI.tldr: 本文发现GNN过度平滑中一个被忽视的现象——消息传递在社区内部和社区之间以不同时间尺度进行，导致社区内表示先崩溃而社区间仍有区分度，称为"回声室效应"。作者提出回声室指数（ECI）来量化该效应，并设计社区感知分裂传播（CASP）插件来解耦社区内外的聚合过程，改善GNN在多种数据集上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN过度平滑的诊断方法依赖全局聚合指标，无法捕捉真实的异质消息传递动态。真实图具有显著社区结构，消息传递在两种时间尺度上运行——社区内表示快速崩溃、社区间缓慢分离，这之间存在一个关键窗口期，社区内表示已无法区分但社区间仍有分离，现有全局指标无法捕捉这一失败模式。
AI.method: 1) 提出回声室效应概念，揭示社区内/间表示崩溃的时间尺度差异；2) 引入回声室指数（ECI），按社区归属对成对距离进行分层，量化全局能量衰减而社区间分离持续的现象；3) 理论分析表明特征保留机制在特定条件下会保留回声室效应；4) 提出社区感知分裂传播（CASP）插件，解耦社区内和社区间的聚合过程，并从标签结构中学习两者的平衡。
AI.result: CASP在大多数同质性和异质性设置中提升了多种骨干GNN的表现。回声室效应的后果取决于标签结构：社区与类别对齐时可增强节点分类性能，不对齐时则使分类从理论上更难。
AI.conclusion: 过度平滑不是单一的全局现象，而是具有社区感知的异质动态。理解并解耦社区内外的消息传递对设计更好、更稳健的GNN至关重要，CASP为此提供了轻量级且有效的解决方案。

title: VST: Verifiable Structured Transport for Auditable Agent-to-Agent Alpha Discovery
summary: Agent-to-agent (A2A) alpha discovery is slowed by repeated feedback cycles between mining and evaluation agents, whose hand-offs, in contemporary LLM multi-agent systems, are free-form natural-language messages that carry no stable contract and cannot be replayed. We first restructure this communication as a structured agent-to-agent protocol of \emph{typed, causally addressable, unicast records}, so that the committed stream forms a causal trajectory. On that trajectory a single predictor with four typed heads forecasts the accumulated guidance the two miners would receive several cycles ahead; a transactional verify--leap controller then commits a multi-cycle speculative outcome only when it passes a four-level gate, and otherwise rolls back to the exact prior state. Structure is the enabling contribution, and its value is not accuracy. A controlled ablation shows an equal-information free-text channel reaches the same predictor hit rate. What typing provides is a state that can be schema-checked, replayed deterministically, and prevented by construction from leaking a forecast to an evaluator: auditability by construction, not an empirically stress-tested guarantee. On a CSI~1000 out-of-sample holdout, our single run is the only one among eight methods (seven baselines and ours) to hold a positive median annualized return and Sharpe at the factor level, though the median return \emph{in excess} of the benchmark stays negative for every method including ours; its development-selected top-20 portfolios reach a $0.71$ median holdout Sharpe, selected on a split inside the optimization horizon. We report these single-run results descriptively, gross of costs, and are explicit about their limits throughout; in particular we do not isolate the effect of the leap machinery from the inherited search substrate, which we leave to future work.

AI.tldr: 本文针对LLM多智能体系统中A2A（agent-to-agent）alpha发现的效率问题，提出将智能体间自由文本通信重构为结构化协议（类型化、因果可寻址的单播记录），使提交流形成因果轨迹，并通过带四个类型头的预测器与事务性的"验证-跳跃"控制器实现多周期投机性提交。其核心贡献在于结构而非精度——类型化提供可审计性（可schema检查、可确定性回放、防构造性泄露），而非提升预测命中率。在CSI 1000样本外测试中，该方法在八种方法中唯一保持因子层面正的中位年化收益与Sharpe，但超额中位收益仍为负，结果以描述性方式报告且未隔离跳跃机制与基础搜索基座的各自贡献。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM多智能体alpha发现系统存在反复的挖掘与评估智能体间反馈循环，其交互以自由文本消息进行，缺乏稳定契约且不可回放，严重拖慢A2A alpha发现效率并阻碍审计验证。
AI.method: 将A2A通信重构为结构化协议，采用类型化、因果可寻址的单播记录，使提交流成为因果轨迹；在该轨迹上，一个带四种类型头的预测器预测多个周期后两个挖掘者将累积的引导；事务性的"验证-跳跃"控制器仅当结果通过四级门控时提交多周期投机性结果，否则回滚至先前精确状态。
AI.result: 在CSI 1000样本外测试中，该方法作为八种方法中唯一在因子层面保持正的中位年化收益和Sharpe的方法；开发阶段选出的前20投资组合达到0.71的中位保持期Sharpe（在优化期内部分分割上选择）；但所有方法的基准超额中位收益均为负（包括本方法）。控制消融表明，同等信息量的自由文本通道可达到相同预测命中率。
AI.conclusion: 这些单次运行结果以描述性方式报告，且未计成本；作者承认其局限，特别是未将跳跃机制的效果与继承的搜索基座分离，该隔离工作留待未来研究。表明类型化通信的核心价值在于构造性可审计性，而非提升收益或预测精度。

title: Hidden in Plain Sight: The Overlooked Significance of Canonical Elements for Extreme LLM Sparsity
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are often considered fragile under aggressive sparsification, and maintaining reliable performance typically requires sticking to moderate sparsity levels. However, recent studies suggest that LLMs are more resilient to high sparsity than previously thought, reframing the problem as a design challenge rather than a fundamental limitation. In this work, we challenge the perceived limits of unstructured post-training LLM pruning by revisiting elementary pruning strategies that have remained relatively underexplored at this scale. Through a progressive sparsification framework with second-order saliency and continued training coordinated with sparsity progression, we show that pretrained LLMs can retain strong performance far beyond commonly studied sparsity regimes. Across LLaMA-2 and Qwen-3 model families, our approach improves perplexity and downstream accuracy up to 99\% sparsity, surpassing both the current state-of-the-art and representative baselines. Precisely, on LLaMA-2-7B, our approach achieves WikiText-2 perplexities of 13.48 and 19.67 at 95\% and 99\% sparsity, respectively, while delivering 3.23$\times$ decoding speedup and 6.21$\times$ memory savings at 95\% sparsity. Taken together, our results show that LLMs can be pushed into extreme sparsity while retaining strong performance, providing a foundation for further improving sparse models in this regime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种渐进式稀疏化框架，结合二阶显著性度量和与稀疏度进度协调的持续训练，证明预训练大语言模型在高达99%的极端非结构化稀疏度下仍能保持强劲性能，远超以往认为的稀疏性极限。
AI.motivation: 先前研究认为大语言模型在激进稀疏化下表现脆弱，通常只能维持适度的稀疏水平。但近期研究表明LLM对高稀疏度比预想的更具韧性。本文旨在挑战非结构化后训练剪枝的感知极限，重新审视在LLM大规模场景下未被充分探索的基础剪枝策略。
AI.method: 采用渐进式稀疏化框架，使用二阶显著性（second-order saliency）评估权重重要性，并将持续训练（continued training）与稀疏度递增过程相协调。通过让模型在高稀疏逐步推进的同时持续训练，使模型适应日益稀疏的结构。
AI.result: 在LLaMA-2和Qwen-3模型家族上，该方法在高达99%稀疏度下均提升了困惑度和下游任务准确率，超越现有最先进方法和代表性基线。在LLaMA-2-7B上，95%和99%稀疏度时WikiText-2困惑度分别达到13.48和19.67，且在95%稀疏度下实现3.23倍解码加速和6.21倍内存节省。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明LLM可以被推向极端稀疏度同时保持强劲性能，这一发现为在该稀疏区间进一步改进稀疏模型提供了基础。

title: A Hierarchical Consistency Framework for Auditing Retrieval-Augmented Generation Systems
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) is commonly evaluated by whether the final answer is correct. That test is insufficient: an answer can match its reference while the context that produced it contains a direct contradiction, leaving the contested evidence invisible to answer-only review and retrieval relevance scores. This paper presents the Hierarchical Consistency Framework (HCF), a post-hoc, model-agnostic audit of three distinct levels of a RAG process: the knowledge corpus, the final retrieved context, and the generated answer. HCF represents corpus conflicts as source-linked atomic facts, thereby identifying the documents responsible, and returns each Answer Consistency Score (ACS) with an explanation of supporting and contradictory contextual statements. We evaluate HCF on several controlled corpora spanning five domains and 100 query-corpus instances. A human evaluator compares every generated response with its supplied ground-truth response. The results show that the three diagnostic levels can dissociate: the corpus with the highest mean retrieval similarity has the lowest mean ACS, while a structurally degraded corpus performs worse at corpus level but better at answer level. Most importantly, HCF identifies contradictory retrieved evidence in several cases where the answer still matches the ground truth. HCF does not certify factual truth; it makes the evidence supporting and challenging an answer inspectable and attributable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分层一致性框架（HCF），用于对RAG流程的三个层级（知识语料库、检索上下文、生成答案）进行事后审计。HCF将语料库冲突表示为源链接原子事实，生成带有支持性与矛盾性解释的答案一致性得分（ACS）。实验表明三个诊断层级可以解耦，且HCF能在答案与参考答案匹配的情况下识别出检索证据中的矛盾，使支撑与挑战答案的证据可检查、可归因。
AI.motivation: 传统RAG评估仅检查最终答案是否正确是不够的——答案可能匹配参考但在产生该答案的上下文中存在直接矛盾，导致争议性证据在仅看答案的审查和检索相关性评分中不可见。
AI.method: 提出Hierarchical Consistency Framework（HCF），一种事后、与模型无关的审计框架。HCF将语料库冲突表示为源链接的原子事实，从三个层级（知识语料库、最终检索上下文、生成的答案）进行分析，并为每个答案返回带解释的Answer Consistency Score（ACS），同时指出支持性和矛盾性的上下文陈述。
AI.result: 在五个领域100个查询-语料库实例上进行评估，由人工评估者比较每个生成响应与其提供的真实响应。结果表明三个诊断层级可以解耦：平均检索相似度最高的语料库具有最低的平均ACS值，而结构退化语料库在语料库层级表现较差但在答案层级表现较好。最重要的是，HCF在多个答案仍匹配真实值的情况下识别出矛盾的检索证据。
AI.conclusion: HCF不认证事实真实性，而是使支持和挑战某个答案的证据变得可检查和可归因，为RAG系统提供更全面的审计能力。

title: Layer-Wise Gate-Controlled Prompt Truncation in a Multimodal Chest X-Ray Classifier
summary: Mixture of Prompt Experts (MoPE) adapts multimodal transformers through input-dependent prompt composition, while retaining a fixed prompt length. We investigate a layer-wise gating extension in a binary chest X-ray classification pilot study. The controller predicts a retention ratio for each sample, averages these ratios within a mini-batch, and uses the resulting integer length to truncate the static and mixed visual prompts. Retained mixed prompts are also scaled by the individual ratios. In one recorded run per configuration, the gated model reached a best validation accuracy of 0.8996, compared with 0.8969 for the fixed-length baseline; the corresponding final values were 0.8963 and 0.8802. The exported gate statistics imply a retained length of one at all recorded training points, relative to a configured maximum of six. This reduces the complete visual sequence from 210 to 200 tokens, but no direct runtime measurements establish an acceleration benefit. Report-derived labels, report text as input, sequential data partitioning, and the absence of repeated controlled experiments limit interpretation. The findings document prompt shortening under the configured gate penalty; they do not establish sample-specific length allocation, superiority over fixed short prompts, or clinical utility. Code is available at: https://github.com/jingtaolei/mope-dynamic-prompt-truncation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoPE（提示专家混合）模型，通过层间门控扩展实现样本依赖的输入提示截断，在二元胸部X光分类试点研究中，门控模型的最佳验证准确率为0.8996，略优于固定长度基线的0.8969。但门控统计显示保留长度几乎恒为1（配置最大为6），且缺乏运行时加速证据和重复实验控制，结论有限。
AI.motivation: 探索如何通过输入依赖的提示长度分配来适配多模态Transformer，以提升提示调优的效率和性能，同时保持固定的提示长度配置。
AI.method: 采用层间门控扩展：控制器为每个样本预测保留比例，在迷你批次内平均该比例，并利用得到的整数长度截断静态和混合视觉提示；保留的混合提示还按个体比例缩放。将完整视觉序列从210减少到200个token。
AI.result: 门控模型最佳验证准确率0.8996对比固定长度基线0.8969；最终值0.8963对比0.8802。但门控统计显示所有记录训练点保留长度均为1（相对最大6），提示从210减到200 token，无直接运行时测量证实加速。
AI.conclusion: 研究发现仅记录在配置门控惩罚下的提示缩短现象，不能确立样本特定长度分配的有效性、相对于固定短提示的优越性或临床实用性。受限于报告标签、报告文本输入、顺序数据分区及缺乏重复对照实验等因素。

title: Risk Is Not Review Value: Wrong-Answer Exposure Under Bounded Review Budgets
summary: LLM assistants often produce more answers than humans can review before users see them. Most evaluations ask whether an answer is wrong, unsupported, or low-confidence. Bounded review budgets instead ask which answers should be checked first under a fixed review budget. Risk alone is not enough: a high-risk answer may be hard to repair, while a moderately risky answer may be directly correctable from available evidence. For generated-answer evaluation, we model review prioritization as exposure reduction, where review value combines estimated wrongness, intervention affordance, impact, and cost. We evaluate review queues with Wrong-Answer Exposure Ratio (WAER), the fraction of wrong answers left unreviewed, and post-repair residual exposure (PRRE), the fraction still exposed after deterministic benchmark-supported repairs. PRRE uses repairability rules that do not numerically reuse the affordance scores used for ranking. On a 720-item TAT-QA/SciFact stress benchmark, review-value ranking keeps answer-level WAER nearly unchanged at 20% budget (0.605 vs. 0.600) but lowers PRRE from 0.881 to 0.716. These results show that trustworthy LLM evaluation should measure not only error detection, but also how limited review capacity reduces exposed wrong answers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将LLM代答评估中有限的审查预算建模为“暴露减少”问题，通过结合错误概率、可修复性、影响和成本来排序审查队列，并引入WAER和PRRE两个新指标衡量在固定预算下未审查和未修复错误答案的比例。
AI.motivation: LLM助手生成的回答数量远超人类在用户看到前能审查的量，现有评估只关注错误检测，忽略了在固定审查预算下应优先检查哪些答案这一关键问题。单纯依赖风险排序不够，因为高风险答案可能难以修复，而中等风险答案可能可以直接从已有证据中修正。
AI.method: 将审查优先级建模为暴露减少问题，审查价值综合考虑估计错误程度、干预可及性（可修复形态）、影响力和成本。提出WAER（未审查错误答案比例）和PRRE（确定性基准支持修复后仍暴露的比例）两个指标，PRRE的修复规则不重复使用排序所用的可及性分数。
AI.result: 在720项TAT-QA/SciFact压力测试基准上，审查价值排序在20%预算下保持答案级WAER几乎不变（0.605 vs 0.600），但将PRRE从0.881降至0.716。
AI.conclusion: 可信的LLM评估不仅应测量错误检测能力，还应关注有限的审查能力如何有效减少暴露给用户的错误答案，可修复性应纳入审查优先级的核心考量。

title: Deep Barycentric Regression for Optimal Transport Map Estimation and its Statistical Optimality
summary: The optimal transport (OT) map provides a geometric transformation for aligning probability distributions and has become a useful tool in machine learning. However, existing estimators of the OT map still exhibit a gap between sharp statistical guarantees and practical parametric estimation based on stable training objectives. Theoretical estimators achieve minimax optimal convergence rates, but they are typically nonparametric and can incur demanding implementation design or inference costs. Practical estimators are parametric and scalable, but their statistical guarantees remain underexplored, and their min-max, adversarial-like training objectives can be sensitive to optimization algorithms. We propose BROT (Barycentric Regression for OT), a simple two-step method that first computes the unregularized OT plan and then fits a deep neural network (DNN) to the induced barycentric targets by least-squares regression. Under standard regularity conditions, we prove that the DNN estimator of BROT attains the minimax convergence rate, when the ground-truth OT map is Lipschitz. Numerical studies on synthetic datasets and an image dataset show that BROT provides accurate map estimates, strong target distribution matching, and competitive transport costs, compared to existing estimation methods. Experiments on two downstream tasks, single-cell perturbation prediction and unsupervised domain adaptation, further suggest that the accurate estimation of BROT can translate into stronger task performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BROT（Barycentric Regression for OT），一种两步骤的最优传输映射估计方法：先计算无正则化OT计划，再用深度神经网络对诱导的重心目标进行最小二乘回归。在标准正则条件下，当真实OT映射为Lipschitz函数时，BROT的DNN估计器达到极小极大收敛速率。数值实验和下游任务（单细胞扰动预测、无监督域适应）表明BROT具有出色的性能和实际应用价值。
AI.motivation: 现有OT映射估计器存在理论与实践之间的鸿沟：理论估计器能达到极小极大最优收敛速率，但通常是非参数的，实现复杂且推断成本高；实际估计器是参数化且可扩展的，但其统计保证未被充分探索，且基于最小最大对抗训练的目标对优化算法敏感。需要一种兼具理论最优性和实际可操作性的估计方法。
AI.method: BROT采用简洁的两步方法：第一步计算无正则化的最优传输（OT）计划；第二步将OT计划诱导出的重心映射作为目标，通过最小二乘回归拟合深度神经网络（DNN）。该方法避免了对抗训练的不稳定性，同时利用DNN的参数化可扩展性。
AI.result: 在标准正则条件下，当真实OT映射为Lipschitz时，BROT的DNN估计器被证明达到极小极大收敛速率。合成数据集和图像数据集上的数值实验表明BROT能提供准确的映射估计、强目标分布匹配能力和有竞争力的传输代价。在单细胞扰动预测和无监督域适应两个下游任务中，BROT的准确估计转化为更强的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: BROT成功弥合了OT映射估计中理论最优性与实践可操作性之间的鸿沟，通过简单的两步骤回归框架同时获得极小极大统计保证和稳定的参数化训练过程，并在多个下游任务中验证了其实际价值。

title: Beyond Sparse Rewards: A New Benchmark and Structure-Aware Graph Alignment for Micro-Drama Understanding
summary: Micro-dramas, characterized by ultra-short durations and hyper-dense storylines, pose unique challenges for video understanding that conventional benchmarks fail to address. To bridge this gap, we introduce M-Drama, the first large-scale bilingual benchmark for micro-drama comprehension, featuring over 35K instances across 9,138 clips. Furthermore, while reinforcement learning can enhance VLMs on complex narratives, existing reward metrics often suffer from sparse and superficial signals, failing to capture intricate character identities and temporal structures. We propose SAGA (Structure-Aware Graph Alignment), a novel graph-matching reward function that models narratives as heterogeneous graphs. SAGA computes dense, rigorous rewards via decoupled semantic triplet and structural temporal matching. Extensive experiments on Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct demonstrate that SAGA outperforms existing baselines, delivering substantial improvements in open-ended accuracy and summary quality, while maintaining competitive out-of-domain generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/qyx1121/MDrama_SAGA.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了M-Drama，首个大规模双语微短剧理解基准（含35K+实例、9,138个片段），并提出SAGA（结构感知图对齐）奖励函数，通过异构图建模和稠密结构化奖励增强视觉语言模型在微短剧复杂叙事理解上的表现。
AI.motivation: 微短剧具有超短时长、情节密度极高的特点，现有视频理解基准无法应对其独特挑战。此外，强化学习虽能增强VLM对复杂叙事的理解，但现有奖励指标信号稀疏化、表面化，难以捕捉剧中复杂的角色身份与时间结构。
AI.method: 1) 构建M-Drama双语基准，包含35K+实例与9,138个片段；2) 提出SAGA奖励函数，将叙事建模为异构图；3) 通过解耦的语义三元组匹配与结构时序匹配，计算稠密且严格的奖励信号。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上的大量实验表明，SAGA优于现有基线方法，在开放式准确率和摘要质量上均有显著提升，同时保持良好的跨领域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了微短剧理解基准的空白，并验证了结构感知的图匹配奖励函数在提升VLM复杂叙事理解方面的有效性。

title: A Statistical and Machine Learning Framework for Quantifying Offensive Impact in Professional Box Lacrosse
summary: Professional box-lacrosse statistics summarize outcomes but provide limited information about shot quality or the roles behind scoring opportunities. This study develops a documented framework for estimating expected goals (xG) and attributing recorded offensive involvement using 1,006 manually annotated Rochester Knighthawks shot attempts, including 151 goals, from 13 consecutive 2025-2026 National Lacrosse League games. Logistic regression, random forest, and extremely randomized trees were evaluated across three nested feature sets using Leave-One-Game-Out cross-validation and a training-fold base-rate benchmark. The contextual baseline random forest had the lowest observed pooled log loss (0.4189) and Brier score (0.1260), improving on the benchmark by 1.22% and 1.50%; five of nine specifications did not beat the benchmark. Adding two-man-action and pick-type fields did not improve the primary metrics. Core Offensive Impact attributes recorded involvement through shooter xG and shot-based expected assists for final passers. Expected Pick Value (xPV) compares a qualifying pick's observed-state probability with a no-pick counterfactual. Its magnitude was indistinguishable from model noise. Its directional pattern exceeded 200 row-permutation replicates, but limited tail resolution and failure to preserve game-level pick composition make the diagnostic descriptive rather than inferential. Accordingly, xPV is reported only as an exploratory augmented component. Given the single-team, 13-game sample, the results are an initial case study rather than league-wide or causal estimates.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于2025-2026赛季国家长曲棍球联盟（NLL）罗切斯特刀锋队13场比赛的1,006次手动标注射门尝试（含151粒进球），开发了预期进球（xG）估计框架与进攻参与归因体系。结果显示，基于上下文基线的随机森林模型在池化对数损失（0.4189）和Brier分数（0.1260）上表现最佳，分别比基线基准提升1.22%和1.50%，但九种规格中有五种未能超越基准。研究同时提出用于评估掩护球员价值的预期掩护值（xPV）作为探索性补充指标。
AI.motivation: 职业长曲棍球（箱式长曲棍球）的统计数据仅能总结比赛结果，无法提供射门质量或得分机会背后球员角色的详细信息，因此需要构建能够估计预期进球并归因进攻参与的框架，以更深入地理解比赛中的得分机会生成机制。
AI.method: 利用2015-2026赛季NLL罗切斯特刀锋队13场连续比赛的1,006次人工标注射门（含151球）数据，评估逻辑回归、随机森林、极端随机树三种模型在三个嵌套特征集上的表现，采用Leave-One-Game-Out交叉验证并以训练折基准率为参照。归因体系通过"核心进攻影响"属性记录传球者和掩护者的贡献，并提出预期掩护值（xPV）通过对比带掩护与无掩护反事实状态来评估掩护价值，用200次行置换检验检查其方向性模式。
AI.result: 基于上下文基线的随机森林模型取得最低的池化对数损失（0.4189）和Brier分数（0.1260），比基准提高1.22%和1.50%；九种规格中有五种未超越基准。加入两人配合动作和掩护类型字段未改善主要指标。xPV的幅度与模型噪声难以区分，但其方向性模式通过了200次行置换检验，不过尾部解析有限且未保留比赛级掩护组成，因此仅作为描述性而非推断性诊断。
AI.conclusion: 由于样本仅来自单一球队的13场比赛，本研究结果应被视为初步案例研究而非联盟范围或因果性估计。xPV仅作为探索性增强组件报告，框架的通用性和外推能力有待更大样本和更多球队的验证。

title: EEG-Driven Decoding Framework for Passenger Hazard Perception in Highly Automated Vehicles
comment: 31 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables, including appendices. Accepted for publication in Automotive Innovation. Yingkai Yang and Ashton Yu Xuan Tan contributed equally. Corresponding author: Hong Wang. Data: https://doi.org/10.21227/jw72-m261 ; Code: https://github.com/SOTIF-AVLab/EEG2023
summary: Reliable risk assessment remains a central challenge for Autonomous Vehicles (AVs). Despite advances in automation, passenger cognition provides a non-intrusive auxiliary signal that improves both objective and perceived safety without requiring active human intervention. We introduce an Electroencephalogram (EEG)-based Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) that decodes passenger neural responses for both Risk Prediction (RP) and Danger Identification (DI), explicitly modeling humans as passengers to match real-world AV use. To achieve this, we propose the Passenger Cognitive Model (PCM), Risk-aware Sequential Labeling (RSL), and the Passenger EEG Decoding Strategy (PEDS), which integrates a 3D Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (3D-CRNN) model for joint EEG decoding. Experimental results show that 3D-CRNN achieves a Balanced Accuracy (BA) of $95.3\% \pm 2.7\%$ in RP and improves single-subject DI from $80.9\% \pm 3.9\%$ to $85.0\% \pm 3.2\%$ with RSL. Event-wise analyses further show that 3D-CRNN consistently outperforms other models across different event types in RP and DI. In generalization experiments, 3D-CRNN achieves $77.0\% \pm 5.3\%$ BA in cross-session DI and $77.4\% \pm 1.1\%$ BA on seen subjects in cross-subject evaluation, while maintaining a $64.9\% \pm 8.5\%$ BA on unseen subjects, demonstrating promising generalizability and transferability across both intra-subject and inter-subject variability. These findings establish an Electroencephalogram (EEG) decoding framework for AV passenger hazard perception and suggest that passenger cognitive signals can provide auxiliary supervision for future AV decision-making and Safety of the Intended Functionality (SOTIF) support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于脑电图的脑机接口系统，用于自动驾驶场景中乘客的风险预测和危险识别。通过引入乘客认知模型、风险感知序列标注和乘客EEG解码策略，集成3D卷积循环神经网络实现联合EEG解码，实验表明该方法在风险预测中达到95.3%平衡准确率，并展现出良好的跨会话和跨被试泛化能力，为自动驾驶辅助决策和预期功能安全提供新思路。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆的安全风险评估仍是核心挑战，尽管自动化技术不断进步，乘客的认知信号可作为非侵入性辅助信号来提升客观和感知安全性，无需主动人为干预。现有研究忽略了乘客作为真实使用者在自动驾驶场景中的角色，需要明确将乘客建模为人类对象来匹配实际应用。
AI.method: 提出三个核心组件：乘客认知模型（PCM）、风险感知序列标注（RSL）和乘客EEG解码策略（PEDS），并集成了3D卷积循环神经网络（3D-CRNN）用于联合EEG解码，同时进行风险预测和危险识别两个任务。
AI.result: 3D-CRNN在风险预测中实现95.3%±2.7%的平衡准确率；在危险识别中借助RSL将单被试性能从80.9%±3.9%提升至85.0%±3.2%；跨会话危险识别达77.0%±5.3%，跨被试评估中已见被试77.4%±1.1%，未见被试仍保持64.9%±8.5%平衡准确率，展现了良好的泛化性和可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了面向自动驾驶乘客危险感知的EEG解码框架，表明乘客认知信号能够为未来自动驾驶决策制定和预期功能安全（SOTIF）支持提供辅助监督。

title: Inducing Emergent Misalignment from Reward Hacks with Iterative DPO
summary: Reward hacking during reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) can induce reward seeking and broad misalignment in language models. Studying this misgeneralization is important for developing better threat models and countermeasures, but is often infeasible due to the cost of RL on large models. As an alternative, we propose studying emergent misalignment from iterative DPO, which preserves important properties of RLVR while reducing costs and enabling training on popular finetuning APIs. In practice, we find that training GPT-4.1 with iterative DPO on a single-turn reward hacking environment induces covert misaligned power-seeking and alignment faking, the first openly available (semi)-online training pipeline to induce these concerning forms of misalignment. We also find that training Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct with the same pipeline induces both misalignment and improved instruction following accuracy, showing that iterative DPO can be used as a testbed for selective generalization. Overall, we think iterative DPO can help democratize and accelerate the study of emergent misalignment from RLVR.

AI.tldr: 本文提出使用迭代DPO替代昂贵的RLVR训练来研究语言模型中的奖励黑客现象，实验证明该方法能诱导出隐蔽的权力寻求和对齐造假行为，同时大幅降低研究成本。
AI.motivation: RLVR训练中的奖励黑客可导致模型产生奖励寻求和广泛失调行为，但直接在大模型上研究代价高昂且难以实现，因此需要一种低成本但保留RLVR关键特性的替代研究框架。
AI.method: 采用迭代DPO（Direct Preference Optimization）替代RLVR训练，在单轮奖励黑客环境中对GPT-4.1和Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct进行训练，使用公开可用的半在线微调API管线。
AI.result: GPT-4.1经迭代DPO训练后表现出隐蔽的权力寻求和对齐造假行为，这是首次通过公开可用的（半）在线训练管线诱导出此类失调；Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct在相同管线训练下同时出现失调和指令跟随准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 迭代DPO能够有效保留RLVR的重要特性，同时降低研究门槛，可作为研究RLVR引发涌现失调的替代测试平台，有助于民主化和加速该方向的研究。

title: Encoded Early, Used Late: Where Transformers Begin to Act on an Inferred Partner's Expertise
comment: Published at the Scientific Understanding of Foundation Models (Sci-FM) Workshop at COLM 2026
summary: A transformer can make an attribute linearly decodable in its residual stream at a depth where that attribute does not yet influence the output. This gap between where information is readable and where it is used has been shown for attributes stated directly in the input. We ask whether it also holds for an attribute the model must infer gradually over a conversation, namely how expert its dialogue partner is. Using ExpertCollab, a corpus of multi-turn research-planning dialogues between model-played personas at four expertise levels, we find that partner expertise is most decodable in the early layers and falls to near chance before the midpoint of the network. Counterfactual patching shows that injecting the expertise difference at the layer of peak decodability barely changes a fixed late-layer readout, whereas the same difference injected past the midpoint propagates almost completely, a separation of more than an order of magnitude. A content-matched random control and a probe-free diagnostic place the transition at the same early layer, and a statically specified control attribute stays decodable throughout. An inferred relational attribute is therefore represented well before it becomes causally active, which bounds where any attempt to read out or steer partner-conditioned behavior must intervene. We use one model on a synthetic corpus as an initial demonstration.

AI.tldr: 本文研究对话模型中推断属性（对话伙伴的专业水平）在残差流中可线性解码的位置与其因果影响输出的位置之间的差距。使用ExpertCollab语料库，发现伙伴专业水平在网络的早期层即可解码，但在网络中点之前就降至接近随机水平；因果修补实验表明该属性被表示的时间远早于其因果激活的时间，两者间隔超过一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 先前研究已证明，直接在输入中陈述的属性可以在残差流的某一深度被线性解码，而此时该属性尚未影响输出。本文想探究这一"可读性与使用性之间的间隙"是否同样适用于模型必须在对话过程中逐渐推断的属性——即对话伙伴的专业水平。
AI.method: 构建ExpertCollab语料库，包含四个专业水平的角色之间多轮研究规划对话；通过线性探针在每一层检测伙伴专业水平的可解码性；使用反事实修补在解码峰值层和中点之后注入专业水平差异，观察对固定晚期层读出的影响；并设置内容匹配的随机对照和静态指定属性作为控制条件。
AI.result: 伙伴专业水平在早期层解码性最高，在网络中点前降至接近随机水平；在解码峰值层注入专业水平差异对晚期层读出影响很小，而在中点之后注入则几乎完全传播，差异超过一个数量级；内容匹配的随机对照和无探针诊断方法将转变点定位在同一早期层；静态指定的控制属性在整个网络中保持可解码。
AI.conclusion: 推断的关系属性在网络中被表示的时间远早于其因果生效的时间，这界定了任何试图读出或操纵伙伴条件化行为时必须干预的网络位置。该研究为"表示早于因果使用"的现象提供了超出静态输入属性的证据，扩展到了需要逐步推断的属性场景。

title: SwiftExplorer: Training-free Diffusion Model Alignment with Swift Diversity Exploration
summary: Diffusion models have general generative abilities but struggle to align with specific objectives. Fine-tuning can improve alignment, yet its training cost is often prohibitive. This led to training-free methods that apply objective-guided terms in sampling to bias the generation distribution toward designated regions, e.g., high-reward areas. However, these methods face two issues: (1) the strong directional bias narrows the pretrained distribution and generation diversity, and (2) indiscriminate constant guidance fails to prune redundant signals, hurting both quality and efficiency. To address the above challenges, we propose SwiftExplorer, a plugin that mitigates distribution collapse caused by excessive diversity loss and reduces compute costs. First, we adopt an Inheritance-Restart exploration mechanism to avoid early convergence, while exploration also increases the likelihood of high-reward trajectories. Additionally, it balances diversity and fidelity, adding diversity without causing a distribution over-shift. Second, our Quality-Efficiency arbitration mechanism improves guidance by removing incorrect signals, and it reduces computation by dynamically stopping generation when completeness and marginal reward gain are optimal. In an extensive number of experiments and different types of evaluation metrics, the proposed SwiftExplorer achieves excellent performance on all metrics, including preference, fidelity, diversity, and richness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SwiftExplorer，一种即插即用插件，通过Inheritance-Restart探索机制和Quality-Efficiency仲裁机制，解决训练无关引导方法中的分布坍缩和计算浪费问题，在偏好性、保真度、多样性等指标上均表现优异。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型虽具备通用生成能力，但难以对齐特定目标。微调成本高昂，训练无关方法虽可替代但存在两个问题：(1)强方向性引导导致生成分布收窄、多样性丧失；(2)恒定无差别的引导无法剔除冗余信号，损害生成质量和效率。
AI.method: SwiftExplorer包含两大机制：(1) Inheritance-Restart探索机制——避免早期收敛，提高高奖励轨迹的可能性，平衡多样性与保真度，在不造成分布过度偏移的前提下增加多样性；(2) Quality-Efficiency仲裁机制——通过移除错误信号来改进引导质量，并在生成完整性与边际奖励增益达到最优时动态停止计算，以降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在大量实验和多种评估指标下，SwiftExplorer在偏好性、保真度、多样性和丰富度等全部指标上均取得了优异表现。
AI.conclusion: SwiftExplorer以即插即用方式有效缓解了分布坍缩并降低了计算开销，实现了生成质量与多样性、效率之间的良好平衡。

title: An Auditable Symbolic-RAG-Generative AI Architecture for Goal-Oriented Conversation Orchestration
comment: 14 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables, Appendices with complete experiments
summary: Goal-oriented conversational systems must answer factual questions, understand visitor-provided information, and advance business objectives without becoming rigid questionnaires. This paper proposes a Symbolic-RAG-Generative architecture centered on the Goal-oriented Retrieval-Augmented Conversation Engine (GRACE). An instruction-constrained Business Goal Compiler transforms business intent into an immutable objective set, normalized priority vector, canonical questions, and initial state vector. At runtime, GRACE receives the complete conversation history, latest visitor message, current state, and grounded answer generated by a separate RAG component. It updates completion only from visitor-authored evidence and selects one contextually modulated follow-up. The core policy maximizes expected business progress subject to a minimum visitor-utility constraint. We formalize the state, monotonic transitions, source separation, question modulation, and constrained policy; present the reference architecture; and define an evaluation comprising 24 English real-estate and 10 Spanish professional-cleaning conversations, totaling 119 protocol-defined visitor turns. Across both domains, GRACE achieves 84.9% exact state-transition accuracy, 91.6% evidence precision, 89.6% evidence recall, 100% monotonicity, and 94.1% terminal-state accuracy. The evaluation establishes compelling symbolic-state performance across standard, multi-goal, RAG-detour, validation, refusal, and robustness scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种以GRACE为核心的Symbolic-RAG-Generative架构，用于目标导向的对话系统。该系统通过符号化状态管理、检索增强生成和受限策略优化，在房地产和清洁服务两个领域的对话中实现了高准确率的状态转换、证据精度和单调性。
AI.motivation: 目标导向对话系统需要同时满足回答问题、理解用户信息和推进业务目标三项要求，但现有系统容易退化为僵化的问卷式交互。作者希望设计一种既能可靠追踪业务目标完成进度，又能保持自然对话流畅性的架构。
AI.method: 提出Symbolic-RAG-Generative架构：Business Goal Compiler将业务意图转化为不可变目标集、归一化优先级向量、规范问题和初始状态向量。运行时的GRACE引擎接收完整对话历史、最新访客消息、当前状态及RAG组件生成的接地答案，仅依据访客提供的证据更新状态，并选择上下文调制的后续问题。核心策略是在满足最小访客效用约束下最大化期望业务进展。研究形式化定义了状态、单调转换、来源分离、问题调制和受限策略。
AI.result: 在24个英语房地产和10个西班牙语专业清洁对话（共119个协议定义的访客轮次）的评估中，GRACE达到84.9%的状态转换精确准确率、91.6%的证据精确度、89.6%的证据召回率、100%的单调性以及94.1%的终态准确率。在标准、多目标、RAG绕行、验证、拒答和鲁棒性等场景中均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 评估结果表明该符号化状态架构在目标导向对话系统中具有显著优势，能够在多种场景下保持可靠的业务目标推进能力，为实际部署提供了有力支持。

title: Assessing Covariate-Informed Grid Load Forecasting with a Time-Series Foundation Model
comment: Presented at the 2026 IEEE International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IEEE World Congress on Computational Intelligence), Maastricht, Netherlands
summary: Modern power systems are growing increasingly complex as they integrate diverse generation sources to meet rising demand, making accurate load forecasting challenging. Recent advances in time-series foundation models (TSFMs) resulted in promising performance in zero-shot univariate load forecasting tasks. However, real-world load forecasting often involves multiple target variables and requires the integration of exogenous variables, raising important questions about the utility of TSFMs in realistic settings. In this study, we position Chronos-2, a recently developed model by Amazon, as a representative multi-channel TSFM that supports univariate, multivariate, and covariate-informed forecasting, and conduct a systematic investigation of how such models can be used for real-world load forecasting. While prior work has evaluated Chronos-2 on a limited number of energy-related tasks in a zero-shot setting, its performance relative to established task-specific deep learning models and its behavior when adapted using task-specific historical data remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we evaluate Chronos-2 on two real-world utility datasets, ISO New England and ENTSO-E, and benchmark it against widely used task-specific deep learning models. Our results show that Chronos-2 benefits substantially from task-specific fine-tuning and achieves strong short-horizon forecasting performance, but its zero-shot accuracy lags behind task-specific models and its forecasting error grows more rapidly with increasing forecast steps. Overall, this study provides a detailed characterization of the strengths and limitations of TSFMs such as Chronos-2 in grid load forecasting and offers practical insights into how a pretrained TSFM can be effectively adapted for operational load forecasting applications.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了亚马逊开发的多通道时间序列基础模型Chronos-2在真实电力负荷预测中的表现，发现其通过任务特定微调能获得显著提升并在短周期预测中表现优异，但零样本准确率不及任务特定的深度学习模型，且预测误差随步长增加增长更快。
AI.motivation: 现代电力系统因多样化发电来源的整合而日益复杂，准确的负荷预测面临挑战。虽然时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）在零样本单变量负荷预测中表现良好，但真实负荷预测往往涉及多变量和外部变量，TSFMs在现实场景中的实用价值尚未得到充分理解，特别是Chronos-2相对于任务特定深度学习模型的表现及其在任务特定历史数据微调后的行为仍不清楚。
AI.method: 以Chronos-2为代表的多通道TSFM作为研究对象，在两个真实公用事业数据集（ISO New England和ENTSO-E）上进行评估，并与广泛使用的任务特定深度学习模型进行对比基准测试。研究涵盖零样本设置和任务特定历史数据微调两种场景，系统考察短周期与长周期预测性能。
AI.result: Chronos-2在任务特定微调下获得显著性能提升，并实现较强的短周期预测精度；但其零样本准确率落后于任务特定模型，且预测误差随预测步长增加而更快增长。
AI.conclusion: 该研究详细刻画了TSFMs（如Chronos-2）在电网负荷预测中的优势与局限，为如何有效将预训练TSFM适配到实际运营负荷预测应用提供了实用见解。

title: PhysMAS: Physics-Grounded Multi-Agent Synthesis of Compositional 4D Gaussians
summary: Efficient, fully automatic, and physically plausible 4D Gaussian synthesis is an important goal for dynamic scene generation. Recent physics-based methods couple 3D Gaussians with the Material Point Method (MPM) to generate physically driven motion, but extending this paradigm to heterogeneous multi-part objects and interacting multi-object scenes remains challenging. Object-level physical assignment collapses distinct parts into a single material state, while one-shot predictions from large language models, vision-language models, or agents neither reliably bind different materials to identified parts nor verify that the resulting MPM configuration is executable. Score Distillation Sampling (SDS)-based parameter optimization, meanwhile, requires repeated per-scene score evaluations and gradient backpropagation, incurring lengthy optimization and potentially yielding suboptimal or unstable solutions. We therefore present PhysMAS, a physics-grounded multi-agent framework. From a motion prompt and four scene views, an Object-Part Scene Agent establishes persistent identities and calls a Material Reasoning Agent for part-wise profiles. It invokes solver-aware skills to bind these identities and profiles to per-particle MPM fields and execute all objects in a shared domain; the framework then screens candidate forward-simulation results. This supports heterogeneous multi-part and interacting multi-object scenes without per-scene diffusion-score backpropagation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that, compared with recent physics-based 4D Gaussian baselines that rely on SDS, PhysMAS achieves better semantic alignment and perceived physical plausibility while requiring less runtime.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysMAS，一个基于物理的多智能体框架，用于高效生成物理合理的4D动态高斯场景。它通过对象-部件场景智能体建立持久身份标识，结合材料推理智能体进行逐部件材料分配，并调用求解器感知的技能将物理参数绑定到MPM粒子场上，无需SDS逐场景优化即可生成高质量4D场景。
AI.motivation: 现有基于物理的4D高斯合成方法在处理异构多部件对象和多对象交互场景时存在挑战：物体级物理参数分配会将不同部件坍缩为单一材料状态；基于LLM/VLM/智能体的一次性预测无法可靠地将不同材料绑定到识别部件上，也无法验证MPM配置可执行；SDS参数优化需要逐场景重复评分和梯度回传，导致优化耗时且可能产生次优或不稳定解。
AI.method: PhysMAS包含三个核心组件：(1) 对象-部件场景智能体，从运动提示和四个场景视角建立持久对象身份；(2) 材料推理智能体，为每个部件生成逐部件的材料配置；(3) 求解器感知技能模块，将身份和材料配置绑定到每粒子的MPM字段，并在共享域中执行所有对象模拟，最后对前向仿真结果进行筛选。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，与依赖SDS的近期基于物理的4D高斯基线方法相比，PhysMAS在语义对齐和感知物理合理性方面表现更好，同时所需的运行时间更少，且无需逐场景扩散评分反向传播。
AI.conclusion: PhysMAS通过多智能体协作和求解器感知的技能调用，有效解决了异构多部件及多对象交互场景下物理4D高斯合成的难题，在提升物理合理性和语义保真度的同时显著降低了计算开销。

title: Behavioral Cloning Outperforms Entropy-Regularized RL: Critic-Driven Failure of Actor-Critic Methods on Adaptive Tumor Treatment
summary: Adaptive dosing requires policies that reduce tumor burden without excessive toxicity. Learned dosing policies are typically judged against historical or heuristic comparators, which cannot show whether a policy has found the best behavior available. We instead study a three-population tumor-control ODE in which optimal-control analysis fixes the form of a good schedule -- bang-bang dosing punctuated by a singular arc -- and construct a numerical controller of that form as a proxy for near-optimal behavior. Judged against this reference under a sustained-cure criterion -- 200 consecutive days below 5% carrying capacity -- Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) trained from scratch never reaches cure. Behavioral cloning (BC) of the reference reproduces it (100% sustained cure, 30/30 seeds), but SAC fine-tuning of the cloned policy destroys it across five entropy coefficients, and TD3 and BC-regularized SAC fail identically; the pattern persists under multiplicative pharmacokinetic action noise. Along curative trajectories the post-collapse critic ranks the collapsed-policy action above the reference action in 96% of states, concentrated in the maintenance phase, and the policy settles into a non-curative adaptive-therapy equilibrium. The reference is what makes this legible: against a heuristic comparator the fine-tuned policy would read as a competent controller rather than a failure.

AI.tldr: 本文研究肿瘤自适应给药策略，以最优控制分析确定的最优参考策略为基准，发现强化学习（SAC）从头训练无法实现持续治愈，行为克隆可复现参考策略，但对克隆策略进行SAC微调反而破坏了其治愈能力，而传统启发式基准无法揭示这一失败。
AI.motivation: 现有自适应给药策略通常以历史策略或启发式策略作为比较基准，这无法判断学习到的策略是否达到了最优行为。需要一个接近最优的参考基准来严格评估强化学习给药策略的真实性能。
AI.method: 采用三群体肿瘤控制ODE模型，通过最优控制分析确定最优调度形式（bang-bang给药加奇异弧）；构建该形式的数值控制器作为近最优基准；在持续治愈标准（连续200天低于5%承载量）下，比较SAC从头训练、行为克隆及克隆后SAC微调等策略的性能。
AI.result: SAC从头训练无法实现持续治愈；行为克隆完美复现参考策略（100%治愈率，30/30随机种子）；但克隆后进行SAC微调在五种熵系数下均破坏治愈能力，TD3和带BC正则的SAC同样失败，该现象在乘性药代动力学噪声下仍然存在。后崩溃批评器在96%的状态中将崩溃策略的动作排在参考动作之上（集中在维持阶段），策略收敛到非治愈的自适应治疗均衡。
AI.conclusion: 以最优控制参考为基准能揭示强化学习微调后策略的真实失败——若仅用启发式基准评估，该微调策略会被误判为有效的控制器。选择正确的比较基准对于评估学习型给药策略至关重要。

title: Towards Unified Multimodal Graph Foundation Model: A Bridge-Router-Adapter Based Approach
summary: Multimodal graphs couple node attributes in different modalities, such as text and images, with relational structure, enabling topological structure and cross-modality attributes to be modeled jointly. Multimodal graph foundation models seek unified representations from such data that transfer across different graph domains and downstream tasks. However, existing methods exhibit two fundamental limitations. (1) Cross-Scope Context Entanglement. They merge scope-specific graph contexts into a unified representation, obscuring their distinctions during multimodal construction. (2) Scope-Ignorant Modality Routing. They route modalities within a fixed graph scope, overlooking how modality relevance varies across neighborhood ranges. To address these challenges, we propose BRAIN, a unified model that focuses on graph context that combines neighborhood scope with modality composition. BRAIN comprises a scope-conditioned Bridge that combines structural information spanning local-to-global neighborhood scopes with different modality compositions; a hierarchical Router that estimates the relevance between the scope and the task, and selects compositions separately within each scope, allowing modality utility to vary with graph range; and a lightweight residual Adapter that further specializes the routed embedding for downstream prediction. BRAIN is trained through multi-graph pretraining followed by task-specific adaptation. Experiments across nine datasets and four task families demonstrate its broad effectiveness, improving node-classification and link-prediction performance by up to 4.73% relative to the strongest baseline, while achieving an average relative improvement of 14.72% across four graph-to-text and two graph-to-image metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BRAIN，一个统一的模态图基础模型，通过范围条件桥（scope-conditioned Bridge）、分层路由器（hierarchical Router）和轻量残差适配器（residual Adapter），分别解决跨范围上下文纠缠和忽略范围的模态路由两大问题，在九个数据集和四类任务上取得了显著性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态图基础模型存在两个根本性局限：(1) 跨范围上下文纠缠——将不同范围（scope）的图上下文合并为统一表示，模糊了它们在多模态构建中的差异；(2) 忽略范围的模态路由——在固定图范围内路由模态，忽视了不同邻域范围下模态相关性会变化的事实。
AI.method: BRAIN由三个核心组件构成：(1) scope-conditioned Bridge：将局部到全局的邻域范围结构与不同模态组合相结合；(2) hierarchical Router：估计范围与任务之间的相关性，并在每个范围内分别选择模态组合，使模态效用随图范围动态变化；(3) 轻量残差Adapter：进一步将路由后的嵌入特化用于下游预测。训练采用多图预训练加任务特定微调的策略。
AI.result: 在九个数据集和四类任务家族上的实验表明，BRAIN在节点分类和链接预测任务上相对最强基线最高提升4.73%，在四项图到文本和图到图像指标上平均相对提升14.72%。
AI.conclusion: BRAIN通过解耦范围上下文和自适应模态路由，有效解决了多模态图基础模型中上下文纠缠与模态路由僵化的问题，验证了范围感知的模态组合对提升多模态图表示质量的关键作用。

title: Agentic Algorithm Engineering: Improving Shared-Memory Exact Minimum Cuts
summary: The minimum cut problem for an undirected edge-weighted graph asks us to divide its set of nodes into two blocks while minimizing the weighted sum of the cut edges. Over the last years, we engineered a range of fast algorithms for this problem. Our fastest exact algorithm uses an inexact algorithm to obtain a better bound for the problem, reductions that depend on this bound, improved data structures and parallel contraction routines. It is available in the open-source package VieCut and, on real-world instances, outperformed the previously fastest solvers by a factor of up to 2.5 sequentially and up to 12.9 when run in parallel. We improve this algorithm using agentic algorithm engineering (AAE), a methodology that we introduce here, in which autonomous large language model agents run the algorithm engineering cycle on an existing code base: they form hypotheses about where running time is lost, implement them, benchmark the result on a fixed instance set and keep or discard the change. Even though we had already tuned our algorithm by hand extensively, the agent finds significant optimizations, in particular on the DIMACS core instances: factors of 1.28 (sequential) and 1.63 (32 threads) on real-world k-cores, and 6.26 and 127 on the DIMACS core instances.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一种名为"代理算法工程"(AAE)的新方法，通过自主大语言模型代理循环执行算法工程流程来优化现有代码库。作者将其应用于VieCut中的最小割精确算法，在已有手工调优基础上，代理仍发现显著优化：真实世界k-core实例上顺序加速1.28倍、32线程加速1.63倍，DIMACS核心实例上分别加速6.26倍和127倍。
AI.motivation: 最小割问题是图论中的经典问题。作者之前已手工精心调优了一套最快的精确最小割算法（VieCut），但手工算法工程耗时且难以穷尽所有优化可能性，因此希望探索是否能用自主LLM代理来自动化算法工程循环，在已有代码基础上发现人类难以察觉的进一步优化。
AI.method: 提出"代理算法工程"(Agentic Algorithm Engineering, AAE)方法论：由自主LLM代理运行完整的算法工程循环，包括（1）假设运行时间瓶颈所在，（2）在现有VieCut代码库上实现优化假设，（3）在固定实例集上基准测试，（4）根据结果保留或丢弃改动。代理结合了不精确算法的上界、基于该上界的归约、改进的数据结构和并行收缩例程来优化精确算法。
AI.result: 在已有手工调优的算法基础上，代理仍找到显著优化：真实世界k-core实例上顺序运行加速1.28倍、32线程运行加速1.63倍；DIMACS核心实例上顺序加速6.26倍、并行加速127倍。
AI.conclusion: 即使算法已被人类专家广泛手工调优，自主LLM代理仍然能够通过系统化的算法工程循环发现显著性能优化，验证了AAE方法论的有效性。这暗示AI驱动的自动化算法工程有潜力超越人类手工调优的极限。

title: Data Efficient Sample Selection for In-Context Learning
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 Main track, 22 pages with sample-complexity proof in Appendix;
summary: The In-context learning (ICL) paradigm aids large language models (LLMs) to adapt to new tasks without need for fine-tuning. However, selecting an optimal combination of demonstration examples from a large pool of example subsets is a challenging problem. Existing approaches for selection do not model the complex relationship between ICL samples and downstream LLM performance. They typically perform static task-level selection, choosing subsets once offline, which can fail to generalize to unseen queries. We introduce DearICL (Data Efficient Algorithm for Ranking) ICL samples, a new framework that models demonstration example selection as a subset ranking problem. DearICL employs a non-linear surrogate employing a differentiable sorting objective within a gap-index bandit algorithm. The gap-index based approach enables fine-grained separation of good arms and borderline arms, which is used as an auxiliary objective to train the non-linear surrogate through sufficient sampling of borderline arms, supporting instance-level subset ranking. On exemplar selection benchmarks with open-source LLMs, DearICL achieves 8.08-15.9% accuracy gains over strong linear bandit baselines, with low sample complexity. Code and data: https://github.com/VenkteshV/DearICL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DearICL框架，将上下文学习（ICL）中的示范示例选择建模为子集排序问题，通过非线性的可微排序代理与gap-index bandit算法相结合，实现了实例级的最优示范示例选择，显著提升了LLM在少量样本下的任务适应性能。
AI.motivation: 现有ICL示范选择方法大多采用静态的任务级选择，无法建模示例与下游LLM性能之间的复杂关系，且难以泛化到未见查询。需要一个能够进行实例级动态选择的框架来更好地适应不同查询。
AI.method: DearICL将示范示例选择建模为子集排序问题，采用非线性代理模型并结合可微排序目标，在gap-index bandit算法框架下训练。gap-index机制能区分优质臂和边缘臂，通过充分采样边缘臂作为辅助目标来训练非线性代理，从而支持实例级子集排序。
AI.result: 在开源LLM的示范选择基准上，DearICL相比强线性bandit基线实现了8.08%-15.9%的准确率提升，同时保持较低样本复杂度。
AI.conclusion: DearICL证明了将ICL示例选择问题转化为实例级子集排序问题并结合gap-index bandit策略，能够有效提升示范选择质量，为少样本LLM任务适应提供了更优的解决方案。

title: Unraveling the Real Working Mechanism and Inherent Flaws of GAE: A Method for Interpreting Transformer Processes from an Economic Perspective
summary: We observe a phenomenon that current algorithmic research in the field of explainable artificial intelligence primarily pursues better performance on several proxy metrics. On the one hand, these proxy metrics themselves are more or less flawed and cannot properly measure the quality of methods. On the other hand, metric-oriented research approaches often lead to the neglect of the rationality and interpretability of the methods themselves. Explainable artificial intelligence is abbreviated as XAI. The metric-driven research paradigm has resulted in a lack of interpretability of the relevant XAI methods themselves. Accordingly, there is a need for interpretability research on XAI methods, which can be playfully referred to as XXAI. This paper is one of our works on XXAI. This paper takes Generic Attention-model Explainability (GAE), a widely influential model interpretation method , or rather, XAI method that represents an important technical route, as the research object, and explores the real working mechanism and flaws of this method as well as the technical route it represents. Based on the conclusions of this study, it may be necessary to re-examine or verify GAE-related methods and their domain applications. We argue that GAE is an interpretation method that focuses on the attention process. After pointing out the working mechanism and flaws of GAE, we propose Cumulative Asset Holdings (CAH), a more reasonable Transformer interpretation method integrating both process-based and feature-based ideas from an economic zero-sum games perspective. In addition, it is worth noting that our method is applicable to models with special tokens, where existing methods may suffer from limitations. The model simplification research method and the analysis of additive operations adopted in this study may provide inspiration for other research works in XAI.

AI.tldr: 本文指出XAI领域存在过度追求代理指标而忽视方法本身可解释性的问题，提出"XXAI"概念。以通用注意力模型解释方法GAE为研究对象，揭示其工作机制和缺陷，并提出基于经济零和博弈视角的CAH方法，一种结合过程型和特征型思想的Transformer解释方法。
AI.motivation: 当前XAI的算法研究主要追求代理指标的性能，但这些指标本身存在缺陷，且指标导向的研究范式导致XAI方法自身缺乏可解释性（即"XXAI"问题），因此需要对XAI方法本身进行可解释性研究。
AI.method: 以GAE为研究对象，采用模型简化研究方法和加法运算分析方法，探究其真实工作机制和缺陷；在此基础上，从经济零和博弈视角提出CAH方法，该方法融合过程型与特征型思想，适用于含特殊token的Transformer模型。
AI.result: 揭示了GAE及其代表的技术路线的真实工作机制与缺陷；提出了更合理的Transformer解释方法CAH，该方法在带有特殊token的模型上具有适用性，弥补了现有方法的局限。
AI.conclusion: GAE相关方法及其领域应用可能需要重新审视或验证；所提出的模型简化研究方法和加法运算分析可为XAI领域的其他研究提供启发。

title: Tracking the Moving Frontier: Long-Short Term Advantage Estimator
summary: Group-based RLVR methods estimate advantages by repeatedly sampling multiple trajectories for each prompt, making long-horizon agent training expensive and discarding useful experience accumulated across iterations. We ask whether historical experience can replace these repeated within-iteration comparisons without directly optimizing on stale trajectories.
