We introduce OntologyBench, a tiered biomedical retrieval benchmark comprising 471,854 training and 125,744 evaluation query-document relevance pairs across concept grounding, relational retrieval, and compositional phenotype-based retrieval.
  Although these tasks can be tractable using ontology-aware reference methods, across task tiers, embedding performance is generally lower on relational and compositional tasks than on concept-grounding tasks. Fine-tuning on ontology-derived supervision improves performance on several relational and compositional tasks, whereas the evaluated reranking and LLM-based candidate-scoring methods provide little or no end-to-end improvement. Errors frequently reflect diseases matching only subsets of the phenotype evidence.
  These findings indicate that the evaluated embedding and reranking configurations do not reliably recover the compatibility encoded by the selected ontology relations and phenotype combinations and motivate retrieval systems that better integrate learned representations with structured biomedical knowledge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OntologyBench，一个分层的生物医学检索基准，包含471,854个训练样本和125,744个评估样本的查询-文档相关性对，涵盖概念锚定、关系检索和基于表型的组合检索三类任务。研究发现嵌入模型在关系和组合任务上表现较差，虽然本体监督微调能改善部分任务，但重排序和大语言模型候选评分方法几乎没有带来端到端改进，错误往往源于疾病仅匹配部分表型证据。
AI.motivation: 现有生物医学检索系统的评估缺乏能够反映本体论结构关系的标准化基准，特别是对于涉及关系和组合推理的复杂检索任务，需要系统性地评估不同检索方法的性能。
AI.method: 构建OntologyBench基准，设计三层级任务（概念锚定、关系检索、基于表型的组合检索），利用本体感知参考方法和多种主流检索策略（嵌入模型、微调、重排序、LLM候选评分）进行系统评估。
AI.result: 嵌入方法在关系型和组合型任务上表现低于概念锚定任务；本体监督微调可提升部分关系和组合任务性能；重排序和LLM候选评分方法几乎无端到端改善；常见错误是疾病仅匹配部分表型证据。
AI.conclusion: 现有嵌入和重排序配置无法可靠地恢复本体关系和表型组合所编码的兼容性，需要开发能够更好融合学习表示与结构化生物医学知识的检索系统。

title: CoRL: Co-Evolutionary Reinforcement Learning for Adaptive Indirect Prompt-Injection Attacks and Defenses
summary: Tool-augmented language agents are vulnerable to indirect prompt injection (IPI). Unlike direct prompt injection, IPI hides adversarial instructions in untrusted tool outputs and can covertly alter the execution of a legitimate task. Defenses trained on fixed attacks may fail as an attacker changes its strategy, injection site, and payload. To address this problem, we formulate adaptive IPI as an asymmetric, partially observable, general-sum Markov game: a multi-turn attacker adapts payloads at reached tool-return sites from the public trajectory, while a tool-using defender must block the injected objective and complete the user task. We propose CoRL, a verifier-grounded co-evolution and repair framework with three stages: Attacker SFT initializes multi-turn attacks from successful trajectories; bilateral Co-PPO jointly trains both agents with role-specific rewards and historical opponent populations; and Defender SFT consolidates verifier-accepted teacher repairs for population-discovered failures. Across 1,514 clean, fixed-template, and adaptive executions per defender, CoRL reduces overall ASR by 38.5 points to 0.0% and raises utility by 13.1 points to 76.3%. Stage-wise and controlled ablations show positive contributions from online Co-PPO and population-mined repair, while external-benchmark evaluation indicates transfer in attack resistance. The defender balances safety and task utility under the evaluated attacks, while the retained attackers provide candidates for adaptive red-team evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoRL框架，将通过间接提示注入（IPI）攻击形式化为非对称、部分可观测、一般和马尔可夫博弈，并通过验证器引导的协同演化与修复机制提升工具增强语言代理的安全性。在1,514次执行中，CoRL将整体攻击成功率从38.5个百分点降至0.0%，同时将任务效用提升13.1个百分点至76.3%。
AI.motivation: 工具增强的语言代理容易受到间接提示注入（IPI）攻击，攻击者将对抗性指令隐藏在不可信的工具输出中，可隐蔽地篡改合法任务的执行。传统针对固定攻击训练的防御在面对攻击者不断变化的策略、注入位置和载荷时容易失效，急需更具适应性的防御方法。
AI.method: 将自适应IPI形式化为非对称、部分可观测、一般和马尔可夫博弈；提出CoRL（验证器引导的协同演化与修复）框架，包含三个阶段：1) 攻击者SFT：从成功轨迹初始化多轮攻击；2) 双边协同PPO：用角色特定奖励和历史对手种群联合训练双方代理；3) 防御者SFT：整合验证器接受的教师修复以解决种群发现的失败。
AI.result: 在每位防御者的1,514次干净、固定模板和自适应执行中，CoRL将整体攻击成功率降低38.5个百分点至0.0%，并将任务效用提升13.1个百分点至76.3%。分阶段和受控消融实验表明在线协同PPO和种群挖掘修复均有积极贡献，外部基准评估显示攻击抵抗能力具有迁移性。
AI.conclusion: CoRL在保障任务效用的同时有效提升了防御者对自适应间接提示注入攻击的抵抗能力，防御者在已评估的攻击下实现了安全性与任务效用的平衡，保留的攻击者可为自适应红队评估提供候选模型。

title: Safe Harness Self-Evolution: A Theoretical Analysis of Feasibility and Limits
summary: Harness self-evolution is the process by which an agent modifies its prompts, tools, code, or orchestration in response to task feedback while keeping the underlying language model frozen, with changes persisting across subsequent tasks. We provide a systematic theoretical analysis of the feasibility and limits of safe harness self-evolution, connecting modification generation, finite-data certification and selection, safe adoption, and behavior after an update. Under a fixed user-task distribution, we establish conditions guaranteeing overall expected-reward improvement while controlling changes on retained tasks, characterize the probability of generating qualified modifications, and derive finite-data bounds for safe selection and adoption. Our analysis shows that generation and certification impose distinct constraints: current task performance does not determine the probability of generating qualified modifications, and generating more candidates need not improve the guarantee of a successful update when evaluation is limiting. Stagnation may therefore arise even when improvement opportunities remain. We further show that worst-case evaluation cost for recognizing genuine improvements diverges as expected reward approaches its upper bound. Across successive updates, certified improvement guarantees accumulate over a finite run, but a successful update does not by itself guarantee that further improvement remains possible. These results provide a basis for diagnosing bottlenecks and designing safer self-evolution mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文对"安全型框架自进化"（即智能体在冻结底层语言模型的前提下，通过修改提示词、工具、代码或编排方式来实现自我改进）进行了系统的理论分析，涵盖了修改生成、有限数据认证与选择、安全采纳以及更新后行为等环节，给出了期望奖励提升和旧任务行为受控的充分条件，并揭示了生成与认证之间的约束差异、停滞现象的可能成因，以及连续更新中保证的累积性质。
AI.motivation: 框架自进化是提升智能体能力的重要途径，但对其安全性与可行性的理论边界缺乏系统性理解。现有方法往往盲目生成修改候选项并选择采纳，却未厘清在什么条件下改进必然发生、安全性如何保证、以及何时会出现停滞不前的困境，因此需要从理论上为设计更安全的自进化机制提供指导。
AI.method: 采用理论分析框架，在固定用户任务分布假设下，构建了将修改生成、有限数据认证与选择、安全采纳和更新后行为统一纳入的数学建模体系。通过推导条件不等式和概率界，分析了期望奖励改进的条件、生成合格修改的概率特征、有限数据下安全选择与采纳的界，以及最坏情况评估代价的散度行为。
AI.result: 研究得出以下关键发现：(1) 当前任务表现不决定生成合格修改的概率，生成与认证是两类不同的约束；(2) 当评估能力受限时，生成更多候选并不必然提升成功更新的保证，停滞可能发生在仍存在改进机会的情况下；(3) 期望奖励接近上界时，识别真实改进所需的最坏情况评估成本趋向发散；(4) 在有限次连续更新中，认证的改进保证可以累积，但单次成功更新并不能保证后续仍有改进空间。
AI.conclusion: 该理论分析为诊断框架自进化中的瓶颈（如停滞原因、评估成本爆炸）提供了基础，并为设计更安全的自进化机制（如在生成与认证之间合理分配资源、设定现实的改进预期）指明了方向。

title: No-Regret Mixing of LRU and LFU with Optimal Switching Cost
summary: Caching systems often rely on simple eviction policies such as Least Recently Used (LRU) and Least Frequently Used (LFU), which perform well in complementary request regimes. Recent policies such as LeCar and Cacheus combine LRU and LFU using ideas from the experts problem in online learning. Specifically, upon a miss, they randomize between the two eviction rules using probabilities derived from scores updated by tracking the history of past evictions. While these policies exhibit strong empirical performance, it remains unclear whether they are guaranteed, on every request sequence, to perform asymptotically as well as the better of LRU and LFU, i.e., whether they achieve sublinear regret with respect to this benchmark. We first show that LeCar suffers linear regret against an oblivious adversary, even with unbounded history. We then propose H-MC, a Hedge-based mixture of virtual LRU and LFU caches that preserves Hedge's selection probabilities, and hence its regret guarantees, while minimizing the switching cost among all joint selection rules with these marginals.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了LeCar和Cacheus等基于在线学习（专家问题）的缓存策略虽然经验表现良好，但其对每次请求序列能否渐近达到LRU和LFU中较优者的性能（即亚线性遗憾）并不保证。作者首先证明LeCar即使在无界历史下也对盲目对手产生线性遗憾，随后提出H-MC——一种基于Hedge算法的虚拟LRU和LFU缓存混合策略，该方法保留Hedge的选择概率及其遗憾保证，同时最小化所有具有相同边缘分布的联合选择规则中的切换代价。
AI.motivation: 现有缓存策略如LeCar和Cacheus虽然在实践中表现优秀，但缺乏理论保证——不清楚它们是否能在每条请求序列上渐近达到LRU或LFU中较优者的性能（亚线性遗憾），该问题需要严格的数学分析来回答。
AI.method: 作者首先通过对抗性分析证明LeCar对盲目对手存在线性遗憾；然后提出H-MC方法，将Hedge算法应用于两只虚拟缓存（LRU和LFU）的组合，保留Hedge的选择概率及其遗憾保证，同时最小化联合选择规则中具有这些边缘分布的切换代价。
AI.result: 证明了LeCar即使在无界历史下也会遭遇线性遗憾，无法达到亚线性遗憾的理论保证；提出的H-MC方法继承了Hedge算法的遗憾保证，是一种理论上站得住脚的LRU/LFU混合策略。
AI.conclusion: 基于在线学习思想的缓存策略需要严格的理论验证；H-MC提供了首个在理论上保证亚线性遗憾的LRU/LFU混合缓存策略，弥合了经验性能与理论保证之间的差距。

title: Less Is Personal: Learning Minimal Sufficient User Profiles for Personalized Language Models
summary: Retrieval-augmented personalization enables large language models to produce more accurate and preference-aligned outputs using relevant records retrieved from user histories. Personalized language models typically prepend a fixed number of retrieved user records, even when additional history is redundant, harmful, or unrelated to a user's distinctive behavior. We study minimal sufficient personalization: constructing the least costly ordered profile for each input while preserving the utility achievable from a retrieved candidate pool. We introduce ENOUGH, a method that iteratively appends behavioral records or emits STOP to construct profiles with adaptive lengths. Offline, bounded counterfactual search evaluates profile prefixes by jointly considering downstream gains, user specificity, and token costs. The resulting long-horizon targets are distilled into a multi-head value controller with explicit ranking and stopping supervision. At inference, the controller selects and orders records through lightweight decisions, and the frozen generator is invoked once after stopping. Extensive experiments on six personalized tasks demonstrate that ENOUGH consistently outperforms strong heuristic and retrieval-augmented baselines in both effectiveness and efficiency, achieving minimal sufficient profiles that preserve personalization utility while reducing unnecessary context costs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ENOUGH方法，用于检索增强的个性化语言模型中的"最小充分个性化"问题——即为每个输入构建成本最低但能保持个性化效用的用户记录序列。该方法通过离线有界反事实搜索生成长期目标，并蒸馏到多头部价值控制器中，在推理时以轻量级决策选择记录，冻结的生成器仅在停止后调用一次。
AI.motivation: 现有个性化语言模型通常固定拼接固定数量的检索用户记录，忽略了额外历史可能是冗余、有害或与用户独特行为无关的情况，导致不必要的上下文成本增加，而非根据每个输入自适应判断需要多少历史记录。
AI.method: ENOUGH方法采用迭代策略：每次迭代要么追加一条行为记录，要么发出STOP信号以构建自适应长度的用户画像。在离线阶段，使用有界反事实搜索评估画像前缀，综合考量下游收益、用户特异性和token成本；随后将长时程目标蒸馏进一个多头部价值控制器，该控制器具有显式的排序和停止监督信号。推理时，控制器通过轻量级决策选择和排序记录，生成器在停止后仅被调用一次。
AI.result: 在六个个性化任务上的大量实验表明，ENOUGH在效果和效率两方面均持续优于强启发式基线和检索增强基线，能够生成最小充分画像，在保持个性化效用的同时降低不必要的上下文成本。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证实了自适应长度的个性化画像构建是可行的，通过"最小充分个性化"策略可以兼顾个性化输出质量与推理效率，为检索增强个性化提供了新思路。

title: Efficient Exploration Is Enough
summary: This work introduces an alternative view of efficient exploration and studies its theoretical and empirical implications in the absence of extrinsic rewards. Specifically, we define efficient explorers as agents that prioritize generating generalizable experience, i.e., data that supports learning models capable of predicting and adapting across the environment. This allows us to analyze efficient exploration through the lens of prediction and generalization. Theoretically, we demonstrate that optimally efficient explorers naturally schedule their trajectories to visit the most informative and learnable regions first. Empirically, we show that optimizing for these agents gives rise to an automatic curriculum of progressively more complex behaviors, even in relatively simple environments. These results indicate that pursuing this purely intrinsic objective alone is enough to drive the emergence of highly sophisticated behaviors. We believe that this new framework provides a principled mechanism by which agent-environment systems may sustain an open-ended process of increasingly complex behavior without external rewards, tasks, or objectives.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种关于高效探索的新视角，将高效探索者定义为优先产生可泛化经验的智能体，通过预测和泛化的视角分析探索过程。理论上证明最优高效探索器会自然地安排轨迹优先访问信息量最大、最易学习的区域；实验上表明优化该目标能让相对简单的环境中涌现出渐次复杂的自动课程行为。这表明仅凭纯内在目标就足以驱动复杂行为的涌现，为无外部奖励的环境下开放式复杂性进化提供了原则性机制。
AI.motivation: 在缺乏外在奖励的条件下，如何实现高效探索并促进复杂行为的涌现是一个核心问题。现有探索方法缺乏统一的理论框架来定义"高效探索"的含义，作者希望从预测与泛化的角度重新审视探索的本质，从而为开放式智能体的持续进化建立理论基础。
AI.method: 作者将高效探索者定义为优先产生"可泛化经验"（即能够支持预测和跨环境适应模型学习的数据）的智能体，将探索效率问题转化为预测与泛化问题。在理论上分析最优探索者的轨迹调度特性，在实证上通过优化该内在目标观察环境中行为的涌现与课程化发展。
AI.result: 理论上证明最优高效探索器会优先安排轨迹访问最具信息性和可学习性的区域；实证结果表明，在相对简单的环境中，优化这类探索者会产生一个自动课程，推动行为逐步走向更高的复杂性。纯内在目标的优化足以驱动复杂行为的涌现。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提供了一种原则性机制，使得智能体-环境系统可以在没有任何外部奖励、任务或目标的情况下，维持一个开放式且行为日益复杂的进化过程，为无监督智能体发展和开放式AI研究提供了新的理论视角。

title: Does Deeper Reasoning Compromise Alignment? Revealing and Mitigating of Alignment Collapse in Large Reasoning Models
summary: The emergence of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) has established a robust foundation for Large Reasoning Models (LRMs). While deep reasoning is widely believed to enhance safety alignment, the stability of alignment mechanisms under extended reasoning remains underexplored. This paper challenges the prevailing view by revealing a critical vulnerability: Deep Reasoning May Induce Alignment Collapse. To rigorously quantify this phenomenon, we propose the Alignment Loss Rate (ALR) metric. Our experiments demonstrate that as reasoning depth increases, ALR rises significantly, indicating a severe degradation in model robustness against external perturbations. Capitalizing on this instability, a novel jailbreaking paradigm, Reasoning Trap (RT), is proposed. RT induces the model into extended reasoning to amplify the impact of adversarial attacks, leading to a sharp decline in safety capabilities. To elucidate the mechanism behind this collapse, we identify Attention Dilution as the root cause, arising from the competition for attention between the extended reasoning process and the original input. To mitigate this, Reasoning Residual Alignment (RRA), a lightweight defense strategy that dynamically re-emphasizes the input via residual connections integrated with the reasoning process.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了深度推理可能引发对齐崩溃的漏洞，提出ALR指标量化该现象，并设计了基于此漏洞的越狱范式（Reasoning Trap）及轻量级防御策略（RRA）。
AI.motivation: 尽管深度推理被广泛认为可以增强安全对齐，但对齐机制在扩展推理过程中的稳定性尚未被充分探索。本文旨在挑战这一主流假设并揭示潜在的安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出Alignment Loss Rate (ALR)指标量化对齐崩溃程度；设计Reasoning Trap (RT)越狱范式诱导模型进入扩展推理以放大对抗攻击影响；提出Attention Dilution作为崩溃根因；开发Reasoning Residual Alignment (RRA)轻量级防御策略。
AI.result: 实验表明ALR随推理深度增加而显著上升，模型鲁棒性严重退化；RT能通过诱导扩展推理导致安全能力急剧下降；RRA能动态强化原始输入以缓解该问题。
AI.conclusion: 深度推理可能导致对齐崩溃而非增强安全性，Attention Dilution是核心机制，RRA为这一漏洞提供了有效的轻量级防御方案。

title: I Don't Miss You, but I Do: Self-Explanation Faithfulness of Modality Missingness in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used in settings where some input modalities may be unavailable, yet we know little about whether they can faithfully explain how such missing information affects their own predictions. We introduce an interventional protocol for evaluating self-explanations of modality dynamics: models state what each modality alone would support, whether restoring a missing modality would change their answer, and whether the available evidence is sufficient; we then execute the corresponding modality intervention and compare these claims with the model's realized behavior. We evaluate eight open-weight VLMs from two model families across four tasks spanning complementary and isomorphic text-image settings and a multi-view driving setting. We find a systematic tendency to overstate the sufficiency of available modality evidence. Models substantially underestimate the effect of restoring missing modalities: task-level median predicted change rates are at most 8.8%, while the corresponding executed change rates reach 72.1%, with underprediction in 62 of 64 model-task-condition settings. Insufficiency claims are rare, but precise when produced: restoring the modality changes the answer in a median of 78-100% of flagged cases. Retrospective self-explanations show the same tendency: on complementary data, models over-credit single-modality sufficiency; on isomorphic data, they over-credit single representation sufficiency relative to their executed behavior. Together, these results show that VLMs systematically mischaracterize how their predictions depend on available and missing modality evidence, motivating executable interventions as a behavioral ground truth for evaluating multimodal self-explanations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种干预性协议，用于评估视觉-语言模型(VLM)对模态缺失如何影响自身预测的自解释能力。通过执行真实的模态干预并与模型声称的行为对比，发现VLM系统性高估可用模态证据的充分性，严重低估恢复缺失模态对预测的影响（中位预测变化率≤8.8%，实际执行变化率高达72.1%）。回顾性自解释也表现出同样的偏差倾向。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型越来越多地被用于某些输入模态可能缺失的场景，但我们对模型能否忠实地解释缺失信息如何影响自身预测知之甚少。现有研究缺乏系统评估多模态自解释可靠性的方法。
AI.method: 引入一个干预性评估协议：首先让模型陈述（1）每个单独模态支持什么、（2）恢复缺失模态是否会改变答案、（3）现有证据是否充分；然后实际执行对应的模态干预，将模型的声明与其真实行为进行比较。在来自两个模型家族的八个开源VLM上，覆盖四个任务，包括互补性、同构性文本-图像设置以及多视角驾驶设置。
AI.result: 发现模型系统性高估可用模态证据的充分性。模型严重低估恢复缺失模态的影响：任务级中位预测变化率最高仅8.8%，而实际执行变化率可达72.1%，在64个模型-任务-条件设置中有62个出现低估。不足性声明很少见但精确：在被标记的情况下，恢复模态在中位78-100%的情况下改变了答案。回顾性自解释也呈现相同倾向。
AI.conclusion: VLM系统性地错误描述其预测对可用与缺失模态证据的依赖关系，这凸显了使用可执行的干预作为评估多模态自解释的行为基线的必要性。

title: Bridging the Semantic-Utility Gap in Multimodal RAG via Generator-in-the-Loop Alignment
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Artificial Intelligence
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) augmented with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) benefit from access to external evidence. However, standard retrievers and rerankers optimize for semantic similarity rather than answer utility, creating a preference gap: documents that appear relevant may not help the generator produce a correct answer. Motivated by this, we propose a two-stage generator-in-the-loop alignment framework that closes this gap without human document-level relevance annotations. Our framework consists of two stages: in Stage 1, a VLM generates a hypothetical text passage from the image-query pair, which is used as the retrieval query for dense text search, bridging the image-to-text modality gap. In Stage 2, a cross-encoder reranker adapted with low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is fine-tuned using answer-supervised preference pairs mined from the frozen VLM: given the dataset answer label, a candidate document is labeled positive if the VLM produces the correct answer when given that document as context, and negative otherwise. This generator-guided signal is compatible with multiple alignment loss functions, including contrastive (triplet) loss, pairwise direct preference optimization (DPO), and supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and supports periodic re-mining to refresh preference pairs as the reranker improves. Experiments on VQA-X and A-OKVQA with Qwen3.5-2B and Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct show that our proposed framework consistently outperforms rank-order, random, and REPLUG-style likelihood baselines under various alignment losses and pool size settings, suggesting that answer-level generator feedback is an effective supervision signal for preference alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出一个两阶段"生成器参与"对齐框架，用于视觉语言模型中的检索增强生成。第一阶段用VLM从图像-查询对生成假设文本作为检索查询，弥合图文模态差异；第二阶段用LoRA微调交叉编码器重排序器，以回答监督偏好对（基于冻结VLM能否产出正确答案）进行对齐，从而弥合检索相关性与答案实用性之间的偏好差距。
AI.motivation: 标准的检索器和重排序器优化的是语义相似度而非答案效用，导致偏好差距：看似相关的文档不一定能帮助生成器产出正确答案。现有方法缺乏文档级相关性标注，难以直接弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 第一阶段，VLM从图像-查询对生成假设文本作为稠密检索查询，弥合图像到文本的模态鸿沟；(2) 第二阶段，使用LoRA适配的交叉编码器重排序器，通过从冻结VLM中挖掘的回答监督偏好对进行微调——依据数据集的答案标签，文档能使VLM给出正确答案则标记为正样本，否则为负样本。该信号兼容对比损失（三元组）、DPO和SFT，并支持周期性重新挖掘偏好对来持续刷新。
AI.result: 在VQA-X和A-OKVQA数据集上，使用Qwen3.5-2B和Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct进行实验，该框架在多种对齐损失和池大小设置下均持续优于排序基线、随机基线和REPLUG风格似然基线。
AI.conclusion: 回答层面的生成器反馈是一种有效的偏好对齐监督信号，能在无需人工文档级标注的情况下弥合检索相关性与生成答案效用之间的差距。

title: Beyond the Matrix Sign: Quadratic Spectral Descent
summary: Muon can be interpreted as optimizing a linear local objective over a spectral-norm ball. This gives a matrix-sign update that preserves the singular directions of the gradient and assigns the same magnitude to all active singular modes. We ask whether these two properties remain optimal when local curvature is taken into account. To answer this question, we keep Muon's spectral-norm constraint unchanged and replace the linear local model with a quadratic one. We call the resulting method \emph{Quadratic Spectral Descent} (QSD). We show that curvature can change both the singular values and the singular directions of the optimal update. To make QSD practical, we approximate curvature with Kronecker-factored statistics and solve the constrained quadratic with a small number of Frank--Wolfe steps, each of which has a closed-form matrix-sign subproblem. We further provide an optimality certificate, a comparison with Muon under the same quadratic surrogate, and an $O(1/K)$ convergence rate for the inner solver. Experiments on GPT pre-training show that QSD consistently improves validation loss over Muon and recent Muon variants, and reduces wall-clock training time by up to $8.49\%$ at matched validation loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了二次谱下降（QSD）方法，在Muon的谱范数约束下引入二次局部模型考虑曲率，通过Kronecker分解近似曲率并使用Frank-Wolfe步骤求解约束二次问题，实验表明QSD在GPT预训练中持续优于Muon及其变体，匹配验证损失时训练时间最多减少8.49%。
AI.motivation: Muon通过谱范数球上的线性优化更新参数，但忽略了局部曲率信息。作者质疑在考虑曲率时，Muon保留梯度奇异方向、对所有活跃奇异模式赋予等幅值的属性是否仍然最优，因此希望在谱范数约束下引入二次模型来改进。
AI.method: 保持Muon的谱范数约束，将线性局部模型替换为二次模型；用Kronecker因子统计量近似曲率；通过少量Frank-Wolfe步骤求解约束二次问题，每一步都有闭式矩阵符号子问题；提供最优性证书，并与Muon在同一二次代理下对比。
AI.result: 在GPT预训练实验中，QSD相比Muon及近期Muon变体持续改善验证损失；在匹配验证损失条件下，训练墙钟时间最多减少8.49%。此外还给出了内层求解器的O(1/K)收敛率。
AI.conclusion: 曲率确实会同时改变最优更新的奇异值和奇异方向，将曲率信息纳入谱范数约束下的二次优化是有益的，QSD是一个实用且更优的替代方案。

title: Do Dynamic Routers Need Memory? HeRo: History-Aware Routing for Efficient LLM Inference
summary: Dynamic layer routing reduces the inference cost of Large Language Models (LLMs) by learning to skip layers for individual tokens. Existing methods, however, treat each routing decision as a local operation conditioned solely on the current hidden state which is a formulation that overlooks the sequential, path-dependent nature of routing across depth: earlier decisions shape the representations seen by downstream routers, and the layer-usage objective couples all decisions jointly. We propose History-Aware Routing (HeRo), a dynamic routing framework that resolves this mismatch by introducing a router memory mechanism to maintain an explicit routing state across model depth. The memory is constructed via linear attention, incrementally aggregating preceding routing scores and their induced residual updates into a compact history representation. At each routed layer, the router conditions jointly on this accumulated state and the current hidden representation to select the executed branch. Instantiated for token-wise FFN routing, HeRo trains only lightweight routers and adapters on a frozen backbone, requiring no modification to pretrained parameters. Across Llama 3.1-8B, Llama 2-7B, and Llama 2-13B, HeRo consistently achieves the highest aggregate performance retention among ten baselines. On Llama 3.1-8B, it bypasses 26.87% of model parameters while achieving 100.24% of dense model performance across seven benchmarks, and retains 97.01% while bypassing 38.82% of model parameters under a tighter computation budget. Ablation studies confirm that removing routing history consistently degrades performance, most notably on multistep reasoning and code generation, validating that explicit routing memory enables more accurate and adaptive dynamic routing than solely conditioning on hidden state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出History-Aware Routing（HeRo），一种动态层路由框架。核心创新在于引入路由记忆机制，通过线性注意力在模型深度方向聚合历史路由决策和残差更新，让每个路由决策不仅依赖当前隐藏状态，还依赖累积的历史路由状态。在Llama 3.1-8B、Llama 2-7B和Llama 2-13B上，HeRo在十个基线中取得最高性能保持率，可在跳过26.87%参数的同时达到100.24%的密集模型性能。
AI.motivation: 现有动态层路由方法将每个路由决策视为仅基于当前隐藏状态的局部操作，忽略了路由决策在深度方向的序列依赖性和路径依赖性：早期路由决策影响下游路由器看到的表征，且层使用目标将所有决策联合耦合。这种公式化的不匹配导致路由精度受限。
AI.method: HeRo通过线性注意力构建路由记忆机制，沿模型深度增量聚合先前的路由分数及其诱导的残差更新，形成紧凑的历史表示。在每个路由层，路由器联合当前隐藏表示和累积历史状态来选择执行分支。针对逐token的FFN路由场景，HeRo在冻结骨干网络上仅训练轻量级路由器和适配器，不修改预训练参数。
AI.result: 在Llama 3.1-8B、Llama 2-7B和Llama 2-13B上，HeRo在十个基线中取得最高聚合性能保持率。在Llama 3.1-8B上，绕过26.87%模型参数时达到密集模型100.24%的性能（七个基准）；在更紧计算预算下，绕过38.82%参数时仍保持97.01%性能。
AI.conclusion: 消融实验表明移除路由历史会导致性能持续下降，尤其在多步推理和代码生成任务上最为显著，验证了显式路由记忆使动态路由比仅依赖隐藏状态更准确、更具适应性。

title: CLUES-WEASEL: No additional clues required to choose your time series clustering algorithm
summary: Time series data is very common in many real-world applications and in numerous domains, with increasing interest for automated information extraction using machine learning. One of these subfields is time series clustering, which consists in identifying clusters among a set of time series in an unsupervised fashion. Most time series clustering algorithms suffer from the same balancing act: they trade clustering performance for faster runtimes or vice versa. We present a novel time series clustering algorithm that we call CLUES-WEASEL, which stands for CLustering with the UnsupervisEd Second version of Word ExtrAction for time SEries cLassification. CLUES-WEASEL extracts features using the unsupervised version of the transformation step of WEASEL 2.0, which is a time series classification algorithm, then reduces these features using principal component analysis, and finally performs clustering with the $k$-means algorithm using these reduced extracted features. Through extensive experiments, we prove that CLUES-WEASEL is significantly better than any other existing time series clustering algorithm while being (much) faster than any state-of-the-art one. We also show that the architecture of CLUES-WEASEL can work well with other time series feature extraction algorithms. Our findings highlight the relevance of CLUES-WEASEL for time series clustering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为CLUES-WEASEL的新型时间序列聚类算法，该算法利用WEASEL 2.0的无监督特征提取步骤、主成分分析降维以及k-means聚类，在显著优于现有聚类算法的同时，运行速度远超当前最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 时间序列聚类算法普遍存在性能与运行速度之间的权衡矛盾，即追求更好的聚类效果就会牺牲运行效率，反之亦然。作者希望提出一种能够同时兼顾高聚类性能和高运行效率的新算法。
AI.method: CLUES-WEASEL算法的流程包括三个步骤：首先利用WEASEL 2.0（一种时间序列分类算法）变换步骤的无监督版本提取特征；然后通过主成分分析（PCA）对提取的特征进行降维；最后使用k-means算法对降维后的特征进行聚类。
AI.result: 通过大量实验证明，CLUES-WEASEL在所有现有时间序列聚类算法中聚类效果显著最优，同时运行速度比任何最先进的算法都快得多。此外，该算法的架构也可适配其他时间序列特征提取算法，具有良好的通用性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明CLUES-WEASEL在时间序列聚类领域具有重要价值，成功打破了聚类性能与运行速度此消彼长的传统权衡，为该领域提供了一种高效且效果卓越的新方案。

title: Qiushi Engine on AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard
summary: This report analyzes Qiushi Engine v0.8 across all 40 test tasks in AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard, a benchmark that requires autonomous agents to carry a research question through experimental design, code implementation, actual execution, result analysis, and report delivery. Qiushi Engine is model-configurable; this evaluation selected DeepSeek deepseek-v4pro-preview as the model backend. The official AstaBench leaderboard records a score of 0.816 and an average benchmark cost of USD 15.209 per task, while the full-precision local recomputation is $81.59 \pm 1.87$. Four tasks satisfied every rubric item, yielding a full-task completion rate of 4/40 = 10% -- 7 percentage points above, and about 3.3 times, the approximately 3% best rate reported for AstaBench's official agents. Across 507 required rubric items, 416 were satisfied (82.1%). Official scoring archives and 40 Meta-Trace records show sustained production and verification of reports, code, and experimental artifacts; the principal gaps lie in repeated runs, external dependencies, specified metrics, and ablation studies. The report explains the benchmark, system workflow, aggregate results, representative cases, and limits of interpretation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析Qiushi Engine v0.8在AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard基准的全部40个测试任务上的表现，记录了0.816的官方得分（每任务平均成本15.209美元，全精度本地重算81.59±1.87美元），完整任务完成率10%（4/40），远超官方代理约3%的最佳水平；在507项必需评分标准中满足416项（82.1%）。
AI.motivation: 评估Qiushi Engine v0.8这一自主代理系统在端到端研究任务中的能力，考察其是否能自主完成从实验设计、代码实现、实际执行、结果分析到报告交付的完整研究流程，并与官方基准代理进行对比。
AI.method: 以DeepSeek deepseek-v4pro-preview为模型后端配置Qiushi Engine v0.8，在AstaBench E2E-Bench-Hard的40个测试任务上运行，依据官方评分标准对507项必需rubric标准逐项评估，并结合官方评分存档与40条Meta-Trace记录分析系统表现。
AI.result: 官方排行榜得分0.816，完整任务完成率10%（4/40），比官方代理约3%的最佳率高出7个百分点（约3.3倍）；507项rubric标准中416项（82.1%）满足。主要差距集中在重复运行、外部依赖、指定指标和消融研究方面。
AI.conclusion: Qiushi Engine v0.8在端到端研究基准上表现优异，远超官方基准代理，但仍有改进空间；文章对基准框架、系统工作流、聚合结果、代表性案例及解释局限性进行了系统阐述。

title: Translation of Black-Box Clinical Prediction Models into Standalone Transparent Nomograms: Temporal External Validation in Heart Transplantation
comment: 33 pages of main text with 4 figures and 3 tables; supplemental information (supplementary methods, Figures S1-S4, Tables S1-S26) appended, 86 pages total
summary: We convert black-box clinical prediction models for tabular data into standalone nomograms that can be audited term by term. PRiSM (Partial Responses in Structured Models) takes the shape of each effect and interaction from the source model, not merely which variables mattered, and lets the outcome select and weight them. We tested this in 50,356 heart transplant recipients, with validation in a later era than training. Nomograms from all 5 source models - a public clinical risk score, logistic regression, neural networks, random forests and extreme gradient boosting - met a prespecified noninferiority criterion for discrimination before any further simplification, and generally preserved calibration and clinical net benefit. Those from the 3 machine-learning models showed no detectable difference in discrimination from de novo generalized additive and explainable boosting models, exceeded neural additive models, and carried fewer terms than the explainable boosting model. PRiSM is released as an open-source Python package.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRiSM方法，将黑盒临床预测模型（针对表格数据）转化为可逐项审计的独立列线图。在50,356名心脏移植受者上测试，5种源模型（临床风险评分、逻辑回归、神经网络、随机森林、XGBoost）生成的列线图均满足非劣效性判别标准，且ML模型生成的列线图在判别性能上无显著差异于GAM和可解释提升模型，但项数更少。PRiSM已作为开源Python包发布。
AI.motivation: 临床预测模型中的黑盒机器学习模型虽然预测性能优越，但缺乏可解释性，难以被临床医生逐项审计和信任。现有的可解释性方法大多只提供变量重要性等粗粒度信息，无法完整捕捉模型的效应形状和交互结构，也无法将模型转换为临床可直接使用的决策工具（如列线图）。
AI.method: PRiSM（Partial Responses in Structured Models）的核心方法是：从源模型提取每个效应的形状及交互结构（而非仅变量重要性），并让结局变量来选择和加权这些效应，最终将黑盒模型转化为独立的可逐项审计的列线图。研究在50,356名心脏移植受者数据上验证，并在时间上更晚的时代进行外部验证。
AI.result: 5种源模型生成的列线图均满足预设的判别力非劣效性标准，且在进一步简化前即达标；通常保持良好的校准度和临床净获益。3种机器学习模型（神经网络、随机森林、XGBoost）生成的列线图在判别力上与从头训练的广义可加模型和可解释提升模型无显著差异，优于神经可加模型，且项数比可解释提升模型更少。
AI.conclusion: PRiSM能够在不显著损失预测性能的前提下，将多种黑盒临床预测模型转换为透明、可审计的列线图形式，兼顾了模型性能与临床可解释性，为精确医疗中的模型审计和临床部署提供了实用工具。

title: A Better Spur Should Start From Each Objective
summary: Real-world Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) often suffers from sparse rewards, reward conflicts, and late-stage reward tug-of-war, causing traditional linear scalarization to experience severe metric oscillations. To address optimization conflicts among multiple objectives in real-world deployment scenarios, we propose Multi-Marginal Preference Optimization (MMPO), a fine-grained framework that intervenes at the data, gradient, and constraint levels rather than relying on coarse-grained global scalarization. Specifically, MMPO performs exposure debiasing to mitigate sparse and biased rewards, applies priority-aware orthogonal projection to decouple conflicting gradients, and introduces self-prompted gradient constraints to prevent dominant objectives from overwhelming weaker ones. Experiments on real-world e-commerce datasets show that MMPO improves training stability and consistently achieves better performance across conflicting metrics. Moreover, it generalizes robustly to broader tasks such as ToolRL and code generation, demonstrating its effectiveness as a practical paradigm for multi-objective alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出MMPO框架，通过在数据、梯度和约束三个层面进行细粒度干预，解决多目标强化学习中的稀疏奖励、奖励冲突和后期奖励拉锯问题，替代传统的粗粒度线性标量化方法。
AI.motivation: 真实世界的多目标强化学习面临稀疏奖励、奖励冲突和后期奖励拉锯等挑战，传统线性标量化方法会导致严重的指标振荡，需要在更细粒度层面解决多目标优化冲突问题。
AI.method: MMPO从三个层面进行干预：(1) 数据层面——曝光去偏以缓解稀疏和偏置奖励；(2) 梯度层面——优先级感知的正交投影以解耦冲突梯度；(3) 约束层面——自提示梯度约束以防止主导目标压过弱势目标。
AI.result: 在真实电子商务数据集上，MMPO相比传统方法在冲突指标上提升了训练稳定性并取得了一致的更好性能；在ToolRL和代码生成等更广泛任务上也展现出了鲁棒的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MMPO作为一种实用的多目标对齐范式，通过细粒度的数据-梯度-约束三层干预有效替代了粗粒度的全局标量化，证明了其在多目标强化学习领域的高效性和可推广性。

title: Forecasting the Winner of a Live Tennis Match
summary: With the rise of live sports betting in recent years, tennis forecasting has expanded from pre-match prediction to models that update win probabilities as a match unfolds. A central challenge in creating such a model is the constant need for models to adapt to score and performance changes. This study examines how pre-match and live information can be most effectively integrated into a model to produce accurate win-probability estimates. The analysis uses 8,222 Grand Slam matches containing a total of 1,505,355 points. Five models were evaluated using a chronological split, with matches from 2011-2021 used for training, 2022 for validation, and 2023-2024 for testing. Trace, a hybrid model, achieved accuracies of 76.06%, 82.15%, and 88.34% at 25%, 50%, and 75% match progress, suggesting that hybrid modeling is a practical approach to live tennis forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对网球比赛实时预测中如何有效整合赛前与实时信息的问题，利用8,222场大满贯比赛共1,505,355个数据点，评估了五种模型，其中混合模型Trace在比赛进行到25%、50%、75%时的预测准确率分别达到76.06%、82.15%和88.34%，表明混合建模是实况网球预测的有效方法。
AI.motivation: 随着网投注的兴起，网球预测已从赛前模型扩展到比赛进行中实时更新获胜概率的模型。核心挑战在于模型需要不断适应比分和表现的变化，因此需要探索如何最有效地整合赛前与实时信息以提供准确的获胜概率估计。
AI.method: 研究使用8,222场大满贯比赛共1,505,355个数据点，按时间顺序划分数据集（2011-2021训练、2022验证、2023-2024测试），评估了五种模型在比赛不同进度阶段的表现。
AI.result: 混合模型Trace在25%、50%和75%比赛进度时分别达到76.06%、82.15%和88.34%的预测准确率。
AI.conclusion: 混合建模方法是将赛前与实时信息有效整合的可行方案，能够为实况网球预测提供准确的获胜概率估计。

title: Vision: Data-Centric Anchoring for Robust and Interpretable Agentic AI
summary: Agentic AI systems built on large language models fail in two persistent ways that scaling does not fix: they break under distribution shift, and they cannot explain the decisions they make. We argue these are co-symptoms of one structural deficiency in the data lifecycle that governs how agents are trained, evaluated, and deployed. Observational interaction logs record what an agent did, not what it would have done otherwise. They encode spurious correlations without controlled variation, so they lack the counterfactual structure needed to separate causal signal from coincidence or to validate an explanation. No model-centric method can recover invariances the data never contained. We present Data-Centric Anchoring: robustness and interpretability should be engineered into the data environment, not extracted from models after training. Our central contribution is the Data-Centric Agentic Loop, a four-stage framework of Curate, Augment, Constrain, and Attribute. The ordering is structural, not stylistic. Curation precedes augmentation because generative models amplify whatever bias they are trained on. Augmentation precedes constraint because invariance objectives are vacuous without variation across environments to be invariant to. Attribution closes the loop, converting observed failures into targeted data interventions for the next iteration. Each stage manufactures the preconditions of the next, which makes the loop self-correcting rather than merely sequential. We ground the framework in a failure-driven taxonomy that links four core failure modes to the data lifecycle: spurious feature reliance, distribution-shift fragility, uncertainty miscalibration, and explanation unfaithfulness. We close with the limits of this approach and the open problems that stand between it and practical deployment at scale.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"数据为中心锚定"框架，主张鲁棒性和可解释性应通过数据环境（而非模型后处理）来工程化实现，核心是通过"策展-增强-约束-归因"四阶段的数据循环，从根源上解决大语言模型智能体在分布偏移下失效和无法解释决策的两大持久问题。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体系统存在两个缩放无法解决的持久缺陷：分布偏移下失效以及无法解释决策。作者认为这两个问题是同一结构性缺陷的共病症状——即数据生命周期中缺乏反事实结构。观测性交互日志只记录了智能体实际做了什么，而非本应做什么，缺乏受控变异，因此无法分离因果信号与巧合，也无法验证解释。任何模型中心的方法都无法恢复数据中从未包含的不变性。
AI.method: 提出Data-Centric Agentic Loop四阶段框架：(1) Curate（策展）- 在增强前先过滤数据，因为生成模型会放大训练数据中的任何偏差；(2) Augment（增强）- 在约束前增加跨环境变异，否则不变性目标无意义；(3) Constrain（约束）- 施加不变性约束；(4) Attribute（归因）- 将失败归因并转化为下一轮定向数据干预。该顺序是结构性的而非风格性的，各阶段相互制造前提条件，形成自校正闭环。同时配套一个基于失败驱动的分类体系，将四种核心失败模式（虚假特征依赖、分布偏移脆弱性、不确定性校准偏差、解释不忠实性）与数据生命周期关联起来。
AI.result: 论文的主要"结果"是一个概念性框架而非实验数据。它建立了从四种核心失败模式到数据生命周期环节的系统映射，论证了数据为中心的方法论优势，并识别了该方法的边界条件与开放问题。核心主张是：框架的顺序安排是结构性的（增强会放大偏差、不变性需要变异前提），使其具有自校正能力而不仅是顺序执行。
AI.conclusion: 鲁棒性和可解释性应被工程化到数据环境中，而非从训练后的模型中提取。该框架为失败归因和数据干预建立了闭环通道，但论文也坦诚指出了其局限性和通向大规模实际部署之间的开放问题。

title: Online Surrogate Repair: Decoupling High-Fidelity Feedback from Search Length in Closed-Loop Discovery
summary: Closed-loop AI scientists can generate candidate designs at low marginal computational cost, whereas reliable feedback may require wet-lab synthesis, characterization, or high-fidelity computation. Addressing this imbalance through custom laboratory automation remains infrastructure-intensive and costly, while replacing new experiments with a fixed surrogate leaves persistent model errors that can be amplified by optimization. We propose \emph{online surrogate repair} (OSR), a closed-loop algorithm that uses sparse high-fidelity evaluations to update the surrogate throughout a longer agent search conducted primarily with inexpensive surrogate feedback. An acquisition rule selects which designs from the agent's accumulated proposals receive high-fidelity evaluation, and the resulting labels update the surrogate used in subsequent episodes. Across controlled synthetic environments, we demonstrate that improving global surrogate fit does not necessarily reduce maximum regret, whereas Q90-UCB and expected improvement (EI) substantially reduce regret by directing evaluations toward regions that determine the optimizer's decisions. On MADE, controls receiving high-fidelity feedback after every episode require $6.36$--$7.23\times$ more oracle queries to match Online EI under two LLM orchestrators and $10.27\times$ more under the non-LLM Chemeleon+MLIP workflow. Online surrogate repair introduces a novel third feedback regime between fixed-surrogate operation and high-fidelity feedback after every episode, separating the frequency of high-fidelity evaluation from the duration of the agent's search.

AI.tldr: 提出在线代理修复（OSR）算法，在主要由低成本代理反馈驱动的长程智能体搜索中，稀疏地使用高保真评估来更新代理模型。实验表明OSR在MADE基准上比每轮高保真反馈的控制组节省6.36-10.27倍查询量，开创了介于固定代理和高保真反馈之间的第三类反馈机制。
AI.motivation: 闭环AI科学家的候选设计生成成本极低，但可靠的反馈（如湿实验合成或高保真计算）代价高昂。现有的两个极端——定制实验室自动化（基础设施昂贵）和固定代理模型（误差被优化放大）——都无法有效解决该不平衡问题。
AI.method: 在线代理修复（OSR）：采用闭环算法，主要使用廉价的代理反馈进行长程智能体搜索，同时通过采集规则（acquisition rule）从智能体累积的提议中选择需要高保真评估的设计，用得到的标签更新后续回合使用的代理模型。比较了Q90-UCB和期望改进（EI）两种采集策略。
AI.result: 在受控合成环境中，提升全局代理拟合质量并不必然降低最大遗憾，而Q90-UCB和EI通过将评估导向决定优化器决策的区域，显著降低遗憾。在MADE基准上，每轮都获得高保真反馈的控制组需要6.36-7.23倍（两种LLM编排器）和10.27倍（非LLM Chemeleon+MLIP工作流）的oracle查询才能匹配在线EI的表现。
AI.conclusion: 在线代理修复开创了一种第三种反馈机制，介于固定代理操作与每轮高保真反馈之间，将高保真评估的频率与智能体搜索的持续时间解耦，为基础设施受限的科学发现场景提供新的效率路径。

title: TTGBench: Benchmarking Topological Evolution and Semantic Drift in Text-attributed Temporal Graphs
summary: Temporal graph learning models the evolution of dynamic systems, where both structural interactions and semantic states change over time. However, existing benchmarks primarily emphasize structural evolution via temporal link prediction (TLP), while support for semantic evolution remains limited. Although temporal node classification (TNC) is sometimes included, it is typically restricted to simplistic binary settings that fail to capture realistic semantic drift. Moreover, commonly used datasets exhibit high link repetition, leading to inflated performance estimates and obscuring true model capability. To address these limitations, we introduce \textbf{TTGBench}, a new benchmark that jointly evaluates structural and semantic evolution. TTGBench comprises six real-world, text-rich datasets characterized by \emph{Dual Volatility}, enabling rigorous and fair evaluation of existing models. Notably, it is the first benchmark to support both multi-class and multi-label TNC, filling a critical gap in evaluating temporal semantic drift. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 17 state-of-the-art methods across Temporal Graph Neural Networks (TGNNs) and Large Language Model (LLM)-based paradigms. The results reveal a clear \emph{capability divide} between the two paradigms: TGNN-based methods excel at structural prediction but fail at semantic tracking, whereas LLM-based predictors show the opposite trend. Through in-depth analysis, we uncover their fundamental limitations and provide insights for developing more comprehensive temporal graph models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TTGBench基准测试，包含六个具有"双波动"特性的真实文本丰富数据集，首次同时支持多类和多标签时间节点分类的语义演化评估，并系统比较了17种TGNN与LLM方法，揭示两大范式在结构与语义预测上的能力鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有时间图学习基准主要侧重于结构演化（时间链接预测），对语义演化的支持有限；时间节点分类常被限制在过于简化的二分类设置中，无法捕捉真实的语义漂移；此外常用数据集存在高链接重复问题，导致性能评估虚高。这些缺陷使得现有模型的能力难以被公平、全面地评估。
AI.method: 构建了TTGBench基准框架：选取六个真实世界的文本丰富数据集，专门设计为具有结构变化与语义变化同时发生的特点（称为"双波动"Dual Volatility）；首次同时支持多类和多标签时间节点分类任务；对17种最新方法（涵盖TGNN和基于LLM的两大类范式）进行系统性评估。
AI.result: 评估结果显示TGNN方法与LLM方法之间存在明显的"能力分界线"：TGNN方法在结构预测方面表现出色但在语义追踪上失败，而LLM基础的方法则呈现完全相反的格局。深入分析了这两类方法的根本局限。
AI.conclusion: 现有两大时间图学习范式各有根本性缺陷，均无法同时胜任结构与语义演化建模，未来需要开发更全面的时间图模型，本文提供的基准和发现为这一方向提供了重要参考。

title: Accuracy is Not Enough: A Divergence-Based Approach to Evaluate Fidelity Loss in Quantized LLMs
summary: Deployment of Large Language Models (LLMs) on memory-constrained edge devices relies heavily on aggressive post-training quantization. However, evaluating these models is largely based on zero-shot task accuracy, which depends solely on argmax predictions and is insensitive to changes in the underlying predictive distribution. Consequently, accuracy can exhibit unstable, non-monotonic behavior under progressive quantization, masking substantial fidelity loss relative to the BFloat16 (BF16) uncompressed base model and providing misleading deployment signals. We introduce a distribution-sensitive evaluation framework quantifying information loss in quantized LLMs as the divergence between full-vocabulary predictive distributions at the token decision boundary. We compute statistical distances, including Jensen-Shannon Divergence and Total Variation Distance, between outputs of full-precision and quantized models, enabling a fine-grained analysis of distributional shift. Using this framework, we quantify probability mass displacement and distributional drift relative to the BF16 reference, capturing predictive distribution changes not reflected in top-1 accuracy. We conduct a 120-run experimental matrix across five foundation architectures and four reasoning benchmarks under progressive quantization regimes, from uncompressed BF16 to Q2_K, providing a systematic fidelity analysis. Our results show divergence metrics generally increase under stronger quantization, complementing task accuracy with a fidelity signal. Across tested llama.cpp schemes, mixed-precision Q4_K generally yields lower divergence than uniform Q4_0 at similar memory footprints. These findings motivate distribution-aware evaluation as a practical diagnostic complement to task accuracy; they do not directly establish correctness, calibration, safety, or user-perceived quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分布敏感的评估框架，通过计算量化LLM与BF16全精度模型之间完整词汇预测分布的JS散度和总变差距离，来量化分布信息损失，弥补仅依赖top-1准确率评估量化的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM量化评估几乎完全依赖零样本任务准确率（仅基于argmax预测），对底层预测分布的变化不敏感，导致在渐进量化下准确率呈现不稳定、非单调的行为，掩盖了相对未压缩BF16基线的实质性保真度损失，提供误导性的部署信号。
AI.method: 提出分布敏感评估框架：1) 在token决策边界计算量化模型与全精度模型的JS散度和总变差距离；2) 在五类基础架构、四个推理基准和从BF16到Q2_K的渐进量化制度下进行120次实验，系统分析概率质量位移和分布漂移。
AI.result: 散度指标通常在更强量化下增加，与任务准确率形成互补的保真度信号。在llama.cpp的压缩方案中，混合精度Q4_K在相似内存占用下通常比均匀Q4_0产生更低的散度。
AI.conclusion: 分布感知评估可作为任务准确率的实用诊断补充工具；但结果不直接证明正确性、校准性、安全性或用户感知质量。

title: SE-GoS: Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills for Skill Library at Scale
summary: Modern LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills, yet as skill libraries scale to thousands of entries, effective retrieval becomes a bottleneck. Graph-of-Skills (GoS) addresses this challenge by exploiting dependency-aware graph structure for scalable skill retrieval, while SkillDAG further demonstrates that skill graphs can accumulate execution-backed structure online. However, these approaches leave open whether historical execution traces can be systematically distilled into a better retrieval graph that generalizes to unseen tasks. We present Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills (SE-GoS), a training-free framework that evolves an existing GoS graph from execution traces while preserving the original retrieval pipeline. SE-GoS performs three complementary updates: topology evolution that discovers and prunes skill relationships from execution evidence, edge-weight evolution that reinforces retrieval-relevant relationships based on historical effectiveness, and description evolution that optimizes retrieval-facing skill descriptions using execution feedback. Across three LLMs on SkillsBench, SE-GoS consistently improves task reward while reducing input tokens relative to full skill loading, with gains varying across model families. In a representative setting, one evolution round improves reward from 52.4\% to 59.4\% while reducing input tokens by approximately one-third relative to full skill loading, and the resulting graph transfers to a disjoint held-out split with a 5.4-point improvement over the static GoS baseline. These results show that skill graphs can be improved from execution experience without model training, changes to the retrieval algorithm, or modifications to skill content, turning a static retrieval graph into an evolving retrieval infrastructure.

AI.tldr: SE-GoS是一个无训练框架，通过从历史执行轨迹中演化已有的GoS技能图来提升检索效果，在不改变检索算法和技能内容的情况下，使静态检索图转变为可演进的检索基础设施。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体的技能库扩展到数千条记录，有效的技能检索成为瓶颈。现有方法如Graph-of-Skills利用依赖感知的图结构进行检索，SkillDAG展示技能图可以在线积累执行支撑的结构，但仍未解决如何从历史执行轨迹中系统性地提炼出更好的、能泛化到未见任务的检索图这一问题。
AI.method: SE-GoS执行三种互补的更新操作：(1)拓扑演化——从执行证据中发现和剪枝技能关系；(2)边权重演化——根据历史有效性强化检索相关的关系；(3)描述演化——利用执行反馈优化面向检索的技能描述。整个过程无需模型训练，保持原有检索流程不变。
AI.result: 在SkillsBench上使用三种LLM测试，SE-GoS一致性地提升了任务奖励，同时相较于完整技能加载减少了输入token。在代表性设置中，一轮演化将奖励从52.4%提升到59.4%，输入token减少约三分之一；演化后的图可迁移到不相交的持出集，比静态GoS基线提升5.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 技能图可以通过执行经验得到改进，且无需模型训练、检索算法变更或技能内容修改，从而将静态检索图转变为动态演进的检索基础设施。这验证了基于执行轨迹的图演化方法的有效性。

title: MpSub: A Momentum $p$-Dimensional Subspace Trust-Region Method for Derivative-Free Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
summary: Full-parameter fine-tuning of large language models has substantial memory costs because backpropagation stores activations and gradients. Zeroth-order optimization avoids this by estimating update directions from loss evaluations, but existing methods require tuning a sensitive learning rate for each model and task. We propose the momentum $p$-dimensional subspace trust-region method (MpSub). At each iteration, MpSub searches within a $p$-dimensional subspace: one direction preserves historical momentum from the most recent accepted step, while the remaining directions explore via fresh random sampling. The subspace gradient is estimated by central differences, a trial step is computed from a linear trust-region model, and the trust-region radius adapts according to the agreement between predicted and observed loss reduction, eliminating the learning rate. For LLM fine-tuning, evaluations within an iteration share a minibatch, and directions are regenerated in place from seeds, using forward passes alone. For smooth deterministic objectives under unorthogonalized Gaussian directions, we bound the finite-difference error, quantify gradient energy captured by the subspace, and prove that $\lim_{k\to\infty} \|\nabla f(x_k)\|_2 = 0$ almost surely under a safeguarded radius update. Under a matched budget of 8,400 training-objective forward passes, we fine-tune OPT-125M and OPT-350M on CommitmentBank. With the same preset parameters at both model sizes, MpSub attains mean test accuracies of 0.673 and 0.690 over three seeds, matching tuned MeZO (0.685) without any learning-rate search.

AI.tldr: 本文提出动量p维子空间信赖域方法（MpSub），通过仅在p维子空间内搜索（一个方向保持历史动量，其余方向随机采样）并以信赖域半径自适应替代学习率，实现无需调参的大语言模型零阶微调，在相同前向传播预算下匹配甚至超越需调参的MeZO方法。
AI.motivation: 全参数微调大语言模型因反向传播存储激活值和梯度而内存开销巨大。零阶优化虽可通过损失评估估计更新方向来避免这一问题，但现有方法需要对每个模型和任务手动调整敏感的学习率，增加了使用难度和成本。
AI.method: MpSub在每次迭代中于p维子空间内搜索：一个方向保留最近接受步骤的历史动量，其余方向通过随机采样探索。子空间梯度以中心差分估计，在线性信赖域模型上计算试验步长，并根据预测与观测损失减少的一致性自适应调整信赖域半径，从而消除学习率。LLM微调时同一次迭代内的评估共享一个minibatch，方向从种子原位再生成，仅依赖前向传播。理论分析部分，针对光滑确定性目标函数与非正交化高斯方向，界定了有限差分误差，量化了子空间捕获的梯度能量，并在安全半径更新下证明了梯度范数几乎必然趋于零。
AI.result: 在8,400次训练目标前向传播的匹配预算下，对OPT-125M和OPT-350M在CommitmentBank上微调。在两个模型规模使用相同预设参数下，MpSub在三个随机种子上达到平均测试准确率0.673和0.690，匹敌经调优的MeZO（0.685），且无需任何学习率搜索。
AI.conclusion: MpSub通过排除学习率超参数，以自适应信赖域半径替代，在大语言模型零阶微调中实现了无需调参即可匹敌甚至优于现有最优方法的性能，兼具理论收敛保证和实际有效性。

title: Style Over Substance: Content-Invariant Wrappers Flip LLM Safety-Judge Verdicts
comment: 8 pages, 1 table. Code, wrappers, and per-verdict labels: https://github.com/Yongxi-Zhou/safety-judge-robustness
summary: Automatic safety judges -- systems such as Llama Guard or a GPT-4o grading prompt that decide whether a model's reply is harmful -- produce the numbers behind almost every reported jailbreak success rate, defense evaluation, and safety leaderboard. We ask whether these judges grade what a reply contains or how it sounds. We keep a reply's content fixed and add content-invariant style wrappers: fixed strings placed before or after the reply that change only its tone (an educational disclaimer, a fake safety "reasoning" block, a token refusal followed by the unchanged harmful body), or, on harmless refusals, framing that merely sounds dangerous. The body is preserved byte-for-byte, so a faithful judge must return the same verdict, and any flip is an error of the judge, not a change in safety. Over 600 JailbreakBench replies x up to 7 forms x 8 judges, we measure flip rates with paired significance tests and measured noise floors. Findings are precise rather than universal: most judges barely move, but specific judges harbor cheaply exploitable blind spots. A token-refusal wrapper flips 19.9% of GPT-4o-mini's correct "unsafe" verdicts (noise floor 0.5%; 18.2% under majority-of-three re-scoring) yet moves Claude only 0.4%. The deployed Llama Guard 4 is deterministically gamed: an "educational course" framing flips 12.3% of its harmful verdicts to safe. A second deployed guard (gpt-oss-safeguard-20b) is immune, and rewriting only the grading prompt (StrongREJECT-style) cuts the attack tenfold on the identical model -- the vulnerability lives in the judge, not the content. A two-annotator human validation confirms 100% content invariance and 90% of flips as judge errors (kappa 0.95-1.0), and a bootstrap shows the underlying model ranking is already unstable to sampling alone. We release the dataset, wrappers, code, and per-verdict labels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究自动安全评审系统（如Llama Guard、GPT-4o评分提示）是否真正评估回复内容本身，还是被回复的"语气/包装"所影响。研究者保持回复内容逐字不变，仅添加内容无关的风格包装（如教育性免责声明、伪造安全推理块、标记拒绝后附有害正文等），对600多条JailbreakBench回复×7种形式×8个评审器进行测试。结果发现多数评审器几乎不受影响，但特定评审器存在可被轻易利用的盲区：GPT-4o-mini有19.9%的正确"有害"判定被标记拒绝包装翻转；Llama Guard 4可被"教育课程"框架确定性绕过（12.3%翻转率）；而gpt-oss-safeguard-20b免疫且重写评分提示可将攻击降低十倍。
AI.motivation: 自动安全评审器输出的数字支撑了几乎所有报告的越狱成功率、防御评估和安全排行榜，但学界尚未系统性检验这些评审器评估的究竟是回复的实际内容还是其表面呈现形式（语气、包装、框架）。如果评审器可以被风格包装欺骗，那么大量已有的安全评测结论可能失真。
AI.method: 研究者采用内容不变性测试：将回复正文逐字节保留，仅在其前后添加内容不变的风格包装器（如教育免责声明、伪造的理由块、标记拒绝+有害正文、以及看似危险的框架套在无害拒绝上）。收集600多条JailbreakBench回复×7种形式×8个评审器的数据，使用配对显著性检验和测量的噪声底线来评估翻转率，并进行双注释者人工验证及bootstrap稳定性分析。
AI.result: 多数评审器几乎不出现判定翻转，但发现具体可被利用的盲区：a)token拒绝包装使GPT-4o-mini的19.9%正确"不安全"判定翻转为安全（噪声底线仅0.5%，多数投票重新评分后仍为18.2%），而对Claude仅影响0.4%；b)部署中的Llama Guard 4被"教育课程"框架确定性欺骗，12.3%的有害判定翻转为安全；c)gpt-oss-safeguard-20b完全免疫；d)仅重写评分提示（StrongREJECT风格）在同一模型上将攻击效果降低十倍，证明漏洞在于评审器而非内容本身。人工验证确认100%内容不变性，90%翻转判断为评审器错误（kappa 0.95-1.0）。
AI.conclusion: 结论是：安全评审器的脆弱性并非普遍存在而是具体、可选择性的——某些特定评审器隐藏着廉价可利用的盲区，问题出在评审器自身机制而非被评审内容的语义。研究同时表明底层模型排名对采样本身已不稳定，强调需要更稳健的自动化安全评估方法论。研究者已开源全部数据集、包装器、代码和逐条判定标签。

title: On the Recall Scaling Laws in Mamba: A Theoretical and Mechanistic Study via Hashing
comment: 53 pages, 20 figures. Code and experiments available at: https://github.com/yuvalko1/mamba-recall-scaling-laws
summary: Associative Recall (AR) is the cognitive ability to learn and retrieve links between items in memory. In NLP, AR is used as a benchmark for evaluating the in-context memory capacity of architectures such as Mamba, and has been found to strongly correlate with language modeling performance. This paper explores AR from the perspective of mechanistic interpretability, aiming to reverse-engineer the exact internal algorithm used by Mamba to perform recall. Our key insight is that Mamba performs recall by implicitly learning linear hash functions, and we identify the low-level circuit that enables this behavior. Building on these findings and inspired by theoretical tools in similarity-preserving hashing, such as the Johnson-Lindenstrauss lemma, we develop a theoretical framework for analyzing AR, which we term Recall Scaling Laws. Given the vocabulary size and the number of facts in context, this framework allows us to (1) predict the embedding and state dimensions required for Mamba to achieve perfect recall, (2) predict recall success probability given the model dimensions, and (3) analyze multi-layer models and multi-head SSM patterns. Empirical results show that our theoretical findings are accurate and predictive, offering insights into how AR capacity scales with vocabulary, state, embedding size, and architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文从机制可解释性角度研究了Mamba架构中的联想记忆（AR）能力，发现Mamba通过隐式学习线性哈希函数来实现回忆，并提出了"回忆缩放定律"（Recall Scaling Laws）理论框架，用于预测模型维度与回忆成功率之间的关系。
AI.motivation: 联想记忆（AR）是评估Mamba等架构上下文记忆能力的重要基准，且与语言建模性能高度相关，但现有研究缺乏对其底层内部机制的深入理解。作者希望通过逆向工程揭示Mamba执行回忆任务的具体算法。
AI.method: 作者发现Mamba通过隐式学习线性哈希函数实现回忆，并识别了支持该行为的低层电路。借鉴相似性保持哈希（如Johnson-Lindenstrauss引理）的理论工具，作者构建了"回忆缩放定律"理论框架，根据词汇量和上下文事实数量，预测嵌入维度和状态维度需求、回忆成功概率，并分析多层模型和多头SSM模式。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，理论预测与实际结果高度吻合且具备预测能力，验证了该框架的有效性，揭示了AR能力如何随词汇量、状态大小、嵌入维度和架构变化而扩展。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为理解Mamba类架构的记忆机制提供了理论基础，建立了模型维度与回忆能力之间的可预测缩放关系，对架构设计和规模扩展具有指导意义。

title: zScore-N: A Neural Network for On-Chain Wallet Reputation Scoring
summary: Wallet reputation scores decide who receives an airdrop, who can borrow, and who enters an allowlist across decentralised finance. They almost always begin as hand-written formulas: compositions of clamped logarithmic, linear and square-root transforms over behavioural features, with every threshold and point award set by hand. Such a formula is readable and deterministic, but it is piecewise and non-differentiable, it cannot improve as data accumulates, and it cannot distinguish a feature that is genuinely zero from one its pipeline failed to capture. We present zScore-N, the neural network that replaced ours in production. The formula served as its teacher: calibrated against 5,208,952 wallets sampled across 2019-2024 and verified to reproduce production output to within 2.3e-13, it supplies unlimited labelled training data at zero label noise. The trained network reproduces it to 0.58 points RMSE on the 1000-point scale (R^2 = 0.99997), against 2.25 for gradient-boosted trees and 28.04 for linear regression on identical features and splits. Trained with missing-value masks against uncorrupted targets, it halves the error that incomplete data introduces: at 10% feature-level missingness the formula drifts 51.4 points from its own complete-data output with a systematic -12.5 point bias, while the network drifts 17.9. The network carries the score at production scale, across a population of millions of wallets spanning six orders of magnitude in size and activity.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍zScore-N，一个替代生产环境中手工编写公式的神经网络钱包声誉评分系统。该网络以原有公式为教师，通过5,208,952个钱包样本进行校准，利用公式生成无噪声的无限标注数据来训练网络。网络在1000分制上达到0.58点RMSE（R²=0.99997），显著优于梯度提升树（2.25）和线性回归（28.04）。更重要的是，通过缺失值掩码训练，网络在数据不完整时将误差从51.4点降至17.9点，消除了系统性偏差。
AI.motivation: 去中心化金融中的钱包声誉评分几乎都始于手工编写的分段公式，这些公式虽然可读且确定性，但存在四个关键缺陷：分段非可微、无法随数据积累而改进、无法区分真实为零的特征与管线捕获失败的特征。
AI.method: 采用知识蒸馏方法：将生产环境中的手工公式作为教师模型，经由5,208,952个钱包（2019-2024年）校准并验证输出误差在2.3e-13以内，从而提供无限量且零标签噪声的训练数据。训练神经网络时使用缺失值掩码，对未损坏的目标进行训练。
AI.result: 神经网络在1000分尺度上达到0.58点RMSE（R²=0.99997），优于梯度提升树（2.25）和线性回归（28.04）。在10%特征级缺失率下，公式相对完整数据漂移51.4点并带有-12.5点系统性偏差，而网络仅漂移17.9点，误差减半。网络能在生产规模下承载数百万钱包的评分任务。
AI.conclusion: zScore-N证明了用神经网络替代手工评分公式的可行性：不仅精确复现原有规则，还增强了鲁棒性——尤其是在数据不完整时的处理能力上显著优于原公式，同时消除了手工公式不可微、不可学习等结构性限制，并成功支撑了生产级的大规模部署。

title: Emergent Charging Coordination in Electric Delivery Fleets
comment: 42 pages, 11 figures. Submitted to Transportation Research Part C
summary: In electric delivery fleets, mid-shift charging is non-trivial: each vehicle must decide when, where and how much to charge to finish on time with battery above a safety floor. The choices are coupled: queues build where too many vehicles pick the same station. Prior work resolves this coupling with central dispatching, precomputed schedules or reservations, machinery that charging infrastructure rarely supports. Instead, we use a family of learning agents under purely local control: every vehicle runs the same policy, deciding alone from its time budgets and broadcast station occupancies, leading to emergent coordination without central control or messaging. We validate this paradigm in simulation on real OpenStreetMap networks of twenty cities, each with a frozen scenario calibrated by an omniscient Oracle (99.5% of shifts completed on time), whereas a naive greedy rule (nearest station on low battery) completes just 73%. Agents trained with neuroevolution (NEAT) and policy gradients (PPO) on four cities and deployed zero-shot across all twenty, sixteen never seen in training, complete 96.8% and 98.6% of shifts, with the policy-gradient controllers proving more robust when demand or vehicle characteristics drift beyond the trained regime. In contrast, tuned threshold heuristics that read vehicle urgency alone fall short in contended cities (~80%). Through training, these learning agents rediscover partial charging and short opportunistic sessions, and route around busy stations, cutting per-session queue waits from about 45 minutes to under 2. In summary, this coordination paradigm balances local urgency against public occupancy, reaching near-Oracle performance at minimal implementation cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种电动车队中途充电的纯本地控制范式：每辆车独立使用同一学习策略（神经进化NEAT或策略梯度PPO），仅依据时间预算和广播的站点占用率决策充电时机、地点和电量，无需中央调度或消息传递。在20个真实OpenStreetMap城市路网模拟中，PPO控制的零样本泛化达到98.6%的按时完成率，接近Oracle（99.5%），远超贪心策略（73%）和阈值启发式（约80%），并将每次充电排队等待从约45分钟降至2分钟以内。
AI.motivation: 电动车队中途充电决策存在关键的耦合问题：过多车辆选择同一站点会造成排队积压，而传统解决方式依赖中央调度、预计算时间表或预约机制，这些硬件/基础设施要求在实际充电网络中很少被支持。作者希望寻找一种无需中央控制、仅靠本地信息和涌现协调的可行方案。
AI.method: 采用同策略（homogeneous policy）的多智能体学习框架：每辆车独立决策，输入为自身时间预算和从广播获得的各站点占用率；训练两种学习代理——神经进化（NEAT）与策略梯度（PPO）。在4个城市训练、20个城市零样本测试，并与Oracle、贪心最近站策略及阈值启发式基线对比。
AI.result: 在20个城市的真实OpenStreetMap路网仿真中：Oracle完成99.5%的班次；NEAT和PPO零样本部署（其中16个训练未见城市）分别完成96.8%和98.6%的班次；贪心规则仅73%，阈值启发式在拥堵城市约80%；PPO在需求或车辆特性漂移时更鲁棒；学习代理自主发现了部分充电、短时机会充电等策略，排队等待从约45分钟降至2分钟内。
AI.conclusion: 该本地控制学习范式在平衡个体时间紧迫性与公共站点占用率之间取得了良好效果，以极低的实现成本达到接近Oracle的性能，为缺乏集中式基础设施的电动车队中途充电提供了一个可行且可扩展的解决方案。

title: Agentic ML Exploration (A-MLE) for Ads Ranking
summary: Modern industrial ads ranking stacks are increasingly bottlenecked not by model capacity or training compute, but by the throughput of human ML iteration - the cycles of research, implementation, training, debugging, evaluation, and launch required to surface a single statistically significant improvement. A typical ranking stack contains numerous differentiated models with heterogeneous data, architectures, and infrastructure constraints, and each cycle takes days to weeks of senior engineer attention per model. As a result, techniques that have proven effective on one model diffuse into others slowly and unevenly, leaving substantial recoverable signal unexplored. We present Agentic ML Exploration (A-MLE), an autonomous LLM-agent system that systematically explores ML techniques across a portfolio of ads ranking models. A-MLE decomposes ML iteration into five stages involving hypothesis generation, exploration strategy, experiment execution, result analysis and shared knowledge substrate which are orchestrated by a single agent that invokes domain-specific skills and agentic workflows against a sandboxed execution layer, with human-in-the-loop checkpoints at each stage boundary. We deploy A-MLE across a representative set of large-scale ads ranking models and evaluate it along a tiered capability framework (tool availability, autonomous workflow execution, and open-ended exploration). We further report a controlled cross-LLM study using a fixed agent loop, which surfaces qualitative differences in execution reliability and exploration aggressiveness across the Claude Sonnet, Gemini, and GPT families. We discuss failure modes and the design choices that govern reliability. Our findings suggest that agentic exploration is a practical force multiplier for ML engineers in industrial recommenders, especially for the long tail of models that rarely receive expert attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A-MLE（Agentic ML Exploration），一个自主LLM智能体系统，用于在广告排名模型组合中系统化探索机器学习技术。它将ML迭代分解为五个阶段（假设生成、探索策略、实验执行、结果分析和共享知识库），由单一智能体编排，并在每个阶段边界设有真人检查点。该系统在多种大规模广告排名模型上部署，并通过分层能力框架和跨LLM对照研究进行评估。
AI.motivation: 现代工业广告排名系统的瓶颈已从模型容量或训练算力转向人类ML迭代的吞吐量——研究、实现、训练、调试、评估和上线每个改进都需要数天到数周的资深工程师投入。多个异构模型之间已验证的技术扩散缓慢且不均匀，导致大量可回收的信号未被探索。
AI.method: 将ML迭代分解为五个阶段：假设生成、探索策略、实验执行、结果分析和共享知识基块，由单一智能体编排，调用领域特定技能和自主工作流运行在沙箱执行层，每个阶段边界均设有人机检查点。采用分层能力框架（工具可用性、自主工作流执行、开放式探索）进行评估，并进行固定智能体循环的跨LLM对照研究。
AI.result: 系统在代表性的大规模广告排名模型集合上部署成功。跨LLM对照研究（Claude Sonnet、Gemini和GPT系列）揭示了执行可靠性和探索激进性方面的定性差异，并识别了失败模式及影响可靠性的设计选择。
AI.conclusion: 智能体探索是工业推荐系统中ML工程师的实用增效器，尤其对很少获得专家关注的长尾模型效果显著。研究表明自主智能体系统可以系统性地弥补人力ML迭代吞吐量的瓶颈。

title: ParetoTransport: Generative Optimization by Mass Transport Toward The Pareto Front
summary: Offline multi-objective optimization requires not only moving the objective vectors of candidate designs toward the Pareto front, but also distributing them effectively along it. Generative methods have recently emerged as a natural approach because they learn a distribution over feasible designs while allowing generation to be steered toward promising designs. Existing methods, however, largely retain classical sample-wise guidance strategies, leaving the distribution-level modeling capability of generative methods underused. We propose ParetoTransport, a training-free guidance method for pre-trained flow-matching models that explicitly specifies and refines a population-level distribution in objective space. ParetoTransport guides a flow-matching sampler to iteratively transport the empirical offline distribution toward the Pareto front, with Wasserstein matching to intermediate proxy distributions. This directly controls distributional displacement and mass allocation along the front. We establish a convergence result and demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on standard offline MOO benchmarks, extending recent evaluations beyond hypervolume to generational distance, inverted generational distance, and Wasserstein distance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ParetoTransport，一种针对预训练flow-matching模型的免训练引导方法，通过Wasserstein匹配中间代理分布，在目标空间中迭代地将经验离线分布传输到Pareto前沿，实现对分布位移和前沿质量分配的显式控制，并在标准离线多目标优化基准上取得最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有离线多目标优化的生成方法主要沿用经典的样本级引导策略，未能充分利用生成方法在分布级建模上的能力，导致解集在前沿上的分布不够有效。
AI.method: 提出ParetoTransport方法，在预训练的flow-matching模型中引入免训练引导，通过Wasserstein距离匹配中间代理分布，迭代地将经验离线分布传输至Pareto前沿，显式控制分布位移和沿前沿的质量分配。
AI.result: 建立了收敛性结果，并在标准离线多目标优化基准上取得最先进性能，同时将评估从超体积扩展到世代距离、反向世代距离和Wasserstein距离等多种指标。
AI.conclusion: ParetoTransport验证了分布级引导策略在离线多目标优化中的有效性，超越了传统样本级引导方法，为生成式多目标优化提供了新的分布建模方向。

title: CircuTutor: Transforming Static Circuit Problems into Intelligent and Dynamic Tutoring
summary: Learning direct current circuit concepts requires learners to connect invisible physical quantities, such as current, voltage, resistance, and power, with observable outcomes such as bulb brightness. Conventional textbook materials and general-purpose circuit simulators provide opportunities for problem solving and exploration but offer limited support for explaining why circuit behavior changes or diagnosing the reasoning behind incorrect answers. We present CircuTutor, a circuit-state-driven intelligent tutoring system that transforms static textbook circuit problems into an interactive tutoring workflow. CircuTutor first uses multimodal problem parsing to extract the textbook question, circuit topology, component parameters, switch states, and answer options, which are converted into a structured task and validated through circuit simulation. Learners can then interactively explore the circuit (by changing parameters) and submit an answer while a SPICE-compatible solver computes physically consistent circuit states. After the learner submits an answer, CircuTutor presents a before-and-after circuit state animation corresponding to the selected operation, organizes the simulated state changes into a causal reasoning chain that explains the underlying circuit behavior, maps answer discrepancies to likely misconceptions, and generates adaptive follow-up exercises targeted at the diagnosed misconception. Our experimental results demonstrate that CircuTutor effectively improves conceptual learning and the overall learning experience. The proposed framework demonstrates how simulated circuit states can be transformed into intelligent and interactive tutoring for circuit education, with the potential to generalize to other STEM domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CircuTutor，一个电路状态驱动的智能辅导系统，能将静态教科书电路问题转化为交互式辅导流程。系统通过多模态问题解析提取题目信息，利用SPICE兼容求解器计算物理一致的电路状态，在学生提交答案后提供前后状态动画、因果推理链、错误概念诊断及自适应练习。实验表明该系统能有效提升概念学习和学习体验。
AI.motivation: 学习直流电路概念需要学习者将电流、电压、电阻、功率等不可见物理量与灯泡亮度等可观测结果联系起来。传统教科书材料和通用电路模拟器提供了解决问题的机会，但缺乏对电路行为变化原因的解释功能，也无法诊断学生错误答案背后的推理过程。
AI.method: CircuTutor采用多模态问题解析提取教科书问题、电路拓扑、元件参数、开关状态和答案选项，转换为结构化任务并通过电路模拟验证。学习者可交互式探索电路并提交答案，系统使用SPICE兼容求解器计算物理一致的电路状态，随后展示所选操作对应的前后电路状态动画，将模拟状态变化组织为因果推理链解释电路行为，将答案差异映射到可能的错误概念，并生成针对诊断出的错误概念的自适应后续练习。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，CircuTutor有效提升了概念学习和整体学习体验。
AI.conclusion: 该框架展示了如何将模拟电路状态转化为智能交互式电路教育辅导，有望推广到其他STEM领域。

title: Attributing Cohen's d: Training Data Attribution for Disease-Related Effects in Normative Age Biomarkers
summary: Normative age models are trained to predict chronological age in a nominally healthy cohort. Applied to patients, they deviate, and the gap between predicted and chronological age is read as disease risk. Here, we attribute the disease-related effect size of the age gap directly to individual training samples, rather than using a prediction-level loss as the attribution target. For Cohen's $d$, the resulting closed-form influence functional, validated against leave-one-out retraining, ranks training samples by their effect on held-out case-control separation. Across four diseases and two biomarker modalities in UK Biobank, removing the 10% most influential training samples raises held-out disease-related effect size in every seed. It more than doubles the metabolomic-age effect for type-2 diabetes and raises the brain-age effect for multiple sclerosis by roughly a third. Random removal leaves effect size flat even at 50% removal, confirming the gain comes from which samples are removed, not how many. Flagged subjects carry subclinical cardiometabolic burden that diagnosis-based exclusion misses, on markers the model never sees. For type-2 diabetes, where the method gains most, the marker recovered is HbA1c, the standard measure of blood sugar control. We release pyinfluence, our influence-function package, for reproducibility and reuse.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种将疾病相关效应量直接归因于个体训练样本的影响函数方法（针对Cohen's d），而非传统基于预测损失的归因。在UK Biobank的四类疾病和两种生物标志物模态上，移除10%最具影响力的训练样本使所有种子下的疾病效应量均提升；对T2D的代谢组学年龄效应提升超过两倍，对多发性硬化的脑龄效应提升约三分之一。被标记的受试者携带亚临床心脏代谢负担，且作者发布了可复现的影响函数工具包pyinfluence。
AI.motivation: 传统的脑龄/代谢组学年龄模型将预测年龄与实际年龄的差距作为疾病风险指标，但该指标受到健康训练队列中样本异质性的影响。作者希望直接从训练样本层面归因疾病相关效应量，识别并移除削弱疾病分离能力的样本，从而提升年龄差距指标的疾病检测效果。
AI.method: 提出针对Cohen's d的闭式影响函数，将疾病组与对照组之间的效应量直接作为归因目标（而非预测损失），用于对每个训练样本进行影响力排序。通过留一法重训练验证有效性，并在UK Biobank上对四种疾病和两种生物标志物（代谢组学、脑成像）模态进行系统评估，比较随机移除与基于影响力移除的效果差异。
AI.result: 在四种疾病上，移除10%最具影响力的训练样本后，所有随机种子下的留出集疾病相关效应量均提升。T2D的代谢组学年龄效应提升超过两倍，多发性硬化的脑龄效应提升约三分之一。对照组中移除50%样本时效应量持平，证明提升来自选择性地移除而非样本数量。被标记的训练样本在模型未见的标志物（如T2D中的HbA1c）上表现出亚临床心脏代谢负担。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将影响函数用于直接归因疾病效应量维度，揭示了规范年龄模型训练队列中"看似健康但实际存在亚临床疾病负担"的样本会稀释年龄差距指标对目标疾病的敏感度。通过系统性地移除这些样本，可以显著提升生物年龄指标的疾病检测效能，为生物标志物年龄模型的数据质量管理提供了新范式，并发布了pyinfluence工具包以支持可复现研究。

title: Revoked but Still Authoritative: An Empirical Study of Revocation Enforcement in Agent-Memory Systems
summary: Long-running language-model agents depend on persistent memory. Many agent-memory systems preserve history through soft revocation: a contradicted fact is marked invalid and retained rather than deleted. However, whether that mark is enforced at retrieval time is unexamined. In this paper, we measure five such systems: we load each with a revoked policy and its replacement, track whether the revoked fact is returned at retrieval and whether the agent then acts on it across nine policy scenarios and nine models, and score every trial under six defense conditions. We find that no system enforces revocation by default: the revoked fact is returned wherever the revocation label is visible to the retrieval layer, outranks its replacement, and leads agents to the unsafe action. Based on these findings, we develop a guard that sits between the agent and any memory backend and withholds records that are revoked or conflict with their replacement.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了五种长时运行语言模型智能体的记忆系统，发现所有系统在默认情况下都不会强制执行"撤销"（revocation）机制——被撤销的事实仍会在检索时被返回并导致智能体执行不安全操作。作者提出了一种介于智能体与记忆后端之间的守卫机制来解决此问题。
AI.motivation: 长时运行的LM智能体依赖持久记忆，许多记忆系统通过"软撤销"（soft revocation）保留被矛盾事实推翻的历史记录而非删除。然而，这种撤销标记是否在检索阶段被强制执行从未被系统研究过，存在安全风险。
AI.method: 作者测量了五种记忆系统：将撤销策略及其替代策略分别加载到每个系统中，在九个策略场景和九个模型下追踪被撤销的事实是否在检索时被返回以及智能体是否据此行动，并在六种防御条件下对每次试验进行评分。基于发现，开发了一个介于智能体与记忆后端之间的守卫（guard），用于扣留被撤销或与替代策略冲突的记录。
AI.result: 研究发现没有系统默认强制执行撤销机制：只要撤销标签对检索层可见，被撤销的事实就会被返回、排名超过替代品，并引导智能体采取不安全行动。
AI.conclusion: 现有记忆系统的软撤销机制存在漏洞，检索阶段未能有效拦截被撤销信息。为解决该问题，作者开发的守卫层可以在智能体与记忆后端之间拦截被撤销或与替代策略冲突的记录，从而防止不安全行为。

title: Guiding Worker Self-Selection in Crowdsourcing Contests: An LLM-Augmented Algorithmic Approach
summary: Crowdsourcing platforms coordinate large pools of online workers who strategically choose which contests to enter and how much effort to invest. This self-selection can leave important contests with too few participants or too little effort, while workers may regret entering contests that leave them worse off than available alternatives. We study how platforms can recommend contests to workers using self-selection in Tullock contests (SSTC), a two-stage model in which workers first choose contests and then compete within them. We introduce GRAF, a greedy polynomial-time framework that constructs self-selection outcomes by ordering workers according to a score vector, with guarantees of zero worker regret and platform optimality in special cases of SSTC. Because effective orderings are difficult to design under worker heterogeneity, we propose LLMScore, an LLM-driven evolutionary framework that automatically designs GRAF's scoring algorithm. LLMScore addresses two challenges: jointly optimizing platform utility and worker satisfaction, and evaluating worker regret when exact computation is intractable. Trained only on small instances of one setting, it transfers to larger and structurally different settings; moreover, its output is human-readable code that platform operators can inspect and modify. Across 1,000 synthetic instances spanning four settings, GRAF with LLMScore consistently achieves high-quality, often near-optimal, outcomes with low worker regret, benefiting both platforms and workers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRAF框架（基于分数向量的贪心多项式时间算法）和LLMScore（LLM驱动的进化框架），用于解决众包平台竞赛推荐问题，在保证工人零遗憾的前提下实现近乎最优的平台效用。
AI.motivation: 众包平台的工人会策略性选择竞赛及投入努力，这种自我选择可能导致重要竞赛参与者不足或努力不够，工人也可能后悔进入不如其他选择的竞赛。需要一种平台推荐机制来引导工人选择，同时兼顾平台效用和工人满意度。
AI.method: 提出两个核心方法：(1) GRAF——贪心多项式时间框架，通过按分数向量对工人排序来构建自我选择结果，在SSTC特殊情况下提供零工人遗憾和平台最优性保证；(2) LLMScore——利用LLM驱动进化搜索自动设计GRAF的评分算法，联合优化平台效用与工人满意度，并在精确遗憾计算不可行时进行近似评估，输出人类可读代码便于平台运营者审查修改。
AI.result: 在1000个覆盖四种设置的合成实例上，LLMScore仅在小规模单设置上训练，便能迁移到更大规模和结构不同的设置。GRAF配合LLMScore始终取得高质量、通常接近最优的结果，同时保持较低的工人遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 本文展示了一种结合机制设计与LLM驱动自动化搜索的可行方案，能够在复杂的工人异质性场景下自动生成有效的评分算法，同时兼顾平台和工人双方的利益，并具备良好的跨设置泛化能力和人类可解释性。

title: Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification for Hallucination Detection in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Hallucination detection is crucial for large language models (LLMs), as hallucinated content creates significant barriers in applications requiring factual accuracy. Current detection methods mainly depend on internal signals like uncertainty and self-consistency checks, using the model's pre-trained knowledge to identify unreliable outputs. However, pre-trained knowledge may become outdated and has coverage limitations, especially for specialized or recent information. To address these limitations, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a promising solution by retrieving relevant evidence at inference time, grounding outputs beyond the model's parametric knowledge. In this paper, we target a critical and practical learning problem RAG-based hallucination detection (RHD), where RAG is employed to enhance hallucination detection by addressing information updating challenges. To address RHD, we propose a novel method Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification (EAEV), which detects entity-level hallucinations by leveraging RAG to align generated entities with retrieved evidence contexts. Specifically, EAEV evaluates entity-evidence alignment through three complementary dimensions and introduces counterfactual stability analysis to ensure robust alignments under evidence perturbations. Experiments across multiple RAG benchmarks demonstrate that EAEV achieves consistent improvements over existing methods with strong generalization capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于检索增强生成（RAG）的幻觉检测方法EAEV（Evidence-Aligned Entity Verification），通过将生成实体与检索到的证据上下文进行对齐，从三个互补维度评估实体-证据一致性，并结合反事实稳定性分析来确保对齐的鲁棒性，实验证明该方法在多个RAG基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有幻觉检测方法依赖模型内部信号（如不确定性和自一致性检查），但预训练知识可能过时且覆盖范围有限，尤其对于专业或最新信息。RAG通过检索相关证据来弥补参数化知识的不足，因此需要解决如何利用RAG增强幻觉检测这一关键问题。
AI.method: 提出EAEV方法，利用RAG将生成的实体与检索到的证据上下文对齐来进行实体级幻觉检测。方法包括三个互补维度来评估实体-证据对齐程度，并引入反事实稳定性分析，在证据扰动下测试对齐的稳定性以确保鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个RAG基准上的实验表明，EAEV相比现有方法取得了一致的性能提升，并展现出较强的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EAEV通过实体级对齐和反事实分析有效解决了RAG场景下的幻觉检测问题，验证了利用外部证据辅助幻觉检测的可行性和有效性。

title: Local gradient neural operator
comment: 29 pages, 11 figures. Code available at https://github.com/baiming-zhang/LGNO
summary: Field temporal prediction and source identification constitute canonical problems in dynamical systems. Conventional approaches to these problems depend on a thorough understanding of the governing partial differential equations (PDEs). Recently, deep learning, as represented by neural operators, has provided a data-driven paradigm for addressing such tasks. However, most existing global neural operators for PDEs require large training datasets and many learnable parameters, with limited interpretability and generalization. We propose the local gradient neural operator (LGNO) as a lightweight and interpretable alternative for field temporal evolution prediction and source identification in typical mechanical problems. The method builds on priors from nonlinear gradient discretization and uses multilayer perceptron convolutional layers to learn translation-invariant local kernels that resemble discrete stencils. A zero consistent stencil factorization separates coefficient learning from field reconstruction, rendering the learned operators more transparent. For problems with symmetries, network folding shares equivalent components and reduces parameter counts. We evaluate the method on PDE benchmarks covering linear and nonlinear, static and dynamic, and low and high dimensional cases. Results show that LGNO maintains accuracy, parameter efficiency, and rollout stability across these tasks, and further exhibits wide applicability to mechanical problems including diffusion, flow, and quantum phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文提出局部梯度神经算子（LGNO），一种轻量级且可解释的深度学习框架，用于PDE场的时间演化预测和源项识别，在多个机械问题基准上展现出精度、参数效率和滚动稳定性的优势。
AI.motivation: 现有全局神经算子处理PDE任务需要大量训练数据和可学习参数，且可解释性和泛化能力有限，缺乏能够同时满足轻量化、可解释和高效预测的替代方案。
AI.method: 基于非线性梯度离散化的先验知识，利用多层感知机卷积层学习平移不变的局部核（类似离散模板）；通过零一致性模板分解将系数学习与场重建分离，增强算子透明度；针对具有对称性的问题，采用网络折叠共享等价组件以降低参数量。
AI.result: 在涵盖线性和非线性、静态和动态、低维和高维的PDE基准上，LGNO保持高精度、参数效率及滚动稳定性，并广泛适用于扩散、流动和量子现象等机械问题。
AI.conclusion: LGNO作为全局神经算子的轻量可解释替代方案，在保证性能的同时显著提升了模型透明度和参数效率，展现出在典型机械问题中的广泛应用前景。

title: Three Types of Negation of Triple and its Elements and an Extension of Triple
summary: In various data models, the classical triple is a typical semantic data model. However, due to the design of the triple as a simple structure for representing positive assertions, it cannot sufficiently express different forms of negation present in the triple and its elements. This paper conceptually proposes that there are three distinct forms of negation within triples and their elements: contradictory negation, opposite negation and intermediary negation. Based on the the set SCOI and the logic LCOI+PLCOI with three kinds of negation, we propose an extension of triple that can distinguish and express these three different negations in the triple and its elements, called the TCOI triple with contradictory negation, opposite negation and intermediary negation. The TCOI triple is a semantic and structural extension of the classical triple. While retaining the ability to express positive assertions, it systematically introduces the three semantic dimensions of three negations, allowing these negations to independently act on the elements of the triple and on the whole triple. This significantly enhances the triple model capability to represent and reasoning about complex negative information. This paper also explores the expressive power and reasoning of the TCOI triple, as well as the application of TCOI triple implication reasoning in counterfactuals and counterfactual reasoning. We propose a truth-value (continuous value) algorithm for TCOI triple implication reasoning and perform its calculation through an example of the counterfactuals and counterfactual reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为TCOI三元组的扩展语义数据模型，在经典三元组基础上系统地引入三种否定形式（矛盾否定、对立否定和中间否定），并基于SCOI集合和LCOI+PLCOI逻辑，实现TCOI三元组蕴含推理的连续真值算法，支持反事实推理。
AI.motivation: 经典三元组作为简单的肯定断言表示结构，无法充分表达三元组及其元素中存在的不同形式的否定，因此需要一种能够区分和表达多种否定形式的数据模型扩展。
AI.method: 基于SCOI集合和具有三种否定的逻辑LCOI+PLCOI，提出TCOI三元组，作为经典三元组的语义和结构扩展，使三种否定可独立作用于三元组的元素及整个三元组；并提出TCOI三元组蕴含推理的连续真值算法。
AI.result: TCOI三元组在保留表达肯定断言能力的同时，系统引入了三种否定的三个语义维度，显著增强了对复杂否定信息的表示和推理能力；通过反事实推理示例完成了蕴含推理真值计算。
AI.conclusion: TCOI三元组是对经典三元组在否定表达能力上的实质性扩展，其蕴含推理机制可有效应用于反事实及反事实推理场景。

title: A Theoretical Analysis of Generalization Dynamics in Neural Networks under Gradient Descent with Weight Decay
summary: Understanding generalization remains a central challenge in machine learning because it requires jointly considering data, architecture, and training dynamics. In this paper, we develop a theoretical framework that characterizes how these factors jointly shape generalization performance throughout training. More precisely, we study a broad class of neural networks trained under the $\ell^2$ loss by gradient descent (GD) with weight decay, and prove the convergence of GD to a neighbourhood of the global minimizers of the empirical loss. By partitioning the space based on the input data, we then decompose the population error into data error, optimization error, and prediction variation error, and bound them separately. In particular, for the prediction variation error, which measures the oscillations of the learned function, we propose (local) approximate homogeneity and derive explicit cellwise and layerwise bounds for its evolution along the training trajectory. These bounds yield two important implications: a necessary condition of improved generalization explains differences in layerwise generalization behavior; a sufficient condition describes delayed generalization and provides a theoretical characterization of grokking.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个理论框架，刻画数据、架构和训练动态如何共同影响泛化性能。针对ℓ²损失下带权重衰减的梯度下降训练的神经网络，作者将群体误差分解为数据误差、优化误差和预测变化误差并分别界定，利用近似齐次性推导出逐单元和逐层的误差界，从而解释逐层泛化差异及grokking现象的理论表征。
AI.motivation: 理解泛化是机器学习的核心挑战，因为它需要同时考虑数据、架构和训练动态三个因素，而现有理论往往难以统一刻画这些因素如何共同塑造训练过程中的泛化表现。
AI.method: 研究一类在ℓ²损失下通过带权重衰减的梯度下降训练的神经网络，证明GD收敛到经验损失全局最小化器的邻域；基于输入数据划分空间，将群体误差分解为数据误差、优化误差和预测变化误差三部分并分别界定；针对预测变化误差提出局部近似齐次性假设，推导其在训练轨迹上演化的逐单元和逐层显式界。
AI.result: 得到的误差界产生两个重要含义：一个必要性条件揭示了逐层泛化行为的差异；一个充分条件刻画了延迟泛化现象，为grokking提供了理论表征。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一解释了数据、架构和训练动态对泛化的影响，并从理论上同时刻画了逐层泛化差异和grokking的延迟泛化机制。
