title: MemForest: Efficient Agent Memory Management via EventTree Partitioning and Progressive Merging
summary: Agent memory systems have demonstrated significant potential in long-term dialogue, personalized assistants, and video understanding. However, continuously accumulated memory introduces substantial storage and retrieval costs during inference. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{MemForest}, a general memory compression framework adaptable to various agent memory systems. Specifically, MemForest partitions historical memory into event-centric units by leveraging global semantic similarity and local temporal continuity. For each unit, it constructs a maximum spanning tree, termed an EventTree, and progressively merges redundant memory nodes by selecting high-weight edges, reducing storage overhead. Furthermore, we introduce an anchor-guided propagation retrieval mechanism that retrieves relevant memory nodes from the temporal neighborhoods of key nodes, improving retrieval accuracy. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MemForest. Under the unimodal Mem0 framework, MemForest retains \textbf{97.1%} of the original performance while compressing \textbf{50%} of historical memory across three benchmarks (LoCoMo, LongMemEval, and PersonaMem), achieving a \textbf{1.89x} retrieval speedup. Under the multimodal M3-Agent framework, it preserves \textbf{99.7%} of the original performance with a \textbf{50%} compression ratio across two benchmarks (M3-Bench-robot and M3-Bench-web), achieving a \textbf{2.24x} retrieval speedup. \textcolor{RoyalBlue}{\textit{Our code is available at [https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}}](https://github.com/Celina-love-sweet/MemForest.}})

AI.tldr: MemForest是一个通用的智能体记忆压缩框架，通过事件单元划分、最大生成树构建和锚点引导的传播检索机制，在显著压缩记忆存储的同时保持较高的任务性能提升检索速度。
AI.motivation: 智能体记忆系统在长期对话、个性化助理和视频理解中潜力巨大，但持续累积的记忆在推理阶段会带来巨大的存储和检索开销，亟需有效的记忆压缩方法。
AI.method: MemForest包含三个核心组件：（1）通过全局语义相似性和局部时间连续性将历史记忆划分为事件中心单元；（2）为每个单元构建最大生成树（EventTree），通过选择高权重边逐步合并冗余记忆节点以减少存储开销；（3）引入锚点引导的传播检索机制，从关键节点的时间邻域中检索相关记忆节点以提升检索准确性。
AI.result: 在单模态Mem0框架下，MemForest在压缩50%历史记忆的同时保留97.1%的原始性能，并在LoCoMo、LongMemEval和PersonaMem三个基准上实现1.89倍的检索加速；在多模态M3-Agent框架下，以50%压缩比保留99.7%的原始性能，在M3-Bench-robot和M3-Bench-web两个基准上实现2.24倍的检索加速。
AI.conclusion: MemForest在单模态和多模态智能体记忆系统中均表现出有效性，能够在高压缩比下保持接近原始的性能水平，大幅提升检索效率。

title: Decomposition-Guided Diffusion Language Models for Inertial Confinement Fusion Prediction
summary: Inertial confinement fusion (ICF) is a leading pathway toward clean energy, but each shot at the National Ignition Facility costs on the order of one million dollars, making accurate AI surrogates a high-value target. We study exogenous-driven ICF waveform prediction, where a 512-step neutron-rate diagnostic must be inferred directly from a laser pulse and target design parameters, with no historical response observed. The regime stresses standard time-series predictors with temporal sparsity (picosecond peak in a nanosecond window), input-output scale mismatch (under 300 real shots), and peak sensitivity (picosecond timing). We propose ICF-DLM, to our knowledge the first LM-based ICF predictor, combining (i) a physics-typed decomposition into yield $Y_{DT}$, peak timing $t_{\mathrm{peak}}$, and local waveform $w_{\mathrm{local}}$; (ii) bidirectional denoising that defers commitment to peak location; and (iii) a physics-driven PPO reward re-injecting metric structure across numeric tokens. On ICFBench (50K simulations + 232 experimental shots), ICF-DLM cuts peak-timing error from 11.6 to 9.2 steps over a matched autoregressive LLaMA-3-8B and outperforms classical sequence models and LLM-based time-series predictors. Beyond ICF, the recipe shows potential to address science domains with low data and sparse events.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ICF-DLM，首个基于语言模型的惯性约束聚变（ICF）预测器，用于在无历史响应观测的情况下，直接从激光脉冲和靶设计参数推断512步中子率诊断波形。通过物理类型分解、双向去噪和物理驱动的PPO奖励机制，将峰值时间误差从11.6步降低至9.2步，优于自回归LLaMA-3-8B及经典序列模型。
AI.motivation: ICF是实现清洁能源的重要途径，但国家点火装置每次射击成本高达约一百万美元，因此高精度AI替代模型具有极高价值。现有时间序列预测器在该场景下面临三重挑战：时间稀疏性（纳秒窗口中的皮秒峰值）、输入输出尺度不匹配（不足300次真实射击数据）以及峰值灵敏度（皮秒级的时序精度要求），亟需开发专用预测模型。
AI.method: ICF-DLM包含三项核心设计：(i) 物理类型化解耦——将预测分解为聚变产额Y_DT、峰值时间t_peak和局部波形w_local三部分；(ii) 双向去噪机制，推迟对峰值位置的决定以降低预测偏差；(iii) 物理驱动的PPO奖励函数，将度量结构重新注入数值token中，引导模型优化关键物理指标。
AI.result: 在ICFBench基准（5万次模拟+232次实验射击）上，ICF-DLM将峰值时间误差从11.6步降至9.2步（相较于匹配的自回归LLaMA-3-8B），并优于经典序列模型和基于LLM的时间序列预测器。
AI.conclusion: ICF-DLM证明了语言模型在低数据、稀疏事件的科学预测场景中的潜力。该方法框架有望推广至其他面临类似挑战（低数据量、事件稀疏）的科学领域，为科学AI预测提供新的方法论参考。

title: Beyond Coherence: Benchmarking Professional Editing-Technique Execution in Multi-Shot Audio-Video Generation
summary: Recent multi-shot audio-video generators can produce increasingly coherent and cinematic outputs, but coherence does not imply the ability to execute editing techniques. Professional editing depends on shot structure, transition grammar, audio-video cut relations, and montage, yet existing benchmarks largely rely on proxies such as content quality, synchronization, or physical plausibility, systematically missing whether such editing instructions are actually executed. We introduce CutCraft, the first benchmark for editing-technique execution in multi-shot audio-video generation. CutCraft extends structured multi-shot prompts with explicit editing specifications and is paired with a hierarchical hybrid evaluation framework that combines shot-structure alignment, expert-model metrics, tool-grounded multimodal judgment, and rubric-based question answering. Beyond evaluation, we design an agentic editing baseline that decomposes generation into planning, shot-level synthesis, and post-hoc composition, explicitly realizing editing semantics such as J-cuts, L-cuts, and transition timing. Across 13 state-of-the-art closed- and open-source models, CutCraft reveals a consistent gap between coherence and editing-technique execution: current systems often produce plausible multi-shot videos yet fail to execute editorial instructions reliably. We find unstable shot structures, weak control of transition execution, and sharp degradation on higher-order montage, while aesthetic quality is only weakly correlated with editing-technique compliance. The benchmark and metrics, and the editing agent baseline are available at https://github.com/AlibabaResearch/cut-craft-bench.

AI.tldr: 提出了CutCraft，这是首个针对多镜头音视频生成中剪辑技术执行能力的评测基准，配套层级混合评估框架与智能体剪辑基线，对13个前沿模型评测后发现：现有系统虽能生成连贯的多镜头视频，但往往无法可靠执行编辑指令，在镜头结构稳定性、转场执行控制与高阶蒙太奇方面存在显著短板。
AI.motivation: 现有多镜头音视频生成器可输出连贯且电影感强的内容，但连贯性并不等于能执行专业剪辑技术（如J-cut、L-cut、转场语法、音画剪切关系、蒙太奇等）。现有基准多依赖内容质量、同步性或物理合理性等代理指标，系统性遗漏了对剪辑指令执行情况的验证，缺乏专门评测剪辑技术执行力的基准。
AI.method: 提出CutCraft基准：1）在结构化多镜头提示中显式扩展剪辑技术规格说明；2）构建层级混合评估框架，融合镜头结构对齐、专家模型指标、工具辅助多模态判断和基于规则问答四种评估维度；3）设计智能体剪辑基线，将生成过程拆分为规划、镜头级合成和事后合成三个阶段，显式实现J-cut、L-cut和转场时序等编辑语义。
AI.result: 对13个具有代表性的闭源与开源模型评测后发现，连贯性与剪辑技术执行之间存在一致差距：当前系统常能生成合理的多镜头视频，但无法可靠执行编辑指令。具体表现为镜头结构不稳定、转场执行控制薄弱、高阶蒙太奇表现急剧退化，且美学质量与剪辑技术合规性仅呈弱相关。
AI.conclusion: 现有音视频生成模型在"生成好看内容"与"执行专业剪辑意图"之间存在系统性的能力鸿沟，该鸿沟无法通过现有代理指标捕捉。CutCraft基准、评估框架及编辑智能体基线为后续研究提供了评测工具与改进方向，项目已开源。

title: Latent-MoE: Domain-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for PDEs with Multi-Regime Physics
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) struggle on PDEs whose governing physics varies across the domain. We trace this to a structural property of standard coordinate networks: their neural tangent kernel (NTK) is translation-variant and lets training points of large coordinate magnitude disproportionately influence predictions elsewhere, producing long-range coupling and gradient conflict during training. We show analytically and empirically that mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures with centered, compact-support routers yield a uniformly banded NTK whose kernel-regression weights decay exponentially with distance, localizing the learning. Building on this, we propose \emph{Latent-MoE}, which interleaves domain-aware MoE blocks within a shared backbone. Unlike FB-PINNs or X-PINNs, which rigidly partition both the domain and the parameters so that the parameters on different subdomains are updated independently, Latent-MoE is designed to preserve the localization benefit of domain-aware routing while allowing capacity to flow across regions through the shared backbone. On standard homogeneous-physics benchmarks Latent-MoE is competitive with established baselines; on benchmarks with multi-stage time-variable physics, where global models and rigid domain decompositions both fall into spurious solutions, it improves over them by more than an order of magnitude, with markedly reduced gradient conflict during training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Latent-MoE架构，通过混合专家（MoE）与紧凑支撑的局部路由器生成均匀带状NTK，实现物理信息神经网络在异质PDE上的局部化学习，在多变物理基准上比现有方法提升超一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 标准PINNs在物理规律跨域变化的PDE上表现不佳，根源在于坐标网络的NTK具有平移变性，导致大坐标幅度的训练点在远处产生过度影响，造成长程耦合与梯度冲突。
AI.method: 提出Latent-MoE，将域感知的MoE块交错嵌入共享骨干网络中。与FB-PINNs/X-PINNs的刚性强域划分不同，Latent-MoE通过居中且紧凑支撑的路由器产生指数衰减的核回归权重，既保留局部化训练优势，又允许容量通过共享骨干跨区域流动。
AI.result: 在均质物理基准上与现有方法相当；在多阶段时变物理基准上，相比全局模型和刚性域分解方法，改善幅度超过一个数量级，且训练过程中梯度冲突显著减少。
AI.conclusion: Latent-MoE有效解决了PINNs在处理域内物理变化时的长程耦合问题，在保持参数共享与容量流动的同时实现局部化学习，为异质PDE求解提供了新的架构思路。

title: LEBGen: An LLM-Enhanced Bayesian Network Framework for Few-Shot Travel Survey Data Generation
summary: Travel survey data are essential for transportation planning and travel behavior analysis, yet collecting large-scale representative samples is costly and time-consuming. A practical alternative is to generate synthetic survey records from a few-shot sample. However, such samples provide incomplete coverage of heterogeneous traveler groups and insufficient evidence for recovering the complex dependencies between demographic characteristics and travel behavior. Existing approaches have complementary limitations. Probabilistic generative models such as Bayesian networks (BNs) offer explicit distributional control, but structures learned from few-shot samples may omit meaningful dependencies or retain spurious ones. Large language models (LLMs) can help address these difficulties in BN structure learning by providing behavioral knowledge that complements the limited statistical evidence. We therefore propose LEBGen, an LLM-enhanced BN framework that uses this knowledge to refine network structure for few-shot travel survey data generation. Specifically, the LLM first identifies traveler personas from demographic attribute and travel behavior statistics, then recovers dependencies missed by the persona-augmented BN structure and prune spurious ones. The refined BN is parameterized exclusively from the observed data to generate synthetic records. Under a 2% few-shot setting on the 2022 Hong Kong Travel Characteristics Survey, LEBGen reduces the mean marginal Jensen-Shannon divergence from 0.0671 to 0.0091 and the mean absolute Cramer's V error by 14.3% over the best-performing baseline, substantially improving both distributional and dependency fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LEBGen，一种结合大语言模型(LLM)与贝叶斯网络(BN)的少样本出行调查数据生成框架。LLM提供行为知识用于补充BN结构学习中缺失的依赖关系并剪除虚假依赖，从而提升少样本合成数据的分布保真度和依赖保真度。
AI.motivation: 大规模出行调查数据采集成本高昂且耗时，少样本合成是实用替代方案，但少样本难以覆盖异质出行者群体且无法充分恢复人口统计特征与出行行为间的复杂依赖关系。现有概率生成模型(如BN)虽能提供显式分布控制，但从少样本学习的结构可能遗漏重要依赖或保留虚假依赖。
AI.method: 提出LEBGen框架：(1) 利用LLM从人口属性与出行行为统计中识别出行者画像(persona)；(2) 基于画像增强的BN结构，LLM进一步恢复被遗漏的依赖关系并剪除虚假依赖；(3) 使用精炼后的BN结构，仅从观测数据估计参数生成合成出行记录。
AI.result: 在2022年香港出行特征调查2%少样本设置下，LEBGen将平均边际Jensen-Shannon散度从0.0671降至0.0091，平均绝对Cramer's V误差相对最优基线降低14.3%，在分布保真度和依赖保真度上均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: LLM提供的补充性行为知识能有效改善少样本下BN结构学习的缺陷，LEBGen显著提升了少样本出行调查数据合成质量，为交通规划与出行行为分析提供了可行的数据生成方案。

title: Kalman Delta Networks: Uncertainty-aware Associative Memory
summary: Linear attention is increasingly used in frontier language models for efficient long-context inference and constant-memory decoding. Its fixed-size recurrent memory, however, requires an online decision at each token: what to write and how strongly to overwrite existing associations before knowing which information future queries will require. Delta-rule models learn this strength from the current token embedding but do not track confidence in the memory estimate, preventing each write from adapting to accumulated evidence. To represent this uncertainty explicitly, we reformulate recurrent associative memory as a linear--Gaussian state-space model, for which the Kalman filter is the optimal recursive estimator, and introduce a new family of models, Kalman Delta Networks (KDNs). Within KDNs, the transition propagates both the memory state and its uncertainty, allowing the Kalman gain to weight each residual write by accumulated evidence and observation reliability. Under this formulation, Delta-style updates emerge as a special case that substitutes a token-wise isotropic surrogate for predictive covariance and omits covariance tracking. Exact tracking, however, entails a dense, state-dependent Riccati recursion that is poorly suited to GPU-parallel linear-attention scans. To address this issue, we introduce two scan-compatible KDN approximations. Diagonal KDN projects each one-step posterior onto the diagonal Gaussian family through online mean-field variational inference, whereas Isotropic KDN uses an isotropic approximation with a single uncertainty scalar per head. Their uncertainty recurrences are Mobius maps, enabling associative scans with logarithmic parallel depth. Across controlled pretraining at 750M and 1.3B parameters, KDN variants consistently improve perplexity and mean downstream accuracy over state-of-the-art linear-attention models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Kalman Delta Networks (KDNs)，将线性注意力中的循环关联记忆重新建模为线性-高斯状态空间模型，利用卡尔曼滤波器作为最优递归估计器来显式追踪记忆估计的不确定性，使每次写入能根据累积证据自适应调整强度。KDNs作为Delta规则模型的一般化扩展，并通过对角线和高斯各向同性两种扫描兼容的近似来处理精确协方差追踪的计算问题，实验表明在750M和1.3B参数规模下优于现有线性注意力模型。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力模型中的Delta-rule在决定写入强度时虽然利用当前token嵌入学习权重，但缺乏对记忆估计置信度的显式追踪，导致每次写入无法根据累积证据自适应调整。为了显式表示这种不确定性并在写入决策中利用它，需要将递归关联记忆重新形式化为可进行最优递归估计的框架。
AI.method: 将循环关联记忆重新建模为线性-高斯状态空间模型，卡尔曼滤波作为最优递归估计器。转移过程同时传播记忆状态及其不确定性，卡尔曼增益根据累积证据和观测可靠性加权每次残差写入。为解决精确追踪带来的密集Riccati递归无法GPU并行扫描的问题，提出两种近似：(1) Diagonal KDN，通过对在线均值场变分推断投影到对角高斯族；(2) Isotropic KDN，使用每头单一不确定性标量的各向同性近似，其不确定性递推为Mobius映射，支持对数深度并行扫描。
AI.result: 在750M和1.3B参数规模的受控预训练实验中，KDN变体在困惑度和下游平均准确率上一致优于最先进的线性注意力模型。结果验证了显式不确定性追踪对线性注意力记忆更新决策的有效性。
AI.conclusion: KDN框架证明了将经典信号处理中的卡尔曼滤波思想引入线性注意力架构的有效性，为长上下文高效推理提供了新的理论视角。Delta风格更新被重新解释为KDN的一个特殊情况（用各向同性替代预测协方差且忽略协方差追踪），而完整的不确定性建模能带来一致性的性能提升。

title: FastE: Readout-Triggered Token Compression for LLM Embedding Inference
summary: In this study, we identify depth-dependent prefix redundancy in final-readout LLM embedding models, notably across representative backbones including Qwen3-Embedding and Qwen3-VL-Embedding. We find that removing prefix states is substantially more damaging in shallow layers than at greater depth, showing that prefix states become increasingly compressible as the prefix and readout states propagate through the network. To this end, we introduce FastE, a training-free, plug-and-play method. FastE uses a shared fixed threshold on batch-mean readout-prefix alignment as a lightweight online heuristic for selecting when compression occurs, and ranks prefix states by the attention scores they receive from the readout position to determine which states are retained in subsequent layers. Our evaluations demonstrate FastE's ability to substantially reduce computational costs: on NarrativeQA with Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B, it reduces decoder-backbone FLOPs by 40.11% while retaining 99.53% of Full Forward nDCG@10. Across five text embedding benchmarks, two backbone scales, and three cross-modal retrieval tasks, the quality-efficiency trade-off is directly customizable through the maximum removal ratio without retraining. We believe FastE offers practical value for scalable embedding generation in retrieval, indexing, clustering, and multimodal representation systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FastE，一种无需训练、即插即用的方法，利用深度相关的前缀冗余特性来压缩最终读出LLM嵌入模型中的前缀状态，从而显著降低计算成本同时保持检索质量。
AI.motivation: 作者发现最终读出LLM嵌入模型中存在深度依赖的前缀冗余现象：浅层中去除前缀状态对性能损失较大，而深层中前缀状态可压缩性更强。这一发现为优化嵌入模型的计算效率提供了新机会。
AI.method: FastE采用训练无关的启发式策略：使用共享固定阈值作用于批均值读出-前缀对齐度，作为在线选择压缩时机的轻量判断标准；同时根据读出位置对前缀状态的注意力分数进行排序，以决定哪些前缀状态在后续层中被保留。
AI.result: 在NarrativeQA上使用Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B时，FastE将解码器骨干FLOPs降低40.11%，同时保留99.53%的Full Forward nDCG@10性能。在五个文本嵌入基准、两种骨干规模和三个跨模态检索任务上均验证了有效性，且质量-效率权衡可通过最大移除比率直接定制。
AI.conclusion: FastE为检索、索引、聚类和多模态表示系统中的可扩展嵌入生成提供了实用价值，实现了无需重训练即可大比例降低计算成本的效果。

title: Foundation Models for Generalizable Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication
summary: Semantic and goal-oriented communication is increasingly studied for 6G, but generalization beyond seen data remains a key weakness under tight rate budgets. Many existing systems overfit their training data and degrade sharply at very low bit rates because they attempt to compress the entire signal. We introduce Foundation Model-Guided Semantic and Goal-Oriented Communication (FMSGOC), a framework that uses broad visual-linguistic Foundation Model priors to mitigate overfitting. It further improves rate efficiency by concentrating bits on sparse, goal-aligned anchors and relying on generative foundation-model priors to reconstruct the masked regions. By decoupling what to send from how to reconstruct, a vision-language foundation model selects and transmits a sparse set of semantic anchors, while a pretrained diffusion model, fine-tuned for masked completion, reconstructs the image at the receiver. In our experiments, FMSGOC reaches 0.039 bits per pixel (BPP), maintains high semantic fidelity (cosine similarity 0.87-0.90 on CIFAR-10), remains robust on previously unseen inputs (0.83-0.86 on ImageNet), and shows good perceptual similarity (0.1278/0.1558, CIFAR-10/ImageNet), outperforming strong end-to-end baselines at lower bit rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了FMSGOC框架，利用视觉-语言基础模型的先验知识来缓解语义通信中的过拟合问题，通过仅传输稀疏的目标对齐语义锚点，并在接收端使用微调后的扩散模型进行掩码区域重建，在极低码率（0.039 BPP）下实现了高语义保真度和跨数据集的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有语义与目标导向通信系统在6G场景下存在两大缺陷：一是过度拟合训练数据，对未见数据的泛化能力差；二是在极低比特率下性能急剧下降，因为它们试图压缩整个信号而非只传输必要信息。
AI.method: FMSGOC将"发送什么"与"如何重建"解耦：发送端利用视觉-语言基础模型选择和传输一组稀疏的语义锚点；接收端使用针对掩码补全微调过的预训练扩散模型重建图像，从而以基础模型先验替代对大量数据学习的依赖。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10上达到0.039 BPP，余弦相似度0.87-0.90；在未见过的ImageNet上仍保持0.83-0.86的余弦相似度；感知相似度分别为0.1278（CIFAR-10）和0.1558（ImageNet），在更低比特率下优于强端到端基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过结合基础模型的生成先验和稀疏语义锚点传输策略，能够在极低码率下同时实现高语义保真度和跨数据集泛化，为6G语义通信提供了新范式。

title: Feyospace-v1: How the Cyber Mercury Seven Trained Frontier Cyber Models
summary: Training capable cyber agents is often treated primarily as a problem of model scale, yet open-weight post-training is constrained more directly by the cost of executable environments, reliable multi-turn supervision, and access to strong teachers. We present a data-centric framework that addresses these bottlenecks through five complementary systems: Choulea analyzes hidden reasoning signatures, SkyReal reduces teacher-sampling cost, Hongzwang bypasses API restrictions on teacher execution, PSBreakup restores capabilities weakened by model merging, and Kreator converts expert interventions into trainable reasoning. Our data engine constructs resettable coding, vulnerability, CTF, kernel-history, full-exploit, firmware, and device-backed environments. Candidate trajectories are retained only after execution verification and evidence auditing, yielding 164,269 trajectories for long-context supervised fine-tuning. The three checkpoints improve over their starting models by an average of 23.76% on the full CyberGym suite and 10.49% across the pooled CTF suites. As of September 1, 2026, Feyospace-s1 achieves a verified success rate of 63.24% and ranks 10th on the official CyberGym leaderboard, while all three checkpoints rank 1st among models at comparable parameter scales. To our knowledge, this is the first end-to-end demonstration that a seven-person independent team can train open-weight models with leading agentic cyber capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个数据驱动的框架，通过五个互补系统（Choulea、SkyReal、Hongzwang、PSBreakup、Kreator）解决可用环境成本、多轮监督和强教师访问等瓶颈，构建了164,269条经执行验证和证据审计的轨迹用于长上下文监督微调，训练出的三个检查点相比基线平均提升23.76%（CyberGym套件）和10.49%（CTF套件），Feyospace-s1在CyberGym官方排行榜上取得63.24%的验证成功率并排名第10，所有检查点在相近参数规模模型中排名第1。
AI.motivation: 训练高效能的网络智能代理常被视为模型规模问题，但开源权重后训练更直接受限于可执行环境的成本、可靠的多轮监督以及强大教师模型的可访问性。作者旨在解决这些瓶颈，证明一个小型独立团队也能训练出具有领先代理能力的高质量开源模型。
AI.method: 提出一个数据中心的框架，通过五个互补系统解决各瓶颈：Choulea分析隐藏推理签名，SkyReal降低教师采样的成本，Hongzwang绕过API对教师执行的限制，PSBreakup恢复被模型合并削弱的能力，Kreator将专家干预转化为可训练的推理。数据引擎构建了可重置的编码、漏洞、CTF、内核历史、完整利用、固件和设备支撑环境。候选轨迹仅在执行验证和证据审计通过后保留，最终获得164,269条轨迹用于长上下文监督微调。
AI.result: 三个检查点相比起始模型在全套CyberGym套件上平均提升23.76%，在合并CTF套件上平均提升10.49%。截至2026年9月1日，Feyospace-s1达到63.24%的验证成功率，在官方CyberGym排行榜排名第10，且三个检查点在可比参数规模的模型中均排名第1。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个端到端的证明，表明一个七人独立团队能够训练出具有领先智能体网络安全能力的开源权重模型，挑战了"只有大规模团队和资源才能实现最先进代理能力"的传统假设。

title: InfluenceField: A Differentiable Field with Interventionally Identifiable Causal Structure for Multimodal World Modeling
summary: Multimodal large language models often capture visual-linguistic correlations but struggle to predict how local visual interventions propagate and affect downstream answers. We introduce InfluenceField, an intervention-aware latent field inserted between the visual encoder and language decoder. It lifts patch features into a continuous spatial representation, propagates directed influence over multiple steps, and predicts local intervention effects through a shared transition operator. Training jointly optimizes language modeling, cross-environment invariance, counterfactual rollout supervision, and structural regularization. For a nonlinear finite-basis population model, we show that target-aligned interventional supervision, together with a one-step separation condition on the transition, restricts admissible representations to within-location reparameterizations, so that the directed dependency graph of the full transition is recovered exactly. A linear specialization gives an exact partial-coverage characterization and a finite-loss stability bound, and the field analysis derives the spatial profile of coefficient interventions together with a shared-channel calibration result. On CausalVQA, InfluenceField improves overall accuracy over its backbone by 13.1 percentage points, with the largest gains on the planning and hypothetical categories. Capacity-matched baselines and structural controls attribute the gains in robustness and factual-counterfactual consistency to the causal objectives rather than to added capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InfluenceField，一种插入在视觉编码器和语言解码器之间的干预感知潜空间场，用于预测局部视觉干预如何传播并影响下游答案。在CausalVQA基准上，该方法相比骨干模型整体准确率提升13.1个百分点，其中规划与假设类别的提升最为显著。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型虽然能捕捉视觉-语言相关性，但难以预测局部视觉干预如何传播并影响下游答案，即缺乏对视觉因果干预效应的推理能力。
AI.method: 在视觉编码器与语言解码器之间插入干预感知潜空间场（InfluenceField），将patch特征提升为连续空间表示，通过共享转移算子多步传播有向影响并预测局部干预效应。训练时联合优化语言建模、跨环境不变性、反事实推演监督与结构化正则化。理论层面包含非线性有限基群模型的可识别性分析、线性特化的偏覆盖刻画与稳定性界。
AI.result: 在CausalVQA上，InfluenceField相比骨干模型整体准确率提升13.1个百分点，规划与假设类别的增益最大。容量匹配的基线与结构对照实验表明，性能提升主要归因于因果目标函数而非模型容量增加。
AI.conclusion: InfluenceField通过因果干预监督与理论可识别性保证，使多模态模型能够在潜空间层面精确恢复有向依赖图并预测干预效应，提升了视觉问答中因果与反事实推理的鲁棒性和一致性。

title: EvolveScaler: Synthesizing Information-Evolution Contexts via Executable State Machines and Natural-Language Rendering
summary: In persistent interactions, long contexts may encode an evolving process rather than a fixed record: later events can revise or revoke earlier information, changing what remains valid and what conclusions follow. We call this setting information evolution (IE). Solving IE requires identifying valid records, applying updates in order, and reconstructing the query-relevant state from the event history. Existing text-first synthesis pipelines make such data difficult to verify because state transitions and answer logic remain implicit. We introduce EvolveScaler, a code-driven framework that defines information evolution before rendering it as natural language. Human-authored operational specifications define state transitions, record validity, difficulty controls, and executable answer logic; a strong LLM then synthesizes a self-contained simulator from each specification. Executing validated simulators produces natural-language multi-turn event histories, while deterministic replay computes reference answers and atomic checklists. We instantiate EvolveScaler with 117 task prototypes and 159 final-question operators across five difficulty levels spanning approximately 7 to 1,200 events per instance, yielding about 35,100 training examples and 585 validated evaluation instances. On the very_long tier, the strongest model reaches 59.3% avg@5, while six models score below 10%. Training an internal A3B model on 6,000 EvolveScaler examples improves performance over its base checkpoint on all eight independently constructed out-of-distribution benchmarks, with a 5.25-point average gain. These results show that code-driven IE synthesis provides both challenging evaluation and transferable training supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EvolveScaler框架，通过代码驱动的方式合成信息演化（IE）任务，解决长上下文中事件状态动态变更的推理挑战。该框架将状态转换与答案逻辑显式编码为可执行规范，生成自然语言多轮事件历史及确定性参考答案，并提供约35,100个训练样本与585个验证实例，显著提升了模型在多个基准上的表现。
AI.motivation: 长上下文中存在信息演化场景——后续事件可能修订或撤销先前信息，改变哪些记录仍然有效以及能得出什么结论。现有文本优先合成管线将状态转换和答案逻辑隐式化，使得数据难以验证，缺少可靠的训练与评测数据。
AI.method: EvolveScaler采用代码驱动范式：先通过人工编写的操作规范定义状态转换、记录有效性、难度控制和可执行答案逻辑；再利用强LLM根据每份规范合成自包含模拟器，执行验证后的模拟器生成自然语言多轮事件历史，并通过确定性回放计算参考答案与原子检查清单。框架覆盖117个任务原型和159个最终问题算子，横跨五个难度等级，事件规模约7至1,200个。
AI.result: 生成了约35,100个训练样例和585个验证实例。在very_long层级，最强模型达到59.3%的avg@5准确率，而六个模型低于10%。在6,000个EvolveScaler样例上训练的内部A3B模型在全部八个独立构建的分布外基准上均有提升，平均提升5.25个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 代码驱动的信息演化合成既能提供具有挑战性的评测基准，也能提供可迁移的训练监督信号，证明该方法是解决长上下文信息演化问题的有效途径。

title: The Accuracy Paradox: Empirical Diagnostic of Default Decision Thresholds in Multi-Label Enzyme Commission Prediction [With Code]
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures,Enzyme Commission prediction, multi-label classification, class imbalance, threshold optimization, conformal calibration, accuracy paradox, bio-data, applied machine learning, bioinformatics. imbalanced bio-data, model diagnostic, performance metrics, open-source pipeline
summary: Automated prediction of Enzyme Commission (EC) numbers plays a central role in functional annotation and computational drug discovery. However, standard multi-label machine learning pipelines frequently rely on default decision thresholds (t=0.50), assuming balanced prior distributions across target heads. In this study, we present a systematic empirical diagnostic of uncalibrated fixed decision boundaries operating under severe class imbalance across N = 14,096 annotated compounds categorized into six primary EC classes (EC1-EC6). Our results highlight a pronounced Accuracy Paradox: while the multi-label system achieves a deceivingly high mean accuracy of 77.16%, the macro F1-score (0.3976) and macro recall (0.3872) reveal severe predictive breakdown. Majority target classes suffer from hyper-sensitivity and over-prediction, whereas minority classes exhibit sharp recall decay, culminating in a total decision boundary collapse for EC6 (Recall = 0.00%) despite underlying discriminative power (ROC-AUC = 0.5857). Feature correlation analysis further reveals high linear redundancy among topological indices relative to fingerprint density metrics. Ultimately, this diagnostic study demonstrates that standard point predictions mask critical errors in bioinformatics workflows. We establish target-specific threshold optimization and post-hoc conformal calibration as essential, open-source post-processing safeguards for reliable applied machine learning and deep learning architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文系统诊断了多标签酶分类（EC编号预测）任务中默认决策阈值（t=0.50）在严重类别不平衡下的失效问题，发现系统虽报告77.16%的高平均准确率，但宏F1仅0.3976，其中EC6类别召回率降至0%，揭示了"精度悖论"这一关键缺陷。
AI.motivation: 标准多标签机器学习流程通常默认使用t=0.50的决策阈值，假设各目标类别的先验分布均衡，而实际酶功能注释任务中各类别样本严重不平衡，这种默认设定可能导致预测性能被严重高估，现有研究缺乏对此问题的系统性实证诊断。
AI.method: 对14,096个已注释化合物进行六类主要EC类别（EC1-EC6）的多标签分类实验，系统评估固定决策边界在类别不平衡下的表现，结合宏F1、宏召回率、ROC-AUC等指标进行诊断，并进行特征相关性分析以检查拓扑指标与指纹密度度量之间的线性冗余。
AI.result: 系统平均准确率达77.16%（表面高），但宏F1仅为0.3976，宏召回率仅0.3872；多数类存在过度敏感和过度预测，少数类召回率急剧下降，EC6类别在决策边界处完全崩溃（召回率=0.00%），尽管其ROC-AUC为0.5857；特征相关性分析显示拓扑指数间存在高度线性冗余。
AI.conclusion: 标准点预测会掩盖生物信息学工作流中的关键错误，需要将目标特定的阈值优化和事后共形校准作为开放源码的后处理保障措施，以确保可靠的应用机器学习和深度学习架构。

title: SRPO: Setwise Relative Policy Optimization for Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Multi-agent large language models solve complex tasks by coordinating several policies in a shared environment. However, existing reinforcement learning methods usually optimize each response or trajectory separately, even when several outputs jointly cause one state transition. Consequently, the update unit differs from the action executed by the system. To address this problem, we propose SRPO (Setwise Relative Policy Optimization), which treats the active set the minimal set of outputs consumed by one transition, as one multi-agent action. Specifically, SRPO combines member log-ratios into one cardinality-normalized set ratio, assigns one relative advantage, and clips the set once. This formulation unifies division of labor and joint co-evolution as actions with different set sizes. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and multi-turn search demonstrate one training interface for fixed, mixed, and dynamically routed workflows across four model scales, with the strongest macro-average results among the reported comparisons. Optimization diagnostics further characterize its stability under different event reductions and set sizes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SRPO（Setwise Relative Policy Optimization），将多智能体大语言模型中共同导致一次状态转换的输出集合视为一个多智能体动作进行整体优化，解决了传统策略优化中更新单元与系统实际执行动作不一致的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法通常单独优化每个响应或轨迹，但多智能体LLM系统中多个输出是联合导致一次状态转换的，导致更新单元与系统实际执行的动作不一致，难以实现有效的分工与协同进化。
AI.method: SRPO将被一次转换所消费的最小输出集合——"活动集"——视为一个多智能体动作。具体做法包括：将成员的对数比率组合成基数归一化的集合比率；为集合分配一个相对优势值；对整个集合进行一次性裁剪。该框架将不同集合大小的分工与联合协同进化统一为一种动作形式。
AI.result: 在数学推理和多轮搜索任务上，SRPO提供了一个统一训练接口，适用于固定、混合和动态路由的工作流程，覆盖四个模型规模，在报告的对比中取得了最强的宏平均结果。优化诊断进一步表征了其在不同事件归约和集合大小下的稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 将多输出集合作为一个整体动作进行优化的SRPO方法，有效弥合了策略更新单元与系统实际执行动作之间的差距，为多智能体LLM的协同优化提供了一种通用且稳定的训练框架。

title: AVCG: A Generalized Variational Framework for Counterfactual Generation under Hypothesis Distributions
summary: Counterfactual explanations formalize "what-if" scenarios by identifying modifications to an input instance that obtain a desired alternative prediction. Traditionally, whether generated via instance-specific optimization or amortized single pass models, these approaches rely on a single, deterministic point-estimate predictor. However, this ignores predictive uncertainty and hypothesis variability, leading to brittle explanations that frequently become invalid if the underlying model is retrained or updated. To address this fragility, we propose the Amortized Variational Counterfactual Generator (AVCG), a generalized optimization framework that formulates counterfactual generation as optimization over an arbitrary distribution of plausible predictive hypotheses rather than a single deterministic predictor. This formulation naturally accommodates Bayesian posteriors, Rashomon-restricted hypothesis spaces, and other uncertainty representations within a unified optimization framework. Evaluation across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrates that the AVCG framework produces counterfactual explanations that remain highly valid under predictive uncertainty and model changes, while maintaining competitive plausibility and single-pass runtime performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AVCG（Amortized Variational Counterfactual Generator）框架，将反事实解释生成从基于单一确定性预测器的优化问题泛化为对任意合理预测假设分布上的优化，从而在预测不确定性和模型更新下生成更稳健有效的反事实解释。
AI.motivation: 传统反事实解释依赖单一确定性点估计预测器，忽视了预测不确定性和假设变异性，导致解释脆弱——一旦模型被重新训练或更新，生成的解释往往失效。
AI.method: 提出AVCG，一个广义优化框架，将反事实生成表述为在任意分布（如贝叶斯后验、Rashomon受限假设空间等）上的优化问题，并采用摊销式单次前向生成方案，在统一框架内整合不同不确定性表示。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的评估表明，AVCG生成的反事实解释在预测不确定性和模型变化下保持高度有效性，同时具有竞争力的合理性和单次前向推理运行时间性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将不确定性感知纳入反事实生成框架，AVCG有效解决了传统方法因模型脆弱性导致的解释失效问题，在解释稳健性与计算效率之间取得了良好平衡。

title: Personalizing LLM Agent Memory Using Biometrics
summary: Personalized memory helps LLM agents deliver stable, tailored assistance by storing and reusing user-specific data across interactions. In multi-user scenarios, however, retrieval must consider not only semantic similarity but also whether the current requester matches the identity associated with the stored memory. We propose Bio-Memory, a biometric-aware memory architecture that conditions memory retrieval on both semantic similarity and biometric matching. Built on top of A-Mem, Bio-Memory augments each atomic memory note with a biometric embedding and uses biometric matching to form the retrieval candidate pool before semantic ranking. We evaluate Bio-Memory on LoCoMo in a 10-user shared-agent setting over 7 face benchmarks and 10 palmprint protocols. Across datasets, Bio-Memory consistently separates owner and non-owner queries. Under face-based personalization, the largest average gap reaches 27.29% / 21.15% in F1 / BLEU-1 on CALFW; under palmprint-based personalization, the corresponding gap is 25.75% / 19.22% on MS_Blue. These results support biometrics as a practical control signal for personalized memory retrieval in shared environments.

AI.tldr: 提出Biometric-aware记忆架构Bio-Memory，在语义相似度之外引入生物特征匹配来约束记忆检索，确保只有与记忆所有者身份匹配的用户才能检索到对应个性化记忆，在共享多用户场景中有效区分所有者和非所有者查询。
AI.motivation: 多用户场景下LLM代理的个性化记忆检索仅依靠语义相似度不够，因为无法确认当前请求者是否与存储记忆的所有者身份匹配，需要引入身份信息来保证记忆的安全性与个性化精度。
AI.method: 基于A-Mem架构，为每条原子记忆笔记添加生物特征嵌入，先通过生物特征匹配构建检索候选池，再在此候选池内进行语义排序，实现双重条件约束的记忆检索。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo数据集上的10用户共享代理设置中，跨7个人脸基准和10个掌纹协议评估。基于人脸个性化在CALFW上实现最大平均差距27.29%/21.15%的F1/BLEU-1；基于掌纹个性化在MS_Blue上实现25.75%/19.22%的对应差距，稳定区分所有者和非所有者查询。
AI.conclusion: 生物特征可作为共享环境中个性化记忆检索的实用控制信号，有效解决多用户场景下ID匹配与记忆访问控制的问题。

title: Prevalence calibration as shortcut mitigation
comment: Accepted at the 17th International Workshop on Machine Learning in Medical Imaging (MLMI 2026), held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026. 11 pages, 2 figures
summary: Shortcut learning denotes the widespread situation in which a classifier exploits spurious correlations rather than diagnostic features. Existing mitigation strategies mostly aim to learn shortcut-invariant representations; their empirical success is limited and they cannot be applied to classifiers using frozen foundation model encoders. We propose to reframe shortcut learning as fundamentally a calibration problem: unconstrained learning implicitly calibrates each shortcut group to its training set disease prevalence, rendering the resulting classifier necessarily over-confident in one group and under-confident in the other. Building on this insight, we prevalence-equalize calibration between shortcut groups through two encoder-agnostic methods, an in-processing regularizer and a post-hoc prevalence-equalized recalibration step. Across chest-drain-pneumothorax benchmarks on CheXpert and SIIM-ACR, spanning fine-tuned CNNs and frozen foundation-model backbones, both methods substantially outperform all baselines. Post-hoc recalibration of a standard ERM-trained DenseNet raises misaligned-group AUROC from 0.23 to 0.73, indicating that shortcut reliance degrades the classification head rather than the underlying representation. Besides two new state-of-the-art shortcut mitigation approaches, our findings more fundamentally connect shortcut learning to calibration theory and algorithmic fairness.

AI.tldr: 该论文将捷径学习(shortcut learning)重新定义为校准问题，提出两种与编码器无关的方法（训练中正则化和训练后重校准），在胸部X光片数据集上显著提升了错位组的AUROC性能。
AI.motivation: 现有捷径学习缓解策略主要旨在学习与捷径不变的表征，但经验效果有限，且无法应用于使用冻结基础模型编码器的分类器，因此需要新的解决思路。
AI.method: 将捷径学习重新定义为校准问题，提出两种与编码器无关的方法：1) 训练中的正则化器(prevalence-equalize regularizer)；2) 训练后的重新校准步骤(prevalence-equalized recalibration)，两者均在捷径组之间实现患病率均衡的校准。
AI.result: 在CheXpert和SIIM-ACR的胸部引流-气胸基准测试中，两种方法均大幅超越所有基线；对标准ERM训练的DenseNet进行事后重校准，将错位组AUROC从0.23提升至0.73。
AI.conclusion: 捷径依赖主要损害分类头而非底层表征，该工作将捷径学习与校准理论和算法公平性联系起来，提供了两种新的最先进的捷径缓解方法。

title: BIO-MEMART: Biometric-Aware KV Cache Memory for Multi-User LLM Agents
summary: KV cache is evolving from a serving optimization into an external memory substrate for long-term LLM agents. In a shared multi-user deployment, however, reusable KV blocks introduce a missing access-control question: semantic relevance alone cannot determine whether a memory block is authorized for the current physical user. We propose Bio-MemArt, a biometric-aware KV-cache memory framework for multi-user LLM agents. Bio-MemArt attaches a normalized biometric template to each stored KV memory block, filters the shared memory pool with the current user's biometric probe, and then runs the original MemArt retrieval and KV reuse pipeline only inside the authorized candidate pool. This design preserves latent-space retrieval, direct cache reuse, and decoupled position encoding while adding physical-user access control to shared KV memory. We evaluate Bio-MemArt under Owner and Non-owner query conditions on long-term dialogue QA with face and palmprint benchmarks. Across face benchmarks, the average owner and non-owner biometric success rates are 95.71% and 0.86%; across palmprint benchmarks, they are 97.60% and 2.00%. In the efficiency study, average prefill tokens drop from 18,781.96 under full-context prompting to 28.57 with Bio-MemArt, showing that biometric gating preserves the low-token operating regime of KV-cache memory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Bio-MemArt，一个面向多用户LLM智能体的生物特征感知KV缓存内存框架。它通过为每个KV内存块附加标准化生物特征模板，先用当前用户的生物特征探针过滤共享内存池，再在授权候选池内执行原有的MemArt检索和KV复用流程，从而在保留潜在空间检索和直接缓存复用优势的同时，为共享KV内存引入了物理用户访问控制。
AI.motivation: KV缓存正从服务优化演变为长期LLM智能体的外部内存基质。在多用户共享部署中，可复用的KV块面临缺失的访问控制问题——仅凭语义相关性无法判断某内存块是否被授权给当前物理用户。
AI.method: Bio-MemArt将归一化生物特征模板附加到每个存储的KV内存块上，用当前用户的生物特征探针过滤共享内存池，随后仅在授权候选池内运行原始MemArt检索和KV复用管道，同时保留潜在空间检索、直接缓存复用和解耦位置编码。
AI.result: 在面部基准上，授权用户和非授权用户的平均生物特征成功率分别为95.71%和0.86%；在掌纹基准上分别为97.60%和2.00%。在效率研究中，平均预填充token数从全文提示下的18,781.96降至Bio-MemArt下的28.57，表明生物特征门控保持了KV缓存内存的低token运行模式。
AI.conclusion: Bio-MemArt成功在共享KV缓存内存中实现了物理用户级访问控制，既保持了高精度的授权用户访问率（>95%），又将非授权用户访问率控制在极低水平（<2%），同时未牺牲KV缓存内存原有的高效率特性。

title: Structured Extrema Errors in Classical Surrogates for Viscous Burgers: A Physics-Consistent Interpretation
summary: We study the local errors of classical machine-learning surrogate models, which approximate the time evolution of the one-dimensional viscous Burgers equation. Four models are compared on the same prediction task, using the spatial grid values directly: radial basis function (RBF) kernel ridge regression (KRR), linear Ridge, ExtraTrees, and Random Forests. Across all four models, the one-step residual, defined here as the true value minus the predicted value at each grid point, forms clear curved branches near predicted maxima and minima. A more detailed analysis of KRR shows that these errors are much more strongly related to the second spatial derivative, which measures local curvature, than to the first spatial derivative. Near a smooth extremum, predicted value and curvature form a local two-branch fold. Under our local curvature-based model of the residual, this fold predicts a leading-order near-parabolic relation between predicted value and residual. This geometric result motivates a direct test of the Burgers advection (transport) and diffusion (smoothing) terms. For KRR and Ridge, regression tests on held-out trajectories, a control that breaks the spatial alignment of the diffusion term, and a spectral test of high-frequency content are consistent with insufficient viscous smoothing at moderate and high viscosity. In this case, the surrogate retains more small-scale structure than the true future state. The same physical explanation is much weaker for the tree models. Finally, a correction that uses only predicted quantities reduces both one-step error and error during recursive rollout, where each prediction is used as the next input.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了经典机器学习代理模型在近似一维粘性Burgers方程时间演化时的局部误差。比较了四种模型（RBF核岭回归、线性Ridge、ExtraTrees和随机森林），发现所有模型的单步残差在预测极值附近形成弯曲分支结构。对KRR的详细分析表明，误差与二阶空间导数（局部曲率）高度相关，而非一阶导数。在光滑极值附近，预测值与曲率形成局部两分支折叠，产生预测值与残差间的近抛物线关系。对KRR和Ridge的回归测试、对照实验和谱测试结果一致表明，在中高粘度下代理模型对粘性平滑不足，保留了比真实未来状态更多的小尺度结构。该物理解释对树模型较不适用。最后，仅使用预测量的修正方法同时降低了单步误差和递归滚动预测误差。
AI.motivation: 理解机器学习代理模型（用于近似偏微分方程时间演化）产生误差的几何和物理机制，从而为改进代理模型的预测精度提供理论基础。作者试图将数值误差与方程本身的物理项（对流与扩散）联系起来，而非仅停留在统计层面的误差分析。
AI.method: 在相同的预测任务上对比四种模型（RBF核岭回归KRR、线性Ridge、ExtraTrees、随机森林），用空间网格值直接作为输入。分析单步残差的分布形态，通过残差与一阶/二阶空间导数的相关性分析识别主要误差来源，提出基于局部曲率的残差模型。对KRR和Ridge进行回归测试、打破扩散项空间对齐的对照实验以及高频内容谱测试来检验粘性平滑不足的假设，并设计仅使用预测量（无需真实值）的修正方法来改善预测。
AI.result: 四种模型的单步残差在预测极值（最大/最小值）附近均形成清晰的弯曲分支。KRR的误差与二阶空间导数（局部曲率）的相关性远强于与一阶导数的相关性，在光滑极值附近预测值与曲率形成两分支折叠结构，推导出预测值与残差之间存在近抛物线关系。对KRR和Ridge，多项测试均支持"粘性平滑不足"的假设，即代理模型在中高粘度下保留了过多小尺度结构。该物理机制对树模型解释力较弱。基于预测量的修正方法有效降低了单步误差和递归滚动误差。
AI.conclusion: 机器学习代理模型对粘性Burgers方程的预测误差具有系统性的几何结构——集中在极值附近、与局部曲率强相关，本质上是代理模型对扩散（粘性平滑）项的建模不足所致。误差的几何特征与物理机制紧密关联，且可通过纯预测量的修正来缓解，为一类偏微分方程代理模型的可解释性和可修正性提供了新见解。

title: AgentGrad: Intervention-guided Prompt Optimization for Multi Agent Systems
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) achieve strong performance by employing specialized multiple agents, yet their performance depends on the prompt design of each agent. For MAS prompt optimization, textual gradient methods that guide prompt updates using natural-language feedback have emerged as a leading paradigm. In this paper, we identify limitations in two stages of existing textual gradient approaches: gradient extraction and gradient aggregation. In gradient extraction, previous works select a target prompt without verifying whether modifying it resolves the failure, and derive gradients without agent-level supervision over the corresponding agent's intermediate output. In gradient aggregation, individual gradients are randomly grouped and concatenated, often mixing unrelated failure modes and producing prompts that fail to generalize. To address these limitations, we propose \textbf{AgentGrad}, a prompt optimization framework for multi-agent systems based on sequential intervention and semantic textual gradient abstraction. For each failure, sequential intervention modifies the behavior of one agent at a time to identify the target agent whose modification resolves the failure. The modified output of the target agent then serves as agent-level supervision for extracting a fine-grained gradient. Semantic textual gradient abstraction clusters semantically similar gradients to prevent mixing unrelated failure modes, and abstracts each cluster into a generalized gradient that captures the shared corrective pattern. Experimental results show that AgentGrad achieves state-of-the-art performance across five MAS benchmarks and reduces wall-clock optimization time by $2.5\times$ on average compared to the next-fastest baseline.

title: Streaming Hierarchical Inference with Tabular Foundation Models
comment: Streaming Continual Learning ECML PKDD Workshop 2026
summary: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) have recently demonstrated strong predictive performance through in-context learning, but their deployment in high-throughput data streams remains challenging due to communication overhead and latency. We propose \textit{HINT}, a hierarchical inference framework that combines edge-based retrieval with cloud-based TFM inference. A graph-based approximate nearest neighbor memory maintained over a sliding window provides local predictions and uncertainty estimates, allowing confident samples to be processed locally while uncertain instances are selectively offloaded, together with their retrieved context, to a cloud-hosted TFM. The framework exposes an offloading threshold and a neighborhood retrieval policy that can be varied to balance predictive performance and communication cost. Experiments show \textit{HINT} consistently identifies favorable trade-offs.

AI.tldr: HINT是一个分层推断框架，结合边缘端检索与云端表格基础模型推断，通过滑窗图近似最近邻内存提供本地预测和不确定性估计，仅将不确定样本及其检索上下文卸载到云端，从而在预测性能与通信成本之间取得平衡。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型在上下文学习方面表现出色，但在高吞吐量数据流部署中面临通信开销和延迟挑战，亟需一种能减少通信成本同时保持预测性能的推断方案。
AI.method: 提出HINT框架：使用基于图的近似最近邻内存（维护在滑动窗口上）进行边缘端本地预测和不确定性估计；高置信度的样本在本地处理，不确定样本携带其检索上下文选择性卸载到云端的TFM进行推断；框架提供卸载阈值和邻域检索策略两个可调参数来平衡性能与通信开销。
AI.result: 实验表明HINT能够持续识别出预测性能与通信成本之间的有利权衡（favorable trade-offs）。
AI.conclusion: HINT通过边缘-云协作的分层推断架构，有效缓解了TFM在高吞吐量部署中的通信瓶颈，同时提供了可调节的性能-成本权衡机制。

title: A Three-Tier Persona Vector for Controllable User Simulation in Agentic Evaluation
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 6 tables. Extended treatment of the persona component of StateGen (arXiv:2606.16307)
summary: Evaluating tool-augmented LLM agents requires diverse, realistic user inputs yet most evaluation frameworks use flat role descriptions ("you are an angry customer") that produce near-identical conversations regardless of the underlying scenario. In this paper, we propose a three-tier persona vector with 23 operationalized dimensions: 6 categorical demographics (jurisdiction, age, channel, device, language proficiency, time availability), 12 continuous behavioral traits (patience, assertiveness, digital literacy, etc.) sampled with Gaussian noise around curated profile base vectors, and 5 continuous emotional states (frustration, anxiety, trust, confidence, stress) that shift in response to scenario context. Orthogonal to the persona, a 4-level query-complexity overlay controls utterance phrasing from direct to deliberately vague. We evaluate the persona model inside a synthetic data generation pipeline across 64,698 multi-turn conversations spanning 8 named profiles and 3 production corpora. Key findings: (i) a 15.8 percentage-point spread in agent goal-achievement across personas confirms trait vectors produce measurably different user behavior; (ii) the same persona behaves differently across scenarios due to scenario-reactive emotional state shifts, validating the scenario-reactive design; (iii) domain-specific projects show persona sensitivity on booking-flow compliance (~15-20 percentage points gap between tier-aware and pressure-test personas), demonstrating the model faithfully reproduces real-world difficulty distributions; (iv) seven rule-described trait correlations produce auditable co-occurrence patterns without requiring learned covariance matrices. The persona model is fully specified for reproduction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种三层人物角色向量模型（three-tier persona vector），包含23个可操作维度，用于生成多样化、真实的工具增强型LLM智能体评估对话数据。模型在64,698个多轮对话中验证，证明不同人物角色会产生可测量的行为差异（目标达成率跨度达15.8个百分点），且场景反应性情绪状态设计能有效模拟真实世界的难度分布。
AI.motivation: 现有评估框架大多使用扁平化的角色描述（如"你是一个愤怒的客户"），导致无论底层场景如何变化，生成的对话几乎相同，缺乏多样性。为了评估工具增强型LLM智能体，需要多样化且真实用户输入，因此需要更精细的人物角色建模方法。
AI.method: 提出三层人物角色向量模型：第一层为6个分类人口统计维度（管辖地、年龄、渠道、设备、语言熟练度、可用时间）；第二层为12个连续行为特质（耐心、果断、数字素养等），在精选的档案基础向量周围添加高斯噪声采样；第三层为5个连续情绪状态（挫折、焦虑、信任、自信、压力），随场景上下文动态变化。此外正交叠加4级查询复杂度覆盖层，控制话语从直接到刻意模糊的表达。
AI.result: 在64,698个多轮对话中（涵盖8个具名档案和3个生产语料库）验证发现：（1）不同人物角色的智能体目标达成率产生15.8个百分点的差异，证实特质向量产生可测量的不同用户行为；（2）同一人物角色在不同场景中行为不同，验证了场景反应性情绪状态设计；（3）领域特定项目在预订流程合规性上表现出15-20个百分点的人物角色敏感性差异；（4）7条规则描述的特质相关性产生可审计的共现模式，无需学习协方差矩阵。
AI.conclusion: 该人物角色模型能忠实再现真实世界的难度分布，已完全规格化以便复现，为工具增强型LLM智能体的评估提供了比扁平角色描述更精细、更真实、更可审计的合成数据生成方案。

title: $α$-Graph: Attention-Infused Normalizing Flow Approach to Tractable Graph Modeling
summary: Graph modeling, a crucial task for representing complex relationships in graph-structured data, has achieved significant success in recent years. However, current graph modeling methods rely on traditional Graph Neural Networks and pre-training approaches to implicitly learn the underlying relational structure of graph data. Thus, these prior methods cannot capture the complex graph structure and correlations among inputs. In this paper, we introduce a novel Attention-based Normalizing Flow-based Approach\footnote{Our implementation and models will be released publicly for research reproducibility.} (ANFA or $α$) that provides an explicit, interpretable, and tractable Graph Modeling ($α$-Graph). In particular, we propose a new Unconditional Graph Normalizing Flow with an Invertible Attention Mechanism to capture the complex relational structure of graph data. To further enhance the expressiveness of the model, we introduce Conditional Graph Normalizing Flow with Learnable Queries that enables efficient modeling of correlations in graph-structured data. We show that our Conditional Graph Normalizing Flows behave similarly to Unconditional Graph Normalizing Flows, enhancing expressiveness while maintaining training stability and efficiency. Our experimental results on three benchmarks will illustrate the effectiveness and the state-of-the-art (SoTA) performance of the proposed $α$-Graph method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于注意力机制与归一化流的图建模方法（ANFA/α-Graph），通过无条件图归一化流与可逆注意力机制显式捕捉图结构，并引入带可学习查询的条件图归一化流来增强模型表达能力，在三个基准数据集上取得了最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有图建模方法依赖于传统图神经网络和预训练方式隐式学习图数据的底层关系结构，无法有效捕捉复杂的图结构和输入间的相关性，缺乏显式、可解释且可处理的建模途径。
AI.method: 提出了两种核心组件：(1) 带可逆注意力机制的无条件图归一化流（Unconditional Graph Normalizing Flow），用于显式捕捉图数据的复杂关系结构；(2) 带可学习查询的条件图归一化流（Conditional Graph Normalizing Flow），用于高效建模图结构数据中的相关性，增强模型表达能力的同时保持训练稳定性与效率。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，所提出的α-Graph方法在性能上达到了最先进（SoTA）水平，且条件图归一化流与无条件图归一化流表现类似，在增强表达力的同时维持了训练稳定性。
AI.conclusion: α-Graph提供了一种显式、可解释且可处理的图建模框架，验证了将归一化流与注意力机制结合用于图结构数据的可行性与有效性，为图建模领域提供了新的研究方向。

title: Graph-Based Personalized Memory for LLM Agents: Representation, Evolution, Retrieval, and Evaluation
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents are evolving from single-session tools toward long-term personal assistants that must adapt to individual users across tasks, contexts, and interactions. This shift makes memory a core requirement for personalization, since user preferences, goals, constraints, relationships, and past experiences are accumulated gradually and often change over time. Graph-based personalized memory provides a structured way to model such user information through explicit relations, temporal context, and evidence links. Such representations can model not only what an agent remembers about a user but also how memories are connected, revised, and retrieved to support personalized decisions. However, existing work remains fragmented across personalized agents and generic graph memory frameworks, making it difficult to understand the design space as a whole. This survey develops a lifecycle-oriented view of graph-based personalized memory for LLM agents. We organize existing studies around memory representation, memory evolution, memory retrieval, and memory evaluation. We further compare key design choices, discuss current evaluation practices, and open challenges in building reliable long-term personalized agents. This survey aims to clarify how graph-based memory can support adaptive, controllable, and user-centric LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 本文以生命周期视角系统综述了面向LLM智能体的基于图的个性化记忆研究，围绕记忆表示、记忆演化、记忆检索和记忆评估四个维度组织现有工作，对比关键设计选择并讨论当前评估实践与开放挑战，旨在阐明基于图的记忆如何支持自适应、可控且以用户为中心的LLM智能体。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体正从单次会话工具演变为长期个人助理，需要跨任务、跨场景地适应个体用户，这使得记忆成为个性化需求的核心。尽管基于图的个性化记忆通过显式关系、时间上下文和证据链接提供了结构化建模方案，但现有研究在个性化智能体与通用图记忆框架之间较为碎片化，缺乏对整体设计空间的宏观理解。
AI.method: 本文采用综述研究方法，提出一个生命周期导向的分析视角，将现有研究系统地划分为记忆表示、记忆演化、记忆检索和记忆评估四个核心阶段，并在此基础上对比各研究的关键设计选择，审视当前的评估实践。
AI.result: 论文组织和比较了围绕图式个性化记忆的现有研究，总结了各记忆阶段的设计选项差异，并指出了当前评估实践中的不足以及构建可靠长期个性化智能体所面临的开放挑战。
AI.conclusion: 基于图的个性化记忆能够有效支持LLM智能体实现对用户的自适应、可控与以用户为中心的长期服务，但该领域仍需进一步统一框架、完善评估方法并攻克长期可靠性等开放性问题。

title: MetaKV: Adaptive KV Cache Compression for Constrained LLM Inference
summary: Key--value (KV) cache compression is an effective way to reduce the memory overhead of large language model (LLM) inference, particularly for long-context workloads. However, existing compression methods make different trade-offs among accuracy, inference latency, and peak KV cache memory utilization, making a single fixed configuration unsuitable across different prompts and resource constraints. We introduce MetaKV, an adaptive framework that selects a KV cache compression configuration for each input prompt based on user-specified latency and peak memory budgets. MetaKV uses lightweight prediction models to estimate the end-to-end latency, peak memory, and probability of a correct response for each candidate configuration, and selects the configuration that best satisfies the latency-memory constraints while preserving accuracy. We evaluate MetaKV across ten configurations from three representative KV cache compression methods, KVQuant, H$_2$O, and RocketKV, together with an uncompressed FP16 configuration, on four datasets covering mathematics, science, commonsense reasoning, and reading comprehension. Across a wide range of latency and peak memory constraints, MetaKV consistently outperforms the best static configuration, improving constrained success rate (CSR), the fraction of prompts answered correctly while satisfying both constraints, by approximately 0.07 on average and up to 0.135. These results demonstrate the benefit of adapting KV cache compression to individual prompts and latency-memory constraints. Code is available at https://github.com/MichaelWang0505/MetaKV.git

AI.tldr: MetaKV是一个自适应KV缓存压缩配置选择框架，根据每个输入提示词以及用户指定的延迟和峰值内存预算，利用轻量级预测模型评估各候选配置的端到端延迟、峰值内存和正确响应概率，选择满足约束且保持准确性的最优配置。在四个数据集上对比十种压缩配置，MetaKV平均约0.07、最高0.135地提升约束成功率（CSR），优于任何单一静态配置。
AI.motivation: 现有的KV缓存压缩方法在准确性、推理延迟和峰值内存利用率之间存在不同的权衡取舍，单一固定配置无法同时适应不同的提示词和资源约束场景。作者希望解决这一静态配置无法在不同条件下的保持最优性能的问题。
AI.method: MetaKV构建了一个自适应框架，核心包括：1) 使用轻量级预测模型估计每个候选配置的端到端延迟、峰值内存和正确响应概率；2) 根据用户指定的延迟和峰值内存预算，在多个候选压缩配置（涵盖KVQuant、H2O、RocketKV及未压缩FP16配置）中选择最能满足约束且保持准确性的配置。
AI.result: 在数学、科学、常识推理和阅读理解四个数据集上，跨广泛的延迟和峰值内存约束场景，MetaKV一致性优于最佳静态配置，约束成功率（CSR）平均提升约0.07，最高可提升0.135。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，根据单个提示词及延迟-内存约束来动态适配KV缓存压缩策略是有益的，验证了自适应配置选择优于固定配置的有效性。

title: CLAMP: Constrained Decoding for Vision-Language Embodied Planning
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Embodied planning increasingly relies on vision-language models (VLMs) to translate instructions and visual observations into executable action sequences. However, fluent plans are not always executable. A VLM may refer to objects that are not visually observed, select actions whose required affordances are unavailable, or violate syntax and action constraints. We introduce CLAMP, a multimodal constraint-grounding framework that turns scene evidence into decoding-time constraints for a frozen VLM planner. CLAMP uses the initial observation to restrict object references to those supported by the scene, while a provided symbolic action model specifies state transitions and goals. During decoding, hard masks eliminate invalid next-token candidates, while a Hidden Markov Model (HMM)-based world-state lookahead module reweights the probabilities of the remaining feasible candidates based on action preconditions and goal reachability. This allows the planner to retain the VLM's language prior while preventing visually unsupported, unsafe, or infeasible candidates from entering the plan. For unseen tasks and environments, CLAMP adapts the HMM at test time using label-free continuations sampled from the frozen VLM. Experiments on VLABench, SafeAgentBench, and TaPA show that scene-grounded constraints improve object grounding and safety, while most remaining failures stem from perception errors or misaligned constraint specifications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CLAMP框架，通过将场景证据转化为解码时约束（硬掩码+基于HMM的世界状态前瞻重加权），使冻结的VLM规划器生成视觉上可支持、安全且可执行的行动序列，在VLABench、SafeAgentBench和TaPA三个基准上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 具身规划中，VLM生成的流畅计划并不总是可执行的——可能引用场景中未观察到的物体、选择不具备所需可供性的动作、或违反语法与动作约束。现有方法缺乏对场景证据与动作先验的约束整合机制。
AI.method: CLAMP包含两个解码时约束模块：(1) 硬掩码基于初始观察和符号动作模型消除无效的下一token候选；(2) 基于HMM的世界状态前瞻模块根据动作前置条件和目标可达性对剩余可行候选的概率进行重加权。在测试时，CLAMP利用冻结VLM采样的无标签延续来适配未知任务和环境中的HMM。
AI.result: 在VLABench、SafeAgentBench和TaPA上的实验表明，场景接地约束改善了物体接地和安全性能；剩余的大多数失败源于感知错误或约束规格不匹配。
AI.conclusion: CLAMP通过解码时约束有效保留了VLM的语言先验，同时防止视觉上不支持、不安全或不可行的候选进入计划，是可扩展、即插即用的具身规划约束接地方案。

title: Heat Field Signatures: From Point Clouds to Smooth Geometry
summary:
Bringing multiscale geometric analysis directly to irregular point clouds remains difficult: quantities such as local dimension, anisotropy, density variation, and geometric transitions are typically estimated through explicit neighborhood, manifold, or graph constructions, or left for neural networks to infer from coordinates. We introduce Heat Field Signatures (HFS), which lift a point cloud to a multiscale family of smooth ambient heat fields, providing a direct interface from discrete samples to geometric analysis.
  From this field, HFS computes closed-form global and local signatures directly from pairwise distances, capturing heat concentration, intrinsic dimension, anisotropy, and scale transitions. We further introduce the Heat Dimension Spectrum (HDS), a compact summary of multiscale geometric composition. HFS can be used as a closed-form descriptor, a lightweight learned representation, or a geometric feature channel for neural point-cloud models.
  Across synthetic and real-world benchmarks spanning subcellular, neuronal, tree, and protein data, HFS outperforms strong point-cloud and multiparameter-persistence baselines while substantially reducing end-to-end cost. On SCOP protein-fold classification, HFS improves over the strongest deep baseline by nearly $24$ percentage points using coordinates alone, while standalone HFS representations are exactly rotation-invariant by construction. More broadly, HFS turns a classical heat field into a practical interface for multiscale geometric analysis in modern point-cloud learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了热场签名（HFS），将点云提升为多尺度光滑环境热场家族，直接从成对距离计算全局和局部几何签名（热集中、内蕴维度、各向异性和尺度转换），并引入热维度谱（HDS）作为多尺度几何组成的紧凑摘要。HFS可作为闭式描述符、轻量学习表示或神经点云模型的几何特征通道，在多种基准上超越强基线且大幅降低端到端成本。
AI.motivation: 将多尺度几何分析直接应用于不规则点云仍然困难：局部维度、各向异性、密度变化和几何转换等量通常需要通过显式的邻域、流形或图构造来估计，或留给神经网络从坐标中推断，缺乏直接而高效的几何分析接口。
AI.method: HFS将点云提升为一个多尺度光滑环境热场家族，从该热场中直接利用成对距离计算闭式全局和局部签名，捕获热集中、内蕴维度、各向异性和尺度转换等几何信息；同时引入热维度谱（HDS）作为多尺度几何组成的紧凑摘要。HFS支持闭式描述符、轻量表示学习和几何特征通道三种使用方式。
AI.result: 在涵盖亚细胞、神经、树木和蛋白质数据的合成与真实基准上，HFS超越强点云和多参数持久性基线，同时大幅降低端到端成本；在SCOP蛋白质折叠分类上，HFS仅用坐标就将最强深度基线的准确率提升了近24个百分点，且独立的HFS表示天然具备旋转不变性。
AI.conclusion: HFS将经典热场转化为现代点云学习中多尺度几何分析的实用接口，证明了热场方法在不规则点云上的有效性和高效性，为点云几何分析提供了新范式。

title: GoAnt: Quality-Diversity Multi-Agent Search for Alpha Factor Discovery in Market Microstructure Data
comment: 14 pages, 1 figure, 8 tables, including supplementary appendices
summary: Automated alpha factor discovery searches symbolic trading signals from price-volume panels and order-book data under a fixed evaluation budget. Existing single- and multi-agent program-search systems can overfit predictive proxies that fail after execution costs and repeatedly explore redundant factor families, limiting execution robustness and behavioral diversity. We introduce GoAnt, a quality-diversity multi-agent search framework that combines non-communicating Explorer, Exploiter and Connector workers with a shared adaptive Mental Map and a compact Queen dispatcher. The Mental Map organizes candidates by leakage-free execution profiles and retains one elite per niche, while the Queen reallocates the evaluation budget from explicit search-state summaries. We also define a map-independent effective-yield protocol that counts high-quality, mutually nonredundant factors directly from each method's evaluation records, giving archive-based and map-free systems the same ruler. On real A-share microstructure data spanning 2023--2026, GoAnt reaches quality-weighted yields of 41.8 and 47.6 in price-volume and order-book settings, improving the strongest baseline by 57% and 97% under matched budgets. Its locked populations retain 0.64 and 0.67 of in-sample quality out of sample, compared with 0.61 and 0.63 for a static map.

title: Semi-Supervised Learning under Spatially Biased Sampling
comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables. Supplementary material included as an ancillary file
summary: Standard semi-supervised learning (SSL) typically relies on labelled and unlabelled data sharing a common marginal distribution. This assumption is often violated by biased spatial sampling mechanism, when labels are collected under spatially biased or preferential site selection. We treat this marginal mismatch, spatial autocorrelation, and spatial non-stationarity as three distinct mechanisms, varied independently via a labelled-sampling concentration parameter, a spatial length scale, and a non-stationarity strength parameter, and ask how mismatch degrades SSL, whether the cluster and manifold assumptions survive it, and how the resulting failure can be diagnosed. Using a controlled synthetic framework alongside PovertyMap-WILDS, California housing, socio-economic and US air quality monitoring datasets, we systematically vary the degree of mismatch while accounting for spatial autocorrelation and non-stationarity. Through a series of analyses including a segmented-regression changepoint, we show that in the synthetic generator, SSL performance does not degrade gradually but instead exhibits a threshold-like breakdown between approximately 0.71 and 0.77 once distribution mismatch becomes sufficiently severe. We further demonstrate that spatial non-stationarity contributes to performance loss independently of marginal mismatch and that models become increasingly overconfident outside the regions where labels are available. To support practical deployment, we evaluate several distribution-divergence measures as indicators of reliability and introduce a kernel-weighted local divergence metric that provides a more stable estimate of spatial mismatch than a naïve localised approach. These findings provide empirical evidence and diagnostic tools for better documenting the risk of incorporating unlabelled spatial data into semi-supervised learning workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了半监督学习(SSL)在空间偏倚标记采样下的失效机制，通过合成数据和多个真实空间数据集，发现SSL性能不会随分布失配逐渐退化，而是在失配严重度达到约0.71-0.77时出现阈值式崩溃，并提出了一种核加权局部散度度量作为空间失配的可靠诊断工具。
AI.motivation: 标准半监督学习假设有标签和无标签数据共享相同的边缘分布，但这一假设在空间偏倚采样（如优先选址）下常常被违背。现有研究缺乏对这种空间失配如何影响SSL性能的系统性理解，也缺乏相应的诊断工具。
AI.method: 作者将边缘失配、空间自相关和非平稳性作为三种独立机制，通过标签采样集中度参数、空间长度尺度和非平稳性强度的参数分别独立变化加以控制。采用合成框架加PovertyMap-WILDS、加州住房、社会经济和美国空气质量监控四个真实数据集，结合分段回归变点分析来系统评估SSL性能退化行为，并引入核加权局部散度度量来诊断空间失配。
AI.result: SSL性能并非逐渐退化而是表现出阈值式崩溃（变点位于约0.71-0.77之间）；空间非平稳性独立于边缘失配贡献性能损失；模型在标签可用区域之外越来越过度自信；所提出的核加权局部散度度量比朴素局部化方法提供了更稳定的空间失配估计。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为将无标签空间数据纳入SSL工作流提供了经验证据和诊断工具，强调需谨慎评估空间失配风险，并提出了可靠的分歧度量来支持实际部署中的可靠性评估。

title: Application of curiosity driven exploration methods for hardware interference identification
summary: The transition from single-core to multi-core architectures in safety-critical embedded systems introduces significant challenges due to inter-core interference caused by contention for shared hardware resources. Such interference affects execution times and complicates the verification of strict temporal requirements, particularly in domains such as avionics where standards require comprehensive identification of interference sources. Existing interference analysis approaches, whether manual or model-based, struggle to capture the full range of behaviors arising from the complex interactions among micro-architectural components. In this paper, we frame multi-core interference analysis as the exploration of a complex system behavior space. We propose the use of curiosity-driven exploration algorithms from artificial intelligence to systematically and efficiently cover the space of possible interference behaviors. Using a simulator-based environment, we show that the proposed approach achieves broader and more uniform behavioral coverage within a limited experimental budget compared to traditional pseudo-random program generation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将多核安全关键嵌入式系统的干扰分析建模为复杂系统行为空间探索问题，并采用人工智能中的好奇心驱动探索算法，在模拟器环境下系统且高效地覆盖可能的干扰行为，相比传统伪随机程序生成方法，在有限实验预算内实现了更广泛和更均匀的行为覆盖。
AI.motivation: 多核架构在安全关键嵌入式系统中的应用引入了共享硬件资源竞争导致的核间干扰，影响执行时间并使严格时间需求的验证复杂化，特别是在航空电子等标准要求全面识别干扰源的领域。现有手动或基于模型的干扰分析方法难以捕捉微架构组件复杂交互产生的全部行为。
AI.method: 将多核干扰分析框定为复杂系统行为空间的探索问题，采用人工智能中基于好奇心驱动的探索算法，在基于模拟器的环境中系统性地高效覆盖可能的干扰行为空间。
AI.result: 与传统的伪随机程序生成方法相比，该方法在有限的实验预算内实现了更广泛且更均匀的行为覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 好奇心驱动的AI探索算法有望显著提升多核干扰分析的覆盖效率和系统性，为安全关键系统的干扰源识别与验证提供新方法。

title: Solving the Elastic Wave Equation with Physics-Informed Neural Networks: A Robust and Critical Assessment
comment: Comments: 154 pages, 44 figures. Based on the Master's thesis of Davide Staub, ETH Zurich, March 2024. Original thesis: https://doi.org/10.3929/ethz-b-000668359
summary: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have recently emerged as a promising approach for solving Partial Differential Equations (PDEs), offering a meshfree alternative that integrates physical principles into the learning process. This presents a new paradigm compared to traditional discretization methods and purely data-driven machine learning techniques. While promising, PINNs are not a panacea; they inherit challenges such as spectral bias and unstable convergence. Moreover, their potential in seismology remains largely unexplored. In this work, we provide a robust and critical assessment of PINNs for solving the elastic wave equation in seismology. We investigate the performance of PINNs on problems with varying degrees of complexity across various seismic sources and parameter models, from constant to highly heterogeneous settings. A pivotal aspect of our work involves investigating whether embedding physical principles directly into the network architecture enhances convergence and accuracy. We test an extensive range of neural architecture designs, from unrestricted, uninformed PINNs to highly specialized ones. We find that integrating an understanding of wave physics into the network design significantly improves accuracy. For instance, introducing a custom wavelet or plane wave layer, coupled with encoder and decoder layers, consistently yields a relative $L_2$ error approximately half that of the standard PINN, as evidenced across numerous experiments. We further demonstrate that this novel architecture enhances accuracy when applied to the acoustic wave equation, underlying the versatility of our network. Another key contribution of our research is the successful conditioning of PINNs on seismic source locations. This signifies a considerable advancement towards rapid seismic hazard detection and seismic analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文对PINNs在求解弹性波方程中的性能进行了全面评估，发现将波动物理知识嵌入网络架构（如自定义小波/平面波层）可显著提高精度，相对L2误差约为标准PINN的一半，并在声波方程中验证了其通用性，同时在震源位置条件化方面取得了进展。
AI.motivation: PINNs作为一种有前景的PDE求解方法，在地震学中的应用尚未被充分探索，且存在谱偏差和收敛不稳定等挑战，需要对其在地震弹性波方程中的表现进行系统评估。
AI.method: 系统性地对PINNs在地震弹性波方程中的性能进行评估，测试从均匀到高度异质的多种介质模型和不同震源，比较从无物理信息到高度特化的多种神经网络架构，包括将波动物理原理直接嵌入网络架构的设计。
AI.result: 将波动物理知识嵌入网络架构（引入自定义小波层或平面波层并结合编码器-解码器层）可显著提高精度，相对L2误差约为标准PINN的一半；该架构在声波方程中同样有效，展示了其通用性；成功实现了对地震源位置的条件化。
AI.conclusion: 物理知识嵌入网络架构而非简单加入物理约束，能显著提升PINN求解地震波方程的精度与收敛性，并朝快速地震灾害检测和地震分析迈出了重要一步。

title: When Can One Obtain Certificates of Optimality Using Positivstellensaetze?
summary: We study certificates of positivity and optimality for learning problems whose objectives and constraints need not be polynomial. We isolate an axiomatic core of Fischer's constructive strict and weak Positivstellensätze and prove the resulting theorems for abstract function algebras over ordered fields. The framework separates two roles that can otherwise be conflated: objective and constraint functions may be built from broad classes of continuous or definable operations, while the auxiliary primitives used to construct a certificate satisfy explicit scalar and closure axioms. We give instances over continuous and definable function algebras, including ordered fields not closed under square roots, derive lower-bound and global-optimality certificates, and analyze both expanded term length and shared computation-graph complexity.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对目标和约束未必是多项式的学习问题，研究了正性证书与最优性证书。作者提取了Fischer构造性严格与弱Positivstellensätze的公理化核心，并在有序域上的抽象函数代数中证明了相应定理。该框架区分了目标/约束函数与辅助原语两个角色，前者可由广泛的连续或可定义运算构建，后者满足明确的标量与闭包公理。论文给出了连续与可定义函数代数上的实例（包括不闭合于平方根的有序域），推导了下界与全局最优性证书，并分析了展开项长度与共享计算图复杂度。
AI.motivation: 传统Positivstellensatz（如Fischer的构造性版本）通常局限于多项式函数，但实际学习问题中的目标函数和约束条件往往不限于多项式。作者希望扩展该理论，使其适用于更广泛的非多项式函数类别（如连续或可定义函数），同时保持证书构造性的优点，从而为更一般的优化与学习问题提供正性和最优性保证。
AI.method: 论文首先从Fischer的构造性严格和弱Positivstellensätze中提取公理化核心，然后在有序域上的抽象函数代数中证明所得定理。框架将目标/约束函数与证书构造所用的辅助原语分离：前者允许来自广泛的连续或可定义运算类别，后者需满足明确的标量与闭包公理。随后论文在连续函数代数和可定义函数代数上给出具体实例，包括不闭合于平方根的有序域情形，并推导下界与全局最优性证书。最后分析了两种复杂度度量：展开项长度与共享计算图复杂度。
AI.result: 论文成功构建了超出多项式范畴的正性与最优性证书理论框架，在抽象函数代数上证明了相应的构造性定理，并在连续及可定义函数代数上给出了具体实例，覆盖了不闭合于平方根的有序域。同时推导了学习问题的下界证书与全局最优性证书，并提供了解释两种证书构造代价的复杂度分析。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将Positivstellensatz方法系统性地推广到非多项式的学习问题场景，通过公理化抽象揭示了证书构造的核心机制，为更广泛函数类上的优化与学习提供了理论保障，并为后续研究证书构造的实效计算奠定了分析基础。

title: Automated Chest CT Protocol Selection via Large Language Model Derived Text Embeddings from Imaging Request Text
summary:
Purpose: Accurate CT protocol selection is critical for diagnostic quality and patient safety, yet the current process is manual, time-consuming, and prone to inconsistencies. Prior Machine Learning methods using keywords or bag-of-words lack contextual understanding and perform poorly on rare protocols. We propose a decision support system using large language model (LLM) features to recommend protocols from free-text clinical indications, capturing clinical nuance and phrasing variation for more consistent, efficient selection.
  Methods: In this REB-approved retrospective study, 285,123 chest CT imaging requests from a large academic medical center (2017-2024) were split into training (228,099, 80%) and held-out test (57,024, 20%) sets. Each request included procedure names, clinical indication, HIS comments, and the selected protocol. Clinical text was embedded using a fine-tuned LLM, Meta's LLaMA-3.1-70B; these features input a logistic regression classifier predicting 18 protocol labels (e.g., PE, LDCT).
  Results: The pipeline achieved a weighted precision of 0.84, weighted F1-score of 0.81, and overall accuracy of 79% across 18 CT protocols. On 300 independent cases with expert consensus, the LLM reached an overall accuracy of 80% versus 83% for radiologists, with no significant difference (p = 0.263). Performance was comparable across most classes, with the LLM exceeding radiologists for some challenging categories, and entropy analyses indicated more balanced protocol use, suggesting reduced variability.
  Conclusion: An LLM-based recommendation system can leverage general knowledge from a large natural-text corpus to accurately assign chest CT protocols from free-text imaging requests, and may serve as a viable foundation for protocol recommendation tools where inputs require language understanding.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种基于大语言模型（LLM）特征的决策支持系统，用于从自由文本临床适应症中推荐胸部CT扫描协议。系统使用微调的LLaMA-3.1-70B嵌入临床文本，再通过逻辑回归分类器预测18种CT协议标签。在28.5万+例数据上测试，加权F1分数达0.81，准确率79%，与放射科医生的表现无显著差异，表明该系统可作为CT协议推荐的有效基础工具。
AI.motivation: 当前CT协议选择依赖人工操作，耗时且容易出错。已有的基于关键词或词袋的机器学习方法缺乏上下文理解能力，对罕见协议表现差。需要一种能够理解临床语境和措辞变化的自动化决策支持系统。
AI.method: 使用285,123例胸部CT影像请求（2017-2024年），按80/20划分训练和测试集。每条请求包含程序名称、临床适应症、HIS备注和所选协议。使用微调的Meta LLaMA-3.1-70B对临床文本进行嵌入，将特征输入逻辑回归分类器，预测18种协议标签。
AI.result: 系统达到加权精确率0.84，加权F1分数0.81，整体准确率79%。在300例独立专家共识案例中，LLM准确率80%对比放射科医生83%，差异无统计学意义（p=0.263）。在某些具有挑战性的类别中LLM表现超过放射科医生，熵分析表明协议使用更均衡，变异性更低。
AI.conclusion: 基于LLM的推荐系统能够利用大型自然文本语料中的通用知识，从自由文本影像请求中准确分配胸部CT协议，可作为需要语言理解能力的协议推荐工具的有效基础。

title: It's All in the Way You Say It: The Role of Information Representation in LLM-Based Glycemic-Event Prediction
comment: Submitted to a journal for peer-review
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly being investigated for physiological time-series prediction, yet their effectiveness may depend not only on the model itself, but also on how physiological information is represented and presented at inference time. This study investigates prompt-based general-purpose LLMs for postprandial hyperglycemia and hypoglycemia prediction in individuals with type 1 diabetes. Using the OhioT1DM dataset, we evaluate multiple open-weight LLMs under zero-shot and few-shot inference across prediction horizons of 30, 60, and 90 minutes. The analysis varies both the textual representation of the available physiological information and the amount of information exposed to the model, ranging from glucose observations alone to derived descriptors and additional contextual variables related to insulin, meals, carbohydrates, and physical activity. Performance is compared with conventional patient-specific supervised models and with Gluco-LLM, a language-model-based architecture explicitly adapted to glucose time-series forecasting. Results show a marked task-dependent behavior. Conventional supervised models achieve the strongest performance for hyperglycemia prediction, whereas the best observed prompt-based LLM configurations improve performance for hypoglycemia across all investigated horizons. The effectiveness of prompt-based inference is also strongly influenced by how physiological information is represented, while providing additional contextual information does not lead to a systematic improvement. Overall, these findings highlight physiological information representation as a central design factor in prompt-based LLM approaches to glycemic-event prediction.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用OhioT1DM数据集，系统评估了基于提示的通用大语言模型（LLM）在1型糖尿病患者餐后高血糖和低血糖预测中的表现，比较了多种零样本/少样本推理配置与传统的患者特异性监督模型及专用Lluc-LLM架构的性能差异。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在生理时间序列预测中的有效性可能不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于生理信息在推理时如何被表征和呈现，然而目前缺乏对这一因素的系统性研究。
AI.method: 使用OhioT1DM数据集，对多个开源权重大语言模型在30/60/90分钟预测时域下进行零样本和少样本推理；变化生理信息的文本表征方式以及暴露给模型的信息量（从单一血糖观测到衍生描述符及胰岛素、饮食、碳水化合物、身体活动等上下文变量）；与传统患者特定监督模型及Gluco-LLM架构进行性能对比。
AI.result: 研究发现任务依赖性显著：传统监督模型在高血糖预测中表现最佳，而最优的基于提示的LLM配置在所有预测时域上均改善了低血糖预测的性能。生理信息的表征方式强烈影响提示推理的有效性，但增加额外的上下文信息并未带来系统性性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 生理信息的表征方式是基于提示的LLM血糖事件预测方法中的核心设计因素，值得在未来的模型设计和研究中加以重视。

title: HyCO: A Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Sequential reinforcement learning (RL) solvers and global diffusion model (DM) solvers for neural combinatorial optimization exhibit complementary failure modes under an optimization-regret view. The former enjoys small marginal regret in the early construction stage, but suffers from horizon-wise compounding errors with super-linear regret growth; the latter avoids horizon compounding but incurs linear or sublinear regret w.r.t. the dimension of the remaining unsolved subspace. We propose Hybrid Neural Solver for Combinatorial Optimization (HyCO), a hybrid inference algorithm that constructs a solution prefix with an RL solver and adaptively switches to a conditional DM to complete the remaining decisions. To characterize why such hybridization helps, when to trigger the handover, and how to realize it in practice, we first develop a unified error-scaling theoretical framework and prove that, under explicit error-scaling assumptions, i) the hybrid structure achieves strictly lower expected regret than either backbone alone, and ii) there exists a unique optimal trigger step that minimizes the hybrid regret. We then design a lightweight adaptive trigger that combines policy entropy and RL-DM disagreement to detect trajectory-level signals of the regime shift as a practical proxy, since the optimal trigger step is defined at the expected-regret level and is not directly computable on individual trajectories. Experimental results on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that HyCO achieves consistent improvements over both backbones and support the empirical effectiveness of adaptive triggering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HyCO，一种混合神经求解器，先使用强化学习（RL）求解器构建解的前缀，再自适应切换到条件扩散模型（DM）完成剩余决策，用于神经组合优化问题。理论证明该混合结构在期望遗憾上严格优于任一单独方法，并存在唯一最优切换步。实验表明HyCO在多种基准上一致优于两种基线。
AI.motivation: 序列强化学习求解器在早期构建阶段边际遗憾小，但存在随轨迹长度超线性增长的累积误差；全局扩散模型求解器避免了逐级累积问题，但遗憾随剩余未解子空间维度呈线性或亚线性增长。两种方法呈现互补的失败模式，作者希望利用这种互补性设计一种混合推理算法，以获得更好的优化性能。
AI.method: HyCO的推理过程为：先用RL求解器构建解的前缀，然后自适应地在某个切换步（handover step）切换到条件扩散模型来完成剩余决策。作者首先建立了统一的误差缩放理论框架，证明在显式误差缩放假设下混合结构能获得低于任一单独方法的期望遗憾，且存在唯一的最优切换步。由于最优切换步定义在期望遗憾层面，无法在单个轨迹上直接计算，作者设计了轻量的自适应触发机制，结合策略熵和RL-DM不一致性来检测轨迹级别的状态切换信号。
AI.result: 在多样化的基准测试上，HyCO相较于RL求解器和扩散模型求解器均取得一致的性能改进，实验结果也支持了自适应触发机制的有效性。理论上证明了混合结构具有更低期望遗憾以及唯一最优触发步的存在性。
AI.conclusion: 通过理论分析和实验验证，HyCO阐明了RL与扩散模型在神经组合优化中的互补性，并提供了实用的混合推理方案。该工作为理解何时与如何在RL和生成模型之间进行切换提供了统一的理论框架和有效的实践方法。

title: Closing the Consistency Gap: Self-Evolving Agents That Learn to Stay on Course
summary: Large language model (LLM)-powered agents can be accurate on average yet unreliable in production, a discrepancy that has been observed but remains largely unaddressed. When given the same task five times, a ReAct agent on the AppWorld benchmark using GPT-4.1 succeeds in all five runs only 53% of the time, even though its per-run pass rate averages 77%. We call this 24-point shortfall the consistency gap, and we argue that addressing it is a precondition for trustworthy AI agent deployment. We present a self-evolving agent framework that reduces this gap by identifying unstable, low-consistency steps in agent trajectories and converting them into episodic memory the agent can draw on in future runs. At its core is a Consistency Analyzer that pinpoints where and why a trajectory is likely to flip across executions, and a Guideline Generator that converts the diagnosis into targeted guidelines, committed to memory and injected into future agent executions on similar tasks. On AppWorld with ReAct/GPT-4.1, our framework raises the fraction of tasks that succeed in all five runs by +16 points on same-task evaluation and +13 points on similar-task generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自进化智能体框架，通过一致性分析器定位轨迹中的不稳定步骤并将其转化为情景记忆，显著缩小了LLM智能体在生产环境中的"一致性差距"（same-task一致成功率提升16个百分点，相似任务泛化提升13个百分点）。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体虽然平均准确率可观，但在生产环境中可靠性不足——同一任务执行五次仅53%能全部成功，而单次平均通过率却达77%，存在24个百分点的"一致性差距"。作者认为解决这一差距是可信AI智能体部署的前提条件，而此前这一问题虽有观察但未被系统解决。
AI.method: 提出一个自进化智能体框架，核心包含两个组件：(1) 一致性分析器（Consistency Analyzer），定位轨迹中在多次执行中可能翻转的低一致性步骤，并诊断出错原因；(2) 准则生成器（Guideline Generator），将诊断结果转化为针对性准则，提交到情景记忆并在未来相似任务的执行中注入。
AI.result: 在AppWorld基准上使用ReAct/GPT-4.1，该框架使五次执行全部成功的任务比例在same-task评估中提升16个百分点，在相似任务泛化中提升13个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过将不稳定步骤转化为可复用的情景记忆，该框架有效缩小了LLM智能体的一致性差距，为可信AI智能体的实际部署提供了可行路径。

title: Sharp Structure-Agnostic Minimax Risk for Partial Linear Models
summary: We characterize the sharp structure-agnostic minimax risk for coefficient estimation in the partial linear model when the outcome and treatment nuisances are learned by two distinct black-box learners, which resolves the open problem in double machine learning posed by Gu (2025). For each nuisance \(q\in\{μ,π\}\), we characterize the available learner by an approximation-error budget \(a_q\) and a stochastic-error budget \(s_q\), with the latter controlled through localized Rademacher complexity. Writing \(\mathcal E_n\) for the minimax mean-squared error, we show that \[\mathcal E_n\asymp1\wedge\left\{\frac1n+\left(a_μa_π+\min\left\{a_πs_μ+s_π^2,\,a_μs_π+s_μ^2\right\}\right)^2\right\}.\] The main new ingredient is a novel lower bound for the general two-learner problem. Our proof constructs four finite-mixture testing experiments using orthogonal code functions. Across these experiments, the hidden perturbations are placed outside both learner classes, outside only the treatment learner class, outside only the outcome learner class, or inside both learner classes. These four configurations capture, respectively, the interaction between the two approximation errors, the two asymmetric interactions between one learner's approximation error and the other learner's learning error, and the joint estimation difficulty of learning both nuisances. Combining the four resulting lower bounds yields the displayed rate, which matches the latest upper bound in Gu (2026). Our result shows that standard double machine learning can overstate the intrinsic difficulty of target estimation and provides a target-specific principle for learner selection: approximation error and stochastic complexity must be jointly balanced across the two nuisance learners rather than optimized separately.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了部分线性模型中系数估计的结构无关极小极大风险，解决了Gu(2025)提出的双机器学习开放问题。通过为两个黑箱学习者分别设置近似误差预算和随机误差预算，作者推导出极小极大MSE的精确率，并证明标准双机器学习可能高估目标估计的内在难度。
AI.motivation: 双机器学习（DML）框架中被估计的目标参数依赖于两个通过学习器拟合的扰动项，但此前缺乏对两个不同黑箱学习器组合误差的结构无关极小极大下界的刻画。Gu(2025)将此作为一个开放问题。
AI.method: 构造四个有限混合检验实验，使用正交编码函数在各实验中以不同方式放置隐藏扰动（两个学习者之外、仅治疗学习者之外、仅结果学习者之外、两者之内），分别捕捉两个近似误差的交互、不对称交互以及联合估计难度，从而得到新的一般双学习者问题的下界。
AI.result: 推导出极小极大均方误差的精确率为1∧{1/n+(a_μa_π+min{a_πs_μ+s_π², a_μs_π+s_μ²})²}，与Gu(2026)的最新上界匹配。
AI.conclusion: 标准双机器学习可能夸大了目标估计的内在难度；学习者选择应遵循目标特定原则——近似误差与随机复杂度须在两个扰动学习者之间联合平衡，而非分别独立优化。
