title: API Benchmark Scores Do Not Reliably Transfer to Chatbot Interfaces
summary:
Benchmark scores are a central currency in model releases: they inform purchasing decisions, shape public trust, and influence policy. Yet, a key assumption underlying benchmark scores is that the model performance measured through APIs faithfully reflects the behavior of deployed systems.
  We challenge this assumption by auditing ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across seven systems and nine benchmarks spanning general capability, social bias, and sycophancy. We find systematic API--interface differences in both accuracy and consistency. On average, API evaluations score 3.4 percentage points higher in accuracy and 2.1 percentage points higher in test--retest agreement than corresponding interface evaluations. For ChatGPT, the performance difference between API and interface access exceeds the API-only difference between GPT 5.3 and GPT 5.4. Put differently, switching access surfaces can degrade performance as much as downgrading a full model generation.
  We further test whether exposed API controls can reproduce interface behavior by varying system prompts, sampling parameters, and reasoning settings. These controls shift behavior in some cases but do not reliably eliminate the gap. Our findings document a context-validity gap: measurements obtained through APIs do not necessarily generalize to corresponding deployed interfaces, complicating the use of API evaluations as proxies for deployed systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过审计ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini七个系统、九个基准测试，发现API评估与界面评估之间存在系统性差异：API评估在准确性和一致性上均高于对应界面评估（分别高出3.4和2.1个百分点），且这种差异有时超过模型代际间的差距。调整API参数无法可靠消除这一"情境有效性差距"。
AI.motivation: 基准测试分数是模型发布的核心指标，影响购买决策、公众信任和政策制定。但前提假设——API测得的性能能忠实反映实际部署系统的行为——从未被严格验证。作者希望挑战这一假设。
AI.method: 对ChatGPT、Claude和Gemini共七个系统进行审计，涵盖九个基准测试（通用能力、社会偏见和谄媚行为），比较API访问与界面（UI）访问之间的准确性和一致性差异；并进一步测试API公开控制参数（系统提示、采样参数、推理设置）是否可复现界面行为。
AI.result: API评估平均比界面评估准确率高3.4个百分点，测试-重测一致性高2.1个百分点。对于ChatGPT，API与界面之间的性能差异甚至超过了GPT 5.3与5.4之间的API访问差异。调整API控制参数在部分情况下能改变行为，但无法可靠消除差距。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了"情境有效性差距"：通过API获得的测量结果不一定能推广到实际部署的界面环境中，这使API评估作为部署系统代理的有效性受到质疑。模型开发者、采购方和监管者不应将API基准分数视为界面行为的确切代表。

title: Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net: Coarse-Global and Local-Residual Representations for Artifact-Reduced PDE Operator Learning
summary: Localized dimensionality reduction improves the scalability of operator learning for high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs), but independently decoded local patches can introduce block offsets, interface mismatches, and spurious high-wavenumber content. We introduce Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net, which decomposes the solution into a coarse-global component and local residual corrections. A compact global PCA basis captures domain-scale structure, while nonoverlapping local PCA bases represent the remaining fine-scale residual. A block-balanced latent objective couples the two representations, and optional interface-aware fine-tuning further promotes continuity through reconstruction and trace losses. On Poisson benchmarks, the two-scale representation substantially reduces reconstruction error and visible block artifacts relative to plain and overlap-based localized PCA-Net while approximately halving PCA fitting cost relative to overlap. On heterogeneous Darcy flow, it strongly reduces interface and discrete-residual errors, with more modest reconstruction gains. Ablations show that the primary improvement arises from the two-scale output representation, while interface-aware fine-tuning provides complementary continuity refinement. Overall, separating globally coherent structure from localized residual detail provides an efficient representation for artifact-reduced PDE operator learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net方法，将PDE解分解为粗粒度全局分量和局部残差修正，通过紧凑全局PCA基捕捉全域结构、非重叠局部PCA基表示细尺度残差，并引入块平衡潜在目标和可选界面感知微调来减少局部解码带来的块偏移和界面错配伪影。在泊松和异质达西流基准上显著降低重构误差和伪影。
AI.motivation: 局部降维虽然能提升高维PDE算子学习的高可扩展性，但独立解码的局部块会引入块偏移、界面错配和虚假高波数内容，亟需一种既能保持局部可扩展性又能消除伪影的表征方法。
AI.method: 将解分解为粗全局分量（紧凑全局PCA基）与局部残差修正（非重叠局部PCA基）；通过块平衡潜在目标耦合两种表征，并采用可选的界面感知微调（重构损失与迹损失）增强连续性。
AI.result: 在泊松基准上，双尺度表征显著降低重构误差和可见块伪影，并将PCA拟合成本相比重叠方案降低约一半；在异质达西流上大幅降低界面误差和离散残差误差，重构增益较温和。消融表明主要改进来源于双尺度输出表征，界面感知微调提供互补的连续性细化。
AI.conclusion: 将全局相干结构与局部残差细节分离，为低伪影PDE算子学习提供了高效的表征方案。

title: SkillAdam: Stable and Efficient Skill Evolution for Agents
summary: Agent skills provide a lightweight way to equip frozen language-model agents with domain knowledge and procedural guidance, yet obtaining high-quality skills remains costly and difficult to scale. Expert-written skills require substantial human effort. Recent skill self-evolution methods automate an iterative loop that uses execution feedback to revise skills, but their heuristic update strategies often yield unstable optimization and low iteration efficiency. We identify two challenges in realizing stable and efficient skill self-evolution. Direction Stability requires effective corrections to accumulate rather than be overwritten by iteration-local feedback. Update Adaptivity requires the scope of each revision to reflect the consistency of recent case-level improvements. We introduce SkillAdam, an Adam-inspired framework for optimizing discrete and non-differentiable skill documents. As a functional analogue of Adam's first moment, an optimization memory records identified problems and the outcomes of prior solution attempts to stabilize the update direction. As a functional analogue of Adam's second moment, a volatility-driven edit budget tracks the history-weighted variation of recent case-level improvements and adaptively controls the update magnitude. Across seven benchmarks that span short- and long-horizon tasks, SkillAdam achieves state-of-the-art performance with more stable optimization dynamics. It also obtains stronger skills with substantially fewer optimization iterations and lower cost than prior methods. Code repository: https://github.com/ruc-datalab/SkillAdam

AI.tldr: 本文提出SkillAdam框架，借鉴Adam优化器的思想来优化离散且不可微的技能文档，通过优化记忆和波动驱动的编辑预算分别实现方向稳定性和更新自适应性，在七个基准测试上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能获取成本高昂且难以规模化。专家编写技能需要大量人力；现有技能自进化方法使用启发式更新策略，导致优化不稳定、迭代效率低。
AI.method: 提出SkillAdam框架，将Adam优化器的两个核心概念类比到技能文档优化中：1）第一矩（优化记忆）：记录已识别的问题和先前解决方案的结果，稳定更新方向；2）第二矩（波动驱动的编辑预算）：跟踪近期案例改进的历史加权变化，自适应控制更新幅度。
AI.result: 在涵盖短程和长程任务的七个基准测试中，SkillAdam取得最先进性能，优化动态更稳定，且以显著更少的优化迭代和更低成本获得更强的技能。
AI.conclusion: SkillAdam验证了将连续优化器思想迁移到离散技能文档优化的可行性，为解决技能自进化的稳定性和效率问题提供了有效方案。

title: Risk-Conditioned Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings where rare but severe harmful generations can have significant consequences. Existing Risk-Averse RLHF addresses this issue by optimizing Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR), but it trains policies for fixed risk levels and therefore cannot adjust the desired degree of risk aversion at inference time. In this paper, we propose risk-conditioned RLHF, a framework that trains a single policy that provides a continuous risk-control interface, enabling users to select different degrees of risk aversion without retraining or deploying multiple risk-specific models. Experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that a single risk-conditioned policy can adapt to different risk levels at inference time, enabling more flexible and risk-aware LLM deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出风险条件化RLHF框架，通过训练单一策略提供连续的风险控制接口，使用户能在推理时灵活调整风险厌恶程度，无需重新训练或部署多个风险专用模型。
AI.motivation: 现有风险厌恶RLHF（基于CVaR优化）为固定风险级别训练策略，无法在推理时调整风险厌恶程度，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 提出风险条件化RLHF框架，训练单一策略使其携带连续的风险控制参数，在推理时可根据用户需求动态选择不同的风险厌恶程度。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上的实验表明，单一风险条件化策略能够在推理时适应不同风险级别，实现更灵活和风险感知的大语言模型部署。
AI.conclusion: 风险条件化RLHF使单一策略即可应对多样化风险偏好需求，提高了LLM部署的灵活性和风险可控性。

title: PlannerForge: LLM Agents for Scenario-Based Testing of Motion Planners in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 35 pages including appendix
summary: Ensuring the safety of autonomous driving is a critical challenge. Scenario-based testing is a systematic process used to validate Autonomous Driving Systems (ADSs), but it remains a fragmented modular pipeline in which scenario generation, retrieval, modification, ADS execution, and results analysis are performed by separate tools with little interaction. Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise across ADS sub-systems such as perception, planning, and control. However, no prior work covers the whole scenario-based testing pipeline for ADSs with a unified LLM-agent framework. We present PlannerForge, an LLM-agent framework that extends all scenario-based testing stages (from Scenario Generation to ADS Assessment) and adds two further LLM-enhanced stages: ADS Enhancement and ADS Benchmarking. We evaluate PlannerForge with 10 off-the-shelf LLMs across all tasks (Generation, Selection, Modification, Module Routing, Planner Testing, and Enhancement) under 5 prompt conditions. Best-per-task scores range from 0.88 to 1.00, and open-source 20-35B backends match commercial APIs on most tasks. Open-source models such as Qwen3.6:35B match commercial APIs on three of the five tasks. Chaining the modules end-to-end retains 83% / 78% of seed queries (commercial / open). It outperforms Scenario Factory 2.0 (Finkeldei et al., 2025) on natural-language generation (193 vs. 144 executable of 200) and realises 92-96% of requested city, road and vehicle attributes. It outperforms BM25 (Robertson and Zaragoza, 2009) at rank 1 selection (92.0% vs. 67.5%) and From-Words-to-Collisions (Gao et al., 2025) on physically valid edits (>=94% vs. 31%). At N=400, cost-tuning lifts planner success from 50.4% to 70.2% and cuts collisions from 19.0% to 8.4%, without domain-specific fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: PlannerForge是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）智能体的统一框架，覆盖自动驾驶系统（ADS）基于场景测试的全流程（从场景生成到ADS评估），并新增ADS增强与ADS基准测试两个阶段。该框架通过链式模块在10种LLM和5种提示条件下进行评估，在各项任务上取得优异性能，并证明开源模型在多数任务上可媲美商业API。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶安全性验证至关重要，现有基于场景的测试方法是一个碎片化的模块化流水线，各阶段（场景生成、检索、修改、ADS执行和结果分析）由独立工具完成，缺乏统一交互。尽管LLM智能体在ADS各子系统（感知、规划、控制）中已展现潜力，但尚无工作以统一的LLM智能体框架覆盖整个场景测试流水线。
AI.method: PlannerForge是一个LLM智能体框架，扩展了场景测试的所有阶段（从场景生成到ADS评估），并新增两个LLM增强阶段：ADS增强（Enhancement）和ADS基准测试（Benchmarking）。研究使用10种现成LLM对生成、选择、修改、模块路由、规划器测试和增强等所有任务进行评估，在5种提示条件下完成测试。
AI.result: 各项最佳任务得分范围为0.88至1.00；开源20-35B模型在大多数任务上匹敌商业API，如Qwen3.6:35B在五个任务中的三个不逊于商业API。端到端模块链保留了83%（商业）/78%（开源）的种子查询。在自然语言场景生成上超越Scenario Factory 2.0（193对144个可执行场景/200个），实现了92-96%的城市、道路和车辆属性需求；在rank-1选择上超越BM25（92.0%对67.5%）；在物理有效编辑上超越From-Words-to-Collisions（≥94%对31%）。在N=400时，成本调优将规划器成功率从50.4%提升至70.2%，碰撞率从19.0%降至8.4%，且无需领域特定微调。
AI.conclusion: PlannerForge证明了一种统一的LLM智能体框架可以端到端地支撑ADS场景测试全流程，不仅覆盖传统测试阶段，还能通过LLM增强ADS能力和进行基准测试。开源LLM能够匹敌商业API的性能，为降低成本和推广该框架提供了可能。

title: A Machine Learning Framework for Predicting Restaurant Food Waste to Support Sustainable Food Management
comment: 6 pages, 6 figures. Accepted and presented at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Information, Communication and Systems (SPICSCON 2026). Accepted for publication in the conference proceedings
summary: Food waste in the restaurant sector poses a substantial challenge to environmental sustainability and economic efficiency. This paper presents an exploratory machine learning framework for estimating daily restaurant food waste quantities from operational and contextual features. A structured dataset was constructed by integrating restaurant demand records, meteorological data and temporal event indicators, yielding 77,980 records across 27 features. Because large-scale ground-truth food waste measurements are not publicly available, the target variable was derived from operationally justified assumptions, with the complete construction formula and controlled stochastic variability disclosed for full reproducibility. Four supervised regression models, namely Linear Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest and Gradient Boosting, were evaluated under a chronological 70-30 train-test split that respects the temporal ordering of restaurant operations, augmented by 5-fold time-series cross-validation. All reported metrics are explicitly scoped to performance against the constructed target and do not imply validation against measured food waste. Ensemble methods consistently outperformed linear baselines. Random Forest attained an MAE of 6.19 kg, RMSE of 8.36 kg and $R^2$ of 0.817 on the realistic feature subset following systematic exclusion of algebraically leakage-prone variables. Feature importance analysis identified menu diversity, operational area and temporal activity patterns as the primary predictive drivers. The full dataset, target construction formula, codebase and experimental configurations are publicly released to support reproducibility and future extension to empirically measured waste data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于机器学习的探索性框架，用于从运营和情境特征估算餐厅每日食物浪费量。研究整合了餐厅需求记录、气象数据和事件指标，构建了77,980条记录、27个特征的公开数据集。由于缺乏真实的食物浪费测量数据，目标变量基于运营假设构造生成。在四种回归模型（线性回归、决策树、随机森林、梯度提升）的评估中，集成方法显著优于线性基线，其中随机森林在去除泄漏变量后达到MAE 6.19 kg、RMSE 8.36 kg、R² 0.817的最佳性能。菜单多样性、运营面积和时间活动模式是主要预测因子。
AI.motivation: 餐厅部门的食物浪费对环境的可持续性和经济效率构成重大挑战。但由于大规模的真实食物浪费测量数据不公开可得，现有研究缺乏系统性的估算方法，因此需要构建一个可复现的机器学习框架来估算餐厅每日食物浪费量，为后续环境管理提供数据驱动的决策支持。
AI.method: 本研究采用探索性机器学习框架。首先，整合餐厅需求记录、气象数据和时空事件指标构建结构化数据集（77,980条记录、27个特征）；其次，因无公开真实浪费数据，目标变量基于运营上合理的假设推导生成，并公开完整构造公式和受控随机变化以保证可复现性；最后，评估了线性回归、决策树、随机森林和梯度提升四种监督回归模型，采用尊重时间顺序的70-30时间序列划分并辅以5折时间序列交叉验证，同时系统性排除了代数泄漏变量。
AI.result: 集成方法在性能上持续优于线性基线。在排除泄漏变量后的现实特征子集上，随机森林模型取得了最佳效果：MAE为6.19 kg，RMSE为8.36 kg，R²为0.817。此外，特征重要性分析表明菜单多样性、运营面积和时间活动模式是主要的预测驱动因素。所有指标均明确界定为针对构造目标的性能，不代表与实测食物浪费的验证结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了基于运营和情境特征利用机器学习估算餐厅食物浪费量的可行性，随机森林模型展示了良好的预测能力。但需强调，结果仅对构造的目标有效，不能视为实际浪费量的验证。全套数据集、目标构造公式、代码及实验配置已公开发布，为未来在实测浪费数据上的扩展研究奠定了基础。

title: Good Pretraining, Bad SFT: Checkpoint Quality Across the Training Stack
summary: Language-model checkpoints are commonly selected by pretraining loss or benchmark scores, assuming that the highest-scoring checkpoint will remain the best starting point for subsequent training. We show that this assumption can fail in a full 30B mixture-of-experts training pipeline. The checkpoints that perform better after the full downstream training stack also have higher solution density, i.e., retain downstream performance under local weight perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在完整的30B混合专家（MoE）训练流程中，以预训练损失或基准分数选择语言模型检查点的常见做法可能失效——最终下游训练效果更好的检查点并非总是预训练时得分最高的，但这些更好的检查点具有更高的"解密度"（在局部权重扰动下仍能保持下游性能）。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常假设预训练损失或基准分数最高的检查点就是后续训练的最佳起点，但作者通过实验质疑这一假设是否在完整的训练流水线中始终成立。
AI.method: 作者在完整的30B混合专家（MoE）训练流水线中进行实证研究，比较不同检查点在经过完整下游训练栈后的表现，并引入"解密度"概念——即检查点在局部权重扰动下仍能保持下游性能的能力，用以区分最佳检查点。
AI.result: 实验表明，预训练分数最高的检查点在完整下游训练后并不一定表现最好；而最终表现更优的检查点具有更高的解密度，即在局部权重扰动下仍能保留下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 选择检查点时应考虑其解密度（对权重扰动的鲁棒性）而非僅依赖预训练损失或基准分数，因为高解密度的检查点才是后续下游训练的更好起点。

title: Proactive Context-Forecasted Safety Constraints for Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning
comment: 16 pages, 7 figures. Accepted at the 5th Conference on Lifelong Learning Agents (CoLLAs 2026)
summary:
Ensuring safety in reinforcement learning under nonstationarity requires anticipating changes in risk before they lead to unsafe behavior. Existing approaches typically rely on safety constraints defined at design time or updated reactively during execution, assuming that such constraints remain valid over time. However, in nonstationary environments with evolving contexts and changing driving layouts, these assumptions may fail.
  We propose a framework for proactive safety constraint generation based on context forecasting. The approach infers latent environmental context from observations, predicts its future evolution, and constructs safety constraints adapted to anticipated conditions. This enables the agent to proactively avoid unsafe regions instead of reacting only after safety violations occur.
  We evaluate the method in driving environments with structured context variation. The experiments include a sweep over nonstationarity intensities and additional held-out driving layouts, including highway, intersection, and racetrack scenarios. Results show that proactive constraint generation substantially reduces collisions under both seen and out-of-training nonstationarity intensities and generally remains effective across held-out driving layouts while maintaining usable task performance. These findings suggest that context-based constraint generation is a promising approach for safe reinforcement learning under nonstationarity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于上下文预测的前瞻性安全约束生成框架，用于强化学习在非平稳环境下的安全控制。该方法通过推断潜在环境上下文并预测其未来演变，动态生成适应预期条件的安全约束，使智能体能够提前规避危险区域，而非仅在违规发生后被动反应。实验在驾驶环境中验证，结果显示该方法能显著减少碰撞且保持可用任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法在非平稳环境下的安全约束通常在设计阶段固定或运行中被动更新，假设约束随时间保持有效。然而在环境上下文不断演变、驾驶布局变化的非平稳场景中，这些假设往往失效，导致智能体无法在风险升级前采取预防措施。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于上下文预测的前瞻性安全约束生成框架，包含三个步骤：(1)从观测中推断潜在的环境上下文特征；(2)预测上下文的未来演化趋势；(3)根据预期条件动态生成自适应安全约束。这使得智能体能够提前规避不安全区域，而非在安全违规发生后被动做出反应。
AI.result: 在包含结构化上下文变化的驾驶环境中进行实验，涵盖非平稳性强度扫描以及高速公路、交叉口和赛道等测试布局。结果表明，所提方法在训练内及训练外（未见过的）非平稳性强度下均能显著降低碰撞率，并在各测试布局中保持有效性，同时维持可用的任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 基于上下文预测的安全约束生成是应对非平稳环境下安全强化学习的一个有前景的方向，能够实现前瞻性的风险规避，为实际复杂动态场景中的安全决策提供了新的解决思路。

title: Deposon: An Auditable, Conservation-Guaranteed, Game-Theoretically Tested Scattering Layer over LLM Reasoning Paths
comment: 23 pages, 5 figures. Author affiliation: School of Chemistry and Life Resources, Renmin University of China. Code: https://github.com/zeroandcat/Deposon
summary: Multi-step LLM reasoning lacks a machine-recheckable ledger: discarded reasoning paths leave no auditable record. We propose the Deposon scattering layer, which binds each node of an LLM-generated concept-decomposition graph to a two-parameter Deposon state; paths undergo three-channel scattering -- transmission, reflection, irreversible dissipation -- obeying T+R+A=1 for arbitrary parameters, with a maximum per-path energy-audit deviation of 2.2E-16 (machine epsilon). We report all three evidence tiers honestly. On synthetic trap benchmarks the path-filtering gain is closed (pre-registered): unified reaches 100% versus a decoy-capture baseline at 7%/10%. On real benchmarks the layer is indistinguishable from a trivial six-keyword rule filter (GSM8K 0.87 >= 0.85, McNemar p=0.5; StrategyQA 0.899 = 0.899); no difference is detected here, so we sharpen the claim to "the differential value lies solely in machine verifiability." Fusion yields a second negative result: convex combinations with a semantic prior never improve (physics 0.484 -> 0.452), and the apparent lambda=2 gain is an anti-field artifact; any fusion gain must be nonlinear. Modeling the reverse dynamics as a potential game on the graph, we evidence an auditable scalar's monotonicity and near-gradientness and quantify the empirical coordination ratio (ECR). The three formalized dynamical-equivalence propositions (P1a/P1b/T-P1c) are falsified under the pre-registered kill protocol, and the potential-game claim is downgraded to approximate (cyclic-graph median residual 0.669): only consistency-level evidence survives at the dynamical level. Code: github.com/zeroandcat/Deposon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Deposon散射层，为LLM多步推理的每个概念分解图节点绑定可审计的Deposon状态，通过T+R+A=1的三通道散射实现路径级能量审计。作者诚实地报告了三类证据：合成陷阱基准上滤波增益关闭（100% vs 7%/10%），真实基准上该层与六关键词规则过滤器无显著差异，融合尝试产生负结果，动力学校准命题（P1a/P1b/T-P1c)均被预注册kill协议证伪。
AI.motivation: LLM多步推理缺乏机器可复查的账本——被丢弃的推理路径留有不可审计的记录，这阻碍了推理过程的验证与可信度提升。
AI.method: 提出Deposon散射层：将LLM生成的概念分解图每个节点绑定双参数Deposon状态，路径经历透射、反射、不可逆耗散三种散射通道（T+R+A=1），传播误差达机器精度；同时将逆向动力学建模为图上的势博弈，量化经验协调比（ECR）。
AI.result: 合成陷阱基准：统一方法达100%，诱饵捕获基线仅7%/10%。真实基准：与六关键词规则过滤器不可区分（GSM8K 0.87≥0.85, McNemar p=0.5；StrategyQA 0.899=0.899），因此将声明锐化为"差异价值仅在于机器可验证性"。融合产生负结果：凸组合从未改善，λ=2增益被证明是反场伪影。三个动力学校准命题被证伪，势博弈声明降级为近似（中位残差0.669）。
AI.conclusion: Deposon层在真实基准上的增量价值不在推理精度而在于机器可验证性；动力学层面的势博弈声明仅存一致性级别证据。

title: Learning Metamaterial Eigenmodes with Wavelet-Encoded Fourier Neural Operators
summary: Machine learning surrogates based on neural operators have shown broad applicability in solving forward PDE problems. However, eigenvalue problems, in which an eigenparameter and one of several valid eigenmodes must be simultaneously solved, remain difficult because standard operator learning formulations assume a unique input-output map. This work demonstrates that Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs), combined with wavelet-based encodings of PDE inputs, can learn and predict multiple eigenmodes of the elastic wave equation, corresponding to deformation modes of acoustic waves propagating through arbitrary metamaterial geometries. We provide a mechanistic explanation and experimental evidence for why wavelet encodings are well matched to the dual spatial-spectral structure of the FNO, enabling deterministic mode selection on both continuous-valued and binary-valued geometries within a single model, and for why prediction accuracy varies with geometric discontinuities. For metamaterial design, the resulting surrogate accelerates the simulation stage of the design cycle by three orders of magnitude relative to finite element analysis on a consumer-grade CPU, while preserving high fidelity. These results also carry broader implications for designing input encodings in other multi-mode PDE solvers based on spectral neural operators.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了将傅里叶神经算子（FNO）与小波编码相结合，能够同时学习并预测弹性波方程在任意超材料几何结构中的多个特征模态（变形模式），相比有限元分析提速三个数量级且保持高精度。
AI.motivation: 特征值问题需要同时求解特征参数和多个有效特征模态，而标准的算子学习框架假设输入-输出映射是唯一的，因此难以直接应用于此类问题。作者旨在克服这一局限性，使神经算子能够预测多模态解。
AI.method: 将小波编码用于表示偏微分方程的输入几何，并与傅里叶神经算子（FNO）相结合，利用小波编码的双重空间-频谱结构与FNO的频谱学习特性相匹配，从而实现连续值及二值化几何上的确定性模态选择。
AI.result: 在单个模型中成功预测弹性波方程的多重特征模态；预测精度对几何不连续性的敏感性得到解释；与有限元分析相比，在消费级CPU上实现了三个数量级的加速，同时保持高保真度。
AI.conclusion: 小波编码与谱域神经算子的组合为解决多模态PDE问题提供了有效范式，其思路对设计其他基于谱神经算子的多模态PDE求解器的输入编码方式具有更广泛的启示意义。

title: Answer-Distribution Trajectories: A Stochastic-Dynamics View of LLM Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought reasoning provides a structured computation between a model's input and final answer. Yet it is often evaluated through endpoint accuracy, which ignores the path taken to reach that answer. An emerging line of work addresses this limitation using entropy profiles, which track how uncertainty evolves over the reasoning process but do not reveal which competing hypotheses account for that uncertainty. We introduce answer-distribution trajectories, a stochastic-dynamics-inspired representation that tracks the model's full predictive distribution over answers as reasoning unfolds. As a strictly finer representation than endpoint and entropy summaries, answer-distribution trajectories enable us to characterize a trace through a dynamical reasoning profile spanning exploration, revision, motion, and commitment, and to distinguish different dynamical mechanisms of reasoning success and failure. Across sixteen open-weight language models and four reasoning benchmarks, we show that traces with the same endpoint and similar entropy profiles can exhibit substantially different reasoning dynamics. We further find substantial variation in these dynamics both within and across models and tasks, with different objectives favoring different dynamical profiles. Additionally, we show that training and inference choices systematically reshape these profiles. Our results suggest that answer-distribution trajectories provide a rich framework for analysing and evaluating the dynamics of LLM reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"答案分布轨迹"（answer-distribution trajectories）这一方法，通过追踪模型在推理过程中对答案的完整预测分布，揭示推理的动态机制。相比仅看最终准确率和熵曲线，该方法能更细粒度地区分探索、修正、移动和承诺等不同推理模式，并在16个开放权重模型和4个推理基准上展示了端点与熵相同但动态机制截然不同的推理痕迹。
AI.motivation: 现有链式思维推理评估大多依赖端点准确率，忽略了推理路径本身的信息。虽然熵曲线能追踪推理过程中的不确定性演变，但无法揭示哪些竞争性假设导致了这些不确定性，因此对推理动态的理解仍不充分。
AI.method: 引入受随机动力学启发的"答案分布轨迹"表示方法，在推理过程中每一步都记录模型对答案的完整预测分布，将其视为一个动态过程来刻画推理轨迹。基于该表示定义推理的动态特征，涵盖探索、修改、移动和承诺等维度，用于区分推理成功与失败的不同动态机制。
AI.result: 在16个开放权重语言模型和4个推理基准上，发现具有相同端点和相似熵曲线的推理痕迹可展现出显著不同的推理动态；推理动态在模型内部及模型之间、任务之间均存在可观差异；不同优化目标偏好不同的动态特征；训练和推理选择会系统性重塑这些动态模式。
AI.conclusion: 答案分布轨迹为分析和评估大语言模型推理动态提供了更丰富的框架，超越了端点准确率和熵曲线所能提供的信息。

title: Nyström Attention Matches Full Attention for Cross-Sectional Stock Prediction
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. A short version is under review at the TS-LIMITS workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: MASTER's inter-stock multi-head attention -- the module responsible for modeling cross-sectional stock relationships -- accounts for 42.5% of model parameters and 25% of predictive value. We systematically decompose this module and uncover a surprising structure: the learned attention is near-uniform (perplexity 278/300), yet forcing exact uniformity eliminates all cross-sectional discrimination. Spectral analysis resolves this paradox: the deviation from uniformity is low-rank (effective rank ~65, top-10 modes capture 96.5% of energy), explaining why sparse approximations consistently fail while Nystrom low-rank attention (m=32 landmarks) matches full O(N^2) attention at O(mN) cost -- certified equivalent via TOST at both N=300 (5 seeds, Rank IC p=0.003) and N=800 (10 seeds, Rank IC p=0.034). Additional findings include: (i) attention anti-correlates with return similarity (Spearman rho = -0.614; on the industry-labeled subset, -0.645 unconditionally and -0.627 after controlling for industry, beta, and volatility), suggesting complementarity-seeking rather than correlation mining; (ii) all graph-based alternatives degrade performance, with hard masking worse than complete module removal; and (iii) at N ~ 3,500 with adapted architectures, no cross-stock module (GCN, Nystrom, or MASTER-style pipeline) significantly outperforms a per-stock LSTM baseline (n=4 seeds), indicating that the benefits observed at smaller scales do not trivially transfer. These results establish that the inter-stock attention's value resides in a compressible, dynamic, near-global redistribution that rewards low-rank approximation but resists sparsification.

AI.tldr: 本文系统拆解了MASTER股票间多头注意力模块（占参数量42.5%、预测价值25%），发现其注意力近似均匀但微小的低秩偏差（有效秩~65，前10个模态捕获96.5%能量）才是价值所在。Nyström低秩注意力（m=32）在O(mN)成本下匹配全量O(N²)注意力，而稀疏近似和图方法均告失败。此外，注意力与收益相似性负相关（揭示互补性寻求而非相关性挖掘），且在N~3500的大规模场景中所有跨股票模块均不优于单股票LSTM基线。
AI.motivation: 理解跨股票注意力模块为何有效及其内在结构，解决"近似均匀的注意力如何具有判别力"这一悖论，并为高效近似方法的选型提供理论依据。
AI.method: 系统分解MASTER的跨股票多头注意力模块，结合谱分析（有效秩、能量分布）、均匀性逼近期实验、Nyström低秩注意力替换、TOST等价性检验、规模扩展实验（N=300至3500）、图替代方法对比及可控相关性分析等多种手段。
AI.result: 注意力与均匀性的偏差是低秩的（有效秩~65，前10模态占96.5%能量），Nyström方法（m=32）在N=300和N=800下通过TOST认证等价于全注意力；注意力与收益相似性显著负相关；所有图方法均降低性能；在N~3500时跨股票模块无法超越单股票LSTM基线。
AI.conclusion: 跨股票注意力的价值在于一种可压缩、动态、近全局的重分配机制，该机制偏好低秩近似但抗拒稀疏化；其优势在极大股票数量下可能消失，架构规模需谨慎适配。

title: Time-Varying Data as Sheaves: an Invitation to Narratives
summary: Modern science and engineering increasingly rely on time-varying data, yet the mathematical tools used to model temporal phenomena are often developed within separate disciplines, obscuring common principles and limiting the transfer of ideas across fields. This chapter presents the theory of narratives, an abstract framework for time-varying objects of any mathematical kind that supports both theoretical investigations and applications. To illustrate this perspective, the chapter develops three vignettes, each illustrating a different research direction. The first addresses a general concern: What information loss can occur when switching between different representations of temporal data? The second concerns structural and algorithmic approaches: How can we systematically decompose time-varying data into simple pieces and obtain invariants describing its structural complexity? The third is an application to control theory: How can we model multi-agent systems with switching communication topologies? More important than any individual vignette, the central message of this invitation is that a suitable abstract perspective can organize and guide research across remarkably diverse mathematical and scientific domains.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"叙事理论"（theory of narratives），一个用于建模任意数学类型时变对象的抽象框架，并通过三个研究方向的范例（信息损失、结构分解与不变量、多智能体控制）展示该框架如何跨领域组织和指导研究。
AI.motivation: 现代科学与工程越来越依赖时变数据，但时间现象建模的数学工具往往在不同学科中孤立发展，掩盖了共同原理并限制了思想跨领域转移，因此需要一个统一的抽象框架来组织时变对象的研究。
AI.method: 作者提出叙事理论——一个适用于任意数学种类时变对象的抽象框架，并通过三个"小插曲"（vignettes）说明其应用：一是研究不同时变数据表示之间转换时的信息损失；二是系统地分解时变数据为简单片段并获取描述结构复杂性的不变量；三是将框架应用于具有切换通信拓扑的多智能体系统的控制理论建模。
AI.result: 三个范例分别从表示转换的信息论、结构分解与算法不变量、以及控制理论三个角度验证了叙事理论框架的适用性；更重要的是，演示了抽象视角能够统一并指导跨不同数学与科学领域的研究。
AI.conclusion: 本章的核心信息是：合适的抽象视角可以组织并指导跨越多种数学与科学领域的时变研究，叙事理论正是这样一个起到桥梁作用的元框架。

title: Sparse Data Augmentation for Optimization with Provable Guarantees
comment: 32 pages, 1 figure. Published at IEEE CDC 2026
summary: In nonconvex optimization problems arising in geometric machine learning, data augmentation is commonly used to promote invariance by averaging empirical losses over transformations of the data. Computing the fully augmented objective, however, requires access to every element of the transformation group $G$, which may be prohibitively expensive when $G$ is large or accessible only through sampling. We study whether full augmentation can instead be approximated using a small, fixed sample of transformations acquired before optimization and reused thereafter. Under suitable regularity conditions, we show that, with probability at least $1-δ$, gradient descent (GD) on the resulting sparsely augmented objective returns an $\varepsilon$-stationary point of the fully augmented objective using $\mathcal{O}\bigl((\log |G|+\log(1/δ))/\varepsilon^2\bigr)$ group-transformation-oracle queries. By comparison, standard group stochastic gradient descent (group-SGD), which samples a fresh transformation at every iteration, uses $\mathcal{O}(1/\varepsilon^4)$ transformation queries. Therefore, gradient descent with fixed sparse augmentation requires fewer transformation queries than both GD applied to the fully augmented objective and group-SGD. Our proof techniques, which may be of independent interest, establish a uniform approximation of the full group-averaged gradient field by a random group average using spectral properties of group-induced operators and tools from representation theory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在几何机器学习中，能否用优化前预先固定的小规模变换样本（稀疏增强）来近似完整的数据增强目标函数。作者证明，在适当正则条件下，固定稀疏增强上的梯度下降（GD）能以O((log|G|+log(1/δ))/ε²)次群变换查询找到全增强目标的ε-驻点，优于每次迭代重新采样的组随机梯度下降（group-SGD）所需的O(1/ε⁴)次查询。
AI.motivation: 在几何机器学习中，数据增强通常需要遍历整个变换群G来平均经验损失以促进不变性，但当G规模庞大或仅能通过采样获取时，完整的增强目标计算代价过高。作者希望探索能否用优化前预采样的固定小规模变换来近似全增强目标，从而大幅降低计算成本。
AI.method: 作者分析了在固定稀疏增强目标上运行梯度下降的优化保证。核心证明技���包括：利用群诱导算子的谱性质和表示论工具，建立随机群平均对完整群平均梯度场的均匀近似理论，该理论可能具有独立的研究价值。
AI.result: 在概率至少1-δ的情况下，固定稀疏增强上的梯度下降仅需O((log|G|+log(1/δ))/ε²)次群变换查询即可找到全增强目标的ε-驻点，优于group-SGD的O(1/ε⁴)次查询以及直接对全增强目标做GD的查询成本。
AI.conclusion: 固定稀疏增强配合梯度下降在变换查询效率上优于全增强GD和group-SGD，表明在优化前预先固定小规模变换样本是一种高效且理论上可保证的增强近似策略。

title: Everything in Moderation: Per-Domain Coverage Optima and Alignment-Resistant Domain Gaps in Multi-Domain Mid-Training
summary: Mid-training, the stage between pre-training and alignment, is where a model's per-domain data composition is typically set by data availability rather than principled design. We ask what that decision buys, and whether a later alignment pass can undo it. In a controlled logical-reasoning setting (Qwen3-8B-Base, with a 4B replication; five semantically rule-disjoint KOR-Bench domains) we train 30 allocations spanning the five-domain simplex, 24 sweep configurations plus six withheld from the fit, at five seeds each. Three findings emerge. First, every domain has an interior coverage optimum: the moderate band ($10\%$-$40\%$) is best for all five domains, and a calibrated permutation test for quadratic interiority gives $P\approx0.010$; the fitted mid-training-only curves, with 8B peaks between $9.9\%$ and $35.1\%$, reproduce for curve shape but not peak location. Second, the gaps survive a fixed-budget alignment pass: compensatory SFT raises 116/120 cells (mean $+4.32\%$) yet bridges $0/240$ pairs at a $5\%$ threshold and $30/240$ at a $10\%$ ratio, an equal-budget uniform control behaves almost identically, and a permutation null would bridge $13.8\pm3.3$ and $77.9\pm8.5$ pairs ($P<0.001$). Third, zero coverage collapses mid-training-only accuracy, though a FineWeb-Edu-only control shows the collapse is commingled with generic drift. An exploratory $θ^*$ allocation attains the largest full-pipeline gain ($+4.36\%$ vs. $+0.80\%$/$+0.64\%$\,pp) but is marginal under Welch test.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型"中期训练"（预训练与对齐之间的阶段）中数据组成分配的影响。在受控逻辑推理场景中，作者训练了跨越五维单纯形的30种数据分配方案，发现每个领域都有内部覆盖最优区间（10%-40%），该最优在中性GPT后的固定预算对齐后仍然成立，且零覆盖会导致准确性崩溃。
AI.motivation: 中期训练阶段的数据组成通常由数据可用性而非原则性设计决定，作者希望探究这一决策的实际收益，以及后续的对齐阶段能否抵消中期训练中次优数据分配带来的影响。
AI.method: 使用Qwen3-8B-Base及4B副本，在五个语义规则不相交的KOR-Bench领域上，训练30种跨越五维单纯形的数据分配（24种扫描配置加6种留出配置，各5个种子），通过校准置换检验判断最优区间，并通过固定预算的SFT对齐和均匀控制实验验证结论。
AI.result: 三项发现：1) 所有领域在10%-40%的中等覆盖率均存在内部最优点（置换检验P≈0.010），但曲线峰值位置无法复现；2) 补偿性SFT虽平均提升4.32%（116/120单元格），但无法显著弥合中期训练差距（0/240对在5%阈值下，30/240在10%比率下）；3) 零覆盖率导致中期训练准确性崩溃，但部分与通用性漂移混合。
AI.conclusion: 中期训练的数据组成决策具有持久影响，无法通过对齐阶段完全修复；领域覆盖存在一个适度的最优区间（10%-40%），过高或过低覆盖均不利。探索性θ*分配获得了最大的全流程增益（+4.36%），但在Welch检验下不显著。

title: KBBQ: A Predictive Noise Law and the Limits of Spectrum Flattening in FP4 Quantization
summary: We develop a second-order theory of quantization noise in matrix multiplication in which the quantization format is characterized by the variance it assigns to each element. The constant variance profile of integer quantization recovers existing integer-noise theory, while the multiplicative profile of floating-point rounding reduces the data dependence to a scalar, the participation factor $κ$, yielding a closed-form signal-to-noise-ratio law. The resulting functional also admits a closed-form upper bound $κ^{*}$ that no function-preserving linear transform can exceed and that is attained by a recent state-of-the-art method. Building on this analysis, we introduce KBBQ (\textbf{K}appa-\textbf{B}raked \textbf{B}lockwise \textbf{Q}uantization), which parameterizes the extent to which a transform approaches this ceiling. At W4A4, across four base models and two FP4 formats, KBBQ outperforms the prior state of the art without additional deployment-time computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了矩阵乘法中量化噪声的二阶理论，通过参与因子κ得到了闭式信噪比定律及其上界，并基于此设计了KBBQ量化方法，在W4A4精度下超越现有最先进方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的整数量化噪声理论无法很好地解释浮点格式（如FP4）的量化行为，因为浮点舍入噪声具有乘性特征，导致数据依赖性复杂，缺乏统一的理论框架来指导量化方法的设计。
AI.method: 本文首先建立了二阶量化噪声理论，将量化格式统一表征为其赋予每个元素的方差；整数量化的常数方差恢复已有理论，而浮点量化的乘性方差将数据依赖约化为标量"参与因子κ"，从而得到闭式信噪比定律和闭式上界κ*。基于此分析，提出KBBQ方法，参数化变换接近该上界的程度。
AI.result: 在W4A4设置下，覆盖四个基础模型和两种FP4格式，KBBQ在无需额外部署期计算的情况下超越了先前最先进方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本文从理论上统一了整数和浮点量化噪声的分析框架，并证明了一个函数保持线性变换无法超越的量化噪声上界，且该上界可被现有SOTA方法达到；KBBQ作为实用方法在低比特浮点量化场景中实现了更优的性能-复杂度权衡。

title: The Surprising Effectiveness of Approximate Value Iteration in Self-Play
summary: Combining search with function approximation has driven major advances in game-playing programs, making self-play algorithms more competitive than ever. Still, the computational overhead of the most popular methods, based on Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS), can be substantial. In this work, we investigate whether simpler methods remain competitive in non-trivial, moderately sized games such as Connect Four, Hex(7x7) and synthetic games. We train a minimal self-play implementation of Approximate Value Iteration (AVI) and use ground-truth oracles for exact evaluation. Contrary to expectations, our results demonstrate the surprising effectiveness of AVI: it learns more accurate value functions than those learned by AlphaZero, while its one-step-lookahead greedy policies remain competitive with MCTS-based policies at substantially lower training and inference costs. Preliminary experiments on Othello and Go(9x9) show that AVI trains stably on larger games and learns effective value functions. These findings suggest that the success of MCTS-based methods may have eclipsed simpler approaches that have become increasingly practical with modern deep-learning tools.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在中等规模博弈游戏（如Connect Four、Hex 7x7及合成游戏）中，简单的近似值迭代（AVI）方法是否仍能与基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的复杂方法（如AlphaZero）竞争。实验结果表明，AVI训练出的价值函数比AlphaZero更准确，其一步前瞻贪心策略在显著降低训练和推理成本的同时仍保持竞争力；初步实验也证明AVI在Othello和Go 9x9等更大规模游戏中训练稳定。
AI.motivation: MCTS与函数逼近结合虽推动了博弈程序的发展，但计算开销巨大。作者质疑在中等规模博弈中，是否需要如此复杂的算法，旨在探索更简单的方法是否仍具竞争力，以降低计算成本并挑战"越复杂越有效"的直觉。
AI.method: 作者实现了一个极简的自我博弈版近似值迭代（AVI）训练框架，与AlphaZero风格的MCTS方法进行对比。使用地面真值Oracle进行精确评估，在Connect Four、Hex(7x7)和合成游戏上比较两者的价值函数准确性和贪心策略性能，并在Othello和Go(9x9)上进行初步扩展实验。
AI.result: AVI学习的价值函数比AlphaZero更准确；AVI的一步前瞻贪心策略与MCTS策略竞争力相当，但训练和推理成本大幅降低。在Othello和Go(9x9)的初步实验中，AVI训练稳定并能学习到有效的价值函数。
AI.conclusion: MCTS的成功可能掩盖了更简单方法的优势。随着现代深度学习工具的发展，如AVI这类简易方法已变得更加实用，值得博弈算法研究领域重新审视其潜力。

title: GPU-Enabled Large-Scale Optimization Using Randomized Linear Algebra
summary: This paper introduces rlaopt, a PyTorch-based package for large-scale optimization and scientific computing using randomized numerical linear algebra (RandNLA). Despite substantial progress in RandNLA-based algorithms, few implementations combine GPU acceleration with a simple interface for specifying optimization problems. rlaopt addresses this gap by providing GPU-enabled solvers for positive-definite linear systems and convex empirical risk minimization with constraints and regularizers. These solvers use RandNLA to accelerate conjugate gradient (NystromPCG), operator splitting (NysADMM), and stochastic gradient methods (SAPPHIRE). Moreover, rlaopt includes a modeling language that lets users specify problems using natural mathematical syntax. rlaopt automatically checks compatibility with the selected solver and performs the required problem decomposition. The solvers also support differentiation through their iterations, enabling applications such as hyperparameter tuning. Experiments on ridge regression, bounded multinomial logistic regression, and bounded elastic net identify when randomized preconditioning improves performance and demonstrate substantial speedups from GPU execution. The package is open-source under an Apache license, with source code at https://github.com/udellgroup/rlaopt and version 0.1.0 available on PyPI.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个基于PyTorch的开源包rlaopt，用于大规模优化和科学计算，结合了随机数值线性代数（RandNLA）算法与GPU加速。该包提供正定线性系统和带约束/正则化的凸经验风险最小化的求解器，支持自然数学语法建模、自动求解器兼容性检查以及迭代微分，实验表明其在岭回归、有界多项逻辑回归和有界弹性网络等任务中具有显著GPU加速优势。
AI.motivation: 尽管RandNLA算法取得了实质性进展，但很少有实现能同时兼顾GPU加速和简洁的问题定义接口，这限制了RandNLA算法在大规模优化中的实际应用。rlaopt旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: rlaopt提供三类基于RandNLA加速的求解器：用于正定线性系统的NystromPCG（共轭梯度）、用于算子分裂的NysADMM，以及用于随机梯度方法的SAPPHIRE。同时包含建模语言，支持用户以自然数学语法描述问题，自动检查与选定求解器的兼容性并执行问题分解，求解器还支持迭代过程的微分以用于超参数调优。
AI.result: 在岭回归、有界多项逻辑回归和有界弹性网络上的实验表明，随机预条件处理在特定条件下能提升性能，且GPU执行带来了显著的加速效果。该包以Apache许可证开源，可在GitHub和PyPI获取。
AI.conclusion: rlaopt成功地将GPU加速与简洁用户接口相结合，为RandNLA算法在大规模优化问题中的实际部署提供了可行的开源解决方案，其建模语言和可微性设计使其具有广泛的应用潜力。

title: SAEScientist-Bench: Can AI Agents Conduct Autonomous SAE Interpretability Research?
summary: While research on recursive self-improvement (RSI) has predominantly automated model training pipelines, reliable autonomous development demands a missing pillar: post-hoc monitoring and auditing to understand what models learn and ensure safe alignment. Mechanistic interpretability tools are essential to bridge this gap, among which Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) serve as a cornerstone by isolating interpretable features for model inspection and steering. In this paper, we introduce SAEScientist-Bench to evaluate whether AI agents can act as scientists utilizing SAE tools for autonomous mechanistic discovery. Given a target concept, an agent designs contrastive probes and navigates a Gemma Scope dictionary of 131K+ features in Gemma-2-9B-IT to discover the optimal feature, evaluated against curated expert reference features anchored on Neuronpedia across activation rank, concept selectivity on contrastive texts, and causal steering. Across 10 agent configurations and 20 tasks, frontier agents demonstrate genuine discovery capabilities and lead different evaluation dimensions, but remain well behind the expert baseline, approaching expert levels on separating target concepts from contrastive controls while lagging substantially in causal generation steering. Further analysis reveals that although agents can design contrasts to rule out spurious candidates, they frequently misinterpret experimental measurements. These results establish experimental model understanding as a measurable capability for closed-loop autonomous AI R&D. Our code is available at https://github.com/Trae1ounG/SAEScientist.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAEScientist-Bench，用于评估AI智能体能否作为科学家自主利用稀疏自编码器（SAE）工具进行机制可解释性发现。智能体需针对目标概念设计对比探针并在Gemma-2-9B-IT的13.1万+特征中寻找最优特征，与专家基准比较。结果显示前沿智能体具备一定真实发现能力但远低于专家水平，尤其在因果生成干预方面差距显著。
AI.motivation: 递归自我改进（RSI）研究主要关注自动化模型训练流程，但可靠的自主开发还缺少事后监控与审计能力，即理解模型学到了什么并确保对齐安全。机制可解释性工具（尤其是SAE）对此至关重要，然而缺少对AI智能体能否自主运用这些工具进行科学发现的系统评估基准。
AI.method: 构建SAEScientist-Bench评估框架：给定目标概念后，智能体需设计对比探针，在Gemma-2-9B-IT的Gemma Scope字典（131K+特征）中导航搜索最优特征。通过与基于Neuronpedia的专家参考特征对比，从激活排名、对比文本的概念选择性以及因果引导三个维度进行评分，涵盖10种智能体配置和20项任务。
AI.result: 前沿智能体展现出真实的自主发现能力并在不同评估维度上各领先，但与专家基线仍有显著差距：在区分目标概念与对比控制方面接近专家水平，而在因果生成引导上大幅落后。进一步分析表明智能体能设计对比来排除虚假候选特征，但常误读实验测量结果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究将实验性模型理解确立为闭环自主AI研发中一项可测量的能力，为未来智能体驱动的机制发现与安全对齐研究奠定了基础。

title: Topology-induced Operators Reveal Complementary Graph Representations without Training
summary: Graph representation learning has largely focused on designing increasingly sophisticated models to transform graph topology into vector representations, or embeddings. However, the extent to which embedding quality depends on model learning, rather than on the underlying topological transformations, remains unclear. Here, we show that informative embeddings can be derived without complicated model design and gradient-based training. Propagating random features through implicit hierarchical structures induced by random walks and anonymous walks yields embeddings that capture node proximity and structural role, respectively. These two training-free embeddings preserve complementary aspects of graph organization and perform competitively with classic and recent methods across various node-, edge-, and graph-level tasks. They often require substantially less computation, resulting in a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off. Combining the two types of embeddings further improves inference quality of some tasks compared with using either embedding type alone. Our results suggest that informative graph embeddings can arise from carefully chosen topological transformations before any learning operation is applied.

AI.tldr: 本文表明无需复杂的模型设计和基于梯度的训练，仅通过将随机特征传播到由随机游走和匿名游走所隐含的层次结构中，即可获得信息丰富的图嵌入，分别捕捉节点邻近性和结构角色，这些嵌入在多项任务上与经典及近期方法表现相当，且计算开销更小。
AI.motivation: 图表示学习领域大量研究聚焦于设计日益复杂的模型来将图拓扑转化为嵌入表示，但嵌入质量在多大程度上取决于模型学习、而非底层的拓扑变换这一问题尚不清晰。作者希望探究是否可以不依赖复杂模型和梯度训练就能获得有信息量的嵌入。
AI.method: 作者提出一种免训练的嵌入方法：将随机特征通过随机游走和匿名游走所隐含的层次结构进行传播，分别生成捕捉节点邻近性的嵌入（随机游走）和捕捉结构角色的嵌入（匿名游走），两种嵌入互补并可组合使用。
AI.result: 两种免训练嵌入在节点级、边级和图级任务上与经典及近期方法表现相当，且计算量显著更低，具有良好的质量-效率权衡；将两种嵌入组合可进一步提升部分任务的推理质量。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果提示，信息丰富的图嵌入可以源自精心选择的拓扑变换本身，而无需经过任何学习操作，这为理解图表示学习中拓扑变换与模型学习各自的作用提供了新视角。

title: MeClear: Cooperative Game-Theoretic Attribution and Risk-Aware Memory Clearance for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
summary: Long horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents rely on external memory systems to preserve user preferences and task knowledge across extended interactions. Conventional retrieval mechanisms optimize semantic compatibility rather than downstream utility, frequently introducing outdated, misleading, or conflicting evidence into the active context. We present MeClear, a task conditioned memory clearance framework that identifies memories featuring negative downstream utility through cooperative attribution and selectively suppresses them from agent execution. MeClear combines Leave One Out screening with sampled cooperative Shapley attribution to distribute utility across interacting evidence, effectively resolving redundant conflict masking where single removal evaluations fail. Utilizing attribution rankings, MeClear executes a query scoped minimal clearance strategy over a nested filtration, verifying task recovery on the cleared context without permanently altering the persistent memory bank. Comprehensive experimental evaluations across ten long dialogue memory pools demonstrate that MeClear achieves a target recall of 85.9% and an overall task recovery rate of 82.3%, representing a 25.5 percentage point improvement over Leave One Out (LOO) baselines.

AI.tldr: MeClear是一个任务条件化的记忆清除框架，通过合作归因识别具有负面下游效用的记忆并有选择地抑制它们，在不永久修改持久记忆库的前提下提升长对话LLM代理的任务恢复率，在十个长对话记忆池上取得了显著优于Leave One Out基线的效果。
AI.motivation: 长视野LLM代理依赖外部记忆系统维持用户偏好和任务知识，但传统检索机制仅优化语义兼容性而非下游效用，常将过时、误导或冲突的证据引入活动上下文，影响代理执行效果。
AI.method: MeClear结合Leave One Out筛选与采样合作Shapley归因来跨交互证据分配效用，解决单一移除评估无法处理的重叠冲突遮蔽问题；利用归因排序在嵌套过滤上执行查询范围的极小清除策略，验证清除上下文的任务恢复而不永久更改持久记忆库。
AI.result: 在十个长对话记忆池的综合实验中，MeClear实现了85.9%的目标召回率和82.3%的整体任务恢复率，比Leave One Out基线提高了25.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务条件化的合作归因与极小清除策略，MeClear能够有效识别并抑制负面下游效用的记忆，显著改善长对话场景下LLM代理的任务执行能力。

title: Geodesic-informed Generative Diffusion Model For Topology-preserved Image Video Generation
summary: Generative diffusion models have emerged as a class of powerful techniques for various imaging applications, including but not limited to synthesis, reconstruction, and segmentation. Despite their success, current generative models pose two key limitations. First, they primarily rely on image intensity and texture information, with limited attention to underlying object geometry. As a result, they do not guarantee geometric or topological consistency during the generation process, which is a crucial requirement for high-stakes domains such as computational anatomy, biology, and robotics, where preserving object structure is critical. Second, existing models fail to explicitly learn or represent shape changes in the generative process. Such deformation dynamics remain occluded within network parameters; hence leaving the transformation process uninterpretable and physically uninformed. To address these challenges, we introduce IGG (Image Generation informed by Geodesic dynamics), a novel framework that integrates topology-preserving geodesic principles into the diffusion-based generative process. In contrast to conventional methods that operate in image intensity space, IGG learns and synthesizes diverse samples within geodesic deformation spaces, where geometric object changes are learned as smooth and invertible smooth mappings from a given template/source image. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/nellie689/IGG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IGG框架，将拓扑保持的测地线动力学原理整合到扩散生成模型中，在测地线形变空间而非图像强度空间中学习并合成多样样本，确保生成过程中的几何与拓扑一致性，并显式学习可解释、物理一致的形状变化。
AI.motivation: 现有生成扩散模型主要依赖图像强度和纹理信息，忽视底层物体几何结构；无法保证生成过程中的几何和拓扑一致性，且形状变化被隐匿在网络参数中，缺乏可解释性和物理依据。这些问题在计算解剖学、生物学和机器人等高风险领域尤为关键。
AI.method: IGG框架将拓扑保持的测地线原理集成到基于扩散的生成过程中。与在图像强度空间操作的传统方法不同，IGG在测地线形变空间中学习并合成多样样本，将几何对象变化学习为从给定模板/源图像到目标的光滑且可逆的映射。
AI.result: 实验结果表明IGG在各种成像应用（包括合成、重建和分割）中有效，能够保持几何与拓扑一致性，并显式、可解释地表示生成过程中的形状形变。
AI.conclusion: IGG通过引入测地线动力学来约束扩散生成过程，解决了现有模型缺乏几何/拓扑一致性和形变不可解释的两大局限，为需要严格结构保持的应用领域提供了更可靠的生成方案。

title: A Generalization of Amari's Bayesian Duality
summary: Amari's contributions to information geometry and machine learning are well known. Here, we revisit Amari's work on Bayesian duality which has not received as much attention. We connect Amari's Bayesian duality to a convex duality of Bayes' rule. Using this connection, we present a generalization of Amari's Bayesian duality and discuss its relevance for modern artificial intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了Amari在贝叶斯对偶性方面的工作，将其与贝叶斯规则的凸对偶性联系起来，并提出了一种Amari贝叶斯对偶性的推广，讨论了其对现代人工智能的意义。
AI.motivation: Amari在信息几何和机器学习方面的贡献广为人知，但其贝叶斯对偶性工作受到的关注较少。作者希望重新审视这一工作，并探讨其在现代AI背景下的相关性。
AI.method: 将Amari的贝叶斯对偶性与贝叶斯规则的凸对偶性建立联系，并基于此联系提出Amari贝叶斯对偶性的一般化形式。
AI.result: 建立了两者之间的概念桥梁，获得了Amari贝叶斯对偶性的推广版本，并揭示了其对现代人工智能的潜在价值。
AI.conclusion: Amari的贝叶斯对偶性虽未被充分关注，但通过与凸对偶性建立联系并加以推广，可以为现代人工智能提供新的理论视角和工具。

title: SIM: Subspace Interaction-based Method for Token-Level Text Anomaly Detection
summary: Token-level text anomaly detection, as an emerging trend of text anomaly detection, moves beyond coarse-grained document-level detection by localizing anomalous tokens within text. By providing fine-grained abnormality prediction, token-level text anomaly detection plays a critical role in various real-world applications, such as spam filtering and fake news detection. However, existing methods still rely on the global distance calculation for scoring, during which the local anomaly signals are severely diluted by numerous redundant normal feature dimensions. Moreover, pre-trained language models used in these methods inevitably smooth out surface anomalies, further limiting their effectiveness in token-level anomaly detection. To address these limitations, we propose a Subspace Interaction-based Method (SIM for short) for token-level text anomaly detection. To prevent local signal dilution, SIM adopts a subspace interaction-based anomaly detector, which decouples high-dimensional token embeddings into multiple low-dimensional ones, amplifying localized anomaly signals hidden within specific dimensions. To counteract the over-smoothing effect, we design a hard pseudo-anomaly generation module to construct pseudo-anomalous tokens, simulating the subtle anomalies obscured by semantic smoothing. Also, a probabilistic boundary loss is developed to standardize anomaly scores into statistical distances, effectively enforcing anomalous instances to deviate significantly from the normal distribution center. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmark datasets verify the effectiveness of SIM and demonstrate its remarkable efficiency, robustness, and interpretability. The source code is available at: https://github.com/yankehan/SIM-TAD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于子空间交互的token级文本异常检测方法（SIM），通过将高维token嵌入解耦为多个低维子空间来放大局部异常信号，并设计硬伪异常生成模块和概率边界损失来缓解预训练语言模型的过度平滑问题，在多个基准数据集上验证了其有效性、效率、鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有token级文本异常检测方法存在两大局限：一是依赖全局距离计算打分，导致局部异常信号被大量冗余的正常特征维度稀释；二是预训练语言模型会不可避免地平滑表面异常，进一步削弱token级异常检测效果。
AI.method: SIM方法包含三个核心组件：1）子空间交互异常检测器，将高维token嵌入解耦为多个低维子空间以放大特定维度中隐藏的局部异常信号；2）硬伪异常生成模块，构造伪异常token以模拟被语义平滑所掩盖的细微异常；3）概率边界损失函数，将异常分数标准化为统计距离，迫使异常实例显著偏离正常分布中心。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验验证了SIM的有效性，同时展示了其在效率、鲁棒性和可解释性方面的显著优势。
AI.conclusion: SIM通过子空间交互策略有效解决了局部异常信号稀释和过度平滑两大瓶颈问题，为token级文本异常检测提供了更精准、高效且可解释的解决方案。

title: ExecCritic: Learn to Test, Test to Improve for Coding Agents
summary: Execution feedback can guide coding agents toward correct repository repairs, but only when the tests capture the behavior requested by the issue. Agent-generated tests can encode incomplete or incorrect behavioral targets; when the same trajectory writes both the patch and the test, their errors can agree and create false confidence. We introduce ExecCritic, combining a test--verify--revise scaffold with a role-specific reinforcement learning recipe for training agents within it. The scaffold separates test construction from source-code repair: a Test agent independently generates repository-native tests, a fail-closed harness qualifies and freezes them, and a Repair agent revises source code from their execution feedback without changing the tests. Both roles use Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B as the backbone and are trained separately. In Learn to Test, the Test agent learns to produce behaviorally valid tests that distinguish correct from incorrect patches. In Test to Improve, the Repair agent learns both direct task resolution and feedback-guided revision. On SWE-bench Verified, test quality determines whether feedback helps: holding the base Repair agent fixed, tests from the base Test agent reduce resolved rate from a no-test baseline of 61.2% to 57.3%, whereas tests from GPT-5.6-sol raise it to 65.3%. Role-specific post-training raises the Qwen Test agent's Base-to-Gold success from 22.2% to 62.2%; composing the two post-trained Qwen agents reaches 72.6%, an 11.4-point gain over the original no-test baseline without stronger-model or Oracle feedback at evaluation time. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/execcritic.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ExecCritic框架，将代码修复中的测试生成与源代码修复分离为两个角色，并分别使用角色特定的强化学习训练。该方法在SWE-bench Verified上将解决率从61.2%提升至72.6%，展示了高质量测试对基于执行反馈的代码修复的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 现有执行反馈引导的编码代理只有在测试准确捕捉issue行为时才能有效工作。然而，当同一个代理同时生成补丁和测试时，二者的错误可能相互一致，产生虚假的自信。这是阻碍执行反馈方法提升代码修复效果的核心问题。
AI.method: ExecCritic采用test-verify-revise框架：Test代理独立生成仓库原生测试，fail-closed验证机制负责测试质量把关并冻结测试；Repair代理仅根据执行反馈修改源代码而不改动测试。两个代理均以Qwen-3.5-35B-A3B为骨干模型并分别训练——Test代理通过Learn to Test学习生成区分正确与错误补丁的有效测试，Repair代理通过Test to Improve学习直接任务解决与反馈引导的修订。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified上，固定基础Repair代理时，基础Test代理的测试将其解决率从61.2%降至57.3%，而GPT-5.6-sol生成的测试则提升至65.3%，表明测试质量决定反馈是否有益。角色特定训练将Qwen Test代理的Base-to-Gold成功率从22.2%提升至62.2%；组合两个后训练Qwen代理达到72.6%，比原始无测试基线提升11.4个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ExecCritic通过角色分离与角色特定强化学习训练，有效解决了代理自生成测试与补丁错误一致导致的虚假自信问题，在不依赖更强模型或Oracle反馈的情况下显著提升了代码修复性能，证明了测试质量在执行反馈中的决定性作用。

title: CUNO: Curriculum and Preference Optimization for Stable Graph Unlearning under Mass Deletion
summary: Graph unlearning removes the influence of designated training data from a trained graph model without retraining from scratch. However, existing methods suffer a sharp drop in model utility under large deletion ratios (mass deletion), a phenomenon we refer to as catastrophic unlearning. We find that a key cause is the uniform treatment of all deleted samples, which is particularly damaging in graph learning: structural dependencies cause different nodes to play vastly different roles in the learned model, yet existing methods apply the same forgetting operation to the entire forget set. Based on this insight, we propose CUNO, a curriculum-based graph unlearning framework that removes the forget set progressively, ordering samples by their estimated unlearning difficulty across multiple stages. CUNO further employs a distribution-level negative preference optimization (NPO) objective at each curriculum stage that steers the model away from its original behavior on the current forget subset while preserving retained performance. Our theoretical analysis shows that the curriculum design is most beneficial when the forget set spans a wide range of unlearning difficulty, a condition naturally satisfied under mass deletion. Comprehensive experiments confirm that CUNO consistently mitigates catastrophic unlearning: at 20% deletion, it retains 74% of the original utility compared to 26-53% for existing methods, and maintains more than half the original utility even at 50% deletion. Our code is publicly available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/cuno-D4FF.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CUNO框架，通过课程学习的方式按难度渐进式地执行图遗忘（graph unlearning），在每个课程阶段使用分布级负偏好优化（NPO）目标，有效缓解大规模删除下模型效用的灾难性下降问题。
AI.motivation: 现有图遗忘方法在大规模删除（如20%-50%）时会出现严重的模型效用下降，称为"灾难性遗忘"。作者发现根本原因在于现有方法对所有待删除样本统一处理，忽视了图结构中不同节点在学习模型中所扮演角色的巨大差异。
AI.method: 提出CUNO框架：(1) 将遗忘集按估计的遗忘难度排序，分多个课程阶段渐进式移除；(2) 每个阶段使用分布级负偏好优化（NPO）目标，引导模型远离当前遗忘子集的行为同时保持保留数据的性能；(3) 提供理论分析说明当遗忘集跨越广泛的难度范围时（大规模删除的自然特征），课程设计最为有效。
AI.result: 实验表明CUNO持续缓解灾难性遗忘：在20%删除率下保留了74%的原始效用（现有方法仅为26-53%），在50%删除率下仍能保持超过一半的原始效用。
AI.conclusion: 通过识别图中不同节点的结构角色差异并据此设计课程式遗忘策略，可以有效解决大规模图删除场景下的效用崩溃问题，为图机器学习的数据删除合规要求提供了更实用的方案。

title: Co-Evolving Harnesses and Models: On-Policy Correction Helps Weaker Models Catch Up Where Imitation Fails
summary: Agent harnesses (the system prompt, tool set, execution hooks, and context-management scaffolding around a model) are a critical determinant of agentic task success. Automated harness evolution can enable smaller models to perform well on domain-specific tasks at a fraction of frontier-model cost. Since both the harness and model weights shape behavior, we ask how harness evolution and lightweight fine-tuning should be combined. Across seven enterprise agent tasks, we first evolve a harness with the weaker model, then find that a stronger expert often uses it more effectively, suggesting expert supervision could close the remaining gap. However, training the weaker model on the expert's complete trajectories under the evolved harness backfires: performance regresses on all seven tasks by 4 to 30 points across Qwen3-Coder and Gemma 4, even though the same procedure helps under the unevolved harness. Our analysis shows that imitation transfers knowledge and increases scaffold usage, but disrupts model-harness fit: the weaker model adopts the expert's planning strategy without the competence to execute it and no longer matches the harness evolved around its native planning style. We therefore develop an on-policy expert-correction pipeline, automated by a meta-level MLE agent, that localizes the failing turn in the weaker model's own rollout and asks the expert to rewrite only that turn. This preserves the model's planning style and combines the gains of harness evolution and model adaptation. Our results identify and resolve a source of contention between harness and weight updates, yielding a compatibility-preserving recipe for economical co-evolution on domain-specific enterprise tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究智能体任务中"工具链（harness）进化和轻量级模型微调"如何协同的问题。研究发现，在进化后的工具链上，用专家完整轨迹训练弱模型会导致性能全面回退（7个任务均下降4-30分），因为模仿破坏了模型与工具链的契合度。作者提出了一种"在策略专家纠错流水线"，仅让专家重写弱模型自身轨迹中失败的那一轮，从而保留模型原生规划风格，同时结合工具链进化和模型适应的收益。
AI.motivation: 智能体的工具链（系统提示、工具集、执行钩子和上下文管理脚手架）对任务成功至关重要。自动化的工具链进化可以让小模型在领域任务上以远低于前沿模型的成本表现出色。由于工具链和模型权重共同决定行为，需要弄清工具链进化和轻量微调应如何组合，以避免两者更新之间产生冲突。
AI.method: 首先在7个企业智能体任务上，用弱模型进化工具链；然后用专家在进化后的工具链下生成完整轨迹对弱模型进行模仿学习训练（发现回退）；分析回退原因后，开发了在策略的专家纠错流水线，由元层面的MLE智能体自动化定位弱模型自身 rollout 中失败的那一轮，仅让专家重写该轮，保留模型自身规划风格。
AI.result: 在进化后的工具链上，对弱模型进行完整轨迹模仿训练导致全部7个任务的性能回退4-30分（Qwen3-Coder和Gemma 4均如此），而在未进化的工具链上同一过程有助于性能。回退原因是被模仿的学习增加了脚手架的使用并转移了知识，但破坏了模型-工具链契合度：弱模型采用了专家的规划策略却缺乏执行能力，与其围绕原生规划风格进化的工具链不再匹配。提出的在策略专家纠错流水线能够保留规划风格，同时结合工具链进化和模型适应的增益。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别并解决了工具链更新与模型权重更新之间的冲突根源，提供了一种保持兼容性的共进化配方，使弱模型与工具链能够在企业领域任务上以经济的方式协同进化，兼顾性能提升和成本控制。

title: Revisiting Spectral Representations in Generative Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models have shown remarkable performance on diverse generation tasks. Recent work finds that imposing representation alignment on the hidden states of diffusion networks can both facilitate training convergence and enhance sampling quality, yet the mechanism driving this synergy remains insufficiently understood. In this paper, we investigate the connection between self-supervised spectral representation learning and diffusion generative models through a shared perspective on perturbation kernels. On the diffusion side, samples (e.g., images, videos) are produced by reversing a stochastic noise-injection process specified by Gaussian kernels; on the spectral representation side, spectral embeddings emerge from contrasting positive and negative relations induced by random perturbation kernels. Motivated by this, we propose a self-supervised spectral representation alignment method to facilitate diffusion model training. In addition, we clarify how joint spectral learning can benefit diffusion training from a geometric perspective. Furthermore, we find that the optimization of the spectral alignment objective is in an equivalent form of diffusion score distillation in the representation space. Building on these findings, we integrate a spectral regularizer into diffusion training objectives to improve the performance of diffusion models on multiple datasets. Experiments across images and 3D point clouds show consistent gains in generation quality. Code is released at https://github.com/yuehaowang/spectral-reg-diffusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自监督谱表示对齐方法，通过将扩散生成模型与谱表示学习统一在扰动核的视角下，在扩散训练目标中加入谱正则化项，从而在图像和3D点云生成任务上持续提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有研究发现对扩散网络的隐状态施加表示对齐可以促进训练收敛并提升采样质量，但其内在机制尚不清楚。作者旨在从扰动核的共享视角出发，理解这一协同作用的原理。
AI.method: 首先从扰动核的角度统一阐述扩散生成模型与自监督谱表示学习的关系；在此基础上提出自监督谱表示对齐方法来促进扩散模型训练，并从几何角度阐明联合谱学习的益处；进一步发现谱对齐目标的优化等价于表示空间中的扩散分数蒸馏，最终将谱正则化项集成到扩散训练目标中。
AI.result: 在图像和3D点云等多个数据集上的实验表明，加入谱正则化后扩散模型的生成质量获得了一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: 谱表示对齐与扩散训练之间存在深刻的数学联系，将谱正则化引入扩散训练可以有效提升生成质量，代码已开源。

title: A Data-Driven Framework for Identifying and Prioritizing RPA Opportunities in Healthcare Processes
summary: Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is widely used to reduce administrative burden in United States hospitals, yet an estimated 30-50% of RPA initiatives underperform because processes are selected informally, without a repeatable method to catalogue candidates, prioritize them, match each to an automation tier -- a Python bot, an open-source orchestrator such as n8n, or an enterprise platform such as UiPath -- and forecast financial return before committing resources. We propose a four-module, data-driven framework unifying these decisions: a Process Taxonomy of twenty recurring hospital processes across five value streams; a Prioritization module deriving an Automation Suitability Index from an Analytic Hierarchy Process matrix with an explicit consistency check; a Tool-Tier Selection module recommending the least-cost technology sufficient for a process complexity, integration, and compliance profile; and a Return-on-Investment module quantifying labor savings, error-cost avoidance, payback, and net present value. Applied to a synthetic portfolio spanning all twenty processes, plus a reference data-flow architecture linking it to hospital EHR/payer/ERP systems: 12 of 20 clear the prioritization threshold; the ranking is robust to +/-20% weight perturbation (Spearman correlation 0.83, top-5 set preserved 97.7%, 2,000 Monte Carlo trials); an Automation Risk Index flags four qualifying processes as Critical risk; a budget-constrained portfolio optimization shows diminishing marginal NPV as spend scales from $400K to $1.03M; and a second Monte Carlo analysis shows portfolio NPV stays positive at its 5th percentile. The framework is a conceptual synthesis of the literature rather than an instrument calibrated on primary hospital data; we discuss HIPAA governance and a research agenda for empirical validation. A supplementary Python implementation accompanies the paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个四模块数据驱动框架，用于统一美国医院RPA流程选择的决策：涵盖流程分类、优先级排序（AHP+一致性检验）、工具层级选择（Python/n8n/UiPath）和投资回报预测。在20个流程的综合投资组合上进行验证，显示排序对权重扰动稳健、预算约束下NPV呈边际递减，并提供了Python实现。
AI.motivation: 美国医院广泛采用RPA以减轻行政负担，但30-50%的RPA项目因流程选择不正规、缺乏可重复的方法来盘点候选流程、排序、匹配自动化层级并预测财务回报而表现不佳。需要一个系统化框架来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 提出四模块框架：(1) 覆盖五个价值流的20个医院流程分类；(2) 基于AHP矩阵及一致性检查的自动化适宜性指数排序模块；(3) 根据流程复杂度、集成度和合规性档案推荐最低成本技术的工具层级选择模块；(4) 量化劳动节省、错误成本规避、回收期和NPV的投资回报模块。配以参考数据流架构和Python实现。
AI.result: 在覆盖20个流程的合成投资组合中：12/20通过优先级阈值；对±20%权重扰动具有稳健性（Spearman相关0.83，top-5集合保持97.7%，2000次蒙特卡洛试验）；自动化风险指数标记4个关键风险流程；预算约束下组合优化显示从$400K到$1.03M支出中边际NPV递减；组合NPV在5%分位数下仍为正。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是文献的概念综合而非基于真实医院数据校准的工具；讨论HIPAA治理问题，并提出经验验证的研究议程。附有Python实现供实际使用。

title: Synergistic Fusion of Topological Structure and Temporal Semantics of Mobility for Urban Region Embedding
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering
summary: Urban region embeddings have shown promising results in diverse urban sensing tasks such as crime, income, and service-call prediction. Recent methods improve representation quality by integrating mobility data with auxiliary modalities, using cross-view attention or contrastive objectives to align heterogeneous features into a unified region representation. However, leveraging the temporal dynamics of human mobility remains under-explored. Regional inflow and outflow fluctuate throughout the day, and inter-region connections emerge, persist, and dissolve over time. Moreover, prevailing fusion strategies combine views additively and miss the joint signal that emerges only when views co-occur. To address these gaps, we propose Mobility Stream-Structure Synergy (MoSS), which derives complementary views from mobility data: a Sequence view that preserves each region's hourly inflow/outflow profile, and a Structure view based on zigzag persistence diagrams that capture how regional connectivity emerges, persists, and dissolves over time. A synergy module then extracts emergent representations from the co-occurrence of these views through multi-degree interactions, explicitly capturing higher-order signal across views. Extensive experiments on New York City and Chicago show that MoSS achieves state-of-the-art performance across three downstream tasks using mobility data alone, outperforming baselines that rely on auxiliary modalities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoSS框架，通过从时空流动性数据中提取序列视图和基于zigzag持续同调的结构视图，并利用多阶交互的协同模块捕获视图共现的高阶信号，仅凭流动性数据即可在城市区域嵌入的多个下游任务上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有城市区域嵌入方法虽已引入辅助模态和多视图融合，但仍有两个关键不足：一是忽视了人类流动性的时间动态性（区域间连接随时间的涌现、持续与消解）；二是现有融合策略多为加性融合，无法捕获视图共现时才出现的联合信号。
AI.method: MoSS从流动性数据中提取两个互补视图：序列视图保留每个区域逐小时的流入/流出分布；结构视图基于zigzag持续同调图捕捉区域连接随时间涌现、持续和消解的模式。随后通过协同模块以多度交互方式提取两视图共现时的涌现表征，显式建模跨视图的高阶信号。
AI.result: 在纽约市和芝加哥的大规模实验中，MoSS仅使用流动性数据，在三个下游任务上均达到SOTA性能，超越了依赖辅助模态（如POI、收入数据等）的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: MoSS证明了充分利用城市流动性的时间动态及其多视图协同信号，可以在不依赖辅助数据模态的情况下实现更优的区域表征质量，为城市感知任务提供了一种更纯粹且有效的建模思路。

title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
comment: 36 pages including references and appendices, 6 figures, 11 tables
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents that plan over long horizons and act through external tools. Most agents select actions through unconstrained generation over an accumulating history, leaving implicit the procedural knowledge of what to do, in what order, and under which conditions. As trajectories lengthen, agents can lose track of their objectives, invoke tools out of order, and repeat unproductive actions. We introduce the Procedural Graph: just as a knowledge graph organizes factual knowledge into (entity, relation, entity) triplets for what-is questions, a Procedural Graph organizes procedural knowledge into (procedure, relation, procedure) triplets for what-to-do questions. At each decision step, the framework localizes the agent's active node, and a guidance model translates the surrounding subgraph into step-level situational guidance that biases the solver's next action without dictating it. The graph is self-evolving: an LLM refiner contrasts failed trajectories with successful ones and edits the graph's topology and attributes, committing edits that preserve or improve held-out validation performance while retaining rejected ones to discourage repetition. Starting from a minimal skeleton, the loop builds graphs that match or surpass hand-designed ones. It can also repair a flawed expert prior. Across multiple datasets, task types, and LLMs, the Procedural Graph delivers consistent gains over memory-based baselines, and self-evolution further improves performance without manual engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Procedural Graph框架，将程序性知识组织为(过程，关系，过程)三元组图结构，为LLM智能体提供逐步的情境化行动引导，并通过自进化机制从成功/失败轨迹中自动优化图结构，显著提升长程任务中的智能体性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体主要依赖自由生成方式从累积历史中选择动作，缺少对"做什么、按什么顺序做、在什么条件下做"的程序性知识进行显式建模。随着轨迹变长，智能体容易丢失目标、乱序调用工具、重复无效动作，亟需一种结构化的程序性知识表示与引导机制。
AI.method: 1) 提出Procedural Graph，将程序性知识组织为(procedure, relation, procedure)三元组。2) 在每一步决策中定位智能体的活动节点，由引导模型将周围子图翻译为细粒度的情境引导信息，偏置但不强制求解器的下一步动作。3) 图是自进化的：LLM精炼器对比失败与成功轨迹来编辑图的拓扑和属性，接受能够保持或提升验证集性能的编辑，同时保留被拒绝的编辑以阻止重复尝试。
AI.result: 在多个数据集、任务类型和LLM上，Procedural Graph相较基于记忆的基线方法取得了一致的性能提升。从最小骨架开始即可构建出匹敌或超越手工设计图的效果，还能修复有缺陷的专家先验，自进化进一步提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化地表示程序性知识并辅以自进化机制，是提升LLM智能体在长程规划与工具调用任务中表现的有效途径，能在无需人工工程的情况下持续优化。

title: Online Signature Verification Using Augmented Path Signature and T-Mamba
comment: International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition (ICDAR) 2026
summary: Handwritten signature verification is vital for personal authentication across commercial and financial applications. Although deep learning methods are widely adopted for online signature verification (OSV), they often struggle with capturing highly discriminative features and modelling long-range dependencies. To address these issues, we propose a novel framework that integrates the augmented path signature (APS) descriptor with the T-Mamba model. The APS descriptor first applies time and basepoint augmentations, then computes sliding-window path signatures. The path signature is a non-parametric feature map from rough path theory that effectively captures geometric structures and nonlinear inter-channel interactions. Inspired by the efficacy of state space models (SSMs) in sequence modelling, our T-Mamba model employs a hybrid design combining two temporal convolutional network (TCN) blocks with a time-scanning Mamba. This design enables the model to learn both local temporal patterns and global long-range dependencies, substantially improving verification accuracy. Our framework achieves state-of-the-art EERs on three public benchmark datasets (MCYT-100, SVC-2004 Task 2, DeepSignDB), validating its effectiveness and robustness, especially when the training data is limited. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/DLRL04/OSV-using-APS-and-T-Mamba.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合增广路径签名（APS）描述符与T-Mamba模型的在线手写签名验证框架，通过在三个公开基准数据集上达到最先进的等错误率（EER），验证了其有效性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 在线签名验证在商业和金融应用中至关重要，但深度学习方法在捕捉高判别性特征和建模长距离依赖方面存在不足。
AI.method: 首先使用APS描述符对签名进行时间和基点增广，并计算滑动窗口路径签名以捕捉几何结构和非线性通道间交互；然后将APS特征输入T-Mamba模型，该模型混合两个时间卷积网络（TCN）模块与时间扫描Mamba，以同时学习局部时间模式和全局长距离依赖。
AI.result: 在MCYT-100、SVC-2004 Task 2和DeepSignDB三个公开基准数据集上取得了最先进的EER结果，尤其在训练数据有限的情况下表现出色。
AI.conclusion: APS与T-Mamba的联合框架有效提升了在线签名验证的准确性，验证了路径签名理论与状态空间模型在序列建模中的互补优势。

title: Adaptively Incorporating Directional Hints into Zeroth-Order Optimization
summary: We study zeroth-order optimization of non-convex functions with the aid of directional hints, which are cheap but potentially inaccurate approximations of the true gradient direction, given by linear subspaces at each iteration. To leverage these hints adaptively while maintaining robustness to their quality, we introduce Control-Variate Zeroth-Order Descent (CV-ZOD), a new framework that refines the classical zeroth-order gradient estimator with a control variate that can be set based on the directional hints. We first show that the oracle algorithm that optimally sets the reference vector and step size at each iteration achieves a convergence rate that interpolates between the first-order $O(1/T)$ rate and the zeroth-order $O(d/T)$ rate, depending on the quality of the hints along the trajectory. We then develop a practical variant of CV-ZOD that achieves the same oracle guarantee up to logarithmic factors, without any prior knowledge of the hint quality. We validate the method empirically on simulation-based scientific optimization tasks, demonstrating sustained progress on non-convex landscapes where zeroth-order descent is slower and existing guided methods stall as guidance deteriorates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Control-Variate Zeroth-Order Descent (CV-ZOD)框架，利用方向提示（directional hints）加速非凸函数的零阶优化，通过控制变量法精细改进经典零阶梯度估计器，实现收敛率在一阶O(1/T)与零阶O(d/T)之间插值，且无需预知提示质量。
AI.motivation: 零阶优化（仅依赖函数值）在科学计算等场景中至关重要，但其收敛速度受限于维度d。现有方法要么速度过慢，要么依赖精确梯度方向引导，当引导质量下降时性能会停滞。作者希望利用廉价但可能不准确的方向提示来加速优化，同时保持对提示质量差的鲁棒性。
AI.method: CV-ZOD框架：在经典零阶梯度估计器中引入控制变量（control variate），该控制变量可基于每次迭代中提供的方向提示（线性子空间）进行设定。理论部分先分析最优设定参考向量和步长的oracle算法，再开发无需任何提示质量先验知识的实用变体，使其实用性能逼近oracle保证（仅损失对数因子）。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，CV-ZOD的收敛率根据轨迹上提示质量，在一阶O(1/T)与零阶O(d/T)之间平滑插值；实用变体在不预知提示质量的前提下达到与oracle相同的保证（至多对数因子差异）。在基于仿真的科学优化任务上，该方法在非凸地形上持续取得进展，而经典的零阶下降速度较慢，现有引导方法在引导质量下降时会停滞。
AI.conclusion: CV-ZOD为带方向提示的零阶优化提供了理论严谨且实践有效的统一框架：既能自适应利用高质量提示加速收敛，又能在提示质量差时退化为标准零阶方法的稳健性，填补了引导式方法与纯零阶方法之间的空白。

title: HypLTSF: A Hyperbolic Geometric View of Multi-Scale Hierarchies for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
summary: Multi-scale modeling has become an effective approach for long-term time series forecasting, capturing temporal patterns that range from fine-grained local dynamics to coarse global trends. Representations across these temporal scales are inherently hierarchical, with coarser scales abstracting and aggregating information from finer ones. While existing approaches readily exchange information across these scales, the hierarchy itself is typically left as an emergent byproduct of such interactions rather than captured as a geometric structure in its own right. In this paper, we introduce HypLTSF, a framework that endows the multi-scale hierarchy with a concrete geometric form by embedding scale-wise representations into the Poincaré ball, whose exponentially expanding volume naturally accommodates hierarchical structures. To align this geometry with the temporal hierarchy, HypLTSF imposes two constraints: (1) a radial constraint that orders embeddings by their level of abstraction, and (2) an angular constraint that groups fine-scale patterns sharing a common coarser-scale ancestor. Extensive experiments on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks show that HypLTSF achieves state-of-the-art performance, suggesting that explicitly modeling the multi-scale hierarchy as a geometric structure is effective for forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HypLTSF框架，通过将多尺度时间序列表示的层次结构嵌入到Poincaré球（双曲空间）中，赋予其具体的几何形式。通过径向约束（按抽象程度排序）和角度约束（聚类共享共同粗尺度祖先的细尺度模式），在长期时间序列预测基准上取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 多尺度建模在长期时间序列预测中有效，但现有的跨尺度信息交换方法将层次结构视为交互的副产品，而非将其显式建模为独立的几何结构。作者认为，显式地将多尺度层次捕获为几何结构可能有助于提升预测性能。
AI.method: HypLTSF将各尺度的表示嵌入到Poincaré球中，利用其指数扩展的体积自然适配层次结构。同时施加两个约束：(1)径向约束，用于按抽象程度对嵌入排序；(2)角度约束，用于将共享同一粗尺度祖先的细尺度模式进行聚类。
AI.result: 在长期时间序列预测基准上的大量实验表明，HypLTSF达到了最先进的性能，验证了将多尺度层次显式建模为几何结构的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式地将多尺度时间序列层次结构建模为双曲几何结构（而非仅仅作为信息交互的副产品）能够有效提升长期时间序列预测的性能。

title: EMBLEM: Enhancing Multi-script Table Detection through Masking
comment: Accepted in International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition 2026
summary: Table detection is a core task in document analysis, supporting downstream applications such as information retrieval, document reconstruction, and visual question answering. While existing deep learning models perform well on English and Chinese documents, they struggle with multilingual, multi-script documents due to script diversity and the limited availability of labeled data. To address this challenge, we introduce MANDALA (Multi-script Annotated Documents for Table Detection), a manually curated dataset of 2,323 table-containing pages spanning 18 languages and 15 scripts across diverse domains. We also propose EMBLEM, a masking-based paradigm for Multi-script Table Detection (MTD). EMBLEM generates masked images that conceal script- and font-specific details, enabling models pre-trained on abundant English documents to focus on script-agnostic page layout. Experiments across three table detection architectures show that EMBLEM consistently outperforms strong baselines on MANDALA while remaining competitive on five standard English-dominant benchmarks. Using only English masked images for fine-tuning, with no multi-script training data, EMBLEM achieves an absolute F1-score gain of 20.8% on MANDALA. We release MANDALA along with the accompanying code and models at https://github.com/IITB-LEAP-OCR/EMBLEM.git.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MANDALA多语言表格检测数据集（18种语言、15种文字、2,323页）和EMBLEM掩码训练范式，通过在图像上掩盖文字和字体细节，使模型专注于与文字无关的版面布局，在无需多语言训练数据的情况下，仅使用英文掩码图像微调即在MANDALA上获得20.8%的绝对F1提升，并在五个英文主流基准上保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习表格检测模型在英文和中文文档上表现良好，但由于文字多样性和标注数据稀缺，在处理多语言、多文字文档时性能不佳，迫切需要一种不依赖大量多语言标注数据的方法来解决这一问题。
AI.method: 首次提出MANDALA数据集，人工标注了覆盖18种语言、15种文字的2,323页表单文档；同时提出EMBLEM掩码训练范式，通过生成掩盖文字和字体细节的掩码图像，使在英文文档上预训练的模型能够聚焦于与文字无关的页面布局特征，实现跨文字表格检测。
AI.result: 在三种表格检测架构上，EMBLEM在MANDALA上持续优于强基线，同时在五个英文主导基准上保持竞争力；仅使用英文掩码图像微调（无多语言训练数据）即在MANDALA上获得20.8%的绝对F1增益。
AI.conclusion: EMBLEM证明了基于掩码的训练范式能够有效实现多文字表格检测，摆脱了对大规模多语言标注数据的依赖，为跨语言文档分析提供了新思路；相关数据集、代码和模型已开源。

title: Distillation as Probability Transport: Routed On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher knowledge on student-generated trajectories, but efficient sampled objectives reduce the teacher distribution to scalar credit on individual tokens. Such credit indicates whether a token should gain or lose probability, yet leaves the corresponding redistribution unspecified. We recast OPD as teacher-guided probability transport and propose RouteOPD (Routed On-Policy Distillation), which decomposes local teacher--student disagreement into student-excess sources and teacher-deficit destinations and couples them into explicit transport pairs. RouteOPD optimizes pairwise log-odds toward jointly realizable targets obtained from a bounded teacher potential, while adapting the transport budget to the concentration of teacher demand. This formulation directs updates toward teacher-preferred destinations and controls their magnitude within a single transport operator. Experiments across four teacher--student settings and four mathematical-reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RouteOPD consistently outperforms sampled reverse-KL OPD, with improvements accompanied by higher routing fidelity and lower background leakage. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of explicitly modeling probability transport in on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RouteOPD（Routed On-Policy Distillation），将on-policy蒸馏重新定义为教师引导的概率传输问题。通过分解教师-学生分布间的分歧为"学生过剩源"和"教师不足目的地"，并构建显式传输对来优化成对log-odds，从而指引更新向教师偏好方向移动并控制更新幅度。在四个教师-学生场景和四个数学推理基准上，RouteOPD持续优于采样reverse-KL OPD。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏方法中，高效采样目标将教师分布简化为单个token上的标量信用（credit），只能指示token概率应增或减，但无法指明对应的概率重新分配（redistribution）方向和去处，导致蒸馏效率受限。
AI.method: 将on-policy蒸馏重构为教师引导的概率传输问题；将局部教师-学生分歧分解为学生过剩源和教师不足目的地，并将两者耦合成显式传输对；优化成对log-odds趋向由有界教师势函数得到的联合可实现目标；同时根据教师需求集中度自适应调整传输预算。
AI.result: 在四个教师-学生设置和四个数学推理基准上，RouteOPD一致优于采样reverse-KL OPD，且改进伴随着更高的路由保真度和更低的背景泄漏。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模on-policy蒸馏中的概率传输是有效的，能够更精确地指引蒸馏方向并控制更新幅度，为提升蒸馏性能提供了新范式。

title: TV-Regulated OPD: Direction Matters in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) facilitates the transfer of knowledge from domain expert to student in the post-training phase of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, the supervision signals in mainstream OPD methods suffer from high variance and noise which is generally instable during training. In this work, we systematically investigated what really matters to the performance and the fundamental mechanisms behind the instability during training. We found that retaining only the sign of token-level advantages is sufficient to achieve the performance comparable to standard OPD. Meanwhile, smoother and bounded advantages can stabilize the training process without sacrificing its performance. These motivated us to shape the advantages using the Total Variation (TV) and propose a robust TV regulated On-Policy Distillation (TV-OPD) method. Benefiting from the bounded and diminished advantages, TV-OPD exhibits stable training dynamics and steady late-stage performance. We conducted comprehensive experiments and found that, across various settings, TV-OPD consistently achieved better performance and lower variance in the late-stage of training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TV-OPD方法，通过对token级优势进行Total Variation正则化处理（保留符号并限制幅度），解决了LLM后训练阶段On-Policy Distillation中监督信号高方差、高噪声导致的训练不稳定的问题，在多种设置下取得了更优的性能和更低的训练方差。
AI.motivation: 主流On-Policy Distillation方法的监督信号存在高方差和高噪声，导致训练过程不稳定。作者希望探究影响性能和训练不稳定性的根本机制，并找到一种既能保持性能又能稳定训练的方法。
AI.method: 首先系统分析了OPD中真正影响性能的因素，发现只需保留token级优势的符号即可获得与标准OPD相当的性能；同时更平滑、有界的优势函数可以稳定训练。基于此，作者利用Total Variation（全变差）设计优势函数，提出了TV-OPD（Total Variation正则化的On-Policy Distillation）方法。
AI.result: 在多种实验设置下，TV-OPD相比标准OPD在训练后期一致地取得了更好的性能和更低的方差，展现出稳定的训练动态和稳定的后期性能。
AI.conclusion: 有界且递减的优势设计（如基于Total Variation的形状化处理）是同时实现高蒸馏性能与稳定训练的关键，TV-OPD为LLM后训练阶段的知识蒸馏提供了一种鲁棒且有效的方案。

title: Geometry-Aware Bayesian Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning on the Stiefel Manifold via Stein Variational Gradient Descent
comment: Accepted at the 26th IEEE International Conference on Data Mining (ICDM 2026)
summary: Several geometry-aware approaches to low-rank adaptation have emerged for parameter-efficient fine-tuning of large pre-trained models. These methods aim to take full advantage of the geometric structure of low-rank manifolds for improving the efficiency in subspace utilization and reducing redundancy by enforcing orthogonality constraints during optimization. The strong empirical results of these techniques have motivated further study into whether predictions from such geometry-based adaptation methods could be overconfident. In this paper, we build on the singular value decomposition factorization of adapters to develop a framework based on Stein variational gradient descent (SVGD). In this formulation, the low-rank matrices are transported along the Stiefel manifold to match the targeted distributions while retaining their crucial geometric structure.
