Since this geometry-aware SVGD approach provides multiple solutions during inference, it supports uncertainty quantification and produces better-calibrated adapters on the Stiefel manifold. Extensive experiments show that our method delivers strong model calibration and attains higher prediction accuracy than SVGD and related uncertainty estimation methods that are formulated in Euclidean space.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）的几何感知低秩适配框架，在Stiefel流形上传输低秩矩阵以匹配目标分布，从而实现不确定性量化并生成校准更好的适配器，实验表明该方法在模型校准和预测精度上优于欧几里得空间中的SVGD及相关方法。
AI.motivation: 现有几何感知的低秩适应方法通过正交约束在低秩流形上优化，虽取得强经验结果，但对基于几何的自适应方法预测是否过于自信（overconfident）缺乏研究。本文旨在解决这一校准问题。
AI.method: 基于适配器的奇异值分解（SVD）分解，构建一个基于SVGD的框架，将低秩矩阵沿Stiefel流形传输以匹配目标分布，同时保留其关键的几何结构，支持推理阶段的多次采样以进行不确定性量化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该方法在Stiefel流形上生成了校准更好的适配器，提供了强模型校准效果，并在预测精度上优于欧几里得空间中公式化的SVGD及相关不确定性估计方法。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知的流形SVGD方法不仅能保持低秩流形的几何结构，还能通过多解推理实现不确定性量化，从而在模型校准和精度方面超越欧几里得空间方法，为参数高效微调中的可靠预测提供了新路径。

title: Miles v0.1: Production-Level Post-Training
summary: We present Miles v0.1, a full-stack, production-ready system for frontier post-training. Building upon the clean design of slime, Miles designs each stage of the reinforcement-learning (RL) training loop around a single principle: components should be verified, clean, and customizable. With accuracy, efficiency, reliability, and scalability as first-class goals, Miles aims to make frontier-scale RL accessible to researchers and enterprises alike. This report walks through the system end to end: rollout engines built on SGLang, a trainer with a choice of two backends (NVIDIA Megatron-LM and PyTorch FSDP), and three weight-synchronization transports for different deployment topologies. Beyond full-parameter RL, Miles also supports LoRA RL, on-policy distillation, supervised fine-tuning, and true-on-policy rollout-training alignment, and extends the same architecture to diffusion models. We close with an end-to-end case study: fully asynchronous agentic RL on a GLM-5.2 744B-A40B model over terminal-use coding tasks, running on 64 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs with a median step time of 263 seconds over the first 30 measured steps. Miles is open-sourced at https://github.com/radixark/miles, with the project website at https://miles.radixark.com.

AI.tldr: Miles v0.1是一个全栈、生产就绪的前沿后训练系统，基于"组件应可验证、干净、可定制"的原则设计，支持多种RL训练后端和权重同步方案，覆盖全参数RL、LoRA RL、蒸馏、SFT及扩散模型，并在GLM-5.2 744B-A40B模型上进行了端到端agentic RL验证。
AI.motivation: 使前沿规模的强化学习（RL）训练对研究者和企业用户都更加可及，通过提供准确、高效、可靠且可扩展的系统来弥合前沿后训练所需的工程复杂度。
AI.method: 基于slime的简洁设计，围绕"组件应可验证、干净、可定制"的原则构建RL训练循环的每个阶段；系统包括基于SGLang的rollout引擎、支持NVIDIA Megatron-LM和PyTorch FSDP两种后端的训练器，以及三种适配不同部署拓扑的权重同步传输方式；此外还支持LoRA RL、on-policy蒸馏、SFT、真正的on-policy rollout-训练对齐，并将相同架构扩展到扩散模型。
AI.result: 在64块NVIDIA GB300 GPU上，对GLM-5.2 744B-A40B模型进行终端编码任务的全异步agentic RL，前30步中位步时长为263秒。
AI.conclusion: Miles作为一个开源的全栈后训练系统，已验证其在前沿规模RL训练上的可行性和高效性，项目已开源。

title: IPM-FM: A Foundation Model with Consensus Feature Selection for Industrial Process Monitoring
summary: Industrial process monitoring is fundamental to the safety and economic performance of modern process plants. Current practice remains a one-task-one-model paradigm that is label-inefficient and prone to degradation under operating drift. Foundation models have reshaped language, vision, and generic time-series forecasting, but it has not been adapted to industrial process monitoring. This setting poses domain-specific challenges, including safety-critical decisions and asymmetric sampling between process variables and laboratory measurements. We propose the industrial process monitoring foundation model (IPM-FM). It first learns general-purpose representations from unlabeled industrial process data through self-supervised pretraining, then adapts to specific monitoring tasks using a small amount of task-labeled data, and finally produces calibrated predictions through an uncertainty-aware prediction head. IPM-FM integrates a self-supervised Informer backbone with a multi-criteria consensus feature selector, a recursive lag-feature regression head, and a calibrated Monte Carlo dropout uncertainty module. On a seven-year hydrotreater dataset for diesel flash-point soft sensing, IPM-FM attains an RMSE of 2.99, $R^2$ of 0.50, and 97\% coverage of its 95\% predictive interval, outperforming the strongest classical and from-scratch sequence baselines by 8.3\% and 14.6\% in RMSE respectively, supporting the viability of a unified pretraining--adaptation framework for industrial process monitoring.

AI.tldr: 本文提出工业过程监控基础模型（IPM-FM），通过自监督预训练学习通用表征，再用少量任务标注数据适配特定监控任务，最后通过不确定性感知预测头输出校准预测。在七年加氢处理装置柴油闪点软测量数据集上，RMSE为2.99，R²为0.50，预测区间覆盖率97%，相较最强经典基线和从头序列基线分别提升8.3%和14.6%的RMSE。
AI.motivation: 当前工业过程监控采用"一任务一模型"范式，存在标注效率低且在运行漂移下易性能退化的问题。虽然基础模型已在语言、视觉和通用时间序列预测领域取得突破，但尚未适配到工业过程监控，该场景具有安全关键决策和过程变量与实验室测量之间存在非对称采样等独特挑战。
AI.method: IPM-FM包含三个核心模块：自监督预训练的Informer主干网络用于学习通用过程表征；多准则共识特征选择器用于筛选相关特征；递归滞后特征回归头完成任务适配；以及带校准的蒙特卡洛Dropout不确定性模块生成可靠预测区间。整体采用"预训练—适配"两阶段框架。
AI.result: 在七年加氢处理装置柴油闪点软测量数据集上，IPM-FM达到RMSE 2.99、R² 0.50、95%预测区间覆盖率97%，RMSE较最强经典基线和从头训练的序列基线分别降低8.3%和14.6%。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明统一的自监督预训练—任务适配框架在工业过程监控中切实可行，验证了基础模型范式在该领域的应用潜力，为未来工业过程监控提供了一种更具泛化能力和标注效率的新路径。

title: Geographically Regularized AUC-Maximizing Personalized Federated Learning
summary: Accurate diagnostic and risk-prediction models are important for supporting clinical decision-making during infectious disease outbreaks. However, privacy and governance requirements may restrict patient-level data sharing across healthcare institutions, and data distributions often vary. Moreover, AUC is widely used to evaluate discriminative performance, motivating its direct optimization in model development. We propose geographically regularized AUC-maximizing personalized federated learning (GrAUC-PFL), which directly optimizes a smooth pairwise AUC surrogate to learn personalized models while keeping patient-level data local and accounting for institutional heterogeneity. Graph-based regularization encourages geographically neighboring institutions to have similar coefficient vectors while retaining a personalized models. Simulations and a real-data application suggest improved discriminative performance, particularly when geographically neighboring institutions have similar data-generating characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种地理正则化的AUC最大化个性化联邦学习方法（GrAUC-PFL），在保护患者数据隐私的前提下，直接优化平滑的成对AUC替代损失来学习个性化模型，并通过图正则化使地理位置邻近的医疗机构保持相似的模型系数，从而提升传染病暴发期间诊断和风险预测模型的判别性能。
AI.motivation: 传染病暴发期间需要准确的诊断和风险预测模型支持临床决策，但跨机构的患者级数据共享受隐私和治理约束限制，且各机构间数据分布存在异质性；同时AUC作为广泛使用的判别性能评估指标，需要在模型开发中直接优化，现有方法难以同时解决这些问题。
AI.method: 提出GrAUC-PFL框架，采用联邦学习范式保持患者数据本地化，直接优化平滑的成对AUC替代损失函数，并为每个机构学习个性化模型；利用图正则化（graph-based regularization）鼓励地理邻近的医疗机构拥有相似的系数向量，同时保留模型的个性化特征。
AI.result: 通过模拟研究和真实数据应用，该方法在判别性能上较现有方法有所提升，尤其当地理邻近机构具有相似的数据生成特征时，改进效果更为显著。
AI.conclusion: GrAUC-PFL能够在满足隐私和数据治理要求的同时，有效应对机构间异质性，直接优化AUC并利用地理邻近信息提升传染病诊断与风险预测模型的判别性能。

title: Equivariance Breaks the Learning Rate
summary: Equivariant networks are commonly trained with Adam, yet recent work reports that matrix-structured optimizers such as Muon can perform better on these architectures without explaining why. We identify one source of this difference inside equivariant linear layers. Each irrep block learns a channel-mixing matrix $W_l$ shared across its $2l+1$ components, giving the expanded map $W_l \otimes I_{2l+1}$. For a single application of the layer, the gradient of $W_l$ sums $2l+1$ outer product contributions and has rank at most $2l+1$. Adam rescales stored weights individually without using the irrep boundaries, so one learning rate can produce different spectral step sizes across blocks within a layer. We address this mismatch by normalizing each block update separately, without introducing a new hyperparameter. This changes only the scale of the update, leaving Adam's moment estimates and its direction within each block unchanged. We evaluate the mechanism in a controlled $\mathrm{SO}(3)$-equivariant model with a matched dense control and in an e3nn interatomic potential model trained on rMD17 and MD22. The toy setup isolates a mismatch that grows with width while the dense control shows no corresponding growth. In the interatomic potential model, block normalization and tuning Adam's momentum coefficients independently improve performance, but neither alone matches Muon. Combined, they make Adam competitive with Muon on all datasets, indicating that blockwise step control and momentum accumulation account for much of Muon's advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示等变网络中Adam与Muon优化器性能差异的根源在于等变线性层中irrep块的梯度结构特殊性，并提出逐块归一化更新（不引入新超参数）来解决该失配问题，使Adam在多个数据集上与Muon表现相当。
AI.motivation: 等变网络通常用Adam训练，但近期研究发现Muon等矩阵结构优化器在这些架构上表现更好，原因尚不明确。作者希望找到这一差异的根源，并据此改进Adam使其在等变网络中也能达到Muon的性能。
AI.method: 在等变线性层中，每个irrep块学习一个跨2l+1个分量共享的信道混合矩阵，梯度秩最多为2l+1。Adam对每个权重单独缩放而不考虑irrep边界，导致同一层内不同块的谱步长不一致。作者通过对每个块单独归一化更新来修复此问题，不引入新超参数，仅改变更新的尺度，保留Adam的动量估计和块内方向。
AI.result: 在受控的SO(3)等变模型和e3nn原子间势模型（rMD17和MD22数据集）上进行评估。玩具实验显示失配随宽度增长而密集对照组无此增长。块归一化和调整Adam动量系数能独立提升性能，但单独使用均不如Muon；两者结合后Adam在所有数据集上与Muon相当。
AI.conclusion: 逐块步长控制和动量累积是Muon在等变网络中优势的主要来源。通过块归一化更新并配合调优的Adam动量系数，可消除Adam与Muon之间的性能差距，无需引入新超参数或改变优化器架构。

title: MLIP Detective: Active Failure Mode Discovery Beyond Benchmark Scores for Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
summary: Universal machine-learning interatomic potentials (u-MLIPs) aim to generalize across diverse configurations. Benchmarks enable reproducible evaluation but may not expose failures outside their predefined scope. Here, we show that physics-informed search can complement benchmark-based evaluation by uncovering hidden failure modes. We introduce MLIP Detective, an agentic framework for active failure mode discovery. Starting from benchmark evidence, MLIP Detective generates falsifiable, physics-informed failure hypotheses, screens them with inexpensive simulations, and escalates only the most suspicious cases to human experts together with proposed verification protocols. Without issue-specific prompting, MLIP Detective identified and characterized a systematic anomaly in MACE-MPA-0: the model predicted some relaxed adsorbate-surface systems involving O- or F-containing adsorbates to be higher in energy than their corresponding separated fragments. Using cross-model comparisons, MLIP Detective further inferred a likely training-data origin for the anomaly, consistent with recent reports.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MLIP Detective框架，通过物理信息驱动的搜索主动发现通用机器学习原子间势（u-MLIPs）在基准测试范围之外的隐藏失败模式。该框架无需针对性提示，即自动识别了MACE-MPA-0模型中含O/F吸附物体系的系统性异常。
AI.motivation: 现有的u-MLIPs基准测试虽然能实现可重复评估，但无法暴露超出其预定义范围的失败场景。因此需要一种补充方法，主动发现模型在未知领域中的隐藏缺陷。
AI.method: 提出MLIP Detective代理框架，包含三个步骤：(1)基于基准测试证据生成可证伪的物理信息失败假设；(2)通过低成本模拟筛选这些假设；(3)将最可疑的案例升级给人类专家，并附上验证协议建议。
AI.result: MLIP Detective在没有问题特定提示的情况下，成功识别并刻画了MACE-MPA-0模型的系统性异常——某些含O或F吸附物的弛豫吸附物-表面体系能量高于对应分离碎片。通过跨模型对比进一步推断该异常可能源于训练数据，且与近期报告一致。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息搜索可作为基准评估的重要补充手段，为发现u-MLIPs的隐藏失败模式提供了一种自动化、可扩展的解决方案。

title: Environments as Scaffold: Enriching Feedback to Bootstrap Self-Evolving Agents in Long-Horizon Tasks
summary: Large Language Models demonstrate remarkable proficiency in static reasoning, yet training them as autonomous agents through Reinforcement Learning (RL) for long-horizon tasks is often hindered by severe reward sparsity. While conventional \textit{agent-side warming} up via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) can alleviate this, it is frequently limited by data scarcity and constrained exploration. To address this, we propose a paradigm shift to \textit{environment-side adaptation} by constructing \textbf{F}eedback-\textbf{E}nriched \textbf{E}nvironments (\textbf{FEEs}). Through a pilot study, we establish a feedback design strategy that reformulates environments by transitioning from action guidance to observation enrichment during the later stages of both intra-episode exploration and inter-episode evolution. Large-scale experiments on SciWorld and BFCL benchmarks using various Qwen3 model scales and RL algorithms such as GRPO, GSPO, and DAPO demonstrate that FEEs consistently yield performance improvements over standard settings. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that training with FEEs \textbf{(1)} stabilizes training dynamics by reducing entropy volatility, \textbf{(2)} facilitates proactive state-space exploration in difficult tasks, \textbf{(3) }ensures the internalization of environmental guidance into policy weights rather than acting as a mere inference-time prior, and \textbf{(4) }identifies intra-group feedback consistency as a critical boundary for stable optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出环境侧适应的新范式FEEs，通过构建反馈增强环境来缓解智能体强化学习中的奖励稀疏问题，在SciWorld和BFCL基准上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在静态推理上表现出色，但通过强化学习训练为长时程任务的自主智能体时，常受严重的奖励稀疏问题困扰。传统的智能体侧预热（SFT）虽能缓解，但受限于数据稀缺和探索受限。
AI.method: 提出范式转变：从智能体侧适应转向环境侧适应，构建反馈增强环境（FEEs）。设计策略是重构环境，从动作引导转向观测丰富化，覆盖剧集内探索和剧集间演化的后期阶段。使用多种Qwen3模型规模和RL算法（GRPO、GSPO、DAPO）在SciWorld和BFCL基准上进行大规模实验。
AI.result: FEEs在标准设置上持续带来性能提升。分析表明：训练稳定化（熵波动降低）、促进困难任务中的主动状态空间探索、确保环境引导内化为策略权重而非仅作为推理时先验、发现组内反馈一致性是稳定优化的关键边界。
AI.conclusion: 环境侧适应（FEEs）是缓解智能体RL奖励稀疏问题的有效新路径，其效果优于传统智能体侧SFT预热，具备普遍适用性和训练稳定性优势。

title: Stochastically Perturbed Weights: Ensembles from Deterministic Machine-Learning Weather Models
comment: 57 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables. Submitted to Artificial Intelligence for the Earth Systems (AMS). Code: https://github.com/MeteoSwiss/ai-models-ensembles (v1.0.0)
summary: Machine-learning weather models (MLWMs) now match or outperform operational numerical weather prediction (NWP) at global medium-range forecasting, at far lower inference cost. Many deployed MLWMs are deterministic, producing a single forecast with no estimate of its own uncertainty, whereas a growing family of trained-probabilistic models generate calibrated ensembles directly, at the price of a dedicated training run. We ask instead how much uncertainty can be extracted from a deterministic checkpoint that already exists, without retraining it. Where physical ensembles represent model uncertainty by stochastically perturbing parametrisation tendencies, we perturb the network's raw weight tensors at inference time, a scheme we call stochastically perturbed weights (SPW). We also ask whether it works, where and on which scales to inject the noise, and where it fails. A three-phase ablation across four deterministic backbones, Aurora, GraphCast, SFNO, and AIFS, selects one production baseline per model, benchmarked against the trained-probabilistic AIFS-ENS, FourCastNet 3 and Atlas as well as the operational ECMWF ensemble (IFS-ENS) over 112 initialisation times. At a 240 h (10-day) lead time the SPW ensembles reach continuous ranked probability skill scores (CRPSS) between 0.04 and 0.13 below the best trained-probabilistic baseline, at zero marginal training cost. No injection site works across models: the productive tensor group is architecture-specific, so SPW is at present a tuning procedure rather than a plug-and-play recipe. Its main failure mode is a coherent whole-field offset that overdisperses the domain mean, and restricting the noise to coarse scales or perturbing the initial conditions each repair part of it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为"随机扰动权重"(SPW)的方法，在推理时对已训练好的确定性机器学习天气预报模型的权重张量进行随机扰动，以提取不确定性估计，无需重新训练。该方法在四个确定性基础模型上进行了三阶段消融实验，结果表明SPW能以零边际训练成本达到接近专用概率模型的集合预报技能，但最佳噪声注入位置因模型架构而异，且存在全场偏移导致过度离散的主要失效模式。
AI.motivation: 机器学习天气预报模型(MLWMs)在中长期全球预报中已媲美甚至超越传统数值天气预报，但许多部署的确定性模型无法提供自身的不确定性估计。专门训练的概率模型虽能生成校准集合，但需要额外的训练资源。作者希望探索如何从已有的确定性检查点中提取不确定性，而无需重新训练。
AI.method: 借鉴物理集合中随机扰动参数化趋势的思想，在推理时对网络的原始权重张量施加随机扰动，即SPW方法。作者对Aurora、GraphCast、SFNO和AIFS四个确定性基础模型进行三阶段消融实验，选取每模型一个生产基线，与AIFS-ENS、FourCastNet 3、Atlas以及ECMWF操作集合(IFS-ENS)在112个初始时刻上进行对比基准测试。
AI.result: 在240小时(10天)预报时效下，SPW集合的连续排名概率技能分数(CRPSS)比最优的专用概率基线低0.04至0.13，但边际训练成本为零。没有一种噪声注入位置能在所有模型上通用——有效的张量组依架构而异。主要失效模式是产生连贯的全场偏移，导致域均值过度离散，将噪声限制在粗尺度或扰动初始条件可部分修复此问题。
AI.conclusion: SPW目前是一种需要调参的流程而非即插即用的通用方案，但它为从现有确定性模型中提取不确定性提供了有前景的低成本途径，其局限性(如全场偏移)也可通过尺度限制或初始条件扰动等策略部分缓解。

title: Topological Fraud Detection in Latent Transaction Spaces
summary: Working entirely on topologically anonymized embeddings, we perform fraud detection using iterative rounds of unsupervised filtering followed by supervised sniping. The result is an ultra-low latency privacy--preserving triage that allows institutions to flag suspicious activity without compromising Personally Identifiable Information.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种在拓扑匿名化嵌入上进行欺诈检测的方法，通过迭代的无人监督过滤和有监督狙击相结合，实现超低延迟的隐私保护分类，使机构能够在不泄露个人身份信息（PII）的情况下标记可疑活动。
AI.motivation: 欺诈检测需要在保护用户个人身份信息（PII）的前提下高效进行，传统方法在隐私和延迟之间存在权衡，亟需一种既能保护隐私又能实现快速检测的方案。
AI.method: 在拓扑匿名化嵌入（topologically anonymized embeddings）上执行欺诈检测，采用迭代式的两阶段流程：先进行无监督过滤以缩减候选范围，再进行有监督的分类狙击（sniping）以精准标记可疑活动。
AI.result: 实现了超低延迟的隐私保护型欺诈检测分诊（triage），在完全匿名化的数据表示上完成整个检测流程。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在保护个人身份信息的同时，能够高效、快速地完成欺诈活动的初步筛查与标记，实现了隐私与性能的兼顾。

title: Not All Variables Agree: Reliability-Aware Variable-Wise Gradient Surgery for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
summary: In data-driven training, multivariate time-series forecasting is usually optimized with a scalar loss averaged over samples, variables, and horizons. This averaging is convenient, but the optimizer sees only the aggregated gradient, which does not reveal whether the variable-wise contributions align or oppose one another. To quantify how often this disagreement arises, we measure the variable-wise gradients directly and find that 30.6% of their pairwise cosine similarities are negative on average across seven datasets. However, conflict and harm are not the same thing. Under shared training 35 of the 64 variables do worse than a full-input single-target oracle, and the harmed fraction is not reliably predicted by how often gradients conflict. We propose Per-Variable Surgery (PV-Surgery), an optimizer-side training strategy for backbones with cache-compatible layers. One backward pass builds variable-wise gradient proxies from output-side signals and keeps the pointwise forecasting loss. Reliability-aware selection targets layers whose proxy sums closely approximate their shared-gradient slices. Conditional pooling forms anchor and conflict pools without dropping variables. Common-direction surgery aligns variable or pooled gradients with their normalized mean and restores input norms to avoid reweighting. In experiments across five backbones, seven datasets, and four horizons, PV-Surgery lowers MSE by 3.61% and MAE by 2.93% on average. For multivariate forecasting, this indicates that the variable-wise structure hidden by mean-loss training is a usable optimization signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对多变量时间序列预测的优化器端训练策略PV-Surgery，通过分析变量级别的梯度冲突来改进训练过程，在五个骨干网络、七个数据集和四个预测视野上平均降低MSE 3.61%和MAE 2.93%。
AI.motivation: 在多变量时间序列预测中，传统的均值损失训练只让优化器看到聚合梯度，无法判断各变量对梯度的贡献是方向一致还是相互冲突。研究发现30.6%的变量对梯度余弦相似度为负，且64个变量中有35个在共享训练下不如全输入单目标基准模型表现，但梯度冲突频率并不能可靠预测性能受损的程度，说明需要更细致的优化策略。
AI.method: 提出了Per-Variable Surgery (PV-Surgery)优化器端训练策略：(1)通过一次反向传播从输出端信号构建变量级梯度代理，保留逐点预测损失；(2)可靠性感知选择机制挑选代理和接近共享梯度切片的层；(3)条件池化形成锚定池和冲突池而不会丢弃变量；(4)公共方向调整使变量或池化梯度对齐到其归一化均值，并恢复输入范数以避免重新加权。
AI.result: 在五个骨干网络、七个数据集和四个预测视野的实验上，PV-Surgery平均降低MSE 3.61%和MAE 2.93%，验证了变量级结构作为优化信号的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 多变量预测中均值损失训练所隐藏的变量级结构是一个可用的优化信号，通过PV-Surgery利用该信号可以显著提升预测性能。

title: Certified Topological Interaction in Neural Representations: Class Disentanglement Is Mostly Pairwise
comment: 35 pages, 9 figures, 3 tables. Code and measurement records: https://github.com/sushovan4/disentanglement
summary: Class disentanglement (the separation of a representation's class-conditional point clouds along depth and over training) is usually read off descriptive curves. We measure it as certified topological interaction between labeled point clouds, using the recently introduced Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile: the Euler characteristic of the overlap of the clouds' ball unions as a function of scale, computed by one Alpha-complex sweep with no boundary-matrix reduction. Every number carries a test: exact permutation tests in both directions, a guarded separation certificate, and a paired test for the comparative claims applications make. Across 111 trained networks and 52,650 certified measurements, disentanglement is depth-graded and concentrated in the first epochs, and interaction quotients rank class pairs by confusability (Spearman rho=0.83), on par with cheap separability statistics. In a 96-model factorial population, augmentation is the one training choice that separates classes relative to chance; weight decay compresses the overlap without separating, and depth and width do nothing. The structural finding is one only a k-fold statistic can pose: the joint entanglement of a class triple sits below that of its strongest pair in 97% of triple-layer cells and 99.5% of deep cells, far below a measured null floor, in vision encoders and frozen language models alike. This pairwise dominance is a regularity, not a law: expected from the nesting of overlaps but not forced by geometry, present at initialization and in raw pixels, and manufactured in the last stage alone when a network memorizes random labels. The unnormalized profile mass predicts test accuracy (R^2=0.94), the quotient does not, and neither beats a linear probe. One lesson is reported in full: the paired test must use a scale-free statistic, or it certifies feature-norm dynamics as disentanglement.

AI.tldr: 本文使用交Euler示性数谱（Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile）作为认证拓扑工具，在111个训练网络和52,650个认证测量中量化类解耦现象，发现解耦呈深度分级且集中于早期训练阶段；在96模型因子实验中增强是唯一有效分离类的训练选择；并揭示三元组联合纠缠低于其最强对（成对主导性）这一结构规律。
AI.motivation: 类解耦（class disentanglement）通常只能通过描述性曲线粗略判断，缺乏认证的、可检验的量化度量。现有方法无法提供严格的统计测试来支撑比较性论断，也缺少对类间拓扑相互作用的正式刻画。
AI.method: 采用Intersection Euler Characteristic Profile作为核心度量工具，计算带标签点云球并集的Euler示性数随尺度的变化；支持精确排列检验（双向）、有保护的分离证书和配对检验；在多种网络架构下进行大规模实验测量。
AI.result: 解耦在深度上分级且集中在初始训练epoch；交互商数按易混淆性对类对排序（Spearman rho=0.83）；增强是唯一能将类分开的训练选择；深度和宽度无显著作用；97%的三元层单元和99.5%的深层单元呈现成对主导性；未归一化谱质量预测测试准确率R^2=0.94。
AI.conclusion: 成对主导性是跨视觉编码器和冻结语言模型的规律而非铁律——可由重叠嵌套预期但非几何强制。配对测试必须使用无尺度统计量，否则会把特征范数动态误判为解耦。解耦度量虽丰富，但在线性探针面前不具预测优势。

title: AlphaRJM: Reward-Jump Memory for Stochastic Return-Guided Alpha Discovery
summary: Formulaic alpha discovery is a pool-dependent symbolic search problem in which informative feedback is observed primarily when a complete expression is evaluated. This delayed feedback creates two coupled difficulties: the retained alpha pool does not preserve the full history of realized evaluation feedback, and the value of an intermediate construction action is uncertain because its consequence depends on the formula eventually completed. We introduce AlphaRJM, which addresses these difficulties through Reward-Jump Memory, an event-driven latent state that remains fixed during token construction and updates only at terminal evaluation events using the realized pool reward and evaluation outcome, and an action-conditioned SDE return critic that represents future discounted discovery returns with stochastic particles. The particles guide action selection through their mean and uncertainty and are learned using a distributional Bellman objective combining energy-distance matching, mean calibration, and jump regularization. Empirically, AlphaRJM delivers strong and stable gains across multiple equity universes, forecasting horizons, and random seeds, while ablations confirm the complementary roles of persistent evaluation history, stochastic return modeling, and distributional supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AlphaRJM框架，通过Reward-Jump Memory（事件驱动的潜状态）和基于SDE的动作条件回报评论员，解决因子挖掘中奖励延迟导致的池依赖问题，在多个股票域上取得稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 公式化alpha发现是依赖池的符号搜索问题，反馈仅在完整表达式被评估时出现。这种延迟反馈导致两个难题：alpha池未保留完整评估历史，且中间构建动作的价值因最终公式的不确定性而难以判断。
AI.method: 引入Reward-Jump Memory（在token构建期间保持不变、仅在终端评估事件时利用池奖励和评估结果更新的潜状态），以及动作条件的SDE回报评论员（用随机粒子表示未来折现发现收益，通过能量距离匹配、均值校准和跳跃正则化的分布Bellman目标学习）。
AI.result: 在多个股票域、预测周期和随机种子下表现出强劲且稳定的性能提升，消融实验证实了持久评估历史、随机收益建模和分布监督的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: AlphaRJM通过解决延迟反馈带来的历史信息丢失与中间动作价值不确定性问题，显著提升了公式化alpha发现的性能与稳定性。

title: Leveraging Cardiac Imaging to Improve ECG-Based Detection of Chagas Disease in Resource-Constrained Settings
summary: Chagas disease is a major cause of cardiomyopathy in Latin America. Cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging can characterize its structural abnormalities, but scanners and expert readers remain scarce in endemic regions. Electrocardiography (ECG) is inexpensive and widely available, yet structural disease must be inferred indirectly from electrical signals. We propose to transfer CMR-derived structural knowledge to ECG through contrastive pre-training. Using 63,193 paired ECG-CMR examinations from the UK Biobank, we align an ECG encoder with a clinically grounded CMR embedding space using an asymmetric InfoNCE objective. Despite seeing no Chagas cases during pre-training, the resulting representation improves ECG-based Chagas detection. Across CODE-15% and SaMi-Trop, a frozen linear probe achieves an AUROC of 0.851 and sensitivity at the top 5% of predicted risk (Top5%-TPR) of 0.427 in five-fold cross-validation, compared with 0.827 and 0.377 for an unaligned ECG-FM baseline. On the PhysioNet/CinC 2025 Challenge test set, our model obtains the highest AUROC on SaMi-Trop-3 and the best ELSA-Brasil challenge score among the three top-performing methods, indicating that imaging-supervised ECG representations can generalize to populations and settings beyond the pre-training distribution.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出通过对比预训练将CMR影像的结构知识迁移到ECG表征中。利用英国生物库的63,193对ECG-CMR数据，使用非对称InfoNCE目标对齐ECG编码器与CMR嵌入空间，使ECG模型在未见过的恰加斯病检测任务上取得显著提升，证明了影像监督的ECG表征可泛化到预训练分布之外的场景。
AI.motivation: 恰加斯病是拉丁美洲心肌病的主要原因，CMR能表征其结构异常但设备与专家缺乏；ECG便宜普及但只能间接推断结构疾病，因此需要让ECG具备从影像中获得的结构认知能力。
AI.method: 使用UK Biobank中63,193对配对的ECG-CMR检查数据进行对比预训练，通过非对称InfoNCE目标函数将ECG编码器与基于临床的CMR嵌入空间进行对齐对齐。
AI.result: 在CODE-15%和SaMi-Trop上，冻结线性探针AUROC达0.851，Top5%-TPR达0.427，优于未对齐的ECG-FM基线（0.827和0.377）。在PhysioNet/CinC 2025挑战赛测试集上取得SaMi-Trop-3最高AUROC及ELSA-Brasil最佳挑战分数。
AI.conclusion: 尽管预训练阶段未见过任何恰加斯病病例，影像监督的ECG表征仍能有效泛化到恰加斯病检测任务中，表明该方法可推广到预训练分布之外的多样人群与场景。

title: Multi-Level-Set-Based Physics-Driven Neural Network to Solve 3-D Inverse Scattering Problems
summary: This paper proposes a level-set-based physics-driven neural network solver (LSPDNN) for 3-D electromagnetic inverse scattering. To mitigate boundary blurring and reconstruction artifacts in voxel-wise contrast reconstruction, the proposed solver exploits the piecewise homogeneity of practical scatterers by representing unknown targets with multiple coordinate-dependent neural level-set components. Specifically, a soft-union multi-material model is proposed to separately describe the object support and material distribution. The global support is formed by the union of multiple level-set components, while the local contrast is determined by normalized component weights and learnable complex permittivity candidates. In addition, a model-consistent total variation (TV) regularization is imposed on the material-region indicators, rather than directly on the reconstructed contrast, to suppress fragmented material assignments without excessively smoothing material interfaces. An adaptive loss balancing strategy is further introduced to reduce the dependence on manually selected regularization weights. For each measurement instance, the neural level-set parameters and material candidates are optimized by minimizing a physics-consistent objective function. Numerical and experimental results demonstrate that LSPDNN can reconstruct scatterers with clear boundaries, more uniform material regions, and substantially reduced background artifacts. The results highlight the advantage of the neural level-set parameterization in challenging 3-D inverse scattering cases involving irregular shapes, closely spaced objects, multiple materials, and measurement noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于水平集的物理驱动神经网络求解器（LSPDNN），用于三维电磁逆散射问题。通过软联合多材料模型和模型一致的TV正则化，实现了具有清晰边界、均匀材料区域和低背景伪影的散射体重建。
AI.motivation: 传统像素级对比度重建方法存在边界模糊和重建伪影问题，难以充分利用实际散射体所具有的分片均匀性先验信息。
AI.method: 利用多个坐标相关的神经水平集分量表示未知目标；提出软联合多材料模型分别描述目标支撑域和材料分布；在材料区域指示器上施加模型一致的TV正则化；引入自适应损失平衡策略减少人工选择正则化权重的依赖。
AI.result: 数值与实验结果表明，LSPDNN能够重建出边界清晰、材料区域更均匀且背景伪影显著减少的散射体，在不规则形状、近距离物体、多材料和测量噪声等挑战性三维逆散射场景中表现优异。
AI.conclusion: 神经水平集参数化在挑战性三维逆散射问题中具有显著优势，为高保真电磁逆散射重建提供了有效方案。

title: Why shared attention vectors fail: a case for outcome-indexed tuning
summary: Dimensional attention in learning is often implemented as a globally shared attention vector, where each stimulus dimension corresponds to a single scalar. These scalars are learned by models through gradient-descent on error, where predictive features acquire more salience. We show that under multi-outcome learning, where models predict more than one outcome, this shared vector becomes unstable; it collapses to its bounds and prevents the models from learning meaningful attentional tunings for learning and generalization. We address this by introducing an outcome-indexed attentional matrix that converts globally shared attentional tuning into an outcome-indexed representation. We present an analysis of the unstable shared vectors and derive the conditions under which it holds. Empirically, three synthetic experiments benchmark the proposed attention matrices and show that they converge to meaningful representations, something shared attention vectors fail to do. These results suggest that outcome-indexed attentional matrices are a general fix for gradient-based attentional processes, which improves models of learning under multi-outcome conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文指出在多结果学习场景下，传统设计中所有维度共享的全局注意力向量会变得不稳定并崩溃到边界值，导致模型无法学习有意义的注意力调谐，因此提出了一种以结果索引的注意力矩阵来解决该问题。
AI.motivation: 在多结果学习（同时预测多个结果）中，标准做法使用全局共享的注意力向量会让每个刺激维度仅对应一个标量，这种共享向量在多结果条件下会不稳定、崩溃到边界，阻碍模型学习有效的注意力调谐与泛化能力。
AI.method: 引入结果索引的注意力矩阵（outcome-indexed attentional matrix），将全局共享的注意力调谐转化为按结果索引的表征；并从理论上分析了共享向量不稳定的条件，随后通过三个合成实验对比两类注意力机制的收敛表现。
AI.result: 理论分析给出了共享注意力向量不稳定的成立条件；三个合成实验表明，结果索引的注意力矩阵能够收敛到有意义的表征，而全局共享的注意力向量则失败。
AI.conclusion: 结果索引的注意力矩阵可作为基于梯度下降的注意力过程在多种结果条件下的一般性修复方案，能有效改善多结果学习模型的注意力学习表现。

title: Target-Independent Micro-Interventions for Predicting Training Response Across Language-Model Families
summary: Benchmark scores describe what a checkpoint can do now, but they do not determine how it will respond to the next training episode. We measure this missing state by branching four short, standardized, target-independent micro-interventions from the same checkpoint and recording their effects in a common capability space. Together with current capability, these responses form L-State; its pulse block supports a flexible direct readout and a structure-preserving operator readout. Under smooth local dynamics, the operator construction admits an end-to-end cross-family bound with explicit source- and target-family coordinate heterogeneity. In three-family leave-one-family-out development, both pulse readouts reduce source-standardized MSE by 39.4% relative to capability alone, while separating the best response and direction estimates. On sealed GLM-4-9B, the direct and operator readouts reduce MSE by 71.8% and 78.3%, respectively, and the operator readout raises sign balanced accuracy from 0.366 to 0.754. On sealed Granite-3.1-8B, the direct readout reaches RMSE 0.544 and a development-fitted action-wise selector reaches 0.554, compared with 1.172 for capability alone. A five-family audit finds that the operator coordinate varies by action and family, and that modeling these deviations improves retrospective held-trajectory prediction. Target-independent interventions therefore expose training-response information that current capability misses, with direct and structured readouts covering complementary transfer regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出L-State框架，通过在能力空间中测量检查点对微型干预的响应来刻画模型对下一个训练回合的反应，从而弥补基准得分无法反映的"训练响应状态"，实验证明该方法在多个模型上显著提升预测精度。
AI.motivation: 基准分数只能描述检查点当前的能力，无法预测它在下一次训练中的响应方式。这一缺失的状态信息对模型训练动态的理解和预测至关重要。
AI.method: 从同一检查点分叉四个短小、标准化、目标无关的微型干预，在共同能力空间中记录其响应效果，与当前能力一起构成L-State。脉冲块支持直接读出和保结构算子读出；在平滑局部动态假设下构造端到端跨家族界。
AI.result: 三家族留一验证中两种读出将标准化MSE降低39.4%；在GLM-4-9B上MSE降低71.8%和78.3%，符号平衡准确率从0.366提升至0.754；在Granite-3.1-8B上RMSE从1.172降至0.544/0.554；五家族审计显示算子坐标随动作和家族变化。
AI.conclusion: 目标无关干预能暴露当前能力遗漏的训练响应信息，直接读出与结构化读出覆盖互补的迁移场景，为理解模型训练动态提供了新的测量维度。

title: Leveraging contextual events on structure-aware next activity prediction
summary: Predictive process monitoring aims at forecasting various aspects of running processes. Among the different tasks, next activity prediction represents the most extensively investigated. However, only a limited number of existing approaches explicitly encode contextual information, i.e., the environmental conditions in which the process is executed, typically modeled through event log attributes or aggregated measures. In this paper, an approach based on the concept of Instance Graphs is introduced. To incorporate contextual process instances, several encoding strategies are proposed and evaluated by measuring their impact on prediction performance. For each encoding strategy, a set of prefix-Instance Graphs is generated and subsequently provided as input to a Graph Neural Network for the classification task. The proposed approach is evaluated on multiple real-world event logs, and the experimental results demonstrate that incorporating contextual process instances benefits prediction performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于实例图（Instance Graphs）的预测性流程监控方法，通过多种编码策略显式融入上下文流程实例信息，并利用图神经网络进行下一活动预测。在多个真实事件日志上的实验证明，融入上下文流程实例能提升预测性能。
AI.motivation: 预测性流程监控旨在预测运行流程的各个方面，其中下一活动预测研究最为广泛。然而，现有方法中仅有少数显式编码了上下文信息（即流程执行的环境条件），而这些上下文通常通过事件日志属性或聚合指标建模，不够充分。因此需要一种能更有效融入上下文流程实例信息的方法来提升预测性能。
AI.method: 基于实例图（Instance Graphs）概念提出新方法。首先提出多种编码策略来融入上下文流程实例，针对每种编码策略生成一组前缀实例图（prefix-Instance Graphs），随后将这些图作为图神经网络（GNN）的输入进行分类预测，以完成下一活动预测任务。通过对比不同编码策略衡量其对预测性能的影响。
AI.result: 在多个真实世界事件日志上进行评估，实验结果一致表明，融入上下文流程实例信息能够带来预测性能的提升，从而验证了所提编码策略和基于实例图方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 基于实例图并采用图神经网络的方法能够有效编码和利用上下文流程实例，显著改善预测性流程监控中下一活动预测的准确性与性能，为未来在流程预测中建模上下文信息提供了可行路径。

title: Suan: Rectifying Direct Preference Safety Alignment in Large Language Models
summary: Integrating robust safety guardrails into Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for delivering helpful yet harmless responses. While proprietary systems exhibit reliable safety controls, their underlying methodologies and trade-offs remain largely undisclosed. Achieving comparable security in open-weight models remains a persistent challenge, as post-trained variants frequently suffer from over-refusal and degraded general quality. To overcome these drawbacks, we introduce Suan, a novel preference optimization algorithm. Unlike existing methods, we formulate the optimization objective directly at the gradient level, bypassing the standard variational derivation. As a result, we obtain more interpretable and robust training dynamics. Extensive evaluations across a diverse suite of competitive baselines and benchmarks demonstrate that Suan achieves superior safety alignment while fully preserving response utility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Suan，一种在梯度层面直接构建优化目标的新型偏好优化算法，用于大语言模型的安全对齐，在不损害响应质量的前提下实现更优的安全性能。
AI.motivation: 开源权重模型在实现与专有系统相当的安全控制方面面临挑战，现有后训练变体常出现过度拒绝（over-refusal）和通用质量下降的问题。
AI.method: Suan算法绕过了标准的变分推导，直接在梯度层面构建优化目标，从而获得更可解释且更稳健的训练动态。
AI.result: 在多个竞争性基线和基准上的广泛评估表明，Suan在实现更优安全对齐的同时，完整保留了响应的实用性。
AI.conclusion: Suan为开源LLM提供了一种无需牺牲响应质量即可实现强大安全护栏的有效解决方案，弥补了开源与专有系统在安全控制上的差距。

title: SUN: Reaching for Novelty in Reinforcement Learning
comment: 39 pages. Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026)
summary: Exploration in reinforcement learning (RL) remains a fundamental challenge. Recent goal-conditioned RL strategies (which select goals to encourage broader state coverage) have shown promising results, but none scores a goal by novelty and reachability jointly: the two signals are traded off by hand, applied in sequence, or one is neglected outright. In this paper, we introduce a reachability-aware goal-selection framework that explicitly integrates these two aspects, and that can be seamlessly incorporated into any off-policy RL algorithm. To this aim, we propose SUccessor-to-Novelty (SUN), an indicator derived from successor value functions to identify goals that are both novel and reachable. We prove that SUN recovers count-based bonuses in the limit, bounds short-horizon hitting probabilities, and provably rejects unreachable goals. We further present an adaptive goal-selection strategy that leverages these properties, and an accurate yet lightweight pseudocount to avoid the overhead of classic methods. We back up all our claims with thorough benchmarks: SUN consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in standard and novel environments with unreachable or hard-to-reach states, irreversible transitions, obstacles, mazes, and unbounded spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SUccessor-to-Novelty (SUN)框架，通过后继值函数派生指标，在目标条件强化学习中联合优化目标的"新颖性"与"可达性"，可无缝集成到任意离策略RL算法中，并在多种环境（不可达状态、障碍、迷宫等）中优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有目标条件RL探索策略未能同时兼顾新颖性与可达性：两种信号要么人工权衡、要么顺序使用、要么完全忽略其中一个，缺乏统一的联合优化框架。
AI.method: 提出SUN指标，由后继值函数推导，用于识别既新颖又可达到的目标。理论上证明SUN可在极限下恢复基于计数的奖励、界定短时域命中概率、并拒绝不可达目标。同时提出自适应目标选择策略及轻量级伪计数方法，避免经典方法的计算开销。
AI.result: 在标准环境及新颖环境（含不可达/难达状态、不可逆转移、障碍、迷宫、无界空间）的基准测试中，SUN一致性地优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: SUN框架成功将新颖性与可达性两个信号统一整合到目标选择中，既具理论保证又具实践效率，为强化学习探索提供了更鲁棒且通用的解决方案。

title: Difficulty-Adaptive Tree-Structured Policy Optimization for Expanding Reasoning Coverage in RLVR
summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has been central to the recent success of Large Reasoning Models. However, while RLVR significantly improves single-sample accuracy, it often fails to expand the model's intrinsic reasoning coverage (pass@k) due to limited exploration during training. To address this, we optimize the structural design of train-time rollouts to enhance pass@k. Our analysis identifies three key design principles: (1) difficulty-adaptive rollout can play an important role in expanding pass@k, beyond serving as an efficiency heuristic; (2) tree-based rollout outperforms parallel sampling in discovering correct answers; and (3) sentence-entropy-guided forking overcomes the localization phenomenon of token-level branching to maximize semantic diversity. Building on these insights, we propose DATPO (Difficulty-Adaptive Sentence-entropy-guided Tree-structured Policy Optimization). DATPO integrates difficulty-adaptive tree search with a sibling-diversity advantage term, explicitly promoting semantic diversity to expand reasoning coverage during training. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that DATPO outperforms baselines especially in pass@k, which directly translates to superior test-time scaling performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DATPO方法，通过难度自适应树搜索和句子熵引导的分支策略来扩大训练时采样覆盖范围，从而提升大语言模型在数学推理中的pass@k表现，并转化为更优的测试时扩展性能。
AI.motivation: RLVR虽显著提升单样本准确率，但由于训练期间探索受限，往往无法扩大模型的内在推理覆盖范围（pass@k），限制了模型在测试时扩展上的潜力。
AI.method: 论文首先识别三个关键设计原则：（1）难度自适应rollout不仅能提升效率，更能扩大pass@k；（2）树状rollout优于并行采样的正确答案发现能力；（3）句子熵引导的分支能克服token级分支的局部化问题以最大化语义多样性。基于这些原则提出DATPO，整合难度自适应树搜索与兄弟多样性优势项，显式促进语义多样性以扩大训练期间的推理覆盖。
AI.result: 在数学推理基准上的实验表明，DATPO在pass@k指标上优于基线方法，并直接转化为更优的测试时扩展（test-time scaling）表现。
AI.conclusion: 通过优化训练时rollout的结构设计（难度自适应+树搜索+语义多样性引导），可以有效扩大模型的推理覆盖范围，从而提升pass@k并增强测试时扩展能力。

title: MoEMB: Scaling Universal Multimodal Embeddings with Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Models
summary: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) increasingly demands encoder's capacity for handling a broad range of tasks and modalities with increased complexity. Prior scaling methods either increase the representation size, retrieval effort, or scales the encoder into a heavy multimodal LLM. Recent works, such as Think-Then-Embed (TTE), explore scaling via reasoning tokens. However, embedding models are hard to scale up: increasing parameters directly tradeoffs for the large training batch size that contrastive learning needs, and retrieval has to be served under tight latency. Moreover, UME tasks are diverse in complexity, where scaling up embedders can bring significant redundant computation. In this work, we propose MOEMB, which instead scales UME along the expert axis through mixture-of-experts (MoE), growing encoder capacity while preserving single-vector, non-autoregressive encoding. Through a systematic study of the design space and training recipes for MoE-based UME, MoEMB sets a new state of the art on both MMEB-V2 and MRMR among models trained on public MMEB-family data: with only 3B active parameters, MoEMB surpasses TTE-based methods with >4x active parameters, using significantly less computes. To further improve the scalability and efficiency, we conduct the first comprehensive study of adaptive computation for MoE-based embedding, spanning diverse strategies across training-based and inference-only methods. Together, these results support expert scaling as an effective and efficient direction for UME, with adaptive computation further improving efficiency for MLLM-based embedding models towards large-scale retrieval and recommendation systems.

AI.tldr: MOEMB是首个将混合专家（MoE）技术系统应用于通用多模态嵌入（UME）模型的工作，通过沿专家维度扩展模型容量，仅用3B激活参数即在MMEB-V2和MRMR基准上超越需4倍以上激活参数的TTE方法，同时保持单向量、非自回归的编码方式。该工作还首次系统研究了MoE嵌入的自适应计算策略，证明专家扩展是UME高效可扩展的有效方向。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态嵌入模型需要处理广泛且复杂度各异的任务，但现有扩展方法存在明显瓶颈：增加参数会牺牲对比学习所需的大批量训练，且检索需满足严格延迟要求。此外，UME任务复杂度差异大，直接扩大编码器会带来大量冗余计算，因此需要更高效的扩展方式。
AI.method: 提出MOEMB，将混合专家（MoE）机制引入多模态嵌入模型，沿专家维度扩展编码器容量，在保持单向量、非自回归编码的同时增加模型能力。论文系统研究了MoE嵌入模型的设计空间与训练策略，并首次对MoE嵌入的自适应计算进行了全面研究，涵盖基于训练和仅推理（inference-only）的多种策略。
AI.result: MOEMB在MMEB-V2和MRMR基准上刷新了基于公开MMEB-family数据训练的模型的最新最优结果：仅用3B激活参数，MOEMB超越了需超过4倍激活参数的TTE方法，同时消耗的计算量显著更少。
AI.conclusion: 专家扩展（expert scaling）是通用多模态嵌入有效且高效的扩展方向，自适应计算可进一步提升基于MLLM的嵌入模型在大规模检索和推荐系统中的推理效率。

title: Neither Adversarial Training Nor Purification: Emergent Adversarial Robustness from Oscillatory Predictive Learning
summary: Adversarial robustness in computer vision is still largely achieved through adversarial training or test-time adversarial purification, both of which introduce significant computational overhead by generating adversarial examples during training or performing iterative denoising at test time. We study whether empirical robustness can instead emerge from architectural and representation-learning inductive biases. We introduce Oscillatory Predictive Learning (OPL), a two-stage framework that combines Artificial Kuramoto Oscillatory Neurons (AKOrN) with predictive self-supervised pretraining using X-PhiNet. Because our default checkpoint uses randomized initial oscillator states, we compare it with other randomized adversarial defense methods that provide precise, reproducible, and strong attack protocols. Experiments on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, with additional corruption evaluation on CIFAR-10-C, demonstrate that our method achieves competitive results under the AutoAttack-rand evaluation protocol. On CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, OPL attains 76.63$\pm$0.76$\%$ and 50.44$\%$ robust accuracy, respectively, under $\ell_\infty$, $ε=8/255$, AutoAttack-rand with EoT $K=20$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出振荡预测学习（OPL）框架，结合人工仓本振荡神经元（AKOrN）和预测性自监督预训练（X-PhiNet），通过在架构和表征学习层面引入归纳偏置来获得对抗鲁棒性，避免了对抗训练或测试时纯化带来的计算开销。在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上分别达到76.63%和50.44%的鲁棒准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有对抗鲁棒性方法主要依赖对抗训练或测试时对抗纯化，两者都会因生成对抗样本或迭代去噪而引入显著的计算开销。作者希望探索能否仅通过架构设计和表征学习的归纳偏置来获得经验鲁棒性，从而避免高额计算成本。
AI.method: 提出两阶段框架OPL：第一阶段使用人工仓本振荡神经元（AKOrN），通过振荡动力学引入固有鲁棒性；第二阶段结合X-PhiNet进行预测性自监督预训练。由于默认检查点使用随机初始振荡器状态，将其与其他随机化对抗防御方法进行对比，采用精确、可复现且强攻击协议（AutoAttack-rand）进行评测。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10和CIFAR-100上，OPL在ℓ∞、ε=8/255、AutoAttack-rand（EoT K=20）协议下分别取得76.63±0.76%和50.44%的鲁棒准确率，并在CIFAR-10-C上额外进行了腐败鲁棒性评估，结果具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，仅通过架构和表征学习的归纳偏置（无需对抗训练或测试时纯化）即可在标准对抗攻击协议下获得具有竞争力的鲁棒性，为高效对抗防御提供了新的研究方向。

title: HOPE: Heterophily-Aware Open-Set Node Classification with Pseudo-Extrapolation
summary: Standard open-set node classification methods rely on the homophily assumption, where connected nodes share labels. However, real-world graphs are often heterophilic, exposing the limitations of current methods and posing new challenges to open-set node classification. On the one hand, cross-class connectivity causes representations from different known or unknown classes to become intertwined after aggregation, undermining their discriminative capacity. On the other hand, structural mixture invalidates threshold-based open-set methods and cross-class feature interpolation, leading to unreliable unknown-class rejection. To address these challenges, we propose HOPE, a Heterophily-aware Open-set node classification method with Pseudo-Extrapolation. To adapt open-set graph neural networks (GNNs) to heterophilic scenarios, HOPE uses a structure-augmented feature initialization layer to capture multi-hop structural patterns. Meanwhile, we design a trustworthy neighborhood aggregation mechanism for standard GNNs to dynamically filter noisy cross-class neighbors. To enhance unknown-class rejection, we introduce a heterophily-guided pseudo-extrapolation strategy. It dynamically maintains known-class centers and extrapolates along cross-class neighborhood displacement directions, synthesizing pseudo-unknown proxies near structurally ambiguous regions. Finally, we optimize the network with joint classification and logit margin regularization, routing synthetic proxies into a dedicated rejection slot without imposing geometric margin constraints in the representation space. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets show that HOPE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art models, validating its effectiveness, robustness, and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HOPE方法，解决异配图（heterophilic）场景下的开集节点分类问题，通过结构增强特征初始化、可信邻居聚合机制和异配引导的伪外推策略，有效提升未知类的判别与拒识能力。
AI.motivation: 现有开集节点分类方法依赖同配性假设（连接节点共享标签），但真实图常具有异配性，导致：(1) 跨类连接使聚合后不同类别（已知或未知）的表征纠缠，判别能力下降；(2) 结构混合使基于阈值的开集方法和跨类特征插值失效，导致未知类拒识不可靠。
AI.method: HOPE包含三大核心组件：(1) 结构增强的特征初始化层，捕获多跳结构模式以适配异配场景；(2) 可信邻居聚合机制，动态过滤嘈杂的跨类邻居；(3) 异配引导的伪外推策略，动态维护已知类中心并沿跨类邻域位移方向外推，合成靠近结构模糊区域的伪未知代理。最后采用联合分类与logit边缘正则化训练，将合成代理路由至专用的拒识槽位，而不在表征空间施加几何边缘约束。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的大量实验表明，HOPE一致优于最先进的现有方法，验证了其有效性、鲁棒性和效率。
AI.conclusion: HOPE通过针对异配图特征设计的开集分类方法，有效解决了跨类连接导致的表征纠缠和阈值拒识失效问题，为异配场景下的开集节点分类提供了新的解决思路。

title: Hyperparameter Scaling Laws Across MoE Sparsity
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models expand model capacity without a proportional increase in training compute, but increasing sparsity makes reliable hyperparameter transfer challenging. In this work, we show that conventional hyperparameter scaling laws are insufficient for ultra-sparse MoEs: the optimal learning rate and batch size vary with activation ratio, and these shifts cannot be explained by either total or activated parameter count alone. To characterize this dependence, we conduct 1,800 pre-training runs spanning six activated-parameter scales and models with up to 6B total non-embedding parameters, processing approximately 20 trillion tokens at a cost of 200,000 equivalent H800 GPU-hours. Our results reconcile conflicting findings in prior work by revealing two scaling regimes. At fixed sparsity, the optimal batch size follows a power-law relationship with training tokens $D$, whereas the optimal learning rate scales with training compute $C$ and remains robust to the allocation between model size and data. Across sparsity levels, the activation ratio $A$ enters both relationships as an additional multiplicative power-law factor. These observations lead to unified hyperparameter scaling laws that transfer across MoE sparsity levels. Large-scale evaluation shows that the scaling form outperforms alternative functional forms. On a held-out ultra-sparse MoE with 12B total parameters and only 1/64 of its experts activated, the predicted hyperparameters remain close to the observed optima, supporting joint extrapolation across model scale and sparsity. Further experiments demonstrate transfer across expert granularities and isolate the effect of activation ratio from that of total expert count.

AI.tldr: 本文通过1,800次预训练实验（约20万亿token，等价20万H800 GPU小时）揭示了超稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型中超参数迁移的新规律：最优学习率与批大小会随激活比率变化，且传统的缩放定律在此场景下失效。作者发现存在两种缩放机制——固定稀疏度下最优批大小与训练token数D呈幂律关系，而最优学习率随训练计算量C缩放；跨稀疏度时，激活比率A作为额外乘性幂律因子进入两者关系，最终形成统一的超参数缩放定律。在12B总参、仅1/64专家激活的held-out超稀疏MoE上，预测的超参数接近实际最优值。
AI.motivation: MoE模型在不按比例增加训练算力的情况下扩展模型容量，但增加稀疏度使得可靠的超参数迁移变得困难。现有研究对超稀疏MoE最优超参数的行为存在矛盾结论，作者旨在揭示其背后的统一缩放规律。
AI.method: 作者开展了1,800次预训练运行，覆盖六个激活参数规模，模型总非嵌入参数最高达6B。通过系统地变化稀疏度、训练token数和模型规模，分析最优批大小和最优学习率随这些变量的缩放行为，并拟合出包含激活比率A在内的统一幂律缩放定律。
AI.result: 实验结果发现两个缩放机制：固定稀疏度下，最优批大小随训练token数D呈幂律缩放，最优学习率随总计算量C缩放（对模型大小与数据的分配比例不敏感）；跨稀疏度时，激活比率A作为额外乘性因子进入两个关系。统一缩放形式在held-out 12B总参、1/64专家激活的超稀疏MoE上预测结果接近实际最优值，并在专家颗粒度和专家总数变化时展现良好的迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 作者提出了一种能够跨MoE稀疏度、模型规模和专家配置迁移的统一超参数缩放定律，解决了以往工作中关于超参数随稀疏度如何变化的矛盾结论，为超大规模稀疏模型的高效训练提供了实用的超参数预测依据。

title: Chimaera: A Mixture-of-Graph-Experts Architecture for Cross-Task and Cross-Dataset Graph Learning
summary: Designing foundation models for graphs is challenging due to the irregular structure of graphs and the different sizes and characteristics of embeddings. Chimaera integrates mixture-of-experts with graph foundation models (GFM). It integrates different GFM architectures, such as graph prompts and linear GNN models. Large language models are used to generate embeddings, and experts can be trained and combined following different strategies, GFMs, embeddings, etc. Furthermore, Chimaera extends existing linear GNNs to support link-level and graph-level tasks in addition to node-level tasks. Empirical analyses are performed on same-task and cross-task experiments with node, link, and graph classification tasks using six benchmark text-attributed graph datasets. The experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of Chimaera and its capabilities for transfer across tasks and datasets. Further insights include the need to use both large and small language models to generate embeddings for the experts, a strong cross-task transferability of simple but effective linear GNNs, and using few samples only to provide strong results.

AI.tldr: Chimaera是一个将混合专家（Mixture-of-Experts）与图基础模型（GFM）相结合的框架，通过集成不同GFM架构（如图提示和线性GNN模型），使用大语言模型生成嵌入，并支持节点、链接和图级别的任务。在六个文本属性图数据集上的实验验证了其跨任务和跨数据集的迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 图的非规则结构以及嵌入的尺寸和特征差异为设计图基础模型带来了挑战，需要一种能够灵活整合多种GFM架构和嵌入策略的统一框架。
AI.method: Chimaera将混合专家机制与图基础模型集成，整合了如图提示和线性GNN等不同GFM架构；利用大语言模型生成嵌入，并按不同策略训练和组合专家模型；此外将现有线性GNN扩展以支持链接级和图级任务。
AI.result: 在同任务和跨任务实验中，Chimaera在节点、链接和图分类任务上表现出有效性，具备跨任务和跨数据集迁移能力。进一步发现包括：需同时使用大型和小型语言模型生成专家嵌入、简单有效的线性GNN具有较强的跨任务迁移性、仅需少量样本即可获得强结果。
AI.conclusion: Chimaera证明了混合专家机制与图基础模型结合的有效性，并提供了关于专家嵌入来源、线性GNN迁移能力和少样本学习的实用见解。

title: BAFF: Bid-Aware Filter Family for Mitigating Training Data Interference in RTB A/B Tests
comment: Accepted as a poster presentation at the OARS Workshop @RecSys 2026. 9 pages, 1 figure, 7 tables
summary: In online A/B tests for real-time bidding (RTB), control and treatment models are typically trained on a shared serving log that includes data generated by the counterpart model. This shared-log training biases each model's training data through two channels: the counterpart model may have selected a different ad from the ad-candidate pool (ad-ranking disagreement) and may have bid a different price (bid-pricing disagreement), potentially distorting the A/B test outcome. Log-splitting eliminates the bias but sacrifices training data; log-sharing retains all data but leaves the bias unaddressed. We formalize the Bid-Aware Filter Family (BAFF), a class of (k,l)-parameterized hard filters that controls tolerance to each channel independently, providing a structured search space between these two extremes. We further propose a three-stage online measurement protocol that enables evaluating data-sharing strategies by their deviation from an interference-free reference model in production. In offline simulation, a (k,l) sweep surfaces operating points with smaller deviation from the interference-free reference model than both log-sharing and log-splitting. In a live RTB deployment on a demand-side platform (DSP), filter-based variants preserve the reference model's business metrics (e.g., CPC, CTR) more closely than both baselines. The best operating point is setting-dependent, underscoring the practical value of the search space itself.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Bid-Aware Filter Family (BAFF)方法，用于解决RTB在线A/B测试中共享日志训练导致的模型间数据偏差问题，通过(k,l)参数化的硬过滤器在"日志切分"和"日志共享"两个极端之间提供结构化搜索空间，并设计了三阶段在线测量协议来评估不同数据共享策略。
AI.motivation: RTB在线A/B测试中，对照组和实验组模型在共享serving log上训练，会通过两个渠道引入数据偏差：广告排序不一致（ad-ranking disagreement）和出价定价不一致（bid-pricing disagreement），从而扭曲A/B测试结果。日志切分可以消除偏差但损失训练数据，日志共享保留全部数据但偏差未解决，缺少两者之间的中间方案。
AI.method: 形式化定义了Bid-Aware Filter Family (BAFF)——一类(k,l)参数化的硬过滤器族，可独立控制对两种不一致渠道的容忍度；提出三阶段在线测量协议，通过对比无干扰参考模型来评估不同数据共享策略在生产环境中的偏差表现。
AI.result: 离线仿真中，(k,l)参数扫描得到的操作点比日志共享和日志切分两个基线更接近无干扰参考模型；在DSP实时RTB部署中，过滤器变体在业务指标（如CPC、CTR）上比两个基线更接近参考模型。
AI.conclusion: 最佳操作点依赖于具体场景设置，这凸显了所提出搜索空间本身的实际价值——它允许从业者根据自身部署情况灵活选择最优的数据共享策略。

title: PAC-Bayesian Bounds for Learning Partially Observed Stochastic Linear Time-Invariant State-Space Systems with Inputs and Sub-Gaussian Noise
summary: In this paper we derive a Probably Approximately Correct (PAC)-Bayesian error bound for partially observed linear time-invariant (LTI) stochastic dynamical systems in state-space form with inputs and sub-Gaussian noise. Such bounds are widespread in machine learning, and they are useful for characterizing the predictive power of models learned from finitely many data points. The bound derived in this paper relates the expectation of prediction errors with the prediction error generated by the model on the data used for learning. In addition, we show that it can also be used to derive bounds for the parameter estimation error. In turn, this allows us to provide finite-sample error bounds for the prediction error and parameter estimation error for a wide class of system identification algorithms. Furthermore, as LTI systems are a sub-class of recurrent neural networks (RNNs), these error bounds could be a first step towards PAC-Bayesian bounds for RNNs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对部分观测的线性时不变（LTI）随机动态系统，推导了PAC-Bayesian误差界，将预测误差的期望与模型在训练数据上的预测误差联系起来，并可用于推导参数估计误差的有限样本界，进而为广泛的系统辨识算法提供预测误差和参数估计误差的界。此外，由于LTI系统是RNN的子类，该工作可为RNN的PAC-Bayesian界提供第一步基础。
AI.motivation: 机器学习中PAC-Bayesian误差界广泛用于刻画从有限数据中学到的模型的预测能力，但将其推广到部分观测的LTI随机动态系统（带输入、次高斯噪声）仍缺乏相关理论成果。作者旨在填补这一空白，为系统辨识算法提供理论保证。
AI.method: 基于PAC-Bayesian理论框架，针对状态空间形式的部分观测LTI随机动态系统，在次高斯噪声假设下推导预测误差的PAC-Bayesian界；进一步将该界扩展到参数估计误差，并应用于广泛的系统辨识算法以获得有限样本误差界。
AI.result: 成功推导出部分观测LTI系统的PAC-Bayesian预测误差界，并证明了该界可进一步用于导出参数估计误差界，从而为多种系统辨识算法提供有限样本误差保证。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为部分观测LTI动态系统提供了统一的PAC-Bayesian理论分析框架，且由于RNN包含LTI系统，该结果有望成为将PAC-Bayesian界推广到RNN的第一步。

title: Adaptive Anisotropic Attention for Axis-Structured Signals
summary: Dense self-attention treats all token pairs as equally plausible before learning, an interaction-isotropic prior that can be mismatched to structured signals. For structured, low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) signals such as EEG, dependencies are organized along the electrode and time axes, and this uniform prior exposes each token to many irrelevant interactions. We introduce Adaptive Anisotropic Attention (AAA), which splits attention into two paths: a temporal path, where each token attends to the tokens of its own electrode across time, and a spatial path, where it attends to the tokens of the other electrodes at the same time step. A small gate predicts, for every token, a convex combination of the two path outputs: two non-negative weights that sum to one. On six EEG downstream tasks, the resulting model, AXON (AXis-factorized Operator Network), improves mean balanced accuracy over a dense baseline under both linear probing and full fine-tuning. We show that both paths (temporal and spatial) are necessary and that the weighted sum beats a hard choice of one path; most of the benefit comes from the gate learning a different temporal/spatial balance at each layer of the network. Controlled audio spectrogram experiments show that axis factorization transfers beyond EEG. These results suggest that aligning attention with the natural axes of structured signals provides a useful inductive bias.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应各向异性注意力（AAA），将注意力分解为时序路径和空间路径，并通过门控机制为每个token学习两条路径的凸组合权重，在EEG等低信噪比结构化信号任务上优于密集注意力基线。
AI.motivation: 密集自注意力在训练前将所有token对视为同样可能的交互，这种各向同性的先验与结构化信号不匹配。对于EEG这类结构化、低信噪比信号，依赖关系沿电极轴和时间轴组织，均匀先验会使每个token暴露于大量无关交互中。
AI.method: 提出自适应各向异性注意力（AAA），将注意力拆分为两条路径：时间路径——每个token关注同一电极上不同时刻的token；空间路径——每个token关注同一时刻其他电极的token。一个小型门控网络为每个token预测两条路径输出的凸组合（两个非负权重和为1），得到AXON（AXis-factorized Operator Network）模型。
AI.result: 在六个EEG下游任务上，AXON在线性探针和全量微调两种设置下均优于密集基线。消融实验表明两条路径均不可或缺，加权求和优于硬选择单一路径；大部分收益来自门控在不同网络层学习不同时间/空间平衡。控制音频频谱图实验表明轴分解可迁移到EEG之外。
AI.conclusion: 将注意力与结构化信号的天然轴对齐提供了有用的归纳偏置，是一种有效的注意力设计方向。

title: Eliciting Weak-to-Strong Generalization with On-Policy Reverse Distillation
summary: Weak-to-strong generalization asks whether stronger models can learn from weaker supervisors and surpass them. This question is particularly important for successive model generations and multi-domain consolidation, where repeating frontier-scale post-training from scratch can be prohibitively expensive. Yet conventional distillation treats the weak teacher as an optimization target, potentially imposing its capacity ceiling on the student. We introduce On-Policy Reverse Distillation (OPRD), which evaluates the teacher's policy shift relative to its reference policy on student rollouts and amplifies the component of the student's verifier-driven policy gradient along that direction. By rescaling only verifier-supported updates, OPRD preserves the stationary points of policy optimization while accelerating learning beyond the teacher. In both successive model transfer and multi-teacher distillation, OPRD achieves higher performance with fewer student updates than existing RL and distillation approaches. Response-style analysis shows that OPRD students remain closer to models trained with verifier-based RL alone than to their weak teachers, suggesting that teacher guidance accelerates rather than redirects the student's own optimization. Results in conventional strong-to-weak distillation further demonstrate that OPRD effectively combines verifier-driven policy optimization with teacher guidance regardless of capacity ordering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"在线策略反向蒸馏"（OPRD）的新方法，通过评估教师模型在学生回滚上的策略偏移，仅放大由验证器支持的学生策略梯度分量，从而在保留策略优化不动点的同时，实现超越教师模型限制的学习加速，在模型代际迁移和多教师蒸馏中均优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 弱到强泛化（weak-to-strong generalization）的核心问题是：更强的模型能否从较弱的监督者那里学习并超越它们。这在连续模型代际更新和多领域整合中尤为重要，因为每次从前沿规模开始重复后训练成本极高。然而，传统的蒸馏方法将弱教师视为优化目标，这可能会将教师的能力上限强加给学生模型。
AI.method: OPRD的核心创新在于：1）在学生布行的策略上评估教师相对于其参考策略的策略偏移量；2）沿着该偏移方向放大由验证器驱动的学生策略梯度分量；3）仅重缩放验证器支持的更新，从而保留策略优化的不动点同时加速学习过程。
AI.result: 在连续模型迁移和多教师蒸馏两个场景中，OPRD均以更少的训练步数实现了比现有强化学习和蒸馏方法更高的性能。实验分析表明，OPRD学生模型更接近于仅用基于验证器的RL训练的模型，而不是弱教师，说明教师引导是加速而非改方向地改变学生自身的优化轨迹。此外在传统的强到弱蒸馏场景中，OPRD也能有效结合验证器驱动的策略优化与教师引导。
AI.conclusion: OPRD证明了教师引导可以加速而非限制学生模型的自身优化过程，无论教师和学生的能力顺序如何，都能有效结合验证器驱动的策略优化与教师知识，从而实现超越教师能力上限的学习。

title: Length Generalization for Transformers via Compression
summary: Recent advancements in transformer length generalization theory enable us to reliably predict when a transformer can learn to solve a task. In particular, the C-RASP hypothesis (a formalized version of the so-called RASP-l conjecture) posits that transformers length-generalize on a task if and only if a solution is expressible in the C-RASP language. While this hypothesis has strong empirical validation, theoretical problems arise from the fact that no computable length generalization bounds exist for C-RASP, alongside the discovery of seemingly contradictory experiments. To address these problems, we refine the C-RASP hypothesis utilizing the recently-proposed fragments C-RASP+ and C-RASP1. These fragments have computable length generalization bounds, though in the worst case requiring an extremely large (double exponential) sample size. It is an open question whether these sample size bounds are tight. In this paper, we resolve this open question by providing an exponentially tighter bound. In doing so, we show a polynomial length generalization bound for transformers if we adopt compressed strings, via a novel connection to power words. As an application, we show how this yields a fine-grained analysis of the C-RASP conjecture that resolves contradicting experimental evidence against it.

AI.tldr: 本文针对C-RASP假设中缺乏可计算长度泛化界以及存在矛盾的实验证据等问题，利用C-RASP+和C-RASP1片段改进了该假设，将最坏情况下双指数样本复杂度界指数级收紧为单指数界，并通过对压缩字符串与power words的新颖联系证明了Transformer的多项式长度泛化界，最终解决了关于C-RASP猜想的矛盾实验证据。
AI.motivation: C-RASP假设虽经验验证充分，但理论上存在两个问题：一是C-RASP语言缺乏可计算的长度泛化界；二是存在看似矛盾的实验结果。这两个问题阻碍了对Transformer长度泛化能力的可靠预测和理论理解。
AI.method: 利用近期提出的C-RASP+和C-RASP1片段来改进C-RASP假设。这两个片段具有可计算的长度泛化界（但最坏情况下需要双指数样本量），本文通过提供指数级更紧的样本复杂度界来解决问题，并通过与power words的新颖联系来分析压缩字符串场景下的Transformer长度泛化。
AI.result: 本文成功将样本复杂度界从双指数收紧到单指数级别（指数级更紧），同时证明在压缩字符串条件下Transformer具有多项式长度泛化界，并基于此提供了对C-RASP猜想的细粒度分析，解析了此前看似矛盾的实验证据。
AI.conclusion: 通过收紧样本复杂度界并建立与power words的联系，本文不仅解决了C-RASP假设理论上的可计算性问题，还化解了实验证据与理论之间的矛盾，使得C-RASP假设在理论和实践上更加稳固和自洽。

title: Earth System World Model for What-If Simulations: A Case Study for Terrestrial Ecosystems
summary: Machine learning emulators have become essential for accelerating expensive Earth-system simulations, but most existing approaches remain passive forecasters: they reproduce simulator trajectories under prescribed forcings without an explicit interaction mechanism for user-specified interventions. This limits their use in interactive scientific workflows and Earth-system digital twins, where users often need to explore how a system would respond if selected state components were changed. We propose an action-conditioned world-modeling framework for Earth-system emulation that reformulates simulator trajectories as supervision for controllable state-transition learning. The key idea is transition-action pretraining: naturally observed state changes are treated as label-free action supervision, allowing the model to learn both prescribed dynamics and action-conditioned responses without manually annotated interventions. We further introduce masked response learning to infer unobserved variables under partial state edits and learn coupled system dependencies. We test this framework on ecosystem dynamics across six global regions and multiple stand ages. Experiments show that the model preserves competitive long-horizon emulation accuracy while enabling controllable structural interventions and coherent responses in coupled ecosystem-cycle variables. These results suggest a practical route from passive Earth-system emulators toward interactive, intervention-aware scientific surrogates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于动作条件的世界建模框架用于地球系统仿真模拟，通过将自然观测的状态变化作为无标签的动作监督（即过渡动作预训练），并引入掩码响应学习来处理部分状态编辑下的未观测变量推断，使模型在保持长期仿真精度的同时支持可控的结构干预和耦合系统响应，推动地球系统仿真器从被动预测向交互式干预感知的科学代理演进。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器学习仿真器大多是被动的预测器，只能复现给定强迫条件下的模拟轨迹，缺乏用户指定干预的显式交互机制，这限制了其在交互式科学工作流和地球系统数字孪生中的应用，用户通常需要探索系统的状态组件发生变化时的响应。
AI.method: 提出动作条件的世界建模框架，核心包括：1）过渡动作预训练——将自然观测到的状态变化视为无标签的动作监督，使模型无需人工标注干预即可同时学习预设动力学和动作条件响应；2）掩码响应学习——在部分状态编辑条件下推断未观测变量，学习耦合系统的依赖关系。
AI.result: 在覆盖六个全球区域和多个林龄的生态系统动力学上进行测试，实验表明该方法在保持竞争力的长期仿真精度的同时，支持可控的结构性干预，并在耦合的生态系统碳循环变量中产生一致的响应。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了从被动地球系统仿真器向交互式、干预感知的科学代理转变的实用路径，为地球系统数字孪生和交互式科学探究提供了新的方法论基础。

title: The BatchNorm Illusion: Diagnosing Normalization Artifacts in Machine Unlearning Evaluation
summary: Approximate machine unlearning aims to remove the influence of specific training data from a trained model without retraining from scratch. We identify a previously undocumented confound in how unlearning is evaluated on BatchNorm-based architectures: a single forward pass over retain data, an operation that modifies no weight, can deterministically rewrite the model's normalization state and reverse the apparent surface-metric forgetting. We formalize this operation as a weight-preserving fixed-point operator and prove that any pre-versus-post gap it induces is provably attributable to BN running statistics rather than to any modification the unlearning method made to the weights. This attribution claim cleanly separates measurement failure (BN artifact) from encoder failure (residual weight-encoded information, recently documented in concurrent work), and the same operator framework yields a unique decomposition of linear-probe elevation into BN-measurement-bias and encoder-geometry components. Empirically, the artifact reverses headline forget accuracy by up to 78 pp across nine evaluated methods on standard benchmarks; an attacker with as few as 10 unlabeled images recovers most of the masked accuracy; and a strict GroupNorm control reduces the artifact to zero across all methods. The tested membership-inference attacks change little under recalibration, locating the observed evaluation failure in forget accuracy and linear probing.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了近似机器遗忘评估中的一个新混淆因素：在基于BatchNorm的架构上，仅对保留数据进行一次前向传播（不修改任何权重）就能确定性重写模型的归一化状态，并逆转表面上的遗忘效果。作者将该操作形式化为保持权重的定点算子，并证明了该方法产生的间隙可归因于BN运行统计而非权重修改。
AI.motivation: 现有机器遗忘方法在BatchNorm架构上的评估可能存在系统性偏差，即遗忘指标的变化并非来自权重修改带来的真实遗忘，而是BN运行统计的伪影所导致的测量假象。此前这一混淆未被记录，可能导致对遗忘方法的错误评价。
AI.method: 作者将"对保留数据做一次前向传播"这一操作形式化为权重保持的定点算子，证明其引发的遗忘前后差距可严格归属为BN运行统计而非权重修改。进一步利用同一算子框架，将线性探针的精度上升分解为BN测量偏差与编码器几何结构两部分。同时采用严格的GroupNorm对照实验来消除伪影，并测试成员推断攻击在重校准下的表现。
AI.result: 该伪影在标准基准上可使九种遗忘方法的头部遗忘精度反转高达78个百分点；攻击者仅用10张未标注图像即可恢复大部分被掩盖的精度；GroupNorm对照可将伪影降为零。成员推断攻击在重校准后变化不大，表明评估失败主要存在于遗忘精度和线性探针中。
AI.conclusion: 机器遗忘评估在BatchNorm架构上存在系统性测量缺陷，需要将BN测量伪影与真实的权重编码遗忘分离。GroupNorm等替代归一化方案可作为消除此类伪影的可靠对照手段，为更准确的遗忘评估提供了方法论基础。

title: GraphFAS: A Distributed System for Automated Graph Feature Generation and Selection in Industrial Transaction Networks
summary: Industrial fraud detection often relies on costly expert-crafted features that overlook graph-structured relational signals, while GNNs often do not meet the interpretability and deployment requirements of financial risk control. We propose GraphFAS (Graph Feature Automated Selection), a distributed feature selection procedure based on Boruta that bridges this gap through: (1) a non-parametric graph feature generation module that constructs explicit, interpretable structural features via multi-hop subgraph extraction and multi-scale aggregation without learned parameters; and (2) an automated distributed feature selection algorithm extending Boruta with median-based aggregation across partitions to robustly identify informative features at scale with minimal domain expertise. Compared with end-to-end GNN pipelines, GraphFAS decouples feature aggregation from model training, enabling direct integration with tabular models and direct compatibility with TreeSHAPbased explanations. Deployed in Alipay, GraphFAS delivers orderof-magnitude improvements in engineering efficiency while showing strong performance against expert-driven and graph-learning baselines on large-scale graphs.

AI.tldr: GraphFAS是一种基于Boruta的分布式特征选择方法，通过非参数图特征生成模块构建显式可解释的结构特征，并扩展Boruta算法实现大规模分布式特征选择，已部署于支付宝并在工程效率上取得数量级提升。
AI.motivation: 工业欺诈检测通常依赖昂贵且需专家手工构造的特征，忽略了图结构中的关系信号；而GNN方法往往难以满足金融风控对可解释性和部署效率的要求。
AI.method: 提出GraphFAS框架，包含两个核心部分：(1)非参数图特征生成模块，通过多跳子图提取和多尺度聚合构建显式可解释的结构特征，无需学习参数；(2)基于Boruta扩展的自动分布式特征选择算法，采用基于中位数的跨分区聚合策略，在大规模数据上稳健识别信息性特征。该方法将特征聚合与模型训练解耦，可直接集成表格模型并兼容TreeSHAP解释。
AI.result: 在支付宝大规模图数据上部署，GraphFAS相比专家驱动方法和图学习基线展现出强劲性能，并在工程效率上实现了数量级的提升。
AI.conclusion: GraphFAS有效弥合了传统专家特征与GNN之间的差距，在保证可解释性的同时实现大规模自动化特征选择，为工业风控场景提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Transformers as In-Context Samplers: From Closed-Form Diffusion to Estimation-Free Sampling
summary:
A growing body of work establishes that large language models are not mere statistical memorizers, but are capable of in-context learning: performing inference at test time using only examples provided in the prompt, without any parameter updates. Prior theoretical work has shown that this capability extends to supervised learning tasks such as linear regression. We prove that in-context learning extends further to \emph{data generation}: frozen transformers can simulate iterative generative samplers from in-context samples. We first show that transformers can realize closed-form and smoothed closed-form diffusion samplers. The construction identifies a concrete generative role for softmax attention: it computes responsibility weights and weighted empirical averages, while feedforward layers implement Euler updates.
  To empirically relate these constructions to pretrained language models, we study \emph{semantic-topic sampling}: prompts consisting of words drawn from a common semantic category, such as animals, foods, or cities. Across transformer layers, the normalized hidden states exhibit a two-stage geometry: they move toward a uniform spherical reference in intermediate layers and then return to structured, topic-dependent representations near the output. We further measure an interacting-particle energy on these hidden-state clouds and observe the same U-shape pattern. We then prove that transformers can approximate an energy-based sampler, constructing the same U-shape energy across the layers.

AI.tldr: 本文证明冻结的Transformer可以通过上下文学习实现数据生成，而不只是监督学习任务。作者展示了Transformer可以实现闭式扩散采样器和能量基采样器，并在预训练语言模型上观察到语义主题采样中的两阶段几何结构和U形能量模式。
AI.motivation: 以往的理论工作表明大语言模型具备上下文学习能力并扩展到线性回归等监督学习任务，但尚未有工作证明这一能力是否能进一步扩展到数据生成领域。作者希望从理论和实证两方面弥合这一空白。
AI.method: 作者首先通过构造性证明展示Transformer可以实现闭式及平滑闭式扩散采样器，其中softmax注意力计算责任权重和加权经验均值，前馈层实现Euler更新。随后在预训练语言模型上研究"语义主题采样"任务，分析隐藏状态的几何结构，并测量交互粒子能量。最后证明Transformer可以近似能量基采样器，构造出层间相同的U形能量分布。
AI.result: 理论证明Transformer能够实现从上下文样本中进行迭代式生成采样。实证发现在语义主题采样中，归一化隐藏状态呈现两阶段几何：中间层趋向均匀球面参考，输出层附近恢复为主题相关的结构表示。交互粒子能量呈现U形模式，与构造的能量基采样器一致。
AI.conclusion: 上下文学习的能力不仅限于监督学习，还扩展到数据生成任务。生成式上下文学习为理解预训练语言模型的隐式生成机制提供了新的理论基础，揭示了注意力机制在生成采样中的具体作用。

title: Physics-Informed Deep Learning for False Ventricular Tachycardia Alarm Reduction in the ICU
summary: False ventricular tachycardia (VT) alarms are a leading contributor to alarm fatigue in intensive care units. We propose a deep learning framework combining a 1D SE-ResNet with ICU-realistic data augmentations and a physics-informed auxiliary reconstruction task based on the three-element Windkessel hemodynamic model, implemented as a differentiable forward simulation. By requiring the network's latent representation to produce physiologically plausible arterial pressure waveforms, artifact-driven ECG patterns are penalized while true VT remains coherent across modalities. Evaluated on the VTaC benchmark under a strict real-time protocol (10-second pre-alarm window), our method achieves a 5-point Challenge Score improvement over prior state-of-the-art. Ablation studies confirm that the physics-informed objective is the primary performance driver, providing gains in accuracy, 2x label efficiency, and more localized and clinically meaningful ECG segments.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种深度学习框架，结合1D SE-ResNet、ICU真实数据增强和基于三元件Windkessel血流动力学模型的物理信息辅助重建任务，用于鉴别ICU中的假室性心动过速（VT）警报，在VTaC基准上较先前最优方法提升了5点Challenge Score。
AI.motivation: ICU中假性VT警报是导致报警疲劳的主要原因，亟需有效方法区分真假VT警报，提升临床监测的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出一个深度学习框架，包含三个关键组件：1D SE-ResNet作为主干网络；ICU真实场景下的数据增强策略；基于三元件Windkessel血流动力学模型的可微前向仿真辅助重建任务，要求网络潜在表示生成生理上合理的动脉血压波形，从而惩罚由伪影驱动的ECG模式，同时保持真实VT在多模态间的一致性。
AI.result: 在VTaC基准的严格实时协议（10秒预警窗口）下评估，方法较先前最优方法获得5点Challenge Score提升。消融研究证实物理信息目标是主要的性能驱动因素，带来精度提升、2倍标签效率和更局部化且临床有意义的ECG片段。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息约束辅助任务能够有效提升假VT警报鉴别的性能与标签效率，产出更具临床解释性的结果，为ICU报警疲劳问题提供了可行解决方案。

title: Let It Go or Learn to Self-Correct: Continuous Diffusion for Constrained Discrete Tasks
comment: Preprint. The main results of this work were obtained by May 2026
summary: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models (DDPMs) generate samples by starting from noise and repeatedly denoising while keeping each update close to the current noisy state. This behavior is effective in many continuous domains, but its role is less clear for globally constrained discrete tasks, such as Sudoku, graph connectivity, Latin squares, and N-queens. In such settings, early discrete errors can be difficult to undo. As a result, standard diffusion sampling may preserve early mistakes, even when the model's clean predictions are informative. We compare standard samplers to sampling directly from the model's clean prediction. Without retraining, this single change improves Sudoku validity from 31% to 95%, with consistent gains across the other discrete tasks. We hypothesize that staying close to the current noisy state is harmful because the reverse trajectory can drift off the forward noising distribution the model was trained on. To reduce this train-test mismatch, we further introduce self-correction training, which exposes the model to its own predictions, improving robustness to errors that arise during inference. This substantially improves the performance of standard samplers. Our results suggest that continuous diffusion models can learn nontrivial global constraints, but discrete reasoning tasks require better alignment between training and inference: either through samplers that reduce commitment to early decisions, or through training that teaches the model to correct its own inference-time errors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了扩散模型在全局约束离散任务（如数独、图连通性、拉丁方、N皇后）中的应用问题，发现标准扩散采样会保留早期错误。直接采样模型的干净预测可将数独有效性从31%提升至95%，并引入自校正训练进一步提升标准采样器的性能。
AI.motivation: DDPM在连续域表现优异，但在全局约束的离散任务中，早期离散误差难以撤销，标准扩散采样可能保留早期错误，即使模型的干净预测具有信息量。因此需要探索更适合离散推理任务的采样与训练策略。
AI.method: 1) 无需重新训练，直接采样模型的干净预测替代标准扩散采样；2) 引入自校正训练（self-correction training），在训练过程中暴露模型自身的预测，增强其对推理阶段错误的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 直接采样干净预测使数独有效性从31%提升到95%，在其他离散任务上也有一致提升。自校正训练显著改善了标准采样器的性能。
AI.conclusion: 连续扩散模型能够学习非平凡的全局约束，但离散推理任务需要更好的训练与推理对齐：可通过减少对早期决策的承诺的采样器，或通过教会模型纠正推理阶段错误的训练方式来实现。

title: Training-Free Task Vectors for LLM Behavioral Control
summary: Task vectors enable post-training model editing by identifying semantically meaningful directions in weight space, typically computed as the difference between a fine-tuned model and its pretrained initialization. However, this reliance on fine-tuning makes discovering such directions costly and limits the practicality of post-training model editing. To address this limitation, we introduce Training-Free Task Vectors (TFTVs), a novel method to compute task-vector-like directions without requiring fine-tuning. Our method maps activation steering vectors to rank-one weight-space edits using only forward-pass statistics, while satisfying arithmetic properties that directly support learning via addition, forgetting via subtraction, and the composition of multiple edits. Empirically, we evaluate TFTVs on large language model behavioral control tasks and show that they consistently amplify, suppress, and compose target behaviors while preserving general knowledge and problem-solving skills. We also validate our method against other editing and steering baselines, experimentally demonstrating that TFTVs achieve stronger trait control with better or competitive utility preservation. We hope our work opens new directions for the community in post-training model editing and broader training-free model control. Code is available on the project website: tftv-llm.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出训练自由任务向量（TFTVs），一种无需微调即可计算任务向量类方向的方法，通过仅使用前向传播统计将激活引导向量映射为秩一权重空间编辑，支持行为增强、抑制与组合，在LLM行为控制任务上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统任务向量依赖微调模型与预训练模型的权重差值来计算，但微调成本高昂，限制了后训练模型编辑的实际应用性。作者希望摆脱对微调的依赖，以更高效的方式发现语义上有意义的方向。
AI.method: TFTVs通过仅使用前向传播统计信息，将激活引导向量（activation steering vectors）映射为秩一权重空间编辑（rank-one weight-space edits），无需微调。该方法满足算术性质，可直接支持行为增强（加法）、遗忘（减法）以及多编辑组合。
AI.result: 在大型语言模型行为控制任务上进行评估，TFTVs能一致地放大、抑制和组合目标行为，同时保持通用知识和问题解决能力。对比其他编辑和引导基线方法，TFTVs实现了更强的特征控制能力，且效用保持更好或相当。
AI.conclusion: TFTVs为后训练模型编辑和训练自由的模型控制开辟了新方向，提供了低成本且高效的任务向量替代方案。代码已在项目网站上公开。

title: PlayTrain: An Efficient Reinforcement Learning Framework for LLM-Generated Adaptable JavaScript Games
summary: While many video-game environments (VGEs) have played crucial roles in advancing reinforcement learning (RL), developing novel VGEs or modifying existing ones to support new features, has been a laborious process requiring extensive hand-coding. Here we present PlayTrain, an RL framework that combines the abilities of large language models (LLMs) to robustly generate JavaScript (JS) games from a minimal human prompt, and an efficient pipeline that can run any JS game in a standard 'gym' environment. Not only are recent LLMs particularly good at writing JS code, but the JS format also allows users to easily play generated VGEs, while PlayTrain enables us to train RL agents on the exact same games. We demonstrate multiple use cases of PlayTrain, including cloning well-known Atari and ProcGen games in simple JS, where PlayTrain trains pixel-based agents end-to-end at over 1M agent-decisions per second on a single GPU node; and creating modified versions thereof (e.g., that support novel test sets, procedural generation logics, or game dynamics). Through PlayTrain, we reimagine RL VGE development: all we need is a single JS file, generated and modified through an LLM. We discuss promising future RL research directions that PlayTrain unlocks.

AI.tldr: PlayTrain是一个将LLM自动生成JavaScript游戏的能力与高效强化学习训练管线相结合的框架。它只需用户提供简短提示即可生成游戏，并能以每秒超过100万次智能体决策的速度在单个GPU节点上端到端训练像素级智能体。
AI.motivation: 传统的视频游戏环境开发或修改需要大量手工编码，过程繁琐费力。尽管现有VGE在推动RL研究中发挥了关键作用，但创建新环境或为现有环境添加新功能一直是劳动密集型工作，亟需更高效的自动化方案。
AI.method: PlayTrain利用大语言模型从极简人工提示中稳健地生成JavaScript游戏代码，并通过一个高效的管线将任意JS游戏标准化接入gym环境。JS格式既便于用户亲自游玩体验，又能让RL智能体在完全相同的环境上进行训练。
AI.result: PlayTrain能够克隆知名的Atari和ProcGen游戏为简洁的JS版本，并以超过1M agent-decisions/秒的速度在单个GPU节点上端到端训练像素级智能体；还能生成支持新测试集、程序化生成逻辑或新游戏动态的修改版本。此外展示了多种用例。
AI.conclusion: PlayTrain重新构想了RL游戏环境开发范式——只需一个由LLM生成和修改的JS文件即可完成全部工作，并为未来的RL研究方向开辟了新的可能性。

title: Multi-Task Learning for Sparsely-Labeled Time Series: A Case Study on Cold-Hardiness Modeling
summary: We present a real-world case study of multi-task learning (MTL) for temporal process modeling from limited data with temporally sparse labels. Specifically, we investigate multi-task learning for the important agricultural problem of predicting grape cold hardiness, which is the temperature at which lethal freezing occurs. Cold hardiness changes in response to weather and is difficult to measure directly in the field. Thus, growers rely on predictions to decide when to apply costly frost mitigation measures. We apply recurrent neural networks (RNNs) for daily cold-hardiness prediction from time series weather data. A major challenge is that the cold hardiness response varies across plant cultivars and ground-truth data for each cultivar is temporally sparse and limited. To address this challenge, we investigate multi-task learning (MTL) approaches for combining data, where different tasks correspond to different cultivars. We develop a variety of MTL architectures and evaluate them in both MTL and transfer learning settings. Our results show significant differences between architectures and that certain architectures are able to consistently outperform single-task learning and state-of-the-art scientific models. Additionally, we show similar results for the qualitatively different, but related, task of budbreak prediction. Further, improved accuracy for budbreak and cold hardiness is achieved by a single MTL model that simultaneously learns both tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个多任务学习（MTL）在时间过程建模中的真实世界案例研究，应用于葡萄抗寒性预测这一农业问题。通过循环神经网络（RNNs）从时间序列气象数据预测每日葡萄抗寒性，采用MTL方法联合不同品种的数据。结果表明某些MTL架构能持续优于单任务学习和最先进的科学模型，且在芽破裂预测任务上也有类似表现，甚至单一MTL模型同时学习两个任务能进一步提高精度。
AI.motivation: 葡萄冷硬度难以直接测量，种植者依赖预测来决定是否采取昂贵的防冻措施。然而冷硬度反应因品种而异，且每个品种的标注数据在时间上稀疏且有限，给预测带来了巨大挑战。
AI.method: 将不同葡萄品种作为不同任务，采用RNN进行每日冷硬度预测，开发多种多任务学习架构，在MTL和迁移学习两种设置下进行评估，并将冷硬度和芽破裂两个相关任务联合学习。
AI.result: 不同MTL架构之间存在显著差异，部分架构能持续超越单任务学习及最先进的科学模型；在芽破裂预测中也有类似结论；联合学习两个任务的单一MTL模型获得了更高的预测精度。
AI.conclusion: MTL在稀疏、有限标注数据的真实农业应用中具有明显优势，通过合理的架构设计和多任务联合学习，可以有效提升时间过程建模的预测性能。

title: ThinkPrior: Zero-Rollout Difficulty Priors for Cold-Start Prompt Selection in RLVR
summary: In reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) trained with group relative policy optimization (GRPO), the KL-free reward-advantage term studied here depends on within-group reward variation. If all rollouts in a group are correct or all are wrong, their group-relative advantages are identically zero; these zero-advantage silent groups provide no reward-advantage gradient, yet uniform sampling spends 39% of a run's rollouts on them.
